  [#179584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179584) · [6699d70](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6699d706dc35aa150153ef033095262b4120a589) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Reorganizes the Context panel so you can see usage, refresh the report or compact when permitted without scrolling through every category. Choose **View context** from the composer to open one category at a time and search or expand long lists. Focusing a category highlights its share of usage, and **Escape** closes it and returns focus to its button. Background refresh keeps your open category and search. [Chat context guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180332">PR #180332</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/06a3bbdcc1dece03692fc12f64f6cdcd2912758a">Commit 06a3bbd</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>
- Adds machine details to the session placement menu and a **Machine** page on mobile for eligible sessions. A clearer confirmation explains what stopping a cloud or device worker means for the session and lets you retry if the stop fails. It will not stop a different worker if the session changes while the confirmation is open.
  [Session machine and worker controls #176445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176445) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds a People view to mobile chat for viewers and, when available, the conversation’s creator, owner and participants. An available mention action inserts a mention into your draft without sending it.
  [PR #176505](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176505) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fa4f5241e891f1339162077b5e05b7b379339e9d) · [Mobile Details host](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/ui/src/pages/chat/chat-details-mobile-host-content.tsx#L274). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Limits the desktop chat header to three viewer avatars with a count for the rest. In Details, the People list identifies the owner and links to profile activity where available; the collapsed section shows the total when the complete list has more than three people, and shows a count for known participants not yet loaded.
  Chat Details People — [#186025](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186025) · [`fff56630`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fff56630338adf921d6eb30fbd411452cdf4adf1). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski); Desktop session Details and presence — [Details](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/panels) [PR #176454](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176454) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/baa2a6d69f3caf299b45c8337906e4cb7ec26c66) · [Details integration #176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653) · [integration commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1894bb9b0a5327e1e19535a9adcfae520b26c027) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Gives the session name more room in mobile chat and lets you tap it to open Details, even when disconnected. On the narrowest screens, Panels and the session Dashboard, when available, move into Actions.
  [#181076](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181076) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c78f168cba73245d5b9459f271fd7f4e338cef69)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores the desktop chat Details panel in one pass when reloading a cached chat, so sections appear together before live data fills in.
  [#185242](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185242) · [dad7cbe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dad7cbe17463dd9040f723d69f2826cf8e931fdf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes session Details easier to scan with clearer headings and more separation between each section and its contents.
  [#174725](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174725) · [`22d416b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22d416b82ef9b2946e6b44b87f83c7a3273d29d2). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fades long labels where they’re cut off in Details and related panels so badges, file extensions and buttons stay visible. The selected pull request title uses a two-line ellipsis on mobile.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179752">#179752</a> · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>
- Tucks away the path and branch copy buttons in **Details → Environment** until you hover over a row or move keyboard focus into it. The buttons stay visible on devices that don’t support hover.
  [#173812](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173812). [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bbb7faabfc0efe14d1214f57efa843594948ad33). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Chat and Side chat

- Adds photo attachments, microphone dictation and emoji suggestions to [Side chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#session-rail-and-side-chat), along with its own model, reasoning and speed choices. **Default** uses the agent’s utility model and fallbacks; an explicitly selected model handles the question on its own, and photo questions need an image-capable model.
  [#177699](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177699) · [29947bba](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29947bbaaad642fcf8d6d8d37b661f5df26ce205). Thanks to [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Removes the extra **Clear side chat** button from the desktop side tab. Hiding the panel or switching tabs keeps the thread and draft. Closing the tab clears the thread, and the tab stays open if the reset fails. The main panel and mobile still offer **Clear side chat**, which keeps drafts, images, and questions added after you click. Empty Side chat on mobile uses the same layout as other panels. See the [chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176575">#176575</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a39a64fb1cc21631601bcdb2ddce3d528dd8cdbf">a39a64fb</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds previews of installed skill instructions to [Control UI chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat). Hover over or focus a `SKILL.md` link for a local skill available to the selected agent, then copy its source or open the file in Review. Previews show up to 400 lines.
  Gateway clients with `operator.read` can retrieve these files through `skills.files.get`. [PR #174781](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174781) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/646647245f1ac802d5eaf04899cccfa228969720). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Brings Side chat in line with the main chat. Questions and answers use the same bubbles and spacing, with a timestamp and Copy when you hover over a message, and pending answers use the same working indicator.
  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen). [#180133](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180133) · [commit 64cc717](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/64cc7173c662b81fbcca3ff0efa0a7145d5a2f31)

###### Terminal and panels

- Adds a command box to the embedded terminal for preparing a command and uploaded file paths before submitting them. Each terminal keeps its draft and attachments as you switch sessions or move the panel; mobile also gets a session picker and available file controls.
  Closing a live personal terminal on mobile asks for confirmation. [PR #176540](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176540) and [commit 45d8d6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/45d8d6fda35ff53f164a6ed98fb6400a34a37d7e). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Brings the machine name and controls for viewing, taking control, sizing and fullscreen together in the Control UI’s Remote Desktop panel. Connection progress and sign-in prompts are clearer, and a Retry action appears after a connection failure. On mobile, the panel can also open in a new window when available.
  [Remote Desktop controls #176546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176546) and [Remote Desktop changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b285d46c19b11a18b8bb91d97745d57d4ff9f0a7) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds **Refresh** and **Copy link** to embedded portals on desktop. Copied links exclude the launch token. If a portal can’t load, the recovery screen explains why and offers **Retry** or **Open in a new tab** where available. On mobile, the header shows the portal name and the menu offers **Open in browser** and **Close** when permitted.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176557">#176557</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9c9a8deed34193e1131fc15d549c390c0811453e">9c9a8dee</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Uses the standard desktop panel layout when Discussion is unavailable or can’t open inside the panel. If an external link is available, you can use it to open the discussion.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176579">#176579</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/47b2a3fe6b852bb1e250dc1568b9b4317a110c5f">47b2a3fe</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Lets agents expand a browser, terminal, desktop, or portal panel to fill the conversation pane and restore the split view.
  <span>Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165153">#165153</a></span>
- Moves the Panels menu from the bottom of the screen to beside its button in phone-width chat layouts.
  [PR #174883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174883) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5302cc8e522ff279862ce6e160f42e212fbb35a4). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Adds placeholders shaped like the content you are waiting for in desktop and mobile session panels, including a document-shaped placeholder for HTML attachments.
  Chat Details and session panels — [#178939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178939), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178951). Thanks to [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski); Chat HTML attachment loading — <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180493">PR #180493</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/efbdecccd9557eceec4afe1d0a878d5e9adcf9dc">Commit efbdecc</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Makes empty session panels such as Subagents, Processes and Discussion look consistent on desktop and mobile, and gives Browser and Terminal actions matching buttons. Keeps empty pages in mobile Details from shifting when there’s no description or action.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181892">#181892</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/904ab2e8da31826c6dd0bdbdb4b1e126b8c0acdf">904ab2e8</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Makes submenu arrows consistent in the Control UI, including in right-to-left layouts. Updates the desktop Files controls and the mobile Files empty screen to match the session panel styling.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176321), [43ff445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/43ff44578522a45f39c9e65c6eceeb329db8214c).
- Aligns labels and icons in the Control UI side-panel launcher, lightens the shortcut hints, and gives the empty desktop panel a transparent header.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183351">#183351</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1e5df7d9ecffcd323ec45cbff92691e62d6a180f">1e5df7d</a> · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>

##### Web chat and dashboard

<a id="saved-a2ui-widgets"></a>

- Removes A2UI widgets and the Plugin SDK hook for custom widget renderers. [HTML widgets](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/show-widget) can replace saved A2UI widgets. Other widgets using the retired hook show their source as a preview instead of working interactively. Existing HTML, native plugin and MCP App widgets remain supported.
  Attempts to add a retired registered widget leave the board unchanged and point to HTML widgets. [Retire A2UI widgets and registered renderers](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182109) · [Client compatibility and retired widget handling](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182277) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Opening and reading conversations

- Removes an extra wait before sending the first message in a new session and shows the new conversation in the sidebar while the Gateway accepts the message.
  - Removes an extra wait before the first message is sent when a new Control UI session needs a worker. The session stays visible in the sidebar while the list catches up, and its working indicator appears once OpenClaw accepts the message.
    [#185625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185625) · [b08dc84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b08dc847dc348a171af48a2b3e329411c5363700) · [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Shows a temporary selected row with the other sessions in the sidebar as soon as you send the first message in a new conversation, while the Gateway accepts it. See [sessions and the sidebar](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar.md).
    [PR #174888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174888) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c1d5fdb6bb21a0ba5c948c1c7f49c0c6127591c8). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Cuts initial Control UI downloads when opening Chat or starting a new session by loading optional views and menus as needed, and prioritizes the conversation and message box on a cold Chat reload. It also reduces delays on the first load after a Gateway restart. New Session menus offer Retry if they fail to load, and the Plus menu stays open with Retry if its options fail.
  - Reduces work when opening chats, prioritizing the conversation and message box on cold reloads while optional views and media load as needed.
    - Reduces work when opening a conversation by rendering fewer offscreen rows and preparing menus, the Context breakdown and Details when you open them. Details remembers expanded sections, and live subagent status stays visible while previews load. Reloads also avoid downloading all settings just to check whether **Read aloud** is available.

###### Chat and new sessions

- Updates the mobile message box to start compact and expand when you edit. You can open composer menus, use its controls or tap the blank space around it without losing your place in the draft. The first tap to edit won’t send the draft as the box expands. Session activity, approvals and queued messages sit alongside the composer.
  [PR #176498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176498) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bc029e59c6cef775559b6603091316560b00760). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Refines the New Session project picker with an existing-folder choice for the selected device. Admins can browse, writers can enter a path, and unsupported models show an unavailable state. The agent picker moves to the welcome name when you have more than one agent, and repository and checkout controls stay together on narrow screens.
  Device folders — [PR #190088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190088); release-adaptation import repair [Commit 3f181e7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f181e76c435f56637dac6388c45014e6b97f621). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release-adaptation import repair. New Session layout — [#175255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175255) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Makes the New Session selectors more compact on phones, leaving more room for your prompt. Open the picker to see full values, including the OS and machine size.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173186">#173186</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Adds a scrollable activity strip above the mobile message box for relevant subagents, goals, task progress, pull requests and publication status. Tap an item for details. The strip shows refresh status. During an approval it hides other activity but keeps the session’s goal visible if it has one. [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  [Mobile activity #176378](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176378) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/744df3f99b8bcbf50026f4c194aee1fff2245f74) · [Mobile composer #176498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176498) · [Panel navigation #176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Keeps your agent’s public handoff message in Control UI chat when work resumes. The wait indicator shows the sessions involved, their status and requests for your input, with links where available. A **Resumed** marker shows how long the wait lasted and can expand to show those sessions.
  [#185585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185585) · [0ab9fc0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0ab9fc06cc61f944e6201a7b5f53fc47945772e5) · [Chat handoff guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Shows active subagent tasks before their progress totals, and shows a working indicator with elapsed time while Side chat waits for an answer.
  [Subagent progress #172492](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172492) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f2cc6f7ef231f62246aaeb9ce097b61d8c6aa09) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Side chat #172546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172546) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/24b285489674539ee337e60e2fcca00dc75bd206) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Groups active tool work and delegated tasks into an expandable bubble in the optional speech-bubble layout, with links to task sessions. Routine waiting labels and timers become dots.
  [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182068](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182068) · [`0d49ef7b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0d49ef7bd1c6fa024d76e962995a0f37aa93c74e)
- Makes tool activity easier to scan with compact rows and results that fit the conversation width. Group summaries no longer count earlier failed or skipped steps as if the current step were failing; expand a group to see individual outcomes. Approval blocks and unknown outcomes still appear in summaries.
  Tool activity layout — [#186041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186041) · [`7fa041d8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7fa041d80fc2e3f970e7642dc179002fc33b61df). The header labels the current step so it doesn’t read like a count of completed steps. Hiding the card doesn’t stop the task or clear saved progress for everyone.

- Folds consecutive system notices, such as recovery and model fallback events, into one compact row in Control UI chat. Open the **system events** row to read them in order, including any delivery notices in the group. A notice on its own still appears directly in the conversation.
  [#173838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173838). Thanks to steipete. [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5c7055a700674c253e7f24d5f923ad95ef9bf8d)
- Removes redundant waiting and routine restart text from Control UI chat while keeping explanations for interruptions and cancellations.

- Adds [desktop chat shortcut guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#desktop-message-input) for sending, inserting a newline, changing the Send shortcut and choosing whether a follow-up waits or steers a reply in progress. - Adds on-device compression for oversized videos in Chat and New Session, with a retry in the attachment card if it fails and availability depending on browser codec support.

Availability depends on browser codec support. See the [chat attachment guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat).
    [#172844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172844) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

Adds a **Retry compression** button so you can try again without reattaching the original video. Finished attachments show the format and size, and the sent file keeps its original base name with the extension for the actual video format.

- Adds a **Media** option in Chat and New Session for selecting existing photos and videos together in supported browsers. The selection goes into your draft without sending it. ###### Sessions and sidebar

- Moves pinned conversations out of the navigation rail and into **Pinned** at the top of Sessions, where they appear as full rows. Drag a conversation to the rail to add a separate shortcut. Removing either the pin or the shortcut leaves the other in place. The sidebar remembers whether you collapsed Pinned. - Shows more sessions in the Control UI sidebar before you need **Show more**. **Collapse** restores the starting view, and each grouping keeps its own expansion.
  The sidebar starts with 30 ungrouped sessions or 15 per group, and **Show more** adds 15 at a time. [Sidebar session limits #186715](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186715) · [Commit fcfe9a6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fcfe9a652b815ad9b4020916140b696eb13f31bb) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes the duplicate owner heading when you group sidebar sessions by Person and select one owner. That owner’s sessions appear directly below the picker even if you previously collapsed the group.
  [#178846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178846), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc99b8c03f536f6f6fc50714a46d1ec8e1f77e1). Thanks to [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Shows up to three pull requests in the [session sidebar hovercard](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar) instead of one and a count, with titles, repositories, and CI status when available. Session views put open and draft pull requests first and use consistent status icons. Unavailable line counts are no longer shown as zero.
  [PR #173885](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173885) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6508e01b27c650e425717609bddee8fca6f1c7bf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the last assistant reply in the compact agent roster when you send a follow-up, without rereading the conversation just to rebuild that preview.
  [#175534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175534). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Batches session list and sidebar refreshes when another client or agent creates sessions. Those sessions normally appear within five seconds, with longer waits possible after a slow refresh. Sessions you create here still appear as soon as they’re accepted. See the [sessions and sidebar guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176581">#176581</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7342277809d06331dc6d89f00a4b7ffdeefbf087">73422778</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts background checks for native Claude and Codex sessions in the [Control UI sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar). A visible tab checks every two minutes instead of every 30 seconds, so sessions started outside OpenClaw can take that long to appear after native indexing. Returning to the tab prompts a refresh, and you can still refresh manually.
  [PR #174404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174404) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fb6a79afeef143aaf54c661af442bb5c01dbcebf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work and traffic as the session sidebar refreshes by sending changed rows, including across tabs and in team mode; refresh the sidebar if an automatic refresh leaves it stale.
  - Reduces data sent for sidebar session updates by refreshing changed rows and reusing cached lists, including on busy Gateways with competing views. A full list is used when a matching comparison is unavailable. Refresh the sidebar if it remains stale after an automatic refresh fails.

###### Boards, dashboards and activity

- Starts preparing visible saved dashboard widgets while reconnecting when saved access remains valid. MCP Apps without confirmed approval wait for live data, and widget actions wait for the connection. Dashboard app content can appear sooner, including in fullscreen, with clicks disabled until it is ready. The options button beside dashboard tabs is also visible without hovering.
  Dashboards — <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178113">#178113</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5ec154f290deccb315e380c9581b1abf8a435020">5ec154f2</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · [Control UI reconnect behavior](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect.md) · Dashboard app loading — [#178740](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178740) · [`017a4ed`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/017a4ede84c4e4244f063c986501a845b28a24ab) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Control UI dashboards — <span>[#179058](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179058) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) · [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui)</span> · <span>[#179086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179086) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski)</span>

###### Sharing and notifications

- Reduces disruptions to your place during live refreshes of public conversations and adds **Top**, **Latest** and **Refresh now** controls. New messages follow automatically when you are already at the end.
  <span>Identical tool groups can affect restoration of expanded steps or reading position. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173181">#173181</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/urls.md">Public conversation links</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Adds an optional animated preview for shared chat and dashboard links. The preview opens on a still image with **Play animation**, and apps without video support can show the still. External players need access to the public preview video when the Control UI is behind a login proxy. [Shared link guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls)
  External players need access to the public preview video when the Control UI is behind a login proxy. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182221">#182221</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Adds explicit session labels to browser **Agent finished** notifications in **Names only** and **Detailed** modes, so you can tell which conversation finished. Private notifications stay generic.
  [Browser notification settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/notifications) [#144862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/144862) · Thanks to [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the change and [@holdyounger](https://github.com/holdyounger) for the report.

###### Settings and interface controls

- Adds a banner to the [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui) that tells you where to make changes when Gateway configuration is read-only. Deployment admins can set their own instructions and a documentation link, and service setup preserves the notice.
  [PR #187015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187015). Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Speeds up the first [settings read](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration) after a Gateway restart. It also reduces the work needed to hide secrets when saving settings, using `/config` or `/debug`, or recording command transcripts. The first request for the settings form itself may take longer.
  [PR #175818](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175818) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1fe9f58c6b7231251e8b21adae23b08239d60aa). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows when Settings is saving, applying changes or reloading, and prevents repeated footer actions while it works. Reload also prevents editing until the configuration has been read.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180360">PR #180360</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d731b3fef0739305e97c477ccf7bb16b121541cc">Commit d731b3f</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Removes routine Saving and Saved notices from settings autosaves while keeping save errors visible. **Apply changes** appears once a save requiring it is confirmed. Keyboard shortcut badges are also easier to read and more consistent across menus and popovers.
  [#184865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184865) · [609a8bd7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/609a8bd7b2b80fe417fb31e2888aedf3efbf7155) · [#184883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184883) · [c752ceeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c752ceeb68ed64b55a5bb35a6758854b5de9cd8e). Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Adds accessible saving feedback when you save or retry Remember settings in the command palette, while keeping the controls usable. Closing settings or reconnecting clears old feedback without cancelling a save already underway.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179836">#179836</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Reduces first-visit downloads by loading optional Settings sections and the Automations job editor when needed. The editor shows a loading state and offers a retry if it fails to load. Hovering over or focusing Settings and Sessions navigation can start preparing those pages.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183367">#183367</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40f1601663df41b7b0da7f41da4831ebee63fc48">40f1601</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Loads Settings without unrelated screens, shows language, theme and typography controls when ready, and offers Retry if a later settings load fails.
  - Shows language, theme and typography controls as soon as their settings are ready, and offers **Retry** if a later settings load fails. Appearance delays offscreen artwork, unchanged settings and schemas take less repeated work, and Privacy & Security can be prepared in the background when Advanced settings is idle in a visible, connected tab with data saver off. The Chat sidebar also takes less work to render when first opened.
    [#183485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183485) · [f3887f5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3887f54d679e7e4f6bba263174150e2658bd96e) · [#183630](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183630) · [#183846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183846) · [#183865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183865) · [b1ae827](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b1ae827b1cdcd884292ce5477c89b6c27db5529f) · [#183895](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183895) · [8af8259](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8af8259a11102e6aaa83994dabe9685cda0cf7d1) · [#184754](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184754) · [`be4af37c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/be4af37c3c9f22aab84711390df3a2b7aa07e8f3). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  - Lets Control UI Settings load without first loading unrelated session and Memory screens, while keeping their settings searchable.
    [Settings loading #184754](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184754).
- Starts preparing supported pages and dialogs after the current view is ready. Hovering over or focusing a navigation control can give its destination a head start, while background preparation respects the browser’s data-saving setting. Headers line up with wide content and use consistent spacing on phones.   [#178754](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178754) · [`43ea096`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/43ea096b7f213dfd17562f12edee8024c58023b5) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Moves the main action to the right in affected dialogs, so Cancel precedes actions such as Save or Add. Desktop approval dialogs put Deny and other available choices before Allow once.

##### Conversation and session controls

###### Starting and writing conversations

- Opens the composer directly from **New conversation** in team mode, using the agent you last selected for that Gateway in this browser. You can choose another agent in the composer or use the **+** beside an agent. A compact layout keeps setup and the draft together on phones and short landscape screens, with a scrolling writing area for longer drafts. See the [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui).
  New conversation [#173824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173824). Thanks to steipete. [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99429609f8fac109603b8d3f2ad223240a8070f1)
- Adds file and image attachments to the Control UI command palette, so you can prepare a background session while keeping your current conversation open. The first attachment selects **New session**; submit when ready. Closing the palette keeps its draft for the same Gateway and account until you reload.
  [Command palette guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui#command-palette-file-attachments) · [#178842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178842) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39ad38a34252efaa0d98301d579347d3054b2a4b). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Groups repository and checkout controls together in **New Session**.
  Repository and checkout controls [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c96ef749f451f534f341a53d5da96d477fb4140).
- Reduces repeated work when preparing a first session. Preparing draft conversation titles also takes less work, especially in workspaces with many skills.
  First-session preparation [PR #176462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176462). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Draft title preparation [PR #187092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187092). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes duplicate workspace setup when you attach files in a sandboxed chat.
  [#184985](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184985). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less temporary memory to prepare inline PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF attachments while preserving their display dimensions.
  [#186136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186136) · [Commit d552a038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d552a038cf279176621be1c1c1c369a856767325) · [#186178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186178) · [Commit be29a24b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/be29a24be4acff6bb7bc13f696b05afd6935e00c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets compatible human input steer a visible background completion in a supporting embedded runtime, where acceptance makes a reply required. Hidden work and unsupported backends, including native Codex for these completions, handle the input in a follow-up turn; another person’s pending question stays open.
  [Queue and steering](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/queue-steering.md) · [#176245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176245) · [Commit 2c2c2f3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c2c2f30e4e475ed71dd02b25bbaa5e811305244). The change also preserves accepted human replies in native Codex steering transcripts. Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Queues a message for a separate turn under the sender’s permissions when a shared conversation is busy and collaborative steering is off, without a routine queue notice. Explicit `/followup` requests still get an acknowledgment, and you are told if a full queue drops your message. Set `messages.queue.collaborativeSteeringFallback` to `reject` to refuse these messages. When collaboration is on, other participants can steer the active turn under the permissions it started with. See the [queue and steering guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering).
  [#185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477) · [25da76e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25da76e481744d924f79d2c61e2aa8a038850016). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant). Related queue proposal [#184846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184846) by [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Adds **Dismiss** for individual canceled inputs in regular Control UI chats where you have permission to send. The input stays hidden across devices while its content and attachments remain stored. [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  [#180871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180871) · [commit 67ab984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67ab9846bed0dec25bad770e074338c05700866e) · [#134887](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/134887) · Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Moves paging for saved unsent messages from the composer to the top of scrolling chat history. If you have multiple pages of unsent messages, scroll to the start of the conversation to find **Show earlier unsent messages** and **Show latest unsent messages**.
  [#179687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179687) · [d66e12f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d66e12fe7f89bc88dd71a17d04a7fa9973bfb79d) · [Control UI chat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md) · Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for co-authoring.
- Shows whether the agent, storage key, or storage source changed when a session storage conflict prevents a chat message from sending.
  Thanks to anmol0b and steipete. [#181959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181959) · [9bd4c62ddf44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9bd4c62ddf447a3a3bddafdc6bec976cb1deb6ea)
- Saves the final prompt and its matching history entry together on supported durable embedded-agent turns, so an interrupted save can’t leave the entry without its prompt. This takes less work and records the prompt before the model request starts. Your original message stays saved if the paired save fails. [Database worker access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/worker-access.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178088">#178088</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22d075f531fff88c86dcdd455df319427c7edb4b">22d075f5</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work when accepting a new chat message and saving input for a new session. When the session has not changed, OpenClaw also does less work before acknowledging a restart-safe message, which is still saved before acknowledgment.
  [#185601](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185601) · [8b5268c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b5268c0d7f02ce5d9402cadac9b8a3d57830007) · [#185613](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185613) · [b8adac7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b8adac7f8845c50748df029b42f42ae1def4cd6c) · [#186087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186087) · [`843abed3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/843abed3a886e62c272b9ed11e91ec55b4a73534). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts database work when looking up pending messages and handing new messages to an agent. Saving recovery information for accepted operator messages also takes less work.
  Pending message lookup — Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182883); New message dispatch — [#182971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182971) · [c800ae54](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c800ae545e06dedfd4f65f1eac69a4a6a4d6809a) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).; Operator message recovery — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183880) · [c96f35d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c96f35d5d60cdbfa6b61f5ee949805b480a69dbb)
- Reduces duplicate delivery writes for ordinary local text replies already saved in chat history. If OpenClaw exits unexpectedly after saving the reply and before sending its final live notification, the notification can be lost. The reply is available in history.
  <span>Preparation <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173054">#173054</a> · Activation <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173253">#173253</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Speeds up matching incoming replies for agents with long delivery histories across many conversations, especially when there is no match or the reply is to an older message. Matching a reply to the latest message can be slower in some setups.
  [#175556](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175556) · [288dd0a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/288dd0a8a6257829b479eaa1d70042c06284549d). Thanks etzelm, RomneyDa.
- Reduces processing overhead during warm Gateway chat turns and model fallback lookups.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173261)
- Cuts the work OpenClaw does to start and finish ordinary local turns on the Gateway. If you inspect placement in the database directly, in-progress local turn claims now live in the Gateway and expire when it restarts. [Database placement records](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/worker-access.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178098">#178098</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e72ef289a5aad24840156fab4ab225d18809a18">4e72ef28</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work needed to prepare and finish ordinary chat turns, and temporary memory use when taking over a session run, finishing a turn or recording delivery.
  Session lifecycle memory [#186234](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186234) · [Commit 56705371](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/567053713e703dec162651e6e2a10c05b498cafa) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Chat turn preparation and completion [PR #174098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174098) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b1d81e30585a21bd9b9facfa7f9e9c3b225a07c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts out repeated requests for the same session information during tool-heavy runs in `openclaw tui`, reducing the work the Gateway does while the run is active.
  Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176149">#176149</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/781afcf53be3b8a94d4b92178e69f83003df7dad">Commit 781afcf</a>
- Reduces processing and temporary memory when continuing recovered Gateway operator runs whose role settings have not changed.
  [#186070](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186070) · [`5e27a6cf`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e27a6cf109fb3356e747901781ad6bb68de0622). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts duplicate database lookups for deleted agents and shared session stores during startup, while keeping deleted stores out of use.
  Startup lookups [PR #174408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174408) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50ef1857adb24dc1dd4da094c47bea4b4c138ed8) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Session controls and navigation

- Records you as the creator by default when you ask an agent to start a session or schedule work, so you can find and manage eligible sessions you started even when they are assigned to someone else. [Creator attribution](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session#creators-and-assigned-owners) does not change the permissions the work runs with or publish anything, and existing records keep their original attribution.
  [Delegated creator attribution](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178493) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Groups devices, the Gateway and cloud profiles in the session destination picker. When moving a session, you can see its current location if known, choose a different destination and retry if destinations fail to load. Unavailable choices explain why they cannot be selected. You cannot move to the same known destination, though changing the machine or operating system on the same cloud profile counts as a different destination where available.
  Destination picker [PR #176437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176437) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a38409f85f77e839fcdfc486ed2b975b78d2a535) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds a choice to archive a parent or its eligible session tree, with **Archive all (N)** as the main choice, Undo for the tree and a warning about active work.
  - Adds a choice to archive a parent session alone or archive its whole nested tree, with **Undo** for the tree. Archiving only the parent moves its nested sessions to the top level. The dialog warns about active work. See [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
    Sessions already moved out of the tree stay outside its archive. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172489) · [86380bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86380bba721a2719434d701f2badfaf629fda87c)

  - Makes **Archive all (N)** the main choice when the eligible session tree is available, with a count that includes the parent and all eligible nested sessions. Choose **Archive only this session** to move its direct children to the top level without archiving them. Deeper sessions stay nested beneath those children. On narrow screens, both archive choices stay together above **Cancel** when there’s room. [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar)
    Thanks to jacobtomlinson. [#180738](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180738) · [e31e4b9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e31e4b9145e23a1acf7a208fd07517e5f7b6b271)
- Speeds up transcript archive preparation when deleting a session and reduces work to preserve local changes in a safety snapshot when deleting an archived session with a managed worktree. For archive-then-delete on a non-Incognito session with a managed worktree, confirmation can arrive before cleanup finishes; check the worktree list for the recorded result.
  [Transcript archives on deletion #184398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184398) · [Worktree safety snapshots #184475](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184475) · [Managed worktree cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · [Worktree cleanup confirmation #184582](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184582) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f25b04ca2505ef552fa4ecfac6d593dbede061f7). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds drag-and-drop placement in **Pinned** so you can drop an eligible session above or below a top-level pin and keep its separate rail shortcut in place.
  [#181038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181038) · [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar). Thanks [@TheAngryPit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Moves pinning and activity actions into a menu next to each profile, leaving more room for activity counts. Open it with the menu button, a right-click or **Shift+F10** to pin or unpin a personal shortcut, view activity, open it in a new tab or copy its link.
  [Sidebar guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar) · [#185198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185198) · [4c2a271](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4c2a27148307b98006e3a7276b0d79c6b5a8c50d). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Puts the project and conversation title together in a more compact mobile header, with navigation, Details and Panels within reach. Long names fade at the edge, and the header shows people and public-sharing status where applicable. Gateway and device connection notices appear in the header too, with Retry when available for an offline Gateway.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176360](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176360), [fd096c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fd096c33c4b5db986b14be9d47748f2635ee9e63), [#176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653).
- Adds dedicated pages to the mobile session menu for advanced actions, icon and color, assignment, and moving a session to a group. The group list is alphabetical and searchable.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176363), [d84e193](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d84e193fcc3b99e8d6fef3c34d01b559cc97ebf1).
- Labels the active conversation version and puts help next to the Versions heading on desktop. On mobile, the Versions list keeps its order when you switch versions and distinguishes loading, a failed load, and an empty list, with Retry where available.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176344), [0f013a6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f013a6b3b80b57e856c9ac623e4d3b60870715b).
- Adds a visible **Close pane** button to each desktop split pane, including inactive panes. Closing a pane keeps the conversation and any work in progress. [Chat layouts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat).
  Thanks to steipete. [#182003](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182003) · [5e334a3d5c00](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e334a3d5c004cf81c6a75e6dea23cc8f3b2910a)
- Shows when a session command is still working during a list refresh without hiding the rows or selections you already have. Separates list-loading errors from command errors, and clears old command feedback when you select **Refresh**.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180589) · [872b050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/872b05006bba2fdde24b094f90a547e21b988808)
- Reduces CPU and memory work for routine session edits, including renaming, pinning, changing appearance, marking a conversation read or archiving it.

###### Sharing and access

- Adds a person filter to [Session Share](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/session-share.md), limiting sharing within selected groups to sessions owned by or directly involving that person. Restart the source node host after changing the filter. Receivers who already read transcript text may still have it.
  Set `share.involvingProfileId` alongside `share.groups`. If a session has no owner, its trusted creator can also match. [#182286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182286) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Separates session access, public-link details, and people in the desktop sharing menu. Open Search people when you need it, and see whether copying a public link worked or a sharing change failed. A public link stays readable without signing in even when the session is marked Draft. [Session sharing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar#share-a-session-publicly)
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176398), [ef273ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef273ce110b13dd2b0da5c61906c37087d6fe5a0).
- Adds mobile **Sharing options** for managing a public link and available member permissions, with **Session access** for changing who can use the session. The public-link switch shows the confirmed setting, and you can copy the link once it is available.
  [Mobile sharing and access views](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176515) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds localized navigation, copy buttons and status messages to [public conversation links](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls#public-session-transcripts), including right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Persian. The conversation itself stays unchanged.
  The page uses a supported Control UI or browser language and falls back to English for missing translations or when JavaScript is off. [Public reader localization](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173800) · [reader translations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6054c7b5591ad2172634ecf70e811c7e7f9f32b) · [contribution](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2489c41091702c7ab5d474c5c191473543b5b62). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Removes the warning color from the **Public** label and globe in the chat header. Public sessions remain readable by anyone.
  [#185108](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185108) · [132df45](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/132df45aa97a8790f4181778fe132fb158c3b38f). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Reduces database work for new reactions in shared sessions and avoids unnecessary work saving sharing details or updating older conversation links. Repeated session reads and sharing requests also need less setup when storage settings are unchanged.
  Shared-session reactions — <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183306">#183306</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fa2f156c3642c412c5f4244c53cf912019693400">fa2f156</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).; Older conversation links — <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183404">#183404</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c32e78844637baa0b5b147e440f7e3d9af17a25a">c32e788</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).; Sharing details — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Cuts CPU work and temporary memory for repeated session-sharing checks while checking current access each time.
  [#185136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185136). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work for live presence updates sent to viewers with the same access, and lowers memory overhead for frequently changing shared session information and sharing updates.

###### Chat history and context

- Moves the [context breakdown](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#context-breakdown) to the ring beside the model picker. Open it for usage and available cost or plan information, then choose **View context** for files, tools and skills. Files and loaded tools are grouped by source, and tools available on demand are listed separately. Compacting from the report keeps your unsent draft.
  **Files and tools in the breakdown** — [Context guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/context) Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176381), [ee3c1e8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee3c1e842d97bf78d6130f6c262518b95b0418f3).

  **Context ring and report** — [#179225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179225), [`ff63be5`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff63be54cf44a9a3c5f4967a64e6d71e7eceae77), [Issue #179147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179147). Thanks to [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds a configurable [compaction summary limit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction) so long-context agents can keep more detail when OpenClaw summarizes a conversation. The default stays at 16,000 characters. Larger summaries must fit the model’s context and leave less room for other material on later requests.
  Summary limit [#196207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196207). Thanks [@aniruddhaadak80](https://github.com/aniruddhaadak80) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the release adaptation (31cc8d8a).
- Reduces temporary allocations during long-conversation compaction and repeated history and database work during manual compaction. It also prevents a later token-count correction from counting a legacy session compaction twice.
  Compaction memory [#174433](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174433) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Legacy manual compaction [PR #175311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175311) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4fb0436986d4943b3a9b631a9116698f7e2edd1). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Saved-chat manual compaction [PR #176473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176473). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when preparing the next turn in a long conversation. A same-generation transcript rewrite during a read can leave cached context-size estimates stale and affect the context window.
  Context preparation [#174435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174435) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated work checking the size of active transcripts and preparing to summarize conversations with many tool calls.
  Active transcript size estimates — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182577](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182577); Compaction preparation — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). - Reduces temporary memory when preparing filtered conversation history, loading compressed history for agent context or compaction, and exporting long compressed transcripts.

- Adds opt-in history recovery for new or empty-reset conversations using the bundled Claude CLI and a native login. Set `plugins.entries.anthropic.config.historyRecovery.attestNativeLogin` to `true` to enable it. OpenClaw sends the native access token to Anthropic to verify the account before recovering covered history. [Claude CLI history recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)

- Clarifies [saved message recovery in Claude CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#history-account-boundaries). Native login alone does not replay saved messages into a fresh session by default, although the same native session can be resumed. Selecting a saved subscription token enables recovery for new chats without unlocking earlier history that had no recorded account.
  History account boundaries [PR #174457](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174457). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

- Frees memory from idle background transcript readers sooner by stopping them after 90 seconds of inactivity. They restart when needed, while chat history and transcript search readers remain ready for five idle minutes.

###### Live updates and replies

- Reduces work and temporary memory for session snapshots and live updates to connected clients, including shared sessions and chat progress after reconnecting.

    **Active session and subscriber updates** — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).   **Legacy and queued compaction** — [#173972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173972) · Thanks steipete.

  **Inline save receipts** — [#175038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175038) — Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
