- Reduces repeat reads, copying and memory allocation when updating saved or already-loaded sessions, including activity updates from messages and tool results. Plugins still receive editable results that do not change the saved session.
  [#184321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184321) · [bb92103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb92103e5698c1000e46a2e51e5bfa5070cd6f5a) · [#185773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185773) · [`0f9c51e`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f9c51e858ae64215d6b35815d51e007b85175c0) · [#186051](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186051) · [`126c3b55`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/126c3b55f47031150c2f9aee3f4419f81c821940) · [#186086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186086) · [`a72d4e2e`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a72d4e2e979e2b9a2a98632674a5d884010ea310). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU and memory use when replacing large batches of saved sessions, including large saved prompts, and reduces how long other writes can wait behind those batches.
  [#185722](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185722) · [`75bcfa2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/75bcfa27b025f1ac3004f92d22ec6cfad84b1cbe) · [#185770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185770) · [`979c8de`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/979c8decf7dfe07616aac6243f7bcf78d505be58) · [#185909](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185909). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work that can hold up other Gateway requests while OpenClaw saves a scheduled reply back to its source conversation or handles manual session compaction requested by an in-process plugin.
  [#174610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174610) · [`4fdbf99`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4fdbf994161856f05641b3f4ba4543b7c24cdc69). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids blocking other Gateway work during the final checks for Slack Stop and session title updates on managed session stores.
  [#177561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177561) · [cee90c3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cee90c3af2bd8fd8da8b598803ed30086437dd1a). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory used for session indexes, shared prompt prefixes and settled subagent runs, as well as preparing replies in very long conversations with a context limit.
  **Session indexes, shared prompts and settled subagents** — [Subagent announcements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce) [#173501](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173501) · [40d0181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40d01813a80a28d6c9bb48ca7581363ecb008a0b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173545) · [4919373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/49193738769d6cbbb57e310821997a649c1ddeca) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173548) · [f4f4b19](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4f4b192c43fecf333dcaa299b1fdf1622903f77) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  **Long conversation context** — [#174700](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174700) · [`9296818`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9296818dcafc5dfaddf4b61be64337ce3f7e87f2). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU and memory allocation when checking which workers own existing sessions.
  [#184884](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184884) · [06994811](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/06994811c67500f2478a74578e80b0dd2a5086b6). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work of checking whether an agent has been deleted while processing session events, without skipping those checks.
  [#185892](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185892). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Chat and session display

- Keeps your chat’s model, thinking level, fast mode and permission settings visible when you reload a cached conversation. You can change them once the live settings are ready.
  Cached composer settings [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99f7a303e3ffde6c341bb3b496c77a9056059764). Originating change [#184383](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184383).
- Groups consecutive system events in an expandable summary while keeping a single event directly visible.
  System event grouping [#173838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173838) and [#176719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176719). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops trying to preserve old message breaks when a streamed block reply is rewritten.
  Block reply rewrites [PR #174838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174838) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f54db524286ca3ac43eb458b208e3f91b82b4f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Softens the cutoff on long queued messages in mobile chat with a fade, and aligns the icons and hover feedback for queue controls such as Steer and Retry.
  [#184771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184771) · [`528e1b22`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/528e1b222d65c4bc75032f2267b423be5cd7f42f). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds **No icon** to the Emoji section of the session appearance picker, so you can clear an emoji without changing the session color.
  No icon [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72ed23cafb75b7ea772c1982fe1f5429f4da2172). Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).

##### Agents, tools and delegated work

- Adds Goal controls to existing idle Codex cloud-worker sessions with remote execution. Automatic Goal turns count once when they finish, including the turn that completes the Goal; starting or resuming it yourself does not add to that count. Custom tool policies still apply. See the [Goal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/goal) and [sandbox allowlist](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing).
  [#175918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175918) · Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Adds a mobile Goal details view for the full objective, elapsed time and available controls, even after a run ends. Failed edits stay in the editor, and any available recovery action remains in the details view.
  [Mobile Goal details and recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176519). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds active-run guidance to experimental [Advisor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/reference/advisor), so an agent repeating a failed step or straying from your request can receive a short correction while it works. Advisor is off by default and uses the session model. Advice that cannot reach the active run is dropped, and unfinished reviews are cancelled when you stop a run or send a new message.
  Active-run Advisor reviews ([#174568](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174568)). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173459">#173459</a>. Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Combines rapid tool activity into fewer progress draft updates, so the next update can still reflect the latest activity even if the tools go quiet. The first update and failure updates don’t have to wait for that schedule.
  [#174007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174007) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Adds an automatic per-command memory limit for foreground, background and PTY `exec` commands on Linux Gateway hosts. A large command can stop with a `memory-limit` message that shows its usage and limit. The sampled limit scales with host or cgroup capacity and the Gateway’s own memory use. [Exec memory protection](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182111) · [#182163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182163) · [`2d8051e8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d8051e83b254c549ea2f084b3b3aadd199606ab) · [`377c0fcb`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/377c0fcb1f106b6ebda3f069d554d1d64732998b)
- Sets a default limit of 1,024 PIDs for new Docker and Podman sandbox containers, including browser containers. You can set `docker.pidsLimit` for workloads that need a different budget. [Sandbox settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents/sandbox)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182381">#182381</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38604">#38604</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@imhaojie](https://github.com/imhaojie) (reporter).
- Spaces out automatic recovery attempts for a worker environment that keeps failing, without delaying healthy environments or recovery you request yourself. Failure warnings show the attempt count and when the next retry is due.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183652](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183652)
- Keeps eligible background Git work off the main Gateway process on Linux when a session identity change triggers worker placement or publication updates.
  [#183836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183836). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds policy-aware agent target guidance to delegation, helping models avoid requests for disallowed agents.
  <span>Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@jsalamone05](https://github.com/jsalamone05). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159863">#159863</a></span>
- Warns when Crabbox replaces a rejected configured worker binary with a managed binary. The warning explains why and identifies the binary in use.
  <span>Thanks [@xydigitLybnnnn](https://github.com/xydigitLybnnnn), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165016">#165016</a></span>
- Adds a machine-readable reason when a legacy collector is settled without a recorded result, so callers can distinguish it from other failures. Use `yielded_without_result` in `agents_wait` to identify this case for selective retry. [Subagents tool reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165797">PR #165797</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72ffe36e1278d52ca958a9ef88149aae6a8b9d94">`72ffe36`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/etzelm">@etzelm</a>.</span>
- Shows how long a yielded subagent has been waiting for an external continuation in the native subagent list and wait results. [Subagents tool reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165798">PR #165798</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf6ed0e1466cb0e15a2c9f9f29aade357f2baef6">`bf6ed0e`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/etzelm">@etzelm</a>.</span>
- Improves catalog tool validation errors with the received type and a safe value preview when available. See the [Tool Search guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tool-search).
  Thanks to [@raydeStar](https://github.com/raydeStar) for the fix and [@daddyclint82](https://github.com/daddyclint82) for reporting it. [#172453](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172453) · [1c93dbe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c93dbed0cce9698eedc32839793baa487481a82)
- Releases surplus idle Code Mode workers sooner after a burst, reducing retained worker memory. A later parallel burst may take longer to start.
  Surplus idle workers can retire after 30 seconds, with one kept warm for up to five minutes since its last completion. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173317](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173317) · [Code Mode worker lifecycle](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/code-mode/internals.md)
- Reuses unchanged Tool Search definitions across turns and avoids preparing the tool list twice when rebuilding the catalog, while keeping calls pointed at the current tools.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173433">#173433</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes the extra wait before a paused agent can pick up results from nested subagents, and cuts repeated warnings while those subagents are still working. If a result still hasn’t arrived five minutes after the last recorded completion in a finished batch, OpenClaw can deliver the batch with a notice about the missing result. The deadline survives Gateway restarts.
  [#173907](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173907) · [Subagent handoff guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff) · Thanks steipete.
- Reduces database writes for repeated subagent completions and quiet delivery cleanup, and reduces allocations when checking retained runs. Startup also skips reading task and result text when retained run details need no update.
  [Completion cleanup #173424](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173424) · [Settlement checks #173655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173655) · [Startup reads #173678](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173678). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Groups subagents by status on desktop, with Show more to reveal the rest of a long Done list. On mobile, the list separates running and finished work and asks for confirmation before stopping an active run. Both layouts show elapsed time and bring you back to your place in the list after viewing a subagent.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176347](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176347), [f2bebe6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2bebe643c4312fdb253b3cf6083cf8f76dab616).
- Adds a **Stop** button to compact composer notices on desktop when a subagent run can be stopped from that conversation.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176582">#176582</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1189ab4e7a12d5b36f088b5e256596318148cca">d1189ab4</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds an optional session status check for which tools are available in the current conversation and why others are missing. Your agent can use it to explain when a tool is turned off for this conversation. [Session status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session-tool)
  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176073">#176073</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f427a05291c9b5d0db53654713f4367502a2eb4c">Commit f427a05</a>
- Keeps tool settings editable and tool groups open in Agents → Tools while the preview reloads or is unavailable, without showing outdated results. Adds Retry when the tool catalog fails to load, leaving the built-in list editable until you retry.
  [#179513](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179513) · [e6f3751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e6f3751d7b9090010868af59a7fca5d6b5b5bc68) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the Agents identity editor editable while changes save and shows saving and error feedback inline. Switching agents or leaving the page clears the old feedback without interrupting a save already underway.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180590](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180590) · [98e6f17](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98e6f17891d2233fadc4c2b913480547d5cd4726)
- Adds optional [allow and block lists for Gateway environment variables inherited by new ACP agent processes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/acp-agents-setup). Explicitly granted credentials still reach the agent. Filtering out a variable the agent needs to sign in can prevent it from connecting.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179899">#179899</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/pull/897">#897</a> · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).</span>
- Adds guidance to set the subagent’s working directory with `cwd` when delegating edits outside the agent workspace, so file edits are checked against the intended project folder.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176914">#176914</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference">Subagent tool reference</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds task labels and Swarm group IDs to accepted local subagent launches in `sessions_spawn` when those values are available. Collected `agents_wait` results also include the group ID and elapsed runtime when known. [Swarm](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/swarm).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182136) · [`40e0e5ab`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40e0e5ab151484228a9f6072ee9a20ede6db3fed)
- Adds clearer Crabbox tool results for profile choices, attachment status, box creation or reuse, command and process results, and shutdown. Longer requests can show that they’re in progress on surfaces that display tool updates.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177368">#177368</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e055783d9f99624b76edfc6d47e6b313a9b75ed3">Commit e055783</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/reference/crabbox">Crabbox tool reference</a>
- Makes setup and message progress consistent on the Custodian page and in the assistant panel. The thinking indicator appears while a reply is pending, and health updates can still appear while you wait. Switching sessions or replacing credentials clears the old progress, and you can still cancel model sign-in while an answer is pending.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180580) · [e98056e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e98056e3e6638cc54fa9f80ac061c12782241e33)
- Changes when Bash and Zsh startup-file edits take effect in OpenClaw’s shell commands. Commands can keep using old aliases or functions until the five-minute refresh, even in a newly started OpenClaw process.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182499">PR #182499</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39b7d76a5a8d459436c8b7aca944dd608046b139">39b7d76a</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Loads QuickJS worker files for the lifetime of the OpenClaw process. Restart OpenClaw if you replace those files.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces background database and worker activity while Reef messages are waiting for owner review. Decisions written by another process can take until a restart or message expiry to appear.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182247">#182247</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Refines the opt-in [experimental tool filter](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/experimental-features) so a simple “thanks” after completed work can be answered without sending along optional tools.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182451">PR #182451</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/96a99e864990264bd48c273b7aa127ba6ea89dcf">96a99e86</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Cuts repeated dependency lookup when new Crabbox cloud workers start from the same prepared runtime. If the saved dependency list cannot be used, the worker falls back to the usual install and logs a warning. After a successful start, the Gateway log shows how long steps such as download, installation, and verification took. [Cloud worker setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182338">#182338</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178605">#178605</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@saftall](https://github.com/saftall) (reporter).
- Reduces the work needed to prepare cloud worker bundles by skipping parsing of code that will stay out of the bundle.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184181) · [c678c6ea842b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c678c6ea842baab5e4b072f1f5c60c235b504c6f)
- Updates the [Codex harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-reference/dynamic-tools#protected-conversation-continuity) to clarify fallback tool execution and context handoffs for reused protected conversations, including why an immediate native continuation without a relay may start before fresh context is available.
  [#181528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181528) · Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Cuts out repeat checks on successful agent deletions and keeps the explanation when a deletion is refused.
  [#173967](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173967) · Thanks steipete.
- Cuts repeat work when listing agents with restricted access. If access is granted while the list is already being assembled, newly visible agents may appear on the next request. Revocations still apply to the current request.
  [#173967](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173967) · Thanks steipete.
- Reduces how much long agent conversations can hold up other Gateway work while the next model request is being prepared.
  [#173913](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173913) · [Prompt caching guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) · Thanks steipete.
- Reduces temporary memory use for tool calls that send frequent progress updates, especially when the tool has a large input.
  [#179143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179143), [`3a68bb8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a68bb855095752bbcc984f582a1f517cd48923c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway work when agents stream large tool calls through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Azure Responses, ChatGPT Responses or Kimi.

###### Host file edits

- Changes host `apply_patch` to allow edits outside the workspace by default. [Configure workspace restrictions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/apply-patch) if you need them; sandbox and other containment policies still apply.
  [Host patch policy](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186381) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Models, providers and usage

- Adds model discovery to custom OpenAI-compatible provider setup, with manual entry available. Noninteractive OpenAI and OpenAI Responses setup imports advertised models and selects the first when you omit `--custom-model-id`; Anthropic-compatible setup requires a model ID.
  [#173300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173300) · [Setup report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/121584) · [Onboarding CLI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/onboard.md) · [Setup wizard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/start/wizard-cli-reference.md). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@alexandre-leng](https://github.com/alexandre-leng) for reporting the setup gap and proposing discovery.
- Adds an opt-in 12-hour prompt cache lifetime for GPT-5.6 and later through the OpenAI Responses API. Twelve-hour writes cost 2.5 times ordinary input, compared with 1.25 times for 30-minute writes, with the same cached-read rate. OpenClaw estimates costs using the lifetimes OpenAI reports. [Cache lifetime guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching#openai-12-hour-cache-lifetime)
  Set `params.promptCacheTtl` to `"12h"`; reuse depends on the workload. [Model configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-agents/models) · [#178695](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178695) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4697b8ec8051ab0682acf495340eed5fd976dd17). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the feature request and follow-up fixes.
- Adds OpenAI-hosted web search for eligible ClawRouter Responses routes when the catalog confirms support and admission and your search settings and permissions allow it. [ClawRouter guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter)
  OpenClaw keeps managed search when eligibility is unknown and shows errors returned by hosted search. [#179903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179903) · [ClawRouter #282](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/pull/282) · [ClawRouter #286](https://github.com/openclaw/clawrouter/pull/286). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds an optional Abliteration provider with four models, including Large Flash for text and images. Install `@openclaw/abliteration-provider` separately and connect with a vendor API key. [Abliteration setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/abliteration)
  Large v2 uses Low reasoning when you choose Off. [#182248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182248) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a link to community provider plugins in the searchable onboarding provider picker, including when a search has no matches.
  [Community provider plugins on ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/plugins). [#148488](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148488). Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Applies the existing `retry.provider.maxRetries` setting to eligible local Codex, Copilot and Muse continuations. Set it to 0 to disable those continuation retries. [Retry settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/retry.md)
  [PR #171121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171121) · [f6f939a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f939a8ebc65fc9bbe6c01b6723677e94a9614f). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for this PR.
- Adds a Liquid Inference setup guide for the existing custom-provider connection. The guide explains how to set a per-request price cap and when a fallback can incur separate charges. [Liquid Inference guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/liquid-inference)
  [#172061](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172061) · Thanks to [@ababkin](https://github.com/ababkin), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU work while streaming long ordinary Ollama replies.
  Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#172417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172417) · [709540a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/709540a5cb213e6e879cf58cf53b0e39ff3bd70d)
- Adds a link to the llmman local-server guide for Ollama agent turns that abort or hang even when direct Ollama requests work. See [Ollama troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama/troubleshooting).
  Thanks to [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin). [#172617](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172617) · [f3ea7ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3ea7cedaf295b244092f01af5863210b2c68705)
- Added a temporary “Waiting for the local model to respond” status for slow managed llama.cpp and native local Ollama requests in Control UI, TUI and channels that already show progress drafts.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Uraroga](https://github.com/Uraroga). [#172951](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172951) · [Local model wait status](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/logging.md)
- Changed when in-place provider price edits appear in usage estimates. The displayed rates update when the provider configuration refreshes.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173009)
- Stops the model picker waiting for native discovery when a prepared model list is available. Newly discovered models appear on a later read, so reopen the picker if needed.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173251">#173251</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/models.md">Model discovery</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Reduces the impact of large usage backfills on other Gateway work. Later refreshes reuse saved totals and can retry unfinished sessions.
  [#173475](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173475) · [e19d017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e19d0174124e52fb587e7354f17784956df7479d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Corrects the detailed llmman LAN and Docker setup guidance. For LAN access, set `LLMMAN_API_KEYS` on the daemon and supply the same key as `LLMMAN_API_KEY` to OpenClaw. A Docker-hosted Gateway can reach the host daemon at `http://host.docker.internal:17434/v1`. Use the placeholder only with an unkeyed loopback daemon.
  [#173538](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173538) · [42c05ac](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/42c05ac87a89bb53eff36ee5058c61cfb069701d) · Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets shared model catalog loads finish and warm the cache after all waiting callers cancel. A caller can still stop waiting independently.
  [#173563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173563) · [cc83172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc8317251986af8e51876cbac7f944afaddec109) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces idle memory used by workers that collect session usage costs.
  [#173651](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173651) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated database work when usage charts and logs read long SQLite session histories.
  [#174890](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174890) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

It updates DeepSeek V4 Pro cost estimates, extends thinking controls to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and switches the default for image understanding to Kimi K2.7 Code. DeepSeek V4 Flash and Kimi K2.6 move out of the active picker and remain recognized by explicit model ID. [OpenCode Go guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/opencode-go)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176384](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176384), [e84284a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e84284a6b902affb5393a1dcc262f5a80178b7ce).
- Reduces database work when OpenClaw looks up your default personal model accounts to prepare your model catalog.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176556">#176556</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87a996d92fe619e64643ef1c7036046080b6263d">87a996d9</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces temporary memory use when preparing OpenAI Responses requests that continue a long conversation.

- Cuts out repeated database reads for an unchanged remote model catalog during Gateway startup and reconnection. Later reads pick up saved catalog updates and deletions.

- Skips the second validation during managed llama-server setup when the staged install has already passed its checks.

- Uses the first result to finish when the OpenAI sign-in callback and manual entry race.

- Cuts down on usage notifications sent to connected apps by grouping successful refreshes for up to half a second. Updated totals are still available immediately. If a refresh fails, the affected agent’s latest successful update is sent before the error. [Gateway events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events)
  [#177769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177769) · [d18c1dcf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d18c1dcf0c5ecc9294fb0ba5a759b75678f1c75d). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports unreadable custom tool definitions as an error before sending a request to Anthropic. The request stops even if the other tools are usable.
  [#177997](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177997) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies how to tell a saved conversation history warning apart from failed Claude CLI sign-in or a failed request for an approval decision. The guide explains when to use native Claude CLI sign-in and when HTTP requests need an API key.
  [#178193](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178193) · [commit 87b3202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87b3202de29d37ecae46cf95cfc697c21c109218) · [CLI backend troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Improves [Muse Code sign-in](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/muse) with progress during testing and activation, less duplicate verification and a chance to start a chat after connecting. Setup asks whether to remember native permissions for the selected agent. Muse uses its own tools on the OpenClaw host, outside OpenClaw’s optional sandbox, tool and workspace-only restrictions. Other provider connections can offer a new chat when a suitable model is available.
  [Sign-in and new chat #172610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172610) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/527d11de3f5199b0e3d67509019de4e53972bb60) · [Setup stages #173270](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173270) · [Muse Code setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/muse.md). The offered model applies to the new chat only. Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Opens the Chat and New Session model pickers with less delay. Providers without recommendations initially show up to nine choices. Use **All models** or search to reach the rest.
  Opening **Effort** keeps your typing focus. [Model picker #173275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173275) · [Control UI chat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated database reads when OpenClaw prepares an updated plugin model catalog and when unrelated session changes leave stored model-account details unchanged.
  [Plugin catalog #174016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174016) · [Account reads #174026](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174026) · [Database worker guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  [Muse recommendations #176366](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176366) · [Muse commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e08207aea9d41cde8a8621fb1f2d3ce1296faea4) · [Recommendation changes #177594](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177594) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d2504ccb5b0a141375fbc28a02044771209d617). Thanks to all three for the recommendation update.

  [Concurrent streams #177106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177106) · [Stream and session checks #177202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177202). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Speeds up opening and searching large model lists in Chat, New Session and Model Providers. Search finds models in collapsed provider groups, and keyboard selection remains available across the list.

- Cuts repeated Control UI work when model availability or provider lists refresh, when you save a chat model, or when you switch sessions. The Models page also avoids rebuilding default choices for usage-only changes.

- Adds a notice naming the old and new models when you send your first message after switching. In a chat that already has messages, the Control UI asks before switching to a model it does not recognize as local, since processing the conversation again can use more tokens. You can cancel or choose **Don’t ask again** for this Gateway in this browser. Model names are easier to read in the notice, with full references available on hover.
  Switch confirmation and model-change notice — Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). - Keeps your Model Setup draft through validation updates, shows save errors without clearing your selection, and prevents a second submission while sign-in is saving. Leaving setup or reconnecting clears an old saving indicator. Browser sign-in offers a link to reopen or copy, while device-code sign-in shows the code and explains expiry and retry.

- Adds a Fast option for ClawRouter OpenAI Responses routes when the catalog advertises priority service for the selected key and route. OpenClaw sends the selected tier on eligible requests. See the [ClawRouter guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter).
  Fast option — <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179903">#179903</a> · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).</span>

- Adds `/fast ultra` as a shortcut for `/fast ultrafast` in supported chat commands and inline directives, including the Control UI. The shorthand also works in model-level `params.fastMode`. See the [slash command guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/slash-commands).

- Smooths dragging the effort slider in the chat composer, with a preview that follows your drag and a selection that snaps to the nearest supported level on release. Speed choices take less room and explain when Ultrafast is unavailable. Selecting Ultra gives a brief visual cue that respects reduced-motion settings.
  Effort and speed controls — [#184764](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184764) ([`78363f2b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/78363f2b83ada0538dc1b3544850b8a921e511d7)). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Reduces back-and-forth after a selected model hits a rate limit. When a fallback succeeds on that turn, later normal turns in the same conversation [temporarily try it first](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover), which can help reuse the provider’s prompt cache. Your selected model stays next in line.

- Adds a [configuration example](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/provider-examples#route-interactive-and-background-requests-to-different-urls) for using separate URLs for interactive chat and background work with the same model, including fallbacks, matching generation settings and per-automation route overrides.

- Keeps [ChatGPT Responses](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced#transport-websocket-vs-sse) on SSE at the same endpoint after an automatic WebSocket fallback, even if your credentials or headers change. SSE uses the current credentials. Only the most recent failed endpoint per session and runtime is remembered, so returning to an older failed endpoint can trigger another WebSocket attempt. Explicit WebSocket mode or a session restart can allow another attempt.

- Changes ClawRouter so it can report a model catalog error instead of reusing an older result. It also keeps an earlier Ollama lookup result from being displaced before a new lookup finishes.
  [#178344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178344) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes manual ONNX export to publish its manifest last. If an export fails and leaves an incomplete output folder, retry with a new folder or clear the incomplete output.
  [#178344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178344) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the most recent 8,000 bytes of output in Microsoft Foundry device-code sign-in errors without cutting off the live output.
  [#178464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178464) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Prompt caching and conversation continuations

- Clarifies prompt-cache warnings so you can tell whether the pinned prompt was kept or why it restarted. The [prompt caching guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) also clarifies native OpenAI Responses behavior. Routine instruction updates leave the original cached instructions intact, while changing the route or personal profile, resetting, or compacting starts a new prompt series.
  Cache warnings — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Prompt caching guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/prompt-caching.md) · [#183898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183898) · [c38142d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c38142d67d42f4856de3ab00d602859f99a0067b) · OpenAI Responses cache guide — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184158](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184158) · [63d79f84fe79](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/63d79f84fe79d1e6eaa810fb975dd9677088877f)

##### Daybreak Access

- Updates translations for Daybreak and its colors, unavailable Access and Ultrafast options, and personal-instructions sign-in guidance. The sign-in text names both eligible read scopes.
  [#185069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185069).

##### Plugins, skills and templates

- Adds light and dark backgrounds to plugin themes. Select the plugin theme and **Theme artwork** in the Control UI to see the matching image. A mode without a usable image falls back to neutral artwork, and older Gateways reject the new manifest field.
  [Theme backgrounds #172627](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172627) · [Artwork visibility #173673](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173673) · Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/patrick-erichsen).
- Uses ClawHub by default when installing a plugin by package name from the CLI, chat or an agent. Add `npm:` to commands or scripts that should use npm, including scoped package names. Bare, unversioned IDs for bundled and official plugins remain shortcuts. See the [plugin install guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/install).
  A missing ClawHub package does not trigger a fallback to another registry. [#173669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173669) · Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Adds automatic shortening of one eligible oversized learned skill per agent during daily maintenance when Skill Workshop is in auto mode. The rewrite sends the skill text to the agent’s primary model provider and can be undone from version history. See [Skill Workshop](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skill-workshop#skill-diet).
  Explicitly denying an agent access to Skill Workshop also skips its daily maintenance, including unused-skill archiving. [#186861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186861) · [commit c4f34cb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4f34cb7bb716ddb09cca57af925d3a7a9d71f71) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

Look for `runtimeRetention`. [Retention inspection](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update#inspect-retained-references) also shows the run ID and Gateway service for holds created while preparing an agent run.
