- Reduces idle memory use in the [geolocation plugin](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/geolocation) by releasing its in-memory cached city database after a minute without lookups. It reopens the file on the next public-IP lookup.
  Idle geolocation — [#176512](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176512) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds search and category browsing for official templates from **Pages** when **Templates** is enabled under [**Settings → Labs**](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings#templates-labs). Built-in pages are alphabetized without reordering your dashboards. The experimental Claws feature is now called Templates and remains off by default. If you used Claws, update old commands, Control UI links, configuration and Gateway API calls using the [Templates guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates). Existing state is migrated.
  Pages browsing — [PR #175291](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/413d2fc66983d396ff1e9281f568954ef3c83de6) · [Templates follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1c8d42588a4badf8df75b0af5e65f05a9714f00). Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen) for the original PR. · Templates rename — [#186457](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186457). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

##### Plugin development and Decisions

- Adds SubQ Snap for classifying, routing and scoring text or JSON through the optional Decision role. The plugin is off by default and available from a source checkout while its package awaits publication. Evaluations send the supplied evidence to SubQ and use your credits. [SubQ setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/subq) · [Decision models](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models)
  - [#171965](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171965) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds Decision V2 support for Liquid AI d1 and d1 Ultra for text, JSON or a single inline image. The plugin is an unpublished candidate for compatible development checkouts. Evaluations send evidence to Liquid AI and incur provider charges. [Liquid AI setup and supported inputs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/liquid-ai)
  - Native Decision V2 support for d1 and d1 Ultra. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>. <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/liquid-ai">Liquid AI setup and supported inputs</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177369">#177369</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/863839d032939ec1ef582ce3b991df77e35e7aaf">Commit 863839d</a>
- Adds Baseten elephant-1 and mammoth-1 for yes-or-no, multiple-choice and scored decisions with text or JSON. Evaluations send the supplied evidence to Baseten. [Baseten Decision models](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/baseten#decision-models)
  - Decision model integration · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179819">#179819</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bff1d869fcef5d397394532bf9291b3dcf1f26e2">bff1d869</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds Boolean, choice, score, sort and tags decisions with Levanto Sage through the optional [Levanto plugin](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/levanto.md).
  - [Levanto Sage decision provider](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157433). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds paged transcript changes for context-engine plugins, including reset-aware cursors and a way to identify the entry replaced by a rewrite. Plugins must adopt the API.
  [PR #167481](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167481) · [commit cadffe5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cadffe56b139c06aa5d64dc81f8ea60d22b2e316) · Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds a way for plugins to start a follow-up in a selected session and check whether it was accepted and how it ended. Discord presence greetings and Slack interaction and presence follow-ups use this path. [Plugin SDK session events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system)
  Refused Slack presence follow-ups can be retried, and Reef avoids resubmitting an accepted overdue notice after a later turn failure. [#180079](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180079) · [commit c538e280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c538e280e80842e5bac887e2178b9df0c6ba1c2a). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a requester-scoped catalog so eligible plugin commands and tools can show models available in a conversation. The catalog and Gateway model list also expose a declared model family when known. [Requester model catalog](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/models#requester-admitted-model-catalog) · [Model catalog reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/models) · [Gateway RPC reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-system-and-channels)
  The catalog does not grant model selection or inference permissions. [#180283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180283) · [commit 414a00c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/414a00cd3c6a9f6b8b912111bdc7ee07d7503c5a) · [issue #180161](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180161) · [#181685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181685) · [commit 2995f75](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2995f75ce20d9944e797a3056016da06f88d733b). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds the final system prompt reported by updated workers to the before_agent_run hook, so plugins can check it before allowing a turn. Older workers omit it. [Plugin hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks#choose-a-hook)
  [Report #170118](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170118) · [#182142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182142) · [commit 3a342c57](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a342c570186bff915779812fa6a127feb08d479). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini).
- Adds the plugin lint command to [check runtime compatibility](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/runtime-compatibility) without running the plugin. Installs also show advisory compatibility warnings.
  [PR #182419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182419) · [aae13944](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aae13944bdf494f26eb02d2ce84237a9acb3e875) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds image checks to [input policy plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session), so a plugin can block a request before its images reach the model. A local image can be read before the policy decision.
  [#196337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196337). Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant) for the original change and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release adaptation (16e43b38).
- Removes 13 top-level Plugin SDK methods. Move session workflows, agent events, run context and session actions to their grouped APIs. Use middleware for Codex tool-result transforms, direct URLs or allowed local files for media, and transforms declared by your own provider or CLI backend. [SDK migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration/removed-surfaces)
  [#177829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177829) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Retires AgentsAPI plugin executor controllers. If you have controller-owned sessions, use your previous OpenClaw version and original controller to retire or migrate them before upgrading. Verify that their executors have stopped and remove `executorController`. Use hosted AgentsAPI or arrange an external lifecycle owner for new self-hosted sessions. [AgentsAPI upgrade guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/agentsapi#upgrading-from-a-controller-plugin)
  [`e604de4c24`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e604de4c242e71e4ab11cf71f50c227fe480a457) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Removes retired heartbeat turn options and callbacks from the Plugin SDK. Affected `before_agent_reply` hooks should use `sessionKey` in place of `heartbeatEventQueueSessionKey`. The `heartbeat_prompt_contribution` hook remains available for proactive automation jobs. [SDK migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration/removed-surfaces)
  Thanks to steipete. [#180563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180563) · [7f4cbc1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f4cbc1e2a1a98bac51d780ff92e0ef4276cdcf2)
- Updates the session and node MCP clients to SDK v2 while keeping legacy MCP negotiation. The affected session methods, native app previews and Codex adapters keep their v1 result shapes in 11.5 and report an error if a conversion would lose data. If your plugin uses these contracts, see the migration guide for the v2 result types planned for the following stable release.
  [MCP SDK migration guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-migration.md) · [#175403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175403). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds experimental database-engine interfaces for full-text and vector search indexes.
  <span>Plugin developers can bind text and vector index handles on admitted stores. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172681">#172681</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. PostgreSQL search support comes from <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173625">#173625</a> and <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174085">#174085</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-overview/infrastructure.md#L209-L222">Database engine and search documentation</a>.</span>
- Adds a `backupDir` option for maintenance plugins to take a verified session-store snapshot before deleting an entry. Use a fresh backup directory.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173200">#173200</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime/agent.md">Agent maintenance SDK</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds `postJsonResponse` for provider plugins to read bounded JSON responses and release the submission connection before polling or downloading. Treat catalog values handed to the SDK as immutable.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173375">#173375</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins">Provider SDK guide</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds `createSpeechDirectiveParser` for speech providers to share directive parsing and return provider-specific override patches for the host to merge.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173394">#173394</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds invocation-bound execution for version 2 plugin tools in the calling sandbox, model selection within the caller’s permissions, and checks that results can be returned in full.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173455">#173455</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/24ed521600a94b943290f0810f0bfad4e7fe3eae">Commit 24ed52160</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/building-plugins">Plugin development guide</a>. Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Surfaces missing-module errors from incomplete built plugin SDKs. If you maintain the build and hit this error, rebuild the SDK and restart OpenClaw.
  [#173523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173523) · [a05b8f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a05b8f6e552c11340df8ab706e7a8ab180701dec) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Gives memory plugins the option to use the current repository’s identity when they store project scope in their own format.
  [#173935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173935) · [Memory plugin SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/infrastructure) · Thanks jalehman.
- Reuses eligible direct connections for repeated OpenAI and TypeSafe Decision evaluations, so those requests don’t have to open a new connection each time.
  [#174002](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174002) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Limits plugin loading when preparing a one-shot Decision V2 evaluation on a cold start, avoiding unrelated memory and context-engine plugins.
  [#171822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171822) · Thanks [@htuyer121](https://github.com/htuyer121).
- Adds an optional way for agent harnesses to defer preparing finalization context until it’s needed, so they can skip that work when the reply has already been delivered.
  [#173945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173945) · [Agent harness SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/sessions-and-results) · Thanks steipete.
- Adds Decision debug logs that distinguish a proposed tool restriction from one that took effect or was lifted. When tools are restricted or restored, the logs show how many tools the model had before and after.
  [#174013](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174013) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Keeps an experimental Decision tool restriction in effect for an evaluation already underway if you turn Decision off or change its model. The new setting applies to the next evaluation, and live permissions still apply. [Experimental features](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/experimental-features)
  [#174632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174632) · [`87c1f1c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87c1f1c673b136b23c374596bc718e317b8810bd). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets link-reader plugins opt into loading an overview first and fetching individual sections as they’re needed. The SDK supports staged and full-document requests. [Link-reader host hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/host-hooks)
  [#174644](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174644) · [`b5ef99d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b5ef99d7053d1014f18b443c9069af4aa4ec72cf). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a Memories panel placement for packaged Settings plugins. Memory views can see which methods the Gateway advertises, and requests from the old view are rejected when that list changes. [Feature plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/feature-plugins)
  [#174925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174925) — Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds an optional `classifyErrorCode` hook so CLI backend plugins can identify specific failures and OpenClaw can show guidance when it has a matching message. [CLI backend plugin guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/cli-backend-plugins)
  [#175558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175558) · [e60fbe9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e60fbe9362af72cddeb03db3ace680080754d814). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Adds `withSqliteReadOnlyInspection` for Doctor migration plugins to inspect an admitted SQLite database without waiting for maintenance writes to stop. [Plugin SDK runtime](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime)
  [#175659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175659) · [ff908fe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff908fed3f958854fba17ace4b6e6f09545ad8f2). Thanks steipete.
- Adds `resolveWebSearchToolPolicyAsync` for harness developers who need to check whether hosted web search is available.
  Use the async resolver when the session facts may need to be loaded first. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176707) · [commit 1ffa33e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ffa33e94e306c4acfcb86126c00427cdf526c57) · [Agent harness SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/core-ownership)
- Adds an `AGENT_SELECTION_REQUIRED` error code for plugin cron calls that need an agent owner but cannot find one.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176841](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176841) · [commit f8b7096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f8b7096ef827a265deac16dceab3a50bec4b1ba0) · [Plugin cron service](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/gateway-and-nodes)
- Adds an optional synchronous `onRotationComplete` callback to the plugin SDK’s `WorkerTaskPool`, so plugins can publish released resources before queued work resumes.
  If the callback throws, retry rotation to let queued work resume. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176849](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176849) · [commit 0ee0def](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0ee0def0f8a4133c0613d262ab201924df565e7a) · [WorkerTaskPool SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/config-and-utilities)
- Preserves the reason a plugin supplies when it cancels an in-progress isolated completion, including values other than an `Error`. The completion timeout starts after the runtime module loads.
  [#177814](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177814) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the `configuredEndpointDiscovery` manifest opt-in for provider plugins that discover an owned runtime model catalog from a configured endpoint. [Model catalog guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/manifest/models)
  [#179223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179223), [`48f2918`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/48f291827824b2269f27adca6b951a64391b83f5). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds `activeBranchOnly` to exact saved-message lookups so plugin authors can search just the active conversation branch. The option is off by default. [Plugin SDK agent runtime](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/agent)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179931">#179931</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/233955d89d932a27e887b76519f744b91b1fe6bc">commit 233955d8</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds warnings for registered plugin tools with dictionary fields that would reject arbitrary keys on native OpenAI Responses routes. To keep those keys, use `openRecord` or set `additionalProperties: true`.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180041">#180041</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d920bfc80fe14a6fac9a0019fc7887da66dfa189">commit d920bfc8</a>. Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds `ToolArgumentValidationError` for reporting invalid arguments from a plugin tool’s `prepareArguments` hook. [Plugin tool documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/tool-plugins)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180041">#180041</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d920bfc80fe14a6fac9a0019fc7887da66dfa189">commit d920bfc8</a>. Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds [guidance for plugin authors](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime) on handling database disconnects when no query is running, marking affected tools unavailable, and restoring them with a fresh connection.
  [#181176](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181176) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e814620175d8ff29f8c7a22e7986c84f3352aea)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by [@3f3feng](https://github.com/3f3feng) ([#146290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/146290)).
- Adds synchronous and asynchronous Plugin SDK helpers for bounded directory scans. They list links without following them and report when the scan reaches its limits. [Plugin SDK infrastructure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/infrastructure).
  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#182185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182185) · [`65c7ed79`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65c7ed799833c87cc5bb46e60354aef6048cf23f)
- Adds an option for session catalog plugins to require a fresh access check before showing results. [Plugin entrypoint guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-entrypoints/define-plugin-entry)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182242">#182242</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Adds provider aliases for embedding plugins and shows those aliases in startup diagnostics. [Embedding provider SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins/media-and-search)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182250">#182250</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/LiLan0125">@LiLan0125</a>, <a href="https://github.com/dwc1997">@dwc1997</a>.
- Adds person-scoped session metadata reads to the session-store SDK. [Plugin SDK guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime/agent.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182286">#182286</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Adds `appendAgentMessage` for trusted Gateway plugins to write an agent message with mentions to a conversation the caller has permission to write to. Retries can reuse the same append identity. [Gateway plugin SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/gateway-and-nodes)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182352">#182352</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/280c7c7d494a796cc870fbd794088b84df1e53dc">280c7c7d494a</a>. Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) (released co-author).
- Adds `getRuntimeExecutionProfile` so plugin authors can identify an ahead-of-time compiled standalone host. Builds that allow interpreted execution can use it for supported plugins installed after the build, Node Code Mode, and QA expressions and lambdas. [Runtime profiles](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/runtime-profiles)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182346">#182346</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f828ee45788fd10ca3b7291ce09d9e185034768">interpreter follow-up</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the runtime profile.
- Reduces the work OpenClaw does on ordinary agent turns when no session fork is requested. Plugin side questions can use a conversation with saved history after a restart without needing a new message first. Prompt-cache reuse is best effort for reconstructed forks.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182844) · [Plugin SDK runtime](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime)
- Adds an `ifEmpty` option for read-only Plugin SDK state operations to return a chosen result when a store is empty.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182882)
- Adds Plugin SDK imports for validating data against JSON Schema without runtime code generation and for checking the runtime profile.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182928) · [Plugin SDK imports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-subpaths)
- Cuts repeated work when Codex reads live plugin settings and when plugins look up their own metadata.
  [#183047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183047) · [2111311c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2111311cbc909b97cddaad38f19a06931352645d) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an optional `dispatcherPolicy` so video provider plugins can use their configured download transport with the [shared video downloader](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins/media-and-search) while keeping strict checks on download destinations.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183308">#183308</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d52d5b80cfe7b3f3002d47a865952c4cbf741ea8">d52d5b8</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds an optional channel plugin callback for the final result of a queued reply, so plugins can receive it after the initial dispatch returns.
  [#183803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183803). Thanks to [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [channel runtime reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/channel).
- Reduces the work of preparing session details for trusted plugins.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183914](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183914) · [711999c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/711999ce96e6d2d9b0a5e15049fd8d21aeda163f)
- Adds a lightweight browser contract for feature plugins. Use `FeatureClientContract` with `createFeatureClient` to keep validation schemas out of the browser download while the Gateway handles validation and authorization.
  [Feature plugin guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/feature-plugins.md) · [#184267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184267) · [de8863f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/de8863ffc12e05c7ff0d1a2aa5bb9194bb1d3f24). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an optional prompt-origin field for CLI backend plugins. Backends with a native non-user input marker can use it to keep OpenClaw-generated prompts out of user-authored history.
  [CLI backend plugin guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/cli-backend-plugins.md) · [#184216](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184216) · [505fc9f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/505fc9fe7c8e46db23ce9141d6820d2fee97de41). Thanks [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Adds `loadAuthProfileStoreForRuntimeAsync` and `AuthProfileCredential` to `openclaw/plugin-sdk/provider-auth`. [Provider plugin guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins)
  [#184705](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184705) ([`594fb05d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/594fb05dcccd89cc38135ffb6af0872ef29b4d90)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds `createPluginConfigParser` to the plugin SDK so plugin authors can reuse validated settings without carrying stale values across a configuration reload.
  [#185013](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185013) · [Plugin SDK configuration and utilities](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/config-and-utilities) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory allocation for streaming text updates that OpenClaw assembles itself. If your extension edits the top-level fields of one of these text-only updates, make a copy first.
  [#185093](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185093) · [Agent runtime architecture](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/agent-runtime-architecture.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts the work needed to report unrelated runtime errors after OpenClaw compiles TypeScript plugins with the default compiler.
  [#185646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185646) · [819a6c6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/819a6c6eee753d03fe587282989481dea5ce23a6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an option for CLI backend plugins to receive a mid-turn message’s context and distinguish your messages from ones OpenClaw forwarded. [CLI backend plugin guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/cli-backend-plugins)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185945">#185945</a> · Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)
- Adds `materializeErrorStack`, a best-effort [plugin SDK helper](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/config-and-utilities) for keeping diagnostic errors while allowing completed request data to be released.
  [#186147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186147) · [Commit eea1d352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eea1d35267cbf60eb9b91099ba771514fab0b41c) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the temporary memory needed to check plugin session actions, such as activity panel refreshes. Rejects action data with too many fields before reading their values.
  [#186236](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186236) · [Commit 3053cf72](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3053cf72744159f8d46c58bd230af6e358141c2a) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an optional hook for channel plugins to send a best-effort notice after a message has permanently failed.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186289">#186289</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2734af0424630e66432421d4f7df3ac3d5b8a122">commit 2734af0</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound">Channel SDK outbound delivery</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Adds `readSqliteDatabaseWriteRevision` so plugins can read the in-process SQLite write revision without issuing a query.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8a7c1fb91c8a220b0aa3941ee5e1de830457b07).
- Adds a guarded HTTP helper for provider plugins that reuses OpenClaw’s model connection policy. Release the response in `finally`; the helper supplies neither credentials nor request authority. [Provider plugin SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins)
  [HTTP helper #174002](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174002) · [Provider HTTP SDK commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa78569f23d1787235a624d462d7afcfe993245) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Reduces the work of preparing conversation history for plugin hooks, especially in long conversations. Nested message content passed to `before_prompt_build` and `agent_turn_prepare` is read-only. Return a hook contribution to change the prompt, or copy the content before editing it for your plugin’s own use. [Prompt-hook migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration#prompt-hook-history-is-read-only)
  [History reuse #182239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182239) · [Read-only history #182349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182349) · [Node history preparation #184337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184337) · [Saved history preparation #184376](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184376) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when plugins save several pieces of state together, poll unchanged state or repeatedly register keys that are still in use. Reads continue to reflect committed updates, including Doctor repairs. [Plugin state reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system)
  [Batched updates #183400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183400) · [Commit 849ae25](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/849ae25464725ba47a4b718c78b57114d47b62a7) · [State polling #183844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183844) · [registerIfAbsent #186230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186230) · [Commit 1b1c9657](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b1c96578f67978b097e9c5852af456f815f6755) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Updates the [provider guides](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins/model-catalogs) with live model discovery and advertised thinking-level guidance, and adds a [contribution checklist](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins#checklist-before-you-open-a-provider-pr) for connection setup, documentation and testing with a real agent turn.
  [Model discovery and thinking levels #187214](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187214) · [Provider checklist #187362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187362) · Thanks obviyus.
- Keeps the synchronous memory `status()` fallback for third-party managers through December 31, 2026. Migrate to `statusAsync` before its removal in the first January 2027 stable release. [SQLite SDK migration guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-migration/sqlite-async.md)
  [Status migration commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c96ef749f451f534f341a53d5da96d477fb4140).
- Updates the [plugin SDK contract](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/plugins/sdk-migration.md) without a compatibility window. If your plugin registers a session-keyed run, move `setActiveEmbeddedRun` into the host-admitted `runAttempt` and retain its cleanup function. Replace `chatAbortControllers` and `chatQueuedTurns` with authenticated Gateway method calls, and read `startDeadlineAtMs` instead of `expiresAtMs` in start-owner observations.
  [Session SDK migration #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36e277d76147ab839a5068f4d8bc0c5254f1d05a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds a deprecation warning when a plugin calls the built-in memory manager’s synchronous `status()`. Switch to `statusAsync()` using the [SQLite SDK migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration/sqlite-async). The synchronous call remains available through December 31, 2026, with removal planned for the first January 2027 stable release after the warning and replacement have shipped in stable.
  [Memory status migration #175199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175199) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a2494eaff8650466a90d1e0a86abdf3f0bf9eba) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes `normalizeWhitespace` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/web-content-extractor`. If your plugin imports it from that path, replace that import.
  [Web extractor SDK #178569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178569) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/beff1f230006be857c4ec2f6c317b2d48d7b8055) · Thanks [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes after-tool plugin hooks so editing a tool result can affect what OpenClaw shows later. Treat those results as read-only.
  [After-tool hooks #174838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174838) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f54db524286ca3ac43eb458b208e3f91b82b4f) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes the automatic skip for [`before_prompt_build` hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session) that call themselves on the same runner. If you write one of these hooks, avoid calling it recursively.
  [Prompt hooks #174872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174872) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0301614ddd9862e57d5b7d9d23e5851d72ea36c6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes delayed plugin cleanup so it can read or clear newer temporary plugin state when the same context keys are reused. When a hook and an instance of the same plugin report the same error object during cleanup, it can appear as one failure instead of two.
  [Plugin cleanup #174872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174872) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0301614ddd9862e57d5b7d9d23e5851d72ea36c6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [Gemini Decision 1](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models) for yes-or-no questions, choices and scores based on text, JSON or a supported image. Select `google/gemini-decision-1` with a Gemini Developer API key. Evaluation sends the supplied evidence to Google at Gemini API rates. Chat model discovery no longer removes Decision-only models from the selection for evaluations.
  [Released adaptation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01b98da7d3dbcca5d26a6a970f1ab0438adfdcab), adapted from [PR #197501](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197501) and [upstream commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0182580ebf7e1436686791f263f49a5dae52df0a). The upstream commit names Ayaan Zaidi as author; released co-author credits include @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
- Adds Decision SDK V2 support for the existing [local ONNX classifier](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/onnx) without an API key. A compatible host and plugin pairing is required. The adapter handles Boolean, choice and score questions on text or JSON, and V1 calls still work.
  [ONNX Decision V2 #174162](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174162) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/317eb4873718dd1709d64c4c26b5c50c1be01e0b) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an [SDK option](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities#decision-models-contract-version-1) for plugins to mark evaluations as optional.
  [Optional evaluations #174266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174266) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds [custom channel settings views](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/feature-plugins#packaged-settings-presentations), so plugin authors can customize Control UI settings pages for their channels while OpenClaw handles configuration editing and account access. Nostr’s existing profile editor moves into its plugin, while remaining in the same place for users. A Settings-only plugin view also lets the existing Memory overview load without starting Memory Core’s runtime UI.
  [Channel settings views #176042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176042) · [Settings view changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a80f9e0b10e5bec3bbfe342ce8fd70e9135ae86) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [Memory Settings view #174452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174452) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Avoids reading a saved diff back just to find out when it was created or expires. Plugin authors can also get those timestamps when registering a new stored item without changing code that uses the existing yes-or-no registration method. See the [plugin storage guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system).
  [Storage receipts #174081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174081) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6753a1e8b055e5d43adc3ff3dfc736d934855de1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an [event-type filter](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/memory-and-context) for memory plugin developers so unrelated events don’t take up space in filtered results.
  [Memory event filter #174806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174806) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5733c40baa2130780b867e3f500762d9e75bfef) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Yun-0000](https://github.com/Yun-0000).
- Adds a [Plugin SDK helper](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime) to check the database write revision in the current process without running a query.
  [SQLite revision helper #175142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175142) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds opt-in support for saving a whole batch in [custom plugin queues](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound), without requiring existing single-event queues to change.
  [Queue batches #175183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175183) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa0f5a85299c69232ef04ee1060c3b7c6207adb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a reusable [group-DM configuration schema](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/imports) for plugin authors who build channel account settings, so they can share the standard fields and keep their own rules for channel IDs.
  [Group-DM schema #175231](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175231) · Thanks steipete.
- Adds multi-key tasks to the Plugin SDK’s `enqueueKeyedTask`, so tasks that share any key wait their turn while unrelated tasks can run independently. It also accepts compatible `Map` and `WeakMap` storage and keeps the existing single-key call.
  [Keyed tasks #175829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175829) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5038842a0dff13a7993f814eaec4df28279b7ad) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds type information for the optional block and list-item details that the plugin SDK’s `markdownToIRWithMeta` already returns.
  [Markdown metadata types #175880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175880) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an opt-in for link-reader plugins to receive the current chat pane session, and clears stale previews when that session changes. The session key is context, so the receiving method must still authorize access. See the [plugin host hooks guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/host-hooks).
  [Link reader context #173652](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173652) · Thanks to galiniliev.
- Adds an optional cancellation signal to plugin Gateway requests, allowing cooperating work to stop when a request is cancelled.
  [Request cancellation #172692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172692) · Thanks shakkernerd.

##### Memory, Knowledge and search

- Adds Gateway API status, search and record access for selected LanceDB memory to authorized operators and owner-private sessions. Use memory.search version 2. The Control UI Memories tab still needs LanceDB search and record support.
  [#165756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165756) · Thanks [@ScientificProgrammer](https://github.com/ScientificProgrammer) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds ways to [organize Knowledge claims](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/maintenance) by page or subject and file unlinked claims. An existing current claim on the same page can replace older snapshots without a duplicate, keeping them in history and allowing you to undo the replacement.
  [Superseding claims](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/corrections#supersede-claims-by-an-existing-claim) · [#186266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186266) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e665f5b70fb707863cfd1be5ef347ba7d95fb2a1) · [follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae5a297308c0ed09bcf276372a51976b8400f4e4). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds a way to [move a section](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/tools#extract-a-section) to another Knowledge page while keeping links pointed at their intended destinations and retaining claim subjects. It refuses moves that would change a link’s destination and claim replacements that depend on the claim being retired. Knowledge also rejects writes that would grow a page past its [size limit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/tools#page-budgets), while allowing edits that do not grow an oversized page.
  [Section extraction and page limits](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186270) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff2d7187a57c449db6190e3b7dc933f30bf2ac37) · [follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae5a297308c0ed09bcf276372a51976b8400f4e4) · [link and claim safeguards](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186578). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds Bun startup support for Knowledge and includes its registry and storage workers in standalone builds.
  [#183771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183771) · [Knowledge runtime reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/extensions/knowledge/README.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids full transcript scans for default-agent session searches, including repeated searches using a prepared query.
  [Session search](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Reduces memory pressure during session search rebuilds while keeping oversized messages searchable. Offline SQLite rebuilds retain search state and active session events together.
  [Streaming rebuilds](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99ea176ddcb9af166b739ed476ab2edddb1c667a) · [Offline SQLite rebuilds](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/62bb192d22f949d3db0e5d12078fca8a60f9c303).
- Skips unnecessary memory search startup work when memory search is turned off for every agent.
  [PR #176048](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176048) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a0ffdb1b8dbfcfda139c44818364b1dd9bd29dba) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Speeds up vector memory searches on file-backed SQLite stores using sqlite-vec. These searches can use more memory. [SQLite vector acceleration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config#sqlite-vector-acceleration-sqlite-vec)
  [#174971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174971) — Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Combines PostgreSQL memory keyword requests, including the broader search used when the initial keyword and path searches find nothing. Strong keyword matches can rank ahead of weaker matches on meaning alone in hybrid search. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#178641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178641) · [`1c4b270`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c4b27072712e12300b8454837c2a3264cf2a21b) · [#178714](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178714) · [`6263957`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/62639573d1bca08810a1316972ef0ed77d786cc2) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated background scans when agents in the same Gateway process watch the same memory folder, including when agents join or leave without changing the watched files. Each agent keeps its own file selection and index. [Built-in memory guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin)
  [Shared scans #173468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173468) · [Commit 68166d8e6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68166d8e61e94ce46aeeed9fe439e82e7da7114f) · [Issue #173445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173445). Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@staruy](https://github.com/Staruy) for the report. [Watcher membership #174616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174616) · [Commit 1c09c1c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c09c1c3f064c5517f871878a688f4a5099df66e). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU work when compiling related pages in large Memory Wiki vaults.
  <span>Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164761">#164761</a></span>
- Helps avoid repeat embedding requests for unchanged memory when the cache is full by removing eligible superseded entries first on SQLite and PostgreSQL. It also reduces CPU work during light and REM Dreaming. [Built-in memory guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/memory-builtin.md)
  [Embedding cache #164792](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164792) · [Dreaming #164794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164794). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Adds a guide for moving Ollama memory embeddings to llmman. Keep the Ollama provider, leave `/v1` off the new base URL and run `openclaw memory index --force` after switching. [llmman memory embeddings guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/llmman)
  [#172041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172041) · Thanks to [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin).
- Adds guidance for reducing embedding memory use on small hosts that still run multiple slots. On those hosts, set `LLMMAN_NUM_PARALLEL=1` in the external llmman daemon’s environment. See the [llmman provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/llmman).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176565">#176565</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9dc6d7a048f179aa018da6c6767422ae0bc57f25">9dc6d7a0</a>. Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@jj5638521](https://github.com/jj5638521).
- Updates the llama.cpp guide to show v2026.10.5 users the [interactive setup for local embeddings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/llama-cpp#set-up-only-local-embeddings). That version rejects the unattended option.

- Uses approximate matching by default for broad PostgreSQL memory searches, reducing comparison work. The closest matches can differ from an exact search. SQLite uses exact matching. If your PostgreSQL memory store uses pgvector older than 0.7, upgrade the extension before reopening the store. [PostgreSQL](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql).
  Small, explicitly scoped PostgreSQL searches use exact matching. [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). After a PostgreSQL major-version upgrade, reindex the memory path indexes as described in the linked guide.
  [PR #183888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183888). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

Query instructions can be set globally or per agent without rebuilding the index. Changing the document prefix on an existing index requires `openclaw memory index --force` to resume semantic search.
  [Memory configuration reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/memory-config.md). Include any spaces or line breaks the model expects in the query prefix. An empty per-agent query instruction restores provider formatting.   [#185321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185321) · [1fcf6e7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1fcf6e7df5f67c55da9aaf72f03d390905237453). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

###### LanceDB startup

- Removes LanceDB's automatic initialization retries, which previously allowed up to three attempts. If two processes initialize the same new table, an invocation can report the first error while the table is still becoming readable; retry the invocation once the table is ready.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173064">#173064</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>

##### Messaging channels

###### Nextcloud Talk

- Adds file sharing and supported native voice messages to [Nextcloud Talk](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/nextcloud-talk.md). With OpenClaw and the Nextcloud Talk plugin at 2026.11.5 and a configured API account, opt in to receive files and voice from allowed senders, and send files as downloadable attachments. Sent files remain in that account’s Nextcloud Files until removed.
  Bot-only accounts send web links. See [outbound attachment requirements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk#outbound-attachments). [Incoming shares and voice](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/135895) · [Outgoing attachments](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174306) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/136323b81590fded130fafba60d1b5996f3bac19). Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Adds native voice notes in Nextcloud Talk for explicitly requested MP3 and WAV replies, including replies read aloud by OpenClaw. Voice notes require [Nextcloud Talk API credentials](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk); other audio formats remain attachments.
  [Voice replies #178521](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178521) · Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [quoted reply context](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/channels/nextcloud-talk.md) in Nextcloud Talk 21 and later, so the agent can see the text and author you are replying to when Talk sends the quote and your visibility settings allow it.
  [Quoted replies](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178077) · Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) for the report.

###### Slack

- Adds the ability to ask your agent to create a public Slack channel and invite you. The channel is returned even if the invitation fails.
  Enable `channels.slack.actions.channels` or the equivalent per-account setting. Existing Slack apps need the `channels:manage` and `channels:write.invites` scopes and must be reinstalled or reauthorized. [Slack channel creation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163783). Thanks [@dlmccoy](https://github.com/dlmccoy).
- Reduces the CPU work and temporary allocations needed to prepare Slack replies, including replies with formatted blocks or tables.
  [#184187](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184187) · [81d95d4c4c9e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/81d95d4c4c9eae4727a4a05a96786845db1070ed) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Discord

- Adds an opt-in hook for an authorized policy plugin to remove sensitive content from new Discord events before they are saved to the queue. If sanitization fails, the event is refused.
  See [hook setup and permissions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks#before-durable-channel-ingress) and [durable ingress monitors](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound#durable-ingress-monitors). [Discord ingress hook](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181039). Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Reports a failed Discord voice join if startup is canceled before the connection is ready. You can retry the join yourself. Established connections keep their existing reconnect behavior.
  [#177864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177864) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [Discord troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/troubleshooting) for missing nested plugin dependencies when the Gateway runs with Node’s `--preserve-symlinks` settings.
  [#184143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184143) · [bdf12f6b6b12](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdf12f6b6b1235f10ee361687e0c32db94dd3a6b) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Removes a duplicate warning for slow Discord reactions while keeping the queue warning.
  [#178464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178464) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Telegram

- Groups consecutive matching tool calls in Telegram’s status-only Working preview into one row, such as `Exec ×12`, leaving room for other steps. Calls with different details, failures, approvals and written progress updates stay separate. [Streaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming)
  [#184712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184712) ([`3e82ccd7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3e82ccd7eae1840be6937440d0836e2daebc5ec6)). Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) for the improvement and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it.
- Keeps disabled Telegram buttons visible without making them tappable, with a text fallback where rich buttons aren’t available.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9afcc1b7b29a51535771a09747556970f6fbdfbd) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces the work needed to save a batch of Telegram updates before acknowledging it during [isolated long polling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/transports).
  [#175183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175183) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa0f5a85299c69232ef04ee1060c3b7c6207adb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the CPU and temporary memory needed to process formatted Telegram messages, reply context and poll text as they come in.
  [#183951](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183951) · [f7eab4e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7eab4e6cec3107c28336fe50839b42b5d74c90c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work of checking Telegram accounts during startup and status checks when you have multiple accounts configured.
  [#185771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185771) · [`a4fe79b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4fe79b762d99848add2a66d81b6ddee27e9b663) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Feishu

- Stops retrying failed removal of Feishu document-comment typing reactions during later cleanup, so a reaction may remain on the comment.
  [Feishu comment reactions #177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortened the retry cooldown for failed Feishu bot-name lookups to one minute per account, including after repeated failures.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173047)
- Removes a brief pause while configuring a new Feishu app.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177422">#177422</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b10d3f701143ae970dd08e47b23822c4abaf035e">Commit b10d3f7</a>

###### X

- Adds images, a GIF or a video to [X replies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x) for allowlisted maintainers, including replies without a caption. Reauthorize a text-only X connection with `media.write` to send attachments. If an upload fails, OpenClaw does not post the caption alone.
  Guest replies remain text-only and work-session replies still require explicit approval. [X reply media](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174051) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/75a5207363f0a82c974a7ec5ac22644635897874). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces browser processing when you refresh or edit a large X reply allowlist in the Control UI.

###### Mattermost

- Adds [Mattermost bot-post settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/mattermost#posts-from-other-bots) to ignore bot posts with `allowBots: false` or require explicit activation in channels with `allowBots: "mentions"`.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183239">Bot-post settings and loop protection #183239</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/da579df307a59d6106c8e8a53a90dd5d52a50ae1">Landed commit</a>. ###### Microsoft Teams

- Reduces the work OpenClaw does to save Microsoft Teams file uploads and updates to their consent cards. Poll votes also take less work to save.
  [#184084](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184084) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### WhatsApp

- Loads less JavaScript for WhatsApp settings in English and keeps English visible while another language loads or if it fails to load.
  [#184126](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184126) · [29397d2a185c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29397d2a185c29d4b4d79d2ad41af0f7cf1f6a9b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Zalo

- Corrects the Zalo Personal guide to point to the separate Zalo Bot API integration and explain how to send completed reply blocks as separate messages. Block streaming is off by default. Set `agents.defaults.blockStreamingDefault` to `"on"` to enable it. [Zalo Personal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/zalouser).
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#182112](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182112) · [`5a1187ca`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a1187ca8112cc9cdd1e2977625dad7d699998ed)
- Refreshes other Zalo profiles’ group details on their next lookup after you sign out of one profile.

###### LINE

- Caps simultaneous LINE name lookups, so sender or group names can be missing when too many uncached names are requested at once.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Nostr

- Changes the order of relays tried for outgoing Nostr messages. OpenClaw tries the last relay that accepted a send first, then falls back to the other configured relays.
  [#177931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177931) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Twilio SMS

- Allows SMS status to show a partial result when a Twilio check finishes near its deadline.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177422">#177422</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b10d3f701143ae970dd08e47b23822c4abaf035e">Commit b10d3f7</a>

###### Channel delivery and recovery

- Changes channel stall reporting so an exceptional failure while reporting a stall can interrupt the Gateway and require a restart.
  [#178250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178250) · [e8df448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8df448f663e25180976fbcf26ab89543c4b01d1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces idle channel recovery checks to every five minutes by default. Normal incoming messages and scheduled retries do not wait for that check, and delivery can resume when a slot opens. Messages queued by another process, including manual resubmissions, and deliveries left by a stopped process may wait for the next recovery check. A custom interval can take longer. See the [durable ingress guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound#durable-ingress-monitors) and [channel commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/channels).
  [Idle delivery checks #182237](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182237) · [Recovery timing #183233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183233) · [Landed commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9aa85a1967cb6b86c5ca3aa3c44de35b1f7a3e6) · [Channel recovery timing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-channel-outbound.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts the queue work needed to start processing eligible single messages when a channel’s inbox is idle. Keeps an eligible Telegram message on the route chosen when it was accepted, even if OpenClaw recognizes the chat as a forum while saving the message. If your durable ingress queue wraps `enqueue`, wrap `enqueueAndClaim` too or omit it to keep your wrapper in the admission path.
  [Durable ingress for channel plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/durable-ingress) · [#175459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175459). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database and processing work for queued incoming channel messages, including pickup and retries, and reduces the work of filtering duplicate deliveries.
  [Queue handling #174393](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174393) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca53a1553462622f8fddfa081de829402b4d9a2e) · [Incoming message reads #174555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174555) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/109de7f1e80fba82891646c3b93fb3b977bcdc41) · [iMessage follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3e3ee173e2e5bd87331388b83e5fcf08dc2ae2e8) · [Busy queues #183941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183941) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e79654199eb185dc146def5519358cb4ed5ba6d3) · [Duplicate deliveries #183945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183945) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/00101eb1f63232d5b2e524089a76b650c21ac05e) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Channel status and indicators

- Stops recorded channel status from waiting on extra sign-in checks for channels that are already loaded or excluded by plugin policy.
  [#184402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184402) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work OpenClaw does to keep channel typing indicators active while a reply streams or an agent uses tools.
  [#184962](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184962) · [c613786b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c613786be437ffc365fd55fdb1956f5bbefb73eb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less temporary memory to check for repeat channel progress updates.

###### Messaging replies

- Clarifies which reply token to use for silence in direct or group chats on messaging channels. If your workspace instructions use `HEARTBEAT_OK` for silence, change them to use `NO_REPLY` on its own. [Message guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/messages#silent-replies)
  [#179485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179485) · [7268cee](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7268cee1d50549a955858d97fbc99845ca739dde) · Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the documentation, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for testing.

###### Regional channel maturity

- Breaks out regional channel maturity by account type, connection method, and capability, so evidence for one setup doesn’t imply another was tested. [Maturity taxonomy](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/maturity/taxonomy.md)
  [#177116](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177116). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

##### Mobile and desktop apps

- Adds Open and Share to Android chat documents that previously appeared only as filenames. The file card shows download progress, lets you retry, and tells you if no app can open the file. Documents are limited to 100 MiB, opening requires a compatible app, and downloaded copies are temporary.

- Moves Model sign-in into the iOS chat model menu, while keeping a sign-in link available when credentials need attention. [iOS guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md)

  [#183245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183245) · [4200fbd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4200fbd032d427efad320e9b5af483ff036305ac) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the docs and [@jb-dev1](https://github.com/jb-dev1) for the report.
- Updates the [Android guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/android) to show how to open the current session’s Dashboard from **Chat actions** (⋮) → **Dashboard**. It requires a connected Gateway and uses the same operator identity as the app. The [dashboard architecture guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/dashboard-architecture) also lists Android among the apps that display dashboards in the embedded Control UI.
  [#184198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184198) · [77c9dc706b3e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/77c9dc706b3e36cd6c14c974e4baf2b90f826e9d) · [issue #181514](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181514) · Thanks [@wyf027](https://github.com/wyf027), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@samueltardieu](https://github.com/samueltardieu).
- Reduces temporary memory use when OpenClaw refreshes the node list after a paired device changes.
  [#184783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184783) · [`9d3d98fc`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9d3d98fcb5c00cfc823f76104250ce5af54fd1dc) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds translations for saved-plan controls and recovery messages on iOS and macOS, and iPad prompts for pairing with a Gateway and scanning a setup code. The Mac app also gets translations for unavailable speech recognition and dashboard failure messages, while **Support** is translated on iOS and **Support** and **Get support** on macOS.
