- Fills in translations for automation sessions on iOS and for Queue next, Steer now and connection guidance in iOS and macOS chat. Android gets translations for loading more sessions and retrying after a loading failure, as well as file download, open and share controls and their error and reconnect messages.
  [iOS and macOS chat #183426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183426) ([6e298fb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6e298fbd79e0d4896b438555434eeccb90de4f2e)) · [Android sessions #183474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183474) ([40e5252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40e5252393b5fa70b9e5f2192a02c7256c6dc2aa)) · [Android files #178520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178520).

##### Browser, media and voice

- Adds short spoken results to a connected client’s active [Talk call](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions), such as an announcement after a device action, without starting a new agent task. The client must own a ready Gateway-controlled call and have Talk permission.
  Acceptance confirms the text reached the speech provider. [Client speech #184546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184546) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99caa18ecd2897a9b1e25ba153932807300d790d) · [Administrator client preparation #184596](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184596) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82d3925c99a38315e095ac28d8997d128cf5c314) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds [DeepSeek web search](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/deepseek#web-search) with any model. Its Search API returns titles, links and summaries. Install and enable the official DeepSeek plugin and use a DeepSeek key; searches may incur provider charges.
  [#175729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175729) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/51aa1b76d5d3dde7b4972e09f28f6495b081a7d6) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Changes locally managed Chromium profiles to start without a visible window by default. If you need a visible window, stop the running browser and set `browser.headless` or the profile’s `headless` setting to `false` before starting it again. `OPENCLAW_BROWSER_HEADLESS` takes precedence. Browser discovery can also use an installed full Playwright Chromium without a download. If you choose a headless-shell executable on macOS or Linux, set its path explicitly and use a separate profile to protect existing browser data.
  [#154607](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154607). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds automatic local app previews in OpenClaw-managed Chrome with Playwright for agents authorized for unrestricted execution on the same host. This access can also reach other local services on that host. Set an explicit `browser.ssrfPolicy` to disable automatic local access. [Browser configuration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/browser/configuration.md)
  <span>Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165153">#165153</a></span>
- Adds Inworld speech-rate controls and the `inworld-tts-2` and `inworld-tts-2-flash` models. Delivery presets apply only to `inworld-tts-2`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167951">PR #167951</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e0e02020b98ed86f4400f847de28c5aca7c943a7">`e0e0202`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/deltawerks">@deltawerks</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Keeps automatic media selection on the model it started checking if the active model changes during setup. A later selection can pick up the change.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173009)
- Reduces the temporary memory needed to prepare Talk recordings for file transcription without changing the audio sent for transcription.
  [#175035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175035) — Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Replaces the fixed English line for delegated requests in OpenAI GPT-Live Talk with a short spoken acknowledgment that aims to use your language and vary its wording. It confirms only that Talk heard the request. [Realtime Talk sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions)
  [#175603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175603) · [bbc39da](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bbc39da684d63db6260bb885464fa2b0c37eb056) · [#171848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171848). Thanks enki, dylanharrington, steipete.
- Groups secondary Browser controls in the actions menu, including opening a new tab, copying the address, and opening the page externally where available. When the desktop panel can’t show a page, it explains why and offers **Retry**, **Start**, or **Refresh** as appropriate. The chat sidebar also explains when Browser is unavailable.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176564">#176564</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2d1bf4d80077af16ff38b28287b66a464d0cb40">c2d1bf4d</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Refreshes the link reader on desktop and mobile with a navigation toolbar and a simple address form for empty tabs. Copy the current page’s link from the menu without losing an unfinished address, or open the page externally from the toolbar. On desktop, the new-tab button moves into the toolbar.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176571">#176571</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86e724a25d40de85df1e8a294fdd92e525bac087">86e724a2</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Keeps the provider settings a text-to-speech conversion started with, even when it tries a fallback. New settings apply to the next conversion.
  [#178250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178250) · [commit e8df448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8df448f663e25180976fbcf26ab89543c4b01d1) · [Text-to-speech API](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tts/api). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a choice of full Chromium or Chromium’s headless shell when [building an OpenClaw Docker image](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker). `OPENCLAW_INSTALL_BROWSER=1` still installs both, while `0` or an unset option skips the browser. If you switch to the shell, use a separate headless profile with its own executable path and port. Reusing a full Chromium profile can lose saved site data. With full Chromium only, set the Chromium channel in your own headless Playwright scripts or keep both distributions for the existing launch behavior. Diffs can render PNGs and PDFs with the installed full Chromium when the shell is absent.
  [Commit d4eccd8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4eccd8345371519a9fee2e3f08b875331dd28fa). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Updates the optional Lightpanda deployment example to 1.0.2 for Docker Compose and native downloads. It enforces cross-origin restrictions by default, so sites that relied on unrestricted access across origins may behave differently. Check that a page changed as expected after a click, and use Chromium for sites where buttons inside shadow DOM still fail. The Compose example adds a readiness check and graceful stop; an unhealthy container that is still running will not restart automatically, and existing deployments are not automatically restarted. See the [lightweight browser guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/browser/lightweight).
  [Dependency refresh](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171658) · [Download update and click guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181666) · [Commit d04319e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d04319e60431093017071e23d76f23d5cbf5cb8f) · [Compose readiness and stop configuration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4eccd8345371519a9fee2e3f08b875331dd28fa) · [11.5 sample configuration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/deploy/lightpanda/compose.yaml). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for requesting the update and the Compose changes.
- Skips starting a virtual display for headless sandbox browsers while retaining it for browsers with a window.
  [Commit d4eccd8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4eccd8345371519a9fee2e3f08b875331dd28fa). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces the browser resources needed to keep Browser cards and native Browser views up to date and positioned when many panels are open in the Control UI.
  [#183760](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183760). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Moves the Chrome-family cookie database copy off the Gateway’s main thread on macOS, so other Gateway requests can continue while an import prepares the copy.
  [#181944](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181944) · [commit f991117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9911178a75406ba2c31614ec3c5f9eb80bcff9f). Thanks to steipete.
- Clarifies the existing private-network access rules in the [browser configuration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/browser/configuration). Leaving the setting unset allows public hostnames subject to destination checks. Explicitly turning it off can block those hostnames.
  [#184835](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184835) · [commit 342da13](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/342da13c92e0af1add7936f9bc479394f01e426c) · [Issue #184790](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184790). Thanks [@PratikRai0101](https://github.com/PratikRai0101), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@butzyb1983-tech](https://github.com/butzyb1983-tech).
- Changes how local browser connections restore proxy exclusions. While OpenClaw temporarily bypasses the proxy for a loopback browser connection, changes made to `NO_PROXY` or `no_proxy` in the same process can be overwritten.
  [#182302](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182302) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rejects browser extension relay requests that use changed settings while an earlier startup attempt is still running. Retry after that attempt finishes.
  [#178344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178344). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Updates Canvas commands that look up a node to use the current Gateway node list. Update an older Gateway if it lacks `node.list`.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows your camera choice immediately in Appearance settings and lets you leave while it switches. If the switch fails, the selector returns to your last confirmed choice and shows the error. Retrying a switch or searching for cameras or microphones again clears the previous error without moving focus away from the selector.
  [#179672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179672) · [commit c0a3f2f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c0a3f2f9b49ba8fb808fe7426cf4008b9fc19d24) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [guidance for oversized video attachments](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#video-preparation-compatibility), including why a recording may be refused before upload, what to try next, and how browser preparation differs from playback.
  [#181079](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181079) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74cb12dd2c7597f0d9a388b94bb2b776cac6db25). Thanks [@TheAngryPit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit).
- Uses less temporary memory when choosing a media provider automatically, applying configured image provider aliases, or picking the most recent attachments to process.
  [#183954](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183954) · [commit 8ebe214](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8ebe2147e41f53ed4fb1578cb7e83f166c2e840e). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces temporary memory allocations when OpenClaw encodes images or converts BMP files to PNG.
  [#185202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185202) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated work when listing media-generation activity for a session.
  [#183971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183971). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces browser work for Control UI Talk captions, the microphone meter and the Stop voice input tooltip. When the tab is hidden, caption updates and the level meter pause while audio capture and playback continue; captions catch up when you return.
  [Live captions and hidden-tab meter](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184003) · [Hidden-tab captions](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184132) · [commit 4846765](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4846765d3e20bb194bd17a0a9909e49c2ea69dc6) · [Tooltip positioning](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184200) · [commit be76319](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/be763191504ff57ed561540896e2ed25a735f726) · [Stationary tooltip](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184609) · [commit 4a97c0a9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a97c0a9c637e7ef92cdbcf8183c48293f602e04) · [Microphone meter](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184961) · [commit 3fb6424](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fb642489fe19a6d5c34644673a0ec9270e72a26). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work your browser does to capture and play audio in Control UI Talk on browsers with built-in support for the conversion. Older supported browsers use the existing fallback.
  [#184879](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184879) · [commit e7e2592b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e7e2592ba03aa507d7a787523de845fb707d3909). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

Overlapping saves keep changes in order without overwriting unrelated settings. See [text-to-speech commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tts/commands).

##### Meetings

- Marks the meeting summary as busy for assistive technology while OpenClaw is generating it.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#180648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180648) · [4adce84](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4adce84e576877449d49846e2f4b5b9684b64e3f)

##### Workboard

- Loads [Workboard](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) cards and sessions in pages of up to 100. Boards and dashboard widgets show how much has loaded and offer **Load more cards** or **Load more sessions** where applicable. Card search and filters cover loaded cards, dependencies outside that set are marked **Not loaded**, and reordering waits until all cards are loaded. The Sessions agent filter also covers loaded rows, while the people filter applies across the board. Refresh if live movement causes entries to be skipped or repeated. Workboard CLI listings and session controls follow pages for you. Custom Gateway clients must pass `nextCursor` as `after` to retrieve the rest; a Sessions move returns only the first page.
  [PR #175349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175349). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces browser work on large Workboards when opening boards, sizing labels, using menus and status popovers, selecting and dragging linked cards, loading columns, and applying live card updates. Keyboard navigation, card details and reordering remain available.
  [Labels and menus #183763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183763) · [Opening and linked cards #183922](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183922) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/337db548716a823eff7e9af0ef203773917e4e92)) · [Columns #183999](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183999) · [Live card updates #184721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184721) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d9586cfd09bf05c5cb873d8099959e6bedd37ad)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the CPU work Workboard does to display card dates and durations, including when you clear a search on a large board. If your system time zone changes while Workboard is open, reload the page to refresh the card timestamps.
  [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) · [#184286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184286) · [4b2d97b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4b2d97bafc3e92ab859fbfed44ecbc655bed03e8). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when saving [Workboard cards](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) with long histories or lots of related data, and when successful saves check for duplicate cards or newer revisions.
  [Card history and related data #174174](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174174) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/911db4b680804787d1f4acd4792b90566a0f1ab7) · [Duplicate and revision checks #183038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183038) · [8f807add](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f807addc796520a08729ea309d9dacf77a08430). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated work when several tabs refresh Workboard board and card lists, while keeping committed edits visible on the next refresh.
  [#179090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179090) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) · [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard).
- Removes an extra SQLite lookup when moving a session on the Workboard Sessions board, while still rejecting moves based on outdated placement.
  [#182943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182943). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets Board widgets load while an already-open SQLite session is only saving ordinary transcript entries, such as messages and tool results.
  [#173763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173763). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Uses less CPU and memory when loading session dashboards with widgets, and cuts extra work when switching Board tabs or updating native report widgets on large dashboards.
  [Session dashboards #184391](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184391) · [Board reports #184570](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184570) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cd627de53f3f16fc5835672bc74baa39d93ccb3). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts CPU and memory overhead when preparing Workboard tools for each agent turn.
  [#186394](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186394). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Storage, workspaces and files

- Adds full-text, substring and exact vector search options for developers who declare the corresponding indexes in fresh PostgreSQL store schemas. Install the extensions and grant the permissions required by the chosen modes. [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)
  Full-text configuration belongs to each store. Independent Gateways sharing a database need separate state directories and schema prefixes. Run one Gateway per store and use separate roles and grants if installations need different permissions. [Shared database setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#one-database-with-separate-namespaces) · [Search indexes #173625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173625) · [Store-scoped configuration #173745](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173745) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated startup overhead for repository and worktree reads across short polling gaps.
  [#172849](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172849). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changed branch suggestions and workspace Git status to refresh after a 30-second cache. External changes may take a moment to appear. Worktree creation checks the branch you select.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172992](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172992)
- Speeds up repeated project listings when session details have not changed and reduces work on unrelated sessions when opening recent projects on large shared Gateways.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reused project listings [#173281](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173281) · Profile-scoped recent projects [#173323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173323)
- Avoids repeatedly recalibrating managed Btrfs worktree checkouts as a repository advances through commits.
  The process reuses its measured checkout strategy for matching worktrees. A substantial workload change can make that choice slower until the process restarts. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173318](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173318) · [Managed worktrees](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/managed-worktrees.md)
- Reduces temporary allocations for large session inventories as OpenClaw discovers new SQLite access scopes.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173410">#173410</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids repeating some SQLite checks when the Gateway reopens an unchanged database in the same run. OpenClaw also avoids a second full integrity scan when it reopens its agent database in the same process after a direct media-persistence migration. See [SQLite integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery).
  [Media migration reopening #173499](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173499) · [commit 497b0af](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/497b0afb37069ef211cd37575d8338aa19b42bce) · [Gateway reopening #174660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174660) · [commit 6552b30](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6552b30f56da4568cd4ba464bfd6cef4ac4f62f1). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work during startup and first use while checking SQLite schemas.
  [#173617](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173617) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reuses unchanged files when an eligible idle managed worktree template moves to a different commit. Adds file cloning on XFS volumes that support it, with regular Git checkout available as a fallback.
  [#173892](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173892) · [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · Thanks steipete.
- Reduces SQLite log writes for transcripts, session data and memory origins, and cuts write work on SQLite and PostgreSQL for activity such as ACP replay, skill usage and reactions. PostgreSQL transcript and session-window writes also need less index work. To return to a build that cannot read the upgraded databases, restore a verified pre-upgrade backup with its matching build. See [database versioning](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning).
  [Transcript, session and memory writes #174036](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174036) · [Replay, usage, lease and activity writes #174638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174638) · [commit 139b998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/139b998d0b6aeaa3811326b3198fcb117e1c8307) · [Agent schema history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/agent-schema-history) · [State schema history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/state-schema-history). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated PostgreSQL work when setting up search, using vector indexes, running prepared queries, moving data between databases, and exporting backups. [PostgreSQL operations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#174705](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174705) · [commit 87f2bbf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87f2bbf10856757c37ad008967eab2195e53d171). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes an unnecessary second read when verifying a backup. That also saves a pass when you create a backup with verification enabled or verify one before restoring it.
  [#175518](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175518). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Avoids rewriting your entire SQLite conversation archive just to classify old messages during the 11.5 storage migration. Some reads of older history can take more work as a result. Verified moves from SQLite to PostgreSQL also handle those older transcripts without requiring the rewrite first.
  [Database storage changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes.md) · [#175531](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175531). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids rereading session data from PostgreSQL when OpenClaw has just saved a replacement and can still use the data it committed.
  [#175718](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175718) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f5de32afc6a57c4edf14e9fdb0edae1301482ffd). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows “Updating repository…” instead of a generic wait message while a new worktree fetches the default branch. If you reopen the chat while the fetch is still in progress, you see that status there too.
  [PR #178526](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178526). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Reduces database space for overlapping managed workspace inventories and reloads them more quickly. Existing inventories convert during reconciliation. The upgraded database needs a build that supports its new schema. To roll back to 11.4, [restore the verified pre-upgrade backup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning) with its matching build.
  [Managed workspaces](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · [#184581](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184581) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a25b072d1684843a0649f755e4e65c2a40f5f5d1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts work on large managed sandbox workspaces after small edits, including memory used to check and apply changes. Checkpoints save changed and removed paths, waiting requests can share a scan, and cancelling the operation stops the checkpoint read. Large compressible checkpoints put less pressure on the write queue. To return to an older checkpoint writer, [restore the verified pre-upgrade backup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning) with its matching build.
  [#179734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179734) · [#179783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179783) · [#180149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180149) · [commit 7ef8532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ef85325b7c718f7ec27ecf496fe09a92a080d94) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens workspace paths on new native Windows Crabbox workers, leaving more room for installers and nested files before Windows path limits. [Reprovision an existing worker](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation) to use the shorter paths.
  [#181202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181202) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a7dcf319571375855037ee2752402ea14aa05dd) · [#166198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166198) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the change and [@saftall](https://github.com/saftall) for the report.
- Adds a [two-host setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/file-transfers#split-storage-setup) for keeping workspace files on a paired node while the Gateway keeps configuration and session state. It also clarifies how Memory files, workspace Skills and input attachments work in that setup.
  [#184900](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184900) · [0eed99e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0eed99e0cff5a5e5564bd4dc2e91683972b77be0) · Thanks [@kevinlin-openai](https://github.com/kevinlin-openai).
- Gives recovery guidance when a worktree name belongs to another session. Choose an unused name or leave it blank to generate one. Fresh worktrees take less setup work, including when the default branch has advanced. In worktrees using accelerated checkout, preparation of the first prompt can start sooner while workspace tools wait for checkout to finish.
  [#178185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178185) · [commit d22bd4f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d22bd4f3187a35e1b84d9d4100397c6975a7715c) · [#184253](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184253) · [b70762f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b70762fc496cb6c595fc15d45944a5cf2114e4d6) · [#184305](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184305) · [0c6a286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c6a28603c6ac74efbc110037daec8ef2647512f) · [managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · [#184372](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184372) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated database work when preparing a populated agent workspace for another turn. Protection against recreating generated files that disappear lasts at least 23 hours after the last unchanged preparation, including across a restart.

##### Installing, updating and recovery

- Adds recovery-copy counts and sizes to local [status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) and [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor), and lets you preview eligible migration backups and orphaned update copies for [cleanup by exact path](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#explicitly-retire-an-unmanifested-original). Incomplete size estimates are marked. Stop the Gateway before confirming removal. Deletion is permanent.
  [Recovery copy counts and cleanup #181195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181195) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b7940222e3b0827580de712372ac87fd3f87d871) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Lets some active main conversations pick up after a graceful Gateway restart. Built-in Goals that qualify can continue after the recovered reply succeeds. Subagents and background commands stop instead of restarting on their own. If startup fails before the continuation begins, automatic resumption can be lost. Clients using `sessions.recover` need to account for its removal. See [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).
  Queued messages follow in order under each sender’s current permissions, and the Control UI returns to the normal composer. The Gateway process limits its wait for shutdown cleanup; embedded Gateways still wait for cleanup they own. [Restart recovery #185730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185730) · [Goal continuation #186599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186599) · [Tagged restart recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/restart-recovery.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces unnecessary work in Doctor’s plugin-link checks and repairs and in plugin relinking after a core update. Both skip old npm plugin copies when OpenClaw can identify the active installs.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@patelmm79](https://github.com/patelmm79). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176121">#176121</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44df069fe2d14c399bc7f7620d25c016289041cf">Commit 44df069</a>
- Stops `openclaw doctor --lint` from repeatedly copying the state database when several checks need a private copy.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176130">#176130</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/470ba9649aaa62e53fb17e3e56cab505861db3c3">Commit 470ba96</a>
- Stops Doctor’s local embedding check from copying memory databases for agents that use remote embeddings or have memory search turned off. It also skips copy-failure warnings for those agents. This check runs with `openclaw doctor --lint --all` or when selected explicitly. [Doctor lint guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176281">#176281</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c7d58180902acd551acd0182dc51e32edab49863">Commit c7d5818</a>
- Skips completed legacy webhook migration checks at Gateway startup without rewriting your config. If OpenClaw can’t save that the check finished, it warns and tries again on a later boot. [Config migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations)
  [#177224](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177224), [issue #169406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169406). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@oxen-horse](https://github.com/oxen-horse), [@hbgangcn1](https://github.com/hbgangcn1).
- Logs why a background update check could not look up new versions. Also reports unexpected failures in the scheduled check itself and keeps normal shutdown quiet.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177397">#177397</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3656d831b800c1210471db06fdafe9ab4c9e6d3">Commit c3656d8</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating">Updating OpenClaw</a>
- Cuts the number of files in npm installs to leave more room below the updater file-count limit while keeping the original Control UI assets.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182279">#182279</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Shows the process IDs Doctor can identify when it refuses maintenance because an agent database is in use, so you can check what’s blocking the repair before stopping anything.
  [#183735](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183735). Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). [Doctor recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/recovery). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cf016bbbd1b409f09e01c19ba9ee2697c2e21ba).
- Avoids a second full database backup during `openclaw doctor --fix` when the schema upgrade has already prepared every store and no heartbeat migration still needs a backup. Doctor keeps the full rollback backup when a store isn’t ready or remaining heartbeat work needs it.
  [#186031](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186031) · [`1b356b48`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b356b487d8e7eb5946af999eb4fe9517eaee2ef). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds [confirmed lock recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock#recover-a-crashed-foreign-owner) when a stopped PostgreSQL-backed Gateway leaves a lock that blocks its replacement from starting. Verify that the old Gateway has stopped, then run `openclaw gateway recover-lock` with the same state directory and profile and follow the printed confirmation command. Confirmation requires an OpenClaw build that expects the database’s current schema version.
  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert). [#183623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183623)
- Cuts startup delays for `openclaw agent exec` and Auto Review on Linux when the running Gateway has already checked the same SQLite agent database and OpenClaw can verify it is opening that file. A replacement file gets its own integrity check.
  [#182984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182984) · [0a592701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a59270186cb9a405415d71acc68ec18000f9c70) · [#183052](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183052) · [feee07c1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/feee07c12e1bdc433cba610999c8f021675aae73) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · [Integrity checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#integrity-checks)
- Removes an unnecessary wait on other agents’ session stores when the Gateway recovers an agent’s sessions after a restart. The Gateway still warns about legacy session problems it finds on startup. [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)
  [#185706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185706) · [`965ada3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/965ada3e32dca796505c3398fd406b19c10a3a24) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Moves official Docker and bundled sandbox images to Debian 13. If you used the old default sandbox images, build the Debian 13 replacements before starting new sandboxes, including browser or common images if you use them. See the [sandbox image setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/images-and-setup).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176595">#176595</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a4e7aefd743790bbca49925ae0c7e6c1a85e6d4">3a4e7aef</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies how to upgrade container installs safely. Keep SQLite state on persistent local storage, run one Gateway per state volume, and stop the old Gateway before starting its replacement. If you use the documented Kubernetes manifest with an existing state volume, run Doctor separately with the new image before bringing the Gateway back up. [Docker upgrades](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker#upgrading-container-images) · [Kubernetes guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/kubernetes)
  [#178794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178794), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177288), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f7572ad13d12d5d34d21adecf5198cbb0fbb39d). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@akshitkhokhani](https://github.com/akshitkhokhani), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Adds Docker guidance for read-only containers, including what needs writable storage and where to mount a separate private volume for Doctor’s recovery captures. For a read-only config mount, set `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY=1` for both the Gateway and CLI and apply config repairs in the external deployment source.
  <span>[#179042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179042) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@eliasbogordos](https://github.com/eliasbogordos) · [Docker installation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker) · [Externally managed config](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/config#externally-managed-config)</span>
- Adds automatic cleanup of eligible older update recovery copies and migration originals when the 11.5 updater completes an update successfully. The recovery copy for that update stays in place. Cleanup can also run when you’re already on the requested version, and any problems appear as warnings. If you need an older rollback copy, keep an independent backup before updating, since cleanup permanently removes eligible copies.
  [#181033](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181033) · [Update cleanup and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps verified database snapshots for manual update recovery even if OpenClaw can’t confirm that the live database stayed unchanged. These snapshots may predate later writes, so preserve current data and follow the recovery guide before restoring. [Manual recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery)
  [#178629](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178629) · [`f06bab6`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f06bab6edeeecb80e54cbe6d3dc42708aef4f292) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Warns when a managed Gateway service may restart with outdated environment values. Restart and Doctor show the affected key names. Run `openclaw gateway install --force` to refresh the service environment if your installation policy permits it.
  <span>Thanks [@maxsxu](https://github.com/maxsxu), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lance23](https://github.com/lance23). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159066">#159066</a></span>
- Adds `openclaw gateway status --runtime-intent-only --json` to inspect the service’s pinned runtime without a running Gateway or PostgreSQL. If status reports a pending migration, run `openclaw doctor`. Use the upgraded CLI to edit runtime pins after migration.
  <span>Updates preserve the service’s pinned runtime while migration is pending, and updater recovery includes the local pin store. The status option and `--require-rpc` are mutually exclusive. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172703">#172703</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/gateway/query.md#L268-L273">Gateway status documentation</a>.</span>
- Adds per-store checks to Doctor so you can see which databases match your configured engine, which need a migration, and which Doctor could not inspect. The JSON report includes every store Doctor inspects. `openclaw status` shows what the selected Gateway already knows and points you to Doctor when those details are unavailable. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor)
  [#174912](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174912) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows which check or repair Doctor is running and repeats the phase name with elapsed time every 10 seconds during long waits. Progress appears in human-readable output. [Doctor guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/running.md)
  [#178767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178767), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/154636), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c6f14b27a938f7a3f5b4960bcc45fe29dd6daccc). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@MoerAI](https://github.com/MoerAI), [@JIRBOY](https://github.com/JIRBOY).
- Adds a Retry button in Updates settings when a status check fails unexpectedly. Opening Updates or checking again shows when that check is running without hiding the settings or the progress of an update already underway.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179759">#179759</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Cuts the time spent checking SQLite databases during routine schema migrations with declared changes. OpenClaw runs a quick check across the database and fully checks affected tables. The default can miss an index mismatch in an untouched table. With the 11.5 CLI, use `openclaw update --full-integrity-check` or `openclaw doctor --fix --full-integrity-check` to check every table and index during migration. [SQLite integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)
  [#174742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174742) · [`dae099a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dae099a9414b37d520dfc5cf31b05a2862259586). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids scanning the same live agent database twice in one standalone Doctor run when you upgrade it with a full integrity check. Requires a full check before the database can be used if the migration only ran a quick check.
  [Database integrity and recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery.md) · [#175402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175402). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces disk activity during package and Git updates to PostgreSQL-compatible versions by avoiding unnecessary database copies. This applies when the update is run by the 11.5 updater.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173201">#173201</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Shortens the readiness wait for managed Gateway updates and recovery by dropping the extra wait for repeated healthy checks. The updater already installed on your system controls the wait during an upgrade. [Managed updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run)
  [#174608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174608) · [commit 5a93d92](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a93d92ef7392191ff8ea2511281124350aff7f6). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Skips a second scan of saved session transcripts during updates when the first scan finds no labels to repair and the history has not changed. Later updates can skip that work once this version is installed. The update from v2026.11.4 still runs both scans.
  [#177933](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177933) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Speeds up the final package checks during npm updates and rollbacks without relaxing those checks. The improvement applies once you’re running the updated updater.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179797">#179797</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169599">#169599</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fc6f44822842cee21256dd655df7ac0d055a209">3fc6f448</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Tsuki-hash](https://github.com/Tsuki-hash) for the earlier proposal and released co-author Aaron08140.</span>
- Fetches less history when Git source installation needs a new tag in a shallow checkout, while preserving the history you already have.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177502">#177502</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/146284a289f98a2cf3babbc55cc3bd16c28e604b">Commit 146284a</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer">Installer guide</a>
- Gives the macOS command-line setup wizard up to six seconds to hear back from the Gateway before timing out, up from 750 milliseconds.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176744](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176744) · [commit f65c1a6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f65c1a6729617f4fd2076dbce39d86799a4d6a1d)
- Clarifies which Doctor session checks can run while the Gateway is up. You can inspect and validate SQLite session history online, and repairs and compaction require a stopped Gateway. Validation can add load. [SQLite maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180414">PR #180414</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f2dc1efeb2a81e05b37c043cef10de2e3d5372b">Commit 2f2dc1e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Clarifies Hermes migration errors when a required text file or memory source can’t be read. The error names the file and tells you to retry with an ordinary, readable UTF-8 file.
  [#180908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180908) · [Hermes migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/migrating-hermes). Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668).
- Clarifies in the [update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) why an npm update can warn about extra execute permissions on unchanged files, and why the updater you already have installed determines whether the update can continue.
  [#181141](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181141) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eabadc409a0398fbe285993f21bc2ff356c4496a)). - Updates the [Gateway update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run) to explain why a package update can stop before changing the installation when the Gateway service uses an unsupported Node version. Preflight checks the Node version used by the service separately from the one in your shell.
  [#181618](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181618) · [Report #181611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181611) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the guide update and [@samueltardieu](https://github.com/samueltardieu) for the original report.
- Reduces the standalone runtime sidecar and bundles SQLite for macOS standalone builds, removing the Homebrew dependency for SQLite on a clean Mac. When packaging for macOS, sign the bundled SQLite library and refresh its hash and the sidecar inventory using the [standalone packaging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  [#172802](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172802). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds ahead-of-time WebAssembly compilation to experimental standalone builds for bundled image, PDF, voice, command parsing, Code Mode, Matrix encryption, and archive workloads. The executable is larger, and compilation covers modules bundled at build time. [WebAssembly in AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone#webassembly-in-aot-builds)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182304">#182304</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Cuts the CPU and memory needed to start Gateway workers in [Bun standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183143">#183143</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8ae44f9249540b4d377fb6b80f25f004a5d959e1">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Adds an [experimental GitHub Actions workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/install/standalone-aot-actions.md) for trying ahead-of-time compiled standalone builds on macOS 27 arm64. Enable it manually and supply a qualifying compiler bundle from a successful run on `main` in the same repository. The workflow targets unsigned standalone archives.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183185">#183185</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5e6258c14bbe68fc9bdefd2162a185016f29c75">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Reduces the work needed to recover saved chat input and pending commands after a Gateway restart.
  [#179528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179528) · [3de0a78](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3de0a781925cdd555033ee5df9610f280b8ab528) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes a second check of meeting transcript data Doctor has just imported. If an import saved the transcripts but did not finish archiving, Doctor can check and archive the source files without parsing the transcripts again. Repairs to older transcript directives also skip a second scan.
  [#178247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178247) · [commit 658e8bd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/658e8bd101e9773b2b2d9cf0378a29407babbc7b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds troubleshooting for older installed versions where debug console logging can stop an update with `managed-service-handoff-failed` while the old Gateway keeps serving. If your installed version is affected, temporarily set `logging.consoleLevel` to `info` and remove `OPENCLAW_LOG_LEVEL=debug` from both the Gateway and update command environments. Run `openclaw update`, then restore your settings. Debug file logging can stay on. [Affected versions and workaround](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting#debug-logging-blocks-the-update-handoff)
  [#177630](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177630) · [b413bdc2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b413bdc277ecd8b7758ba6d7ac0454dec8721e52). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Sets a fixed, size-based time limit for copying or checking candidate state and plugin data. With the 11.5 updater, that work can time out on slow storage even while it is making progress.
  [#175482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175482) · [Tagged update I/O](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/src/infra/update-candidate-io.ts). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes which result wins when update checks overlap in 11.5. An eligible older result that finishes last can replace a newer one, including the scheduled automatic update on dev-channel Git installations. An update already applying keeps its target.
  [#175482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175482) · [Tagged update discovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/src/infra/update-startup.ts). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated reads of saved session data when Doctor checks sessions, including during update-time repairs.
  [#174950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174950) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeat lookups for installation history when Doctor checks whether old webhook settings need to be migrated.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176721) · [commit 35b9027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35b9027b912d80383a68b04cbd7dcc3e6d939184)
- Cuts repeated reads of SQLite databases during Doctor maintenance and update checks while retaining database verification.
  [#177082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177082). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Speeds up Doctor’s tool checks on large agent fleets and reduces their memory use while still checking each agent’s workspace.
  [#182035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182035) · [commit 82b4c0c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82b4c0c078b03a34612b0ac95a11224069b3b300). Thanks to steipete and 609NFT.
- Skips an extra Gateway config read when shell fallback supplies no values.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176596">#176596</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a43904e70446a7c9793f5e12e301c7e1f622ce5">6a43904e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts unnecessary database work when the Gateway checks for restart notifications, saves an installation configuration key in an existing SQLite database, or looks up repository workspaces when there are none to read.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178046">#178046</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cbfe33af1c453503a0d118ac3f47390bc4c6cddd">cbfe33af</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces SQLite snapshot and update backup work by cloning where the filesystem supports it, removing an extra copy from Git update backups and skipping a duplicate check on some private update snapshots. Finished snapshots are verified.
  Btrfs NOCOW clones use unchecksummed, uncompressed files. [Snapshot cloning #172763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172763) · [Private snapshot checks #174928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174928) · [Git backups #177524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177524) · [commit 954a610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/954a610f5d0fd1e5c542e7a7ed4206ad1484bb02). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces startup and update work by avoiding repeated configuration recovery checks, unnecessary database work after desktop approvals have migrated, and repeat full scans of cleanly closed SQLite databases on compatible updates. Databases with a record tied to an older OpenClaw version still need one full check.
  [SQLite checks #176909](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176909) · [Configuration recovery #176976](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176976) · [Desktop approvals #176996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176996) · [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes the wait for pending GitHub publication retries at Gateway startup, so the Gateway can accept agent work while recovery continues in the background. It also avoids a second read of credential information during startup or restart. Shutdown still waits for recovery work already in progress. [Gateway readiness](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health)
  [Publication recovery #180128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180128) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/24ce72273e0c80488c2671e1c99dc37b63e50cb4) · [Credential reads #180154](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180154) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cca4a1714700462e8a6b20adf92ea2e847713574). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Reduces repeated permission checks when the Gateway resumes an operator’s run after a restart, while still checking that the operator has access.
  [Recovery checks #179425](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179425) · [Permission checks #182965](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182965) · [commit f7e2eed9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7e2eed98468b80ed091cf5ed4a7554aaf00c8ef). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps patched Node 24.22.1 in the Docker build on Debian 13. If the shell or PowerShell installer can’t read the selected package’s Node requirement, it falls back to Node 24.22.1 or newer on the 24.x line or 26.12.1 or newer on the 26.x line. [Node compatibility](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node-compatibility)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179992">#179992</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6c00e67f5703c85f2aea88cf79f7ff702821fbb5">commit 6c00e67f</a>. Thanks to [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Adds a `--plugins` option for [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone), so packagers can ship a smaller bundle with the plugins they choose. Builds still include every built plugin by default. A curated build must keep required plugins, and omitted installable plugins can still be added later without rebuilding the executable.
  [#173794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173794) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f69048d28d95f02116495615247695ba61393bb4). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds `--trim-allow` to [experimental standalone AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) so you can keep subprocess support and optionally the JIT when trimming, including when you keep only selected locales.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183377">#183377</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f3ab195038294f9b3ffb96f4f381752e580cdb4">2f3ab19</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds a repeatable `--aot-disable` option for [experimental standalone AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone). If whole-program analysis runs out of memory, try `--aot-disable=flow-results`. Skipping that analysis can produce a larger or slower executable, so validate it before use.
  [#185769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185769) · [`dfff2cc`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dfff2ccf6cbfc0ee494ed39c15924d39dcefb496) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Drops prebuilt Brotli copies of Control UI assets from the npm package to reduce the number of installed files. Gzip copies are still included.
  [#188097](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188097). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Clarifies in the [installer guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer) that Bash installers preserve stricter permissions, create runtime paths without group or other write access, and leave existing files unchanged.
  [Commit 12470a5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12470a5def461a76696befe7a59bd518cae59f8b).
- Refreshes dependencies across OpenClaw, its extensions and native apps, including the OpenAI client and email libraries. New Sherpa ONNX speech runtime downloads use 1.13.8, and OpenClaw accepts version 0.223 of the optional OpenTelemetry exporter alongside 0.220.
  [#185194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185194) · [ed4c9d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed4c9d4434495921bc42192fe724f9fd0d5d629b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Updates the manual-install and source-setup guides to recommend Node 24.22.1 or later on Node 24, or 26.12.1 or later on Node 26, for their security fixes. The [compatibility guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node-compatibility) explains which older versions remain supported, and the [update troubleshooting guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting) identifies 2026.9.5 as the first release with both fixes for the 2026.9.3 and 2026.9.4 updater swap problems.
  Node guidance [#185347](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185347) · [ef1df2f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef1df2f79516e9fbf33b8f8d0ed4b5c6b6d52404). [Node compatibility](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node-compatibility). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Update troubleshooting [#185339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185339) · [b17fbf8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b17fbf8584eac82f995d877c595cc654e46a612c). [Update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Updates the package update guide with repair steps for supported cases where a drive remount changes its device number. The guide explains when you need a recovery-capable installation before running the repair and when to stop and preserve evidence if the launcher cannot be verified. [Package update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). [#184143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184143) · [bdf12f6b6b12](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdf12f6b6b1235f10ee361687e0c32db94dd3a6b)
- Replaces conflicting [manual update instructions for npm, pnpm, and Bun](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods#alternative-manual-npm-pnpm-or-bun) with one recovery procedure that includes running Doctor and refreshing the managed Gateway service before starting it again.
  [#185499](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185499). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds [recovery instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods#system-package-and-image-based-installs) for system-package or image upgrades that leave the Gateway stopped waiting for a state migration. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` as the service account against its state, then restart through the service manager if Doctor does not. If you roll back after migration, restore the matching pre-upgrade state backup too.
  [#178347](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178347). Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Clarifies Doctor’s warning when the CLI and Gateway use different state directories. After moving or renaming the directory, follow the [migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/migrating) and run `openclaw gateway restart` instead of reloading, then rerun `openclaw doctor` with the same profile or state directory.
  [#178386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178386). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report.
- Clarifies in the [Configure guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/configure.md) that on Windows, the same Gateway state and config paths can be spelled with different capitalization, even if a directory has not been created yet.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185917">#185917</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a505a5e05986e33d24c92fe0c9832ac9a30cf5cf">Released commit</a> · Thanks to [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the release backport
- Adds Doctor guidance for when import or restore refuses a session archive moved behind a symlink. Keep the link, archive and migration records intact, make a verified backup, and keep transcripts and raw manifests private when asking for recovery help. [Doctor guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185925">#185925</a> · Thanks to [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@christopherhb](https://github.com/christopherhb), [@kevinlp](https://github.com/kevinlp)
- Clarifies in the [macOS VM guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/macos-vm) that closing a MacBook lid can put the host to sleep and stop the VM and Gateway even with idle sleep disabled, and links to Apple guidance for running with the lid closed.
  [#186801](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186801) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3eb6e8df529bfc83ec5e2c228a00ffc707426416) · Thanks [@Yun-0000](https://github.com/Yun-0000), [@bartdudzic](https://github.com/bartdudzic) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Cuts repeated SQLite and agent-store checks and reads during Gateway startup and restart, including legacy ACP session scans. Doctor skips rechecking session data known to be valid, and SQLite maintenance avoids repeated database work.
  Startup probe Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183576) · Agent stores [#183704](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183704). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Startup database checks [#174411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174411) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Startup and Doctor [#175151](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175151) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · SQLite capability checks [PR #176444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176444) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b99a91d5ee45e039b0ec5e9dc4316899727e9da6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Startup and maintenance [PR #176545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176545) and [commit 59eeed0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/59eeed0be517f825fe74b3d9e39352b55cee02f4). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces disk work for configuration checks and plugin information when a Gateway restarts, including after a verified clean shutdown and when checking whether the previous Gateway is still running. See [state database recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery).
  Checking the previous Gateway [#185782](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185782) · [`b41e95b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b41e95bdfe43e0a51da6f11b32bfbd455fad0824) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) · Clean shutdown [#186176](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186176) · [Commit c4c345af](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4c345af4e8842219a880c13a1788a560878dc84) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces work when the Gateway or CLI starts, including loading settings and plugins and preparing session history after recovery. Some Gateway paths can use more memory.

[#184117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184117) · [3ded9c4ca816](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ded9c4ca81653b0f9736a2941f369fcb4e537a1) · Installed plugin lists Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184137) · [fc7c9c63389d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc7c9c63389d2e28ede30bd4f366e8abfe8d99d0) · Saved plugin model listings [#184238](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184238) · [6f8d6b0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f8d6b066568ae68a0b16fe9fba3bbd3a5a200b0). - Reduces startup waits for Gateways that load several independent external plugins by preparing their sources in parallel for ordered registration.
  [#184211](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184211) · [872cb2a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/872cb2afe987bb5fd2a51e5422cae45cb7a88525). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts Gateway startup work on SQLite installations by skipping database creation during memory recovery for configured agents that don’t have a database yet.
  [#185833](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185833) · [`97a1b4c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97a1b4c07336db0c2f0eb52901118983490b7b1e) · Thanks [@freeqaz](https://github.com/freeqaz)
- Reduces the work needed to load DeepSeek and Moonshot policies when you start a built Gateway from a source checkout. Bundled web-channel requests also load their plugin files from the selected build.
  [#185998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185998) · [`548565cb`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/548565cbacdcb55f15ee57ece60604f6971d7271). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts startup work for operations such as handling images and files, running Git, reconciling chat history, and matching scheduled jobs. The same change cuts startup work for serving Control UI files and public conversation cards.
  [#186137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186137) · [Commit 98a9fdeb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98a9fdeb40ceacbd1c8f7de13862ff5fc7d0c5bc) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Skips extra work when updating a macOS Gateway service with no existing service policies to preserve.
  [#184874](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184874) · [5d0b9202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d0b920274561df6588cb2800cab5af6231c8adb). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU use and memory allocations when checking update status on installations not managed by OCM.
  [#184397](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184397). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens the pause in accepting new requests during release activation for teams using the updated team-server deployment controller. If the controller cannot verify the current or previous release during its initial check, it stops activation without pausing new requests.
  [PR #174290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174290) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67b7402dc5e5f87a214ea255521ed667204b030a) · [Controller guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Puts unresolved problems that need attention under **Fix now** in [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running), with next steps, and removes findings from the final summary once a repair is verified. Doctor also gives clearer guidance for sign-in, credentials and other checks.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e6d56ae46f436c1fd71db03462c2f59ac112c03). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Reduces work in Doctor when preparing plugins, checking databases and conversation history, and reporting migration failures. SQLite snapshot inspection no longer blocks Doctor, and update and Doctor checks avoid duplicate reads of databases without a journal or write-ahead log.
  Model metadata and legacy worktree migrations [#184632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184632) ([`2515d2fe`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2515d2fe6fe5deaa4746f11da029a864a3f275ec)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Bundled plugin preparation <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186274">#186274</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8e328edad391017cca518fc32084a4064f3cbd2b">commit 8e328ed</a>. Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · Delegated update checks and migrated database close <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186250">#186250</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b5eef313c35bd7510fa328c88f8bc4d0472d698">commit 1b5eef3</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186251">#186251</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba2c43235473f7977060b00cce5ad729c951ad83">commit ba2c432</a>.
