- Cuts repeated reads and integrity checks when 11.5 Doctor saves recovery copies, rebuilds indexes or upgrades an unchanged SQLite database. Offline Doctor and the new version’s upgrade preparation also skip unnecessary table checks. Requested [full integrity checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) still cover the whole database.
  Recovery copies and indexes [PR #175359](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175359) and [database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Database upgrades [PR #175776](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175776) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ce9e7c2961cce1202215601799d52dd76e75dcf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Table checks [PR #175808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175808) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bdb482a8dfef0dc76fa04061d2fd57d3938b9100). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Verifies and reuses the original recovery copy during an update instead of making another full copy, and stops the repair if it cannot verify that original. [Older recovery copies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations#older-updater-recovery-copies) cannot restore external plugin files they never captured.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e6d56ae46f436c1fd71db03462c2f59ac112c03). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Extends update and Doctor recovery to preserve the [local credential store](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning#local-client-credentials) as it was before the operation. Ordinary backups keep local client identities and cached tokens but leave out the native socket token, so local socket credentials have to be initialized again after a restore.
  [PR #174294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174294) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4706053bc398d6ccf519a4d21fb1e9ed1cecb31d) · [Client cutover PR #174599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174599) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated file checks during [backup creation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup), while still leaving private update captures out of the archive.
  [#175136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175136) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces SQLite backup work during automatic updates run by 11.5. During [stopped updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating), this version also avoids a second full copy of checkpointed databases with no pending journal.
  Automatic backups [#184559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184559) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c73495de40bcf910b1b1af16ff5dd36b5e0cc9f2) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · Stopped updates [PR #186867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186867) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3eef95dfbb8bcdc5089f890775acbfff97e8858b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database copying during update preparation, including rollback snapshots, healthy format checks and read-only inventories. Checks protecting newer writes remain in place, and recovery requiring private state still uses a snapshot.
  Rollback snapshots and database discovery [#186510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186510). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · Healthy format checks and corruption errors [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · Read-only registration and plugin inventory [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Cuts unnecessary transcript archive work while the Gateway is stopped for an update that migrates your data. Native `openclaw update migrate` also shows progress as it checks your configuration and database schemas, makes a backup and verifies the migration. The candidate must contain this change; work already done by an older installed updater is unchanged.
  [#186797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186797) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/61bfde18d87b76db71070e3a715fd34b3b32f53e) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Defers selected advisory checks during externally supervised native updates so the Gateway can serve requests again before those checks finish. [Update status and history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) show pending checks and findings. If checks remain pending, retry them with `openclaw update finish`.
  [#186929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186929) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4d4080e11cc748ff18516d7142ac231543417c1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds PostgreSQL family checks and recovery safeguards to the OpenClaw updater. Once this version is installed, the updater checks target compatibility before stopping the Gateway or changing data, rehearses updates on private copies and can roll back supported failed updates while retaining update history. See the [update and recovery limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#updates-and-target-compatibility).
  [PR #173968](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173968). Thanks to steipete.
- Returns a pending or retryable status sooner when OpenClaw can’t record the status of a failed-update report. You may need to check again later. If GitHub already created the issue, OpenClaw still shows its link and keeps the report while confirmation is pending.
  [PR #175798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175798) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/27b6bf30c8c51aeb8d07a99e4440a872bd621278). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Improves [recovery cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#explicitly-retire-an-unmanifested-original) by showing progress, avoiding repeated reads of unchanged files and protecting a selected recovery file edited after preview, even if its size is unchanged. Refusal messages identify the failed check and whether owned changes were allowed; run a fresh preview before retrying. Selected rollback originals are removed. [Cleanup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).
  Changed recovery files [PR #187469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187469). Thanks to steipete. · Cleanup progress for originals and captures, with one final JSON result on stdout [PR #175054](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175054). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · Refusal diagnostics [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aea2145245226b1097c613ea872dc18fee5f8838). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Changes concurrent Crabbox installs so they may download the same release more than once.
  [#178344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178344). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Gateway connections and remote access

- Reduces pauses in other Gateway work during long transcript rewrites by letting that work run between portions of the rewrite.
  [#172848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172848). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Batches Gateway WebSocket writes during bursts of events, reducing socket writes and potentially server CPU use. Batched broadcasts also work on Bun without changing message order.
  [WebSocket batching #172882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172882) · [Bun broadcasts #175846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175846) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/964d3238270df34715cd3064ca1d3625facbc8db). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces delays when many paired devices reconnect, including devices with valid tokens and approved nodes waiting behind unrelated pairing updates. Last-seen and last-used times may lag briefly.
  [Paired-client reconnects #173277](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173277) · [Paired-device bookkeeping #173415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173415) · [Device tokens #173723](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173723) · [Approved nodes #174028](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174028) · [Gateway pairing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/pairing) · [Gateway logging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/logging.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens the wait for OpenClaw to accept connections after a restart by letting visitor access cleanup and Dreaming schedule updates finish in the background. Expired visitor grants are rejected while cleanup runs. Legacy grants awaiting confirmation can still be refused temporarily.
  [#173685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173685) · [Dreaming](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/dreaming) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces traffic on compatible remote Gateway WebSocket connections by compressing frames of 1 KiB or more, including long chat histories. The Gateway can reuse compressed responses across clients and compress eligible histories off its main thread. [Gateway transport](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/transport)
  [Remote compression #173933](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173933) · [Compression reuse #174966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174966) · [Gateway traffic #176456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176456) · [Direct-local scope](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2ed3341cee711892f3a18219035558ba925af2c9) · [Compression threshold](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/625f243f648528fb7cfb797643b1cd413b66ae86). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database contention during Gateway reconnects. Agent lists, managed media and worktree lookups do less waiting behind writes. Profile, project alias, email sign-in and missing-avatar lookups reuse results, and clients can share the initial profile load.
  [#174930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174930), [#174934](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174934), [#175043](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175043) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds **Fit width** and **Fit height** to the desktop Remote Desktop panel, filling one dimension while letting you scroll the other at the remote desktop’s resolution.
  [#176552](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176552) · [53806d99](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/53806d996150d33c592ac352fc6cc12c0f5ab53f) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes compression overhead from direct local Gateway connections and compresses frames of 1 KiB or more on supported remote connections. Plain TCP or SSH tunnels that look local to the Gateway also skip compression and may use more bandwidth. Per-event payload and pre-compression frame sizes are available in [Prometheus](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) and [OpenTelemetry](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/model-calls-and-metrics). See the [transport guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/transport).
  [Local connections #174848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174848) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2ed3341cee711892f3a18219035558ba925af2c9) · [Remote compression and metrics #176456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176456) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/625f243f648528fb7cfb797643b1cd413b66ae86) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway CPU and memory work when compressing broadcasts to multiple clients, including recipient-specific parts and connections with compatible compression settings.
  [Compression memory #175641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175641) · [1ea9cff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ea9cff5ca2e8296d653b337b50d977283cdeafe) · [Broadcast compression work in #174966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174966) · [Broadcast compression #182202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182202) · [`afdc8c25`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/afdc8c255b349ecf715ee42e035bfcde520542e3) · [Recipient-specific compression #183051](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183051) · [92893679](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9289367925e6d3bf0cf9c62c2de688644c138826) · [Shared compression #184946](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184946) · [5b62b1e2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b62b1e2a1b8acbedff6ec2382810231bf689397) · Thanks vincentkoc and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces temporary memory used to send session and presence updates to multiple clients, and cuts repeated work publishing agent session updates.
  [Session broadcasts #176583](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176583) · [841ac58e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/841ac58e111e13a108f4fc96a24dba5b82bb9f93) · [Shared updates #179244](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179244) · [Presence broadcasts #179423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179423) · [Session viewers #182362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182362) · [Shared headers #185183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185183) · [WebSocket updates #185545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185545) · [e990b80](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e990b80eb8cdca9ff92f37854b9564178cedcf51) · [Agent session updates #185553](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185553) · [a531e60](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a531e602a067e7c7ca385ad0a901a0369136ec78) · [Deleted-agent checks #185557](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185557) · [17e930d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/17e930d5da38d7697144da5bfdb118892d7a8439) · [Live update broadcasts #173883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173883) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces traffic for incremental Online roster updates and device presence on updated apps, while older clients continue to receive full rosters. The full device list remains available to macOS and iOS. The Gateway also does less work when part of a presence entry changes.
  [Online roster updates #177471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177471) · [Commit 5995b47](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5995b47698462a30af120eff3f51ac29b091a678) · [Opt-in presence updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/presence#opt-in-presence-deltas) · [Device presence #177520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177520) · [Commit 78e0bb4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/78e0bb48373590754ed370b33be231abec61fc28) · [Device presence](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/presence) · [Presence processing #183873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183873) · [8017af6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8017af6ab92dbbfce9b029186f404aae2bff4c1e) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces routine health traffic for the Control UI and updated Android, Linux and Apple operator clients, and sends less presence data when the Control UI reconnects. Full diagnostics remain available on request and the full roster remains in Online.
  [Gateway health](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/health.md) · [#178106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178106) · [f4484758](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4484758021a87a4f50a904c588939295be10b57) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops sending a [health event](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health) on every refresh when status is unchanged. Custom clients that relied on those updates should use `tick` for connection liveness and the `health` RPC for current readings. The web caretaker checks for existing problems when it connects and retries a failed initial check.
  [PR #175390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175390) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway traffic for background tool progress while keeping activity visible in the sidebar. Protocol clients that need full tool detail can subscribe with full interest or fetch saved output with `chat.message.get`. It also reduces memory used to deliver live agent events to multiple subscribers and overhead while streaming replies and tool updates. See the [Gateway protocol guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events).
  [Tool progress #179092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179092) · [`a158f59`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a158f5981580dab910c4737af634e080a7c4c160) · [Event delivery #179149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179149) · [`a6b339e`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a6b339e1c4d6bc238ed20620204f55311dcfdb0b) · [Streaming #179197](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179197) · [`5fdded4`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fdded4b3981e1a701e9fb398860a6e791d15a81) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces data sent for live tool activity and channel progress. Custom Gateway clients should follow the [event field changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events.md) for session metadata, command output and `dispatch_action` results, and read channel session details from `sessions.changed` and `session.message`.
  [Tool event fields #175850](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175850) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f38cf498961d10f5a1a44271ff182668cc28d0e8) · [Channel progress #175852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175852) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f0abcb4213ae590d7452176a6bcd0475c0ab4150) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets you connect during Gateway startup without waiting for [Team Reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/team-reports) or the Workboard Sessions board. Either feature still waits for its own data when opened.
  [#173872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173872) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens startup after another OpenClaw process releases the same profile, and avoids waiting to save records for native plugins already cleared to load. It also avoids rechecking other agents’ session usage when one agent using default storage finishes startup recovery.
  [Profile release and plugin records #174159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174159) · [Session usage #181834](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181834) · [52ed37dd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/52ed37dd19b11840d05607a3899595375edd2731) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the chance that slow storage stalls the Gateway during container setup, CLI-agent preparation, media handling or sandbox skill sync. Wide-area DNS zones and managed Chromium preferences are saved asynchronously.
  [#181928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181928) · [d347a4d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d347a4d7b9ec4b0a4b3e2036331eae034489a69f) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory churn during concurrent agent sessions and repeated work when the Control UI opens or reads settings, sessions build recaps, agents read databases and plugins handle requests. It also reduces temporary memory used to track Gateway, session and plugin operations during streamed replies.
  [Runtime allocations #174130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174130) · [Runtime bookkeeping #179222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179222) · [`e998107`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e9981073bdd2eaf4da7b4e981ef64b749cf1bb42) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes a source of Gateway stalls when recording agent turns blocked by policy or checking session events during agent deletion.
  [PR #174873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174873) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2ad33fdde4488fbf675d2f85cca8543bee6e7b2a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes sources of waiting when a browser reconnects to a busy Gateway. Browser push keys, session GitHub options, Workboard cards and GitHub previews no longer wait for unrelated requests, and saved push-key reads no longer wait for unrelated writes. Workboard clients that need to read their own changes should await the mutation response.
  [PR #174759](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174759) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8a4345e0e42d077cf3b4deb7741cf511a3f6873a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated identity lookups during dashboard loads, session handoffs and live connections through [Cloudflare Access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloudflare-access), and repeated profile work when the Control UI reconnects with an already verified GitHub account and email. Identity details can be reused for up to five minutes while the same assertion remains valid; permissions are checked on every request.
  [Identity lookups #179571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179571) · [a03aec7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a03aec75a86b96b76e4edb407ea3ba6841a7a48a) · [Reconnect profiles #186153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186153) · [Commit d3b86610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3b86610df08ae352e82c8e7f1c7f8648b673c00) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces connection work for paired operators, clients with no available plugin link readers, and clients behind trusted proxies. It also cuts CPU work and temporary allocations when the Gateway lists visible plugin link readers as the Control UI connects or reconnects.
  [Visible plugin link readers #185603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185603) · [commit e0ee235](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e0ee23526ced040e4d3cc8bab5203639c5f681a4) · [Plugin link readers #183908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183908) · [82926c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82926c383894e1954b588dbc6986d77dc8aa9186) · [Paired operators #184052](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184052) · [Trusted proxy attribution #183975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183975) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts the work of signing Reef device requests.
  [Reef device signing #183975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183975) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Moves cloud-worker bundle compression and integrity checks off the Gateway’s main thread, and avoids repeated scans when overlapping installs on one node check the same prewarmed build for the same Gateway. Later installs still verify independently.
  [Bundle preparation #175394](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175394) · [Cloud-worker bundle installation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation.md) · [Prewarmed validation #175399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175399) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces peak memory when preparing a cloud node runtime.
  [#184348](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184348) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps [Cloud Workers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers) profile controls disabled together while saving or deleting, and clears old feedback when the connection changes or administrator access is lost, so a late response cannot reopen the editor or show a success notice.
  [PR #180437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180437) · [Commit 3b766f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3b766f691d4671234b13ec66f7be8070718c9596) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Separates loading and errors for execution approvals and node bindings from the device list, and adds **Retry** when binding settings fail to load. Approval errors clear when you switch Gateways or approval targets. A binding form that remains available after a failed refresh or reconnect keeps its unsaved edits.
  [#180285](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180285) · [commit 2deffd0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2deffd0daf43c499d48967ece8909180e60ebad9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces storage writes for paired node statistics while keeping live readings current. Pairing and access changes are saved immediately. See [pairing and status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/pairing-and-status).
  [#184099](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184099) · [7b8221094b0b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b8221094b0bcd9b272317f6f9c02f45e44aa57b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces delays in [session catalogs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs) after a paired device is renamed or its access is revoked.
  [#184408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184408) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Status or location requests sent just after re-pairing a node can be dropped if a request from the old pairing is still finishing. Send the new request again if that happens.
  [PR #175877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175877) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies that [node container isolation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting#isolate-hosted-worker-sessions-in-containers) covers sessions placed on the node. If placement is refused, a session can run on the Gateway instead. Set a [required device worker profile](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-cloud-workers#required-worker-profile) to prevent that.
  [#175134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175134) · [#166351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166351) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@travismeyers](https://github.com/TravisMeyers).
- Clarifies that a Gateway can be reachable on a container network without a published host port. The [network exposure guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/security/network-exposure) covers loopback with Tailscale Serve or Funnel and authentication for non-loopback binds. The [EasyRunner example](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/easyrunner) sets `gateway.publicOrigin` to match the Caddy hostname when using the default browser-origin allowlist.
  [#178826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178826) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/698a6f83b46beae08b9e63dc06138c5fccfb66b1) · Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal) and [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Leaves a canceled deferred Gateway restart pending instead of retrying it on an unrelated configuration edit. Reapply the original configuration or restart the Gateway to finish applying it. If an older hot reload fails after a newer edit takes over, OpenClaw warns instead of automatically retrying recovery; reapply the configuration or restart if the newer reload does not recover it.
  [#175911](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175911) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Gateway operations

- Reduces repeated database reads on a connected but idle Gateway for delivery health, watched sessions and skill discovery.
  [#172964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172964) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts database work during Gateway startup and restart, configuration reloads and SQLite snapshot preparation.
  [Startup and snapshots #174592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174592) · [commit bb8e463](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb8e463bb1a258c6b84bfe2439475ad0f28a6bbc) · [Configuration reloads #182879](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182879) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Delays scheduled media cleanup, including delivery-queue media, until just over two minutes after Gateway startup.
  [#174930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174930) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway memory overhead by loading support for MCP servers and shared session pages only when needed. It also avoids loading legacy-settings diagnostics for valid configurations and reasoning support outside OpenAI-compatible completion streams.
  [#183017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183017) · [commit d3ae5134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3ae5134e207e62b8c100528cea5c5dcf16fe383) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Speeds up `openclaw config validate` when the running Gateway has a large SQLite state database, and avoids copying that database to check plugin settings.
  [#183082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183082) · [commit 7e57516e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e57516eac97ed30d9053b6d318fbf8013cb37a3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway CPU and memory overhead when it repeatedly checks whether plugin-provided commands are allowed on a node.
  [#183278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183278) · [commit 061a444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/061a4447783bd07057ba39c38e242dd709d69be0) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeat startup work when requests for sidebar data, conversation history or images arrive in bursts. Some memory stays in use longer between bursts.
  [#184323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184323) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the heap memory held by workers serving Control UI files after bursts of requests.
  [#185128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185128) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces startup CPU and memory overhead for small background workers, including workers that serve avatars.
  [#185125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185125) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts unnecessary Gateway startup work by leaving Buzz key handling and the Microsoft Teams setup wizard unloaded when they are not needed.
  [#185188](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185188) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes [configuration reloads on Bun](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/environment#filesystem-observation) to react to file changes by default instead of polling. Polling remains available.
  [#188324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188324) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Changes Gateway startup so a configuration reload while deferred plugins are starting can leave earlier plugin or transcript settings in use, and model preparation can use older plugin metadata. Reload again or restart the Gateway if that happens. Changing discovery mode during a plugin reload can also briefly bring back previous service advertisements.
  [#176041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176041) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces startup memory and CPU use for Gateways running without the Control UI.
  [#192552](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192552) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Reduces the amount of source code the Node runtime keeps in memory, and cuts unnecessary startup work for agents and Doctor on Bun.
  [Node memory #196386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196386) · [commit bf0fbfc8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf0fbfc85564c6416ddcaecfeb2812179608de61) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [Bun startup commit 68534810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/685348104cf10667221855ab6f9e806705460c33) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Accounts, credentials and approvals

- Moves client identities, pairing tokens and local socket credentials out of the shared Gateway database while keeping existing credentials. Update older native apps that still read them from that database. A client issued new credentials between an upgrade and automatic rollback needs to pair again. If you are moving a legacy native credential database to PostgreSQL, start the Gateway on SQLite and run `openclaw doctor --fix` before porting. See [credential migration and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning#local-client-credentials).
  [Client credential migration #174599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174599) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds Security Audit and Doctor warnings for sender-name keys in channel and account tool policies. Use stable `id:` keys for flagged entries.
  Thanks to [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit). [#173314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173314) · [Channel tool policies](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/config-tools/tool-policy.md)
- Adds session and agent names to command and Watcher approvals when available, so you can see which conversation sent the request. Command approval prompts also show the working directory and, for commands run on a node, the destination. Titles follow session renames and show the full text in a tooltip when cut off, and Request details takes less space for short content.
  [Approval context #186030](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186030) · [commit d720df3d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d720df3dff51a97ff1d327ae5e0d8a58cd8a174f) · [Request details #186009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186009) · [commit a189175a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a189175a709b8cc3fdc537f82b020b83d98baa3b). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Shows saved profile names alongside the Shared owner label in People, sessions and usage views.
  [#164593](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164593) · Thanks [@theangrypit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit), [@cassiemei](https://github.com/CassieMei) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Moves the native-permissions choice for eligible host-only runtimes such as Muse Code into Provider Access and AI Setup, and remembers it for that agent after successful setup. Continuing lets the runtime use its own permissions on the Gateway host, outside OpenClaw’s optional tool, sandbox and workspace-only restrictions. Mandatory boundaries and policies for OpenClaw-hosted tools apply.
  The choice also appears when connecting an eligible runtime without changing the active model. Manually configured routes can prompt in chat when consent is needed. [#172773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172773) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Reduces delays when existing email-authenticated users reconnect or administrators load the Gateway user list during profile updates, once the profile catalog is ready.
  [#173469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173469) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39ca16f1f9e504924ec4302f2827160e3c155e32) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports an MCP discovery network error during sign-in on Node and Bun without an automatic retry. If sign-in fails with that error, retry the login.
  [#175403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175403) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Places the requesting agent, command and decision buttons together on Control UI approval cards, with more context available on demand. On mobile, a compact card sits beside the composer and expands to show the full request. Remote requests show the computer name when available, and other pending requests get their own list. Cards show when a decision is being submitted and the duration of a time-limited **Always allow** choice.
  [Control UI cards #183350](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183350) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5bf26f681e92fa340d8f4a75133ba7d3e48c2cb2) · [Mobile card #176367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176367) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/58dcfc01287d12997106ceff40cd5cca286717e7) · [Mobile composer #176498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176498) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Reduces repeated work when OpenClaw reads or updates its local device identity and access tokens, without changing the keys or tokens already stored.
  [#177962](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177962) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a focused Doctor command to prepare client credentials without running health checks or changing services. Run `openclaw doctor --client-credentials --repair --non-interactive` for the selected state directory. See the [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running).
  [#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Reduces work and temporary memory used for Gateway permission checks, including repeated checks during active operator runs and tool runs with access-policy plugins. Access revocations still take effect.
  [Permission checks #179165](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179165) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/55fca0edc2ee36d85dda86c49cb45e86bcbae61f) · [Tool runs and local profiles #181782](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181782) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d90c4d0e729914d0160ad1e2f2a1d7d9327ab096) · [Active runs #185074](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185074) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows your Git coauthor choice in Profile as soon as you flip the switch. If the save fails, the switch returns to its previous setting and Profile shows an error.
  [PR #180388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180388) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1f7fd40f0d91ccd398963ac93da7577d71aea170) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the model account you selected as the default for new chats while your choice is still saving. Unlinking an account is reflected right away, too. If either change fails to save, Profile restores the previous selection or link and shows the error.
  [PR #180519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180519) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4d63d65921a964db933fef25a927136146b7ed6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies when a browser opening a Docker-hosted Control UI on localhost can pair automatically. Set `gateway.nodes.pairing.autoApproveLocal: false` to require manual approval for local pairing and access upgrades. See the [Control UI pairing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/connect-and-pair#device-pairing-first-connection).
  [#182041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182041) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a64cfa307a103e210dac28912d7ce11aee81c69) · Thanks shallabby, card4philippe and obviyus.
- Tailors starter prompts in empty chat and **New Session** to Visitor Access guests with no recent chats. Suggestions include exploring OpenClaw and investigating an issue in a sandbox.
  [#182167](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182167) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6209443e228991bbb54fe3d70ebebe5391c5689c) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Adds personal notes and ready-to-copy sign-in instructions to visitor invitations and renewals. Renewals keep the existing note unless you supply a new one. The message includes the configured sign-in address when available and otherwise tells the guest to ask the inviter for it. See the [Visitor Access guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/team-server).
  Integrations reading the invitation result should allow `signInUrl` to be absent. [Invitation messages #182218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182218) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman). [Faster invitation lookup #186159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186159) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fcb687646ac7595b214f27abdf6bf4af783d9016) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces browser work when you edit or remove execution-approval rules, especially in policies with many rules.
  [#182226](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182226) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work to redeem pairing codes and issue a fresh Gateway token to a paired device. An unreadable record for another device no longer blocks token issuance.
  [Pairing codes #183069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183069) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b916ac7aa82da11d63c62a6b9c1685deadcac2c1) · [Device tokens and rejected pairing updates #185876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185876) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Documents how to generate a Gateway token with npm’s `openclaw.cmd` launcher when Windows PowerShell blocks `openclaw.ps1`, without changing your execution policy. Clients using the old token disconnect after rotation and restart. See the [Windows launcher instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/windows#powershell-execution-policy).
  [#183737](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183737) · Thanks [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) · [Co-authored commit by Ayaan Zaidi](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c0f75ece787e7be7248ea712b9c1df3aacfa814).
- Reduces work to load command-approval policies, match allowlist patterns, prepare large rule lists and return approved command results. If your plugin edits approvals read with `loadExecApprovalsReadOnlyAsync`, copy the returned file before editing it or use `readExecApprovalsSnapshotAsync` for an editable copy. See the [SDK migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration#exec-approval-reads).
  [Approval reads #184092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184092) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9a5304a0c1dfeaf9a9ced403696537a40337e28) · [Allowlist matching #184129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184129) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/add09197f485fb3c0c103d9c0e3fb4c9ea0c7d2e) · [Rule lists #184163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184163) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c87c843424d126da10ff70a31afd1605d817f63) · [Checks and results #184217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184217) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0b806f9568219afee6328fdd8b0ff553c67e797d) · [Policy loads and edits #186166](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186166) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab3fab2c37cfcd2ad05a7d1f825f83dd8231cbb6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work needed to load saved operator approvals and the wait for pending approvals to reappear when clients reconnect to a Gateway with a large backlog.
  [Saved approvals #184390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184390) · [Reconnects #184453](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184453) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes the default execution permission easier to spot and shows when Full Access is active or requires an administrator to select. The picker shows which choice is saving and lets you close it during the save. Number shortcuts work with the new layout, and approval shortcut hints are easier to read.
  [#184777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184777) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/697e69eff4a8909da1cd5de34ddab6c59949d757) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Adds the existing SubQ API key setting to the [SecretRef credential reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/secretref-user-supplied-credentials-matrix.json).
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8ff48313fcb39d8c377ae3b1f5c944879acf833) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an Approval scopes column to `openclaw nodes pending` and the pending section of `openclaw nodes list`, so you can see which permissions you need before approving a node. See the [node pairing commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/nodes).
  [#178455](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178455) · Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Configuration and settings

- Adds run status to the OpenClaw TUI in terminals that support OSC 7501, showing when a run is working, finishes, fails or returns to idle. Cancelling a run returns the status to idle, and exiting the TUI clears it.
  [Terminal run status #175692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175692) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d61650b022fba9a0563ff5f32ac820449d63104) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).

##### Monitoring and reports

- Adds a specific diagnostic reason when the compaction model cannot be resolved, making it easier to identify in logs and alerts.
  Use `reason=compaction_model_unresolved` to identify these failures in alerts. [#138033](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138033) · Thanks to [@louisfy](https://github.com/louisfy) for the fix and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the request.
- Adds an optional fingerprint of delivered skill instructions to skill-use traces, helping operators compare instruction text across runs. The fingerprint can be correlated with known content even when content capture is off.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167529">PR #167529</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b87a4857251803c47efb3be49acdec9f0fc519a7">`b87a485`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/ryan-dyer-sp">@ryan-dyer-sp</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Removes caller locations from subsystem INFO records sent to [diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/privacy-and-trace-context), reducing logging overhead. WARN locations remain available when diagnostics are active.
  [#172839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172839). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Moves generic secret-egress refusal and credential-substitution request logs from info to debug. Structured outcome events and certificate-failure warnings remain.
  [#185614](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185614) · [c422fb2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c422fb2d049e6fc07e67324a1298b4cd6140d2a6) · [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Added a bounded `reason` label to `openclaw_gc_duration_seconds` and rate-limited warnings for frequent major collections in Node Code Mode workers, with current run context when available. Aggregate across `reason` in existing queries that need totals across all collections.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172945) · [Gateway diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/diagnostics.md)
- Moved successful secret substitutions, repeated service-tier mismatches, unattributed cache drops and slow GitHub timings to debug. Actual tool-result truncations log at info.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172996) · [Gateway logging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/logging.md)
- Adds Gateway connection metrics and slow-response timing details to help operators investigate slow connections. First-response timing measures through the server’s write callback.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173079">#173079</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging">Gateway logging</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Reduces memory churn during Prometheus diagnostics scrapes and can shorten scrapes with many metric series.
  The exporter can retain more heap between scrapes. When series are dropped, the overflow counter appears after the other counters. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173278)
- Reduces diagnostic work by discarding events that have no interested subscriber or exporter. The discarded events are unavailable for replay and can leave gaps in the sequence.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173398">#173398</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a Gateway startup log entry for top-level plugin services that take at least 250 ms, with the plugin and service identifiers, duration, and outcome. [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging)
  [#173550](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173550) · [3d05374](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d053745a640ca082db4557c18fca39fe30720a1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lowers the threshold for naming tracked blocking tasks in Gateway stall warnings from one second to 250 milliseconds. The warnings also name the request method even when diagnostics are off. With diagnostics and the Prometheus plugin enabled, operators can track attributed stall counts, durations and dropped records.
  [#173937](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173937) · [Prometheus diagnostics guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) · Thanks steipete.
- Cuts repeated work when several consumers listen for the same Gateway diagnostic event. They can share a read-only copy of a plain public event, while values that can still be changed stay isolated.
  [#173891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173891) · [Diagnostic listener SDK guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/config-and-utilities) · Thanks steipete.
- Adds [Prometheus](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) counters for session-list and cron-list requests, so operators can see where session-list traffic comes from and monitor automation-list requests. Cron labels omit job, session, agent and query values.
  [Session-list requests #172853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172853) · [Cron-list requests #172898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172898) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds Prometheus memory metrics by worker script and reusable Code Mode slot, and keeps completed-task counts, sampled peak heap use and garbage collection metrics visible after short-lived workers exit. Completed-task, peak heap and garbage collection metrics require diagnostics to be enabled; native garbage collection figures are unavailable on Bun.
  [Worker memory #173379](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173379) · [Completed worker metrics #179872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179872) · [Prometheus metrics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus). Script gauges are `openclaw_worker_external_bytes` and `openclaw_worker_array_buffers_bytes`; use `openclaw_code_mode_worker_memory_bytes` by slot and kind for Code Mode. External memory includes ArrayBuffer bytes, and ArrayBuffer coverage can be partial for native-only workers. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Logbook storage work when grouping frames and updating observations or timeline cards, and removes an unused request on each Control UI refresh. Failed writes no longer leave partial updates.
  [Logbook storage #173724](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173724) · [Refresh #177912](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177912) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds reported Codex response token usage to OpenTelemetry traces when the diagnostics plugin, tracing and native OTLP export are enabled. It also adds purpose and runtime labels to usage and cost for isolated model calls, and separates result time from cleanup time. Missing token counts stay unknown.
  [Codex response usage #173946](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173946) · [Isolated model calls #174006](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174006) · [OpenTelemetry model calls](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/model-calls-and-metrics) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Removes whole-update previews from Telegram verbose logs and private Nostr metrics while keeping Nostr relay errors and warnings. Codex timeout warnings show where the timeout occurred, the elapsed time and the limit.
  [#173955](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173955) · Thanks steipete.
- Cuts repeat writes for trajectory diagnostics by saving a typical turn together. If OpenClaw crashes before the next save, more diagnostic events can be lost. [Trajectory diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/trajectory)
  [#174619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174619) · [`f42f37a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f42f37a5f50bd66ef138b6188a93c580ca5875bb). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated session lookups when you send Codex diagnostics. If the session is replaced or removed before the upload starts, request diagnostics again.
  [#174985](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174985) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes two success-only debug summaries from node hosts, one for workspace download timings and one for manifest capture counts. Transfer errors and progress are still reported.
  [#175024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175024) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Gateway startup notices from printing the values of `OPENCLAW_RAW_STREAM` and `OPENCLAW_RAW_STREAM_PATH`. Trims routine messages from Gateway startup and restarts, successful language-server startup, native web search and provider selection, follow-up delivery, and skipped video-generation candidates. The first skipped-candidate warning and follow-up delivery failures are still reported.
  The session recovery guide clarifies that OpenClaw quietly cancels waiting input for archived sessions and retains its receipt. Reset or replacement still produces a blocked-delivery notice. [Session recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/session-tool.md) · [Logging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/logging.md) · [#175456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175456) · [#175546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175546). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds plugin reload details to `openclaw status` and `openclaw status --json`, including which plugins are reloading and why new agent runs may be waiting. [Status command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status)
  [#175686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175686) · [55ce16b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/55ce16b61cd5822f98be360d8297aca7de4353f3). Thanks yxshee, steipete, xtimor.
- Separates composer prediction usage and timing from other background completions in diagnostics, so you can see which activity comes from predictions.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176271">#176271</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c8e786ca8aeef7f19988acd89fffb57d4c752558">Commit c8e786c</a>
- Adds Prometheus gauges for anonymous resident memory and swap on Linux where the OS reports those counters. [Prometheus guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176411), [73c8498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/73c8498ea5ae5f38b710b8e178df2c993b11d036).
- Skips collecting optional prompt statistics when no diagnostics listener needs them at the start of the request.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176589">#176589</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/76c9dc1605bc59e4c2c13fccf15c7dd8e2d8106f">76c9dc16</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces how long audit cleanup can hold up incoming messages and interactive updates when execution audit logs reach their retention limits.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176797) · [commit 4061902](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/406190213d9dda6dd08f38015ce2f6f1829fe8bc) · [Gateway audit guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/audit)
- Adds separate Gateway log timings for preparing the status snapshot and listing the methods and events available to the client, so operators can see how much time each takes during a reconnect.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176809) · [commit c928f1a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c928f1a3a05daa017eb939fc33a1a7d49af4ea70) · [Gateway logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging)
- Adds detail to slow checkout-diff logs, so you can tell which changes were requested and whether the request was for a summary or a full patch.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176974">#176974</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging#slow-git-content-reads">Slow Git content reads</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds a client-type breakdown to Gateway request counts in Prometheus, so you can compare traffic attributed to the Control UI, mobile apps and other clients. [Gateway Prometheus metrics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus)
  Query `openclaw_gateway_rpc_client_requests_total` by method and client kind. Client kinds are self-reported. [#177137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177137). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts storage round trips when several audit records are already waiting to be written. Retries writes it couldn’t confirm without duplicating records already saved. If a batch still can’t be confirmed after three attempts, unsaved records in that batch can be dropped so later records can get through. Skips repeat attempts when there’s no state database. [Gateway audit guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/audit)
  [#177281](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177281). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a direct, read-only way to ask the system agent for the existing system overview, including configuration health, agent and model details, and whether the Gateway is reachable. The overview can come from a cached snapshot.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/SunnyShu0925">@SunnyShu0925</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177314">#177314</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fd12f93cf4fd2cec0ce03be8f183a9dd1b41809e">Commit fd12f93</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177273">Issue #177273</a>
- Removes a redundant warning from auth-profile failure logs while keeping the messages about actual failures and model fallbacks. Log searches and alerts that use `auth_profile_failure_state_updated` will no longer match that event.
  [#177982](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177982) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work for agent-run auditing by saving the start and finish together when a run completes. While a run is still going, its tool activity may appear before its start, or Run Inspector may not find the run yet. If OpenClaw crashes before the run finishes, its start can be missing from the audit log.
  [#178220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178220) · [commit d5ada14](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5ada1406b917579c7591cda139923d0a78b893b) · [Gateway audit log](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/audit). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds stage-by-stage Prometheus timings for server-side Control UI page preparation when diagnostics are configured. Some stages overlap. OpenTelemetry traces keep the original stage timestamps even when diagnostics are reported later. [Control UI document metrics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/prometheus.md#control-ui-documents)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179449">#179449</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Reduces how long preparing large heap profiles can hold up other Gateway work. Heap profiles also show how long you requested, how long OpenClaw allowed, how long sampling actually ran, and why a limit applied. [Gateway diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179925">#179925</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b2468dc3be4971485b57b2fcb02e95f1b28afa9">commit 6b2468dc</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the requested Logbook capture state as soon as you select **Pause** or **Resume**, and restores the previous state if the request fails. Clears the old progress display when you change days or leave Logbook without cancelling the request.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180380">PR #180380</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f4f45d31f424ccde736c8e185e9bc3add80901a">Commit 2f4f45d</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>

- Adds Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics for presence-update counts and encoded bytes by delivery mode, and counters for why incremental session updates reset.

- Reduces memory held by prompt-cache diagnostics on Gateways with many long, idle sessions and reduces repeated diagnostic work during tool-heavy runs. Reports about what changed remain available.

- Adds a Doctor view of diagnostics supported by its Node or Bun process. Operators can query the running Gateway separately with `operator.read`, and support exports include separate redacted reports, retaining the local report if the Gateway is unreachable.
  [Runtime capabilities](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics#runtime-capabilities) · [#182379](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182379) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the work of sending private model and tool diagnostics to multiple trusted listeners.
  [#182233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182233) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes the undocumented `openclaw.session.create` and `openclaw.projects.list` diagnostic events. Slow operations still appear in warning logs.
  [#182322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182322) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Skips counting prompt and tool-definition characters for embedded and simple model requests when no diagnostic listener uses those counts. Tracing can still request them and request byte metrics remain available.
  [#182672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182672) · [OpenTelemetry spans and events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/spans-and-events) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a reason to the Codex debug log when a context refresh cannot keep a conversation going alongside earlier background work.
  [#182755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182755) · [29ed214](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29ed214d9e2b21895a3b3000a6344046cc59acc6) · [Codex harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness) · Thanks [@jjjhenriksen](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen).
- Uses fewer queries to delete selected debug captures and reports exact deletion totals.
  [#183069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183069) · [b916ac7a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b916ac7aa82da11d63c62a6b9c1685deadcac2c1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces database work when generating weekly and monthly Team Reports.
  [#183256](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183256) · [4d13dec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d13deccf923c9e5470a787a885e6736c62f9b7f) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the provider-reported model to completed and failed OpenTelemetry request spans when available, alongside the requested model, so you can distinguish the two on routed requests.
  [OpenTelemetry request spans](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/spans-and-events) · [#183310](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183310) · [f3c34dc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3c34dcad0920f2c68610dd2523dbaa06d8a7079) · [Original work #180768](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180768) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ryan-dyer-sp](https://github.com/ryan-dyer-sp).
- Reduces CPU work when generating system prompt reports with many tools and inspecting large sets of plugins.
  [#184035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184035) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces background work when measuring memory used by an unchanged remote model catalog, its pricing data or published plugin metadata.
  [Gateway diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics) · [#184220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184220) · [ba20ab9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba20ab900373362ccac99454d38293c25db054ee) · [#184255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184255) · [a0fd32b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a0fd32b224469f92a31a6f1c83ae4f8d7e3e294a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces CPU work when monitoring memory for host commands on Linux.

- Replaces duplicate OpenAI Responses warnings with one warning per ordinary failed attempt, including error and request identifiers when available. Same-model retry notices move to debug and exhausted retries are logged as errors. Preparing structured provider-error diagnostics also uses less CPU and temporary memory.
  [#185614](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185614) · [c422fb2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c422fb2d049e6fc07e67324a1298b4cd6140d2a6) · [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging) · [#185609](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185609) · [b6d3f7c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b6d3f7ce6553efa235b0a6d572b189805456bde3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

If your dashboard used the old total or empty class value, sum across classes to get the total. The [Prometheus guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/prometheus.md) includes a query.

- Adds [Prometheus readings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) for Node worker heap usage by script and V8 heap space, and for heap memory remaining after a major garbage collection and when it was observed. The latter helps distinguish memory still in use from garbage waiting to be collected.

Both exporters also show the number of open authenticated operator connections.

  [Repeated tool definitions #173815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173815) · [Model replay data #186798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186798) · [Replay commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c456829cf2e946e9269dea48a032b0f8af2aa8d8) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the data OpenClaw reads to list matching executions when an audit run has more than one match, without changing the list or the details you can open.
  [Audit candidates #173877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173877) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts unnecessary memory allocations when capturing diagnostics with lots of list data, without changing what gets recorded or redacted.

- Cuts the reads Gateway health needs to report failed and backed-up incoming messages.
  [Incoming message health #175183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175183) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa0f5a85299c69232ef04ee1060c3b7c6207adb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Advances the next idle event-loop sample when an exporter first subscribes, instead of leaving it until the idle sampling deadline.
  [Event-loop sampling #171658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171658) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Quiets routine channel and meeting-bot logs while retaining Discord slash-command deployment warnings and reporting Teams reply failures. Feishu card-action logs no longer include command text, Telegram network failures omit raw HTTP error text, and realtime wake-name logs omit the spoken name. Successful Feishu document-comment reply lookups no longer log request IDs, reply lengths or where the reply was found; retries and failures are still logged.
  [Channel and meeting-bot logs #174260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174260) · [Discord and wake-name logs #174279](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174279) · [Slack, Telegram and WhatsApp logs #174402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174402) · [Feishu comment-reply lookup #177891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177891) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcd28a06c67ea3a047e62a840d7215990ff31dbf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts routine success messages from macOS, Android voice and the iOS Share extension, and removes a repeated macOS screen-recording error. Android and macOS Talk warnings omit unrecognized directive names, and macOS warnings omit unrecognized voice aliases. The Android debug voice probe reports pass or fail and the result filename without logging the result JSON or exception.
  [Native diagnostics #174330](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174330) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04bb3e333d7370f523c3ef8700fcdde356368cdd) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes duplicate debug messages for routine Gateway activity while keeping failure and recovery logs. Expected cancellation of a session usage refresh during shutdown is also quiet, while refresh failures still produce warnings.
  [Gateway diagnostics #174332](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174332) · [Gateway commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e6920f5d22c4645adf6c505802fc195cc96eef7) · [Shutdown refresh #174431](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174431) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes optional package-verification timing logs, SQLite snapshot timing and size logs, and the worker workspace sync debug summary.
  [Package and snapshot logs #174431](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174431) · [Workspace summary #174846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174846) · [Workspace commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/484528c6ae3108b45dbd533e2397d5927cd2a2b3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes provider error excerpts from agent failure and model fallback logs while keeping error categories and references for troubleshooting. Image-loading warnings omit file paths and detailed errors, and routine sign-in, tool and run details are trimmed. Local provider service standard output is no longer retained; recent error output remains available for startup troubleshooting.
