- Removes routine debug messages for ACP session identity updates, hook readiness, skill filtering and Skill Workshop reviews. Web fetch also stops logging its automatic provider choice and the note about an invalid configured provider.
  [Troubleshooting logs #175106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175106) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6d578912da668b3011720ac91997669b6383db5a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies how to pass `--password` to [`openclaw logs`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/logs) when supplying the URL of a password-protected Gateway.
  [Gateway logs documentation #176061](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176061) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4e3188dba9f7c1a865cca7205983db94e95d6c6) · Thanks [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Skips a second Git commit lookup when OpenClaw cannot determine its commit on the first lookup or from build metadata. The commit may remain unknown until restart.
  [Commit lookup #175944](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175944) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/172fe5791520c37aa1ff1f9a1f1bc3aa933eb3f3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Update and installation reports

- Adds reports of update outcomes, such as success, failure or rollback, that may be sent by default when the update service supports them. These reports use categories and release versions without user or installation identifiers. They are separate from feature statistics, and turning off automatic update checks also turns off the reports. See the [telemetry guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/telemetry.md).
  [Update outcome reports #154067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154067) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds an installation-count report that may be sent by default during update checks when the service supports it, separately from feature statistics. The report contains no installation ID or feature inventory. To stop it, turn off telemetry, decline it or set `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`. The telemetry CLI shows whether your installation is eligible to report. See the [telemetry guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/telemetry).
  [Installation-count reporting #186569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186569) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Developer tools and APIs

- Adds support for piping a prompt to an agent with `--message-file -`. Use `./-` or an absolute path for a file literally named `-`.
  [Piped prompts #167122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167122) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/caf3034ae08157264c43e8e085a68f892ac5b5cd) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a repository helper for SDK contributors to find static references to an API in eligible public ClawHub plugins and see where analysis is missing.
  Results cover the latest eligible published artifacts and are paginated. Check bundled callers separately. See the [plugin SDK impact guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/plugin-sdk-impact/SKILL.md).

  [#172722](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172722) · [ClawHub #3957](https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3957) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Adds a QA coverage report showing which scenarios were mapped, attempted and backed by qualified evidence. Run `openclaw qa coverage --evidence <file>` against saved evidence, including in a source checkout. See [QA reporting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/qa-e2e-automation/qa-reporting.md).
  [Coverage report #169697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169697) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b1e6a6ba67203271b0b16541cedb481912e704d7) · [Source-checkout flag fix #186747](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186747) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/89dd4bdf57e7fbed417762f786a75b4110eb3845) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the report, and [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix.
- Defaults local source-checkout tests and the development CLI to the pinned Bun fork, with a Node fallback when it is unavailable. Set `OPENCLAW_VITEST_RUNTIME=node` to use Node for tests. See the [local test guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/test/local).
  [Local runtime #172625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172625) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c6ed448c1fb88e0f1b85a1b39cb9c51d8f61bda) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a best-effort `socket.drain` event so authorized Gateway subscribers can discard stale session state after a reset, replacement or deletion. Refresh session state after reconnecting; iOS and Android clients do not yet consume this event.
  [Session drain event #172950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172950) · [Original proposal #69822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/69822) · Thanks [@gdibble](https://github.com/gdibble) for the proposal and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds repeatable `--config-override` JSON options to `openclaw agent exec` for changing settings on one run without changing saved configuration. Use the option separately from `--auth-env-only`. See the [agent CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/agent).
  [Run overrides #173636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173636) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Adds an optional timestamped assistant reply to `sessions.list` when a client requests `includeLastMessage`, even if the last message is from the user. The preview is available when the recent transcript contains a visible assistant reply. See [sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session).
  [Assistant preview #174984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174984) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Speeds up formatting writes and switches local `pnpm format`, `pnpm format:check` and `pnpm lint` to the pinned Bun tools, with fallbacks to oxfmt or oxlint when unavailable. You can select those alternatives explicitly; oxlint remains the CI gate. See the [local test guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/test/local).
  [Formatting writes #176368](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176368) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/806ea5812ccbe393b4dd0c3a6c1ce0010a5d755a) · [Formatter default #176678](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176678) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a842951a15cd79e22cdd0b4e1059021ee1c99c51) · [Lint default #183123](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183123) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a3f44fb8a9f6e78bf0baa5fd946e4e440ff4c81b) · [Local testing guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/test/local.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds `data-link-reader-preview="off"` for Control UI links that should skip the hover preview. Clicking the link still opens it as usual.

- Corrects the Control UI [contributor guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/CONTRIBUTING.md) to point to current Solid 2 examples and checks.

- Cuts repeated work in source builds, including cached Control UI builds and plugin browser assets already built by an earlier step in a full build.

- Adds a Control UI [development benchmark](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/scripts/README.md#control-ui-development-benchmark) that can repeat runs on a chosen checkout and measure server startup without loading the app. One-off UI builds also skip a redundant Settings build when those assets are already prepared.
  [Benchmark and macOS polling hot reload #179260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179260) · [Settings build #179426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179426) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds cleanup for older abandoned review clones, with a dry run to preview candidates. Active checkouts, local changes and unverifiable clones are left alone. See [PR tooling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/scripts/pr-tooling).
  [Clone cleanup #181022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181022) · [Seed tracking #181041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181041) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an optional matching JIT companion and source debugger for packagers building the experimental standalone executable with `--compile-aot`. You can set source breakpoints against the same code, plugins and resources. See the [matched JIT support build](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone#matched-jit-support-build).
  [JIT companion #182309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182309) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces repeated work and temporary allocations when reading ACP session details, including turns with attachments. Published revisions made from plain configuration data retain their captured values until the configuration is published again.

- Removes the need to allow runtime JavaScript code generation for built-in validation in the Gateway, Codex harness, TypeSafe and other fixed checks. See the [Codex harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness).
  [Fixed validation #182575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182575) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts database work when ACP replay history exceeds its storage limit while keeping the same events.
  [Replay retention #183158](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183158) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db440e9d6220b5da5b9ffcede13556de9d502ea1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds Gateway protocol support for a mention-failure event that follows the session’s read permissions.

- Adds a paused indicator to Gateway session listings and change events so clients can distinguish a subagent waiting to continue from one that has finished. Dashboard-mode rows omit this field. See the [Gateway protocol](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events.md).
  [Paused subagents #185918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185918) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Removes the need to install TSX just to generate the iOS Swift source file list.
  [Swift source list #186351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186351) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4f43698ff8f77d1a3687f3293b9f35d2b9d0272d) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds an optional session ID to the Gateway’s [Stop request](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control), letting clients prevent a delayed Stop from cancelling work after the conversation has been replaced.
  [Session-scoped Stop #186564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186564) · Thanks galiniliev.
- Reduces metadata returned by `chat.startup`, including a second copy of model and account details. If your client reads those details from `chat.startup`, use `models.list` for the picker catalog and account selection or `chat.metadata` for chat metadata. Command metadata, Swarm availability and the required worker inference profile remain available.
  [Chat startup #175317](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175317) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/efedca497b4f87d47c34e795d20551f6ae31d8e8) · [Startup projection](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c96ef749f451f534f341a53d5da96d477fb4140) · [WebChat guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/webchat.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #175317.
- Makes Gateway cron updates smaller by sending job identity and status without the full job definition or run details. Clients that read definitions, summaries, diagnostics or delivery traces from events should fetch them with `cron.get`, `cron.list` or `cron.runs`; plugin hooks still receive the full job.

- Lists manifest-declared plugin commands in `openclaw --help` without loading the plugin runtime.
  [CLI help changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7f83062292962b0ee7487208813dec19af7e43f).
- Adds the prepared system prompt report to completed worker turn result metadata.
  [Prompt report #174547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174547) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bd22b28d632ba4082e923d88a2485be61f8c8af) · Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Returns `UNAVAILABLE` if pending approvals change while a client opens a session message subscription with approvals enabled. The client can retry the subscription. See the [session control protocol](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control).
  [Approval subscriptions #176542](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176542) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fd93662b9552512c768e562eab660ce54c01cbbe) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an experimental way for PostgreSQL store developers to [register text and vector search indexes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#search-on-postgresql) that remain available when the store reopens. Keep the existing definition, including its vector dimension, unless the component that owns the index can rebuild it.
  [PostgreSQL search indexes #174085](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174085) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a5d66c59b39786837e35dd8d3b3b9f79b91969ef) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Cloud workers

- Adds background worker downloads on supported persistent paired nodes after a Gateway update or reconnect. If the download finishes before you open a session, the first session can reuse it. A session that arrives sooner takes priority and installs as usual. See [session hosting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting).
  [Worker downloads #182115](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182115) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d0430c7a50fe849787e63c5c19540505c427853) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shortens the wait for **Stop cloud worker** when the provider confirms it has accepted cleanup. With Crabbox, the environment stays marked as destroying until the machine is released, and charges can continue in the meantime. Worker-provider plugins can opt in to the earlier return and remain responsible for confirming teardown. See [cloud workers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers).
  [Worker cleanup #182138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182138) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a23ba6f5aaaae70c2d98a712c4941695beb0fe63) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Cuts repeated work when applying a source overlay to a worker workspace, and reduces temporary memory use when comparing workspace changes for sync.
  [Workspace sync #185525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185525) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Raises the minimum Crabbox version from 0.77.0 to 0.79.2 for workers, sandboxes and proof commands. OpenClaw downloads a compatible copy when the selected CLI is missing or too old. If your host cannot reach the managed download, supply Crabbox 0.79.2 or later. Legacy direct Azure checkpoints without a recorded snapshot identity require manual reconciliation. See [Crabbox troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting).
  Static SSH uses the explicitly configured port. Coordinator connections use Crabbox’s native TLS and proxy configuration. [Crabbox compatibility #182123](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182123) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7da14efb533b439bf81210e197a1f47c2698cff4) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Crabbox

- Reduces database work when Crabbox maintains or allocates warm images after a successful legacy-data check.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183223">#183223</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fffa5e98e4b95236a94200dc1616285751eca44d">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.

##### Reef

- Reduces repeated database checks when Reef has nothing to reconcile in its SQLite delivery state, and cuts background work checking for peer changes when it has retained delivery history.
  [Empty delivery checks #183223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183223) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fffa5e98e4b95236a94200dc1616285751eca44d) · [Peer change checks #187039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187039) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
