- Adds a [read-only GitHub readiness check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model#inspect-publication-readiness) for authorized agents and clients to inspect a session’s source, supported target and an existing shared publication request. If a receipt is unavailable, keep the original request ID and check it rather than submitting again. The check does not verify permission to publish or whether a PR is ready to merge.
  [PR #187152](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187152). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Changes new managed pull requests, including those from eligible guests, to open ready for review by default instead of as drafts. If you’re not ready for review, ask your agent to publish a draft. OpenClaw keeps that choice if publishing is delayed or resumes after a restart. Updating an existing pull request leaves its review state alone, and requests already accepted under the old default still create drafts if they need to create a PR. Operators rolling upgraded shared state back to a build that cannot read it must restore a verified pre-upgrade backup and use its matching older build.
  [PR #176105](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176105) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cafa09e50556e08c2a04a670f16ac815482c5489) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Lets the person who started a conversation use [`prepare_pr`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) to update its bot-published pull request after someone else pushes to it. Resolve any conflicts and publish again without losing saved work.
  [PR #187465](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187465) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Omits instructions to add the OpenClaw footer to new pull requests when PR attribution is off or the conversation is Incognito. When attribution is on, those instructions apply only to the verified requester’s current request, not to later requests or other people in the conversation.
  [PR #187805](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187805) · Thanks [@lastguru-net](https://github.com/lastguru-net) and [@beru-ant-king](https://github.com/beru-ant-king).
- Skips automatic GitHub publication checks at Gateway startup for sessions with no repository workspace or managed worktree. Checks still run on demand, and removing a session’s last publication target clears its old result.
  [PR #174453](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174453) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Cuts duplicate Git checks for GitHub publishing options when Control UI sessions using worktrees of the same repository reconnect together.
  [PR #174864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174864) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9631b142b4df656a7926f9fdce67055e3837b0ae) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clarifies in the [PR review guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/pull-request-review-flow) that ClawSweeper reviews a PR automatically only once when automatic review is enabled. Later pushes, description edits and reopens do not start another review. If you need another hosted review, update the branch, PR description and evidence, then comment `@clawsweeper re-review`.
  [PR #174533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174533) · [Commit ac9569a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ac9569a4e72134ff80c574b2511bf255a2a6379f) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### GitHub lookups

- Shows the title and description first when you open a pull request, issue or commit in the Control UI GitHub reader. Checks and discussion load separately where available, and file diffs load when you select **Files** or scroll near it. Refresh keeps your place while the new details load. [GitHub reader](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github)
  [Reader loading #174644](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174644) · [commit b5ef99d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b5ef99d7053d1014f18b443c9069af4aa4ec72cf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Loads conversation comments and inline review comments together when you open a full pull request discussion in the GitHub reader or use `github_read`. [GitHub plugin guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github)
  [Pull request discussions #181887](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181887) · [commit 34c95cb9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/34c95cb9e0017b061942cb6df4b3801f7cc53e9e). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps a direct GitHub link in the redesigned link-reader toolbar, with a shorter label in narrow panels. Adds a link from the incomplete-checks notice to the full results when a results link is available.
  [Reader navigation #182131](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182131) · [commit 925ec05f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/925ec05f68df81bc7c6820fd8cd220ba6b0804b5). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds repository names to [GitHub issue and pull request references](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github) in chat and PR views.
  [Repository names #172836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172836). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows cached GitHub hover previews without waiting for a refresh and marks the details when they’re out of date. Reopen the preview to pick up refreshed details when they’re available. [GitHub plugin guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github)
  [Cached hover previews #179167](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179167) · [commit 2c9a7f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c9a7f6d00f23aeb4595ae79c3d4def52dcd86a1). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reuses recently downloaded public author and coauthor photos across [GitHub issue and pull request previews](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/github), and shows cached photos while they refresh to reduce repeated downloads. An older or missing avatar can persist for up to five minutes.
  [Avoid repeated downloads #173295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173295) · [Reuse photos across previews #173871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173871) · [Show cached photos while refreshing #176790](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176790) · [commit 2ed85de](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2ed85de7b6f11d20cc66b47fbb735355cc48e91a). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces local CPU and memory used to read GitHub previews and publishing options, and reduces server work for cached issue and pull request previews when a GitHub service or environment credential is configured.
  [Preview and publishing-option reads #185685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185685) · [commit 3be098d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3be098dc00d77970a6d1cc665ca0034ff9b99150) · [Cached preview reads #186241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186241) · [commit 2229c93b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2229c93b0a4e6f6cc226ae6ceeecfbb4b2e67514). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the processing and memory needed to refresh My GitHub status.
  [My GitHub status #185847](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185847) · [commit 2a8ca15](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a8ca15a3df1cf778e28d2a4852f96352ba3eb50). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets a supported requesting Control UI open the current agent’s GitHub Tools settings for reconnection. Unsupported or blocked clients receive manual directions.
  [GitHub reconnection changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).

#### Bug fixes

##### Automations and scheduled work

- Fixes owners being unable to find or manage existing automations through CLI-backed agents, and authenticated channel owners losing management access across conversations when their messages are queued.
  [CLI-backed management #162237](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162237) · [queued owner messages #172539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172539) · [024d58f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/024d58f3543743418ef0f22c56555ffaf6d15148). Thanks [@grynn](https://github.com/Grynn) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for #162237, and [@johan-eilertsen](https://github.com/johan-eilertsen) and co-author Ayaan Zaidi for #172539.
- Fixes scheduled monitors being skipped solely because another agent has a running automation. Checks can still wait for capacity or conflicting work.
  [Scheduled monitors #167845](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167845) · [Heartbeat guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/heartbeat.md) · Thanks [@yozakura-ava](https://github.com/yozakura-ava) for the PR and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for co-authoring.
- Fixes automation repair showing internal instructions in chat or reporting a false empty-response error in WebChat when there is nothing to say. The original job failure and any repair result or request for help remain visible.
  [WebChat empty response #169684](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169684) · [a1df014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a1df0148036bc63e98605e40b1b1b82d66c44b80) · [repair instructions #173416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173416). Thanks [@huyengiang101086-spec](https://github.com/huyengiang101086-spec), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/oldrich333) for #169684, and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for #173416.
- Fixes cron retention being delayed while agent databases prepare after Gateway startup. Maintenance can proceed for healthy stores and clean up expired isolated sessions in a pending store when it becomes available. [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)
  [Retention startup #177080](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177080) · [expired session cleanup #178798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178798) · [ea9abff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea9abff9e8dcc8a1fc86e5928b67c208c9473bba) · [Managing jobs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/cron-jobs/managing-jobs.md). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Prevents scheduled runs and main-session system events from silently switching away from a pinned session model when it fails. A job's own model or fallback settings still take precedence, and waiting scheduled replies pick up pins added or cleared before they run. Isolated jobs using a session pin check that model's local endpoint and can stop if it is unavailable.
  [Scheduled model pins #177494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177494) · [commit 9883515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9883515ef223fd79d344889d7ed2aa33353de75b) · [issue #177546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177546) · [system events #181669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181669) · [c99f01a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c99f01afc7571e8ff60d1385413a34b1c6020937) · [issue #181668](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181668) · [Scheduled job payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads). Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes background command completions from isolated cron jobs waking the unrelated main session.
  [Originating-session fix #172690](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172690) · [related follow-up recovery #176511](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176511) · [Background process documentation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/background-process.md#L49-L54). Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), reporter [@Ramsbaby (#172651)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172651) and earlier reporter [@eliavb43 (#170872)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170872).
- Fixes replies to delivered scheduled questions losing their context after the destination conversation goes idle.
  A newly delivered visible result refreshes the idle window. Daily resets still use the session start time. [#128845](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128845) · Thanks to [@Thinkr1](https://github.com/Thinkr1) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report.
- Fixes agent edits to a cron expression silently dropping the job’s existing timezone.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168121">PR #168121</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c202b93155c78384515d22a41409e66e9903486c">`c202b93`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/yetval">@yetval</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes one-shot automations being saved at a different hour when the selected time is skipped by daylight saving. Choose a valid **Run at** time to save. [Automation schedules](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/cron-jobs/schedules.md)
  [PR #168923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168923) · [2afb89a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2afb89afd72979705586c526bec273549b7b34bc). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes large automation lists failing when their own batch of delivery previews overloads the session workers.
  [PR #169713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169713) · [d388ca4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d388ca43e08a7997f680cc7fa06548849bcf364f). Thanks to [@huyengiang101086-spec](https://github.com/huyengiang101086-spec) and [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- Fixes truncated silence markers appearing as heartbeat alerts while preserving ordinary reply fragments. With `showOk` enabled, the usual `HEARTBEAT_OK` can still appear.
  [PR #170972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170972) · [22799f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22799f805a84afa7623e50ff772c072462cb4644). Thanks to [@Irish-Joseph](https://github.com/Irish-Joseph) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automation edits reporting success for a blank replacement command while keeping the old command scheduled. Blank replacements are rejected before accompanying edits are applied.
  [#172144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172144) · Thanks to [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Automations editor actions floating above the bottom of the form or appearing before job scratch.
  [#172176](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172176) · Thanks to [@brandon-julio-t](https://github.com/brandon-julio-t), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes open automation details keeping the previous language after you change the Control UI language.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172456](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172456) · [562ceed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/562ceedef82ff08b8fd5f5f9742fa048c5c977df)
- Fixed unbound native CLI automations running under the wrong account. They use the CLI’s current native login, and jobs with saved account bindings keep those bindings. An existing unbound job may switch accounts after upgrading. Update paired Claude nodes and approve their advertised capability to apply credential filtering on the node.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#172916](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172916)
- Fixed restarts and cancellations counting as failures that could disable recurring cron jobs. Genuine failures still count, and one-shot jobs remain disabled after interruption.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172933](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172933) · [Cron troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/cron-jobs/troubleshooting.md)
- Prevents Doctor from permanently binding an unbound legacy cron job to a backup account solely because its usual account is temporarily rate-limited.
  [#173572](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173572) · [70833f4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70833f4c3c11f703169e285557c3e4ecda7ccd3e) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw cron show` crashing on incomplete job details and preserves the duplicate-name error when a matching job has no schedule.
  [#173633](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173633) · [Related schedule guard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173634) · [Cron CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/cron) · Thanks [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO), [@skyzhao1223](https://github.com/skyzhao1223), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automation errors referring to MCP when the account bound to the run was removed or signed out. The error names the account and asks you to select an authorized one.
  [#173649](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173649) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes isolated cron jobs stopping as soon as they send a message to their configured chat. Unless the send is explicitly marked final, the job can finish later steps such as recording that the message was sent. [Cron delivery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery)
  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176141">#176141</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/075b46634555fa317782a0f4d88e158faa935e42">Commit 075b466</a>
- Fixes scheduled triggers and scripts failing to run when OpenClaw incorrectly reports that the named channel account that created the job is unavailable.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176158">#176158</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/685fb5ff66cac21e8a9fdfbc7303ea5b13b12be3">Commit 685fb5f</a>
- Fixes completed hook and isolated cron runs being reported as failed when only delivery was canceled. The run keeps its result and reports the cancellation as a delivery error.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176606">#176606</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4114bb2f6cb8b2f542fd4d7d60043be9a10512a">d4114bb2</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@karljamoralin](https://github.com/karljamoralin).
- Prevents general Gateway restart recovery from running interrupted scheduled jobs a second time, including jobs that received guidance while running. Cron handles them under its own recovery policy. See the [restart recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176682">#176682</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d6ec4c7de8919a1711d0a87798776e1fd5264d97">d6ec4c7d</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Replaces a vague automation error with guidance when a job’s saved account doesn’t match the selected model provider or CLI login. Choose a compatible model and host-managed runtime, or use `openclaw automations edit <jobId> --model <provider/model>@<profileId>` to select a different stored account.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176911">#176911</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/troubleshooting">Automation troubleshooting</a> · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes scheduled agent turns getting stranded after a Gateway restart. OpenClaw can retry an enabled, unchanged job once, including a one-time job, if delivery hadn’t started. The interrupted attempt stays in run history. Possible prior delivery prevents an automatic retry, and a retry can still repeat earlier actions. A one-time job disabled by an interruption on an older release needs manual recovery. [How scheduled jobs work](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/cron-jobs/how-it-works.md)
  [#177127](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177127). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes isolated cron runs leaving native prompt diagnostics out of the transcript even when the run succeeds.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177516">#177516</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1e4beb8dc346afc96c3d3ac18a42c44c81f04299">Commit 1e4beb8</a>
- Fixes delegation guidance that could leave an isolated scheduled job’s reply missing results from its subagents. The agent is now told to collect the results it needs before replying or to do the work itself if it can’t collect them. [Scheduled job payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads)
  [#177734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177734) · [ab6d6bdc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab6d6bdc504b1474e5f612186c1e62425e5dd6ff). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the running watcher in place if an edit or stale removal is rejected. An accepted edit is reported separately from cleanup of the old watcher, and its replacement waits for confirmed exit.
  [#177940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177940) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) (co-author).
- Fixes automation results crowding out the answer you were waiting for in Control UI chat by showing them separately.
  [#177943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177943) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes missing screen reader alerts for field errors in the Automations editor, including when a required name is left blank.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178028">#178028</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7db22d13bf4eb47a3882adedc17af1f87779225a">7db22d13</a>. Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents an automation from silently losing requested tools when an agent creates it or edits its tool list. If an entry cannot be included, the error names it so you can use a supported tool or remove it from the request.
  [#178183](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178183) · [commit 43d0f9b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/43d0f9b25834e2feff1a7ab4835eabb768209c2f) · [Automation tool lists](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads) · [issue #178003](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178003). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@cbremer](https://github.com/cbremer) for the report.
- Fixes scheduled reminders in the main conversation being marked successful before their own turn handles them. If OpenClaw restarts before a pending reminder is picked up, run history records one interruption and the reminder isn’t replayed. [Cron run guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/how-it-works)
  [#178650](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178650) · [`e06a812`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e06a8122736643bf10f43d7cf4d84fb6741c8d1e) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes silent refresh failures in an agent’s Automations list. The list now shows the error and keeps already loaded jobs visible.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179374">#179374</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/147819">Related report #147819</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.
- Fixes schedule creation for jobs that use a required worker’s own credentials, so they aren’t rejected for lacking a Gateway account or assigned an unrelated one. Fixes native Codex schedules being rejected when Codex handles sign-in instead of the Gateway.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179696">#179696</a> · Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).</span>
- Fixes automation failure notices being unable to look up what went wrong until the owner sent another message. An agent handling an eligible scheduler notice or wake-up can read the automations and run history visible to that chat.
  Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc). [#180304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180304) · [commit 3afef59](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3afef59bd8e1ebb0dfde50bb878be0bcf3c4f90a)
- Changes how Cron decides whether a scheduled reply should stay quiet. `HEARTBEAT_OK` text alone no longer makes Cron suppress the reply, and marking a reply quiet does not hide attachments or other non-text content.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180563) · [7f4cbc1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f4cbc1e2a1a98bac51d780ff92e0ef4276cdcf2)
- Fixes scheduled scripts and condition triggers rejecting message actions that should be allowed for the job creator’s recorded chat and account. Telegram still requires an authenticated current conversation for account-bound deletions. [Cron script payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads)
  Thanks to InsanusMokrassar and steipete. [#180565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180565) · [f883a85](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f883a852363f27b2a07b432d704fe122e0ff04ec)
- Fixes scheduled main-session automations and heartbeats that could stop before reaching the model or fail to send a message after a channel DM used the main session under the default DM routing.
  Thanks to masatohoshino, obviyus and RomneyDa, to Suiah98 for the WhatsApp report, and to TheAngryPit for additional integration checks. [#180603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180603) · [ed41b93](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed41b93c7fe292b3069cbe8955f9e223ea60acff) · [Issue #180602](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180602) · [Issue #197181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/197181)
- Fixes native chat refusing to change the allowed tools on an automation you own when the job has no Codex app permissions. You can make the edit in the conversation that owns it without recreating the automation. Jobs with app permissions still need fresh confirmation of those permissions.
  Thanks to obviyus. [#180619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180619) · [f2eed50](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2eed50e9d79da1a2272f13be9c3dc85a48a3e50)
- Clears the old error as soon as you retry loading or saving the cron scratchpad in the Control UI, without clearing your draft or hiding the controls. [Job scratchpad guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads#job-scratch-and-quiet-results)
  Thanks to steipete. [#180659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180659) · [2feda70](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2feda705772b7c3b8d4b42cbc61287c20b85b5ac)
- Fixes new scheduled jobs picking the creator’s account when the job’s model calls for a different one. [Scheduled job payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads)
  Thanks to vincentkoc. [#180677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180677) · [393a1ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/393a1ea66b4d29202aa92ceae9b489921460748c)
- Fixes recurring cron jobs showing a retry time they can’t meet after a Gateway restart, and keeps the retry from shifting the regular schedule. [How cron schedules jobs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/how-it-works)
  Thanks to vincentkoc. [#180677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180677) · [393a1ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/393a1ea66b4d29202aa92ceae9b489921460748c)
- Clears the old model-list warning when you retry loading models in Automations, while keeping your last set of model suggestions and your draft editable.
  [#180807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180807) · [commit 3633f4d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3633f4d7ca58b23953177f4895d03890a5347063) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes scheduled automations rejecting a selected OAuth account because it has no refresh token. The automation can use the account while its access token is still valid.
  [#180823](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180823) · [commit 6786b2d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6786b2d7e5c61e5d9dd786d32a305ebcbdf63610) · [#180757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180757) · Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) for the fix and [@jackten](https://github.com/Jackten) for the report.
- Keeps Gateway Health and Automations diagnostics aligned with the cron store the running Gateway actually uses, including custom stores. Removes a duplicate diagnostics refresh when cron starts or restarts.
  [#180875](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180875) · [commit 978c086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/978c086a4b860aad51a132e0c2b721c9077a1d98) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes isolated cron runs using the native Agents API taking too long to report their result or leaving an unused session behind after the run finishes.
  [#180877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180877) · [commit 1206d80](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1206d801b27738ff604cec4633779f84a1cb3b0e) · Thanks [@yinx65588-boop](https://github.com/yinx65588-boop) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes scheduled follow-ups losing permission to continue in the same conversation after the owner edits the job or a recurring trigger adds context. Queued follow-ups pick up the latest saved edits when the conversation becomes idle. An authorization failure is shown and stops that follow-up. Restarts and cancellations can still be retried. If an older follow-up’s authorization was captured while it was paused, its owner needs to recreate the follow-up after upgrading.
  [#180891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180891) · [Cron payloads](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/cron-jobs/payloads.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes scheduled automations losing their final reply when they remove themselves. Removing or disabling an automation from another turn, or pressing Stop, still cancels the run.
  [#181085](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181085) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a3909d830a403fb2fba7bf19c911563e7908dd92)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automation error links leaving invalid fields hidden. Selecting an error for a field in the collapsed Advanced section opens the section and puts focus on the field so you can correct it.
  [#181218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181218) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/63188e5aebc383cece33a4010f99dc848552d151)). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). Reviewed by [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Removes misleading app reauthorization instructions from scheduled Codex jobs that use only MCP tools or otherwise have no app access.
  [#181219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181219) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/828c38d27dc1b2e28c0d1ed8d9569c3b4432b057)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by [@cbremer](https://github.com/cbremer) ([#180370](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180370)).
- Cuts repeated work that put memory pressure on large installations when Doctor migrated model-account settings for older cron jobs.
  [#181293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181293) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/54dd1c6d9a56fdd323bcc26392ef27ccaf881a3b) · [Doctor state and sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@609NFT](https://github.com/609NFT).
- Fixes confirmed [automation results](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery) waiting for an ongoing reply to finish before appearing in the destination conversation. These results no longer hold up a restart just because that reply is still running.
  [#181506](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181506) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes scheduled jobs from an owner’s Discord DM being treated as if the requester wasn’t an owner. Each run checks the requester’s current owner access, including for private memory from the parent conversation when the job uses it.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181916">#181916</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02e5fd188e886a0bb68e7f01121f4c91fd53d885">02e5fd18</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>.</span>
- Fixes scheduled tasks dropping subagent replies or waiting past their timeout when the system clock changes during the wait.
  Thanks [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182144) · [`e6218151`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e6218151ac552eceb464dc4c53ccf33fc024d178)
- Stops eligible agent automations created from a Control UI conversation from continuing to use a revoked device or access grant. The next run is refused and the automation is disabled with a reason. If a run is already underway, it loses access to remaining operator-only actions. For an eligible older job, bind it from its parent conversation to record creator access. [Automation payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182348">#182348</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f3ac84c9a607afabbaea42a4b2dbf16b56757a7">explicit binding follow-up</a>. Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Corrects what agents are told about scheduling work for the current conversation. A detached run uses the conversation’s saved workspace and sandbox while that conversation is current, falls back to the scheduled agent’s workspace otherwise, and ends if you reset the conversation. Cloud placement follows the scheduled job’s own rules. [How scheduled jobs work](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/how-it-works)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182350">#182350</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents broken characters at the end of last-heartbeat previews for converted command automations when an emoji or other Unicode character crosses the cutoff.
  Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666). [#182776](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182776)
- Fixes reminders and other automations failing to save when an agent sends usable settings in the wrong format, whether it is creating an automation or editing an existing one.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@linuxmum](https://github.com/LinuxMum) for the earlier related proposal. [#182824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182824) · [#97339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97339)
- Enforces run-specific permissions for automation tools in webhooks and channel join introductions. Webhook runs stay scoped to their own automation, and channel join introductions run without automation tools.
  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman). [#183913](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183913) · [f2c594f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2c594ffa23dc1aee6523e5f5b96be869ffcce30)
- Fixes misleading account mismatch errors in scheduled runs that use a CLI account. The run reports when the credential store needs repair or account setup is cancelled.
  [#184555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184555) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65d62b970107c37c03411b1661c6da9c2040ec31) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes newly account-bound automations running on the wrong runtime after a session or configuration change. Older bindings without a recorded runtime still choose one the same way. Errors identify the account or runtime when known and tell you how to record an account when needed. Changing accounts within the same provider is refused if the recorded runtime is no longer available.
  [#185070](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185070) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Prevents `current` automations with a saved runtime from switching models or failing to run when you change the model or provider in the conversation that created them. Jobs without a saved runtime still follow the conversation’s model selection. To change the scheduled model yourself, use `automations edit --model`.
  [#185341](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185341) · [6cdb29b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cdb29b11b41e497ee38c432dedb67fd0d71aa18). [Automation model selection](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes older search results replacing the list on the Automations page when a newer search fails. The last accepted list stays visible alongside the error, and you can retry the search.
  [#185466](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185466). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes upgrade checks choosing the wrong set of scheduled jobs when an older updater leaves out the path to a custom configuration and more than one set is saved. Fixes Doctor losing track of which scheduled jobs and heartbeat data to migrate on SQLite installations with a custom configuration.
  [#185723](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185723) · [`6c5e220`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6c5e22056d96951c1d306b6838f68173cb23d7e7) · [Issue #185457](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185457) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Prevents automatic cleanup from deleting a pinned continuation for an isolated cron run, so you can return to that specific run after it finishes.
  [#185750](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185750) · [`540a712`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/540a712aa046cf61eec3ffa03450e9957abdb8e7) · [Issue #185712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185712) · Thanks [@geomagilles](https://github.com/geomagilles) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)
- Fixes scheduled jobs cutting off long subagent reports when the job delegates the work and sends no reply of its own. If the full report is no longer available, the job still uses the short preview. [Scheduled job payloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185985">#185985</a> · Thanks to [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)
- Prevents Doctor from silently dropping malformed heartbeat hours during migration to automations. If Doctor flags a heartbeat time, correct it to `HH:MM` and rerun `openclaw doctor --fix` to migrate the intended schedule.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186305">#186305</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/750166cb2671233fa2115d969c8078407a276d11">commit 750166c</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186218">issue #186218</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations">Doctor migration guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/nxmxbbd">@nxmxbbd</a> (report).</span>
- Fixes Doctor and update checks getting blocked by a recreated `HEARTBEAT.md` after that heartbeat has already moved to an automation. Doctor flags the file for review without opening it.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186307">#186307</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5544c402a4cc5450021c2f190b1f59ae5034386d">commit 5544c40</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186185">issue #186185</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/heartbeat">Heartbeat guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/nxmxbbd">@nxmxbbd</a> (report).</span>
- Restores skill guidance in scheduled routines that were missing their eligible skills even though they could read the instructions. Stops Code Mode from listing skills it cannot read.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186306">#186306</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc46600a9837f2eaab506321880aba59012660d2">commit fc46600</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186285">issue #186285</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills">Skills guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/giodl73-repo">@giodl73-repo</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> (co-author).</span>
- Clarifies why a reminder was rejected if its delivery destination was left blank or a one-time schedule included a trigger. The error confirms that nothing was saved and tells you how to retry. Omit or fill a blank destination, remove the trigger for a one-time reminder, or choose a recurring schedule.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186354">#186354</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc7380924bdb3cddfcd4fe3e34a6e86fea07d7a1">commit cc73809</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/troubleshooting">Reminder troubleshooting</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/tobyqu">@tobyqu</a> (report), <a href="https://github.com/latter-bolden">@latter-bolden</a> (fleet evidence), <a href="https://github.com/gaozixiang1">@gaozixiang1</a> (earlier safeguard), <a href="https://github.com/lanzhi-lee">@lanzhi-lee</a> (earlier safeguard).</span>
- Fixes scheduled runs showing only a stale tool-failure warning after recovering and recording a meaningful result.
  [#186652](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186652). Thanks to steipete.
- Replaces the error banner for invalid cron expressions and time zones with a message under the affected field. Create and Save stay unavailable until the value is corrected.
  [#186724](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186724). Thanks to jondihaynes and obviyus.
- Fixes operator-created [automations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/managing-jobs) being hidden from the conversation that owns them, so you can find, pause, resume, reschedule, run or remove them from that conversation. Changing what runs or where results go makes the job run with the owner account’s permissions instead of the operator’s. If the job has no account on record, those edits still need a Gateway owner or operator.
  [PR #187195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187195). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents an unmet scheduled automation condition from posting a “did not start” notice or moving the conversation to the top.
  [#188594](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188594), [#188700](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188700). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backports (d1a8134 and 26a71f5).
- Preserves the catch-up delay for missed agent jobs when the scheduler restarts without restarting the Gateway.
  [#191838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191838). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Lets OpenClaw reclaim an idle cron worker under memory pressure when automatic scheduling is off. Manual job runs still work.
  [PR #196387](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196387), [commit 08f5c5f5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08f5c5f5870ea669a725c6bdb42af7c02ef62478). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Automation settings showing triggers as off when you have left them at the default. The control shows “Default: On,” and you can return to that default without saving an explicit On setting.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bc4a01b1fa411b430e26b4c57936ded931ea5762). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nkeil](https://github.com/nkeil).
- Stops queued scheduled runs from using owner-private memory if the requester loses owner access before the run starts.
  [Commit 33e52df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33e52df4cd03e9e6a7d30849c702b45196aa5883) (combined release backport). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the backport, and [@zeroaltitude](https://github.com/zeroaltitude).
- Fixes scheduled runs losing access to the originating conversation’s workspace, memory, or board after you edit a message, switch branches, or reset the conversation that created them. Scheduled operator continuations and plugin commands follow the current conversation, and results meant for that conversation reach it, including in WebChat when no external destination is set. Jobs that depend on an archived or deleted conversation or a missing worktree still pause, and Doctor can report why.
  [Commit 623fd6d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/623fd6dad99d7feaf1945cd631fc8202238c51f2), [Commit 94e1bfb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/94e1bfbba5aeb1aaf76edfa9393a13f2bca71331). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Restores cron’s link to its jobs or run history after a legacy store has already moved, when only one retained set remains.
  [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents [scheduled jobs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery) that use global sessions from picking up another agent’s recipient, account or thread when falling back to a saved destination.
  [#173855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173855), [original repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156970). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes missing failure alerts when a recurring automation is disabled after ten failed runs in a row. OpenClaw sends the disable notice through an eligible configured failure destination without needing the model to respond. If there’s no eligible destination, it queues the notice for the owning agent.
  [PR #174309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174309) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/053cf12a7a0e4f603896569e7d9db1bfe4dd5fdc) · [Automation delivery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/delivery). Thanks [@saftall](https://github.com/saftall).
- Fixes scheduled jobs failing on their first save with PostgreSQL.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps older periodic-task heartbeat instructions out of the conversation history an agent uses after the heartbeat has finished, including turns that ended silently.
  [#174815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174815) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/503bc1bd44992f5dc5426fe2f2fea263524fe0db) · Thanks [@maliv2](https://github.com/maliv2) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Replaces confusing errors with a message that tells you who can edit an automation’s prompt or tools when your chat doesn’t have permission. For an automation with no recorded owner, only a Gateway owner or operator can make those edits. Chat can still enable, disable, reschedule, or remove it where it already has permission.
  [#175153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175153) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops Doctor from replacing a legacy automation’s explicitly linked shared account with the default during migration. If the linked account is missing or cannot run unattended, Doctor warns and leaves the automation unchanged.
  [#175165](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175165) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes [background command follow-ups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) getting dropped after an isolated cron run ends. A completion already queued while the run was active waits its turn and follows up in that run’s session, not the main chat. Completions not accepted before the run ends remain suppressed, and jobs configured for no delivery still don’t follow up automatically.
  [PR #176511](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176511) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aee987f3b95d108fac54f4d84377857455992fc4) · [Issue #176235](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176235). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@elikampf](https://github.com/elikampf).
- Fixes [Doctor lint](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running) checking the wrong agent or missing a `HEARTBEAT.md` that would block repair or an update on setups with legacy heartbeat settings. It checks the configured agents’ actual files, including with `--all`.
  [#186926](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186926) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b8ff3e4f149a538212ee7e9ab58f5ad6ddfcbfb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) for [the report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186862).
- Fixes [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations) turning a disabled heartbeat into an enabled Proactive check and leaving the migration unfinished. Doctor also repairs unfinished migrations when it can confirm the heartbeat was disabled. If it cannot tell, it leaves the automation alone and tells you how to finish the repair.
  [#181659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181659). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) for the report.
- Fixes plain [heartbeat checklists](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/heartbeat) under a `tasks:` line blocking Gateway startup during migration. Doctor keeps those checklists as notes without scheduling them. If a real task declaration is incomplete, the update check flags it and Doctor leaves the original `HEARTBEAT.md` in place for repair.
  [#181842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181842). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) for the report and co-authorship.
- Preserves valid conversation permissions when Doctor repairs an automation’s model account binding.
  [#182262](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182262). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes scheduled automations losing eligible owner-only tools on CLI backends that were available on the embedded runtime. If the requester loses owner access during a run, the automation can no longer keep acting as that owner. Older operator-linked trusted-policy jobs without a saved requester and with a direct-chat parent can read that chat’s owner-private memory. Doctor’s scheduled-run review shows which CLI jobs gain owner-only tools and which jobs lose them because their requester is no longer an owner.
  [#182585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182585). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes older Cron run history becoming unavailable when a new run starts a fresh session while the older messages are being checked. The history still isn’t shared if access was revoked.
  [Final verification repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/be8e76f13738ef16f443b2c6cb99c4d98d632970) and [sharing preparation follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/75812b5d1e2475910db6327e5973b915b0d1e300). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes automation updates and row expansion failing while the Control UI is still loading session details.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9afcc1b7b29a51535771a09747556970f6fbdfbd). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes scheduled prompts showing in full when an automation continues an existing conversation in the Control UI. Runs with enough detail appear as compact automation activity, and older recorded prompts without those details move into a notice you can expand. The agent’s replies and your own messages stay visible.
  [#181035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181035) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents cron history errors from revealing session keys to callers who cannot access them.
  [#172807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172807). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes repeat approval prompts for an unchanged stream watcher when an approved save is retried or approval takes longer. The approval applies only to that watcher.
  [Watcher approval timing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d90406afff0dc32e5f6cb76dfc3b1a9d9f8422ae) · [Save retries #182262](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182262). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #182262.
- Stops a paused job’s forced run when the job is disabled during shutdown.
  [Commit c12366a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c12366a42c46360eaf0da5df6036085a0976eb58).
- Applies the cron job time limit while a run waits for admission as well as while it executes and delivers.
  [Commit c12366a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c12366a42c46360eaf0da5df6036085a0976eb58).
- Fixes accepted Run now requests for the current conversation failing to start after its current turn. When the conversation is reachable, a skipped or pre-start failed run can also report why and what to try.
  [Commit 6604030](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/660403087725b933b51b896e605d2b374c427ece).
- Runs newly due jobs added during live Gateway startup without treating them as downtime catch-up.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Includes the admitted task run ID in scheduled completion events when available. A manual request ID still takes precedence.
  [Commit b15ea1e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b15ea1ecd4fca16df433ca4d25b78ea3f60fa7ba).
- Keeps scheduled notices under scheduler authority and protects owner-only job actions.
  [Commit 28ebe54](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/28ebe54da16719b29f6d074821e1cc97a8c5852f).
- Fixes `openclaw cron list` and `show`, and cron or automation `run --wait`, ignoring Ctrl-C or SIGTERM while waiting. Interrupting `run --wait` stops the wait, not the queued job. An add or edit already sent still reports its result and is not undone by an interrupt.
  [List and show #187726](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187726) · [Run wait #186750](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186750) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6580ecf829031173faa228cb0886a18810d4f1a3) · [Cron commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/cron). Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes automation searches missing jobs, and cron run-history searches missing job names, summaries or errors, when accented text is typed and stored in different forms. Saved automation names and descriptions stay unchanged.
  [Automation search #186794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186794) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/05cd744939ff021e2463a7353875d2fae86583cb) · [Cron history search #187024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187024) · [Commit 0ba1c7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0ba1c7d5eb7419d6fe3b8e921a1fd28bf000fec5) · [Cron commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/cron). Thanks to [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Keeps [scheduled checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads) out of chat when they report no change, including an unchanged known blocker. The desktop and mobile automation views keep the last meaningful result and show when the job was checked and whether that check failed. Meaningful results stay in the persistent conversation where the automation runs even when external notifications are off.
  [#182262](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182262). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes default cron jobs and their history disappearing after you move the state directory while OpenClaw is stopped or restore a backup to a new location. If OpenClaw cannot identify the default schedule in an older store, jobs pause until you run `openclaw doctor --fix` interactively and choose the default partition. The deferred choice no longer blocks the [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor) update check. If retired heartbeat settings remain, complete the [Doctor migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#heartbeat-to-ordinary-automations) before starting the Gateway. See [cron troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/troubleshooting).
  [Moving or restoring data #183508](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183508) · [Deferred selection #184497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184497) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e193f90ea83a34d475e4db8f34f4eb0d3012a45). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Restores [job details and self-removal](https://docs.openclaw.ai/automation/cron-jobs/payloads) for scheduled CLI runs where policy allows. Jobs scheduled into an existing conversation can no longer manage other automations or pause to wait for a child session. Check the scheduled-run access review in `openclaw doctor` if a job relies on those actions. Fixes scheduled automations reporting failure when they hand work to a subagent and end their turn. The scheduler handles child output according to the job’s delivery settings; an automation that needs to combine the results itself must collect them before ending its turn.
  [Job controls and yielding #183987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183987) · [Scheduled-job follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e923309c2978268898f7b57a11879fdfa174ca38) · [Delegation #185445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185445) · [Follow-up commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/71e2f57f04e5b20b283fa8ea0a9577963a591865). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Files and panels beside chat

- Fixes the Files panel refusing to open for people who could already read the conversation. Those readers can list, inspect and download that conversation’s artifacts with session-read access.
  [#173961](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173961) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173908) · [Operator scopes guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/operator-scopes) · Thanks shakkernerd.
- Fixes session-file downloads failing in the Control UI through the configured development Gateway proxy, even for files you could preview.
  [#173973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173973) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173949) · Thanks shakkernerd.
- Keeps browsing, search, previews and downloads in the conversation’s own files for private local Docker and Podman sessions with workspace access set to `none`. Shared conversations respect the reader’s sandbox requirements. MCP apps follow the same workspace boundary, and saved download links respect the current workspace and permissions. For unmanaged private workspaces, use Files to browse session files. Changes requires an admitted checkout. [Workspace access guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
  [#177819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177819) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes session file previews, diffs and downloads failing on Gateways with many active sessions when unrelated reads evict a session from the cache. File and diff requests also keep working during a rename if the workspace stays the same. Download links stop working when the workspace or access changes.
  [#178173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178173) · [commit 6b5279a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b5279a65123a94aa6a2b1e23418889b9f3052cf). [#178311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178311) · [commit 9e1f027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e1f0272c402416c9e34c8a50e71db236c365289). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes links to saved files being rejected as outside the workspace when an assistant uses a full local sandbox path. In supported Docker and Podman workspaces, previews, assets, downloads and follow-up actions use the right file.
  [#186727](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186727). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes download progress and late download results carrying over after you switch files. Prevents a pending attachment from being added to a draft after you switch files or sessions. Keeps an earlier save from leaving the new editor stuck on Saving or replacing the new draft.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179908">#179908</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7d5f4cdca9ed8fda8ab304b084e25f2427ae3ed0">commit 7d5f4cdc</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the chat file preview’s Open in editor control staying in English after you change the Control UI language. Its tooltip and screen-reader labels follow the selected language where a translation is available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179995">#179995</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2f3a928e954bf6fef63f152581b322dce5774b4">commit d2f3a928</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178265">issue #178265</a>. Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes image thumbnails in the Side chat composer failing to open a preview. You can check an image before sending and close the preview without removing the attachment.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180021">#180021</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/232198b01e72e626fb89e5d66df895f49b10b822">commit 232198b0</a>. Thanks to [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes unavailable audio previews going unannounced for screen-reader users in Control UI chat. The announcement names the attachment, and the download stays available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180105">#180105</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba905b7598854740fc8a473a333cf0de7f78a9e7">commit ba905b75</a>. Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Prevents updates to the same attachment from interrupting an image preview that is already loading in the chat sidebar.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179438">#179438</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Prevents Chat from retrying a failed HTML preview after you switch to another file, and uses the current file’s content when starting its preview.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180318">PR #180318</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bef63bc82e632ce248e4708ca88b1d95fed74578">Commit bef63bc</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes supported files in [Files](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui) and Outputs opening as download links instead of previews, including managed images, text, documents and media supported by your browser. Valid PDFs preview in browsers with built-in support up to 16 MiB; larger or unsupported files remain downloadable. Closing or replacing a managed image preview stops its pending load.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181903">#181903</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d25ac789c15a36aa89614abc5bc84e8504ecb4a8">d25ac789</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span> · Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski. [#183854](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183854) · [03b4552](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/03b45525d9cccd4ddfda3da0465b23111d29bef2)
- Fixes large Markdown files losing formatting in chat previews and preserves consecutive spaces in inline code in Markdown attachments.

- Fixes the [Files panel](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#chat-behavior) going blank when you switch away from a conversation with an open file preview and then return. Files takes you back to the folder, search, filters and scroll position you left.
  [PR #187121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187121). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes saved folders disappearing from Files when they contain only excluded cache files. Previously saved folders that still exist stay saved through workspace sync, archive recovery and restore.

- Fixes relative file links in Markdown chat attachments taking you away from the conversation. Choose **Browse files** to pick a file yourself without closing the chat or the attachment.

- Fixes untracked nested Git repositories showing up without names in Review, both in the list and in the file tree.

- Fixes Review offering **Edit file** for read-only files and opening a read-only preview on the first edit request for an editable file. Existing drafts are preserved.

Details retries in the background instead of interrupting you with an error. Access denials still hide protected results, and failed Stop or Clear actions still show an error.
