- Makes subagent icons easier to read in light themes in Chat and Details. Aligns the desktop Sharing, Details, and Panels controls so you can tell an open control from one you’re hovering over.
  [#178964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178964), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178961). Thanks to [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes the chat scrollbar moving inward when you open **Details** on desktop. Messages and the composer stay aligned as **Details** opens or closes, without jumping away from where you were reading.
  <span>[#179059](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179059) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski)</span>
- Fixes uneven icon spacing in the desktop chat side-panel header and makes the dropdown arrow beside **Share** or **Public** smaller so it does not compete with the sharing status icon.
  <span>[#179014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179014) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski)</span>
- Keeps mobile **Details** attached to the current chat when the view is replaced.
  <span>[#179073](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179073) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)</span>
- Prevents Details from overlapping an open side panel on the desktop Dashboard. Choosing **View all** in Details now closes it as Files opens, in both Chat and Dashboard.
  [#179543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179543) · [8971933](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8971933ab8dc9af09abf21a2a1a696fc012aba57) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes the fade from desktop branch names that fit in **Details → Environment**. Clipped names fade and show the full name on hover.
  Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski. [#181930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181930) · [e60285cd0372](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e60285cd037264a1b8097722c1ead51a99b8dc54)
- Places late-arriving Automations below session information and task progress in desktop Chat Details, so those sections stay put. Keeps the floating panel the same size and color as it closes.
  [#183072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183072) · [04aaba0c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04aaba0c783db5c903adcf671b2bfde428db3180) · [#183074](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183074) · [4c031833](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4c031833a5a53f033f19ecb7ce693008453ae57b) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). · [Control UI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui)
- Positions the chat Details panel for the available space from the first layout.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183423">#183423</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86d54ba9f0ffd26938a84c814b154d2ad5c7fe22">86d54ba</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes desktop Chat Details sections jumping when content arrives late or you open and close them quickly. Expanding Task progress no longer jolts nearby sections, and reduced-motion settings use a short fade.
  [#184466](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184466). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes desktop Chat Details loading the same Automations list twice when a conversation is restored after a reconnect. Rows you revealed with Show more also stay visible through unrelated updates.
  [#184483](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184483). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Gives the **Show session files** highlight and Details rows more room, including subagent and process rows and **Show more** controls, with labels aligned to the section headings.
  [#176580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176580) · [6ae64b5d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ae64b5d43bf9c71213af3e6fa65e716825d7aa6). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173803). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f056fb17810b640151aa1611f7573d131f9804b6).
- Removes the extra swarm progress display and duplicate live subagent rows from Control UI conversations. Follow running and finished workers under **Details → Subagents**, or select the running count to open the Subagents panel.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182684](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182684) · [d18177d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d18177d60f91f780325a599df6452dd9936ad708) · [Subagents guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents)
- Fixes unfinished checklist steps looking complete when the main agent finishes its turn successfully. Chat, Details, session hovercards and Board progress show delegated work separately from the saved checklist. Board widgets can follow the selected session even when it is outside the session list and let you retry if its activity fails to load.
  Thanks to [@johan-eilertsen](https://github.com/johan-eilertsen) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix. [#182832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182832) · [Issue #180780](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180780) · [Progress cards](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/progress-card)
- Fixes tool details losing their open or closed state when two panes show different portions of the same chat. Opening or closing shared details in one pane updates the other.
  [#175512](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175512). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes crowded panel tab rows that could hide the selected tab’s close button or move the page when you switched tabs. Tabs meant to stay open remain selectable and have no close action.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176323), [d41a1fd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d41a1fd1f48e4604aba28c45218a401fd1f656a0).
- Restores the Close button when a Control UI chat side panel fails to load, so you can dismiss it without reloading the page or losing your draft. [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui)
  [#177236](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177236), [0dff99a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0dff99a0aea74379a0b8045ca03373c96ca8e84a). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@Lewington-pitsos](https://github.com/Lewington-pitsos), [@cropsgg](https://github.com/cropsgg).
- Fixes Desktop controls such as **Refresh**, **Retry** and **Close** responding to an earlier panel state after the view changes.
  [#179105](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179105), [`7420137`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74201376f97d0ecd479f86db2282debce8a2416d). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops the Subagents and Processes loading rows from shifting sideways as the panels open or reconnect, on desktop and mobile.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181897">#181897</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2fc557a9fb060befdb5443db5d3963fa2cd082bc">2fc557a9</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181898">#181898</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98f1a66870102f4c6ad8eed9f299be7e26a7dcd4">98f1a668</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Stops the loading bubbles in Side chat from jumping or changing width when saved history starts loading.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181899">#181899</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/600db2e43442b642b129b53ced4a06347ec1b1f1">600db2e4</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Removes the duplicate toolbar that appeared beneath the real one while the Browser panel loaded its first view.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181900">#181900</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9b52bdf038ac759ba75f5c496759df421a502ec">d9b52bdf</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Fixes messages and the message box spilling outside the desktop side panel after you swap Chat and Dashboard.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181919">#181919</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1cb858022025d184434525dd77df0ac205404337">1cb85802</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Fixes **Discussion** failing to open after Chat switches from a desktop to a mobile layout.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180623) · [f4db733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4db73310f136bce48f2e21e1ee7a708e40ebbb1)
- Hides the misleading **Publish PR** button in mobile chat when there’s no branch work to publish. It stays available for publication results or recovery.
  [#181018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181018) · [Session details](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#session-details). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [**Details**](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat#session-details) not opening on a full-screen dashboard with the conversation hidden. On a wide desktop layout, **Panels** opens the same conversation beside the dashboard without losing your chat draft or in-progress widget edits. A single full-width widget keeps its height. On phones, **Session dashboard** keeps the conversation available while the dashboard is open, and tapping the conversation title opens **Details** even if you lose the connection.
  [#173821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173821). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/395cc8de7d6c009a6087fbda33162720efb83265).
- Fixes CI details going unavailable after a push or closure while the Control UI still shows the same pull-request commit. Available checks and job steps follow the displayed commit until the session refreshes its pull-request information. [Pull-request checks in Chat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178159">#178159</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fca7a1faeb7bac1b611f04a8cf93151fbe4f5d2c">fca7a1fa</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps local changes visible in Chat’s **Environment** panel so you can open **Uncommitted Review** after publishing a pull request. It also removes the stale **Retry** button that could appear beside an already-open pull request for the same checkout.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182623)
- Stops **Ask in side chat** from filling your question with a duplicate “Regarding” quote. The comment chip carries the passage and comment, and you can type your own question or keep the draft you already wrote. If the selection is too long, the editor stays open and shows the size warning.
  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen). [#180125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180125) · [commit d55993e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d55993e76dcc73def660ca9ecf0ab083f33b3cb7)
- Keeps Terminal tabs, scrollback and selections visible through a brief Gateway disconnect and reconnects to sessions that are still running. You can retry a failed reconnect or interrupted upload, and Terminal warns when it cannot confirm input arrived without resending it. Detached sessions can expire. Open MCP Apps, Canvas views and loaded Link Reader pages and previews also remain visible, downloaded Read Aloud audio continues playing, and stopping Talk during a disconnect no longer leaves an error unhandled. Live actions need a connection.
  [Control UI panels](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/panels) · [WebChat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/webchat) · [PR #174046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174046) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d7d89fce202d9d02bd1bcf9c7d4f5a546fa2bc7). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds **Retry** when Files fails to open or list a folder, so you can retry the same folder or search without reloading the chat or losing your conversation draft.
  [Files listings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui) · [Listing retry #176978](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176978). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). [Files loading #176343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176343). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Keeps the selected panel while browsing Files, preserves keyboard focus on refreshed panel position controls, and restores focus to the remaining chat when you close a split pane with the keyboard. Fixes Terminal docking being unavailable when the terminal can be moved.
  Panel selection — [#176356](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176356). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski); Split pane navigation — [#176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes the empty Participants control from compact chat details, so keyboard users no longer tab to a list with nothing in it.
  [#173822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173822). Thanks to steipete. [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/19d71f91d19254e30b7dc043723eea7b092d78f5)
- Makes long pull request titles easier to read in chat Details. The card’s actions menu holds check details, change totals and the option to dismiss the pull request.
  [#173842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173842). Thanks to steipete. [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/789c8c017d24f53030822ebc71ba46667bbabda5)
- Fixes the Files pane failing to list or preview files when a session you can access is renamed or its activity updates. Images and other preview assets also stay available through those updates.
  [PR #174146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174146). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Stops browser results from opening the Browser panel on their own on desktop and mobile. Results stay in chat, and you can choose Open on a preview to see the panel. A panel you’ve already opened still follows your saved conversation layout.
  [PR #174314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174314) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25f932740d5917e6d24dbd42cd832c24ef67f654) · [Control UI panels](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/panels). Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Removes the misleading “Couldn’t load automations” error and Retry button from [session Details](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) for accounts that cannot read automations. Details also clears automations it already showed if that access is revoked.
  [#175908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175908) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes guests being denied access to All changes in project chats they already have [permission to read](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/operator-scopes). If that access is removed while the changes are loading, OpenClaw withholds the results.
  [PR #175976](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175976), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/568398f0f872249e8af36a2984463bf010feb9eb), and [related issue #159823](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/159823). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise) for the fix and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for the related report.
- Fixes Review in local managed workspaces counting refreshed upstream changes as part of your task. Those upstream files and commits stay out of the task’s changes and branch history, and aren’t selectable as task commits, even after a session reset.
  [#176001](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176001) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the Desktop view disconnecting during a brief panel update that leaves the connection unchanged.
  [#176525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176525) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports read and permission errors for Diffs viewer files while still falling back when a file is missing.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes report text and the scrollbar getting clipped when you narrow the Subagents panel in the Control UI, so you can scroll through the whole report.
  [#186919](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186919) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b9251d11e37929b9dd7984ce06f8270fa710005f) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes chat links that reported a nested workspace file missing when the message gave only its filename. The link opens the file only if a complete workspace search finds exactly one file with that name. Downloads, edits, refreshes, and attachments use the file that opened. Workspace search also flags incomplete results when it skips folders such as dependencies or build output. Use the [file's path](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui#download-files) if the search is incomplete or finds more than one match.
  [PR #174009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174009). Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes chat Files searches that made incomplete results look complete, even when no matches appeared. On desktop and mobile web, Files explains that some files may be missing and offers **Browse files** to clear the search and return to folder browsing.
  [#186575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186575). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes [relative links in workspace Markdown previews](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) opening a missing conversation instead of the intended file. Files keeps the report open and preserves unsaved drafts, even if the target can’t be opened. Files too large to preview still show their details and can be downloaded.
  [#186642](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186642). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the Desktop panel losing the selected target while it loads.
  [#176343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176343). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes attachment links not opening the selected file when Files is already the main panel.
  [#176653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176653). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

##### Web chat and dashboard

- Fixes prompt recall skipping older messages after you load more chat history and return to your draft.
  [Chat keyboard shortcuts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md). [#147371](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147371). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes audio transcripts without spaces appearing as blank messages in Control UI chat, including transcripts already in history.
  [#151375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/151375). Thanks [@brandon-julio-t](https://github.com/brandon-julio-t).
- Fixes Return sending unfinished Control UI drafts on phones and tablets. Return adds a line break, and the on-screen button submits the message or edit.
  Android browsers identifying as desktop Linux use desktop shortcuts. [Mobile chat controls](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md). [#157111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157111). Thanks [@rogeriochaves](https://github.com/rogeriochaves) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes deferred steering appearing in the conversation while the queue looks empty. It also fixes a history refresh overlap that could prevent a steering message from being sent.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167445">PR #167445</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/484f36aa09a6d11fc1a43909261742aa4ad749cd">`484f36a`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>.</span>
- Fixes an active Control UI reply and its controls disappearing when another input is acknowledged. The active reply keeps its tool activity, the composer draft and the correct Stop control.

- Fixes newer Settings edits being lost when Discard waits for an earlier autosave. Form edits resume autosaving. Save retained Raw edits explicitly. [Control UI Settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/settings.md)
  [PR #168828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168828) · [8f1ea22](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f1ea228c1dda047535443d08d17a78b9f673c4e). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a misleading connection warning in the title tooltip when a new Control UI conversation is already connected and has no saved session.
  [PR #168876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168876) · [bcb386a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcb386ad34a89bfa11ac70d8ffe95c6f10929dd8). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes custom Settings entries colliding with declared fields and losing edits to certain keys.
  [PR #168925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168925) · [4a39125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a39125ce6db99fd47b079e0952bc0ed3de744bf). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Workboard card dialogs showing an overly dark backdrop.
  [#171855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171855) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes images drifting away from the pointer and offscreen during wheel or double-click zoom in the Control UI preview.
  [#172016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172016) · Thanks to [@brandon-julio-t](https://github.com/brandon-julio-t), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes translated sidebar status options spilling out of the filter or overlapping the next setting.
  Thanks to [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen). [#172468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172468) · [fb23752](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fb2375291edcfa33dbfe98232138cb4cccf29fd0)
- Fixes forwarded-message attribution spacing on mobile chat.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172300) · [93e4b56](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93e4b56350e492fa30f8bd75b4e47ab1413ecfc1)
- Fixes GIF attachments appearing frozen or unavailable in Control UI chat, so attachments identified as GIFs animate inline. Inline playback loads the original GIF, which can use more data. See the [Control UI chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat).
  Thanks to [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson). [#172341](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172341) · [23fcef0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/23fcef02b83080f8a3cc09bdcb71d36327a4cc76)
- Fixes resumed requests losing their cumulative time and output-token recap when the working indicator clears before the run ends.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172492](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172492) · [3f2cc6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f2cc6f7ef231f62246aaeb9ce097b61d8c6aa09)
- Fixes the chat working indicator and composer status lingering after a Muse answer while background work finishes. **Stop** remains available, and new tool work or a retry brings activity back. Reconnecting also clears obsolete retry or fallback labels.
  The sidebar and favicon can continue showing an active run until it finishes. Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the later investigation. - Fixes ordinary sidebar session pages waiting for unrelated sessions that are not on the page.

- Fixed large photo previews pulling full-size images into chat automatically. Open or download the original when you need it, including when an animated or unsupported image has no preview.

- Fixed short session names being clipped on touch screens in sidebar rows for sessions without children.

- Fixed the sidebar missing the option to archive a session and its children when a worker branch has yet to load. When you archive just the parent, the dialog counts only the direct children that move to the top level.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173014)
- Fixes session searches and assistant reply attribution waiting for workspace details when the assistant’s name is already configured.

- Fixes Control UI requests for a configured avatar or emoji waiting for unrelated workspace identity details.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173106">#173106</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes the visible agent roster waiting for avatars and row details for agents outside your role. If access is granted while the roster is loading, the next roster request can pick up those agents.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173121">#173121</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>

  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173133">#173133</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes missing controls on dashboards with a single plugin widget when the page loads from scratch.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173135">#173135</a> · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).</span>
- Fixes visible session links waiting to show a saved new title when eligible preview information is already available, for both active and archived sessions.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173149">#173149</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>

  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173150">#173150</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>

  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173150">#173150</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes shared conversations and preview images becoming unavailable under cache pressure after overlapping renders.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173189">#173189</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes missing search-engine indexing directives on shared preview assets and rejected share responses. The directives are advisory, and people with a public link can still open it.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173191">#173191</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/security-model.md">Public sharing and privacy</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Gives stale Control UI tabs the reload instruction earlier after a Gateway update, before they start pairing or profile preparation. Failed connection logs also identify the phase and cause.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173402">#173402</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging">Gateway logging</a>. Look for `failurePhase` and `failureCause` in failed connection logs. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Right Arrow leaving focus on the parent when entering a submenu opened by hovering. Control UI menus also recognize WebKit pointer movement when the browser reports zero movement offsets.
  [#173520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173520) · [d934cae](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d934caebcd0544c261ab50bbbfea4bd06807adc6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

- Fixes the details link in an open plugin compatibility notice staying in the old language after you change the UI language.

- Fixes the Share button spacing and alignment next to Layout in chat headers.
  [#173679](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173679) · Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

  [#173703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173703) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).

- Fixes Gateway connection notices clipping or shifting the Control UI layout. Connection status is visible on desktop and mobile, with queued changes and **Retry** when available. Settings keeps connection status and save feedback visible even if the page fails to load.
  The avatar shows connection details on hover or focus, and screen readers announce changes even when the mobile drawer is closed. [#174022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174022) · [Connection loss and reconnect guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect.md#connection-loss-and-reconnect) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes the walking lobster making the mobile message box scroll sideways.
  [#174022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174022) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes session hovercards keeping initials after a channel avatar becomes available, retaining old-language labels after a language change, or closing unexpectedly when you switch cards. Group-defaults dialog labels also update with the language.
  [Avatar after reconnect #126392](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/126392) · [Language changes #172212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172212) · [Hovercard switching #174629](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174629) · [cf79d39](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cf79d394189e47a1003485040277000f75c8e147) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes live reasoning disappearing between tool steps and restores saved reasoning after a reply or reload when the agent or global default enables it and **View → Reasoning** is on. A session-specific setting can still hide it.
  [Live reasoning #171741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171741) · [Saved reasoning #173524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173524) · [4632101](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4632101feed72b18721394d1f0f3e1652b21e424) · [Issue #79469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79469) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@moc2216](https://github.com/moc2216).
- Fixes recognized tool-call text appearing after a streamed reply has started, and replies slowing down after code examples containing tool-call text. Completed code examples and reply text remain visible.
  [Tool-call filtering #172440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172440) · [e085c3f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e085c3fb261e6d2f72c9bcc1ae81c0c7205c2d70) · [Code examples #172701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172701) · [Follow-up #174313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174313) · Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@JasonBuildAI for the report #172663](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172663).
- Fixes typing in New Session stuttering during unrelated session updates, especially with large model catalogs. It also keeps Chat’s plus menu, New Session’s prompt and model selection, and command palette typing and keyboard navigation steady during unrelated updates.
  [New Session typing #172924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172924) · [Command palette #173100](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173100) · [Chat and New Session updates #173114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173114) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes background refreshes interrupting focus, selection or Undo in Raw settings and overwriting unsaved session labels. The file editor also avoids reapplying unchanged editing settings and highlights during unrelated panel updates.
  [Configuration and labels #173115](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173115) · [File editor #173134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173134) · [Raw settings focus #173483](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173483) · [5fdd725](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fdd725db9ae4221bd735a879c3409a78feeb50b) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the transcript jumping between the beginning and end or chat content shifting when a signed-in Control UI conversation reloads. Previously visited conversations with cached titles also avoid briefly appearing as **New session** during a warm reload.
  [Transcript position #172973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172973) · [Cached titles #173266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173266) · [Reload layout #173333](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173333) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unnecessary terminal reconnects when a Gateway reply to a periodic terminal check is delayed.

- Fixes blank New Session pages by offering Retry and, when safe, trying one reload per browser tab after an initial failure. Restores the correct draft when starting a conversation fails. - Replaces broken attachment cards and repeated errors in Chat and New Session with a dismissible error message, keeping your draft and any files that attached successfully. New Session also stops a waiting send if an attachment fails. Retry the file or choose to send the rest of your draft.

  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178139">#178139</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a234721a553bb5895423f738de1ad9dbd3be7ef8">a234721a</a>. Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Control UI menus and buttons that screen-reader and voice-control users couldn’t tell apart by name. Session menus in the catalog sidebar and Sessions table name the session, Delete and Restore name the worktree, and MCP App settings buttons name the app.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178140">#178140</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6535e863fb634871c3baee9ddf312b50c9c9d1d9">6535e863</a>. Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes missing screen-reader feedback after copying a chat table, an agent ID, a Usage session label or a GitHub device sign-in code. These controls expose whether the copy succeeded or failed.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178141">#178141</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a3a5cd5f969d54c774ea38a0f180015981aa16e7">a3a5cd5f</a>. Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the Dreaming control in Agent Memory so screen readers can identify it as an on/off switch and tell which state it’s in.
  [#178197](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178197) · [commit 40a236f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40a236feb0c366cdfcd1dbd82e458e95c6d607fb) · [issue #178196](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178196). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Restores keyboard navigation in Ask OpenClaw questions. Tab takes you to the choices once, and the arrow keys, Home and End move between choices without sending an answer. Press Space or Enter, or click a choice, to submit.
  [#178211](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178211) · [commit 8fd6975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8fd697560b5f8b71e2056e78dd42d0cb1b5d3c0b) · [issue #178209](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178209). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Fixes the command palette losing keyboard focus when you start a session, so if the start fails you can edit your prompt and retry without clicking back into it.
  [#178241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178241) · [commit 72b4cdf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72b4cdf5b8eb1642301f436e917ac8c5fc09b297) · [issue #178240](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178240). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the fix.
- Fixes voice control not finding Create PR links by their visible label in session hovercards and compact chat views. The link names now include the label you see and the branch.
  [#178258](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178258) · [commit a21726d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a21726d532c32968501a3b556c8c64830703870e) · [issue #178257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178257). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Control UI references opening the wrong GitHub repository. Bare references like `PR #126` and project-name shorthand stay as plain text. To make a link, write `PR owner/repo#126` or `issue owner/repo#126`, or paste the full GitHub URL. Standalone hex colors still show a swatch. [Control UI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui)
  [#177773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177773) · [bbdbd1c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bbdbd1c3a28955978fe1dbfe9c7477e33a292993). Thanks to [@jjjhenriksen](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes the Control UI fetching unchanged chat messages again on reload when it has already restored the conversation from cache. It fetches only changes and keeps the cached messages visible if there’s nothing new.
  [Offline use and reconnects](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect.md) · [#175393](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175393). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the Control UI from wiping cached chat and sidebar previews after temporary browser storage errors or harmless differences in how those previews are stored.
  [#175574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175574) · [fad2065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fad20657025261f7dbf1daec8f9ad44dda833d45). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes a Control UI chat cache issue that could leave a later clear or upgrade stuck after another tab blocked a cache upgrade.
  [#177969](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177969) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat history failing to show saved attachments when their stored file type is malformed.
  [#175426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175426). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat history failing to load when it contains a forwarded message from a scheduled job. Also fixes saved and still-pending attachments from forwarded scheduled messages failing to open in the Control UI.
  [#175550](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175550) · [84bd1de](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/84bd1dee92aedf868d087e824ed3c505d16e6b88). Thanks vincentkoc.

- Restores Control UI previews for screenshots saved in local sandboxes in managed project chats, including after the sandbox stops if OpenClaw can still verify that the screenshot belongs to the chat’s workspace. [Control UI media access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/control-ui/security-model.md)
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176199">#176199</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca5ac6f5b69aa8704b653fade36e2fa59937c7fb">Commit ca5ac6f</a>
- Fixes Webchat rejecting a workspace HTML report when your agent explicitly sends it to the current conversation. The chat keeps its own copy, so you can still open or download it if the original changes or is deleted. Use self-contained HTML so the report can open from the saved copy. [Message tool guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools)
  [#178940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178940). Thanks to [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes missing workspace icons and channel avatars in the Control UI for non-admin operators who already have access to the session.
  [#179150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179150), [`3f48057`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f4805759f9fa1adc743a5cdb51bf939c8642539). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Stops Activity from repeatedly trying to load missing agent avatars, including in the mobile Automations panel. Agents without an image show initials, while configured avatars still appear.
  [#174976](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174976) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes saved inline widgets failing to open for guests and other authorized conversation readers, and restores interactive controls for signed-in guests when widget scripts are allowed. Widgets still being saved can load when ready, and the viewer distinguishes denied access from an unavailable host. Strict mode keeps scripts off. [Inline widgets](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/show-widget)
  [Saved widget access #175025](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175025) · [Issue #174975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174975) · [Guest widget interaction #175483](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175483) · [Issue #175440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175440) · [Control UI chat and widgets](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/control-ui/chat.md). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Control UI chat showing two live previews for a single Canvas widget while keeping previews from separate widget invocations distinct.
  [#175467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175467) · [Issue #175445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175445). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes an error that stopped you from pinning your own MCP App preview to a board you could edit, including when you signed in with a Gateway token or password.

- Fixes signed-in guests being unable to choose and send eligible people mentions in conversations they can write in, and restores the people picker in New Session and the command palette for guests who can start a conversation. Selected mentions go with the first message. It also restores live Inbox delivery for mentions to guests who already have access, so they can see and dismiss those entries. [Multi-user mentions](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/multi-user.md)
  [Mention sending #178038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178038) · [commit 28d696e6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/28d696e6ede1d2756c759a1242c0df7ce9e92c07) · [New Session and command palette #178039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178039) · [commit 247890c4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/247890c4b2dc36fd3222e8cf5337dea36ed8a1f1) · [Guest Inbox delivery #178157](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178157) · [commit 68cd29b7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68cd29b7a3720ea96a9d24f8c39faadf1b84d363) · [WebChat mention delivery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/web/webchat.md). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Replaces the unhelpful Retry button on rejected people searches with guidance about access, profile verification or the conversation. Retry is still available for temporary failures when there are no usable suggestions. - Reduces flashes and layout jumps when the first message opens a new chat, keeping the working indicator visible and the pending session in place. The **Show all** agent sidebar also stops flashing a temporary row under an agent. If New Session failed to load in advance while offline, opening it can retry the load. - Fixes pending Control UI messages getting stuck after a disconnect. Eligible first prompts and supported attachment sends retry in order, and queued messages and Steer sends wait through a Gateway pause. Retrying the same message with its original key in the same session can confirm an already accepted send without sending it twice. Sends that cannot safely retry may need review; rejected sends offer **Retry** and **Discard**, which removes only the browser copy. If browser storage is blocked or full, eligible sends can retry and remain visible when you reopen the conversation in the same account and tab, but closing or manually reloading the tab can lose unsaved messages. [Offline and reconnect](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182334">#182334</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182436">PR #182436</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d607801a534ef1711cb8b23e85bb456efba88477">d607801a</a></span> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182639) · [Session control protocol](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).   [#181468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181468) · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Workboard’s New board and Edit board dialogs losing your place in keyboard navigation. Focus returns to the control that opened the dialog when you close it.
  [#181534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181534) · Thanks to [@ameliomansour](https://github.com/AmelioMansour) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes file edits and writes in Control UI chat showing only a generic tool name while the details load. The card shows the action and filename, updates available counts of added and removed lines as work progresses, and updates the label when the action finishes.
  [#181460](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181460) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes typing lag in the Control UI’s Settings form when your configuration is large. Raw shows your current draft, including edits made during a save. [Settings guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings)
  Thanks [@MoerAI](https://github.com/MoerAI) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for reporting it. [#181634](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181634) · [`b2fa105`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b2fa105d4c8f4800e487349edc0f983e3746ff84) · [issue #127341](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127341)
- Fixes chat saying “Waiting for turn to start…” while it already shows progress from a turn started on another client, even after that progress moves into chat history.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181864">#181864</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/baa40a424935cd2d74c4058ef579fca13834dddd">baa40a42</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Prevents a later run from displacing a completed reply’s work time and keeps that time beside its output token count in the chat summary.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181844">#181844</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25f6775438504e84499620683e704f4d4636eed3">25f67754</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Hides **Side Chat** when your connection cannot use it, even if a saved layout had it open. The Control UI keeps locally available session-link titles and skips observer visibility updates, MCP Apps discovery, and plugin catalog loading when your permissions don’t allow those requests. [Control UI access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui).
  Thanks to steipete. [#181970](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181970) · [e23b69458614](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e23b694586141e3bbe1420fa437bc85d0be306e5)
- Fixes keyboard focus leaving the Workboard when you clear a selection that includes a visible card, so you can keep navigating from a card on the same board.
  Thanks to AmelioMansour and obviyus. [#182020](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182020) · [0483f06bb9cb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0483f06bb9cbeafc577bfc2c8546eb04c3c82d24)
- Moves Activity recap refreshes to the end of a run, avoiding an extra model request when new input arrives. If the Gateway has no usable credential for the recap model, Activity shows the recap as unavailable before any provider call or retry. [Control UI settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182137) · [`c02fb415`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c02fb4152692b97a5136a140c2e058aadbf778c5)
- Fixes a skill-authoring error that could stop Control UI chat from retrying an unsent reply when chat is configured to use the message tool. The agent gets one more chance to send the reply.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182219">#182219</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar">@sukhdeepjohar</a>.
- Fixes two issues in Solid, the framework used by the Control UI and some bundled plugin views. It cleans up resources left behind when an update fails to replace the previous view, and keeps rows matched to the right items when their order changes.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182251">#182251</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Keeps session stats, agent skill rows and diagnostics, and provider usage in place while the Control UI refreshes them. Session Storage keeps its inventory and any open **Details by agent** section, and Meeting Capture keeps its controls and health information visible during refresh.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182235">#182235</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Gateway panel commands being rejected when they specify whether a panel should open expanded.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182343">#182343</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes generated Control UI checks that could reject valid values or accept altered ones. The checks preserve exact values and structural rules from the protocol schema.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182373">#182373</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents one press of Escape from closing both the help popover and its parent menu while navigation is still loading. Focus returns to the help button, and a second press closes the menu.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182378">#182378</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes link text jumping in Control UI chat when site icons appear. Offscreen icons wait until they are nearly visible, and already-loaded icons can be reused as you scroll. The chat and browser views release unused icon images when they close. Shared avatars decode in the background without changing their size.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182424">PR #182424</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/41490a6f649ad37a71b0cc9e0009b1ab68e857a5">41490a6f</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Removes duplicate notices in Control UI chat when the conversation already shows a switch to a backup model or back to the original. A successful switch can also appear in the conversation if the original model was skipped because it was unavailable.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182457">PR #182457</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c0b943767d8dbe3f552e06fbbd1e742d04aa1d67">c0b94376</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Closes automatically opened Desktop tabs when OpenClaw confirms the desktop is unavailable, without closing a tab you opened yourself.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182523">PR #182523</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/afeb47ae939c66a85ffdb0c6d772ba87d1528e53">afeb47ae</a></span>
- Shows the error above the message box when an accepted session move fails and clears the misleading progress indicator. Use **Retry move** if it’s offered.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182523">PR #182523</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/afeb47ae939c66a85ffdb0c6d772ba87d1528e53">afeb47ae</a></span>
- Fixes the chat box replacing the agent’s name with a prompt to paste more images after you attach a file, image, or **Add to chat** comment.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182698)
- Fixes paste shortcuts failing to reach the message box when the Control UI conversation history has focus. Copied text and images go into the active draft without clicking the message box first, including when you paste text without formatting.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182705](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182705)
- Fixes the chat transcript jumping when you send a selected passage with a comment and no other message text. The passage and comment stay visible as the message appears in chat history, even if the attachment takes longer to load.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182724](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182724)
- Restores **Panels** and, when available, **Dashboard** to the mobile Chat header. Look under **Actions** on screens narrower than 350 pixels. **People** shows current viewers when there are at least two, and a globe marks public conversations. The title sits above its project name or can use both lines when there’s no project. The default agent workspace no longer appears as a project. Long titles can still be cut off, and mobile Details drops the repeated title. Closing **Sharing** after opening it from **People** returns keyboard focus to **People**, and the reconnect indicator respects reduced motion.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182599) · [e2d7491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e2d74912cbc429473a60155a0a321885eebc5854)
- Removes the opaque scrollbar track from long Cmd+K prompts and brightens the scrollbar handle on hover in browsers that show the styled scrollbar.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#182600](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182600)
- Fixes startup styling in embedded Control UI pages whose security policy blocks the inline startup script.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182825](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182825)
- Fixes duplicate replies and file cards in the Control UI when an agent run sends a file back to the current chat.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182930](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182930)
- Fixes the retry loop restricted members could hit when their Home conversation was unavailable. The Control UI offers **New conversation**, and members can still open a conversation they have access to from Sessions.
  Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@MishukAdhikari](https://github.com/MishukAdhikari) for opening the issue. [#182941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182941) · [Issue #157182](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/157182) · [77c12a4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/77c12a45cd594cd10c182d59fba86f7072cac88c)
- Groups repeated identical failures into the latest Control UI card with a count and its **Try again** action. The saved conversation keeps its full history.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182954](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182954)
- Fixes the chat composer’s Context popover missing its usage bar when token totals are known but the detailed breakdown is unavailable. Removes report and offline notices from the popover. The full Context page still shows detailed errors.
  [#183032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183032) · [fff6e622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fff6e622a255dab262f32c0dfa12b4b2c9bd40d6) · Thanks to [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes [Control UI chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) hiding parts of the assistant’s reply after a run finishes. Commentary and visual results stay in place in both flat and bubble views, with separate **Worked** sections for tool activity and reasoning. Sections you’ve opened stay open when you load older messages, and the final recap shows the whole run’s duration when matching timing was saved.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183267">#183267</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e7f0546192744a786b60b607401e030b0f83940d">e7f0546</a> · Thanks [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Replaces the standing permissions warning in the agent menu with the reason **Create new agent** is disabled, whether the Gateway is disconnected, doesn’t support agent creation, or requires administrator access. The explanation is available on hover and to screen readers when the item has focus.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183274">#183274</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3da32db83c716a1269044459d01fed2003e5411c">3da32db</a> · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>
- Gives the active conversation and selected sidebar items distinct hover feedback. Makes hover, selected and open states more consistent across chat controls, Sharing, panels, Activity and Settings, while keeping conversations selected together visibly distinct and matching sidebar badges to their backgrounds.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183319">#183319</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ce732b1b97c9476b223f50020175712fe64edbbc">ce732b1</a> · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>
- Fixes Control UI avatars stretching or changing size while an image loads or when it fails to load. Keeps compact agent avatars round with centered emoji while preserving the corners in the CRT theme, and aligns shared-chat reply avatars with the message text.

- Fixes empty dashboard previews cutting off their hint text on desktop and narrow screens. Softens the gallery card borders and shadows when you’re not hovering over them.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183298">#183298</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44666a2f2c421aa5b7c6d365cb4dc02f5cde8e9b">44666a2</a> · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).</span>
- Stops the open navigation drawer from pulling keyboard focus back from the composer when you open New Session.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183498">#183498</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a3027303409267e2456f8621e8e8e2d2be970fdd">a302730</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents a Control UI update check from clearing the files for a new version while it’s still installing.

- Stops Chat from reformatting finished paragraphs over and over when you open it mid-reply before Markdown has loaded. The text and code-copy buttons already on screen stay in place as the reply continues and finishes.

- Fixes the Profile display-name field losing keyboard focus when a save submitted with Enter fails. You can keep editing the same draft and retry without selecting the field again.
  [#183719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183719). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93c39c2505c77f8beb1fe0ff8e94e92e8a5de228).
- Fixes overlapping controls in narrow Chat and New Session composers and gives the model and effort buttons matching sizes while keeping their tap areas.   [#184759](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184759) ([`b22e014d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b22e014dfa7da4ce3476672afe955cad806c98e9)). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).

- Fixes person cards showing a loading error when guests open a mention in a chat. Guests see the person’s name and avatar when the chat can identify them, or a simple card with the mention’s name when it can’t.
  [#185035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185035) · [f619886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f619886505db62aaade005058a047e2ed61d677c) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).

  [#185137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185137) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes desktop chat and side-panel headers covering theme artwork, including when the side panel has tabs open.
  [#185229](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185229) · [76ed6ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/76ed6cee0082364d6e849be88a70874ccf8639d4). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops the Control UI from flashing **Queued** with a **Discard** action or **Waiting for turn to start** while a prompt is sending normally. Recovery actions still appear for failed sends, messages held for review and reconnecting sends.
  [#185231](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185231) · [9c68f6e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9c68f6ec0a129cffe623c4d5e08d3d649a95df20). [WebChat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/webchat). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the session sidebar looking idle or queued after an agent starts, while messages waiting their turn stay queued. Activity and unread indicators stay aligned to the left of titles, including with owner filters, and right-to-left titles no longer overlap row buttons on hover.

- Fixes Side chat requiring a second question before you can send a saved selection and optional comment. Use **Ask** or your configured desktop send shortcut. Unsent comments on highlighted text return with their quotes and position when you reopen the same chat in the same browser profile and account. While **Saving…** is visible, automatic and in-app reloads wait and the browser warns before a refresh or tab close. If saving fails, the comment stays in the open tab with a warning; Incognito comments stay in memory only.

- Fixes blank chats and dashboards on reload when saved content is available but the Gateway is still connecting. Saved messages, drafts and dashboard layouts can appear during reconnection. Cached archived chats show their archived bar and parent breadcrumb, read-only chats keep their warning and disabled message box, and cached chats retain the agent’s name and text avatar. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the reaction picker opening offscreen for scrolled messages in WebKit and extending past narrow screens, while keeping long emoji search results scrollable.
  [WebKit picker #186295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186295) · [commit 5f3d8fa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5f3d8fa9689bc613ecb99efa187d2988231f956b) · [issue #184937](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184937) · [Narrow screens #187223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187223). Thanks to [@harjothkhara](https://github.com/harjothkhara) (co-author), [@jonathanlindsay](https://github.com/jonathanlindsay) (report) and Patrick-Erichsen.
- Fixes searches missing matches when the same accented text is entered in a different Unicode form. This covers Systems machines, model and linked-session pickers, New Session projects and workspaces, and uploaded chat attachments on desktop and mobile.
  [Systems search #187241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187241) · [Picker search #187521](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187521) · [New Session search #187611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187611) · [Attachments and fallback models #187674](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187674). Thanks to alix-007, [@huwei-xydt](https://github.com/huwei-xydt) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Control UI chat marking a running tool as **Outcome unknown** when chat history refreshes. A tool also stays marked **Running** after a reload if its activity can be recovered. When history shows a call with no result or live activity, the card says **No result available** and the unknown-outcome count excludes it.
  [#185261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185261) · [d923fa6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d923fa67c65b6b6b9e9e41e0ded05290b6ea1fa3). [Report #185254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185254) · [Control UI chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the loading placeholder flickering or briefly going blank when you reload a direct chat link in the Control UI.
  [#185352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185352) · [8c77ad3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c77ad3c973b3266f8406b630d77f27a60f8332b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a startup race that could leave a Control UI conversation without its history as the Gateway connects.
  [#185370](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185370). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes short Control UI conversation links keeping just the session ID until you reload. When an open conversation gets or changes its name, the address updates without losing your unsent draft or adding a stop to the Back button.
  [#185454](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185454) · [59c7f75](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/59c7f75fc2ff81a56f512f095a432f4eb66445ae). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the chat transcript jumping when the last batch of older messages loads while you’re scrolling by touch in the Control UI.
  [#185505](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185505). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the microphone picker appearing on hover when the microphone button is disabled.
  [#185472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185472). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes browser memory building up in WebKit when you repeatedly open and quickly leave New Session.
  [#185450](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185450). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Claude Code and Codex catalog filters staying visible when their sidebar headers are neither hovered nor focused. The filters remain accessible on touch screens, and the main Filter & sort button stays visible.
  [#185473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185473). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an extra indent on some older session titles beneath **Personal Groups** when **My sessions** is grouped by **Person**.
  [#185536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185536) · [9fde60c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9fde60c57f361da8986a7cbd4ed8bb7fc2aa6523). Thanks to [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Stops the Control UI from looking up the same conversation twice when you reload an already-canonical short chat link, while keeping early history and drafts available.
  [#185661](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185661) · [6f8c9ba](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f8c9bad8bd1a8c339f2d61985e637f9e557550d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents text selection from spilling into neighboring messages when you double-click and drag in a Control UI chat message. A regular drag can still select across messages.
  [#185560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185560) · [4d8806c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d8806c8c2e297af9bc06f5cc73d4b0a3a8f949b) · [Chat selection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) · Thanks [@patrick-erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Keeps **Retry** and **Answer** out of the status updates sent to screen readers for async question cards in Control UI chat. Question text, delivery updates and errors are still available for announcement.
  [#185565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185565) · [c5be644](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5be6441d3a1e4a562cafd9eedd8d0f774e17a64) · [Issue #185716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185716) · Thanks [@pick-cat](https://github.com/Pick-cat) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents saves to the browser’s chat cache from piling up without limit when you switch chats quickly in the Control UI. Ongoing chat updates no longer keep putting off the start of a save. The browser may keep an older saved copy if the pending cache reaches its limit.
  [#185799](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185799) · [`02daed9`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02daed924fb953d9eda971ab8debd8eb79c7d2ba) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Fixes chat colors so your messages use your chosen accent, including while the first message in a new session is pending. Sender names match their bubbles, and other participants and forwarded messages use colors tied to their identity or source conversation. Improves contrast for text and file links in chat, including with custom accents. If your custom theme sets `--chat-user-surface`, your own bubbles now take their color from the selected accent.
  [#185821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185821) · [`82b43a3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82b43a38eeb6d0e2a1444307df146649db3fbd6f) · Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski)
- Stops the Control UI from continuing to load chat history it no longer needs after you switch away from or hide a chat. Returning to the chat resumes loading while keeping your draft and place in the conversation.
  [#185857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185857) · [`491ce01`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/491ce01c486b62c3ec7017bdb7faf81aeb246e4b) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Fixes Control UI reloads dropping and reopening the Gateway connection when cached chats contain links to other sessions. Cached chats still appear while the Control UI connects.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185886">#185886</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes nearby messages jumping as a chat image loads in the Control UI when OpenClaw already knows the image’s dimensions.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185970">#185970</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Stops chat widgets from keeping old copies of the conversation in browser memory after the chat history refreshes.
  [#186007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186007) · [`bb13a9b3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb13a9b34af9bb0e9300cf6f6cbdf77ceb2968bf). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps background-session completion notifications in the corner and their buttons usable when the Control UI command palette opens or closes. Middle-click or Cmd/Ctrl-click **Open session** to open the link in another tab without leaving your draft. If you use multiple Gateways, the new tab may use a different connection.
  [#186040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186040) · [`078b11da`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/078b11daa8b0caf2b8910702728adc76b4e3cf4c) · [#186028](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186028) · [`91e8cd07`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/91e8cd076166a73a794bb7e602207ccbb5bbf32e). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes Reply and Copy overlapping Discard on failed messages in shared chats when you move the pointer away. The sender, delivery status and recovery buttons have their own space.
  [#186035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186035) · [`0cdda616`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0cdda616119b87da2e9985f4e692a1b6097af18f). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes the Control UI holding on to old transcript contents in browser memory after you switch chats, while still restoring your scroll position when you return.
  [#186149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186149) · [Commit e92e637a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e92e637aadfaee0c37262af49ede0d104a558651) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  [#186232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186232) · [Commit ca9ee27e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca9ee27e2ae4f20321e76d36afe4a81dd6950b96) · Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Stops hover tooltips from intercepting Escape after you type in the mobile command palette, so Escape can close the palette.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186316">#186316</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e1f37b9a44f527e451ba7cfa21efd1105d4fd34d">commit e1f37b9</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Keeps an earlier chat answer from being tucked into the next reply’s **Worked** summary when a background command finishes late, including after a reload. Preserves the order of existing messages when command-line history is added.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186323">#186323</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/189e653d99adddd190d8471a2f4ccf6940a555ae">commit 189e653</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186255">issue #186255</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/DonnieFi">@DonnieFi</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (co-author), <a href="https://github.com/samiralibabic">@samiralibabic</a> (report).</span>
- Speeds up reconnecting in a visible Control UI tab served by your Gateway when the network comes back without the browser noticing. Shows **Reconnecting** and queued messages sooner when a stalled connection doesn’t answer a send.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186325">#186325</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/00096a11f22b93a50f898dcd49427a5d5abf64ae">commit 00096a1</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect">Offline and reconnect</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes the Control UI Systems page showing stale cloud worker status until you reload. The active list updates as workers connect, start shutting down, and are removed.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186336">#186336</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b44ebe2f184628300162d6002c0a8d20b77257cc">commit b44ebe2</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/163982">issue #163982</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/genaro23">@genaro23</a> (report).</span>
- Prevents a chat with many hidden agent runs from flooding the Gateway when you open it, reconnect, or use **Mark as read**. Keeps newer **Mark as unread** choices from being cleared while those reads finish.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186342">#186342</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/759f0d9f1b1fa46af8de04c58ed9af10d60c793b">commit 759f0d9</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar">Sessions and sidebar</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Replaces the duplicate attachment choices in iPhone and iPad Safari with one **Add attachment…** row aligned with the rest of the menu. Chat and New Session accept photos and videos, and Side chat accepts images only.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186345">#186345</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb8451d05fec0b117bbaa2eaaf3414daa9f5c851">commit eb8451d</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat">Control UI chat</a>.
