  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186377">#186377</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b1310042b9fd084de7e6533ab58913767edb136">commit 6b13100</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Fixes the gap below standalone Portals previews in tall Control UI windows so the preview fills the available space.
  [#186433](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186433), [issue #186396](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186396). Thanks [@yy19971996](https://github.com/yy19971996), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@NovaeonStudio](https://github.com/NovaeonStudio).
- Fixes [Ask OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/panels#openclaw-system-care) greeting you as your main agent. It also keeps your main agent’s persona out of command planning, without changing the configured model.
  [#186437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186437), [issue #186436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186436). Thanks [@jondihaynes](https://github.com/jondihaynes), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes slow session previews and headlines for long messages with lots of unclosed Markdown emphasis markers.
  [#186493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186493). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the New Session draft and Send button getting clipped when the keyboard opens in a mobile browser. The welcome layout returns to normal when the keyboard closes.
  [#186519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186519). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the loading animation inside its placeholder on chat attachment cards and galleries without cutting off error or approval messages.
  [#186556](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186556). Thanks to steipete.
- Hides keyboard shortcut hints that crowd menus, chat controls and previews on touch-only devices. Hints return when you use a hardware keyboard, and the shortcuts reference still shows the keys.
  [#186558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186558). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes hinted chat links sending signed-in users through the public reader on reload instead of reopening directly in the app.
  [#186561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186561). Thanks to galiniliev.
- Aligns the People panel’s action buttons when session counts differ or are missing. On touch screens, the buttons no longer show a filled background at rest.
  [#186588](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186588). Thanks to steipete.
- Stops reply tracking holding extra copies of large replies after they leave view. Fixes repeated pull-request refreshes when Control UI chat replays the same large reply.
  [#186592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186592). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes Control UI chat labeling a successful workspace PR publication as Interrupted and separating its report from the rest of the agent’s reply.

- Prevents previously loaded quote-and-comment previews shrinking and flashing “Loading…” when you scroll back to them.
  [#186697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186697). Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski.
- Stops wide chat tables shifting or narrowing when the first comment is added or the last removed. Keeps narrow draft-to-conversation layouts aligned and shared-chat names and timestamps readable when the footer wraps.
  [#186734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186734). Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski.
- Aligns avatars, names, session counts and menus in the Online people list on touch devices, and restores the space between avatars and names.
  [#186737](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186737). Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski.
- Prevents agent avatars covering the first column heading when a reply starts with a wide table in desktop chat, including attributed replies.
  [#186742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186742). Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski.
- Keeps wide chat comment previews from covering the comment chip on narrow screens, where they could flicker or reopen as soon as you pressed Escape.
  [PR #187008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187008). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Shift-selection across Pinned and Sections in the Control UI sidebar. The selection follows the visible range in either direction without skipping pinned sessions or including sessions past the clicked row.
  [PR #187060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187060). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Stops owner avatars in the Control UI session filter and its menu from flickering during session refreshes and unrelated updates. Changes to the owner still appear.
  [PR #187072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187072). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Stops the New Session shortcut hint from blocking nearby session-group controls in the Control UI sidebar.
  [PR #187096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187096). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes agent settings buttons losing keyboard focus in the Control UI sidebar when agent details refresh. Pressing Enter still opens the intended settings without switching chats or losing your draft.
  [PR #187106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187106). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the Control UI losing keyboard focus after copying. You can press Enter to copy again without finding the button first, and a copy finishing won’t take focus back if you’ve moved elsewhere.
  [PR #187263](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187263). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes inconsistent highlighting and dimming for hovered, focused, selected and disabled items in Control UI menus, including session sorting and browser card actions.
  [PR #187324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187324). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes arrow keys moving the starting-branch selection while you’re composing text with an input method in the New Session worktree picker.
  [#187732](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187732). Thanks to [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes row buttons intercepting taps meant to open a session in the Control UI’s touch sidebar. Session titles, including child-session titles, keep room beside the buttons.

- Fixes pinned dashboards not updating when an authorized task resumes after a graceful Gateway restart with the Control UI closed. Inline widgets still need a connected client.

- Stops the navigation drawer from opening a tooltip as it moves keyboard focus inside, so Escape can close the drawer.

- Fixes the Sessions and Live activity tabs collapsing to a sliver on the desktop Activity page, where their labels could be clipped and hard to click.

- Stops Control UI chat from saying a queued turn is preparing before preparation has started.
  [#173860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173860). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Control UI reloads showing a browser error during an outage when a cached copy is available. The previous cached app remains available if an update has not finished caching, and the current page stays visible if the connection drops while opening another page. The new page retries when the Gateway is reachable. Live services and uncached pages still need a connection. See [offline and reconnect](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect).
  Slow browser update checks no longer hold terminal reconnects indefinitely, and optional fonts can fail without blocking the page. [PR #174043](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174043) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca009ba036a80172885b60feb7dcc4f0920744e3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Control UI submenus such as **Assign to…** waiting out the hover delay after you click them.

- Renames the unfiltered Workboard heading to “All boards” so it’s clear the page shows cards from every board. Individual boards keep their own names.

- Keeps pending Settings edits available after an agent identity update or brief Gateway disconnect. Unrelated edits can save and same-field conflicts stay in the draft; unsent form changes resume autosaving only when the saved settings still match and no earlier save is unconfirmed. Drafts can still be lost on reload or tab close. See [offline and reconnect](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect).
  Channels no longer appears empty just because the connection dropped. Failed model-default and account-order saves leave edits available, device approval edits detect competing changes on save, and restricted settings clear when access is revoked. [Identity update](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/18a6f1488eff09ac255d78bbeeb8e6234c13f287) · [Settings reconnect #174045](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174045) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67c35e9c115d97143aeb20e52c2cae07b622f33c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes authorized dashboard pins failing to save when a resumed Control UI turn has no client that can show widgets in chat, and restores authorized pinned widget creation and updates in recovered non-scheduled sessions with recorded widget access. Inline previews still need a connected client.
  An inline-only call receives guidance to use `pin=true`. [Resumed turns](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44dfc9bf74279fe040591c174629243ab3c73f5d) · [Recovered sessions](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/860d76601fc29a444443ae11dc8dafa37fbe10ae).
- Fixes memory growth in long-running Control UI tabs when missing avatars repeatedly refresh, and closes failed avatar and workspace-icon requests after choosing a fallback. Initials stay visible while an avatar is unavailable.
  [Avatar refreshes #173870](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173870) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Image requests #152311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/152311) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Shows an error when the terminal picker cannot load the session list, and fixes the Dock button staying disabled when you return to a terminal whose tabs are ready to move. Reopen the picker to retry without losing your active terminal.

- Fixes a blank flash during Control UI reload and stops the startup loading animation continuing in the background on WebKit.
  [Reload indicator #175212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175212) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [WebKit animation release adaptation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9afcc1b7b29a51535771a09747556970f6fbdfbd) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the top bar jumping when you leave Settings on a narrow screen, and the workspace icon pushing the chat title down on mobile.
  [Settings navigation #175241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175241) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [Mobile chat header #175250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175250) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps navigation, plugin tabs and loaded Control UI views and supported drafts, including boards, portals, scheduled tasks and Memory Import choices, available during a brief disconnect when the same client reconnects to the same Gateway and identity. You can still read, filter, copy and draft, while actions that need the connection wait. Retained information may be stale, and drafts may be lost if you reload or close the tab.
  Approvals remain visible but require a connection to act. [Control UI guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui) · [Retained views #174059](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174059) · [Offline navigation #174044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174044) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps keyboard focus on the same agent when pinning or unpinning moves it in the sidebar, and prevents stray console warnings when moving or unpinning items or using session grouping, catalog filter and agent-roster menus.

- Fixes Raw Config’s **Open** action sometimes doing nothing after the configuration page’s active handler changes, and fixes missing agent avatars in the Settings selector when identities have not loaded.

- Keeps an internal Control UI continuation from returning to an earlier external chat after a plugin reload when the current request has no external recipient.

- Fixes board widget publication with PostgreSQL storage.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).

  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b35eca0e734a8b4575cc7b5a244c2ceead6dae1).

##### Conversation and session controls

- Fixes forced replies in external chats when an agent chooses silence and removes a standalone trailing `NO_REPLY` line from an otherwise useful answer or displayed history. When an owed answer is still missing after recovery, users see a system notice.
  Quoted or punctuated mentions of the marker stay visible, and unbuffered previews can briefly show the trailing line. A retry for an undelivered message can end silently when no reply is needed. [Silent replies #170534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170534) · [commit bd5f760](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bd5f760aecae47a8e26c10625005909091eac4ec) · [missing replies #170972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170972) · [commit 22799f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22799f805a84afa7623e50ff772c072462cb4644) · [trailing marker #171990](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171990). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@richardmqq](https://github.com/richardmqq), [@Irish-Joseph](https://github.com/Irish-Joseph) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@cipp-ashe](https://github.com/cipp-ashe) and [@eonicman](https://github.com/eonicman) for reports.
- Fixes nested sessions ignoring the selected sidebar sort order and expands the parent to show newly added persistent child sessions, with a child count and collapse control.
  [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar) · [Child sorting #172189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172189) · [Child reveal #172362](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172362) · [commit 12ec309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12ec309f9b0ba17ddc227451d896f70c956d2f48). Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes delays while streaming long replies containing internal model markers or lots of HTML or JSX. OpenClaw removes markers from ordinary text while keeping them in code examples, and the HTML or JSX reply text stays unchanged.
  [Model markers #175448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175448) · [commit cc16d8d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc16d8d655332a71b13bd505c0b738de87ecd6bd) · [issue #175444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175444) · [HTML and JSX #175472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175472) · [commit 2ad3797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2ad3797ef1cf95c0ebe68a6284a5cc91095f8c91) · [issue #175439](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175439). Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the merge contribution.
- Fixes session catalog copies and imports hanging on faulty pagination, retaining the history already read and warning when the copy is incomplete.
  [Session catalog guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs) [#117233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117233) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents large compaction reserves from authorizing unnecessarily large safeguard summaries.
  Caps the safeguard summary reserve at 20,000 tokens, subject to lower model limits. [#119447](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/119447) · Thanks to [@MoerAI](https://github.com/MoerAI) for the fix and [@joeykrug](https://github.com/joeykrug) for the report.
- Fixes leading `!` commands being sent to the model. They now reach the existing authorized bash handler, and ordinary messages and Markdown images stay in chat.
  [Chat command syntax](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/slash-commands) [#133459](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133459) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes reply runs reporting both completion and failure when finalization fails.
  [#136851](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/136851) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes omitted tool activity crowding useful conversation history out of tool-heavy Codex sessions.
  [#145604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145604) · Thanks to [@zyz619963502zyz](https://github.com/zyz619963502zyz) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the fix and [@ikenraf](https://github.com/ikenraf) for the report.
- Fixes delegated and recovered work using the wrong requester permissions. Collaborative steering defaults to enabled, so admitted participants can steer an active turn under its original requester’s permissions, including permissions they may not have themselves. Set `messages.queue.allowCollaborativeSteering` to `false` to put another participant’s message in a separate turn under their own permissions. With steering disabled, set `messages.queue.collaborativeSteeringFallback` to `reject` to require `/followup <message>`. Resubmit older pending sends if their requester details cannot be recovered.
  Supported session tools can select an admitted participant. Channel plugin authors should migrate configuration-derived tool policies to the documented policy resolvers. [Queue settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/queue.md) · [Session tools](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session-tool.md) · [Audit receipts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/audit.md) · [Channel plugin migration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-migration/compatibility-policy.md). [#157806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157806) · [Quiet steering fallback #185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477) · [Steering defaults and fallback retained #186381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186381). Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the steering fallback changes.
- Fixes Codex user messages missing prompt annotations or transcript mirrors when an admission hook changes their content.
  [#146257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/146257). Thanks [@harjothkhara](https://github.com/harjothkhara), [@pfrederiksen](https://github.com/pfrederiksen) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Reduces Codex session catalog failures caused by oversized thread previews and keeps a slow local host from delaying healthy hosts. A very large individual thread may appear with degraded details or still fail to load.
  Codex retries oversized pages with fewer threads and gives each local host an eight-second budget. [Codex session catalog](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/codex-harness.md). [#157106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/157106). Thanks [@gokay-ai](https://github.com/gokay-ai) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a premature unconfirmed-reply warning when a new message arrives while the previous reply is still being sent.
  [#154417](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154417). Thanks [@hanamizuki](https://github.com/hanamizuki), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@wespinosafv](https://github.com/wespinosafv).
- Fixes delegated sessions failing to compact after a fire-and-forget message has received its reply.
  <span>Thanks [@ethanhawkes-gif](https://github.com/ethanhawkes-gif), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@Angelojiang11](https://github.com/Angelojiang11). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159353">#159353</a></span>
- Fixes completed asynchronous tool results disappearing from the next model request after local compaction. A complete exchange can be summarized when there’s too little room to keep it in full.
  <span>Thanks [@shenrui-ma](https://github.com/Shenrui-Ma), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163689">#163689</a></span>
- Fixes an embedded agent repeating a compaction continuation on a later retry.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164796">#164796</a></span>
- Restores saved history for a fresh bundled Claude CLI session on the Gateway host using a native login without a forwarded credential, when you opt in to account verification. The opt-in sends the native access token to Anthropic to verify the account and is off by default; history is replayed only when ownership can be verified. Existing conversations are not automatically backfilled from their latest native binding.
  [CLI history account boundaries](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md#history-account-boundaries) · [#164796](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164796). Thanks Mitchell Etzel and xydigitLybnnnn.
- Fixes Codex-backed questions failing in Default mode when OpenClaw Ask User is available. Explicit native-question opt-ins retain priority.
  <span>Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@bek91](https://github.com/bek91). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159678">#159678</a></span>
- Fixes number shortcuts in expanded Control UI optional questions inserting digits into the chat draft. The shortcuts select an answer or focus **Other** when the question controls have focus.

- Fixes opted-in session-less CLI backends forgetting earlier conversation on ordinary turns before compaction. The repair applies to history from the same account. [CLI backends guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168244">PR #168244</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/53cfc947f0c6d8c9e2fd8b0a50fb1a5aec89fd17">`53cfc94`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/masatohoshino">@masatohoshino</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes Doctor using internal instructions as titles for native sub-agents during title repair.

Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen), and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for this PR.
- Fixes `chat.inject` notes being refused after a shared cron session has been cached. [WebChat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/web/webchat.md)
  [PR #170137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170137) · [b4b89d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4b89d404ca45b832b1686b3c4fca78be2965ec4). Thanks to [@xyrolle](https://github.com/xyrolle) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes changing only a conversation’s icon or color moving it to the top of **Last updated**.
  [PR #170405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170405) · [1c726e6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c726e68f9526d77d45cce27408ee667f0673936). Thanks to [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).
- Fixes recovered answers or attachments being dropped before delivery when the answer has already appeared in the transcript.
  [PR #171121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171121) · [f6f939a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f939a8ebc65fc9bbe6c01b6723677e94a9614f). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for this PR.
- Fixes premature compaction in durable context-engine conversations and reserves room for the current request when a Codex context limit is configured.
  [#171495](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171495) · Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@nianjiuzst](https://github.com/NianJiuZst), and [@aounakram](https://github.com/aounakram).
- Fixes selected history and restored attachments being cut off before they reach the native Codex harness in explicitly budgeted context-engine conversations. It also avoids adding the same selected history again on later turns. Codex controls compaction after delivery.
  [#171707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171707) · Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@aounakram](https://github.com/aounakram), and [@nianjiuzst](https://github.com/NianJiuZst).
- Fixes false session-discovery warnings while Claude Code or Codex conversations are still loading, and keeps loaded conversations visible through temporary discovery failures. It also keeps previously discovered paired nodes when node inventory temporarily fails.
  [#171870](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171870) · Thanks [@TheAngryPit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit) and [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes affected Codex conversations compacting too early and replacing threads with shortened history when the context engine lacked capacity Codex had already reported.
  [#172010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172010) · Thanks to [@marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents automatic sharing of private session links in generated GitHub pull requests and agent Runtime guidance. Explicitly public sessions can still supply their links.
  [#172194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172194) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Adds a best-effort notice in the original conversation if OpenClaw cannot confirm that it archived the session after the turn. Check the session’s archive state before retrying.
  [#172262](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172262) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new conversations leaving the previous session selected while the new one is being named. A placeholder shows until the title is ready, and the draft returns if creation fails.
  [#172863](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172863). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixed prepared chat sends being rejected when unrelated plugin settings reload, while still rechecking changes that affect permission to send.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172888) · [Plugin hot reload](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/configuration/hot-reload.md)
- Explained when compaction cannot make a request fit in the model context. The message shows estimates and suggests using `/context detail`, reducing context or choosing a model with a larger context window.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@ccbridle](https://github.com/ccbridle) for the report and [@xydigit-zt](https://github.com/xydigit-zt) for the earlier work. [#172912](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172912)
- Fixed unnecessary mid-turn compaction when a continuation still fits after a change to the system prompt or tool definitions, with mid-turn prechecks enabled.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#172927](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172927)
- Fixed cancellation blocking final session status, applicable failure notices and same-account CLI history when a run is stopped or interrupted by a restart.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172978](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172978) · [Agent loop](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/agent-loop.md)
- Fixed the local terminal UI starting another run if you quit while a follow-up is still being queued.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173009)
- Fixes session activity times moving forward during turn bookkeeping.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173054">#173054</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes session and sidebar activity indicators stopping while the final reply is still being delivered.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173063">#173063</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming">Streaming indicators</a> · Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson).</span>
- Fixes remote text attachments reaching the model with garbled characters when their HTTP response declares an encoding.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173212">#173212</a> · Thanks [@ly85206559](https://github.com/ly85206559) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).</span>
- Gives slow local conversation context reads up to three minutes and prevents these timeouts from triggering a model fallback. If a read still times out, the error identifies local preparation and suggests retrying and checking Gateway logs.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173369">#173369</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/155627">Issue #155627</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@EndeavorPioneer](https://github.com/EndeavorPioneer) (report).
- Fixes chat sends failing during a Gateway restart when the Gateway confirms they never started. Control UI, Android and Apple clients can retry the original message after reconnect. On Apple clients, a live send with attachments returns to the composer for manual retry. An explicit Stop ends the attempt.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173389">#173389</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbc9fad085673a9476a03708ed547e56e8a9dafc">Commit fbc9fad08</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery">Restart recovery guide</a>. Already queued Apple attachments use outbox recovery. Automatic retry requires a confirmed unstarted send. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Escape from clearing Sessions search while another registered overlay, modal, or menu is open. Escape can still clear the search from its own filter popover.
  [#173520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173520) · [d934cae](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d934caebcd0544c261ab50bbbfea4bd06807adc6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automatic session titles remaining **New session** when the first task uses a registered skill command or follows a control-only message.
  [#173664](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173664) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes missing start and finish signals for Incognito turns, even when the reply came through. Also fixes queued requests for thread details failing when a turn ends but the thread is still open. Codex still logs submitted messages to disk, so use an OpenClaw-runtime agent to avoid that Codex log.
  [#173717](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173717) · [Incognito sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session#incognito-sessions) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session resets returning an error when another operation replaces the session late in cleanup. OpenClaw leaves the replacement alone and returns it.
  [#173731](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173731) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes valid transcript writes being rejected for sessions that share another agent’s database.
  [#173747](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173747) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat showing “No answer was returned” and asking you to retry a reply you already received when a follow-up between agents returns no result. The false notice also stays out of chat after a reload.
  [#173929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173929) · [Landed commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3da8398eee102282b4be98f7787cbf975e1d4aa) · Thanks steipete.
- Removes blank assistant replies after tool-only turns while keeping tool activity and other visible results in chat. Shows the agent’s acknowledgment when a session pauses to wait for a message, or a “Waiting for a message” notice if the agent did not leave one. The notice clears when the session resumes, while the acknowledgment stays in the conversation.
  [#173938](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173938) · [Persistent acknowledgment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0ab9fc06cc61f944e6201a7b5f53fc47945772e5) · [Control UI chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Codex sessions staying busy after the agent has already sent its reply through the message tool. Prevents an extra empty completion after a directly delivered chat reply, while queued replies still signal when they finish.
  [#173945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173945) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes follow-ups in managed project sessions that stayed unsent when you attached a file or included a comment on a saved selection.
  [#173956](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173956) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173917) · [Workspace access guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) · Thanks shakkernerd.
- Restores **Mark as unread** for guests with session-write access on conversations they own. Those guests can also mark their conversations as read explicitly or by reopening them.
  [#173941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173941) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173925) · Thanks shakkernerd.
- Fixes the conversation sidebar showing an empty **Archived** list after you switch from **All**, even when archived conversations match the filter.
  [#173985](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173985) · Thanks steipete.
- Prevents conversation compaction from treating unreadable history as empty. If OpenClaw can’t inspect the history, it leaves it alone.
  [#173970](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173970) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes the session move dialog failing to reopen after a load error.
  [#174669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174669) · [`6585a68`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6585a68dcdf962625ee52cb9db571680619d4df2). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat sends and other session reads failing when many sessions are in use at once.
  [#175046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175046) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a failed live transcript update from causing an unhandled error after an agent message has been saved. OpenClaw keeps the message and logs a warning. If the transcript looks out of date, reload the session. [Messages](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/messages)
  [#174947](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174947), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4513e9e09633a740f58b4ccf8802597968868c47) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Winoren](https://github.com/Winoren).
- Fixes a cancelled SQLite session history read failing on a damaged message further down the transcript before it can stop.
  [#174890](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174890) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes code blocks losing their formatting when a streamed reply has to send an unfinished block in separate pieces.
  [#174964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174964) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes restart recovery showing an unknown database error instead of reporting that an interrupted reply can’t continue.
  [#175461](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175461). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents hidden assistant text from appearing in a chat reply when OpenClaw recovers a reply that was cut short.
  [#175551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175551) · [cd719ef](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd719ef1c8f329660807d96bf310a03113e1cce2). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes replies being lost when ChatGPT times out while shortening a conversation’s history. OpenClaw can recover and finish the reply. If the run times out with compaction still unfinished, it keeps any partial reply and reports the timeout.
  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176096">#176096</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0215d896f6d46743d6b4f0e978653a2cc0538bd0">Commit 0215d89</a>
- Fixes public conversation links leaving out saved inline widgets or showing their markup as text. With Canvas hosting enabled, signed-out readers can interact with eligible widgets. Unchanged widgets stay in place during live updates while their URLs remain valid, and an invalid widget reference no longer blocks the conversation from opening. Supported external embeds such as YouTube appear as plain links without loading an external player, page or thumbnail. Review your existing public links, since previously omitted widgets may now be visible. [Public conversation links](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls#public-session-transcripts)
  [Public widgets #178648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178648) · [commit d6e3a30](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d6e3a30c0bfce8a479fb6a38dda6f7b65f4ac54c) · [External embed links #179622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179622) · [commit 6ada8b0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ada8b0211b848fa10a8c13a3dfc4b421c42a360) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents automatic session maintenance from archiving a conversation or removing its stored history while any profile keeps it pinned in the sidebar or rail or saved in a personal group. The protection starts when the pin or group entry is saved to the server.
  Thanks to vyctorbrzezowski. [#180610](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180610) · [c4d5fdd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4d5fddda1388a347ca4d575a52b629857fe990c)
- Fixes busy chat sessions falling behind when saved-message notifications pile up. Clients can catch up by refreshing the conversation, and saved messages stay in the transcript. Custom Gateway clients should refetch `chat.history` on a message-phase `sessions.changed` event with neither `messageId` nor `messageSeq`. [Gateway events guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-bootstrap-and-events)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176410), [53bcf50](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/53bcf5095e74fd2e8323b16a507e4ca3d4a2c6b2).
- Fixes first messages in new conversations getting stuck without an error when storage fails, and replaces the generic error after an unconfirmed save with guidance. If the disk is full, free space on the computer running OpenClaw. If there is no known storage cause, wait for current work to finish, reopen the conversation and restart OpenClaw if the problem persists. [Storage error troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/troubleshooting/agent-replies-and-control-ui#agent-run-failed-with-a-storage-error)
  [First-message storage #176998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176998) · [Session control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control) · [Unconfirmed-save guidance #177248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177248) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes generated images and delayed spoken replies appearing in live chat but going missing from conversation history after a reload.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176426), [dbe55cc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbe55ccb20e78b585fa791355a3215bd27273628).
- Clears recovered queued messages from the recovery list as soon as chat confirms delivery.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176375), [5e27311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e273118b7a1cfa2a3fe2edd2f6ebdb8f7d883ab).
- Keeps a failed attempt to continue after provider review visible when the conversation refreshes, so you can retry.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176375), [5e27311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e273118b7a1cfa2a3fe2edd2f6ebdb8f7d883ab).
- Fixes streamed `/btw` answers losing later parts after one part fails to send on direct-provider runtimes. OpenClaw keeps trying to send the rest and can send the complete answer at the end, which may repeat parts you already received. [`/btw` guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/btw)
  Thanks [@xyi74976-del](https://github.com/xyi74976-del) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176310](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176310), [436a131](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/436a13161083acc34ae06904a68422c955258205), [Issue #176270](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176270).
- Restores Retry for Side chat questions that time out. Earlier answers stay in place, late answers from the timed-out attempt are discarded, and you can try the question again once that attempt has finished winding down.
  [#181088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181088) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f5c001cc04043d919b17681b406abf09c543a98)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps pending Codex and Copilot questions open when someone sends guidance but lacks permission to answer, including guidance with an image. Human steering messages also stay in native Codex conversation history in this situation.
  [Codex history #176245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176245) · [commit 2c2c2f3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c2c2f30e4e475ed71dd02b25bbaa5e811305244) · [Question permissions #177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698) · [commit f83b7ade](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f83b7ade15f3aefad7b367bef084ea5ffdbd9f8b) · Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes session-scoped operators being unable to steer permitted running sessions they created, including their own delegated sessions. [Session tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session-tool)
  [#177565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177565) · [commit 0db4b4b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0db4b4b8d89f6103b64425710882c213d2220b31) · [Reported in #177539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177539) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes steering messages being delayed while a reply recovers from a full context window or dropped if the run ends before accepting them. A permitted correction uses that reply’s tools, model and permissions, and can become a follow-up if the reply ends. Missing confirmation alone will not send it twice. It also restores the explanation when native `/steer` is refused because collaborative steering is off, and the final answer to a native `/followup` in an idle conversation. [Queue and steering](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering)
  [Context recovery #177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698) · [commit f83b7ade](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f83b7ade15f3aefad7b367bef084ea5ffdbd9f8b) · [Native replies #178035](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178035) · [commit aeba2046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aeba20460e366763d18d824edc0abc1f3baa62a6) · Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes missing or interrupted progress feedback when OpenClaw has to shorten a conversation to recover. Slow progress notifications can finish separately while recovery continues.
  [#177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698) · [f83b7ade](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f83b7ade15f3aefad7b367bef084ea5ffdbd9f8b). Thanks to [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Keeps accepted channel messages and queued follow-ups as interrupted pending inputs when required transcript compaction fails. Completed private inputs also retain their link to the original request after a restart.
  [#177939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177939) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes restart recovery counting a resend as failed when a new message interrupts it before it runs. The interrupted resend is marked canceled, so it isn’t sent to the model or retried at the next startup.
  [#177803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177803) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes non-private subagent follow-ups timing out before the first model request after a Gateway restart, even after OpenClaw had picked up the follow-up. Private follow-ups still have a time limit on waiting for a result.
  [#177990](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177990) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completed WebChat turns being marked as interrupted after a Gateway restart when their message-tool text or confirmed managed media was already in the conversation. Undelivered additions still qualify for recovery. [Restart recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/restart-recovery.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178053">#178053</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/469f0e2288c834d534eaa6cddb7011ac68a794d1">469f0e22</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the rename button and message reactions available while the same Control UI chat reconnects. Changes to a session’s name, icon or color, moves to an existing category, and reactions are queued and sent after reconnecting to the same Gateway and account with unchanged credentials. Keep the tab open until they are sent, because closing or reloading it loses unsent changes.
  [Reconnect queue #177558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177558) · [Chat controls #178176](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178176) · [commit 7a0c15b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7a0c15b15693f1238f47473f6be1827df4b4ee6b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the New Session environment picker showing no results while cloud choices are loading, and stale CLI agent choices appearing after switching away from an agent and back before its choices finish loading.
  [Environment loading #179469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179469) · [commit e330a5a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e330a5a1eb985373c319ba58363d11799df0b240) · [CLI choices #179551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179551) · [commit 527107f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/527107f896892ce7878950e017c4fb02f4639b4a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes **Sessions** controls that could act on an earlier version of the list when you clear a selection or filters, delete selected sessions or all archived sessions, or load more.
  <span>[#179078](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179078) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)</span>
- Adds a **Working** indicator for pending Sessions actions and keeps failed renames and group edits available to retry. Failed moves keep their rows, new groups are saved before a dropped session moves into them, and **Undo** appears only for sessions actually archived. OpenClaw shows why commands fail, reports a list refresh failure even when deletion succeeded, and avoids showing results from a page or connection you have left.
  [Action feedback #179523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179523) · [commit 1b73195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b73195ece94418683c19f6faa6c3884d607b0cf) · [Command feedback #180326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180326) · [commit 641dbb3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/641dbb383a738695c3a7a3c337b87357e7efe866) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the sharing picker calling people Visitors even when they already have permission to participate. For Read-only and Suggest sessions, it shows who can read, suggest or send and lets you change permissions where sharing allows it.
  Gateway clients can also read projected permissions in the optional `permissions` field on `session.members.listEvidence`. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#180136](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180136) · [commit e3da7af](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e3da7af76e91ce48242f0596966b39e8f613485e)
- Fixes Chat sharing showing an empty member list while it’s still loading. Refreshing keeps the members already shown and preserves your search in the compact menu. An unfinished sharing action no longer leaves the controls busy when the same session is loaded again.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180316">PR #180316</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/88baa37e9cc6d092cf98186f40793485517fab33">Commit 88baa37</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents unrelated settings changes late in a Session Share request from clearing the host list or forcing you to retry a transcript page. Participant labels can be out of date until refreshed.
  [#177294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177294). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `/context map` showing files with the same name as identical tiles. The labels distinguish, for example, the workspace’s `AGENTS.md` from the project’s `AGENTS.md`.
  Thanks [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176165">#176165</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/49b6c3aa26236018b2612b082f05340de33c9970">Commit 49b6c3a</a>
- Preserves what you typed and keeps Rename tied to the same conversation when you reconnect with the mobile dialog already open.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176363), [d84e193](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d84e193fcc3b99e8d6fef3c34d01b559cc97ebf1).
- Fixes a Windows error that could block session history and archive operations, including voice session history. The same fix covers PostgreSQL database discovery for backups, PostgreSQL checks during updates, and database inspection in Doctor.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176430), [23537be](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/23537be086cc29dcded1ccda13067f79c3e724c2).
- Shows why compaction failed after a model provider rejected a prompt as too large. The error suggests retrying or running `/compact`.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176711](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176711) · [commit f036b81](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f036b814a14dfb1b25f435b5c4da1df136bbb46b) · [Compaction guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction)
- Fixes session searches that could fail after a model catalog refresh if they included a previously viewed archived native session. The fix restores results for active conversations too, and lets you find the archived session under its current model.
  Thanks to co-author [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#176752](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176752) · [commit 9d013ba](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9d013baeb67c283c51bdcc3928b4330c7ccf5d97)
- Fixes keyboard focus slipping off the button that restores pasted text to the chat composer when another attachment finishes loading.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176767) · [commit f109c26](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f109c26c618e1b81a7c81eb336edde02f86d4dec)
- Fixes delayed transcript entries being saved with the visibility or attribution of a later run.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176804) · [commit 1929324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1929324867c352347772d4a4ecda110c24d891af)
- Clears leftover reply data when a queued chat message is stopped or dropped. A separate recovery reply can still arrive.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176913">#176913</a> · Thanks to [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).</span>
- Fixes a stall that could leave session branch lists waiting when several were opened at once after a period of inactivity.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176977">#176977</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes missing update times in the terminal session picker and in interactive `openclaw resume` when a session’s last-message preview is blank.
  [#177146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177146), [1e1c03a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1e1c03ad7222404586af133ee8390f0af41c5add). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise).
- Fixes a false “No answer was returned” retry notice that could follow a successful reply in live chat or show up after reloading the conversation.
  [#177206](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177206), [issue #177171](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177171). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes connected clients showing an idle session as busy after a Gateway-started run finishes, such as a run triggered by a heartbeat or a background command completing.
  [#177241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177241), [issue #177065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177065). Thanks [@ayaangazali](https://github.com/ayaangazali), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@eliavb43](https://github.com/eliavb43).
- Prevents false leave and rejoin updates when the Control UI replaces a chat pane for the same session. [Presence](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/presence)
  [#177254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177254). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents interrupted setup from saving a new session’s starting model without its thinking level. Reduces the database requests needed to save both settings in spawned and scheduled sessions.
  [#177256](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177256). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a late cancellation for a replaced chat send from stopping the newer send.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177411">#177411</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/853959ea26ffc49c6a01d36d655775ed64bb9ea7">Commit 853959e</a>
- Stops CLI turns that deliver progress only through the message tool from adding an extra combined copy of those messages to session history. The delivered messages and usage totals are preserved.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/akshitkhokhani">@akshitkhokhani</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Oldrich333">@Oldrich333</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177417">#177417</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4adf0ec56f88051aeeec8f35238895ad8b7b0fc1">Commit 4adf0ec</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177093">Issue #177093</a>
- Fixes replies in fresh threads failing to start if OpenClaw can’t report that it left older messages out of the carried-over history.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/chessing234">@chessing234</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177453">#177453</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7dfd9fbace772e559fc903e282c4cd9aeedf2d8c">Commit 7dfd9fb</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177416">Issue #177416</a>
- Adds a Gateway warning for progress updates that previously failed silently after the session catalog loaded. Refresh the catalog to request the latest entries.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177462">#177462</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79225e681f9d55481a02259236e1f9b5db8fc307">Commit 79225e6</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs">Session catalogs</a>
- Fixes session cleanup reporting a failure when an agent is deleted or the session registry changes during a sweep. Cleanup retries with fresh state, and the logs show when it will retry and when it last completed a sweep.
  [#177935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177935) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes session status showing an older model instead of the one you chose when the older model had no provider recorded.
  [#178006](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178006) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new human @mentions missing from the recipient’s Inbox even though the message was sent. The recipient needs access to the conversation.
  [#178297](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178297) · [commit 3e517e9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3e517e9eb12d6c5697a2974ae7ac38da092cb3ca) · [issue #178264](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178264). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes automatic cleanup of large expired-session backlogs holding up other session writes. Those writes can proceed between cleanup batches, while manually requested cleanup still checks the full backlog. [Session maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance)
  [#178845](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178845). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes sessions getting stuck when the SQLite worker handling a change stops before the command is admitted for writing. OpenClaw reports the interrupted command as failed, and later commands can go through.
  [#178921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178921). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a case where loading even a short slice of conversation history could spike CPU and memory use after many old checkpoints build up.
  [#178936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178936). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows the saved provider error when you reopen a cloud session that failed before your first prompt could be sent. Your unsent prompt and follow-up draft stay available.
  <span>[#179065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179065) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jbax1899](https://github.com/jbax1899) · [Original repair #168609](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168609)</span>
- Fixes the history note sent to Claude CLI after `/new` or `/reset` so it doesn’t count messages the reset didn’t carry forward.
  <span>[#178977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178977) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc)</span>
- Prevents Codex from switching your conversation to a new thread when it can’t resume the original to acknowledge a review. If the conversation still points to the original thread, the pending review can be retried there after you restore compatible tools and settings.
  <span>[#179054](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179054) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@richardchen723](https://github.com/richardchen723) · [Codex harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness)</span>
- Reduces memory use when loading large SQLite-backed session transcripts. On Node.js, transcript workers also free cached copies of session history and memory exports under heap pressure. The saved data stays available.
  [#179119](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179119), [`97a111c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97a111c6da0a2f94e2192f5e89787c35a4f40a8a). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes retained-history statistics failing during compaction for imported conversations with conflicting entry types.
  [#179179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179179), [`c13eaee`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c13eaeedc6c1c34c65a10d03f009d62325cdfa1c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Doctor from naming an unnamed main session after an internal heartbeat wake, so the Control UI keeps showing **Main Session**. Automatic dashboard and worktree titles also skip internal wake messages. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  [#179219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179219), [`fc3a42a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc3a42a7eb87a906597187f18db62201020d275b). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes photos dropping out of the agent’s context on later turns in sandboxed chats. If the photo is still in the active sandbox, you don’t need to send it again. [Sandbox workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179301">#179301</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179258">Reported in #179258</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/aspalagin">@aspalagin</a>.
- Fixes idle resets cutting short conversations where you’ve just spoken to your agent in browser Talk, including when you steer a reply by voice. Fixes chat rejecting the typed message that triggers an idle reset so it can continue in the next conversation. [Session resets](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179350">#179350</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179295">Reported in #179295</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/khensthoth">@khensthoth</a>.
- Fixes session lists and refreshes failing for sessions that use affected provider-hosted workspaces.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179421">#179421</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/60a97e3012eddf23ddc31a9442a5cb6470d916fa">Released commit</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Fixes queued follow-up messages being marked as failed even when they finished successfully after the reply ahead of them.
  [#179620](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179620) · [d38a8d3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d38a8d317126802d3cccaa5eab80a700c6e68234) · [Message queue guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes replies and later messages getting held up when a run closes during setup before it can take a queued follow-up, including when a policy blocks the run.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179707">#179707</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179492">#179492</a> · Thanks [@bajiaoshan](https://github.com/bajiaoshan), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@clemenshelm](https://github.com/clemenshelm).</span>
- Fixes blank completions when a request needs a reply and the agent sends only a hidden heartbeat acknowledgment. OpenClaw shows a missing-answer notice. The notice can warn that tools may already have run.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179719">#179719</a> · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes conversation resets failing because an already finished subagent’s old session is unavailable, including for nested subagents. Reset still cleans up unfinished work. [Resetting a conversation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/nesting#reset-a-conversation)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179731">#179731</a> · Thanks [@hidaba](https://github.com/hidaba) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Chat reopening with the default agent instead of your saved agent when that agent is still configured. The fix also keeps you in the workspace session you reopened.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180336">PR #180336</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2fccc2d677c7b354689fced0d4bae706350562b">Commit f2fccc2</a>. Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Prevents a delayed draft restore from updating the composer after you leave it, while still letting the saved draft restore when you return.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180623) · [f4db733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4db73310f136bce48f2e21e1ee7a708e40ebbb1)
- Fixes stale agent names in Sessions after a failed refresh during reconnect. A later update to the session list can refresh the names instead of leaving them stuck.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180698) · [bc4e4d5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bc4e4d533ec9b911bf4c0dede439c1058fa593a3)
- Keeps your folder and worktree choices when saving session group defaults fails, and clears the old error when you retry.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180712) · [33baeed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33baeed599ee2922d6fafeaa209c322e1fa621c3)
- Fixes compaction timing out while reading old history in long-lived sessions. Manual and automatic compaction skip history outside the current conversation context, keep the previous summary when it’s part of that context, and leave the stored transcript intact. [Compaction guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction)
  [#180836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180836) · [commit c902f9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c902f9aa2f647863825e1337cb6eed671256d40a) · [#180514](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180514) · Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@TourAround](https://github.com/TourAround).
- Fixes Tab skipping parts of the date and time when you set a custom session snooze. You can edit the date and time with the keyboard and move to Cancel or Snooze without focus leaving the picker.
  [#180839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180839) · [commit 0388308](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0388308f2984eedce13b95ac624a1cd40dcc87b0) · Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes imported Claude CLI chat history showing known interruption notices as messages you sent. Those notices also stop taking up space on history pages.
  [#180893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180893). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes the Control UI blocking guests and other users without shared-group write access from dragging eligible sessions onto their personal navigation rail.
  [#181038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181038) · [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar). Thanks [@TheAngryPit](https://github.com/TheAngryPit), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Caps the SQLite session archive backlog and asks you to wait and retry if it fills. OpenClaw attempts to stop stalled archiving and transcript maintenance after three minutes. If the work still cannot stop, a verified native service can restart the Gateway and interrupt running work. When automatic recovery is unavailable, OpenClaw gives [recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance).
  [#181098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181098) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f1f7cf3a86c4f2ea5f80d48e074a46e8c7abc7f)). Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@patelmm79](https://github.com/patelmm79).
- Fixes missing follow-up context when a confirmed message reaches another chat but does not appear in the history its agent reads. The fix covers eligible message-tool and plugin sends, scheduled results and failure alerts, routed replies, subagent completions, and Skill Workshop notices without adding a second copy to the sending conversation. Plugin authors should remove `mirror` from durable sends and use `session.policyKey` for proactive destinations without a producing turn. [Durable-send migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration#durable-send-destination-history)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182329">#182329</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168683">#168683</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168684">#168684</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169438">earlier work #169438</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fe7f1e2a43c33005e7015ec559e1d006df0b8e5">3fe7f1e2a43c</a>. Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) (author) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) (released co-author).
- Fixes accepted chat messages disappearing when the conversation is marked read just as the agent is about to start.
  [#185248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185248) · [6f212fb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f212fb009904efe6e9686f4bb433a39048b3b82). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session resets failing while a delivered reply is being saved, and prevents unsent queued follow-ups from arriving after a reset. The delivered reply stays in the old conversation, and an unsent reply can still be retried if you leave the session in place. [Queue guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue).
  **Saving delivered replies** — [#181105](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181105) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ac1e62c3603b209c6c9281c8809b5138eb20f27)). Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal), [@sallyom](https://github.com/sallyom).<br />
  **Queued follow-ups** — <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181878">#181878</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ecb44b0f3f81897c23d09182562d7df6e61edcc">3ecb44b0</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181877">#181877</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/HermanZeng">@HermanZeng</a> and <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes chat messages getting stuck on send while an earlier message waits to steer the current reply. Chat confirms the new message once it’s saved, without waiting for the earlier message to go through. Delivery stays ordered and later failures are reported separately. [How queued steering works](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering).
  Thanks to steipete. [#181953](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181953) · [9434e42d6121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9434e42d61217cf263ee2d6d5e173fa55da4a38f)
- Fixes your guidance getting queued as a separate turn after you reconnect to the same conversation and thread. Your follow-up can reach the reply already in progress with the turn’s original permissions.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186378">#186378</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e680619f3cbd9d3d8e63ddbb53e05ee28f59684c">commit e680619</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering">Queue steering</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/joshavant">@joshavant</a> (co-author), <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> (co-author).</span>
- Fixes accepted corrections getting missed while an agent recovers from a full context window or an embedded agent prepares a reply.
  **Context recovery** — [#185381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185381). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).<br />
  **Corrections during reply preparation** — [#185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477) · [25da76e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25da76e481744d924f79d2c61e2aa8a038850016). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes accepted [`/followup`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue#one-message-followup) messages missing from the Control UI queue. It also keeps queue confirmations from appearing as assistant replies, even when earlier chat activity is replayed. Clients without a queue display still get a text confirmation.
  [#186431](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186431). Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes queued follow-ups and grouped messages sending too early or waiting too long when the system clock changes. [How queued messages are timed](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue).
  Thanks to SunnyShu0925 and steipete. [#182037](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182037) · [32fa320f4300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32fa320f4300d72722e8600ead5baae7f7768eca)
- Fixes session diagnostics showing queued messages as processing before they start or leaving the old session marked as processing after work moves. When a session is stuck in that state with no active run, [eligible queued messages](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue) can start after any cleanup underway.
  [#181184](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181184) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/19395491ca6a79ba5752719906c40151ea6a0b5b)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes typed `/stop` being left unsent while Control UI chat reconnects. When there is a run to stop, the request is sent after reconnecting and targets only that run.
  [#186630](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186630). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes saved chat messages going unanswered when a Skill Workshop notice arrives during request recovery, and keeps recovery instructions available to the agent in later turns or after reopening a conversation when a reply failed to go out. Eligible requests can retry once without duplicating the message.
  **Request recovery** — [#181473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181473) · [Report #179562](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179562) · Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report.<br />
  **Recovery instructions** — [#181615](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181615) · Thanks to [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes earlier conversation context dropping out when OpenClaw recovers an interrupted turn after a restart or during a scheduled run.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185882">#185882</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Keeps timeouts and interruptions distinct when a chat message is still waiting to start, and reserves restart retries for actual Gateway restarts.
  <span><a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery">Gateway restart recovery</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184010">#184010</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and <a href="https://github.com/tre1d">@tre1d</a>.</span>
- Fixes false empty-response errors in Control UI chat when a background command finishes and the agent has nothing new to tell you. Embedded agents also avoid doing extra work to produce a reply in that case.
  <span><a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process">Background commands</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184005">#184005</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Prevents an interruption after a tool-result continuation has started from showing a misleading warning that the earlier result wasn’t delivered.
  [#185203](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185203) · [90e2278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/90e227861c32575c053bb05692886f41f9594703) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes successful chat handoffs appearing as **Interrupted** and losing their confirmation when a plugin adds a note to the handoff. Restores normal capitalization in the wait time shown when a handoff resumes.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186360">#186360</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a919e5ecc4f6c579e16ab21499ccda3acaa1fb07">commit a919e5e</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>.</span>
- Prevents resized images pasted while an agent is working from disappearing from its view after a tool call. This also fixes a false prompt to resend an image OpenClaw still has.
  [#186690](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186690). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes parts of replies going missing when you open a conversation or load older messages, and makes **Show earlier** continue past hidden or already loaded entries. Failed or interrupted loads offer **Retry earlier messages**, disconnected controls show **Waiting for connection**, and catalog sessions keep your place. API clients can page in both directions through recent and offset-based results.
  **Reply history and API paging** — [#186536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186536). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).<br />
  **Loading earlier messages** — [#186544](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186544). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes Control UI exports silently leaving out older messages you haven’t scrolled back to. Both `/export` and `/export-session` download the available conversation as Markdown, or report an error instead of giving you a partial file. [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
  Thanks [@AmelioMansour](https://github.com/AmelioMansour), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#182088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182088) · [`806becee`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/806becee01e436808adca69452ae8ad4bfe79984)
