- Fixes `openclaw sessions export-trajectory` failing on read-only session state. Exporting also leaves saved session data and database file permissions unchanged.
  [PR #187332](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187332). Thanks to yousan, masatohoshino and obviyus.
- Fixes [external Codex transcripts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs#codex-sessions-and-transcripts) showing tool activity as plain labels and JSON. The Control UI shows recorded commands, file changes and outcomes in tool cards when you browse a session or reopen a copy imported with this version. The available details from older nodes depend on what those nodes recorded.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183313">#183313</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9b5c011f9bd40511157160abcf857ea3fe6eb36">d9b5c01</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180947">Original work #180947</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@miguelbranco80](https://github.com/miguelbranco80).</span>
- Fixes Codex session status showing an old context count after manual or automatic compaction. It shows Codex’s new estimate, including zero, or marks context usage unknown until a measurement arrives. The session keeps its cumulative token total.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182434">PR #182434</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1d9da0d5dce9ea92065015cb5de0671d2e68db8b">1d9da0d5</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@cyrusaf](https://github.com/cyrusaf) for the report and [@liuwqgit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) for <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/139285">earlier work on compaction accounting</a>.</span>
- Makes [compaction](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction) errors more useful when a model runs out of room without writing a summary. The error names the model and its actual summary limit, and suggests turning off thinking where supported or choosing a different summary model. The original conversation history is kept.
  [#181200](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181200) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6e4f76bc9f92891851ab0415393a41b2683f1d17)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Claude CLI chat history showing activity out of order and, for newly completed turns that match Claude’s history, repeated narration and final answers. OpenClaw keeps the final answer in its own history, while earlier narration remains in Claude’s history. It also stops background-command notices when Claude runs locally and new automation prompts from appearing as messages you wrote. A fallback provider’s recent conversation keeps Claude’s replies and leaves out those automation prompts. Older duplicates remain, and some older automation prompts can become visible again.
  **Repeated answers** — Thanks [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#184098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184098) · [dce924d16c53](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dce924d16c53a66d086707cd0f9ed02d24bb4739) · [Held-answer follow-up](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cfd37ff97525dd35d816735b6aaf8ae1e5a98de)<br />
  **Background-command notices** — [#184216](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184216) · [505fc9f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/505fc9fe7c8e46db23ce9141d6820d2fee97de41). Thanks [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).<br />
  **Automation prompts and fallback history** — [#185746](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185746) · [`acc6ea2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/acc6ea2f650b3eb83feadb8b7a6c06f3f2623b2e) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix, and [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) for reporting related history issues<br />
  **Activity order** — [PR #187361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187361). Thanks to marvinthebored, Peetiegonzalez and obviyus.
- Fixes CLI-backed sessions losing the original turn or save error when restoring a conversation fork also fails.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#182156](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182156) · [`8e5abec3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8e5abec30544aacefc56c8d2ee0673e9296710e6)
- Stops Gateway logs from saying history was withheld when an existing CLI session resumes. A fresh session still warns if authorization rules prevent carrying over its history.
  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman). [#183624](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183624)
- Fixes slowdowns and excess Gateway CPU use while long replies stream, including replies with code, JSON, markup or attachments. Unfinished attachment markers no longer appear in replies using carriage-return line endings.
  **Markdown lists after code** — [#181511](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181511) · [Related report #181493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181493) · Thanks to [@jasonbuildai](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).<br />
  **Gateway CPU and private runtime filtering** — Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#181692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181692) · [`ba0432c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba0432c05a02f4c93c132cd55a53eb4f913e2234) · [issue #181682](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181682)<br />
  **JSON replies** — Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI). [#182779](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182779) · [#182562](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182562) · [9070fc4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9070fc46d25f86da7da876d87610be2d4ce8f1f7)<br />
  **Empty command output, reply directives and wiki-style markers** — [#184524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184524) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/874dc86b7812605a713462fdc368bcdc72a8d337) · Thanks to [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the repair, and to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for investigating performance. [Performance investigation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184524#issuecomment-6439306679) [#184543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184543) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea9c7a32ce7d61af261332a55af9d5fd6791c743) · Thanks to [@yy19971996](https://github.com/yy19971996), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI).<br />
  **HTML and JSX** — [#185293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185293) · [78325da](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/78325da1f9a843bd40e02f0a04932f11a69a29d6). [Report #185289](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185289) · [Gateway comparison](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185293#issuecomment-6439306075). Thanks [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the repair and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the Gateway comparison.<br />
  **Attachments** — [#186622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186622). Thanks to JasonBuildAI and obviyus.
- Fixes stalls in long streamed replies that contain ordinary Markdown links or inline text labeled “Context”. OpenClaw still strips genuine inbound context metadata from the reply.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182543">PR #182543</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/57d249f7fb214bcc1ed99f2fd91a51d65589998c">57d249f7</a> · Thanks [@xyi74976-del](https://github.com/xyi74976-del) for the fix, [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the filter follow-ups and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) for <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182526">the report</a>.</span>
- Removes stray tool-call fragments that could show up in live replies just before a tool runs and reappear after refreshing the chat. Those fragments no longer garble the text that follows.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182500">PR #182500</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1c0b1c15c65a225adb12a82b0a72ae67da1420a">d1c0b1c1</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@mrciorz](https://github.com/mrciorz) for the report and <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178245">original approach</a>.</span>
- Keeps recognized internal tool-call details out of [posted blocks of streamed replies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming) and preserves literal examples and formatting when a reply arrives in pieces. Ambiguous text can take longer to appear.
  [#184529](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184529) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed6b292be6a7f468b5c61f77a4dd24e55b7b51ff) · Thanks to [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes shared conversation pages, previews and media failing to load when the conversation updates during loading while it remains shared. It also fixes shared images and documents failing to download on the first try while saved history is being prepared. [Shared conversation links](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls).
  **Pages and previews** — Thanks to steipete. [#182007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182007) · [40defea5b904](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40defea5b904fe2aa88b56c4507c61256ef9f217)<br />
  **First downloads** — [#186160](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186160) · [Commit 12bb6168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12bb61686cc759fbfbc4e9005d48689ede39a1c9) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the sidebar showing old shared sessions while access is being rechecked or after that check fails. **Show more** rechecks the whole expanded list, and **Retry** lets you try a failed refresh again without loading another page. [Session Share guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/session-share)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182242">#182242</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Restores targeted Inbox refresh notifications for eligible clients with access to individual sessions and keeps session presence and parent-session details within the reader’s permissions.
  [#184502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184502) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/beb12fafdee64721e2598148b13527f0b9386ad3) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes ongoing workspace work being interrupted when another participant chooses **Hide from Involving me** or **Show in Involving me** in a [shared session](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/multi-user). Authorized participants keep access to their saved workspace files.
  [#186479](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186479), [issue #186472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186472). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes disabled **Hide from Involving me** and **Show in Involving me** actions for eligible signed-in guests who can read the conversation. Hiding or restoring it only changes [your own list](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/multi-user#finding-sessions-by-owner).
  [#185524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185524). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes **Advanced → Fork conversation** being unavailable to guests with [write access to their own conversation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/operator-scopes). An active source is copied through its last completed reply.
  [#186641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186641). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes new visible work staying agent-owned when it comes from a verified requester in an agent-owned or channel-originated session. An existing human owner or an operator selected to take responsibility takes precedence.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182213">#182213</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Fixes personally pinned sessions being automatically repinned when restored from Archived. Undo on the archive notification can restore the captured personal pin when the session is successfully restored.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#181721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181721) · [`5e2f560`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e2f560194b1f588fe821b01df5c71968675e10b) · [issue #181719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181719)
- Fixes personal sidebar pins staying visible after you lose access to a session. The stale pin clears on the current connection, and the saved shortcut can reappear if access returns. Pins outside the current session list also pick up session updates.
  [#185067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185067) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes session archive retention skipping cleanup when cron is off or has no sessions to remove. With age-based retention enforced, eligible reset and deletion archives that are already overdue can now be removed. [Session maintenance and retention](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance).
  Thanks to yuaneen, steipete, indra622, and card4philippe. [#182053](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182053) · [a67706486489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a67706486489054461cf4ee9f8cca32cd5587517)
- Reduces memory left in use after archived-session lists or searches, queued follow-ups and steering messages, and session deletion. Background maintenance also releases data from its first request.
  **Archive reads** — Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182836](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182836)<br />
  **Queued messages** — [#184981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184981) · [67f47a96](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67f47a963ab237ddf9e599b271766c132dcf175e). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).<br />
  **Session cleanup** — [#186060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186060) · [`9f45f035`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9f45f0352ba41416400da50310130f72d22b6cef). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session reads stalling when routine database cleanup overlaps a health check, and session creation or edits failing when two requests open the same agent database at once.
  **Session reads** — <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185877">#185877</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)<br />
  **Session creation and edits** — <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185891">#185891</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes session lists failing while a model provider reloads. The list waits for current results, and if you disconnect, other clients can keep waiting.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186296">#186296</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c8a753a0a4df2dbdba73a1a4b52187800c497950">commit c8a753a</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182783">Original contribution #182783</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/ceckert">@ceckert</a> (original contribution and co-author).</span>
- Fixes active child sessions disappearing from their controller’s session list, and stops conversations appearing busy solely because a child has moved to the top level. Activity stays with the moved conversation and its actual controllers.
  **Conversation activity** — <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183418">#183418</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/10a254dbfe920f51b1ba755fd68f720299aeda38">10a254d</a>. Thanks to [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by @Marvinthebored in <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183389">#183389</a>.</span><br />
  **Child session lists** — <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183440">#183440</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/188709180b44b27995adab7b4ec0923ed2450b3e">1887091</a>. Thanks to [@zongzuoscc](https://github.com/zongzuoscc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Keeps Sessions transcript search open and focused when Escape cancels text composition or is part of a keyboard shortcut. A plain Escape outside text composition closes the search.
  Thanks to AmelioMansour and obviyus. [#181991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181991) · [05bc4bf5c9fc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/05bc4bf5c9fc717841df38d169bb69fa3d88a52a)
- Fixes typing in the open **Assign to** menu triggering other shortcuts or sending text to chat. Start typing in the sidebar or chat header menu to filter people and agents without clicking the search field first. [Session assignment guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
  Thanks to steipete. [#182016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182016) · [c07c61562451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c07c61562451acb3f401add44cb7b0b1feea2297)
- Keeps your highlighted slash command when suggestions refresh, as long as the command is still available.
  [#184530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184530) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3ce499054a038450b064a317d9a74615457cdd4) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a delayed session list response from reverting the Access setting shown in the Control UI after you save it. Newer session changes still appear.
  [#184725](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184725) ([`6e056ae3`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6e056ae3fd33e5aeba4b9b0aaf7a5b5438f5f1a2)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the session sidebar from jumping as rows settle or a saved scroll position is restored.
  [#185137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185137) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session drags being ignored when the sidebar shows categories in place of your saved **Person** grouping. Move sessions between categories or drag an eligible categorized group conversation back to **Groups** while keeping that preference.
  [#185134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185134) · [a401130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a401130bdce1d3e1fea1df6bf673d100cdffef99) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the mobile archive notice layout so the icon sits beside the title or text, with Unarchive alongside.
  [#184767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184767) ([`9890d705`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9890d705c25c823aae6102502063cee54ca0ff42)). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Removes the filled hover background behind the **New session** plus button in sidebar group headers while keeping the icon highlight.
  [#185122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185122) · [0fec413](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fec413cf0585d39369ce35d1ee8ce9c4d00ea3a) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the extra blank space above error messages in Control UI session hovercards.
  [#185182](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185182) · [0fe66bf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fe66bf185e7d07bf3ea5d7ab52c449b5b0e4956) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Replaces generic person IDs in the mention picker with linked, verified GitHub handles when offline recipients have no saved name and a handle is available.
  [#186651](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186651).
- Replaces the retry prompt for unsupported generated files with recovery instructions. Download the original from Files if it was saved to the session and you have access, or ask your agent for a ZIP. Supported attachments in the reply remain available.
  [#186670](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186670). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Corrects the [Control UI Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) to explain that starting a Draft session opens it and sends your first message. Draft controls who can see the session, and background submission is not available for Drafts.
  [#186402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186402). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the blank project picker in New Session when projects fail to load. You can see the error and select **Retry** without losing your draft. A failed refresh keeps the projects that already loaded, and a failed first load keeps your saved project selected.
  [PR #187062](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187062). Thanks [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@rtfcv](https://github.com/rtfcv).
- Fixes the terminal UI waiting too long to send messages or giving up on chat history too soon when the system clock changes during startup.
  Thanks [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183635)
- Fixes `openclaw resume` staying open after Ctrl-C before the terminal UI opens. Canceling at that point also closes its Gateway connection.
  [PR #187225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187225). Thanks to yy19971996, obviyus and alix-007.
- Prevents OpenClaw from dropping words or trying to switch models when you mention `/model` mid-sentence and the next word doesn’t resolve to a model. The message reaches your current model intact instead of risking an unwanted switch or rejection.
  [PR #187416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187416). Thanks to wyf027, obviyus, felixboenkost-droid and holny.
- Fixes long streamed replies slowing down around inline code, comparisons, links or filtered tool-call text. It also fixes missing line breaks or code examples and stray tool-call text appearing in replies.
  [Inline code and comparisons #187433](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187433) · [Line breaks #187434](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187434) · [Double brackets #187656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187656) · [Filtered traces and invisible-only replies #174313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174313) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/752ad78253c21628150219320e37fbeb31099153) · [Streaming](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming) · [Tool-call filtering #174353](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174353) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d649dbab56aad31389e1a579dee57ab15450f74a) · [HTML and comparisons #174833](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174833) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/611806e42a47f7f57099b55abe668c17b0f4c912) · [Final answers and citations #175328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175328) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/49265a7b583ab2e6b883644211968abaf669e850) · [Issue #175264](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175264). Thanks ericcaiwx-star, obviyus, JasonBuildAI, wyf027 and wbxl2000 for the earlier fixes, [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174313) and [@steipete](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174313) for #174313, [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #174353, [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) for #174833, and [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #175328 and [@JasonBuildAI](https://github.com/JasonBuildAI) for the report.
- Prevents an unsent New Session draft from reverting an explicit execution permission such as Read Only to Default when you reload the Control UI. The choice stays with that draft and does not carry over after you create the session.
  [PR #187569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187569). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes follow-ups from the same authorized writer in sandboxed chat and web chat corrections to Codex starting or waiting for another turn instead of steering the reply in progress.
  [Sandboxed follow-ups #187633](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187633) · [Codex web steering #175810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175810) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd4bab62b30e3b2b6784066c5ff735d62ea7772f). Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) for the sandbox fix and [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the Codex fix.
- Stops unchanged text requests from being fed back to the agent as recent chat history after a confirmed local reply from the message tool. Fixes progress updates being counted as answers when the run treats sends as progress by default.
  [#187795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187795), [#186081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186081). Thanks to [@MertBasar0](https://github.com/MertBasar0), and to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the #187795 release backport.
- Removes stray Markdown quote marks from plain-text message previews, including quotes without a space after the marker and nested quotes.
  [#187853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187853). Thanks to [@coaimax](https://github.com/coaiMax), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Removes blank rows left in chat history by completed assistant replies that had nothing to show.
  [#188111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188111). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes archived PostgreSQL conversations failing to resume after a period of inactivity. Restoring the conversation keeps its earlier messages and lets the conversation view refresh with that history.
  [#189991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189991). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (b6cb943).
- Fixes session subscriptions, shared-session updates and artifact downloads being refused when bulk session reads fill the Gateway queue.
  [Session capacity and plugin priority reads #199564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199564), [commit de8696fb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/de8696fb87a06dbe4147e3ad8d3dd9b8b404e123). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes oversized conversation previews keeping later sessions out of the [Codex session list](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness). When the details of an affected interactive session can be recovered, it shows an error status that survives restarts and clears when Codex returns it normally.
  [Oversized preview recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f76d912f5d79f9f22330c92bd9c9c8e761dbf508) · [Discovery batches #173789](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173789) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/77f73f1459e0b171ceeedc43913a32324d6eea13). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves earlier tool calls and results as text when resuming an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions conversation after those tools become unavailable.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed711106a5dcceef7be27cb094bb44481d235f44).
- Avoids repeat downloads of unchanged managed outgoing chat image thumbnails when an authorized app checks for a newer copy.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcbf2c725a8d3b46c3700549276690578f27c57a). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes New Session suggesting a retry when it lacks permission to look for a Git repository. It shows the missing permission when known and points you to the person who manages OpenClaw. Starting a worktree session still requires access, but your selected worktree and unsent draft are kept.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f0973e37405d683e242e217f4d7c30a1efc4118). Thanks [@ylcn91](https://github.com/ylcn91) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes progress labels and reasoning drafts dropping complete words that still fit or cutting text with characters such as emoji shorter than necessary.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21f0262a8883e02054ca05e9509a7249e470cb64). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes announcements in shared conversations picking up messages already accepted for another active request. Those messages stay with the original request even when [Collect mode](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue) combines them or the request reuses its saved input.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a823a52f080634f24fd90826ea7603d9618466db). Thanks [@chuanleiguo](https://github.com/chuanleiguo).
- Keeps eligible assistant progress in refreshed history when a stopped or length-limited reply has no visible answer, while respecting silent replies and display settings.
  [commit c4f6b26](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c4f6b267b390aeb0fae16e50e103102326f8556b).
- Keeps older chat history reachable across hidden rows and preserves continuation after large pages. The UI no longer offers earlier history without an anchor, and a pending refill survives rejection of an outdated snapshot.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Bounds expansion when opening compressed session archives to their stored size plus 1 MiB. If a valid archive exceeds the limit, the original stays unchanged and you can export it as uncompressed JSONL to read it.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Prevents a retry of an already committed message from creating another turn, while refusing conflicting content or sender identity.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps a limited amount of an unfinished request through repeated conversation compactions without replacing it with internal updates or reviving completed work.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps a queued message from sending while its inline edit is still in progress.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Gives a prior writer a limited time to release a conversation before a Codex fork or resume handoff.
  [commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Repairs eligible saved titles showing `[OpenClaw session event]`. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to derive a title from the conversation or clear the marker; user-set names are preserved.
  [commit 7ca4c3c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ca4c3c69590766003d7a6ae10951efa5f15650e).
- Reduces history held in memory during manual and budget-driven compaction. Compaction stops if the selected history is incomplete or mismatched.
  [commit 590f76b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/590f76bb72cfe7a0b0b30536caa3fd79a36c4718).
- Processes large sessions as a stream during manual trimming, keeping the header and requested tail. The trim is rejected if the transcript changes before it is saved.
  [commit 62bb192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/62bb192d22f949d3db0e5d12078fca8a60f9c303).
- Redacts recognized credentials from quoted compaction excerpts before shortening them. The original transcript is unchanged, and pattern matching does not cover every secret.
  [commit 21bb4e7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21bb4e7b236a68de5554b3f69c291b20a51cd207).
- Keeps eligible completed Claude CLI replies in saved chat history and prevents internal instructions from finished background commands appearing as messages you sent when viewing or importing that history.
  [Saved replies](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cfd37ff97525dd35d816735b6aaf8ae1e5a98de) · [Background instructions #174780](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174780) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd3bcc01765305ff1a44f70ca187734269183965). Thanks [@maliv2](https://github.com/maliv2) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@AlwaysTwig](https://github.com/AlwaysTwig) and [@Induj1](https://github.com/Induj1) for the reports.
- Fixes later CLI turns getting stuck after cleanup fails for a previous session.
  [Commit 33e52df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33e52df4cd03e9e6a7d30849c702b45196aa5883). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@zeroaltitude](https://github.com/zeroaltitude).
- Fixes Doctor being unable to repair session history in cold storage, including history kept after an agent rename.
  [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed sessions failing to load messages into model context when they contain characters PostgreSQL cannot represent directly. The original text stays intact.
  [Commit 4ae9adf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4ae9adfae09fc63d302b38d4b06156fb7ffff132). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes short session links and references being held up while an unrelated session gets ready.
  [#173767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173767) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ef29c5cc85456cbbeac2b3fd7b04d44b0236a619). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Shows a sign-in prompt instead of a misleading connection error when a signed-out visitor opens a conversation link behind a sign-in proxy such as Cloudflare Access.
  [#173820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173820). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes automatic session titles staying provisional when a failed title fallback uses the same model as the conversation. OpenClaw can retry the model through the conversation’s own runtime instead of giving up.
  [#174164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174164) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80ae18c16c831aa5b011cbfdf3a6df2dc265849f). Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes session list and history requests being rejected when clients reconnect during recovery of a large subagent backlog after a Gateway restart.
  [PR #174248](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174248) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e6818f076d304fe363dad62a1a070f084dffb49) · [subagent operations guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/operations.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents conversation repair from hiding a recovery notice when the relevant history is not fully loaded.
  [#174278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174278). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops false warnings that conversation history was rewritten when unchanged tool results are replayed. With prompt-cache assertions enabled, it also prevents those false alarms from stopping the run.
  [PR #174282](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174282) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39be602a8c9b11bac9174fc5433d1331fc8b95b8) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps conversation history lookups tied to the right agent when agents share a session store.
  [#174435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174435) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes transcript searches, resets and deletions that could fail with a custom session store. Keeps edits to a shared SQLite session store in submission order and rejects a pending edit if the database file has been replaced.
  [PR #174462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174462). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops a failed OpenCode session-list refresh from bringing back the previous list. The next lookup tries again instead.
  [PR #174509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174509) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbbc6da33dd8d11618feab9320ebcc822b19ec8a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes saved child sessions going missing from Incognito conversation history in the embedded view. On a fresh history read, updated details appear and deleted children drop out.
  [#174579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174579) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ea5451699456ab5f1c313b91e611b09ba9a3790) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors when looking up which channel a conversation is linked to or where its session runs.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes native Codex session monitoring and cancellation on PostgreSQL-backed Gateways.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes active chats losing access to their database after a worker fails mid-operation. Later requests can use the database again once cleanup finishes, but the failed request isn’t retried.
  [#174808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174808) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97f27a65b0a6d2892657a3b666a931a563cbd8d3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `/codex bind --cwd` silently choosing the wrong folder when a quoted path starts or ends with a space. Windows can still trim trailing spaces when starting a process.
  [#174871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174871) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/abe00d4c097400cef91e611dbbd6f0ebf62d1e97) · Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes OpenAI Responses replacing the history chosen by Lossless and similar context engines when you connect with an API key, including when you reopen a session. Existing sessions don’t need a reset, and you can still opt in to OpenAI managing the history. Memory extraction no longer uses OpenAI’s compacted history even if you opt in. See [context engines](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/context-engine.md).
  [PR #174881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174881) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2354224e994429dbb63cd5c09fc96e245aec1488). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes CLI conversations losing context on the next fresh turn after successful compaction, including with stateless CLI backends. The next turn gets the saved summary and recent messages once when the conversation history is verified for the same account.
  [PR #175090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175090) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/737042da6fa05d7a8c17bea676aab7177d6bc371). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@hermod-asgard](https://github.com/hermod-asgard) for the related report. See [CLI backend history boundaries](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#history-account-boundaries).
- Fixes queued restart notices and other background session events being rejected when another turn finishes first in the same conversation.
  [#175219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175219) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8b71aff5547c41390375a8c396fb57f83843d7f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes ordinary replies in an existing Codex thread repeatedly triggering extra summarization when the [transcript size limit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/compaction) is enabled, even after `/compact`. The limit still applies when starting a fresh Codex thread. If older context is left out, OpenClaw tells you so you can resend what it needs. Your full saved transcript is kept.
  [#175256](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175256) · Thanks obviyus, and scotthuang for the [diagnosis](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158044).
- Fixes session setup losing the original error when cleanup interrupts it.
  [PR #175295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175295) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8779297c8e7322a6e27280134a4eb02d4132562). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes replies losing database access when a separate session deletion is refused or canceled before making changes. A deletion that loses permission no longer triggers a database repair on its own.
  [Session deletion #175307](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175307) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/03e18cf9073c2feaa5db9a92a093bfa2169cd02c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes saved chat drafts waiting for a conversation update before reappearing after reconnect.
  [#175721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175721) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a866b9de074a061bf8406d62d59471b088443e6). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes pending reply updates getting held up when the browser pauses a background chat tab.
  [#175721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175721) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a866b9de074a061bf8406d62d59471b088443e6). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes changes to the chat model or thinking level resetting the session list’s filter or limit. A queued message still waits for the new setting to be confirmed, without waiting for another list refresh.
  [#175722](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175722) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ebd9d9dd9ffd9d627effa6c3988e8a75a69e5fb). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes failures when adding someone to a shared conversation if unrelated session list details can’t load. Loading the member list and choosing a recipient no longer depend on those details either.
  [PR #175819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175819) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0b13a3be18cff8b9cf835945ca26782887651b30). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw stalling on Bun while reading large stored transcript summaries.
  [#175844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175844) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/92f57e590a3294af5f98d29e890f8eaf1dd899e0). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible queued messages failing to resume after a graceful restart when their saved message and run use different identities. The original message is retained without a duplicate transcript entry.
  [#175845](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175845) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e044c3f9cef3f57187f05e5daebe28d8bde6e890) · [11.5 restart recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/src/gateway/session-restart-resume.ts). Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Fixes an older background read replacing a newer session preview after session data is refreshed.
  [#175853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175853) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9b4fdb0829fdbba686799c09e463b972dde317f8) · [11.5 preview guard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/src/gateway/session-row-projection-backfill.ts). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes manual session compaction failing when OpenClaw reaches its state directory through a symbolic link, for both SQLite and PostgreSQL session stores.
  [#175900](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175900) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves manual compaction for transcripts in cold storage when the session is selected by ID.
  [PR #174774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174774) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d39d51f6d08d4f0331a06bba9bf8da47394ed77c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes saved replies staying hidden after a temporary session-change error while opening [Control UI chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui). Chat retries loading the history without resending your message or clearing your draft. If the error persists, you can still use Retry.
  [#175924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175924) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes pasted Git URLs not being selectable in the New session project picker for guests who already have permission to start chats. Click the matching result or press Enter to select it.
  [PR #175965](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175965), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f45fe274c179872cf4078d14e7c1cae247b2f0b7). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise).
- Stops New Session from dropping the selected folder group when a Gateway does not advertise group defaults. The Control UI also reports groups as unavailable, rather than empty, when an older Gateway cannot list them.
  [PR #175993](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175993). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops session progress notes from keeping entire long replies in memory after they’ve captured the part they need, without changing the notes or chat history.
  [PR #176509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176509) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a9ef1a826b912e4df85d59a7f0fed2f8a99051b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes known conversation titles briefly appearing as “New session” while cached chats load or the Control UI reconnects.
  **Cached titles** — [#178474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178474). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  **Titles on reconnect** — [PR #178510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178510). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski), and [@shannon0430](https://github.com/shannon0430) for reporting and follow-up verification.
- Fixes searches missing equivalent Unicode spellings in conversation names, terminal session, agent and model pickers, and OpenCode, Claude, Pi and Codex sessions.
  **Terminal pickers and resume** — [terminal UI’s](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/tui) [#186922](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186922) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3bb285a1e5b34a37256bbeda2340ecee054e73a6) · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).

  **Native session search** — [PR #187238](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187238), incorporating [OpenCode](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187189), [Claude](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187196), [Pi](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187204) and [Codex](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187211) contributions. Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).

  **Conversation names** — [PR #187300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187300). Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes queued messages staying pending after a Gateway crash, including when an agent’s session storage is not ready at startup. For file-backed conversations, affected sends appear as cancelled after restart so you can review and resend them. OpenClaw does not resend them automatically.
  **Delayed session storage** — [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f997932248420695abba48df0fc1adba8f191cf). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

  **File-backed crash recovery** — [#187083](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187083) · [commit 19c5db5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/19c5db5a7dbb76c4058924ec9f7a84941c35fc6b). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a missing link back to the original Codex thread when a Continue request joins one already underway for the same local session.
  [#178414](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178414). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a case where Stop showed an error even though it had already stopped a session’s child runs.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completed-work duration disappearing during reconnect when the current conversation is temporarily missing from the session list and its timing is available.
  [#178474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178474). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes queued follow-up messages failing to start after the previous reply finishes.
  [#178488](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178488). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes long text turning into an attachment when you paste it into an empty message box in Chat or New Session. The text stays in the box so you can edit it before sending.
  [PR #178527](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178527). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops Chat from offering to continue a local Codex session when supervision is off and sending would fail. You can still read the conversation, and Open settings takes you to Codex plugin settings to enable [supervision](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/codex-supervision.md).
  [PR #178537](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178537). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for reporting.
- Fixes Control UI chat messages showing as failed when an agent takes too long to come back after a Gateway restart. They stay queued and retry when the agent is ready, unless you remove them from the queue.
  [#186810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186810) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e334b0acc8de72585253b7d8bef3b83eac3bd344) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes **Fork from here** so a local Draft conversation remains Draft in the copy. If Draft creation is disabled, even while the copy is being prepared, OpenClaw refuses the fork and leaves the original alone. Draft is a coordination feature, not a strong security boundary.
  [#186820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186820) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72db2aa4e15706f09d18cd697444c078295ceef9) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents helpers started from a [Draft conversation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/multi-user) from becoming Shared without an explicit choice. When Draft creation is disabled, OpenClaw refuses to start new Draft helpers without interrupting existing work. Sharing the parent conversation does not share its helpers.
  [PR #186856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186856) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6d8ba301c1463ea6ec93f5ab5d19af1bef47eb44) · [issue #186662](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186662). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes `openclaw agent --local` getting stuck and exiting without a reply when starting a session with a mixed-case ID. You can resume the session using the same spelling.
  [PR #186858](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186858) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6febccabd60856178abae25cf262b53aefb49dd) · [issue #186843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186843). Thanks [@moonbow0407](https://github.com/moonbow0407), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@bluet](https://github.com/bluet).
- Prevents New Session from silently switching a selected Draft to Shared when an administrator disables new Drafts. The form keeps your Draft selection, message, and attachments, and you must turn off Draft to create a Shared session instead. If the Gateway refuses the Draft, the form can restore your input when you reconnect. See [sessions and the sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
  [PR #186938](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186938) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9cd97293eb93e0d445481a08ccbe94d5ae52ce63). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes collaborator replies disappearing from an open chat when they could not be added to the chat history. If the history catches up, the reply appears only once.
  [PR #174087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174087) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d52679b8cdd8dc34c9a6707dd6d79e0a7be090f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [chat history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/webchat) catch-up cutting previews shorter than the requested limit.
  [#174407](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174407) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes keyboard focus dropping from **Show in text field** when chat refreshes the same pasted-text attachment in the background.
  [#176719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176719). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Aligns the attachment input with the plus button when opening the picker in Chat and New Session on mobile Safari.
  [PR #173187](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173187). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes the configured rejection fallback being ignored when an admitted participant cannot steer an active turn. The default quietly queues a separate turn under that requester’s permissions; set `messages.queue.collaborativeSteeringFallback` to `"reject"` to reject it instead. See [queue steering](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/queue-steering).
  [Quiet queue or reject fallback #185477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185477) · [Steering defaults and fallback retained #186381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186381). Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a pending share action for a replaced chat from affecting the new session.
  [PR #184451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184451). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the sharing fixture work.
- Stops OpenClaw from confirming guidance sent to a running session before it’s saved. If the receiving session can’t save it during the current reply, OpenClaw queues it for a separate turn where supported.
  [#176587](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176587). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session work getting stuck around Stop and prevents a previous turn from stopping its replacement. Stop saves the cancellation and notifies affected queued work before it confirms, and the next turn waits if the old work is still winding down.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36e277d76147ab839a5068f4d8bc0c5254f1d05a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes retries losing track of the original message or replaying a reply that already finished. Suspended completions no longer hold an unstarted queue slot while they wait to resume.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes worker progress and cancellation acknowledgments getting detached from the turn they belong to, and keeps a completed reply from being cancelled when you Move its session.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes session deletion leaving a paused native task behind. If the task cannot be cancelled, deletion stops instead.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes steering, timeout recovery, side-question context, Talk replies and live permission changes getting mixed up between conversations in different stores that share an ID. A refused question answer stays visible as a refusal instead of starting another turn.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36e277d76147ab839a5068f4d8bc0c5254f1d05a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes steering and deferred recovery losing track of the active Incognito conversation, keeping recovery associated with the correct conversation.
  [PR #175837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175837) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes raw tool results and internal follow-up instructions appearing as user messages after a plugin reload or GitHub publish. Plugins that inspect what started a turn can distinguish these resumptions from ordinary plugin events.
  Plugin consumers inspecting `sourceTool` should recognize `tool_handoff` for these turns. [PR #185168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185168) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e3e393169f6b0d85e22bf3622f20dc8a7ebe1c2f) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Prevents a graceful Gateway restart from dropping app messages already queued for a running conversation. Recovered sends retain their original permission limits, and if OpenClaw can’t verify the original access, the send fails and you can resend it.
  [#196923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196923) and [#196540](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196540). Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the queued-send-permission release backport (11b4beb8af and 4f840ce16a).
- Fixes messages from local root conversations that could be dropped when a plugin they were using reloads. The original message can go through after a successful reload if it is still authorized, but it cannot survive a Gateway restart.
  [#187095](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187095) · [commit bca8823](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bca882333b9d285258052ec95febe6a6a339c5f3). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).

##### Agents, tools and delegated work

- Fixes CLI-backed channel sessions failing to start a worker in a conversation thread.
  <span>Thanks [@linhongyu510](https://github.com/linhongyu510), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159136">#159136</a></span>
- Fixes plugin tools missing the context needed to match background `exec` completions to their originating run in the same session when the run ID is available, including through Claude CLI.
  [#179816](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179816) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Fixes requester replies failing after a directly delivered subagent result appears in the conversation. Restored collector runs no longer stay pending indefinitely, returning a recorded result or a diagnostic failure, and silent yields no longer return stale progress.
  <span>Thanks [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@rozenpl](https://github.com/rozenpl). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159157">#159157</a></span> · <span>Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@potterdigital](https://github.com/potterdigital). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164445">#164445</a></span>
- Fixes parents repeatedly seeing results they already received and delivered results staying pending or appearing suspended after reaching the requester.
  [#171939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171939) · Thanks to [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Leli1024](https://github.com/Leli1024). · Grouped results the requesting agent is still waiting for keep their continuation. Thanks to co-authors [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for clarifying grouped results, and [@assimetria-ai](https://github.com/assimetria-ai) for the report. [#176701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176701) · [commit 850fdaf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/850fdaffc3b0af6225809891621a2652b2bc7077) · [Subagent result handoff](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff) · [Issue #166267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166267) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176713) · [commit 72b5b3d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72b5b3d530cf7f52d487831476b3a9c049cda078)
- Fixes subagent results being lost when different agents use the same child session key.
  [#172840](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172840). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session tool previews omitting enabled plugin tools for dynamic models or showing built-in web search after it has been turned off for that session.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167581">PR #167581</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b28fe43ccf65149034f9666eb7829bf7bf800375">`b28fe43`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/tuaran">@tuaran</a>, <a href="https://github.com/chisalita">@chisalita</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173432">#173432</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0908007388bc4f2fcabc2375ffaecfbcf1d23c6b">Commit 090800738</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/operator-methods">Effective-tool preview</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173403">Issue #173403</a>. Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@CoastalEdge](https://github.com/CoastalEdge) (report).
- Fixes the Tool access menu staying empty after an agent discovers MCP tools. Reopen Tool access to see discovered tools without reloading the page.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168668">PR #168668</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/297f3d8cf2e6ec27201df0eab2bab0d371514438">`297f3d8`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/ericcurtin">@ericcurtin</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jonathanlindsay">@jonathanlindsay</a>.</span>
- Fixes chat reporting an error when a plugin deliberately handles a turn without replying. This covers both direct and queued turns.
  [PR #169921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169921) · [0c2dd5f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c2dd5f3e40f4126046f3f34cbe961801856bfdf). Thanks to [@htjworld](https://github.com/htjworld), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@jonathanlindsay](https://github.com/jonathanlindsay).
- Fixes Claude CLI final answers getting stuck behind stopped tasks or work from an earlier message. [CLI backends](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)
  [PR #170322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170322) · [a9479eb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a9479eb77d0e5cfb0686862b96720ea9e858cbe9). Thanks to [@cassthebandit](https://github.com/cassthebandit) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes repeated cloud-worker allocation failures after a warm-image checkpoint disappears. The first allocation reports the failure. Once Crabbox confirms an unpinned checkpoint is missing, later allocations can start cold.
  [PR #170924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170924) · [b381bc6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b381bc61bba426962c22546a3e5fc89c7d09c8bc). Thanks to [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini).
- Fixes native worker turns failing after they deliver a message.
  [PR #171081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171081) · [de70e83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/de70e8372f46611a3c6a16e316a2df267c5d44ca). Thanks to [@sallyom](https://github.com/sallyom).
- Prevents malformed UTF-8 identity imports from overwriting an agent identity with corrupted text. Optional workspace identity loading skips malformed files.
  [#171611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171611) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Codex follow-up messages being rejected while a background listener is running and prompt-hook context changes.
  [#171963](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171963) · Thanks to [@Matuno](https://github.com/Matuno), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes allowed plugin tools being rejected by session checks, including browser and Tool Search calls.
  <span>Session checks honor configured plugin and plugin-group allowances and continue to apply explicit denials and narrower restrictions. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172678">#172678</a> and <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172604">issue #172604</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/shakkernerd">@shakkernerd</a>.</span>
- Distinguishes ordinary guest and input failures from infrastructure errors in [Code Mode diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode/troubleshooting). Invalid edit and patch anchors now return an actionable input error, and bridge rejections are logged once.
  [#172850](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172850). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the risk of losing already accepted Codex run events when a recorded turn is cancelled.
  [#172876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172876). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixed guest users with session-write access being denied when following up on their own completed child sessions.
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for the report and fix. [#172904](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172904) · [issue #172867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172867)
- Fixed more cases where a model printed a tool call and the turn appeared successful or returned an unclear error. When replay is safe, OpenClaw asks once for a native tool call and reports repeated text attempts as failures.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@5jrfrbd6z9-spec](https://github.com/5jrfrbd6z9-spec) and [@rogerallen1](https://github.com/rogerallen1). [#172908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172908)
- Fixed parent agents being stopped while an owned, authorized collector was still working, including waits inside Code Mode. Stop and execution deadlines still apply. Without a deadline, the parent can wait indefinitely for a collector that never finishes.
  Thanks [@johan-eilertsen](https://github.com/johan-eilertsen) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172959) · [Agent loop](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/agent-loop.md)
- Fixes ACPX project-trust inheritance by reading trusted project records from valid Codex TOML. If ACPX reports malformed configuration, correct the source file and retry the session.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173064">#173064</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Corrects the `openclaw agent exec` guidance to explain that existing workspace instructions may still be included. The guide shows how to disable automatic injection for embedded runs. Tools can still read workspace files.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173203">#173203</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/agent.md">Agent command reference</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/automation/standing-orders.md">Standing orders</a> · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes text and inline-image messages failing because of invalid local media settings they don’t use.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173433">#173433</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports an unknown outcome to eligible conversations when a Gateway restart loses track of a background command. Check for side effects or saved state before retrying.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173454">#173454</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbc41ff76ba1d835ab36261c48c5ecea87deff4c">Commit dbc41ff76</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process">Background process guide</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes SearXNG searches ignoring your configured result limit and timeout. A `count` supplied for an individual search still overrides the configured limit.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173467">#173467</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a6b0183acf31317a6a3207d93c8fc85c81fb5a9">Commit 5a6b0183a</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/searxng-search">SearXNG configuration</a>. Thanks [@ly85206559](https://github.com/ly85206559), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Retires Code Mode workers that stay in a major garbage-collection storm and replaces them on demand. Active cells and parked continuations can finish, cancel, time out, or expire before the old worker exits. [Code Mode executors](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode/executors)
  [#173577](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173577) · [0cda908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0cda908b153efa70ffc1211241cecf569e592fa7) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes active native-runtime replies stopping when an operator changes execution permissions during the reply.
  [#173579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173579) · [bfbfae7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bfbfae742a5187ff2255f0f367c80d685a7fd24b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes healthy subagents failing to resume when a separately owned recovery or cancellation session is unavailable.
  [#173678](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173678) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex registration and first turns failing during cold or slow startup, reports startup errors instead of a generic timeout, and prevents a cancelled or timed-out early turn from interrupting startup for later turns. See [Codex timeout guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-reference/timeouts) and [runtime behavior](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness/runtime-behavior).
  [#172876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172876). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · [#173716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173716) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · [#174706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174706) · [`1e604e0`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1e604e0e9e1139ed7abe296bda846082c32bf492). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores approved replies from visible work sessions when messaging permissions allow them. X follow-up sessions still need approval and can reply only in the original conversation. A waiting notice is local to its work session, and available inter-session messaging is identified for contacting the session that started the work.
  [#173939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173939) · [#173942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173942) · [Work-session tool policy](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-policy) · [X channel guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x) · Thanks steipete. · [#173942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173942) · [Subagent tool reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes agents on supported runtimes losing their delegation tools when a rate limit forces a model fallback as they resume authorized work after child tasks finish. A fallback that only reports a finished task stays report-only.
  [#173989](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173989) · [Landed commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f68ab1d5354bd0f534f8d839a172df835fd9c04) · [Model failover guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Goal Resume staying pending and blocking other Goal controls after a busy-session refusal. The Control UI shows the busy error, and you can choose **Resume** again once the session is idle.
  [#174683](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174683) · [`1b03b6d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b03b6d496c45a69895527595019cf6f5810b1ef). Thanks to [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev). Reported by [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) in [#174656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174656).
- Fixes workspace-only Claude turns dropping structured questions from an explicitly selected tool set, and turns failing when Claude Code makes its built-in question tool available. See [CLI backends](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends).
  [#174740](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174740) · [`b10a19d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b10a19d0e5518b4a72f3238612ec710d7a778a6d). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · [#174951](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174951) — Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes an unfinished embedded-agent turn getting blocked when OpenClaw picks up the same saved input after an explicitly nonfinal progress update from that turn. The agent can finish its reply using the original tool result.
  [#174745](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174745) · [`50e8b86`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50e8b86daea931cd0de29655124bc9fd8c76a3c1). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an extra model request after an agent sends its reply through the message tool, and duplicate CLI agent answers after a final reply was sent to the same conversation.
  [#174948](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174948) — Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). · [#175560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175560) · [b5e1b21](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b5e1b2137c514c2e5939ba4ab693b65f62490033). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes AutoReview being cut off before it returns a report even though the Codex run that started it is still going. You can still stop the review, and each pass keeps its own time limit.
  [AutoReview](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/tools/autoreview.md) · [Codex timeouts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/plugins/codex-harness-reference/timeouts.md) · [#175529](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175529) · [Issue #175519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175519). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes stopped Claude CLI sessions failing to resume or import history when transcripts are in a custom configuration directory, and replaces a generic failure with a wait-and-retry message when another sign-in is in progress.
  [#175549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175549) · [08d89a8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08d89a8bdf54785bb869994203f43985abc7efa1). Thanks vincentkoc. · [#175558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175558) · [e60fbe9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e60fbe9362af72cddeb03db3ace680080754d814). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Keeps private subagent completion notes out of chat history and live conversation updates. Stops automatic follow-ups from those private runs from appearing in the conversation, while preserving permitted messages sent explicitly and replies to later ordinary turns.
  [#175559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175559) · [1cbb6c2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1cbb6c271ae169beb9e4e1212327e04e87685f49). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Changes Codex delegation guidance so new tasks that need OpenClaw tools are directed to a worker that can use them, or kept in the current session when no such worker is available. [Codex dynamic tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-reference/dynamic-tools)
  [#175627](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175627) · [2356477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/235647734fb59541878f1033c7eefcde6d3ca6c2). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes expired subagent results staying stuck after the last recovery attempt fails. OpenClaw records the failed delivery and keeps the result and the earlier blocked-delivery notice. The fix applies while the final recovery attempt is still recorded. [Subagent operations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/operations)
  Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xyi74976-del](https://github.com/xyi74976-del) and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176145">#176145</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9312615878629151e5fe73bac494666c588bad8b">Commit 9312615</a>
