- Prevents subagent progress cards from cutting an emoji in half when they shorten a long task title. [Subagent tool reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference)
  Thanks [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176173">#176173</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14abc23c56ff12a4347e6ec3e21138c2ab552236">Commit 14abc23</a>
- Fixes managed worker turns that could end without confirming they had stopped after you cancelled them.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176181">#176181</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f585b0421821c15ce1d0e545a13bcea0f36ab764">Commit f585b04</a>
- Stops tools called from Code Mode from showing as finished before their activity is saved. If the activity can’t be saved, OpenClaw keeps track of known effects so recovery can take them into account before retrying.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176403), [440c86f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/440c86f20b0ed4a77a2b017dfe37d3ef03e339f0).
- Keeps the selected subagent when you hide and reopen its panel. If you already went back from its details, the panel stays on the list.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176623">#176623</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/13969119c27b47aacdd0789110314a6baded880c">13969119</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completion replies leaving photos or files out of the original conversation, including replies that contain only an attachment. See the [subagent announcements guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176594">#176594</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f738047bced34a7b740eca8b86bf03175ceff33">7f738047</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents Code Mode from counting a nested tool as still running after it has stopped, even if its activity update is dropped.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176658">#176658</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5c558d96d42dc7e0209de3724e1d742705d2831">c5c558d9</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes quota recovery failing in one Codex session while another saves unrelated state in the same store.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176602">#176602</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/11e96b0898bd633663f996ba859e6c6605a364ba">11e96b08</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex launchers and their paused child processes staying suspended on POSIX systems when their owner exits normally during cleanup.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176578">#176578</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0319200bb1b72e8ec2f0601cbb53d61f865313bd">0319200b</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes requested task-delivery recovery being skipped after an earlier write had already checked the SQLite state database.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176600">#176600</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9ae585bb67a36460e35d97a5b5a4fe78ddd5082a">9ae585bb</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps live replies between agents tied to the original authorized request, so returning a result uses that request’s authorization even when the peer can’t start a new message in the other direction.
  Thanks to co-author [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176697](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176697) · [commit bf76b0c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf76b0c86dfc8751493b6a95936348b9aa31797e)
- Fixes Codex dashboard turns that could stop before reaching the model when the Gateway resumed a conversation with hosted web search enabled.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176707) · [commit 1ffa33e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ffa33e94e306c4acfcb86126c00427cdf526c57)
- Fixes accepted agent requests losing their final result when the submitting turn ends normally.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176913">#176913</a> · Thanks to [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).</span>
- Lets a permitted message from a person or another agent wake the built-in agent while it’s waiting on a subagent, so it can respond while the child keeps working. [Subagent tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference)
  [#177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698) · [f83b7ade](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f83b7ade15f3aefad7b367bef084ea5ffdbd9f8b). Thanks to [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Keeps accepted subagent follow-ups tied to the original run and requester, and prevents a completion from being attributed to a later session when the requesting session is missing. It also skips obsolete child completions that could hold up new messages while including cancellations that belong in a waiting group’s result.
  [Subagent follow-ups and results #177698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177698) · [commit f83b7ade](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f83b7ade15f3aefad7b367bef084ea5ffdbd9f8b) · [Completion attribution #179222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179222) · [commit e998107](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e9981073bdd2eaf4da7b4e981ef64b749cf1bb42). Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a queued subagent delivery warning from starting another reply after the result has already arrived. You can inspect unresolved delivery failures on the child session.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Oldrich333">@Oldrich333</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177385">#177385</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/751d109a6717a87b254b47018c5f08b64ce6599b">Commit 751d109</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168339">Issue #168339</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9344233e7a66fe36479d55b7f7ae8e10eb886586">Final queue change</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/slash-command">Subagent delivery</a>
- Prevents a group of subagents from sending already-delivered results back to the parent agent a second time. If only some results have arrived, the follow-up carries the missing ones. A parent that explicitly yielded can still resume, and partial findings from work interrupted by a Gateway restart can still reach it. [Subagent handoff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178104">#178104</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/411b2e63f3f87dd1ce63051b15b3de8e17332ef5">411b2e63</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops repeat failure notices and extra agent turns when recovery permanently fails to produce a visible reply to a subagent’s result. You can inspect the saved result and delivery failure, then continue the conversation yourself once the original problem is resolved.
  [#179675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179675) · [89992cd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/89992cdc1a55c273e6f6e2613c1e2dd64e8db8fa) · [Related issue #168339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168339) · [Subagent operations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/operations.md) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) for preparing the fix, [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for the related report.
- Fixes follow-up agent requests timing out too soon or running after their wait limit has passed if the system clock changes while they’re queued behind another run in the same session.
  [#177179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177179), [15b2d65](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/15b2d6594ed2292e139c7c65571f8fbb141c9009). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes native subagent replies losing their original line breaks when passed back to the parent agent. The parent receives the full reply even when the preview is shorter, with media references kept and delivery instructions left out of the reply text. Replies already shown to the user keep the text that was displayed. [Subagent completion guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/tools/subagents/announce.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180451">PR #180451</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/827ccc2aebdc7c7a93032490cde2cc5fc73cbed5">Commit 827ccc2</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180379">Issue #180379</a>. Thanks [@matthematics1137](https://github.com/matthematics1137).</span>
- Prevents host clock changes from cutting the wait for child agents short or making it last longer than intended.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180554">PR #180554</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68b73bf9cabdfcf4f3e355df78585c9a141415d0">Commit 68b73bf</a>. Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) for the original fix and regression, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the elapsed-time implementation.</span>
- Fixes Stop getting delayed or failing for queued subagents when the session list is slow to refresh or cannot refresh. The list can update after Stop finishes and shows the current run if another has taken its place.
  [#177787](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177787) · [9e7f4d34](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e7f4d34564570e712eeb1165b8f06f32483bf69). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an assistant losing the ability to send follow-up instructions to an already-running native child agent after a Control UI refresh or network interruption. The repair applies when the same verified device reconnects with the same access.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176972">#176972</a> · Thanks to [@enki](https://github.com/enki).</span>
- Restores messaging from a parent or permitted peers to an existing child after the parent gets a new session ID, provided OpenClaw can still connect the old and new parent sessions. A send waiting for approval is cancelled if the link it relied on unexpectedly changes. If OpenClaw can no longer connect the sessions, re-spawn the child. [Session messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/session-tool.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178082">#178082</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdedd194a04ab5241567e3cd3bb25dde0e97a07a">fdedd194</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169828">#169828</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for the report.
- Fixes the Subagents panel leaving out running Codex-native subagents. It shows live status, retries failed refreshes while visible, and leaves native rows read-only. Authorized Gateway clients can request the same live observations with `includeNativeSubagents` on `sessions.describe`.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/enki">@enki</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177414">#177414</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb837719206b2613e5fb176f556929ffbd037c46">Commit eb83771</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/sessions-and-results">Agent harness sessions and results</a>
- Fixes Claude CLI replying when it yields to wait for subagents and recording a successful child handoff as a stopped conversation. Child results can wake the same conversation without a false interruption in its history. Other CLI backend plugins can opt into ending turns on yield.
  [CLI backend plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/cli-backend-plugins) · [Yield handling #176893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176893) · [Handoff history #180198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180198) · [commit b301211](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b301211d03bc0af033f7d6ee2418223712e49a90) · [Issue #179486](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179486). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes mid-run guidance being rejected when a coordinator tries to steer its own running Claude CLI child. [Steering guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/steer)
  [#178865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178865), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178822), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dff89a1a3e0ca92f6b60e26db589d9a49091f1d4). Thanks to [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops image-capable CLI backends from reattaching old images to later text-only messages. Images attached to the current turn or supplied by the channel with a reply go through.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@nunyabiz765](https://github.com/nunyabiz765) for the report. [#176837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176837) · [commit 45fddcf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/45fddcfe1fae0b99606d59409bc2fd69447896e7) · [CLI backend guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) · [Issue #176629](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176629)
- Fixes CLI-backed sessions losing their usual agent instructions, profile, or memory when they run in a separate project folder. The agent keeps its own workspace context and still follows the project's `AGENTS.md`.
  Thanks to sunlit-deng and steipete, to nikolay-bratanov for the report, and to wr-web for checking an equivalent branch. [#180559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180559) · [0372963](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0372963434f6a0b79394dbe330abde2ae34f2a89) · [Issue #180510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180510)
- Fixes a case where Claude CLI didn’t follow up after a background command finished. If session storage is unavailable, you can retrieve the command result with `process poll`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177063">#177063</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168637">Report #168637</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends">CLI backends</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents local Claude CLI from starting a second copy of configured MCP servers when tool execution targets a paired node. Claude’s native Bash runs on the Gateway host. Disabling a configured server named `openclaw` leaves Claude’s other allowed MCP tools available. An affected chat may start a fresh Claude session, with its OpenClaw history preserved. [CLI backends guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)
  [#178723](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178723) · [`1985677`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1985677a3d253ab4cbc8e4f9622601d39658764d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the related report.
- Fixes a source of Gateway stalls when starting Codex sessions on Linux, particularly when the Gateway is already using a lot of memory. [Codex inspection timeout guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/recovery)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179936">#179936</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21dc66737bd6f73b5e6b75599bd0146db2b6cbbf">commit 21dc6673</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new managed Codex launches failing when Homebrew removes the Node executable still in use by the running Gateway, provided the same Homebrew formula has a replacement.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180100">#180100</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39592b2567772ffed75e6d34d22b2236b639fbfd">commit 39592b25</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@TheRealUnknownSoldier](https://github.com/TheRealUnknownSoldier).
- Preserves your environment exclusion list when managed Codex receives host-owned Git settings.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180100">#180100</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39592b2567772ffed75e6d34d22b2236b639fbfd">commit 39592b25</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@TheRealUnknownSoldier](https://github.com/TheRealUnknownSoldier).
- Fixes Codex `/btw` questions failing when the native session uses a different model from the chat, including models configured only in Codex. Uses that session’s web search rules and keeps hosted search off while a supervised session has no model selected. If the model changes before the question starts, retry with the current model.
  OpenClaw rejects a pending question if the session’s model, sign-in or requester permissions change before it starts. [#177114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177114). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes worker turns that could fail without showing a result after their tools finished and the model returned an empty reply. The worker now asks for a visible answer on its final attempt.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177480">#177480</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e767299c6d7e4ac2935dab58e2806c7e43443481">Commit e767299</a>
- Fixes local agents losing access to their tools when the model stops without a visible reply after completing read-only tool calls. The agent gets one chance to continue with its tools.
  [#178192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178192) · [commit 4601114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4601114c7fbdbe10255146c9cdcfff9f7f430f4c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes agents being told to post progress to a chat that doesn’t exist on turns without a source conversation, such as operator CLI runs. The agent is directed to reply to the caller normally, and a separate message still needs a destination. [Codex harness reply guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/plugins/codex-harness.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178108">#178108</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/23c99ef87404ac6213c3532cf5c5c7209d0f7eeb">23c99ef8</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a gap in agent recovery summaries by asking the agent to report an earlier unresolved tool failure even if a later tool call succeeded.
  [#178638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178638) · [`9ccfff0`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9ccfff0640302a1d4d8e074ef85bd285063f14b6) · Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar) for the fix and [@ablake4427](https://github.com/ablake4427) for the report and reproduction.
- Fixes tool calls losing a JSON field and its contents when OpenClaw decodes HTML-escaped text in the arguments.
  [#178314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178314) · [commit 40185dd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40185dd87c2e43a49614e8bf4543727c0d8d65c7). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes end-of-turn processing overlooking nested tool activity that finishes saving as an agent run is cancelled or replaced.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177333">#177333</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6fcf611f87ad7a960f110ee4438505e731aace42">Commit 6fcf611</a>
- Fixes fresh turns that could fail before the first reply when a plugin supplied too much instruction text. OpenClaw trims oversized blocks separately and logs which plugin supplied them. If the built-in agent still runs out of room on instructions and tools alone, the error suggests reducing that context or choosing a model with a larger context window.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176871">#176871</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176827">Report #176827</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session">Plugin prompt and session hooks</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ruirui666888](https://github.com/ruirui666888).</span>
- Improves Doctor’s bootstrap warnings to explain that the model gets excerpts from the start and end of shortened workspace files as space allows, may also get a policy summary from `AGENTS.md`, and gets nothing from files left out altogether. [Doctor’s bootstrap warnings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  Thanks to steipete, Sedrak-Hovhannisyan and issue reporter pawelbbdrozd. [#180600](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180600) · [47e115e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/47e115ebf762298e12166e9b12b6a061bd4d2626) · [Issue #180531](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180531)
- Fixes replies, text `/verbose` and `/status`, and `openclaw agent` using the global verbosity setting when the agent has its own default. Explicit overrides still win. Fixes text `/reasoning` reporting the wrong default in saved sessions that use an agent’s reasoning setting. [Verbosity and reasoning settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/thinking)
  [#177613](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177613) · [64ff6a2e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/64ff6a2e9f91f80b86cec25fb054b31becf43ae3) · [Reported in #177612](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177612). Thanks to [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes ordinary messages failing before an agent can reply when it’s set to deny all tools but inherits a tool allowlist or plugin tool grant. The agent still has no tools, and explicit requests that conflict with the denial still fail.
  [#177741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177741) · [512663e1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/512663e1254b54bc755844c852a2c271904b1232) · [Related channel report #157790](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/157790). Thanks to [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Shows **Saving…** and disables **Set Default** while your default-agent change is being saved. The **Default** badge shows the confirmed choice, and an already-started save can finish after you leave.
  [#179680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179680) · [df39671](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df396710a661171a40d9bdff729f685d67bf4ff9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes **Save** in Agents settings looking finished before the agent list has refreshed. **Reload Config** also shows that it is still running, and both buttons stay disabled until the pending action finishes. Unexpected failures show an error.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180461">PR #180461</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9246f6cacdaf0cf45e1dd0bf0fdd01f538af11f">Commit c9246f6</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes `openclaw agents list --tree --bindings` leaving out routing rules. The rules appear under the agents they belong to.
  Thanks to [@KhanCold](https://github.com/KhanCold) and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#176860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176860) · [commit 034856a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/034856a7f365293c22adde64946c3f974c7b23f6)
- Stops completed agent runs and long-running Gateways from keeping unnecessary recovery history, conversation copies and prompt-cache diagnostics in memory after work ends or sessions are reset, deleted or automatically replaced. Skill Workshop also clears its diagnostic data when a background review ends, including when it fails.
  [Agent recovery history #176804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176804) · [commit 1929324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1929324867c352347772d4a4ecda110c24d891af) · [Prompt-cache diagnostics #177614](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177614) · [commit b61b0809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b61b0809c63792c23df5ef68bc303882e146c134) · [Conversation history #177763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177763) · [commit 10049a6e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/10049a6e9d6115d5b9d23851b378a175a70e5960) · [Prompt-cache diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) · [Agent loop](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-loop). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes turns failing to start in plugin harnesses when one agent runs the turn under another agent’s policy. That policy’s web search restrictions still apply.
  With a separate policy owner and an unscoped session key, set `sandboxAgentId` explicitly. [#177105](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177105). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes delayed replies in older peer-reply flows losing the selected person for personal-tool actions after the original request ends. Those actions still have to be allowed for both the selected person and the original request.
  [#178750](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178750) · [`d705a4b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d705a4bf18c620d53930383750d58f7ade6e7a88) · Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki).
- Prevents local CLI agent runs from leaving private prompt files behind when image preparation fails before launch. OpenClaw delays creating the file until preparation succeeds and cleans up an acquired workspace if the run is then cancelled before launch.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177493">#177493</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2e4260b0158567af08f3cf08bb31ef8d948c0ec9">Commit 2e4260b</a>
- Keeps accepted Copilot runs from being rejected when the Copilot runtime starts shutting down while they’re still starting.
  [#177606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177606) · [16aee921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/16aee9219d04a2bad2e076a018e2c21f06f802e6). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Returns a clear input error if `agents_wait` receives a missing or malformed run ID list. Send run IDs as a list of strings, even when waiting for just one run.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180050">#180050</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d85f1a04b5eb2361ebadc18eae23004277b41354">commit d85f1a04</a>. Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes a false shutdown error after a command has already failed because its runner crashed.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176791](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176791) · [commit 0a6268f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a6268fb1fe1930e59a47ba8e89799bcd0a31740)
- Fixes background command stops being reported as complete before exit is confirmed. Poll after requesting a stop to check for exit and any cleanup failure. Background command wake-ups are tied to completion. Stop results show a configured deadline when available. [Background process guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process)
  [#177940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177940) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) (co-author).
- Clarifies that an empty background command snapshot covers the exec commands seen at the start of that turn.
  [#177943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177943) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes Auto Review disappearing from a guest conversation after a background command finishes in the same process. The follow-up retains access to the permitted reviewer models while the original guest’s authorization is still current.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176999">#176999</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176927">Report #176927</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec">Background commands</a> · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Prevents Gateway stall warnings from starting recovery while a provider request or other session work still has time to finish. Plugin SDK recovery callbacks run only when there’s eligible work to recover. [Gateway diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics)
  [#177557](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177557) · [27379bc2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/27379bc2c15ab1e48380edc6010054bb9d30028c). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes turns losing MCP tools or failing at the Gateway connection limit, including when another sender in the same session has an idle connection. OpenClaw can close idle connections while protecting active work, and those sessions reconnect when needed. If there is no room, the turn continues with a warning and any available MCP tools. Previously listed tools can remain visible but report that they are unavailable, and a sign-in that could not start can be retried on the next turn.
  [Gateway MCP configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-extensions) · [Connection capacity #176880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176880) · [Shared-session connections #177268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177268). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes system clock changes making OpenClaw wait too long for an MCP session slot or refuse a session before checking an available idle slot when MCP is at capacity.
  Thanks to SunnyShu0925 and steipete. [#180622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180622) · [86a37d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86a37d7f443601011923069fbc0edd5bdb5c45b7)
- Stops a known MCP startup failure from making later chat turns wait through another connection timeout. Healthy connections can refresh their tools while retries run in the background, and recovered tools return on the next turn.
  The first connection can wait for initialization and tool discovery. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176863](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176863) · [commit c51d21c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c51d21c0d73ecb8d007c10510e714846c2eb4eb3) · [MCP setup and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp)
- Fixes Streamable HTTP MCP follow-up calls failing while an expired session is reconnecting. A separate call can wait for recovery. The call that hit expiry fails once and stays unreplayed.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/akshitkhokhani">@akshitkhokhani</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/mistahk24">@mistahk24</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177427">#177427</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba427f88834f761470b966fffaebf5a52fcf7ef6">Commit ba427f8</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/159976">Issue #159976</a>
- Fixes MCP tool failures that gave the agent a format error. The agent receives the server’s explanation and any recovery instructions. [MCP troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp#troubleshooting)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179345">#179345</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179318">Reported in #179318</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/JoeThornRiver">@JoeThornRiver</a>.
- Prevents a stray click on the trash button from immediately deleting an MCP server’s saved settings. The Control UI asks you to confirm and lets you cancel before deleting them.
  [#177544](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177544) · [7eea3b6b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7eea3b6b224f75018882bfc300235c1ad2a9bfc6) · [Reported in #177541](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177541). Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Prevents old MCP app setup, settings and context-removal errors from following you to another app or chat session. Retrying clears the previous alert without discarding your settings draft.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180635) · [bf8bcb4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf8bcb406e2891ce0fd2a9523f43f79a4eba867b)
- Fixes the chat resource picker showing “No matching resources” before a new search has finished. You can still edit the query or close the picker while it searches.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179324">#179324</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Keeps MCP form uploads tied to the current session workspace.
  [#178173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178173) · [commit 6b5279a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b5279a65123a94aa6a2b1e23418889b9f3052cf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a warning that names the MCP server when a node can’t confirm cleanup. If you see it, check that server’s process on the node.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177019">#177019</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/mcp-and-skills">Node MCP guide</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes inflated omission counts in the OpenClaw tool list when MCP or client tools are available. Those tools remain searchable.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180395">PR #180395</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e9eb8a3e38c2e6e251f2baea5b0e265ecd86b1a">Commit 4e9eb8a</a>. Thanks [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley).</span>
- Fixes Code Mode losing the reason a catalog tool was not allowed to start or showing an unrelated output error instead. [Code Mode output](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode/output)
  Thanks to vincentkoc. [#180637](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180637) · [a46bd0a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a46bd0ad0bd964c66b5b180700c0e5a9acd566ee)
- Fixes affected custom node commands being mistaken for media commands and rejected. OpenClaw evaluates them under normal node invocation policy.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177433">#177433</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ac6c8b97ea8376f50af41b7a7d97d811dbda0fff">Commit ac6c8b9</a>
- Stops computer use from offering agents the Gateway desktop when none is configured. An explicit request for that desktop returns guidance for retrying with a paired computer and leaves the input unsent. [Computer use guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/computer-use)
  [#178783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178783), [Report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178604), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/394ce3840ed348b5d345b43a03d548a70dd9062d). Thanks to [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@saftall](https://github.com/saftall).
- Fixes a Mac app crash when Peekaboo lists windows with OpenClaw chat open. Peekaboo skips windows in the OpenClaw instance running it, so use CUA for those windows. Inspection and focus stay on the selected external window. Desktop control is still an option when a window action has no effect.
  <span>[#179061](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179061) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@septembermartin](https://github.com/septembermartin) · [Computer use guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/computer-use)</span>
- Prevents first-use ACP sessions from failing just because ACPX is still starting. If the readiness check fails, the sessions still fail to start. Use `/acp doctor` to diagnose the backend.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177499">#177499</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99adde0a5604f7f10ccab2bd7a6374a71d4817a9">Commit 99adde0</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/acp-agents/quickstart">ACP agents quickstart</a>
- Retries Crabbox worker profile setup without protected secrets when a temporary conflict over its lease would otherwise stop it before setup begins. If the conflict persists, setup stops and reports it.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177497">#177497</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c036ce20ea884618055b68556e78bca42b2e6672">Commit c036ce2</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting">Cloud-worker troubleshooting</a>
- Prevents Crabbox from allocating workers for OS overrides that are incompatible with the profile’s setup script and hides those OS and machine choices. If you use a Linux, macOS or WSL2 profile with setup, use a [separate profile with PowerShell setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation#native-windows-prerequisites) for native Windows. Profiles without setup keep their supported choices.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180073">#180073</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97d54bbd14bb20748d850eb7de8c185ea56c5181">commit 97d54bbd</a>. Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes worker setup having to wait to retry a failed machine or operating-system lookup while the other lookup is still running.
  [#177635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177635) · [415e63d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/415e63d4a251fbc0938950ceac48498751189b8e). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes later worker placement lookups showing edits a plugin made to a freshly loaded result.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177489">#177489</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a13e869e7d514ad4811f43443b56d68d149c916e">Commit a13e869</a>
- Fixes worker inference cancellations that could go unconfirmed when a result with invalid provider usage data was being saved.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177348">#177348</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db5bdb30a6bf9f8c52812f63e0591ccf4a53a621">Commit db5bdb3</a>
- Fixes cloud session dispatches failing with a workspace-changed error when another session registers its own empty workspace at the same time. Starting a child session gets the same scoped check, and a change to the selected workspace still blocks stale preparation. [Cloud dispatch guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/dispatching-a-session)
  [#179240](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179240), [`4e6f52e`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e6f52e0beef600c2277257ea815c42ef42ad83a), [Issue #179229](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179229). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a Gateway restart from giving overdue cloud worker cleanup for a stopped conversation a new retry window when its Stop request was recorded. If the cleanup attempt on restart fails, OpenClaw leaves the failure visible. After resolving the problem with the provider, use **Stop** to retry. [Cloud worker troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting)
  [#179132](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179132), [`9ac74df`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9ac74df2409a05d21b3bb05e3a161340839294b2). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway worker startup failure that could occur while preparing a newly assigned workspace.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179383">#179383</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes worker recovery using outdated session assignments when a session moves as the Gateway forcibly abandons a worker. Recovery checks the current owner before acting on the session or its pending results.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179448">#179448</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen">@Patrick-Erichsen</a>.
- Fixes a delayed loading error in MCP settings making a successful server change look like it failed. If the confirmation for removing a server fails to open, MCP settings now show the error and let you try again.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180712) · [33baeed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33baeed599ee2922d6fafeaa209c322e1fa621c3)
- Fixes MCP app context disappearing from the chat composer when a background refresh fails. Late refreshes can no longer bring back cleared context or replace newer context.
  [#180770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180770) · [commit 21a1fa8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21a1fa8285d20fa9cf61b7b7c7c39fe109c0fa34) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a rejected resource connection during native worker startup from taking the shared worker service down. The affected worker reports the error and exits while other workers can still run.
  [#180773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180773) · [commit a06d324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a06d324b5cf0c18bba22038a8ede74a5e9489c82) · Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an expanded MCP server’s tool list in the chat composer’s Plugins menu staying empty after the current direct session run discovers tools. The list refreshes when the run finishes, without having to collapse and reopen it. [Chat guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/chat)
  [#180865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180865) · [commit 22338ef](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22338ef3220a6598bcf893e86018b1446c07ab63) · Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes worker delegation failing to start a child session when its required setup is already underway. The worker waits for the child to be ready before sending its first task.
  [#181019](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181019). Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Fixes parent agents losing access to a retained native child session under tree visibility after its finished run ages out of the recent list. Parents can find the child, read or search its history, check its status, and send notifications or follow-ups within their existing permissions. If another session already controls the child’s work, it keeps control.
  [#181117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181117) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e26493aafd06079dc94195f03b871bba6c3c618)). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Stops Codex from trying another model when active work blocks a manual resume of a native thread with changed settings. Wait for the active work to finish or stop it before retrying.
  [#181204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181204) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/20aecc9faad9c7b421e671d0755f720982c9fae5)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics). Reported by [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal) ([#181046](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181046)).
- Fixes workers being denied when sending messages to their own live parent or siblings under a non-default agent in global session mode.
  [#181207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181207) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea0ba3f63f61adbe2a72922f03201d3e8903314b)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a restart bug that could send the same subagent interruption notice twice and make the parent agent run an extra turn. Recovery also retries undelivered interruption notices and finishes any needed browser cleanup before announcing the interruption.
  [#181482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181482) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex starting a new conversation thread after a subagent with restricted tools finishes. Your next turn resumes the original thread and picks up the subagent’s result, which is marked as seen after a successful turn. The subagent’s tool restrictions still apply.
  [#181591](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181591) · [Report #181580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181580) · Thanks to [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) for reporting and co-authoring the fix, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for contributing.
- Fixes Swarm collectors returning just a short preview of a child’s answer. Collection can recover up to 100 KB of the recorded answer and flags results it can’t return in full. Collector children accept a single request. If a follow-up is refused, collect the result or start a new child. [Swarm guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/swarm)
  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#181622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181622) · [`792b48a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/792b48a34a695b6ad7a6836443b83c1647a1b9cc)
- Fixes agent creation failing with an unavailable error on Gateways that store their state in PostgreSQL, including when the CLI sends the request to the Gateway.
  Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@etzelm for independent verification](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181676#issuecomment-6371657515). [#181676](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181676) · [`317eaa0`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/317eaa07692ca8004df4c703b659bab2525cd21d)
- Fixes the dead end when you submit another objective for an existing Goal in the Control UI. The Goal composer and `/goal` ask you to confirm the replacement, and canceling keeps your draft and leaves running work alone. Confirming keeps the same Goal’s history and budget. Idle and paused Goals keep their status, and a running Goal stops its current turn before resuming on the new objective if it can safely continue and has budget left. If the UI warns it couldn’t save interrupted output, copy any visible text you want to keep. [Goal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/goal)
  Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson). [#181688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181688) · [`ed3e84a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed3e84ab24c235cbfe683346c65a199dbbd9b7d8)
- Fixes Codex losing the final answer after a tool action finishes when an earlier tool exchange was left unfinished. Recovery can leave out earlier conversation details and reuses the completed action’s result. [Codex reply recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/replies)
  Thanks [@indra622](https://github.com/indra622) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix and [@scoootscooob](https://github.com/scoootscooob) for the related report. [#181718](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181718) · [`c12e36d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c12e36d64d31eed6e2d4bdda6c0f1ac80b4a0761) · [Related issue #128916](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/128916)
- Fixes a case where Stop ended the selected run but left its native Codex subagents running.
  Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#181766](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181766) · [`b92d4c9`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b92d4c9d4d7afceb5d08b9e486e84c5370247e5d)
- Fixes unnecessary context-overflow retries during tool use that could happen even when a context engine stayed within its allotted history limit. The fix applies to engines that manage their own compaction.
  Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman). [#181800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181800) · [`441a345`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/441a3457ab0f5019c6830b71575f6dab87dd5abb)
- Rejects malformed Codex errors in known formats while continuing to accept unfamiliar error types.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181823">#181823</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70f8ce638c3961f196ed8e4dc8d1f1202f39c0f0">70f8ce63</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/joshavant">@joshavant</a>.</span>
- Fixes the off-center **Create new agent** form in the Control UI. The form fills the dialog on desktop and mobile.
  Thanks to AmelioMansour and obviyus. [#182014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182014) · [f25028d1bd9c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f25028d1bd9c559bb00687957cdcbaed6c673ca8)
- Clarifies for a resuming Codex agent that it paused intentionally to wait for a follow-up, even if the transcript shows an interruption. [Codex harness](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182122) · [`c19a52bf`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c19a52bf52b76c3982b0f44c3afa741b211523c2)
- Stops private subagent completions from asking the parent to send a message when there is nowhere to send it. The parent is directed to leave the reviewed result in the requesting session. [Subagent announcements](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182124) · [`c8910267`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c8910267e9a726898e7cd6c99fbcf2e1bd4c70dd)
- Keeps permission changes during worker setup inside its Corepack copy by skipping linked files and folders.
  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#182185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182185) · [`65c7ed79`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65c7ed799833c87cc5bb46e60354aef6048cf23f)
- Fixes tools dropping out of the same session’s tool list on background or recovery turns, including screen tools, session creation and plugin tools. Tool calls still require current permission and a connected client wherever the tool needs one. [Prompt caching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182191) · [`e4d101a4`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e4d101a4916281a5b0f2be4ae633db7a750fdb55)
- Fixes altered characters and lost tab indentation when an agent quotes a subagent’s finished work, so code and other formatted text can come through as written.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182223">#182223</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>.
- Fixes Linux managed commands being refused because a loader-free or compiled helper has a TypeScript filename. Node helpers with startup hooks can be refused even if they’re already built. [Managed process guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182306">#182306</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Updates `sessions_spawn` target guidance to distinguish which agents a request can use from which agents are configured, and leaves out generic ACP examples when requester-specific guidance is present.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182327">#182327</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Recovers interrupted Crabbox warm-image captures automatically when the source worker can no longer capture and Crabbox finds no matching checkpoint or one safe to remove. If recovery still needs your help, Doctor and warm-image inspection show any candidate checkpoint IDs they found. [Recover a paused capture](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/warm-images#recover-a-paused-capture)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182353">#182353</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a warning when a sandboxed command requests a terminal that the sandbox can’t provide. The command runs without a terminal, and the warning suggests using a noninteractive command. [Exec tool](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182380">#182380</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38601">#38601</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@imhaojie](https://github.com/imhaojie) (reporter).
- Fixes `openclaw sandbox explain` rejecting channel-prefixed session aliases or inspecting the wrong session when `main` points to a custom session key. [Sandbox CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182406">#182406</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51245">related report #51245</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@Tin55FoilDev](https://github.com/Tin55FoilDev) (related issue reporter).
- Fixes repository-backed cloud sessions losing unpushed Git commits when you reclaim a worker. Eligible commits can be restored when you restart or fork the session, replace the worker, or move the session to the Gateway. If OpenClaw can only recover the file changes, it keeps them for review and tells you the commits weren’t restored. Restoration requires access to the pinned base. [Cloud session lifecycle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle)
  Commit restoration requires compatible installations and a managed branch still at the pinned base. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182387">#182387</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110498">#110498</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a credential error that blocked shell commands on native Windows cloud workers even with a valid managed GitHub identity. Profiles that fail the existing security checks are still rejected.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182435">PR #182435</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2dc1bd54975b083cea0bcaa78768c73a1c837d73">2dc1bd54</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@mick-lu-lingyue](https://github.com/mick-lu-lingyue) for the report and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for reproducing the launcher failure.</span>
- Restores the original error when a worker fails to start. If the worker node is lost during launch, OpenClaw can use its existing recovery path again.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182504">PR #182504</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a6ce7b060cff0a862a3222b25d47c02776d3de3f">a6ce7b06</a></span>
- Fixes restored group chat history making different participants look like the same user to a CLI agent, even when their sender information was saved.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182455">PR #182455</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/448178f8c2aff41303f6a03d8befe5a3cb9fc84b">448178f8</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@roshke](https://github.com/Roshke).</span>
- Fixes Lobster workflows failing to ask for input, check answers or resume with a valid answer on standalone AOT builds. Fixes model-output validation on those builds too.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182928) · [Lobster](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/lobster)
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed node workers failing to record how a turn ended. Recovering the recorded outcome of a worker run that has already ended also takes one fewer database query.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183172">#183172</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a0b170fac1aca670fbb863bb4ddaa0bebcbc2f61">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes agents silently skipping work such as loading a skill when a model returns an available Tool Search call as text. OpenClaw retries when safe and reports a failure if the model repeats the call as text.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183165">#183165</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb8047e801af6415f7b9117a012c8e823054beaa">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183085">Issue #183085 reported by lyrakat</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/Linux2010">@Linux2010</a> and <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Prevents a finished background command from being announced again after your agent has already collected its output from the process log. Adds the command’s exit result to finished logs, including paged output in Code Mode.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183113">#183113</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bd31f8c581e7833ed7f6f28e71e68352dba7392c">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/turian">@turian</a> and <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.
- Fixes misleading access errors in the Gateway logs when the Control UI looks up MCP apps while restoring or switching conversations. Keeps app launches on the conversation’s agent even if a different agent is selected.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183168">#183168</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a14fa613c67820dd4b7884ee3ae661f3f942655c">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182555">Issue #182555 reported by nik-greek</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt">@xiaopan-xydt</a> and <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes command launches reporting a cleanup error when permission expires just after the command is accepted for launch. OpenClaw reports the permission rejection and continues cleaning up the command and any processes it started.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183247">#183247</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d204234f2d209b996da7337de5becf53ea37ca4">5d20423</a> · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes results going missing from large or nested subagent batches when execution identity collection is enabled.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183454">#183454</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4643dbc6d5ab429f56a421431265e97ed5127d05">4643dbc</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce">Subagent announcements</a>. Thanks to [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by @travellingsoldier85 in <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183416">#183416</a>.</span>
- Fixes stalled worker cleanup holding up Gateway shutdown or suspension when using Crabbox or another provider that supports cancellation. OpenClaw retries cleanup after restart or resume if it could not confirm the worker had stopped.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183579)
- Fixes unfinished [Goals](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/goal.md) in built-in chat getting stuck after delegated work finishes in the same process. Eligible Goals can continue in the original conversation without another prompt, and Stop still prevents that follow-up.
  [#183706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183706). Thanks to [@HermanZeng](https://github.com/HermanZeng) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183705).

  [PR #174211](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174211). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes agent turns ending without an answer when an invalid tool call is rejected before it runs, after a progress update. The agent can try once more to finish the reply.
  [#183807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183807). Thanks to [@Mirr0ch1](https://github.com/Mirr0ch1) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/889968f2d69ca626afde3d385f5a1fc42ea7d5e1).
- Avoids holding up unrelated Gateway requests while subagent cleanup loads plugins.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183996">#183996</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes subagent handoffs getting stuck when a cancellation is recorded after the subagent has already finished. Recovery clears the stuck handoff without restarting the cancelled work.
  <span><a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/subagent-yield-handoff">Subagent handoffs</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184063">#184063</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/kintaro001-oss">@kintaro001-oss</a> and <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes MCP Relay connected-app controls losing focus during unrelated updates and keeps the app rows visible but disabled while an action is pending.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184126](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184126) · [29397d2a185c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29397d2a185c29d4b4d79d2ad41af0f7cf1f6a9b)
- Fixes cloud worker setup failing when a required launcher helper was left out of the worker bundle. Requests for the same bundle can reuse it after a successful build. If you ship a custom distribution, include its launcher helpers in the package file list. [Cloud worker setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/setup-and-bundle-installation)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184181](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184181) · [c678c6ea842b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c678c6ea842baab5e4b072f1f5c60c235b504c6f)
- Fixes background commands continuing to run and hold a worker slot after you stop an active turn on a paired node or node-backed cloud worker.
  [Background processes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/background-process.md) · [#184313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184313) · [30134f2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/30134f21dbd0d52fbf47f7ce8cb466a1499e6fcf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes false requests to continue from a subagent that is already waiting for work it delegated. The yield tool explains when it skips a requested message wait so that the delegated work can finish.
  [Subagent tool reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md) · [#184265](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184265) · [d840b33](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d840b332594facec08d483f5e60b38682b62dd86). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes Stop waiting on a native subagent that is trying to create a worktree from a repository another operation is using.
  [#184345](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184345), [#184320](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184320). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents failed native subagent starts from leaving an extra session behind when worktree setup fails after the session is created.
  [#184420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184420), [#184380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184380). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the [Claude CLI backend](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) losing the main reply when discarded messages from native subagents used up the turn’s output limit.
  [#184352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184352), [#168661](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168661), [commit d1470c8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1470c8514ce8a683c1f189caf7ff7a66b04a2c3). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the shipped fix and [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott) for the original work.
- Fixes the [background process panel](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) asking you to reconnect or update a node after its work is done and its idle worker has shut down. If the node is still connected, the panel shows an empty list instead.
  [#184355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184355). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex subagent replies and already accepted follow-up work getting lost when the parent session’s details are updated without changing its owner.
  [#184604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184604) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5ac1ab1fe31e7358e276f63ffbdf5b1677ee58bb) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes agent runs timing out too early when the system clock jumps forward between a tool call and the next model response.
  [#184611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184611) ([`053da3a9`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/053da3a9bad240aa67482ae11b07dc5fce1e2200)). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for co-authoring it.
- Fixes MCP connections reopening while the Gateway is shutting down and closing sessions.
  [#184607](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184607) ([`675ae662`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/675ae662185b64e790be5a87fe95777f64c61957)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Explains why a delegated edit was blocked when the repository wasn’t assigned to the subagent. The error tells the worker to ask its parent to restart the authorized task with the repository as its [working directory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/tool-reference#tool-sessions-spawn).
  [#184901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184901) · [c0ffba6e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c0ffba6e18a33cac1d5f47e47ccef5bbbdc93e2a). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new chat messages getting stuck behind replaced subagent results after a restart, and fixes recovered subagent batches blocking or stalling later results. Accepted child runs can also continue when their recovered parent finishes, while their permissions remain valid.
  Replaced results and queued messages. Thanks to enki. [#180704](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180704) · [0f6a954](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f6a95442d4cb6be33551a7237496c52d6dc630a) · Accepted child runs. Thanks to enki and jalehman. [#180728](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180728) · [714e95d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/714e95d994f058f775ebd327307f27eda39dc677) · Recovered batches. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182285">#182285</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Shows an error when the Goal editor cannot open, and fixes screen readers being told a valid objective is invalid when saving fails.
  Opening the editor. Thanks to steipete. [#180729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180729) · [e68052a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e68052a07f02a5cfcaccbaddf2df8a9374dc462a) · Save errors and accessibility. [#180806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180806) · [commit 99baae1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99baae10742ca88845296ea0c89d02edafaca010) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Claude CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) replies getting stuck when a subagent or workflow handles the result of an agent it started in the background. When that result is meant for the main conversation, the reply stays open to receive it.
  Nested replies. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182267">#182267</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/goslingmanagment">@goslingmanagment (report)</a>. · Forwarded results. <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182516">PR #182516</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d7f8fbf399df62820f8982cab7f7c2de83648b0">3d7f8fbf</a> · Thanks [@goslingmanagment](https://github.com/goslingmanagment) and [@dmsrg399](https://github.com/dmsrg399) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for preserving forwarded answers.</span>
- Fixes runs being marked successful when an output limit cuts off tool work and OpenClaw recovers only a summary. After large tool results, the summary is less likely to lose your original request and can better distinguish finished work from what remains. The turn remains incomplete. [Agent harness guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/sessions-and-results)
  Run failure status. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182231">#182231</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/ablake4427">@ablake4427</a>. · Recovery summary. [#184704](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184704) ([`5a8be2a1`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a8be2a1eb7b06d44b79438fcf69db3651946b2e)), [Issue #178300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178300). Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar) for the fix, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it, and [@ablake4427](https://github.com/ablake4427) for reporting the broader symptom.
- Fixes unnecessary memory retention after tool calls, session access checks, settled inputs, agent initialization and completed runs. It also rejects late plugin callbacks for tool calls whose validation has ended.
  Tool calls. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182396">#182396</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Session access checks. <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182538">PR #182538</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/69a7406cd072cc51aad65b229065b5811c0eba60">69a7406c</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span> · Settled inputs. <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182560">PR #182560</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7299b241097f0badbe8db2660bfaaaad8a92b476">7299b241</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@theeye-io](https://github.com/theeye-io) for <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180898">the related memory report</a>.</span> · Agent initialization. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183083">#183083</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e2f634809c8ff06dfd8e9e6c0461d551cfd9196f">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/shakkernerd">@shakkernerd</a>. · Completed runs and late callbacks. [#184990](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184990) · [Harness attempt runtime](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/plugins/sdk-agent-harness/attempt-runtime.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes follow-ups sent to steer an active native Codex turn going unanswered because an earlier final reply cut the turn short or hid the follow-up answer. An explicit yield can still end the turn.
  [#184992](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184992) · [#180935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180935) · [349c1a4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/349c1a4fe3d445a047def0bd6f19ed83527ff6e3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@LeoStehlik](https://github.com/LeoStehlik).
- Fixes a case where Codex finished its tool work and returned an empty final reply. OpenClaw can recover the answer from the completed work. The recovery prompt now asks the agent to summarize recorded results without calling more tools.
  [#185310](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185310) · [40b1f01](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40b1f0175ef3350140d31299406cfbfe4e2f718c) · [#185351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185351) · [9b69228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9b6922809f475894be6bede11f7626ac93beeaf4). [Report #185286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185286). Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the Codex fix, [@wg-mojo](https://github.com/WG-Mojo) for the report and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the recovery prompt correction.
- Fixes saved Codex conversations getting stuck after a local connection failure ends a turn without a retry. A later turn can pick up the same conversation and its completed work on a fresh connection. OpenClaw leaves the connection alone if replacing it would interrupt active work or discard Incognito history. Unexpected failures relaying Codex requests also get clearer log messages.
  [PR #187375](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187375). Thanks to wtfichigo and obviyus.
- Fixes Codex dropping saved images from earlier assistant replies when it rebuilds a conversation, so an image-capable model can refer to those images in follow-ups.
  [PR #187348](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187348). Thanks to Patrick-Erichsen.
- Fixes Codex’s built-in web search being disabled for [custom providers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness/runtime-behavior) that declare and support standalone search. Inference support alone isn’t enough to enable it.
  [PR #187337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187337). Thanks to Patrick-Erichsen.
- Fixes earlier warnings crowding the final error out of long Codex app-server startup and exit messages.
  [#187873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187873). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Codex summaries undercounting rejected tool attempts, including when a retry succeeds, and prevents an executed failed command from being classified as safe to replay.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/60bc1ec1cd5cf790b9d984e5d1f30404f3008c8f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex Code Mode dropping a follow-up result or showing it in place of the previous task’s result, fixes native tool hooks failing after startup, and keeps a subagent’s own callbacks from being mistaken for its parent’s follow-up. Separate follow-up tracking requires the [native PostToolUse hook](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-runtime/hooks).
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/42f4afe088a8e3301504827f98a2dc74dec3d702). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes Codex return a cancellation error when it cannot verify which subagents belong to the session.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/389ff68c3bc1a5751590d3abe0939582afa80c95).
- Fixes long Claude CLI turns that hit the output line limit too early and end without an answer when using newer versions of Claude Code.
  [#186085](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186085) · [`72c9a55d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72c9a55d4e5d8c98b447c5e0e7c2a5aa5a37cfa2). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes CLI-backed replies being stopped as stalled while the model is still producing new reasoning. Adds an optional check so [CLI backend plugins](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/cli-backend-plugins) can tell OpenClaw whether a quiet turn is still active before recovery starts. Existing time limits still apply.
  [#186446](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186446). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents a CLI-backed agent from restarting your task on a fallback model when it pauses on purpose. The task can continue in the same session, and real CLI failures can still use the fallback.
  [#186660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186660). Thanks to Marvinthebored (PR author), Peetiegonzalez (commit author) and obviyus (co-author).
- Fixes Claude CLI losing a subagent result or mistaking it for your message during a turn. New plugin-backed turns also keep OpenClaw notes out of your message, and newly forwarded prompts stay out of recent conversation sent to a fallback provider. Older forwarded messages without a matching OpenClaw transcript entry may still appear as yours.
  [Subagent message attribution #185945](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185945) · [Original fix and tests #185915](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185915) · [Plugin-backed message history #186439](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186439). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored).
- Fixes subagent results failing to reach an authorized requester whose write access is limited to its own session, and prevents work that requires a result from being accepted without one. It also avoids retries and misleading warnings when the parent handles a result silently, and stops expired results from holding up the parent conversation. Silent results remain available in the Subagents panel.
  [Silent results #185388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185388) · [Expired results #185549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185549) · [commit b7861d6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b7861d6b56cd3897637282c8a93fb5bc8572e0f0) · [Requester delivery #185569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185569) · [commit 5c0201b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5c0201b1e7d8e4ca54e2a79f24666c74c02ae742) · [Required results #185667](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185667) · [commit b3b0f1b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3b0f1bb8105cf784f87f47a8f31a9564888f2e3) · [Subagent result delivery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/announce). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops subagent failures, timeouts and requests for attention from stacking up above the parent chat’s message box. Check those notices under **Subagents**. The parent chat shows its own notices. [Sessions and sidebar guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar).
