  [#185192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185192) · [dd57146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dd571463dbea5a70ff51af3fc215d889b153a708) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes paused subagents appearing finished in Control UI chat handoffs. When only paused subagents are left, the wait stays visible without a running timer, and chat notes which ones are still paused after the parent resumes.
  [#186387](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186387). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes subagent completions getting stuck in retries after cleanup, even when the result already reached the requesting conversation. If OpenClaw can’t send the result in this situation, it tries to leave a failure notice in that conversation.
  [#186443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186443). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes parent agents losing child results they still need when completed tasks are cleaned up, including after a paused child resumes the same task.
  [PR #187270](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187270). Thanks to fuller-stack-dev.
- Replaces a misleading “not found” from [`agents_wait`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/swarm) with completion-message guidance when you wait only on your own eligible children that report back to this conversation instead of being collected.
  [#186652](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186652) and [#186669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186669). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes subagent starts rejecting models such as Muse Wonder Full as unknown when the selected native runtime already offers them. The [Muse sign-in guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/muse) also clarifies that OpenClaw and the `muse` CLI use separate sign-ins.
  [#185411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185411). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes a parent agent being unable to cancel new work in a retained native subagent after an administrator resets the subagent’s session.
  [#185630](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185630) · [2cd6f9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cd6f9a2d4ddfa605b948e2cfd1a845adbe47554) · [Issue #185542](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185542) · [Subagent operations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/operations) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes hidden native subagents being rejected when the agent passes checkout details without requesting a managed worktree. Set [`worktree: true`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/subagents/tool-reference.md) to use those checkout details.
  [#186124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186124) · [`b4c0b92a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4c0b92a2fc7a2b4db4b19c33013961b7a77a0c8). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets stopped subagents finish cleaning up even after the Gateway stops accepting new work.
  [PR #187090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187090). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes **Resume** rejecting a stopped Goal after its work has settled, so you can continue it in the same conversation. The Control UI disables **Resume** while another turn is sending, queued or running, and unsupported requests show a rejection instead of an unconfirmed update.
  [Goal resume #185273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185273) · [commit acf995b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/acf995b629063dd5ac1db2737fd561b491566d6b) · [Integration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185273#issuecomment-6484732344) · [Control UI #185594](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185594) · [commit 6705c8b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6705c8b73782684aad9528ed77f292c883fc12e7) · [Goal guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/goal). Thanks [@jjjhenriksen](https://github.com/jjjhenriksen) for the repair, [@brokemac79](https://github.com/brokemac79) for keeping it working through the admission refactor and integrating it, and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the Control UI change.
- Fixes built-in Goals stalling after a background command finishes, even though the Goal still appears active. If the completion was silent, the Goal continues without posting an automatic follow-up.
  [PR #187069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187069). Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes authorized background command follow-ups, subagent handoffs and Goals being refused permission to continue. Follow-ups use the initiating person’s [current permissions and review rules](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session-tool), so guest work does not inherit the session owner’s access. Owner-only access returns for a tracked background command if its requester is still an owner. After a restart, work without an original caller uses the session’s current authorized user if available; otherwise a person must resume it. Delayed node command results return to the intended session and agent.
  [Owner access after commands #185476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185476) · [commit aa8b35b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aa8b35bb20fd48e694b4eaa8e3421693b297f9d1) · [Continued work permissions #187346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187346). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and steipete.
- Fixes child sessions being unable to find or manage eligible background commands started by an ancestor session in the same agent. Adds a clearer warning when a Gateway restart leaves a background command started on this version untracked. The command may still be running, so check saved output and side effects before rerunning it.
  [#185832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185832) · [`bf72fa7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf72fa79485ab2a132f1bb57b0844aca1c60107c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Prevents a separate final-answer pass after tool use from sending old messages that the context engine had already left out. The pass keeps the selected context and current tool results within the existing limits.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186288">#186288</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1714e2026713c5af46eba5465d44a0253d6fa939">commit 1714e20</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186244">issue #186244</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star">@ericcaiwx-star</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (co-author), <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> (contributor), <a href="https://github.com/digitalfrost84">@digitalfrost84</a> (contributor).</span>
- Fixes unnecessarily low reply limits after a tool call on OpenAI-compatible models when OpenClaw already has a usage measurement that still applies to the same turn.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186300">#186300</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39e4093b654e907fbf30831ad237dcb5cb79c916">commit 39e4093</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173839">issue #173839</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/session-management-compaction/compaction">Compaction reference</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/lyrakat">@lyrakat</a> (measurements and follow-up), <a href="https://github.com/chunlei-wu">@chunlei-wu</a> (related report).</span>
- Fixes tool-heavy Anthropic conversations summarizing or dropping useful history too early when you connect directly with an API key and set a transcript size limit.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186304">#186304</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b296e41b8f46966bb6c4eac933510032f108a4e7">commit b296e41</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185044">issue #185044</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction">Compaction guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/travellingsoldier85">@travellingsoldier85</a> (report).</span>
- Keeps the end of ordinary long tool results, such as a final status code, available to the model during compaction and branch summarization. The middle can still be shortened, and the full output stays in the transcript.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186382">#186382</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3f004e468f410a0101cdadc9127aa590702ae31">commit b3f004e</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/compaction">Compaction guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/KarimVKarmali">@KarimVKarmali</a> (contributor).</span>
- Fixes duplicate attachments from the local agent command when the message tool sends the same file to the same destination and defaults to the reply account. A send through a different account can still be followed by the requested reply.
  [#185410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185410) · [e14a718](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e14a718393ff02f8a3d97ceffebc6aad310c8641). Thanks to [@compoodment](https://github.com/compoodment) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Keeps an agent’s computer tool from changing its list of actions mid-session as desktops connect or reconnect. Results show what the selected desktop can do and explain when an action is unavailable. Newly available actions may need a refresh to appear in the list. Temporarily restricted tools stay visible to the agent while execution stays blocked. Guidance for waiting for follow-up work stays consistent when other tools come and go.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185894">#185894</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes agent turns failing when a Gateway tool policy allows only selected personal-instructions actions, such as reading without editing.
  [#186395](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186395). Thanks [@freeqaz](https://github.com/freeqaz).
- Prevents an ordinary tool error from ending an agent turn just because OpenClaw can’t read the extra error details.
  [#189129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189129). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes replies failing before reaching the model when launched outside the configured agent workspace.
  [Commit 786cfd7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/786cfd7d27b2dff40703a9f724c5abd3626d3ff1).
- Fixes [Code Mode](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode) rejecting valid JavaScript just because the agent left out a display title. Untitled runs show up as “run JavaScript.”
  [#185703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185703) · [`5756676`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5756676babc17d0646c273390121223e142155f6) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Fixes Code Mode losing track of failures or producing oversized error reports, preserves where errors came from, and lets later cells run after the affected errors. It also avoids an unnecessary pause when a required tool reply is already ready, including a QuickJS failure that could occur while saving state during that pause.
  [Error reports #185901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185901) · [Ready tool replies #185903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185903). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes misleading errors when a running Node Code Mode cell tries to import a module. The cell receives a catchable error explaining that modules are unavailable, and an uncaught rejection stops only that cell.
  [#186076](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186076) · [`ff451d28`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff451d28835af32edf52c79b20c2a14e790ff37a). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores missing native `exec` error details in Code Mode. When a working directory is unavailable or a command times out, your agent gets the reason and any recovery guidance alongside the command output.
  [#186515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186515), [issue #186509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186509). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Restores missing warnings for commands that are still running in Code Mode, including when the sandbox cannot provide an interactive terminal.
  [PR #187244](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187244). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes Code Mode holding on to idle workers and their memory when a burst of parallel work gives way to one call at a time. A later burst may take longer to start as workers are brought back.
  [#185239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185239) · [446936a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/446936a734afd10acdedeb6a2c70350bebe96a8c). [Code Mode worker lifecycle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode/internals). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a finished Node Code Mode run from waiting for an unrelated idle worker to close.
  [PR #196435](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196435), [commit 6c4aca95](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6c4aca9553de61693804d5675b140749d397de9c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and to release backport co-authors [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [MCP tool filters](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/registry) hiding a tool when you paste its unambiguous, unsuffixed name from `openclaw mcp probe`. Use original server names when displayed names collide, in wildcard filters, or on a node host. If a server lists tools and your include filter selects none of its tools, OpenClaw warns unless the filter selects a supported resource or prompt.
  [#186108](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186108) · [`c804a35f`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c804a35f58976e8782843f2b817f341b410875db) · [Issue #98193](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98193). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@BilalIrfanContact](https://github.com/BilalIrfanContact), [@Stegallo](https://github.com/Stegallo).
- Fixes MCP servers retrying a failed startup or tool catalog refresh too early or too late after a system clock change. The same change keeps pauses after repeated tool failures from being cut short or stretched out.
  [PR #187198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187198). Thanks [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops sending duplicate MCP lists and single values to the model when a tool returns the same result as text and as a single structured value, while keeping separate recovery guidance. Structured MCP output and Tool Search action results also use less space for formatting, so raw JSON in the Control UI may appear on one line.
  [#196243](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196243). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@GrahamMcBain](https://github.com/GrahamMcBain). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the MCP result-deduplication release backport.
- Prevents operator tool calls over HTTP or WebSocket from triggering false [agent loop warnings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/loop-detection) or crowding real agent calls out of loop detection.
  [#186104](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186104) · [`c28d2e42`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c28d2e4294e478ab3d50ba6a776b9c1892d71de7) · [Issue #186022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186022). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott).
- Fixes [PNG diff receipts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/diffs) reporting the requested scale when the image was shrunk to fit the size limit. The receipt reports the scale actually used without changing the image.
  [#186552](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186552). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes OpenClaw refusing to reuse registered legacy sandboxes with OpenShell v0.1.3. The sandbox still has to report that it’s ready before OpenClaw will use it.
  [#190101](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190101). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Lobster workflows running in the wrong folder when the working-directory path begins or ends with a space or tab, or selecting a different workflow when its filename starts with a space. A space after the file extension is rejected instead of silently selecting another file.
  [Working directories #187739](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187739) · [Workflow filenames #187785](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187785). Thanks to [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents slow workspace file reads during an agent patch and slow Git reads while preparing file operations in linked worktrees from holding up unrelated Gateway work.
  [Workspace reads #186620](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186620) · [Worktree reads #186636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186636). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes context engines holding finished work in memory after they close and cleanup has finished.
  [#185255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185255) · [7611ff9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7611ff9162757cc6ca9cf9d6832f5287bb3602e4). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops embedded agent runs from holding an extra copy of the conversation on each provider retry, which could tie up memory in long or image-heavy chats.
  [#185510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185510). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Gateway holding unneeded memory for subagent sessions left open to continue later, and OpenClaw retaining finished work after a follow-up is cancelled or result delivery times out.
  [Open sessions #185590](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185590) · [commit 427171f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/427171f517f00aeafb48f869559b7e0b39032996) · [Follow-up cleanup #185647](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185647) · [commit 7c1971c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c1971cf3128e34101019c09474f588d9c3c75ad). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw on Node.js holding on to finished agent attempts in memory while plugins run end-of-run or pre-finalization hooks.
  [#185655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185655) · [42d9921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/42d9921d333273e58ce1b8bec8d471aad3274cc7) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible idle workers holding on to large, unused buffers after tasks finish, so they can free that memory without restarting.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35d2e97a4af75d77d487154bebdbbefe94c8662e). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Prevents system clock changes from cutting short or stretching out the grace period for supervised child processes to shut down on Unix-like systems.
  [#185327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185327) · [09ca6c2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/09ca6c25243d1d2ee0479b956be09756f9ea725d). Thanks [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents clock changes from cutting short optional agent maintenance, such as saving to memory, once its time allowance has started.
  [#187643](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187643). Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Cancels extraction of a PDF carried over from an earlier turn when you stop the run that was reading it, instead of leaving it running in the background.
  [PR #187438](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187438). Thanks to yousan, obviyus and steipete.
- Fixes agent runs that could continue after a canceled client-hosted tool call was mistaken for an ordinary input error.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5f641739f5adfabb74dba532a7a1aed89a9e792). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves cancellation when a worker stops while refreshing inputs before a turn, instead of recording a workspace failure.
  [Commit 40d0119](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40d01198e9239dbc2db558f39c21a531bf323e98).
- Fixes remote worker sessions getting stuck when a worker takes over while the previous worker’s last transcript update is being published.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/876e13d3329d1bff324057741bd0139aa69a9cfe). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the refusal to remove an agent’s config entry with `config unset` or a keyed `null` entry in `config patch` when no Gateway is running. This leaves the agent’s state in place. Use `openclaw agents delete` if you want to remove that state too.
  [#185660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185660) · [953eba4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/953eba4bbeec1c8cf7b255cce1c8c3f1496aaf3b) · [Report #185659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185659) · [Config CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/config) · Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) for the report and fix, and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes [`openclaw agents set-identity`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/agents) importing from the wrong file or workspace when a quoted source path starts or ends with whitespace.
  [#186475](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186475). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Claude runs and skill setup on paired nodes failing after the request that started them ends.
  [Commit 33e52df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33e52df4cd03e9e6a7d30849c702b45196aa5883). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@zeroaltitude](https://github.com/zeroaltitude).
- Prevents MCP tools that support cancellation from holding up Gateway shutdown while they wait for a cancellation signal.
  [Commit 33e52df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/33e52df4cd03e9e6a7d30849c702b45196aa5883). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@zeroaltitude](https://github.com/zeroaltitude).
- Stops old databases from retired, unconfigured agents blocking ACP startup.
  [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098) (combined storage release backport), [Commit 5d93d5e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d93d5e29c4a5071b2af5dd8b8ea253cc046f524). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the storage backport.
- Fixes turns using a durable context engine failing before they reach the model when OpenClaw’s state directory is reached through a symlink.
  [#173795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173795) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8adcc746e684cf070445e08a0332e6b42276ea9c). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Crabbox workers getting stuck during teardown when a DigitalOcean fixed lease has ended or an `ascii-box` lease is missing. Stale session attachments clear after OpenClaw confirms cleanup.
  [#173825](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173825). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes OpenClaw failing to discover an active plugin’s tools because a different plugin is no longer active.
  [PR #174047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174047) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e4418ee81d7d4052323111e344bda29af224bc71). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes cancelled or timed-out commands taking extra time to stop on Unix-like systems if the system clock moves backward during cleanup.
  [PR #174151](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174151) and [commit 19c6d8f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/19c6d8f83ecdb399588b32aef8a3b25b7a8f4e56). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes detached subprocesses surviving [managed command cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) and keeping command output open when OpenClaw runs under Bun on Linux.
  [#174168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174168) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9215eace2fb2035fbb985ae757f5e16b1bf4cb83). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes running native agent hook relays expiring too soon or staying active too long when the system clock changes.
  [#174184](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174184) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aeace91ea5f7cebe544449b0c3ce93cd958c99ab). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Prevents stale progress updates from appearing after the narration timeout, even when most of the wait was spent getting the model ready.
  [#174261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174261). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps background session assessments within their existing concurrency limit when a canceled or timed-out model request is still running. Later assessments may have to wait for that request to finish.
  [#174262](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174262). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes OpenClaw reporting that a cancelled brokered child process has closed while its connection is still open.
  [PR #174359](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174359) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cb196c383039cdd85135258df6ce90a6f9d56f4b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing replies after tools finish when the model returns only reasoning or leaves stray tool-call text instead of an answer. OpenClaw can write the reply from the completed results without running those tools again.
  [PR #174376](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174376) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a9033d5d662c78f32a4ea0203fd76572ea003cf7) · Thanks [@arthur-drozdov](https://github.com/arthur-drozdov) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes interruptions to other agents’ session lists, live updates, terminal snapshots, and health and activity summaries when you delete an agent. Usage reports keep updating during deletion and leave out the agent you’re removing.
  [PR #174389](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174389) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e03489121cb9d87dc4bd6f8b57d35fc7f6b395e4) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops an unnecessary model request after Code Mode sends a confirmed final reply to the current conversation and its related work finishes. Progress updates still let the work continue, and finishing an earlier reply does not end a newer request.
  [PR #174487](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174487). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Tool Search rejecting worker tool failures for not looking like successful results, so those failures are returned as errors.
  [PR #174547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174547) · [commit 1bd22b2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bd22b28d632ba4082e923d88a2485be61f8c8af). Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Fixes native subagents reverting a thinking level you saved while they were waiting to start. Fixes subagent launches being rejected just because the parent refreshed its skills during preparation. The child uses the skill versions from the turn that started it, and the parent keeps its updated selection.
  [#174575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174575) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a20b5882d51a361a5172b271ac5a2358348a7756) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes cloud workers still appearing available after you ask them to stop. The environment summary shows them as stopping while teardown is pending and still shows cleanup errors if they occur.
  [PR #174768](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174768) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1956ba00b72be3f21847b7641986db5c8cd26940). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report.
- Stops cloud-worker checkouts and moves back to the Gateway from silently using anonymous GitHub access when your configured account is unavailable. Reconnect or refresh the account in Settings and retry. Anonymous checkout of public repositories remains available if no GitHub identity is configured. Fixes valid checkout credentials being discarded when optional Git author details are invalid.
  [PR #174770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174770) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd53ad130f42bd54d5b379f2ef83259998388242). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@yunligou711-commits](https://github.com/yunligou711-commits) for the report.
- Fixes Codex replies failing when another agent is deleted, while still respecting the requester’s web-search settings. If the model or the requester’s access changes before a turn that uses hosted search starts, Codex stops the outdated request and asks you to retry. Keeps provider and model restrictions in effect for supervised Codex sessions with a model already selected.
  [PR #174774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174774) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d39d51f6d08d4f0331a06bba9bf8da47394ed77c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an interrupted private child completion retry conflicting with the accepted request after the same sender changes their display name. The retry retains the original name, or its absence, while checking the request and current access.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents delayed cleanup of an old [cloud worker](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle) from interrupting a replacement turn or discarding its pending workspace results during a forced teardown. Cleanup can still finish if the original turn has already ended.
  [PR #174826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174826) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b69c1547ab535658f9c6048f7ccae52247e846de). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a completed CLI reply from being discarded just because the command-line executable or runner changed before the reply was returned.
  [PR #174838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174838) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f54db524286ca3ac43eb458b208e3f91b82b4f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps a subagent Stop from reporting failure just because its runner changed after cleanup finished.
  [PR #174838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174838) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f54db524286ca3ac43eb458b208e3f91b82b4f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps a subagent handoff focused on the children already selected even if another child appears.
  [PR #174838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174838) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6f54db524286ca3ac43eb458b208e3f91b82b4f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes completed subagent notifications being recorded as unnecessary during cleanup even though they had already been delivered.
  [PR #174850](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174850) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b83983070664230fc3934fad18427835ceabbed). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [sandboxed agents](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/system-prompt#documentation) being sent to documentation paths they can’t open. When local references aren’t reachable, the agent gets public docs and source links instead. If it can’t check the docs locally or on the web, it’s told to mark answers from memory as unverified.
  [#174856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174856) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aaf3536aca4d1dd007fcd12bee60a696a841975b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), and [@seriouslysean](https://github.com/seriouslysean) for reporting.
- Fixes completed subagent results getting lost when the conversation changes before the reply can be saved. If the first attempt did not send anything or take any other action, OpenClaw can try a fresh reply without rerunning the subagent.
  [#175166](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175166) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes MCP resource searches using the previous server when you submit right after switching servers. The picker also ignores old results after you edit the search or switch away through a session without a resource picker and then return.
  [#175243](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175243) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes [agent deletion](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/agents) reporting that session work was still active after the turn had stopped. If deletion rolls back, OpenClaw saves the turn’s final status before the agent can accept work again. If work really is still running, wait for the session named in the error to finish, then retry.
  [#175257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175257) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0f79db769598861107f9025fa23358e59106bb58). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Stop from waiting for a bound ACP run to finish canceling before interrupting native work and clearing its queued requests.
  [PR #175306](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175306) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4ad659fd42a4f0ed161a39c33891e9d29f790d08). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a cloud worker Stop confirmation from acting on an outdated target or access. If the placement changes while the confirmation is open, it closes without stopping the worker.
  [#175843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175843) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/195f85848cdf1d540e49df14f06b136a672bb87e) · [11.5 Stop handler](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/ui/src/pages/chat/chat-pane-placement.runtime.ts). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes allowed OpenClaw tools being out of reach in [Codex sessions with native Code Mode turned off](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness-reference/dynamic-tools). Those sessions also stop telling the agent to use native tool discovery it cannot access.
  [#175903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175903) · Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Fixes Code Mode losing pending work between successful calls, so the next wait can pick up where it left off instead of starting the work over.
  [PR #175949](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175949) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e9dde4437abd47e608db9859f4a90f509bf558e) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Decision assistance keeping unnecessary tools available for straightforward conversation when the decision model returned extra details along with its answers.
  [#176022](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176022) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents cancelling one [queued subagent follow-up](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/subagents/operations) by run ID from stopping the active run or dropping other queued follow-ups.
  [PR #176438](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176438) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/484391958320f9b06a64c4263c46d889305db279) · [issue #176216](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176216) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Fealves0](https://github.com/Fealves0).
- Restores live previews for running subagents shown in chat, including narration or tool activity when available. Fixes subagent titles getting cut off while there’s still room in the row.
  [PR #176442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176442) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/990f9046637ed99e2c75c32a2212b9e80a382b53) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes successful agent turns being marked as failed or left waiting when cleanup after connection recovery fails or stalls. Restores retries on the previous connection when a failed refresh also fails to clean up.
  [PR #176496](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176496) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b42c33803a88dc210a96baeede6a9ba3cc48b483) · [Issue #176269](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176269). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@surlymochan](https://github.com/surlymochan).
- Waits for queued discussion changes before taking the first ClickClack snapshot. Reports a denied discussion operation instead of treating the denial as outdated.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a warning when OpenClaw shows a recovered summary after hitting the model’s output limit. The summary is written without running more tools, so check what actually finished before relying on it.
  [PR #178525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178525). Thanks [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar), [@ablake4427](https://github.com/ablake4427) for reporting, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for verification.
- Fixes managed Claude CLI turns spending context on every allowed OpenClaw tool definition up front. Definitions load as needed by default, and turning tool search off keeps them loaded up front. Tool permissions and approvals are unchanged.
  [#186776](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186776) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32f9477bf46d0a09c87082bdc06e1ed8176536b6) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc) and [@Futyn-Maker](https://github.com/Futyn-Maker).
- Fixes agent turns ending immediately when the same tool action fails three times in a row with the same error. The agent gets one chance to change course or reply without rerunning that action.
  [PR #186853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186853) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21fdc279afd654efb5f518b9e8ea267edd09ff5a). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Corrects the [Tool Search examples](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tool-search) so the MCP filter keeps the intended tools directly available and the Describe and Call examples find the calendar tool. The guide also shows how to look up the names OpenClaw registers.
  [PR #186865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186865) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7349d9395e2bde0f42882a9f7ef8afab59e19c3) · [issue #186864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186864). Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes avatar presets not selecting when you open the new-agent dialog on a freshly loaded chat page. It also keeps your unsaved agent name and avatar choice from disappearing during sidebar updates or while the preset is being prepared.
  [PR #186899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186899) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c60d45f3f01d3aecfd0e3067e8605ca71920f1ec) · [issue #186873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186873). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Corrects a misleading `apply_patch` error that said patching was restricted to the workspace by default. The permissions themselves are unchanged.
  [#186923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186923) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8445e7ab4222b2b2a0e6a0e52d1321f4ce42530) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Corrects the [cloud-worker troubleshooting guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting) and [protocol reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control) for dispatching a session to a named cloud profile. Callers need write access and either administrator authority or a current profile grant for the session’s verified creator.
  [PR #186948](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186948) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/54afe289085ac724e128aefb21a724ff5f0ba833). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes worker dispatch errors losing their original cause when OpenClaw also fails to record the failure.
  [#174599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174599) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes owner-only tools becoming unavailable when an authorized owner's turn resumes after a GitHub publishing handoff or plugin reload, as long as their access is still current.
  [PR #186321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186321), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fddba9d091277d19e3a38a5e2e51918717f0b0b). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes a parent waiting for a completed subagent after the child resumes from a GitHub publication or plugin reload handoff. The matching resumed task can return its result to the waiting parent.
  [#186541](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186541). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Restores command-line message sends when an agent tool policy applies.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps named native subtasks addressable across parent turns and lists usable agent IDs when a target cannot be identified.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Reports an unfinished tool timeout as an unknown outcome. Check whether the action happened before retrying.
  [Commit 4d1b585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Gives one-shot Codex runs time to close and save state on the first shutdown request.
  [Commit 2d03432](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d0343202a3448a8bcaa2c79ff84c7b5463e14a7).
- Fixes a paused subagent rejecting a same-owner resume message after its pause notice was delivered.
  [Commit 4aa7856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa78569f23d1787235a624d462d7afcfe993245).
- Releases old transcript data from memory after agent attempts and completed turns, including while background work finishes. Saved conversation history and the background work are unaffected.
  [Agent attempt cleanup #174236](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174236) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9b841fdfdcc2d52bd0903e96495a27509b60c331) · [Completed turn cleanup #174246](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174246) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5aabc24a6ed9c2c235440d04e2966c3b6ae3ccf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes embedded agents receiving MCP tools without the server’s [instructions for using them](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp). The guidance also appears in Tool Search and Code Mode for tools discovered there. Long instructions are shortened for embedded agents, while native Claude CLI still receives the full text.
  [PR #174342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174342) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f874f244326ab8764b16dff321c15bfa75e3177a) · [Issue #174336](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174336). Embedded agents receive up to 2,000 UTF-16 units per server; the omitted tail cannot be retrieved through discovery. Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint).
- Fixes supported [Docker-backed MCP servers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/transports) leaving containers running after disconnects or initialization timeouts, including containers started by connection checks. After a Gateway crash, a restart can reclaim tracked containers on Docker daemons still used by an enabled MCP server. Keep the affected server enabled until recovery has reclaimed its containers. Containers left behind before this fix still need manual cleanup.
  Cleanup uses the Docker context that started the server, and the transport guide describes supported commands. [PR #175107](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175107) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff2580ae039ab67f876dc1cdb6ea10ee160da2f8). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@shing1211](https://github.com/shing1211) for the report.
- Reduces unnecessary cleanup work when a cancelled Linux command has no children left, and when many stopped commands need to be [cleaned up](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/background-process) at once.
  [Cancellation cleanup #174495](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174495) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bbbaf48dca2021d3512da2c441e20be5f2a775f6) · [Concurrent cleanup #174762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174762) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65649bfe08159296ed9dcb6b746e367f35f72ec9). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for co-authoring #174495 and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #174762.

##### Models, providers and usage

- Fixes the Models page returning to loading placeholders after rows appear and hiding available defaults while provider details load. Sign-in also avoids reloading unrelated usage and cost data. [Models settings guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-providers/control-ui-and-keys)
  If sign-in status fails to refresh, retry for that provider. Later defaults refreshes preserve your selection. [Loading and sign-in #172608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172608) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e97b15d2105f6fc04893786a49de364beb1fa28) · [Defaults #172729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172729) · [Defaults follow-up #172787](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172787) · [Models settings reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/9d521043782e2bf1d6b8d4f6cb46b1403333dcb3/docs/concepts/model-providers/control-ui-and-keys.md). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes repeated same-model retries for recognized Chinese quota-exhaustion messages, including z.ai warnings, so an eligible configured fallback can start sooner. [Retry behavior](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry)
  [#172173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172173) · [z.ai #173485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173485) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/07afec7832b49097729956fecf38e42894cc9a5d) · [Issue #173436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173436). Thanks [@skyzhao1223](https://github.com/skyzhao1223), [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@LizzyZHU](https://github.com/LizzyZHU).
- Fixes screen readers missing the selected Usage Sessions view when switching between All and Recently viewed, and the expanded or collapsed state of the system prompt breakdown.
  [Sessions view #176088](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176088) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8afe5eff5d15d47c3f2453a84ecfb7a82e488653) · [Prompt breakdown #176877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176877) · [Co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d86a5965c24e1684185e6d6bab6d97ed26bd0de) · [Control UI feature reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/feature-reference). Thanks [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes earlier usage appearing in a separate unnamed row after a rewind or branch switch. Previously missing historical lineage is not automatically backfilled.
  [#187366](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187366) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Gemini and Vertex proxy responses hanging after completion. It also fixes Gemini not trying another configured AI Studio key after an eligible quota error at the start of a response, and a metadata-only response preventing the first-response retry.
  [Google provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/google) [#117194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117194) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenAI image generation and editing results dropping the token usage reported by the provider.
  Includes valid zero counts and text and image breakdowns when reported. [OpenAI images and video](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/image-and-video) [#117226](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117226) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@promptclickrun](https://github.com/promptclickrun) for the report and [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx) for reviewing the usage fields.
- Fixes Claude CLI usage reports undercounting tokens, including on turns with several model calls. Context indicators keep the latest call size, and usage reports omit tiered cost estimates when combined tokens leave the applicable rates ambiguous.
  Whole-turn counts apply to new transcript rows with a reported turn total. The tiered-cost safeguard also applies to matching Codex usage records. [#148682](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148682). Thanks [@mcaldas](https://github.com/mcaldas) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Fusion guidance falling back to default model settings for agents with their own model-specific settings.
  <span>Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158510">#158510</a></span>
- Fixes model catalogs retaining obsolete inventories after configuration reloads.
  <span>Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert), [@aaroneden](https://github.com/aaroneden). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158986">#158986</a></span>
- Fixes Bedrock turns failing to produce a final answer after a tool action has already succeeded.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166720">PR #166720</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79c67a0c9f3ca7533bfd0eba2e7379c39564e011">`79c67a0`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/he-yufeng">@he-yufeng</a>, <a href="https://github.com/juanmanuelramallo">@juanmanuelramallo</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes older OpenAI models failing on unsupported custom tools by selecting function tools automatically. Clear an explicit Codex runtime pin for an affected model. Some older models also need hosted web search disabled or switched to a managed provider.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168590">PR #168590</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01e3cfaef90bae39a76e8425e29ee4cb5b3d89b3">`01e3cfa`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/bhagyaraj-create">@bhagyaraj-create</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes Usage filter menus stripping quotes and changing the sessions included in totals and exports.
  [PR #168988](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168988) · [27875c2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/27875c27cd14bb8dc488077f18edda5e1b7f98f3). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes oversized Codex relay requests reporting generic gateway errors by returning a specific, non-retryable size error.
  [PR #169145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169145) · [1108a99](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1108a99d3c675ced25710ba0c3c86ccd1db1071f). Thanks to [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web), [@dc-ai-gh](https://github.com/dc-ai-gh), and [@gobboon](https://github.com/gobboon).
- Fixes setup and inference for custom OpenAI Chat Completions endpoints that do not require an API key, including endpoints outside the local network. Choose no authentication during setup or pass `--custom-no-auth` with noninteractive setup.
  [#172152](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172152) · Thanks to [@rubencu](https://github.com/rubencu), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenAI Admin usage reports double-counting audio tokens and omitting cache-write tokens from the breakdown. [Usage tracking](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/usage-tracking)
  [#172201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172201) · Thanks to [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing prompt-cache markers for Anthropic latest aliases on OpenRouter.
  <span>Actual cache hits depend on the provider. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172652">#172652</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and reporter <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172642">@michaelrolland (#172642)</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/prompt-caching.md#L372-L373">Prompt caching documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes Novita reasoning requests failing when an output limit and thinking level are used together.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172659">#172659</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/novita.md#L46-L51">Novita provider documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes some capped Gemini requests returning empty or truncated answers when thinking uses the output allowance. On applicable Gemini API and Vertex requests with a numeric thinking budget, the total cap can increase up to the model limit to leave room for the answer.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172698">#172698</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/google.md#L337-L347">Google provider documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes connecting [Muse Code](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/meta) from Models when another model is already active. The active model stays selected.
  [#172826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172826). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Usage exports failing silently after a disconnect and prevents Daily CSV from cancelling another export. [Retry the export after reconnecting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/offline-and-reconnect).
  [#172856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172856). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixed automatic output limits being set too high for some Unicode-heavy prompts on OpenAI-compatible Completions endpoints, leaving more room for the input.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172991)
- Fixed context-length failures when a discovered vLLM model has a configured window larger than its server limit. Refresh the model catalog after changing the server limit.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#173029](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173029) · [vLLM discovery and context limits](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/vllm.md)
- Fixed remote model catalog refreshes discarding usable entries because another entry was malformed or used unsupported input types. If a catalog declares models and none are usable, OpenClaw keeps the previous catalog. Affected older gateways depend on compatible republication of both hosted catalog formats.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@gorkem2020](https://github.com/gorkem2020) for the report. [#173038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173038) · [Remote model catalogs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/config-runtime.md)
- Rejects explicitly selected empty bearer or header credentials in model-provider requests. Supply a value for the selected authentication method.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173101">#173101</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/custom-providers">Custom provider settings</a> · Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson).</span>
- Fixes first chats with a newly activated native model failing because the model is reported unavailable.
  Session creation prepares the catalog on demand. If that preparation times out, you can retry. Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#173263](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173263) · [Native model catalogs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/models.md)
- Fixes Mistral requests silently omitting unreadable tools. The request now reports the error before it is sent, so you can repair the tool and retry.
  One unreadable definition stops the request even when other tools are valid. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173312)
- Fixes usage reports and session archive lookups failing with a SQLite variable-limit error on very large transcript inventories or lookup lists.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173339">#173339</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gemini receiving the wrong tool parameter type when `$defs` and `definitions` contain entries with the same name.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173364">#173364</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Applies the configured managed proxy to local terminal model requests from `openclaw chat`, `openclaw terminal`, `openclaw tui --local`, and the local terminal UI launched by bare `openclaw`. The bare command also starts the proxy before opening local onboarding.
  [#173530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173530) · [35c5097](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35c5097332eec2db9db6d35746d80a1bf89030e0) · Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Reports an Ollama onboarding model pull as failed if its progress callback fails, preventing a later success message from masking the error.
  [#173563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173563) · [cc83172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc8317251986af8e51876cbac7f944afaddec109) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Radius streams failing to separate events when the response mixes standard line endings.
  [#173563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173563) · [cc83172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc8317251986af8e51876cbac7f944afaddec109) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Applies the runner’s idle timeout and failover rules to registered OpenCode Go streams, including cron runs, so a stream that stops making progress can time out and qualify for retry.
  [#173563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173563) · [cc83172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc8317251986af8e51876cbac7f944afaddec109) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the last published shared model list available for the same request while the Gateway rebuilds the catalog. The interim list can still show models affected by recent changes until the replacement is ready.
  [#173585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173585) · [204ff97](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/204ff97706173276407e022b02afb6437653cb56) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes a request to a model outside Vercel Token Pass making the key appear unusable for models that the pass does cover. Running out of Token Pass credits now triggers billing failover.
  [#173750](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173750) · [Token Pass error guidance](https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/token-pass/models-and-routing#errors) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents OpenClaw from replacing an existing `models.json` it can’t read, protecting manually added provider entries during a catalog rebuild.
  [#173970](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173970) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes eligible connection retries for an in-progress reply using the old address after you hot-reload a compatible replacement for a directly configured model provider. It also fixes retries that kept using an API key after you removed it from a local provider that does not require one.
  [#173920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173920) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173691) · [Hot reload guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload) · Thanks steipete and joelagnel.
- Fixes replies that showed raw provider details when every fallback failed after a rate limit. They show available quota reset guidance, including guidance written in Chinese.
  [#173979](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173979) · [Retry guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes paid Claude CLI usage showing as free when old plugin catalog copies override current prices, and stops saving new copies in your model settings. On affected installs, `openclaw doctor --fix` backs up the settings and removes qualifying exact copies. The cleanup can also remove duplicate model listings and correct a misleading Claude CLI sign-in status. [Doctor state and sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  [#174641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174641) · [`5e5ad80`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5e5ad805485b6c70013dfa6796ce228870cc11c3). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Restores provider names shown as `***` in older usage and cost reports when Doctor can verify them from session history. Doctor reports entries it leaves masked and cuts repeat scanning during historical transcript repairs. If your usage still shows `***` and the first Doctor pass upgraded the agent database, run `openclaw doctor --fix` again to apply the deferred repair. [Doctor state and sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  [#174665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174665) · [`df6046b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df6046b4b854a2a436a6d9416c8de2b97f6bee37). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes agents with a separate state scope failing to save valid OAuth sign-in credentials or refreshed tokens.
  [#174724](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174724) · [`62dfe37`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/62dfe37ddd9ebb4ecc08325fdfb0140a683642fb). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes provider usage staying blank or stuck on refreshing on the Models page. Reloading the page also reuses recent usage results within the cache window.
  [#174741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174741) · [`c3f0b6a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3f0b6abc0109bd1e47a850a7765616d775c4a80). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes cached OpenAI Responses and ChatGPT/Codex WebSocket connections holding on to memory from finished or failed runs. [OpenAI transport options](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced)
  [#174752](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174752) · [`aec5072`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aec507283f368f0bb9a63ed5eacb8b31f4a22d69). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway `agent` calls rejecting image attachments for text-only models when image understanding is configured and allowed. By default, OpenClaw sends the image to the configured vision provider and passes its description to your chosen text model with your extra prompt context. If no description can be produced, check `agents.defaults.imageModel` or an image-capable `tools.media.models` entry before retrying. [Local models](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/local-models)
  [#175013](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175013), [Issue #93741](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93741) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@clemenshelm](https://github.com/clemenshelm).
- Fixes model discovery timing out before it contacts vLLM or another affected self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server on a cold start.
  [#175016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175016) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes usage totals staying stale when a refresh overlaps an agent’s first-time setup, including at Gateway startup. [Usage tracking](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/usage-tracking)
  [#174963](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174963) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway session usage log requests returning the whole log for positive fractional limits below the cap. Those requests now return an empty list, and replies stay within the 1,000-entry limit. [Gateway RPC reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-system-and-channels)
  [#175005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175005), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e875ec9c918c523373f37d66a53468667faf58bd) — Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes automatic reasoning summaries being requested from OpenAI and ChatGPT Responses even when you explicitly opt out with `reasoningSummary: null`.
  [#175525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175525) · [Issue #121443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/121443) · [Original draft](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/121442). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@zyw02](https://github.com/zyw02) for the report and original draft.
- Fixes requests rejected by Groq when you use `/think minimal` with a bundled GPT OSS model. OpenClaw uses `low` for `minimal` and `high` for `xhigh`, without a settings change.
  [#175539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175539) · [Issue #131028](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/131028). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@zw-xysk](https://github.com/zw-xysk) for the report.
- Fixes session model and usage displays mistaking OpenClaw command replies for model output. Those replies stay in conversation history without changing the model a later turn inherits.
  [#175553](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175553) · [c742d2d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c742d2d200158bb4ca0534d34a1d5cac285db989). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes raw reasoning appearing in replies from hosted Kimi Code K2 models when thinking was off. Thinking stays on for these models even if a session previously saved Off. An explicit provider override can still turn thinking off and expose reasoning in the reply. [Kimi Code settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/moonshot)
  [#175592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175592) · [acbe920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/acbe9201768097cc34c45e1767490876bb03d905). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes API-key saves in Models and the CLI failing or leaving provider settings unapplied when a model catalog refresh is still finishing. OpenClaw waits for the refresh before continuing the save or applying the settings. [Models CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/models)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176166">#176166</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3af75f57e24764b3a53e8cf04514f2b5bc42fdc">Commit c3af75f</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176195">#176195</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9f666d5fb605ddd0726c3c0951e1faf14eabb2c7">Commit 9f666d5</a>
- Fixes OpenCode Go model discovery and requests going to the wrong address after the provider’s API migration. OpenClaw corrects saved native addresses automatically while honoring custom proxies and explicit API choices. Native OpenCode Go and Zen requests identify OpenClaw and the conversation, including on Gemini routes. Gemini access depends on your OpenCode workspace policy. [OpenCode Go provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/opencode-go) · [OpenCode provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/opencode)
  Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176265">#176265</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e6d28fed48c2528b03512f5282d4be68c6781225">Commit e6d28fe</a>
- Fixes missing fallback notices and incorrect cost estimates when Anthropic identifies the model that answered only at the end of a supported Claude reply. OpenClaw uses that model’s rates when they’re known.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#176289](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176289), [b607b7f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b607b7fefe9cf8108423ea029606d21f1624415f).
- Fixes `openclaw infer model auth status` failing to show authentication status when the model catalog issued a non-fatal warning. The command prints the warning separately in both text and JSON modes. [Infer CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/infer)
  Thanks [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt). [#176338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176338), [79ff19a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79ff19a31509a225997bb72bf7d21dacb54a7eaa).
- Prevents damaged data from an older model catalog from blocking refresh checks when the current catalog is valid.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176593">#176593</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5076dcdad122d37373d05a356788716866946e77">5076dcda</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a model timeout from blocking other turns from trying the same account when there is no other authorized account or fallback model to try.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176862) · [commit 0efa390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0efa390bc66fa739bf3042277a13164b58240b5a) · [Model failover guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover)
- Fixes the official `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash` model being treated like base M3, so OpenClaw recognizes its text and image inputs, 1 million-token context window and five thinking levels. The catalog includes published pay-as-you-go prices. Use the official ID for new configurations. Saved Preview selections keep their settings wherever MiniMax still serves that model.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176955">#176955</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed5a99e0af5fbac18036187413f39afcd810b264">Co-authored commit</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177387">Report #177387</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/minimax">MiniMax guide</a> · Thanks to [@SaladDay](https://github.com/SaladDay) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the patch, and [@Hansen1018](https://github.com/Hansen1018), [@bit-777](https://github.com/bit-777) and [@php737](https://github.com/php737) for the report and compatibility investigation.</span>
- Fixes `xhigh` and `max` thinking being reduced to `high` when runtime reasoning is capped there. Corrects the catalog to show that M3 and both M3.1 IDs lack temperature support.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176955">#176955</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed5a99e0af5fbac18036187413f39afcd810b264">Co-authored commit</a> · Thanks to [@SaladDay](https://github.com/SaladDay) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Stops supported model streams from asking the provider for more response data after cancellation.
  [#177106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177106). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes cancelled LM Studio model preloads from the queue before they start. Running work keeps its slot while it cleans up.
  [#177189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177189). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Corrects the reasoning history OpenClaw sends when you continue an OpenRouter chat with a DeepSeek V4 Flash or Pro point release such as V4.1. Applies the same fallback thinking levels as V4 when OpenRouter doesn’t specify them for the model.
  [#177270](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177270), [6e8118d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6e8118dce05083324c19fb1f7556e73bf2f53b5c). Thanks [@thelooter](https://github.com/thelooter), Eve Kolb, [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Fixes cloud-worker turns that could stop when the primary model failed after saving a reply or tool results. The configured fallback model can pick up from work already saved by that turn.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/robojarvis">@robojarvis</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177477">#177477</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cf4c7b5329e607d05e983788c412bd5b118fb027">Commit cf4c7b5</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover">Model failover</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161211">Issue #161211</a>
- Replaces generic chat failures for two ChatGPT sharing limits with recovery options in the Control UI. Choose **Manage usage** to open your ChatGPT usage settings, or **Copy request for admin** for a Business workspace and send the request yourself.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/stevenlee-oai">@stevenlee-oai</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177530">#177530</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbda20fd3afd9634b0ba73f59c26d394b58bcd92">Commit dbda20f</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/authentication">ChatGPT sign-in and usage</a>
- Fixes model setup and discovery failing on certain configured model IDs that OpenClaw mistook for aliases.
  [#177537](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177537) · [7f902d4b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f902d4b3873bcbd4c97091b17d0cd1a92e5aef7). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw config set` and `openclaw config patch` rejecting valid models from some provider plugins, including when you change a provider setting and its model in the same patch. [Configuration CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/config)
  [#177680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177680) · [dcb4fcad](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcb4fcad930099c64d47b346b7eaeb374f2e133e). Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the Models page staying on “Checking models…” after discovery finishes just before the page opens. The list refreshes and keeps the provider sign-ins it already loaded visible.
  [#177693](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177693) · [0583592c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0583592c9e81db06edb823a5886cbe0f958b175c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex account checks that could block the Gateway while fetching usage, uploading diagnostics, or supervising a session. OpenClaw still checks that the account is authorized before sending a request or returning protected results.
  [#177811](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177811) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes streamed reasoning being dropped from follow-up requests to OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions providers that replay it, including when the model continues after a tool call. [Custom provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-providers/custom-providers)
  [#177871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177871) · Thanks [@surlymochan](https://github.com/surlymochan), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (co-author), [@jimmyjacobson](https://github.com/jimmyjacobson) (report).
- Records an account’s rate-limit cooldown before an agent waits to retry the same model, so later runs can see the cooldown. Also fixes model accounts coming out of cooldown before the applicable provider retry deadline when a subscription quota check reports available quota. [Model failover](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/concepts/model-failover.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178079">#178079</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3415d8c762be0a59175ccd509b0dad1381a2e1e7">3415d8c7</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173381">#173381</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report.
- Fixes LM Studio rejecting model discovery and preload requests when your API key comes from a secret store. This lets LM Studio preload the model with your configured context before inference. [LM Studio](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/lmstudio)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178132">#178132</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/94dacc48dfb325197481e95cc0fe3fd863eec645">94dacc48</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175644">#175644</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@xtimor](https://github.com/xtimor) for the report and investigation.
- Fixes status showing a model alias instead of the model it points to when the alias includes a provider or profile. The displayed context limit follows that model too.
  [#178194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178194) · [commit a0a6af6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a0a6af6b08ecebfbd24030d8cbfaf2e6a9b58e8d) · [Status documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenRouter usage showing as unavailable in `openclaw status --usage` on Node 24 with the default TLS settings. If the usage lookups still fail, JSON output can show the underlying connection error.
