  [#178207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178207) · [commit 4f858be](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4f858be32c49c29cb7d124d5992ddd6f187e21ff) · [Usage tracking](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/usage-tracking) · [issue #178133](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178133). Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jimmarkunas](https://github.com/jimmarkunas) for the report, and [@potoior](https://github.com/potoior) and [@choksi2212](https://github.com/choksi2212) for earlier related diagnostic work.
- Adds warnings in config validation, Doctor and status when a configured utility CLI model is known to be unable to run without tools. If repeated utility-model failures stop session assessments, the open Control UI chat shows one notice for the run and suggests a compatible model or fallback. [Utility model guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/models)
  [#178655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178655) · [`1bda794`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bda794eadb5141e0e507b9917f324e3bbf9f3bf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@xtimor](https://github.com/xtimor) for the report.
- Fixes unexplained empty replies from native Ollama and OpenAI-compatible completions when reasoning is turned off and the model sends only reasoning. The error suggests enabling reasoning or choosing a non-thinking model. Doctor and status flag the mismatch while keeping the reasoning private. [Ollama configuration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama/advanced)
  [#178662](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178662) · [`bc47d4d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bc47d4d6c5f7fdbe1499a3c291f0703323835f33) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@tomdailey55](https://github.com/tomdailey55) for the report.
- Fixes repeat PostgreSQL usage reports failing when the database refuses new connections but OpenClaw still has a working report connection. Refreshed usage totals still appear in subsequent reports.
  [#178673](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178673) · [`cab0df9`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cab0df90f87dbbbcc46086626b80b6e26d27da08) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` skipping repairs to stale model references when an agent’s `models.json` contains comments or trailing commas. The repair keeps references to local providers and preserves the catalog file. [Doctor configuration migrations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/doctor/config-migrations.md)
  [#178706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178706) · [`c93e2b7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c93e2b73b89ffd333459b0a3d83fcfa3f05a8fdd) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Fixes the llama.cpp media catalog withholding recommendations solely because the installed build differs from the build originally verified. Recommendations depend on the executable, resources and recipe.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Makes provider controls and errors in Settings → Models clearer to screen-reader and voice-control users. Connect, remove, API key and connection-test buttons include the provider name, and provider access and usage errors are announced as alerts and remain visible while Retry runs.
  [Provider button labels #178848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178848) · [report #178261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178261) · [commit 64fd065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/64fd06501ee315284580f684861fc66a1a8f7c95) · [Error alerts #181172](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181172) · [commit 97d96e5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97d96e53d22f8740b63aa441ad152ad88264e54c). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes ClawRouter rejecting image input for models it incorrectly listed as text-only. The catalog respects declared input types. [ClawRouter guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter)
  [#178859](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178859). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes Fast being unavailable in the model picker for ClawRouter models that advertise priority on an OpenAI Responses route. Selecting Fast requests that priority, and OpenClaw reports any refusal for your key.
  [#178875](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178875). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes model connection checks ignoring the selected agent’s model configuration. Checks now follow that agent’s model, aliases, fallbacks, and utility settings.
  [#178962](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178962). Thanks to [@kiresakura](https://github.com/kiresakura).
- Fixes the model catalog’s **Retry** button in **New Session** using out-of-date state. Keeps model discovery on the new attempt if you cancel while it’s loading and then reopen it.
  <span>[#179087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179087) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)</span>
- Fixes discovered [ClawRouter](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter) models missing from the model list, including an empty list for custom deployments. Changing or removing a custom URL also clears models saved from the old deployment.
  [Custom deployment discovery #179223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179223) · [commit 48f2918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/48f291827824b2269f27adca6b951a64391b83f5) · [Discovered models #179479](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179479) · [commit 3ba408d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ba408dce2546cc0e2804201f165d5b7d22ab956). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Cuts short a stalled OpenAI Responses tool call when the model keeps streaming blank space instead of arguments, so OpenClaw can start its existing retry sooner. A run of 4 KiB of consecutive whitespace triggers the cutoff, even within an otherwise valid argument. [Retry guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry)
  [#179233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179233), [`ec4420b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec4420b7888278296b579b0c93ba43abc6d50cdd). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes keyboard focus dropping from an account recovery button when the Models sign-in summary refreshes and the same recovery action is still available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179300">#179300</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes empty or unavailable results from `openclaw models list --refresh` when no Gateway is running and model discovery relies on a configured API key or a resolvable secret reference in the provider settings or selected agent’s profile.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179446">#179446</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179411">Reported in #179411</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/hehuang139">@hehuang139</a>, <a href="https://github.com/kybrcore">@kybrcore</a>.
- Fixes configured [fallback models](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/model-failover.md) being skipped after an eligible provider failure when an earlier tool call was rejected without running, or when an output-limit warning follows an attempt that produced no answer and can safely be retried. Safeguards still apply to tools that may have had side effects.
  [Rejected tool calls #179450](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179450) · [report #179396](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179396) · [commit 228b5e9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/228b5e9e7df8b978a85a0f3f3aa249b705f383aa) · [Output-limit fallback #183470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183470) · [commit 1c4520e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c4520e9ebb666cda1ee55bafcb0ff1cc320e414) · [Agent loop](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-loop). Thanks [@hehuang139](https://github.com/hehuang139), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes custom URLs being appended to the default during command-line setup for Ollama, LM Studio, Copilot Proxy and existing llama.cpp servers. Fresh oMLX setup also lets you type a custom URL without clearing a default first. Leave the URL blank to use the default, or to keep a saved address when reconfiguring oMLX or an existing llama.cpp server.
  [#179602](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179602) · [8ecdc96](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8ecdc9682e7979b8c044eede265f57eab9321d02) · [issue #179601](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179601) · Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes GitHub Copilot treating a Windows drive root as a relative path when it’s used as the home directory. If there’s no configured home override and the OS home lookup fails, Copilot reports the error.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179837">#179837</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes stale subscription usage in the Control UI chat composer. Finishing a chat run can refresh an out-of-date quota without a page reload. Adjust how long OpenClaw reuses quota figures with the optional `models.usage.cacheTtlMs` [setting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/usage-tracking).
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179866">#179866</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8970d3e28a1c577eb9fd4b729aa0c8c148ce7341">8970d3e2</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178872">#178872</a> · Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), and [@Alyx-Learbott](https://github.com/Alyx-Learbott) for reporting the discrepancy.</span>
- Clarifies provider certificate errors so you can tell that the secure connection failed and know to check the logs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179898">#179898</a> · Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).</span>
- Fixes missing or misplaced source links in OpenAI and Azure Responses replies, including when citations arrive after the answer text. Follow-up turns can continue from replies that include those links.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179903">#179903</a> · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).</span>
- Replaces the bare “cancelled” notice in model setup and automatic setup with a message in your selected language that says provider sign-in was cancelled. Automatic setup also shows that message when no details are available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179996">#179996</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/24f7f76ea5cb907edf2aa5d520bf95630f763921">commit 24f7f76e</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178274">issue #178274</a>. Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unsupported temperature settings from causing request failures on matching OpenAI and Claude models in ClawRouter and applies the matched models’ native image-size limits. Claude requests with extended thinking drop trailing assistant prefills that contain no tool calls.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180025">#180025</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80d49be73c702a7e82459db22ef449224fed5b18">commit 80d49be7</a>. Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes managed llama.cpp setup telling you to install OpenMP when a different system library is missing. Setup and memory diagnostics name the missing library so you can restore it and retry setup. [llama.cpp recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/llama-cpp)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@coaiMax](https://github.com/coaiMax), @thrasher-. [#180190](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180190) · [commit 32429f1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32429f1734b551f9cd23dc0e880625cef600b02e) · [Issue #179989](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179989)
- Fixes rate-limit waits that used a provider’s full quota refill time even when the provider said to retry sooner. OpenClaw also recognizes reset times for exhausted Anthropic quotas and retry instructions in longer Gemini error responses. [Model failover](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover)
  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#180280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180280) · [commit 442c2f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/442c2f7c5b85250b94b2f433e94ecdd81d4fc544)
- Fixes the **Check status** button disappearing after a failed check during model account sign-in. You can retry without losing your place or re-entering an unfinished answer while the check runs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180425">PR #180425</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3af60715dfc0ff287e9f738833d23b23e17a2a6">Commit c3af607</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Chat’s provider review hiding why a continuation status check failed. Retrying clears the old error and keeps the dialog open. Reopening the dialog preserves feedback about a pending or failed continuation, and a later continuation failure takes precedence over the earlier status-check error.
  [#180819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180819) · [commit 34cb685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/34cb68501ac01855c100d48b7b6860ad4ef97980) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Vercel AI Gateway showing models your key cannot use in the picker and refreshed list. For Token Pass, setup chooses the first recommended model available to your key or leaves the default unset if none match. Upgrading keeps your existing model choice. [Vercel AI Gateway setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/vercel-ai-gateway) · [Token Pass](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/vercel-ai-gateway#token-pass)
  [Key-aware discovery #180838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180838) · [commit caf1220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/caf1220a93614c9d13bdd53b9d3aa3219b90db60) · [Token Pass default #180905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180905). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes shared HTTP model discovery and refreshes cutting off slow providers before their configured timeout or waiting longer than requested. The provider timeout is capped by the overall discovery deadline. [Model discovery settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/models)
  [#180842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180842) · [commit 071ce23](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/071ce2302f9cd1ecc19ea898f78c0b00f4a3431b) · [#168356](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168356) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Joelincn](https://github.com/Joelincn).
- Names the filter in each Usage query filter’s remove button and tooltip, so screen-reader and voice-control users can tell the buttons apart.
  [#180996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180996). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents eligible local reasoning sessions using OpenAI-compatible servers such as llama.cpp from losing room for the next reply or trimming conversation history too early after a tool call. The fix uses the previous request’s measured usage when the start of the prompt still matches. It also fixes unchanged structured output schemas being counted twice against the next reply’s space.
  [#181343](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181343) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/66d6c283b39d784ae8f96829e58cc282a2fec4b8) · [llama.cpp](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/llama-cpp.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@theonlytoshka](https://github.com/theonlytoshka).
- Fixes missing-dependency and false directory-cycle errors when bundled plugins activate during fresh OpenAI API-key setup from the packaged install.
  [#181494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181494) · [Report #181423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181423) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the report.
- Fixes scripted [LiteLLM setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/litellm) reporting success with an invalid proxy URL. Setup now requires an HTTP or HTTPS URL for the override and rejects an invalid value before changing your configuration or saving the API key.
  [#181527](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181527) · Thanks to [@KrasimirKralev](https://github.com/KrasimirKralev) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops ClawRouter from reporting a model switch when the selected model replies under the same name without its vendor prefix. Actual model switches and fallbacks still show a notice.
  [#181598](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181598) · Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes custom-named providers on recognized DashScope endpoints ignoring Qwen thinking settings, including on the first request when the allowed Qwen plugin has not loaded yet. The first request also uses Qwen error handling. Token Plan endpoints also apply the model’s thinking limits and rules for carrying reasoning into later requests.
  [Custom DashScope settings #181638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181638) · [commit 1ee86df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ee86df1b272ed14e900cc7fb07b30f223af2107) · [related issue #171853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171853) · [First request #182442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182442) · [commit abda524d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/abda524dfc56aabb79265eabb82da1e0a0124e93). Thanks [@grootbro](https://github.com/grootbro) for the first fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the report and follow-up.
- Fixes `openclaw models status --probe` reporting `unknown` for available account credentials stored in an environment variable or the protected secret store when probing without a Gateway connection.
  Thanks [@maximora-byte](https://github.com/Maximora-byte) for the fix and [@nathanpalmer](https://github.com/nathanpalmer) for reporting it. [#181716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181716) · [`ad9f814`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad9f81409c251b03450a05465e44fd225b8b289c) · [issue #181686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181686)
- Fixes [fallback models](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover) missing their own plugin instructions and receiving the same message and images twice. The fallback gets fresh plugin context for the message.
  [Fallback instructions #181757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181757) · [commit 752311d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/752311d97eb9f2090c61bd402a971b98f6d2738f) · [Duplicate message fix #183921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183921) · [commit 2cfde9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cfde9ae7385faf12cf283f2ba7f3e2e839cf51f). Thanks [@grootbro](https://github.com/grootbro) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the instructions work and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the duplicate-message fix.
- Fixes provider requests sending headers that were explicitly removed, even if the original header used different capitalization. This also keeps default authorization off local OpenAI-compatible requests that explicitly opt out. Provider plugins that read runtime headers should preserve `null` as a removal through merges and omit it before sending through a string-only HTTP client. [Provider runtime hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins/runtime-hooks)
  Use `omitNullRequestHeaders` after the final merge for string-only HTTP clients. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182351">#182351</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes changes to watched groups invalidating otherwise reusable conversation context. Adding, renaming, or removing a watched group still updates what your agent sees, and compatible providers can reuse the earlier context.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182354">#182354</a>. Thanks to [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley) (author) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (contributor).
- Skips the extra model request for a final answer when a scheduled check finishes its work and intentionally stays silent. Keeps requests needed to finish a turn from disturbing the conversation’s prompt cache. [Prompt caching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182375">#182375</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gemini rejecting some agent turns before they run when a tool accepts more than one kind of value for a field, such as text or numbers in message table cells. Gemini receives one representative type for the affected field.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182390">#182390</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/112050">#112050</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/112054">earlier proposal #112054</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author), [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) (reporter), and [@bobbyg603](https://github.com/bobbyg603) (live testing of the earlier proposal).
- Fixes xAI image generation and editing rejecting a configured private endpoint even after you opt in to private-network access for xAI. Private endpoints remain blocked by default. [xAI provider settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/xai)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182391">#182391</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84627">#84627</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@kicopascualnadal-eng](https://github.com/kicopascualnadal-eng) (reporter).
- Fixes provider authentication failing in standalone builds when authentication is built into the executable, and automatic setup failing to verify bundled providers in experimental standalone AOT Gateway builds. Rebuild existing standalone binaries to pick up the setup fix.
  [Standalone authentication #182403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182403) · [Automatic setup #183902](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183902) · [commit 2d158b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d158b885292802506ec51f9efea7741e8ec9aec) · [Plugin architecture](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/architecture.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds a log warning when a wildcard model policy rules out your configured default and OpenClaw picks another model. The warning names both models so you can check your default or policy. The fallback still runs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182421">PR #182421</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/61deaaef5879e8acc588b38ab866152056d91427">61deaaef</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes reused OpenAI Responses WebSocket connections retaining memory from completed requests after you steer a response.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182667](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182667)
- Fixes OpenClaw switching models and blaming the provider when its own worker pool is full. The error now asks you to check the conversation for completed work before trying again.
  Thanks to [@LeoStehlik](https://github.com/LeoStehlik) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for contributing. [#182867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182867) · [Model failover](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover)
- Fixes runs using up their retries within seconds when a provider stays rate-limited. OpenClaw spaces out same-model retries to give the provider more time to recover. Retry limits and deadlines still apply.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182954](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182954) · [Provider retries](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry)
- Fixes configured thinking levels being replaced by a simple on/off choice on some OpenRouter models. Fixes fallback session titles and other background request failures caused by sending an unsupported thinking setting to a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint. On routes without a configured way to turn thinking off, asking for off leaves the server’s default in place.
  [#182987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182987) · [642b31d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/642b31d1993bd93ce3a0ea68fc3bf581a8058ab1) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@tre1d](https://github.com/tre1d), [@eulrich101618](https://github.com/eulrich101618). · [Custom endpoint thinking settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/thinking#custom-openai-compatible-endpoints) · [Issue #165119](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/165119) · [Issue #177425](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177425)
- Fixes background turns, session handoffs and CLI agent turns switching to the default route when the default wraps the same model you selected directly for the session.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183309">#183309</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/26fd7a60551e3ec63a1fb62f30b5cfa2020783fc">26fd7a6</a> · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).</span>
- Replaces the generic stall message with a provider rate-limit notice if OpenClaw stops a reply during the wait to retry a throttled request. OpenClaw also skips the automatic rerun for those replies.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183545)
- Fixes session-observer assessments and other utility calls rejecting ClawRouter Luna when your credentials allow it to chat through Responses. Previously cached catalogs pick up the fix on their normal refresh.
  [#183779](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183779). Thanks to [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183757). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cb3bb04f96ac17c03c3bef1ae43e92b14d966ae9).
- Fixes model setup hanging and blocking retries after the Gateway saves a new connection but fails to apply it. If that happens on the first save of a configuration, setup restores the previous settings so the rejected model and credential stay inactive after restart. With live reload off, you may still need to restart the Gateway to apply the restored settings.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183964">#183964</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> and <a href="https://github.com/sedrak-hovhannisyan">@sedrak-hovhannisyan</a>.</span>
- Adds useful details to otherwise generic managed local model load errors. Embedding diagnostics and supported OpenAI-compatible JSON chat errors can show recent redacted output from the local process started by OpenClaw. [Local model services guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/local-model-services)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@kir1ll](https://github.com/kir1ll). [#184150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184150) · [9a75157c5c7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a75157c5c7d3e0eb8049fdaffa93fde6a2c01dd) · [issue #182519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182519)
- Redacts request credentials from displayed local provider errors even when the message is too long to show in full.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184150) · [9a75157c5c7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a75157c5c7d3e0eb8049fdaffa93fde6a2c01dd)
- Fixes conversation timestamps and missing-date labels staying in the previous language when you switch the interface language with Usage open.
  [#184377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184377). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the speed badge crowding the effort gauge in the compact chat composer. The gauge fills to the selected effort, Fast and Ultrafast have distinct icons, and Ultrafast uses the same double bolt in the wider composer.
  [#184760](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184760) ([`f9754120`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f97541206a9f3917280b1c51a10ca0fb721cf5a8)). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Stops Control UI chat from recording a model switch before you send a message with the new selection. Saved model changes appear as dividers, and the switch confirmation shows the model name only once. [Model selection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/models#selection-order)
  [#184702](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184702) ([`27b94d43`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/27b94d43e1248ae5c2c4c7a369db8a45f8eb837f)). Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Fixes Control UI Usage filters hiding matching sessions and showing zero totals when you choose a value with spaces in it. Filter menus and suggestions keep names like “Local Model” together.
  [#184707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184707) ([`ae53cd40`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae53cd4052c7ee422d3cecd4e624e05a7161188d)), [Issue #184580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184580). Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) for the fix, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it, and [@rileyjjy](https://github.com/RileyJJY) for reporting it.
- Restores per-run cost reporting when OpenClaw compacts context through the Responses endpoint. The run total includes the compaction call. Saved session totals still omit compaction costs. [Usage tracking guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/usage-tracking)
  [#184719](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184719) ([`2a37974b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a37974b97338c9ff354bbc734f7639e2d23ab78)), [Issue #159825](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/159825). Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) for the fix, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it, and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for reporting it.
- Fixes agent startup rejecting a selected external OAuth profile with credentials supplied only at runtime.
  [#184849](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184849) · [307e5c12](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/307e5c122274c17460ca2d865c14c4744d196476). Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes New Session losing track of your selected model as more models load, and keeps a model list loading when you reopen the chat picker after an unrelated session update.
  New Session model choice — [#184994](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184994) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · Chat picker loading — [Chat picker loading](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ffe19379bf95e36d76bf3fd896c0b67d06a630de).
- Fixes Session Observer assessments and other utility calls being rejected as unsupported even after OpenClaw has discovered chat support for the selected model on that connection.
  [#184996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184996) · Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes ClawRouter losing track of the selected model after a reply, which could report a reroute that did not happen, and false model-switch notices when an OpenAI-compatible provider sends a keepalive before its reply.
  ClawRouter model identity — [#185042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185042) · [7dcd8a8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7dcd8a84f3451064b36c9b04bd03ae0ddc8e0eb6) · Thanks [@PratikRai0101](https://github.com/PratikRai0101), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). · OpenAI-compatible keepalives — [#186689](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186689). Thanks to copystring and obviyus.
- Fixes cost labels that didn’t update with the selected window and keeps session rows stable when you switch which details are open.
  [#185063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185063) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes taps that could fail to open the chat model picker in WebKit.
  [#185137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185137) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the composer’s model, effort or speed, and permission controls flickering when you reload chat or a dashboard without changing your settings. The controls wait for current settings before accepting input and explain that wait to assistive technology.
  [#185144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185144) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops repeated model-list reloads in the Control UI when OpenAI switches back and forth between your requested speed and the same lower tier. The Speed hint clears one minute after the last downgrade, and Ultrafast remains selectable. [OpenAI speed settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openai/advanced).
  [#185195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185195) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes browser and device-code sign-in dialogs in **Model setup** and **Model providers** showing a letter when the provider has a recognizable logo.
  [#185164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185164) · [5c90a44](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5c90a444bbe503eb7a5aa9e05184fa2cb93d5cd1) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Stops Settings → Models from treating routine OAuth token expiry as a sign-in problem. Missing credentials still prompt sign-in, while an uncertain refresh shows **Sign-in unavailable**. Provider-wide rejection warnings stay visible and are shown at the provider level.
  [#185263](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185263) · [018cdd3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/018cdd3feec64552de7e60d2942d687dee9e7af4). [Credential status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/auth-credential-semantics). By @hannesrudolph.
- Fixes embedded agent turns spending minutes retrying the same model after hitting a shared provider token limit. This applies when the turn can safely retry on a configured fallback. Other sessions on the same OpenClaw process can skip a model already known to be over the limit.
  [#185496](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185496). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [configured fallbacks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover) being ignored when a session selects or has already saved the configured primary model. Explicit model locks and empty fallback lists still apply.
  [#185496](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185496). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes stalled model requests ending the whole reply before OpenClaw can retry or try a configured fallback model. Stops cancelled replies from announcing or starting another retry.
  [#185604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185604) · [a8adfc3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a8adfc3854c555576626388b94e2fece49c2a0c6) · [Agent loop](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-loop) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes avoidable prompt-cache misses from earlier image inputs changing on a follow-up. If an image could not be read before, resend it in a new turn to try again.
  [#185567](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185567) · [2d87a46](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d87a461a65c78f31d3e3f942f036cedb13054d9) · [Image replay and prompt caching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes usage refreshes and exact-range reports restoring archived transcripts just to recalculate token and cost totals. Opening archived history still restores it. [Session maintenance guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/session-management-compaction/maintenance.md)
  [#185729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185729) · [`05cd72c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/05cd72c8b13ef5f0a2854b9ddb8483d9171127eb) · [Issue #157643](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/157643) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@anyech](https://github.com/anyech) for the related report
- Fixes image provider and model lists failing to load for some plugins.
  [#185797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185797) · [`a9193fb`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a9193fbc2814d4248733a63f46750b16be7713f3) · [Issue #185726](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185726) · Thanks [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix, and [@giangthb](https://github.com/giangthb) for reporting the issue
- Fixes standalone setup and model verification failing to load built-in providers such as Codex and OpenAI.
  [#185808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185808) · [`e148654`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e148654beaa38a905b341e994db42fabff5710ab) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes plugin-discovered models failing to start when a session runs in a different workspace from the agent’s configured workspace.
  [#185829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185829) · [`ca7f339`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca7f339bf018af8cc6a1f644ec027b262ec2c4ce) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd)
- Fixes turns that could end without a reply when an Anthropic-compatible Gateway relay rejects a malformed tool call. The agent can try to continue once without repeating tools that already finished.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185905">#185905</a> · Thanks to [@AppleSpriter](https://github.com/AppleSpriter), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)
- Fixes the Control UI stalling when you open or expand a long conversation in Usage. The conversation scrolls within its own panel, and search, filters, and keyboard navigation still work across the loaded conversation.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185997">#185997</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes LM Studio chat falling back to thinking on or rejecting thinking settings on models that only support on and off. Ordinary chat requires an LM Studio server with `/v1/messages` support. Requests for structured output still enforce the response schema and can still warn about thinking settings.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186298">#186298</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/842dfae24ad1b73a9599f6c57fdc5d581b49cc80">commit 842dfae</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181888">issue #181888</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182151">Earlier transport investigation #182151</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/lmstudio">LM Studio provider guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/mze2">@mze2</a> (report), <a href="https://github.com/mushuiyu886">@mushuiyu886</a> (earlier transport investigation), and 杨浩宇0668001029 (co-author).</span>
- Fixes eligible OpenAI and Anthropic chats on ClawRouter being left without an automatic utility model when `utilityModel` is unset. With the matching model granted on your key, automatic selection works for composer predictions, titles, progress narration, Activity recaps, and Side chat. Model status and previews reflect the selected default. If you use the automatic GPT-6 Luna route, choose an image-capable utility model for Side chat questions with images.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186327">#186327</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e00a185728d480607b60be048ae7c8c902606f26">commit e00a185</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/clawrouter#utility-model">ClawRouter utility models</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>.</span>
- Fixes cost and usage reports waiting extra time for fresh totals when the system clock moves backward, and prevents clock changes from cutting retries short or extending them past their budget for shared provider token limits.
  Usage totals — [#186388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186388). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). · Model retry budgets — [#186390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186390). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes logs marking a run as failed when a fallback model successfully answers. Runs that really fail still report an error.
  [#186444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186444). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes configured ClawRouter chat models being rejected for subagents even when they work in the main session. This covers selected and inherited models and restores affected models to chat model lists.
  [#186596](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186596). Thanks to jalehman.
- Explains when a plugin package update is holding up model retirement and clears the old warning once repair completes.
  [#186648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186648). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes the model picker in `openclaw configure --section model` leaving out models from standalone CLI providers and making you enter those models by hand.
  [PR #186964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186964). Thanks [@sasan1200](https://github.com/sasan1200), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes repeated tool warnings in Gemini Code Mode and stops sending Gemini unsupported fields for the built-in execution tool.
  [PR #187405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187405). Thanks to wr-web, obviyus and fonchaves.
- Fixes tool follow-ups losing the model’s earlier reasoning on OpenCode Go’s Kimi K3.1 Pro, which could put planning in the reply. The same fix applies to other compatible models that require that reasoning across tool calls, even with effort set to `off` or `none`.
  [PR #187489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187489). Thanks to VACInc.
- Fixes Google Vertex requests going to the wrong location when a model’s endpoint differs from the shared location setting. An explicitly set request location still takes priority.
  [PR #187523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187523). Thanks to wyf027, obviyus and HighervGround.
- Prevents Doctor and update repair from replacing working shared provider sign-in with an older key from `models.json`. If an already imported key for an agent takes precedence over the shared account, Doctor leaves both credentials in place and shows how to remove that agent’s key. Confirm the shared account is the one you want before running the suggested command.
  [#187698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187698). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@paterskip](https://github.com/paterskip).
- Restores missing Claude Code models in the model list and fixes session creation rejecting them when Anthropic models are set up to use the API.
  [#191148](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191148). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman), and thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (7a813c9).
- Fixes agent replies stopping at the output limit without trying the fallback already selected for that reply.
  [#188765](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188765), [#193767](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193767). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fallback and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the carrier.
- Fixes Global and CN Z.AI Coding Plan connections rejecting GLM-5.3 or GLM-5.3-Flash as unknown when live model discovery doesn’t return them.
  [#195390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195390). Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport 066aeb4888).
- Fixes provider catalogs being skipped during concurrent plugin loading and keeps healthy providers’ models visible when another provider is missing credentials or its catalog hook fails.
  Concurrent plugin loading — [PR #196448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196448), [commit 67cc5d9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67cc5d9ab485f8a0aafb6236392513b7ad5b9c46), [issue #195477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/195477). Thanks [@1052326311](https://github.com/1052326311), [@WG-Mojo](https://github.com/WG-Mojo), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). · Provider discovery — [Provider discovery isolation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes agent runs waiting past the [retry delay limit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry) after a provider rate limit. If no fallback model is configured and the request is safe to repeat, OpenClaw tries another eligible provider account or returns the error if none remains. If actions cannot safely be repeated, the turn ends with an error instead. Check what finished before retrying.
  Unsafe retries — [PR #197611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197611), [commit 37740dc6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/37740dc688913e3a9c3edeffd5bcc9fbb9fec11c), [issue #168101](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168101). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport, [@kringsc](https://github.com/kringsc) for the report, and [@aron-intframe](https://github.com/aron-intframe), [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha), [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333), [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott) and [@alexph-dev](https://github.com/alexph-dev) for reproduction and diagnosis. The cap defaults to 60 seconds; setting it to zero disables it. · Safe retries — [commit d0d0f865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d0d0f86547285fee3eb8d861510d1878b9740deb), [PR #162398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162398), [issue #161981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161981). Thanks [@alkor2000](https://github.com/alkor2000) and Peter Steinberger, and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report. Profile pins still restrict selection, and setting the cap to zero disables it.
- Fixes Anthropic Advisor reviews and similar read-only session forks missing an available prompt cache when the thinking level comes from an agent or model default.
  [PR #197203](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197203), [commit bd0fd94c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bd0fd94c887ffe057fcac0ef34f924492e34f182). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes long OpenAI Responses conversations resending their full history when the same API key moves between an auth profile and provider settings. It also preserves saved context after switching or falling back to a compatible model on the same provider connection, and in Anthropic conversations when only the credential source changes.
  Credential source — [PR #200063](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200063), [commit 1bf3b1d9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bf3b1d98b812de06795218cd35e96c6840ad691). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport). · Model changes — [PR #200208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200208), [commit d7ecad68](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7ecad68fd7020947dde5c6011ad5a5f2a7699ed). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes a case where replies could stop going through after you removed a selected model login during a Gateway configuration reload.
  [commit 5650e59b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5650e59bfdf4cb2e3745e8b94fb76ac3d720d831).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving models unavailable when a saved, generated provider catalog lists valid prices for some rates but leaves others out. Correct null or nonnumeric prices at the provider source and refresh the catalog; correct authored `models.json` prices directly.
  [commit eb8a6a8c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb8a6a8c3f45bfd3259f1a195bd8b801e63ea1a3), [related open PR #167267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167267). Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Missing rates are filled with zero while supplied values are preserved.
- Fixes tool-call rejections for explicitly selected pre-GPT-5 OpenAI models by using compatible tools.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f50415ef21515fba2bb23114ab573abd5068b92).
- Replaces raw errors for invalid gateway addresses in non-interactive Bifrost setup with a request for a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL. Setup exits without saving credentials or configuration.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7df11be5ab10e47980973ed9d2ef60f488fa7820). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gemini compatibility for tools whose parameter schemas accept more than one kind of value, including message table cells. The Gemini projection uses the first non-null type.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3bd6a6a0024ef6d515ecceeac803f2f8f91d3c8).
- Fixes eligible retries after a rate limit or other temporary provider rejection adding a hidden follow-up when the provider returned no output and the original message could safely be resent. Resending that message helps the provider reuse cached input.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8d5a13806699ebdd2cba44a072913dea1d7d0115). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Restores configured backup-model fallback after an interrupted attempt without duplicating the user input, and avoids switching models for local session capability errors.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Restores Google tool calls with argument names that are Python keywords.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Sizes the output cap during fresh LM Studio setup after the preferred model context is selected, within the model’s advertised maximum.
  [Commit 85be164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/85be1645ed42112bf5c6245b59f87e2508a333cc).
- Fixes additional `item_conflict` failures when continuing a compacted conversation through OpenAI’s Responses API, including when a plugin modifies the request. Extends the existing `/compact` and retry guidance to more forms of the same error.
  [Commit 9e9bb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e9bb27841888b8b0316485a8a3102593fdd6a24). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes a configured primary account blocking fallback to a different provider’s CLI. An account you explicitly pinned to the session is still rejected if the fallback CLI cannot use it.
  [Commit 25eac4b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25eac4bcab9fbe225134aa0019ad90cb737f137b). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps TypeSafe’s configured endpoint scoped to TypeSafe, leaving OpenAI and OpenRouter endpoint settings alone.
  [Commit a7749da](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7749da15c2db4b0458dd348e9956768b466208e). Thanks [@vishnusenthil-16](https://github.com/vishnusenthil-16) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes missing model-specific Thinking levels and saved Ultrafast defaults not showing as selected in [Models settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings). Saved Thinking and Fast Mode choices stay selected but disabled if the model no longer supports them, and models pinned to an account no longer offer speeds based on another account’s access.
  [#173768](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173768) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d694fe8c09ffa672ed1d144210730fc8dfd9f18e). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes crowded Models settings by aligning controls on wider screens and stacking them so long labels can wrap on narrow screens. API or account details stay available in the open model picker without crowding the closed control.
  [#173769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173769) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b6f5a4b82b4da6649ce5d62c2a960686ce0919e9). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Claude CLI usage showing as unpriced when a matching Anthropic API rate is available, including offline when that rate is bundled. It also fixes one-hour prompt cache writes being estimated at the cheaper five-minute rate. These figures are API cost estimates, not subscription charges.
  [#173792](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173792) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/be6eedf5e0d5a081a0e89a1f8a44d3b4fe4f02a8). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx).
- Stops detected loops in long replies from known models in the 32B class or smaller and keeps the stopped block out of later turns without automatically rerunning tool work. The detector is heuristic and may not recall text already displayed. [Local model guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/local-models#output-budgets-and-repetition-stops)
  [#173844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173844). Thanks to steipete, 5jrfrbd6z9-spec, garysui and Yigtwxx. The detector is adapted from [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md#hermes-agent).
- Applies cloud output defaults to known Ollama Cloud models configured under Ollama without a cloud suffix, unless you set an output limit yourself.
  [#173844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173844). Thanks to steipete, 5jrfrbd6z9-spec, garysui and Yigtwxx.
- Removes the guessed context percentage from chat when a message group reports that the reading is unavailable. When a real reading is present, it takes precedence over estimates from older messages.
  [#173854](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173854), [original report and repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159601). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes ordinary follow-up replies silently dropping a configured or inherited automatic OpenAI model choice in child sessions using the OpenAI Responses fallback with a Codex runtime policy.
  [PR #174077](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174077) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b12e8fbfea8399242e2a2a81ebf8acf91dff3faf). Thanks [@xiajiahang](https://github.com/xiajiahang) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix, [@flyto168](https://github.com/flyto168) for the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174053), and [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) for the [investigation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174077#issuecomment-6335862137).
- Fixes GitHub Copilot isolated completions timing out too early or waiting past their timeout when the system clock changes mid-request.
  [PR #174207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174207). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes undercounted tokens and costs when [model fallback](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/model-failover) discards a completed response. Each completed call uses its own price, and the total stays unknown if any call can’t be priced. Applies the same pricing to turns that continue after a plugin refresh and includes usage from both sides of the refresh in diagnostics.
  [PR #174233](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174233). Thanks [@yinx65588-boop](https://github.com/yinx65588-boop) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for reporting the issue.
- Fixes hangs that could hide diagnostics for oversized or stalled model responses. Failed ChatGPT Responses API requests also report the original error instead of getting stuck.
  [PR #174238](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174238) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cbbf3b94d5f58ce0bc3657cd829865a33a65e3d). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes isolated model requests getting extra time after slow setup or a credential retry. A request that times out during setup won’t start running later.
  [#174259](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174259). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Shows Codex detection and sign-in check errors instead of treating Codex as missing. [Automatic setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/onboarding-overview) also stops and shows the problem if it cannot inspect Codex, rather than quietly selecting a local model. Fix the reported problem and retry, or choose another provider manually.
  [PR #174284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174284) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4959773fa7fb0db1cc1a36172ee278be32d25519) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the memory OpenClaw keeps after discovering models for OpenAI Codex accounts, particularly when you use several accounts.
  [PR #174361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174361) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b9fe6a8cd258dc1b0a9f6f4464ac2fd6406497d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents stale provider model lists from carrying over when OpenClaw fully closes one runtime and starts another in the same process.
  [PR #174493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174493) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1780bb4faf34e0e2d8b8a551104177b06e39588f) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks) and model checks incorrectly reporting valid OpenRouter chat models as missing when the built-in catalog lists only non-chat entries for OpenRouter.
  [#174585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174585) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aa834b100e286b52928656153708ea3e605ce81c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Spaces out retries when conversations hit a shared OpenAI organization token limit on the same Gateway, instead of having each conversation retry or immediately switch models on the same exhausted account. In embedded conversations, you can see when a request is waiting for the rate limit, and interactive requests go ahead of background work when retries resume.
  [PR #174782](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174782) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68a7e7b5b76695c4132c16fd852102492f00dae0). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes strict OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions providers rejecting later turns because older messages refer to a tool the model can’t use on the current turn. The model still gets the old result as text, and your saved conversation stays unchanged.
  [PR #174797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174797) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8fc3509a66ad89028e1bd15c027a5426373cd977). Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@gorendac](https://github.com/gorendac) for the report.
- Fixes GitHub Copilot device sign-in expiring too early or waiting much longer than intended if the computer's clock jumps during sign-in.
  [PR #174822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174822) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b1ac41c3145ae2ab1018d6c2f4ec5c43b576fc5). Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Fixes Tavily search and extract silently switching to hosted Tavily when a custom URL is invalid. MiniMax and MiniMax Portal music and video generation also reject an invalid custom URL instead of switching to the default host. Correct the URL and retry if you get this error. Leaving the URL unset still uses the default.
  [PR #175101](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175101) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/09268f36ba8f0f1a9be06c842e451a638f895d6b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). See the [Tavily](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tavily) and [MiniMax](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/minimax) guides.
- Keeps optional tool arguments optional on public [OpenRouter](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/openrouter) routes, reducing browser tool failures caused by OpenAI models filling in values they should be able to leave out.
  [#175267](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175267) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e96ea4b3d7c639a5393b5b3ff32d0ed9d9e2c6e2). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@alkor2000](https://github.com/alkor2000), and to [@donslaine](https://github.com/donslaine) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/165735).
- Fixes inconsistent [prompt caching](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) for Gemini on supported OpenRouter routes so repeated requests can reuse eligible, unchanged instructions.
  [#175268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175268) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ffb250d717c41abc0c40de1972e51aa0cfaa602c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@woodleyB1992](https://github.com/woodleyB1992) for the [original Gemini report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/129005).
- Fixes `/models` and `openclaw models status` pointing to a saved profile when a custom provider configured for API-key authentication is using its literal configured API key.
  [PR #175340](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175340) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/718e3f03cd1f465de8e506a087f954208489d9cd) · [Issue #175338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175338). Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Fixes OpenAI Responses turns staying busy when the provider keeps sending status updates but makes no progress on the response. The stalled attempt can time out so OpenClaw can recover, while real progress such as reasoning or tool calls still gives it more time. Long computations sending only status updates can also time out.
  [#175733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175733) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a2f7c8ece144dea5b1a89806eae5e0dcfec74c59) · [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178182). Thanks [@enki](https://github.com/enki), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@mrciorz](https://github.com/mrciorz).
- Cuts unnecessary work when OpenClaw prepares model settings or reports costs for a successful isolated completion.
  [#175747](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175747) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/10cbb85fdd98845512b94b5c8e1abd23062d343c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the chat model picker closing on iPhone when you tap a provider to see its models.
  [PR #175775](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175775) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8d9e0332be317d6a295b065ada53a92efb2760aa) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Corrects the names shown for Muse Wonder Contributor, Wonder Full, and Wonder Full Contributor so you can tell them apart in the model picker.
  [PR #175806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175806) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4aa0e219fef1bb622632052a21c10c4d09b83cce) · [Muse guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/muse). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the Models page showing a rejected default as if it saved. It returns to your saved choice and keeps the rejected change available under Retry. Unsent edits survive a temporary disconnect, and the page waits for current defaults after reconnect instead of showing stale ones.
  [#175840](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175840) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d6a7e3d211ec40935cb702c00611a320e32c307c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes SGLang and vLLM setup appending a custom base URL to the default. Pressing Enter keeps your saved URL, or uses the default if you haven’t set one.
  [#175855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175855) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb54f49633be3b2ce91aa7503228172f8b6288ab) · [Issue #175736](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175736). Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) for the fix and [@midhunvnadh](https://github.com/midhunvnadh) for the report.
- Adds a warning when OpenClaw can’t prepare to undo a model change made by an agent. The run can continue without automatic rollback. If you see the warning, check session storage and model settings.
  [PR #175889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175889) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents configured aliases and model names from clearing or adding misleading lines to terminal output in `models aliases list`, `models fallbacks list`, `models image-fallbacks list`, and `models status`. This fix leaves JSON output and saved configuration unchanged.
  [#176007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176007) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the account reorder preview staying on screen when the Models settings window loses focus mid-drag. The drag is cancelled without saving a new order.
  [PR #176481](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176481) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ccdf6be05b473f56371bd04caa484db896b7af17). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Claude Code models staying marked unavailable after you sign in. Signing in or out now updates model availability without a Gateway restart.
  [#178339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178339). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [LM Studio](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/lmstudio) dropping valid model settings for instructions and continuing Responses API requests.
  [#178344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178344). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes native Anthropic PDF analysis rejecting a saved subscription token even though the same profile worked for chat. Signing in only through the Claude CLI still doesn’t supply credentials for [PDF analysis](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/tools/pdf.md).
  [#178420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178420). Thanks to [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and to [@khensthoth](https://github.com/khensthoth) for the report.
- Fixes reusable OpenAI Responses WebSocket connections keeping completed agent turns in memory.
  [PR #178536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178536). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Replaces misleading catalog-refresh advice in `/model` with the relevant next step when you need to sign in, sign-in has failed, or the selected route is temporarily unavailable.
  If prompted for Claude CLI sign-in, run `claude auth login` on the Gateway host or choose another model. [PR #174115](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174115) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ed4e2160559a4a6464c92967a812a24e6725dd24). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Stops [Doctor and update migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations) from silently replacing selected models like `openai/gpt-4.1-mini` based on their names alone. Migrating xAI search settings also preserves your selected model. The OpenAI catalog lists the still-served `openai/gpt-4.1` as deprecated, with shutdown scheduled for January 14, 2027.
  [#178722](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178722), [#170742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170742) and [#169473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169473). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@MonkeyLeeT](https://github.com/MonkeyLeeT) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Gives a configured fallback model more chance to run by limiting default retries in eligible [scheduled and other time-limited runs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry). Explicit retry counts and request timeouts still apply.
  [PR #186368](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186368), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a479bc7f2443da646d5c220e6a78df9b3fbd4566). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@tommyjoseph](https://github.com/tommyjoseph).
- Fixes ChatGPT WebSocket connections failing before reaching a configured HTTP or HTTPS proxy when OpenClaw runs on Bun.
  [#183189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183189). [Original fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161524). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@grynn](https://github.com/grynn) for the report and original fix, and Vishal Doshi for the [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea83c0aa6273c744d7e53c638c61556aa479281e).
- Fixes automatic PDF analysis shortening vision model IDs that contain slashes and failing the first request. The first request uses the full model ID.
  [#186526](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186526). Thanks [@goutamadwant](https://github.com/goutamadwant), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kalch](https://github.com/kalch) for the report and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for verification.
- Fixes hosted models behind a [local relay](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/local-models) being given the longer timeouts meant for local models. Set `models.providers.<id>.remote` to `true` to use hosted timeouts for that provider. This does not change when retries give way to a fallback model.
  [PR #183637](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183637). Thanks [@tommyjoseph](https://github.com/tommyjoseph) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Usage page and `usage.cost` silently leaving sessions out of their totals on large Gateways. Totals and daily charts include archived sessions and recent activity, and reports are marked partial if usage data is still being summarized. The overview can also be partial when a range splits an active 15-minute interval. Large reports put less load on the Gateway. Sessions you lose access to while a report is loading stay out of its totals. Daily p95 latency now shows the highest 15-minute p95 for that day, not a percentile across the whole day.
  [PR #184066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184066). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Usage counting the same turns twice in totals and charts after you rewind, create or switch branches, fork a session, or start a subagent with its parent’s history. Previously uncounted turns still contribute to token and message counts and cost totals. This doesn’t correct copies made before the update.
  [PR #187328](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187328). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops OpenClaw from asking Kilo models to use tools when those models say they don’t support them.
  [PR #187365](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187365) and [report #151015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/151015). Thanks [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Prevents malformed piped model credentials from silently replacing saved credentials.
  [PR #167251](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167251). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing Usage metrics when some turns have no provider usage data. The Usage page, charts, exports and command summaries report measured usage without the old lower-bound label. Turns with unknown usage still count as messages and, if they failed, as errors, but totals can understate what you used or were charged.
  [#187212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187212) · [commit a8fe857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a8fe857038f62b209d7ef0b81e62b4a49fdfdbee). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes interactive [LiteLLM](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/litellm) setup skipping the proxy URL or choosing a model your proxy may not serve. Choose an advertised model or enter an ID; if discovery fails, setup explains why. Signing in again keeps saved provider and model settings, including the proxy address, when provider names differ in capitalization. Activating a saved sign-in no longer brings back duplicate provider entries. If configuration changes during setup, the request stops before credentials go to the old endpoint.
  [Proxy setup and provider settings #173164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173164) · [Model discovery #174818](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174818) · [Reauthentication #174824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174824) · [Discovery commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c60b3ee9aff98514486092223184c24c93c67098) · [Reauthentication commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f4f9261fc1a9dbb27bce28c6cd55322eda1ca86) · [LiteLLM guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/litellm.md). Thanks [@midhunvnadh](https://github.com/midhunvnadh) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@Hylance](https://github.com/Hylance) for the report.
- Fixes the chat model picker leaving search unfocused when it opens before the models finish loading. If you move focus elsewhere, it stays there.
  [Picker focus #174044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174044) · [Focus after loading #175385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175385). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Usage including excluded days in session totals, message and tool counts, and dated conversation entries. It also removes double counting of known files, skills and tool descriptions in the estimated system prompt breakdown.
  [Usage calculations #175744](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175744) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4167d2087eafb1c5d28cb1d473d6096a376f689). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Prompt caching and conversation continuations

- Fixes avoidable [prompt-cache](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching) misses when you continue a conversation, including after background or subagent work, a restart, or a switch between clients. When a subagent finishes while its parent is idle, the handoff is retained in the raw transcript while remaining hidden in chat.
  The fixes cover changing instructions, returned session results, history reloads, Goals and scheduled wakes. Subagent follow-ups retain their role, restrictions and delegation rules. A CLI continuation of a saved group keeps its presentation while using the current reply route; scheduled actions remain limited to the current job. [Instructions and subagent follow-ups #185887](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185887) · [Subagent completions #185888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185888) · [Returned results #186208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186208) · [commit d75ded45](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d75ded45a08bf82b451716f8ddb00df4b01ef55c) · [CLI and scheduled continuations #186338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186338) · [commit 41b50b4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/41b50b4dbcbae199224d2e6aa2c54edaf39d8d43) · [Reports and continuation examples](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/143017#issuecomment-6457000585). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report, and [@iceteaSA](https://github.com/iceteaSA), [@VishalJ99](https://github.com/VishalJ99) and [@duardor968](https://github.com/duardor968) for continuation examples.

  Eligible internal follow-up turns on native OpenAI Responses and direct Anthropic pinned-prompt routes keep the session’s selected personal preferences; isolated cron jobs use shared defaults. Display-only changes no longer cause false history-change warnings. [CLI and recovery #181279](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181279) · [commit 35cb5aa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35cb5aaa451061b246740e0dcca1e4e025502dae) · [OpenAI client changes #181301](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181301) · [commit ec2ae37](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec2ae37f9ded58296c251f3b14f3f8a232a93ec3) · [Same-session follow-ups #183898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183898) · [commit c38142d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c38142d67d42f4856de3ab00d602859f99a0067b) · [Endpoint guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/prompt-caching.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

  Tool permissions still apply immediately. Eligible UI turns keep task suggestions, while incoming turns without a grant do not gain access. Tool search can find the right tool when names overlap, including on remote workers. Embedded run history — [#185784](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185784) · [`b9308ff`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b9308ff8d8f78211414385c4f803edf3d889646e) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Background completions and tools — [PR #197835](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197835) · [commit 2a2c7368](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a2c73689d60e83a66b339a8f1c6a142b9ce2559) · [issue #191128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/191128).
