Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@mirasrael](https://github.com/mirasrael) for contributing, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport, and [@exgeni](https://github.com/exGeni) for reproduction. Task suggestions — [PR #197893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197893) · [commit f3eb4cdf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f3eb4cdff904474619f37147c9e0c33b28169b01) · [issue #155868](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/155868). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).

  Configured owner guidance remains in the prompt when a subagent finishes, without changing sender authority. Thanks to masatohoshino and steipete, to Eragim for the broader cache report, and to CodeForcer for identifying the owner guidance difference. [#180608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180608) · [363aaa0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/363aaa05fcf435b38f8c96a7a6d04c0821ec5043) · [Issue #180607](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180607) · [Related cache discussion](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/150081). For a completion while the parent is idle, the handoff is retained for the next turn’s history. Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino). [#181673](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181673) · [`e62f224`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e62f2242e8d7ee10f7eb79b873100af33364b733) · [issue #181672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181672).
- Fixes repeated prompt-cache writes when session instructions change on affected [Anthropic Messages connections](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/anthropic), including OAuth, custom proxies, Vertex and Foundry. Updated instructions still reach the model, and the session’s starting prompt can be retained across restarts.
  This change does not cover Bedrock Converse or remote worker turns. [PR #197925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197925) · [commit 7c236d45](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c236d45c0689085ba9cf688aac8c725d4bbebdb). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).

##### Daybreak Access

- Fixes a Daybreak Blue access error that could block a run on the OpenClaw runtime after your OpenAI sign-in refreshed, even when the same account still had access.
  [#184364](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184364) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Rejects unavailable OpenAI cyber Access settings for native subagents with an explicit error and enforces account and model eligibility through request submission.
  [#185230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185230) · [commit 94390ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/94390ecb6b3d2b592e5f7636396f633f4af20dcd) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Fixes the Daybreak switch ignoring a click during live chat updates and leaving Daybreak on when you tried to switch back to Standard.
  [#186357](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186357) · [commit 1f26ff4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1f26ff47c370fdd692184fcb6825aab54ae70158) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes queued follow-up messages using an old Access setting after you change or clear it before the follow-up is accepted.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bd6807a336d65b22e65fb99643d7761d1ff9e3fc).

##### Plugins, skills and templates

- Fixes a Template detail view staying pending when the Gateway disconnects, and lets you retry a failed detail request in the same view. Enable the experimental catalog in **Settings → Labs**. [Templates guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates)
  [#179368](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179368) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes custom ClawHub registry installs using unrelated public catalog details. Third-party install hooks apply to packages from custom registries.
  [#147103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147103). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents malformed Claude command files from being imported as corrupted skills. Re-save or re-encode the file as UTF-8 before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168536">PR #168536</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a4f9e6c59ccaf53e2deababd3a536e61a1e2b14">`1a4f9e6`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666">@wangmiao0668000666</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes plugin registry warnings persisting after an unreadable load path is removed.
  [PR #168913](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168913) · [f9b097a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9b097a8d38a59735f2de1070895b2e1ab94144c). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@giodl73-repo](https://github.com/giodl73-repo).
- Removes unsolicited native plugin recommendations from OpenClaw-managed Codex sessions, including when those suggestions were enabled in Codex settings. Browse available plugins with `/codex plugins available`. [Codex native plugins](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/codex-native-plugins.md)
  [PR #169323](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169323) · [eb87bb1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb87bb1fd7bac4724453a90e3daa1ce490c0eb25). Thanks to [@lastguru-net](https://github.com/lastguru-net).
- Fixes skill-library imports failing for bundle directories whose names end in `.zip`. These directories can be imported with their existing names and no trailing slash. [Skill library import](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/skills)
  [#172131](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172131) · Thanks to [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes model-catalog refreshes running unrelated plugin setup checks and local agent commands registering plugins an extra time.
  [#172239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172239) · Thanks to [@ekinnee](https://github.com/ekinnee), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes affected plugin CLI commands failing to register when a plugin reads runtime configuration during startup.
  Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval). [#172428](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172428) · [5dd1f3d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5dd1f3d76653203a505d1d02b22f2fb715b2de11)
- Fixes plugin updates stopping on operator-managed load-path plugins. Those copies are skipped with a warning, so other eligible plugins can still update. See the [plugin update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update).
  Maintain skipped copies at their source. Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval). [#172432](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172432) · [7b33c8b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7b33c8babd2f3deafc4ece23c544dfeae8ddc6d0)
- Fixes large external plugin source preparation blocking Gateway requests during asynchronous loading and reload. If earlier captured code is missing, replacement can continue with a warning that rollback cannot restore it.
  See [how plugin loading works](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/architecture.md).

  [#172750](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172750). Thanks to [@ExoHumann](https://github.com/ExoHumann).
- Filters terminal controls from installed skill and hook descriptions in human-readable CLI reports and hook errors.
  [#172872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172872). Thanks [@alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes eligible agent turns failing during a plugin reload when they need compatible nested work with a static model configuration.
  [#172881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172881). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes explicitly enabled plugins being rejected after a configuration change that leaves the resolved values unchanged.
  Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#173334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173334)
- Fixes the Skill Workshop archive undo command so it restores the right agent’s skill, even when run from a directory that selects a different agent.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173428">#173428</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/abe51c8937170ce29f7884a951cbea6d172e92c6">Commit abe51c893</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/skills">Skills CLI guide</a>. Thanks [@ly85206559](https://github.com/ly85206559), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes command and skill lists failing when the session’s selected skills change while the list is loading. An authorized list can finish with the selection it started with. The next request uses the updated selection.
  [#174612](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174612) · [`56cfa96`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/56cfa960a600442009b07df0547af4282242f8e4). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the Gateway and CLI able to shut down cleanly after preparing an external plugin by finishing accepted work and closing its workers.
  [#174633](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174633) · [`29f7652`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29f765226d7be899c7501364cd286955977a7e85). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids tying up the Gateway while it checks for bundled-plugin conflicts during a Template preview or **Add** on a source build. [Templates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates)
  [#174675](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174675) · [`08e67cb`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08e67cb240edcca582ebbe902311624655f1e1b9). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes plugin services getting left stopped after a configuration-only reload when cleanup takes longer than expected. Once cleanup succeeds, affected services such as the memory indexing watcher restart without another reload. [Plugin services](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/architecture)
  [#174682](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174682) · [`e69e340`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e69e34001fb5e5439dfac48f53e821d970112625). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents `openclaw skills workshop restore` from restoring the newest saved version when `--version` is explicitly empty. Omit the flag if you want the newest saved version.
  [#175023](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175023) — Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).
- Protects the terminal display when `openclaw templates inspect` shows agent names from a template. The same protection covers human-readable diagnostics from `inspect`, `add`, `validate` and `dev`. JSON output still returns the original values. [Templates CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/templates)
  [#174989](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174989) — Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes system clock changes cutting short or prolonging the wait for ongoing work during a Gateway plugin reload or recovery.
  [#175639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175639) · [c99f01a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c99f01a9d7e833badc3158c7e7092fb4cb75295d). Thanks SunnyShu0925, steipete.
- Stops `openclaw plugins reload --wait` from waiting indefinitely for active work. If work is still running after the ten-minute drain limit, the reload begins rollback and lets that work continue. Cleanup and recovery can add time. [Plugin reload commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/uninstall-and-update)
  [#175686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175686) · [55ce16b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/55ce16b61cd5822f98be360d8297aca7de4353f3) · [issue #173061](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173061). Thanks yxshee, steipete, xtimor.
- Fixes later configuration edits leaving pending plugin changes behind after a reload stalls. The next edit retries the pending changes along with the new ones. A manual plugin reload makes a fresh attempt and reports its own result. [Configuration hot reload](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload)
  [#175706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175706) · [176df46](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/176df466214cadbdb577d4fc30c5ab154819fb9a). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Skills Library showing a failed load from the old connection or hiding the current list’s loading indicator after you reconnect. Fixes Skill Workshop showing a failed load for the previous agent or hiding the current agent’s loading indicator after you switch agents.
  [#175698](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175698) · [36bd5fa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36bd5fafcf4a557ed2232c5917820ecdd772a93c). Thanks steipete.
- Reduces memory use during external plugin preparation and prevents setup workers from staying alive solely to keep native files available for reuse or recovery.
  OpenClaw frees prepared-plugin callbacks when their last owner is gone and can save pending setup records after workers exit. [#176124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176124) · [commit 09394ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/09394eca7165df8614a64798060963c4610cbf80) · [#176280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176280) · [commit b81e502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b81e502d2dd5498e235cad1a67049d845ce17317) · [#177067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177067) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Gives each Add button in Templates Explore a screen-reader label with its template name, so you can tell which details it opens.
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176184">#176184</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4284f1a09a3c919a153a8b51d02763a740eb9067">Commit 4284f1a</a>
- Prevents Code Mode skill lists and installed-skill search from returning broken characters when they shorten long skill descriptions.
  Thanks [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176233">#176233</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7492ad6400de448be6e1e9bc29c551c3ec2e5ee1">Commit 7492ad6</a>
- Fixes skills and hooks being marked ready when OpenClaw finds a folder with the name of the executable they require.

- Fixes skill folders going unnoticed when you create them after the Gateway starts on Linux with Node 24. OpenClaw picks up the new folder and edits there without waiting for the periodic refresh.

- Defers plugins that need a data migration and tells you which ones need attention. A reload keeps the working plugin in place if its replacement still needs a migration. If OpenClaw reports one, stop the Gateway, run `openclaw doctor --fix` with the same state and configuration, then start the Gateway again.
  [#178165](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178165) · [commit 36b28bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/36b28bb0f51d9006bae3baafa47959b3332e3c8a) · [Plugin migration recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/inspect-and-diagnose). - Fixes plugin updates leaving the previous installation incomplete when another process holds a file open during replacement. Check which settings are active afterward.

- Replaces the misleading unknown result on the Control UI Plugins page with a clear message when an OpenClaw upgrade blocks an install before it starts. You can retry after the upgrade finishes.
  [PR #187110](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187110). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Prevents OpenClaw from loading hooks from the wrong folder when a configured hook path starts or ends with a space. If the configured folder is missing, OpenClaw reports it instead of loading hooks from another folder.
  [PR #187554](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187554). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Prevents text from templates and file paths from disrupting the display of human-readable Templates CLI reports. JSON output is unchanged.
  [#187666](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187666). Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes missing-file errors when importing affected bundled plugins.
  [#188639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188639), [source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0b084c6aabe75c24c914b7a8f6fec329b83c381f). Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport d949ac4e22).
- Adds the missing icon and activity artwork for the bundled Liquid AI plugin.
  [#189436](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189436). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Gives ClawHub package lookups one more chance to recover from a temporary service error before failing. If the error persists, the extra retry can add a 30-second wait before the final attempt.
  [#190452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190452). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Prevents [marketplace plugin installs and updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/install) from silently choosing the first source when multiple entries have the same name. Remove or rename the duplicates to continue.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fb666f2338801247fde9c1445c50ac02288a439). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes fallback to the built-in context engine when an approved plugin declares a [context engine](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/context-engine#plugin-and-engine-ids) under a different ID. Installation can select its only declared engine, and [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations) can correct an unambiguous old plugin-ID setting. If a plugin declares several engines or drops your selected engine, choose an engine it still provides. A broken link to a local plugin must be corrected before CLI uninstall.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/53fb615aafeba689d6442ac535fd2af3b9ce9b1c). Thanks [@pollybot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Prevents a native chat command from running the same continuing plugin command more than once.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes workspace memory and skills imports racing on the first turn when OpenClaw runs from source.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Keeps empty validation-generated plugin settings from widening a restrictive allowlist.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Stops [automatic Skill Workshop reviews](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/self-learning) from repeatedly retrying when your model provider rate-limits requests, and gives active conversations priority. Reviews use a recent conversation excerpt and no longer look through other sources, so they can miss lessons that need more context. Failed or interrupted reviews are discarded rather than replayed.
  [PR #173889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173889) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a6c6b1d0d14647a50a02ce525655168444f6074) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes plugins loading incompletely when more than one request loads the same plugin at once.
  [PR #174060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174060) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/910b54b1ffa9c3a9e60e3a1722b84d82457bc537). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes remote workspace skills failing to load on Node source installs when several requests arrive while the skills are first loading.
  [#174252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174252). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes installed plugins disappearing when the Gateway starts from another copy of the same standalone build. If your plugins still point to a missing copy or a different build, run `openclaw doctor --fix` from the selected runtime and restart the Gateway. See the [standalone repair instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  [#174273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174273). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores Cloudflare R2 as a bundled plugin in the default package and stops suggesting a separate install to repair a bundled copy. Standalone builds that leave it out can still offer it as a separate install.
  [PR #174287](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174287) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5f09f0e38c142e6ce5f87de7638e478ca1ad84ff) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Auto Review](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/autoreview) remaining unavailable in sandboxed sessions after its protected personal skill is copied in and the tool is enabled. Personal installs work with the default Gateway state directory; with a custom state directory, use a managed install or skill library. Auto Review and other installed helpers are withheld from sandboxes that can write to their installation. If affected, move the installation to a host-only or read-only location.
  [PR #174403](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174403) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df0b8f4a096af11e90856a3fae65f062968cd6fa) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). · [PR #174467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174467). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Skill Workshop silently leaving skills out of the list when an existing skill file is too large or cannot be read safely. The list reports the read error instead.
  [PR #174520](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174520) · [commit 24f9be0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/24f9be0a7c945c70ad216399cfab085147e2f698). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes paired-node agents failing to find or read skills whose instructions were already delivered. It also extends remote-exec skill discovery to eligible skills left out of the prompt, within the [skill delivery limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/skills).
  [#175906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175906) · Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Fixes unexpected errors being hidden when OpenClaw looks for bundled plugins. Normal fallback still applies when a plugin directory is missing or unreadable.
  [#176004](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176004) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Frees memory left behind after plugin recovery cleanup without stopping the running plugin. Keeps native cleanup errors visible if a later cleanup attempt would otherwise report success.
  [#176034](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176034) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes OpenClaw overlooking installed plugins that declare a transcript source when looking up which plugin provides it.
  [PR #176467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176467). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes stale status dots and Ready, Needs Setup and Disabled counts after you enable or disable a skill in Settings → Skills. The page updates without a manual refresh, even when the change comes from another client.
  [#186760](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186760) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5f7d57eff508f815ef03f6560ca12b2b3d4aa0a) · Thanks [@jondihaynes](https://github.com/jondihaynes) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### Plugin development and Decisions

- Fixes context-engine plugin compaction timing out while useful work is still progressing. Plugin authors can opt in by declaring `onProgress` in `info.acceptedHostParams` and calling the callback as work advances.
  The overall limit is ten idle windows. Engines without progress reporting use one window. [#130973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/130973) · Thanks to [@elharonyclaw](https://github.com/elharonyclaw) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes direct plugin model requests failing repeatedly on a rate-limited credential when another configured profile is available. OpenClaw can also try remaining profiles after eligible authentication or billing failures.
  Explicit pins and provider-owned credentials stay tied to their selected account. An exhausted pool returns the last provider error. [Plugin model requests](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-runtime/models.md). [#152489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/152489). Thanks [@leilei3167](https://github.com/leilei3167), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sercada](https://github.com/sercada).
- Fixes duplicate plugin callbacks and refreshes during delegated compaction, and supplies configured transcript-size pressure to manual compaction.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167337">PR #167337</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b7749ae5bdbefbdb9cbc58778c20e3f8a181625">`5b7749a`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/jlapenna">@jlapenna</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes `api.inlineView()` being unavailable to plugin callbacks after registration.
  [#184110](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184110) · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668).
- Raises the Decision V2 batch limit to 400 questions for OpenAI and eligible ClawRouter requests, and rejects oversized OpenAI batches before they reach the API. ClawRouter requires Decisions support on the service; legacy V1 requests remain limited to 256 questions. [Decision limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models)
  OpenAI V2 supports up to 255 alternatives per choice. [OpenAI provider guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/openai.md) · [#172748](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172748) · [#172753](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172753) · [#180210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180210) · [commit bf28212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf28212f2c4fc3ced082728f9712932854c406f6). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixed TypeSafe rejecting valid hosted and local System One responses with extra response or usage metadata. Required answers and token counts are still validated.
  Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson) for the report and co-authorship. [#173045](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173045) · [issue #173039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173039) · [TypeSafe System One](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/typesafe.md)
- Fixes plugin guidance reaching the model twice when a plugin retries with the same key, including across runs in the same session. Codex guidance rejected before dispatch stays out of later model context and can be retried.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173458">#173458</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session">Prompt and session hooks</a>. Treat a `duplicate` outcome as terminal when deciding whether to send fallback guidance. Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents one agent’s rejected credentials from blocking Decision evaluations for other agents using the same provider. Later evaluations can use corrected credentials without resetting the provider.
  [#174001](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174001) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes `plugins.inspect` reporting `credentialReady` as true when a Decision provider that exposes the field hasn’t confirmed its credentials. An unconfirmed result can show false while the provider remains callable.
  [#174027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174027) · [Decision models guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Skips queued ONNX decisions that are no longer allowed to run, saving local compute on work whose results would be discarded.
  [#174005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174005) · Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes the Plugin SDK reporting unreadable web responses as empty when no size limit was set. The SDK now reports the read error.
  [#174632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174632) · [`87c1f1c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/87c1f1c673b136b23c374596bc718e317b8810bd). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw plugins build --entry` leaving duplicate entries that could prevent a plugin package from installing. Rebuilding one entry leaves the others intact, even when they share a filename. [Plugin CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins)
  [#174732](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174732) · [`facbe21`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/facbe21ddf986047e97c39a5a0de2471f16c5bed). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes deprecated SQLite calls hiding one another’s warnings or pointing plugin authors to replacements that don’t exist. The synchronous methods still work in 11.5. Node’s `--throw-deprecation` turns these warnings into errors. Find supported replacements in the [SQLite migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration/sqlite-async).
  [#174902](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174902) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes standalone plugins failing to prepare a sandbox workspace when they provide valid settings but OpenClaw has not loaded a global configuration.
  [#175420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175420). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids unnecessary plugin checks at Gateway startup when a configured Decision model’s provider and plugin have different IDs.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176313), [76d8094](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/76d8094464c77274c0c7df334991b56368e73169).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor` incorrectly flagging the Levanto Sage decision provider as an incomplete chat provider when you use matching V2-capable host and plugin versions. [Levanto Sage compatibility](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/levanto)
  [#177258](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177258). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Corrects the plugin SDK guide to explain that services and channels stay running while existing work finishes. If the wait times out, the reload fails and the old plugin starts accepting work again. The guide also explains when OpenClaw can restore the previous plugin after stopping begins. [Plugin SDK runtime guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime)
  After services start stopping, a failure before replacement may allow the previous plugin code to be restored if cleanup succeeds and the Gateway is outside a restart drain. [#177312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177312). Thanks [@Satoshi-Kusumoto](https://github.com/Satoshi-Kusumoto), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes provider replay hooks reporting a failed write when a session entry was already accepted but replay closed before the hook got its result.
  [#177549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177549) · [8d29c5af](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8d29c5af2807d3624cf587509051f53ed74ec881). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps model request-body state shared for package consumers that use both the internal AI entry point and the legacy OpenAI entry point.
  [#177939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177939) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes plugin link readers continuing to use old settings after a plugin update. Changes to whether a reader uses the current session or loads an overview first now take effect without reconnecting.
  [#177948](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177948) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing or out-of-date agent lists for plugins that use the compatibility roster, including the default main agent when no list is configured.
  [#178252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178252) · [commit 6a2e9a1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a2e9a1f9ea002b14e2847e8ca89e2b90c37f59d). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rejects native OpenAI Decisions results that contain configured or replacement credentials used for the request.
  [#178886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178886), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/121758697b041d637d37e656e8e08342940cb7dd). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes plugin commands in Slack and Discord failing to start declared subagents or schedule declared follow-up turns. Senders need channel command authorization and a verified identity linked to a person with `operator.admin`. A command that starts this work appears once in the conversation.
  [#180968](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180968) · [Plugin command background work](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/background-work#command-scoped-native-children). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Stops queued native subagents from waiting for a slot after the Gateway sees that a channel requester has lost operator access. Queued work reports an error, including work from scheduled commands, and affected subagents already running can be cancelled. The Gateway also withholds pending command replies when the command removes its requester’s access.
  [#181364](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181364) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b8c316977b6064262be4d11d706ade3c0d8edf69) · [Plugin background work](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/background-work) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes native Decision requests failing when a provider’s credential exchange expects a chat model. If your provider plugin exchanges credentials for Decision, use [`prepareRuntimeAuthV2`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins/runtime-hooks). The hook also supports chat, where existing legacy hooks continue to work.
  [#181574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181574) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes a TypeScript error that made provider plugins repeat unrelated settings when returning authentication changes. If your code reads the `models` list from one of these updates, handle the case where it’s omitted.
  [#181606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181606) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents plugin builds and validation from hanging or reading unintended content by requiring regular metadata files. Use regular files or symlinks to regular files for `package.json` and `openclaw.plugin.json`. [Plugin authoring guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/authoring)
  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#181762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181762) · [`8b1ceb6`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b1ceb600efa2ff15866b6f5913bb5f1bfffe257)
- Catches incompatible account types in channel plugin allowlist and default-target callbacks at type-check time. If your TypeScript plugin uses an incompatible account shape for those callbacks, provide `resolveAccessorAccount` or use a compatible shape. [Channel plugin SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182299">#182299</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes published plugins, custom Docker builds, and Node worker bundles missing dependencies needed by the plugins they include. [Docker installation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182335">#182335</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes reply-dispatch plugins being unable to recover native subagent runs when a start receipt is missing. On hosts that support listing, plugins can find and collect their own runs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182473">PR #182473</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5291a06cc263f0815fa087fd02bbdb29c3839089">5291a06c</a> · Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents a plugin’s configuration format rules from changing the checks used by other plugins and tools.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182807) · [Plugin manifest reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/manifest)
- Fixes [before-tool-call hooks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks/tool-policy) missing the reason a run started. When OpenClaw supplies the trigger, plugins can distinguish an automatic memory flush from the user turn that led to it. The requester still determines which permissions apply.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183246">#183246</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4b27ee88cec9a78377a04b2e3a352ba7c503450e">4b27ee8</a> · Thanks [@TheDoshus](https://github.com/TheDoshus) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes TypeScript picking up the wrong plugin types or failing to find them after you copy a declaration cache from another checkout.
  [#183781](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183781). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [declaration cache reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/reference/test/runner-internals.md).
- Fixes a cause of expired sign-in errors in long agent runs for custom provider transports that adopt per-request renewal. Follow-up requests can use a fresh OAuth credential for the same stored account. Transport developers can opt in through `requestAuth`. [Per-request credentials guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins#per-request-credentials-in-custom-transports)
  [#184791](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184791) ([`c152c597`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c152c5976b218bf62f7c7666c4703d1a39ecfa80)). Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes extension commands being stopped almost immediately when `api.exec` is given a timeout longer than about 25 days.
  [#186523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186523). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes TypeScript errors about missing PostgreSQL types when using the installed Plugin SDK, without needing to install those types separately.
  [#188091](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188091). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes [plugin storage work](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-runtime/state-and-system) colliding with Gateway shutdown. Work already accepted can finish, but new storage work is refused once shutdown starts. Stops retrying operations rejected because storage is closing, including Nostr’s saved-place recovery.
  [#189008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189008). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes obsolete native plugin metadata accumulating in a Gateway after repeated plugin rebuilds involving file edits or renames.
  [PR #199042](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/199042), [commit 867f3eb4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/867f3eb43f1f808cf7476b4215e02821f397cee5), [issue #198802](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/198802). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen) for the original change, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport, and [@jaxonparrott](https://github.com/jaxonparrott) for the report.
- Fixes a TypeScript error that could prevent the Slack extension from generating its type declarations.
  [commit 01ee4896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01ee48969b72dd033a01cec0e5f8bc09afa80e55).
- Fixes plugins using the wrong sandbox policy when the Plugin SDK is configured to use a different session store from the running OpenClaw instance.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/addb353acb4cdd16600112be857ca2a1fa62b0f3). Also carried by [the integration commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f50415ef21515fba2bb23114ab573abd5068b92).
- Corrects the GPT-6 Luna Decisions entry so it is identified as supporting Code Mode.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5199713a8ebf1bbcebc168f19f72e49464701156). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the [decision tool](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models) discarding valid responses with details such as an explicit yes or no, an abstention, an error on one question, or reported usage and cost. The tool also tells agents which question types and limits the selected model declares.
  [#174161](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174161) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/66dcec88fe5eb9baf05b9b631617e10285833047). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops optional tool filtering from taking the last available spot from requested [decision evaluations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/decision-models). When the provider is too busy for optional filtering, the agent keeps its tools.
  [#174266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174266). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Skips the extra model request from automatic Decision assistance when there are no tools for it to restrict.
  [#174269](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174269). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [Decision SDK](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities) evaluations getting a fresh timeout after preparation. If preparation uses all the time you requested, OpenClaw skips the provider call. Preparation or cleanup can still take longer than the requested timeout.
  [PR #174283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174283) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50cf3cd338114cbc68cbd443f1c625910a16b7d1) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Avoids loading unrelated parts of OpenClaw just to look up model helpers during plugin or provider setup.
  [PR #174516](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174516) · [commit 296414b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/296414b831eb235a931065ec2b2c91fd05f4f1b4). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Strengthens isolation for plugin hooks that run before tool calls by rejecting inputs that would let them share memory with the host.
  [#175276](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175276) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46d7d8943ec381f11768d1979b8e019694d7151c). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes session-binding capabilities disappearing or operations failing after a plugin registers a class-based adapter.
  [PR #175769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175769) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4608210b7f8a86962a9122faabfe40b88a29ed4) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes configured static model discovery losing the credential ownership declared by provider plugins. Conflicting credential owners are rejected rather than silently accepted.
  [#175896](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175896) · Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Corrects the TypeBox version in the [plugin publishing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/building-plugins.md) and [SDK setup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/sdk-setup.md) examples to the recommended `1.3.37` pin.
  [#172942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172942) · [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c9a6969e27bde70f9e7b38b5bdc80605f1c05be). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a pending V1 decision from being sent after its credentials or selected model change, for providers that honor OpenClaw’s request checks.
  [PR #175995](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175995). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes gaps in [Decision usage reporting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities) for accepted evaluations from the core APIs, the Decision tool, automatic tool screening, and V1 plugins. Token counts and costs are recorded when that information is available.
  [PR #176050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176050) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/137e7b2abc87d14e3be641bd824c064cb0b98e66) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Gives plugins a distinct `LLM_RUNTIME_LIFECYCLE` error when OpenClaw refuses a model request during a reload or after retiring the plugin. Plugin authors can distinguish these refusals from provider failures and decide whether to retry from a fresh operation after the reload.
  [PR #178543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178543). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes [`openclaw plugins init`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/plugins/authoring) generating package names npm rejects for scoped tool and provider plugins. A scaffold for `@scope/pkg` now uses `@scope/openclaw-plugin-pkg`.
  [#186901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186901) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/022048904b5edbc73c8fc5818d2937380122e6f9) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### Memory, Knowledge and search

- Fixes Knowledge reloads opening stores before earlier storage and maintenance work has stopped. Interrupted requests explain that they can be retried, and weekday and month-day maintenance schedules catch the first matching midnight after clocks spring forward.
  [Reload and shutdown](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184999) · [spring-forward schedules](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185003) · [openclaw/knowledge#2](https://github.com/openclaw/knowledge/pull/2) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a1c70d8fd93b83359b5eb90c0256bf1f1d0e014) · [Maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/maintenance). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) and [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif).
- Prevents malformed UTF-8 in ChatGPT exports, Wiki file imports and source sync from corrupting existing pages. These imports and OKF reimports also leave an existing page untouched if it contains malformed UTF-8. ChatGPT reimports preserve handwritten Notes containing a closing-marker example, and leave a page untouched if a Notes marker is missing. Restore the marker or use valid UTF-8 and retry the affected import.
  [ChatGPT exports](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171621) · [bridge and unsafe-local sources](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171675) · [file imports and Notes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173931) · [OKF imports](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175707) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d0ed8a73b4db4d754d5bb48211821cc895b915e6) · [Wiki import guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki) · [Memory Wiki](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/memory-wiki). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- **Known issue:** When the Gateway is offline and no agent is selected and there is no roster error, an enabled Memory overview can show **Waking memory…** and **Refresh status** instead of the offline message.
  [#180660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180660) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an old Active Memory policy-disabled notice lingering on later allowed turns.
  [#138544](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138544) · Thanks to [@Kaspnov](https://github.com/Kaspnov) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes large Memory Wiki searches and lookups blocking other Gateway work. Short page reads can proceed without waiting behind a full-vault scan. Under heavy load, full-vault scans can return an overload error.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166433">PR #166433</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a6ba1da8dcb5fad1d6eda0dfc431b14a229f3ed">`6a6ba1d`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/etzelm">@etzelm</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>.</span>
- Prevents blank or invalid UTF-8 synthesis body files from erasing or corrupting an existing wiki summary.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168045">PR #168045</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f962c130785d4e9976b38232f6b1314e38419b9">`3f962c1`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/nocodet888-arch">@nocodet888-arch</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes missing wiki backlinks for filename-only links and links to headings or blocks.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168118">PR #168118</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72d41b6f9d0bd2290a959f062b134f60664063d7">`72d41b6`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/yetval">@yetval</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Prevents memory promotion and Forget from corrupting malformed UTF-8 files. Convert a copy to UTF-8 before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168574">PR #168574</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0de7db364c23653066fc72a3601f07ea3094aa2b">`0de7db3`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666">@wangmiao0668000666</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes Ollama memory embeddings being blocked when the configured rootless Podman host gateway resolves to a link-local address. [Ollama advanced configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/ollama/advanced)
  [#172015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172015) · Thanks to [@albertominetti](https://github.com/albertominetti), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes stale recall remaining after dreaming repair archives its missing sources. If repair reports a cleanup warning, run `openclaw memory status --fix` or wait for nightly repair.
  <span>Recall from sources that still exist remains eligible. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172704">#172704</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and related reporter <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172688">@karlhillx (#172688)</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/dreaming.md#L40-L46">Dreaming documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixed memory maintenance repeatedly retrying a failed optional embedding service during its cooldown. Keyword search stays available and semantic indexing resumes after the service recovers.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@scoootscooob](https://github.com/scoootscooob). [#172906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172906) · [Built-in memory](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/memory-builtin.md)
- Fixed ordinary `openclaw doctor` runs hiding enabled dreaming when memory search is disabled. Doctor shows dreaming’s effective configuration and cadence separately from search health.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@olveww-dot](https://github.com/olveww-dot) for the report, and [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@bennewell35](https://github.com/bennewell35) for earlier investigations. [#172955](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172955) · [Doctor checks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/checks.md)
- Improves memory recall for native local Ollama runs when Tool Search is unset by making allowed memory tools directly available.
  Applies to embedded native local Ollama runs with memory search enabled and the memory tools permitted. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@lator57-gif](https://github.com/lator57-gif) for the report. [#173280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173280) · [#145137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/145137) · [Ollama troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/providers/ollama/troubleshooting.md) · [Tool Search](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/tool-search.md)
- Fixes Active Memory silently treating a scan as complete when a transcript consumer fails.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173426">#173426</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/885bd760863bd582fb17f22cae53ac690bd68d2b">Commit 885bd7608</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops a SQLite memory index update when removing the old vector fails, before inserting its replacement.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173426">#173426</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/885bd760863bd582fb17f22cae53ac690bd68d2b">Commit 885bd7608</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes silent recall-recording failures in the memory CLI. Search still returns matches and warns when it cannot record the recall for later promotion.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173426">#173426</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/885bd760863bd582fb17f22cae53ac690bd68d2b">Commit 885bd7608</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports errors reading legacy memory directories in Doctor and warns when cleanup of an incomplete retry copy fails.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173426">#173426</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/885bd760863bd582fb17f22cae53ac690bd68d2b">Commit 885bd7608</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Preserves existing Memory Wiki lint report notes when the report cannot be read. Fix the reported filesystem error and rerun lint.
  [#173598](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173598) · [c921503](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c921503c9d2858ba2bece5a94d96965a16e05ca6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an unnecessary full memory-index rebuild after restart when an initially empty index was filled later.
  [#173622](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173622) · [Built-in memory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory repair adding an extra day to existing recall history.
  [#173642](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173642) · [Memory CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible CLI-backed conversations being denied access to memory tools such as Knowledge. Access is scoped to the conversation, with owner-private memory available in eligible owner direct chats.
  [#173927](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173927) · Thanks jalehman.
- Stops OpenClaw from asking agents to add Memory Core’s project comments to memories saved with other providers.
  [#173935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173935) · Thanks jalehman.
- Rejects wrong-sized embeddings from OpenAI-compatible servers when you request a specific size. The Gateway embeddings API reports the requested and returned sizes. If your server ignores the override, remove it or use a server and model that support it. If you change the memory setting, rebuild the affected index. [Gateway embeddings API](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/openai-http-api) · [Memory settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config)
  [#175658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175658) · [6a3d528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a3d528f6e7bed0b89e9590c6a4a0fc3561e1b4c). Thanks frankhli843, steipete.
- Restores smaller embedding sizes for managed llama.cpp with a compatible GGUF model. If your index contains full-size embeddings despite a smaller configured size, rebuild it with `openclaw memory index --force --agent <id>`. [llama.cpp plugin](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/llama-cpp)
  [#175658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175658) · [6a3d528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a3d528f6e7bed0b89e9590c6a4a0fc3561e1b4c). Thanks frankhli843, steipete.
- Fixes `wiki ingest` failing after saving its source when a Gateway import is updating the same Memory Wiki vault. The ingest waits for the other update and can time out after about five minutes if the vault stays busy.
  Thanks to [@hehuang139](https://github.com/hehuang139) and contributor [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and to [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report. [#176839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176839) · [commit f4901f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f4901f8b7c10e736b9d90838436a0aee2ba034fa) · [Memory Wiki commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki) · [Issue #176635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176635)
- Replaces repeated dreaming errors with one warning when a multi-agent setup has no system agent to run new automatic dreaming jobs. Set `agents.defaults.systemAgent.agentId` to an existing agent to let scheduling resume.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176841](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176841) · [commit f8b7096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f8b7096ef827a265deac16dceab3a50bec4b1ba0) · [Dreaming configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/dreaming)
- Stops a memory index update if OpenClaw cannot determine which old search data to remove.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176993">#176993</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes deep memory consolidation giving up after 60 seconds even when you’ve set a longer agent timeout in `agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds`. If you haven’t set one, consolidation still uses its 60-second limit. [Dreaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/dreaming)
  [#177246](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177246), [issue #177068](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177068). Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@nikolay-bratanov](https://github.com/nikolay-bratanov).
- Prevents Qianfan memory indexing from failing because requests to `bge-large-zh`, `bge-large-en` or `Embedding-V1` contain too many inputs. If you use `openai-compatible` for Qianfan, set `memory.search.provider` to `qianfan` and keep your endpoint and key to get the fix. The Qianfan option identifies the provider and model in memory status. If you point it at a different endpoint, supply credentials for that endpoint. [Qianfan memory embeddings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/qianfan#memory-embeddings)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178130">#178130</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0061cdde5f9a06274ee1015d8a2fa2da4579fba1">0061cdde</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/125640">#125640</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@gaodaabao](https://github.com/gaodaabao) for the report, and [@saladinyao-cyber](https://github.com/saladinyao-cyber) and [@vildevev](https://github.com/vildevev) for earlier embedding work.
- Fixes search treating notes from extra memory paths on a remote workspace as stale after a save that leaves the text unchanged. The next sync picks up the new modification time without re-embedding the note.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178156">#178156</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c3dbb08bcbc5d2941e9551c78fc9c5562de039c">1c3dbb08</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory search blaming the embedding provider when its local storage has closed. The error suggests reloading Memory Core with `openclaw plugins reload memory-core` or restarting the Gateway before retrying.
  [#178187](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178187) · [commit ce3f47b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ce3f47b60a55d9302c70936c680319a039a68eed) · [Memory troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory) · [issue #177882](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177882). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@rebarshop-24](https://github.com/rebarshop-24) for the report.
- Fixes Memory Wiki lookups rejecting a visible page whose ID changes during lookup. The result uses the current visible page.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes SQLite memory rebuilds losing progress when an agent turn interrupts background indexing. The next sync continues the rebuild and picks up source changes before replacing the index that search is using. Restarting OpenClaw discards unfinished work, and interrupted PostgreSQL rebuilds still start over.
  <span>[#178979](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178979) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) · [Memory CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory)</span>
- Keeps the Dreaming diary tabs and Reload button visible when the diary, imported insights, or Memory Wiki fails to load, so you can switch tabs or retry without leaving the view.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179371">#179371</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Memory settings dropping the selection and saving state for a pending change when another change finishes. Reconnecting clears old previews, retrying an add-on change dismisses its previous error, and enabling an engine clears the old disabled warning while it saves.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179451">#179451</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes overlapping [memory indexing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory) requests reporting completion before newly detected files are searchable.
  [#179524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179524) · [951bfb8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/951bfb88263e57544e65475b1c3cfdfe25fc95fd) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed memory indexing failing on repeated content, whether you are indexing for the first time, rebuilding the index, or updating it. A later metadata-only update keeps the existing searchable content.
  [#179631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179631) · [0faa81b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0faa81b722bb2e7be64479f75b4ab008cfd603d5) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the old diary staying on screen when you switch agents during Dreaming maintenance, and the panel staying open after you leave it. An earlier action finishing no longer clears the progress indicator for a newer one.
  [#179525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179525) · [052a5fc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/052a5fc89fb6f1a5efc2ff64ef17359c158140dc) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unsaved text and number edits in Dreaming settings getting replaced when an unrelated setting changes.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180009">#180009</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4b283bb2bf1ba286dd3615a9d0070ee6ac38143">commit a4b283bb</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179994">issue #179994</a>. Thanks to [@AmelioMansour](https://github.com/AmelioMansour), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Shows **Loading…** and disables **How to enable** and **Open Config** while Memory Wiki settings are opening. If opening fails, you can retry, and switching agents or leaving Memory clears feedback from the old request.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180317">PR #180317</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e3f3a4311b65e50f1fdfacd600108587a0c47ac">Commit 7e3f3a4</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Memory Import controls staying busy with an import or session backfill from a previous agent or connection. Failed imports show the error inside the confirmation dialog so you can retry there. Settled plan results, errors, and backfill previews no longer flash back to loading when the page receives another update.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180423">PR #180423</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dfc65ff48c566434a2eedd207b54eb6e4cb42152">Commit dfc65ff</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes edits staying invisible to standalone memory searches because the command could exit before indexing them. The command still prints from the available index first, then waits for pending indexing before exiting. Gateway searches send ready results without waiting for indexing and keep them even if cleanup fails. [Memory search guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory)
  Thanks to Sedrak-Hovhannisyan, steipete and issue reporter h6y3. [#180624](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180624) · [16d1b9e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/16d1b9ec6c6782d0e0373299676b48b43b43989f) · [Issue #177685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177685)
- Fixes the English Memory overview saying embeddings were never checked after a result expires. The row says **No recent check** and points you to **Test** for a fresh result.
  [#181384](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181384) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d87b58517b931d0c7da1c6cf47e04c37ca76e2e8) · [Memory readiness checks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/memory.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@davidchyi-beep](https://github.com/davidchyi-beep).
- Fixes generated links showing up as plain text in native Memory Wiki indexes and backlinks when page paths contain spaces. Generated links also handle paths with parentheses.
  Thanks to L4XB and steipete. [#181967](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181967) · [cba52697fcd4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cba52697fcd4d326b2a2ee01cb41937dfa016291)

<a id="local-memory-flushes"></a>

- Fixes memory flushes failing when the separate flush model was unavailable even though the session had a working fallback. Flushes now use the session model and its fallbacks. [Memory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory) · [Doctor migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/config-migrations#memory-flush-model-selection) · [Plugin SDK migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-migration#memory-flush-model-selection).
  Supported updates remove `agents.defaults.compaction.memoryFlush.model`. If your configuration still contains it, run `openclaw doctor --fix` before starting the Gateway. Plugin authors should remove `model` from custom flush plans.

  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@zijunl](https://github.com/zijunl) for the earlier proposal. [#182208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182208) · [`56330328`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/56330328a7f84f464fc45e5538e6bef1c8a8fde2)
- Fixes memory search rejecting `google` as an unknown embedding provider. Both `google` and `gemini` use the same Gemini index, so you don’t need to rebuild it just to change the name. [Memory configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182250">#182250</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/LiLan0125">@LiLan0125</a>, <a href="https://github.com/dwc1997">@dwc1997</a>, <a href="https://github.com/fenglanhua">@fenglanhua (report)</a>.
- Fixes Memory Overview updates taking keyboard focus off **Refresh status**. The embedding **Test** button also stays in place through updates that leave it available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182290">#182290</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Reduces the work of making room in a full PostgreSQL memory embedding cache by letting the database find older entries using the timestamp index.
  Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the original cache-eviction fix. [#182821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182821) · [fdad53b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdad53b1bc1d66d98a11da12fb633a75f8285ecb)
- Fixes unnecessary re-embedding during memory rebuilds and after an [agent database port](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#port-existing-stores). Paused background rebuilds keep cached embeddings for reuse, and PostgreSQL full rebuilds can reuse them when caching is enabled. The cache can temporarily grow to twice its configured limit and is trimmed after the rebuild finishes or is discarded.
  [Paused rebuild cache](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182968) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/355a5ae8bc8e33e1d6590c831b79d667cd0bc60b) · [PostgreSQL rebuilds](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183089) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1cb75e90b29b73dbfc4c1d099a25b25e2e62702f) · [issue #182886 reported by etzelm](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182886) · [database ports and full rebuild reuse](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183302) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f89350c96ff1f1a0ddc690d3a9a4f95098ebf0d2) · [issue #183228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183228) · [Built-in memory](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), who also reported issue #183228.
- Fixes Codex turns reaching memory plugins without the original user message, which could make a plugin like Hindsight skip a completed turn.
  [#182977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182977) · [8b718f35](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b718f357d297b3f4a746c62df0780b65776e625) · Thanks to [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@PaulClawitzki](https://github.com/PaulClawitzki). · [Issue #182950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182950)
- Prevents cleanup of an excluded session archive from deleting newer entries for that session from the memory index. Cleanup also skips an extra lookup when it already knows the session is missing from the index.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183132">#183132</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2e29980f08775b8f2574820fc414ae0f2cfa42c">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Memory settings plugin panels staying active after you leave or switch their tab.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183367">#183367</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/40f1601663df41b7b0da7f41da4831ebee63fc48">40f1601</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes `wiki apply synthesis --body-file` hanging on special files. The command rejects those inputs before changing the wiki and reports the error in JSON mode too. Use a regular UTF-8 file or pass the text with `--body`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183435">#183435</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/690241f3643b6560e7a31e9f5bf8f92f6a153d8c">690241f</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki">Wiki CLI</a>. Thanks to [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).</span>
- Fixes a shutdown error that could occur after an interrupted Memory Core index rebuild.
  [#184616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184616) ([`c5d77b74`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5d77b74ab192b446564a35eda787660727676e2)). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). The temporary rebuild cache can stay at up to twice its configured cap until a later write or completed rebuild trims it.
- Fixes compatible older memory indexes going stale or returning empty results after embedding credentials change. If you are upgrading an older index that uses the generic OpenAI-compatible provider, run a successful search with the original provider, URL, model and credentials before rotating credentials. Switching to the [named oMLX provider](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/omlx) still requires a rebuild.
  [#174851](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174851) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/491bfc2ed67c5c257e6244f4376bb48178244ea9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory search using the wrong text format with recognized Nemotron-3-Embed and Nemotron-3.5-Embed models and rebuilds affected indexes automatically. Gemini also honors an explicit document format, including unprefixed text and batch indexing. You can set [query and document prefixes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config) for aliases and other models. If you change the document prefix, reindex with `openclaw memory index --force`.
  [Embedding formats #184142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184142). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@ajmtrz](https://github.com/ajmtrz) for the report.
- Prevents native Ollama memory search from reusing old vectors when an alias is detected pointing to a different model. If the server does not report model digests, or you retargeted the alias before its first digest was recorded, follow the [reset and reindex guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/memory-config).
  [Ollama alias handling #184142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184142). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@ajmtrz](https://github.com/ajmtrz) for the report.
- Fixes Knowledge and other memory tools being denied in new sessions you create without an initial message when your DM scope is not `main` or your session scope is global. If you already have an affected session, create a new one to restore access.
  [PR #184751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184751) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86bbf0f73632f06da08cce821d47b4d4266ffde6) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes memory tools like Knowledge being denied access in new sessions started with `openclaw agent exec`. Those sessions use the local operator’s existing private memory access.
  [#185041](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185041) · [Memory and context](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/memory-and-context) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes agent database moves between SQLite and PostgreSQL leaving the first memory search to rebuild the index. The [database port](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) now attempts the rebuild before it finishes and reuses saved embeddings for unchanged content when available. The move can take longer, and if an index fails to rebuild, the move stays in place and the command tells you how to retry for that agent before restarting the Gateway.
  [#182008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182008). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the report.
- Adds a best-effort save of durable notes before OpenClaw shortens a conversation that the model rejected as too long. Recovery still proceeds if the notes cannot be saved.
  [#186401](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186401), [issue #114081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/114081), [#118681](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118681). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@XdotX78](https://github.com/XdotX78).
- Fixes Memory file watching silently stopping after a crash. OpenClaw warns when watching is unavailable, retries automatically and catches up on edits it missed. If repeated failures stop automatic recovery, resolve the problem and restart the Gateway to resume watching. See the [Memory guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/memory-builtin).
  [PR #175342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175342) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/de2349923e273ff2639c86ae991eaea95605bb42). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes interrupted session memory indexing treating unfinished work as up to date. OpenClaw keeps the changes pending and can resume without discarding what it already indexed.
  [Interrupted indexing #191633](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191633) · [Session changes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a7c113960489bb7d4d50e5fe3ae511afa741666). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory indexing and rebuilds failing when a gateway wraps an embedding error but the provider’s batch limit is still readable. Indexing retries with smaller batches instead of stopping.
  [#187797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187797). Thanks to [@fredtanxo](https://github.com/fredtanxo), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes large memory index rebuilds on Bun exceeding a memory limit when they reuse saved embeddings.
  [Commit 2c173a3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c173a37a48f850246ae2133aa5c02df2ae35953). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes background session memory becoming searchable too early or too late after a system clock correction. Indexing retries also keep their intended wait times.
  [PR #186829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186829) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4843f39db21ba87dd10c69f9382c33e04118a233). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
