- Fixes silent Ctrl-C or SIGTERM interruptions during memory indexing. The CLI tells you what interrupted the command before cleanup finishes.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186297">#186297</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e265eff48527f0acd785f78972b35fe4b47dc6d1">commit e265eff</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185902">issue #185902</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory">Memory CLI</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/NovaLux12">@NovaLux12</a> (report and reproduction).</span>
- Stops a waiting memory sync from overwriting a newer replacement index.
  [#174851](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174851) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/491bfc2ed67c5c257e6244f4376bb48178244ea9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory search, session backfill and memory-store commands not following the configured database engine.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/389ff68c3bc1a5751590d3abe0939582afa80c95).
- Fixes [memory search](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory) showing no matches or becoming unavailable just as a forced PostgreSQL index rebuild finishes, even when matching memories are in the index.
  [PR #184625](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184625) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/757ff12fc5373ad523a0c4122568ba6808671eb4) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops identifiable Active Memory recall prompts from crowding out real conversations in memory search. Searches skip those prompts right away, and [normal memory sync](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory) removes their old search entries without a rebuild.
  [#176026](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176026) · Thanks [@thesteev](https://github.com/thesteev) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes searches missing matches when the query and saved text use different forms of the same accented letters. This covers retained repository filenames, Session Share source and receiver searches, Knowledge records and memory promotion candidates.
  [#186672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186672). Thanks to SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Keeps text after a null character searchable in newly indexed session text on PostgreSQL and SQLite without changing the saved conversation.
  [Commit 4ae9adf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4ae9adfae09fc63d302b38d4b06156fb7ffff132). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [Memory Wiki ChatGPT imports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/wiki) rejecting valid exports with an uppercase `.JSON` extension or no extension, and folders ending in `.json` that contain `conversations.json`. It also fixes imports flattening line breaks, indentation and spacing, including in code blocks. Re-import the original export to repair affected pages without losing your Notes.
  [Import paths #187175](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187175) · [Import formatting #186909](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186909) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/96e1b9bce19ceff8da3618c6a1f1fa766c784bd0). Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a timed-out or cancelled Memory Wiki search from stopping the rebuild, and lets a build finish when a source file is edited. The compiled view can show the previous text until the next build or refresh; the edit stays in the source file.
  [Search cancellation #187429](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187429). Thanks Baumus and obviyus. [Edits during builds #178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes dream diary and Deep Sleep summary writes failing in shared workspaces that the Gateway can write to but does not own. Writing the diary also leaves the workspace’s existing permissions intact. New diary files are private by default.
  [#185007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185007) · [c224332](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2243320434e1c1ae99105f4b070e1a3a4d24479) · Thanks [@rbartoli](https://github.com/rbartoli), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fills in the missing Memory Core dreaming details in [openclaw doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks). It shows when the last recorded phase ran, how it ended and when the next run is scheduled, even with memory search turned off.
  [#174806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174806) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5733c40baa2130780b867e3f500762d9e75bfef) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Yun-0000](https://github.com/Yun-0000), and [@olveww-dot](https://github.com/olveww-dot) for the [related report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87637).
- Stops the German pronoun `ich` from appearing as a new memory concept tag or crowding out other themes in Dreaming’s REM summaries. Existing tags aren’t rewritten.
  [#178496](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178496). Thanks to [@coaiMax](https://github.com/coaiMax) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and to [@Twilight-Networks](https://github.com/Twilight-Networks) for reporting [#178481](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178481).
- Removes obsolete Memory Core Dreaming jobs when the changed memory plugin no longer owns them.
  [Dreaming jobs](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Prevents unrelated plugin reloads from interrupting Knowledge calls already in progress when the memory plugin and its embedding services stay in place.
  [#185325](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185325) · [59270a3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/59270a3854173ae1db526f66be6b0a8535baea3b). [Related report #182024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182024). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes false reauthorization warnings after you rename a Knowledge scribe’s conversation and labels archived or deleted conversations as ‘Conversation not found’. Repair restores an archived conversation and turns its scribe back on, even if it was paused before archiving. For a deleted conversation, Repair starts a new one and asks it to rebuild and turn on the automation. For a failing scribe with an automation, it makes that request in the existing conversation.
  [#186959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186959) · [commit 3d96ad7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d96ad74cf7278fa0cb7b25b7c48090f1a75729c). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Reduces jumping and flicker in Knowledge’s header, tabs and search box on first load. Content can appear before the tab counts, and a failed count no longer stops the rest of the page from loading. When you return to a previously loaded view for the same agent and store, it can stay visible while it refreshes instead of showing a loading placeholder again.
  [PR #186993](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186993), [PR #186994](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186994). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Removes the blank strip beneath the controls in Knowledge’s Recent, Browse, and Scribes views. Loading appears in a small floating label without shifting the content, and failed loads still show an error and Retry.
  [PR #187055](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187055). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes the **Everything** chip stretching into a tall oval while [Knowledge Browse](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/control-ui#knowledge-page) loads its type filters on phones. The placeholders stay in the same row as the chip.
  [#185523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185523). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes Knowledge dialogs getting cut off on small screens by letting you scroll the contents while the header and buttons stay visible.
  [#186959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186959) · [commit 3d96ad7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d96ad74cf7278fa0cb7b25b7c48090f1a75729c). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes broken emoji and other characters in shortened [Knowledge](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/knowledge/tools.md) claim cards, related statements, evidence excerpts, timeline entries and titles of newly remembered claims. Shortened streaming excerpts stick to the start of the source. It also prevents [Knowledge workers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/knowledge/stores-and-access) from retaining artifact contents after a citation fails verification.
  [Claim and evidence excerpts #186083](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186083) · [Commit 2724b2c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2724b2c33bf7e1b167f28dee069aa61fbd45bd75). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee). [Citation verification #186100](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186100) · [Commit 5cf6a7fd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5cf6a7fd4ebaebb9f1fee12a1d33f2ab291e3f86). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Timeline #186707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186707). Thanks sunnyshu0925 and obviyus. [Claim titles #186986](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186986). Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a memory watcher that’s shutting down from interrupting file-change notifications for other active watchers.
  [commit 7865dc83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7865dc831c224d1655d3e61034a0f0416c348aed).
- Keeps valid cached embeddings from being evicted just because existing entries were replaced.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2fa2e8dea77f700ec9ac337096546261aebf302b).

##### Messaging channels

###### Message delivery across channels

- Fixes outbound routing and policy checks reading destinations incorrectly when requests for the same channel use different plugin rules.
  [#178385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178385). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes queued outbound messages getting stuck after a Gateway restart when a send was already in progress. Recovery keeps checking and looks for evidence of prior delivery before resending an uncertain message.
  [#183712](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183712). Thanks to [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183711).
- Prevents the Gateway from sending a second copy when it retries a timed-out send that is already underway, such as a slow media upload. The retry waits for the original send’s result instead.
  [PR #187561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187561). Thanks to yousan, obviyus and fonchaves.
- Fixes OpenClaw losing track of some final replies before they finished delivering when a Gateway API request reused an existing session. Replies stay tracked for delivery recovery, including across conversation compaction.
  [PR #197427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197427), [commit 7f4704ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f4704ecaf79dc747db8d7c73c614ccd08204acd). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport).
- Fixes queued replies on healthy accounts getting held up by a slow account after a restart or reconnect. OpenClaw can recover replies for up to four account groups at once, while keeping retries in order within each group.
  Thanks [@HermanZeng](https://github.com/HermanZeng) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182658](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182658) · [#182657](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182657) · [061adf5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/061adf5ed38bb42345c9891a83d2d6dfa2b7bd68) · [Durable outbound delivery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/retry#durable-outbound-delivery)
- Keeps queued incoming channel messages from being claimed as a restart pauses new work. If the restart is cancelled, waiting messages can be delivered.
  [Commit b3f5bdd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3f5bddc46c219bf14ab88c1a485aa51f970ca82).
- Prevents later incoming messages in the same queue from jumping ahead of a failed deferred message while OpenClaw schedules the retry.
  [PR #175964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175964). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Keeps a failed cleanup of old queue records from blocking incoming messages on Discord and other affected channels. A failure to save the incoming message itself can still prevent delivery.
  [#186430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186430), [issue #186428](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186428). Thanks [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a slow agent database check from holding up other channels, accounts, and Gateway services that are ready to start. Channels that [queue incoming messages](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-channel-plugins/durable-ingress) can save them during the check, but the affected agent still waits before handling them.
  [#174558](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174558) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/413b3d992f8395304212826272782f4a84ebfd36) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes tool progress updates that could fail to post to Mattermost, including on a freshly started Gateway. Fixes affected ACP final replies that could fail to reach Matrix rooms. Prevents a channel plugin reload from dropping replies it has already accepted for delivery.
  [Commit 292ca7a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/292ca7a1ff7c726c6cc64aced7e2a2abdf141f7f). Thanks [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) and [@FtlC-ian](https://github.com/FtlC-ian), and [@josh-cornelius](https://github.com/josh-cornelius) for the report.
- Fixes Telegram DM topics splitting into separate sessions after a send through an explicitly bound account when DMs are scoped per channel and peer, and fixes messages sent through a Gateway channel plugin missing from the destination conversation’s history.
  [Telegram topic sessions](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175589) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4fbed5dbef8d2d60e0877379e39c98ef6b2a304) · [Destination history](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175590) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fbf7074c270086f3997d19bbecba81108d61780). Thanks xilopaint, obviyus and steipete.

###### Channel login and settings

- Fixes QR login pairing the wrong account or stopping other account listeners. For multi-account channels, pass the same explicit `accountId` to `web.login.start` and `web.login.wait`. Start a fresh login after configuration reload, plugin replacement or Gateway shutdown.
  The deferred credential-write guard is supported by WhatsApp and Zalo. Authors of other channel plugins that defer writes need to call the supplied guard before saving. [#142571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/142571) · Thanks to [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx) for the original fix, [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for completing it and [@abacha](https://github.com/abacha) for the report.
- Prevents Doctor from copying your direct-message senders into a deliberately empty group allowlist during manual or update-time repair. It also leaves missing group allowlists alone when groups are disabled.
  [PR #174787](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174787) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/857a5c556246e2a9c5aaefbfd675b4102352a6bb). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@lockhartheavyindustries](https://github.com/lockhartheavyindustries).
- Fixes channel login and logout saving unrelated plugin activations to your configuration.
  If a previous login or logout saved an unwanted entry, it will still be in your configuration. [#145575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/145575) · Thanks to [@harjothkhara](https://github.com/harjothkhara) for the fix and [@dh-js](https://github.com/dh-js) for the report.
- Keeps recorded webhook setup decisions when Doctor has left a channel pending.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).

###### Channel startup and recovery

- Fixes inbound message processing failing with older plugins after a host upgrade.
  Restores compatibility with the inbound callback used by plugins built for v2026.7.x. [#118011](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118011) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes channels needing two start requests to recover from a timed-out stop. One start is enough after cleanup succeeds, including for automatic recovery. A stop that finishes late no longer triggers a restart on its own. Automatic recovery still respects manual stops and waits for the usual cooldown after a failed attempt.
  [#176514](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176514) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unnecessary restarts of channel accounts that have already recovered, either after the host resumes or while OpenClaw waits for another account to stop.
  [Recovery after host resume #186077](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186077) · [commit b61ab6de](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b61ab6deb40cc640aec077b6e6a7b93a44b5422c) · [Recovery while another account stops #186471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186471). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the Gateway health monitor starting channel accounts before they’re ready during a slow startup. If you stop an account while it’s waiting to start, startup no longer turns it back on.
  [PR #186857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186857) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08e08b7204951b7d4f6b0760a814241fa7c17bf1) · [issue #186832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186832). Thanks [@moonbow0407](https://github.com/moonbow0407), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@kevinuy-collab](https://github.com/kevinuy-collab).
- Fixes channel status checks reporting a timeout for a healthy channel when the system clock jumps forward during the check. Turning the clock back no longer overstates the time left for channel plugins.
  [#177155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177155). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Logs why a bundled channel’s settings schema failed to load, even when OpenClaw can fall back to the settings information in the plugin manifest.
  [#177216](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177216). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Channel replies and progress

- Fixes a Gateway crash when a delayed progress update fails its visibility check. OpenClaw stops progress for that reply and cancels updates already in flight.
  [PR #198645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198645), [commit 7ee0280a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ee0280a05681b935544102112401cf6f7e27510), [PR #198653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198653), [commit fbac0e3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbac0e3a8b720c6e9e2cc4aa982644522f321a60). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Stops Codex from showing calls or results in channel progress for plugin tools marked to stay hidden, including when those calls fail or time out.
  Thanks [@xydt-juyaohui](https://github.com/xydt-juyaohui) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@mir-stream](https://github.com/mir-stream) for reporting it. [#176294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176294), [dc7beb8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dc7beb867b4d6168e94d2b5a55c8fc5eb7af6cc7), [Issue #125623](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/125623).
- Hides recognized tool calls and their arguments in streaming channel previews while keeping the surrounding reply and literal code examples visible.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186375">#186375</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9813528d3c2026a74ba21dc3416a2eb4885fdb9e">commit 9813528</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming">Streaming guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (report).</span>
- Stops Discord progress updates when a request ends without a final reply. Keeps failures while clearing [progress drafts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/progress-drafts), stopping typing indicators or removing acknowledgment reactions from interrupting other work.
  [PR #198653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198653), [commit fbac0e3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbac0e3a8b720c6e9e2cc4aa982644522f321a60). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes long standalone streamed tables showing raw Markdown in later messages by repeating their headers where the table can split at a complete row. A header or row that is too large to fit, or a table that depends on surrounding Markdown, can still break mid-table.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173220">#173220</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160668">issue #160668</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/streaming.md">Streaming tables</a> · Thanks [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and issue reporter [@giodl73-repo](https://github.com/giodl73-repo).</span>
- Stops ordinary channel replies from sending an extra notice when your model uses a different [thinking level](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/thinking) than the one you saved. Verbose mode or authorized tracing can still show the notice.
  [PR #174102](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174102) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c72336d390c08f521be44d10077e20cef5af2783) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

###### Channel commands and settings

- Fixes channel `/models` pickers showing duplicate choices when a provider and CLI alias use the same runtime. Distinct or policy-required choices remain available.
  [#172268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172268) · Thanks to [@zengwen-dt](https://github.com/ZengWen-DT) and [@adam-researchh](https://github.com/Adam-Researchh).
- Keeps local `openclaw message` cleanup warnings from appearing too early or too late when the system clock jumps.
  [#187640](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187640). Thanks to [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Refresh becoming available too soon in Agent Channels while a follow-up refresh is still running. Channel rows stay in place during refreshes and retries, even if a refresh fails. A successful retry clears the error, and late errors from an old connection no longer show up after the panel switches connections.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179777">#179777</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>

###### Search and conversation history across channels

- Fixes Slack and Feishu directory searches and cached Telegram sticker searches missing equivalent accented text, and Mattermost channel and joined Matrix room searches missing names written in equivalent Unicode forms.
  [Slack and Feishu directories and Telegram stickers #187148](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187148) · [Mattermost directory #187199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187199) · [Matrix joined rooms #187881](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187881). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee).
- Stops recent Discord and Slack history from quoting unchanged requests again when OpenClaw can confirm it already answered them. Edited messages and unseen discussion remain eligible for context.
  [#186081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186081) · [`e932da7b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e932da7bf980908208bc5a2358748ee261f60a1c) · [Issue #185844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185844). Thanks [@BilalIrfanContact](https://github.com/BilalIrfanContact), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@lastguru-net](https://github.com/lastguru-net).

###### Slack and Telegram introductions

- Fixes join introductions being requested in Slack group DMs or ignoring Telegram forum topic settings. Slack Enterprise Grid introductions stay with the right workspace. Failed Telegram introductions remain retryable, and long introduction context preserves emoji.
  After an OpenClaw upgrade, a new or replayed Slack Enterprise Grid membership event can produce one extra introduction per workspace and room. [#130699](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/130699) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Attachment limits across channels

- Fixes attachments being rejected even though they fit a fractional size limit in channels including Nextcloud Talk and QA Channel.
  [#178195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178195) · [commit e449e9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e449e9ad3fcd44f013a1dc577d871ff0cb6dcee4) · [Nextcloud Talk media settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk) · [QA Channel media settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/qa-channel). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Interactive questions across channels

- Stops agents from using the built-in interactive question tool on channels such as Mattermost and LINE, where a run could wait for an answer you had no way to submit. On iMessage, Signal and WhatsApp, reply in a regular message instead of using a numbered reaction to answer an agent’s question. Approval reactions are unchanged. Eligible conversations in WebChat, Discord, Slack and Telegram keep their question buttons. Third-party channel plugins must declare support for question buttons to offer the built-in tool.
  [Commit fe160eb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fe160eb18fb0e2dd6f80daa24c46720a53baa619). Thanks [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Slack

- Fixes OpenClaw ignoring per-user DM history limits for Slack’s uppercase user IDs and sending more of the conversation to the model than intended. The existing trimming cushion still applies, so the limit is not a strict message cap.
  [PR #186937](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186937) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7e5491b811dcfeb987ebf7a8dfb0f820f2152e5). Thanks [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/yigtwxx) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack Socket Mode and relay accounts still showing as connected through prolonged outages. When retries fail to bring an account back, OpenClaw can mark it disconnected and restart it automatically.
  [#186757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186757) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/903394cceb1b047db6ade061b2231c64fabe4f6a) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/transports) · Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack channel ID migration changing the wrong account’s channels when the requested account has no channels of its own and another account differs only in capitalization.
  [#178464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178464). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes streamed Slack final replies missing the explicitly requested thread when reply threading is enabled and the preview uses a different thread. [Slack threads guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/slack/threads-and-sessions.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168086">PR #168086</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a4cb020fafb1bf6cefb77e365a62497ee1605f9c">`a4cb020`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/patrick-erichsen">@patrick-erichsen</a>.</span>
- Reduces stalls and delayed replies in Slack during long reasoning streams when no reasoning preview is shown. Enabled previews and final replies still work as before.
  [#196250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196250). Thanks [@ptu-gh](https://github.com/ptu-gh), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and release backport co-authors [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) (2d8db65b3b).
- Stops delayed `sessions_send` replies from starting an unwanted Slack thread under a top-level request when `replyToMode` is off. Replies to requests made in a thread still go to that thread.
  [PR #187065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187065). Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Slack Home and Assistant prompts staying missing after temporary errors for events saved for retry. Fixes malformed rate-limit responses causing thread replies to be temporarily hidden.
  [Slack event handling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/events) [#119395](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/119395) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes answered, canceled or expired Slack questions updating the wrong card or leaving answer buttons behind. Other controls on the card stay in place.
  [Slack messaging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/messaging) [#118081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118081) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Stop from cancelling the previous session when a Slack conversation switches sessions before the stop takes effect.
  [#177561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177561) · [cee90c3a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cee90c3af2bd8fd8da8b598803ed30086437dd1a). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports Slack HTTP webhook path conflicts even when another plugin owns the path. If you hit a conflict, give the Slack account a webhook path no other plugin route uses.
  [#173734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173734) · [Slack troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/slack/troubleshooting) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops repeated passive Slack failure notices for queued follow-ups after the same failure, while preserving notices for explicit requests and separate threads, workspaces, or direct messages.
  [#173515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173515) · [824e909](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/824e909530916673681c05f1dfef9ba3721fd071) · Thanks [@Kimiyu-186](https://github.com/Kimiyu-186).
- Fixes Slack messages repeating text already shown in rich blocks without dropping distinct text or changing code spacing. Edits retain full text when rich presentation falls back to plain text, and structured replies respect the selected account’s Markdown table setting.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6636e22fb5f578c176b6a9da032443ff012239a6). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Telegram

- Fixes a missing-module error that could stop Telegram from starting in standalone builds.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183478">#183478</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1bb18fd0aa5163d348df3398a8c8acaf5efc9019">1bb18fd</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Telegram accounts showing as connected after polling stops. Polling and webhook retries also get their existing grace period without delaying Gateway recovery indefinitely when an outage continues.
  [#186470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186470). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes eligible Telegram approval prompts not reaching the private topic where they were requested.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9afcc1b7b29a51535771a09747556970f6fbdfbd). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Telegram delegated-change approval results missing from the requesting topic when the approval card is in another topic.
  [Telegram approval cards](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/rich-messages) [#137438](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137438) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes live ACP replies appearing only in the session transcript instead of their bound Telegram forum topic when progress streaming is enabled.
  [PR #197191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/197191), [commit 50d263c2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50d263c22be5a60f05504ada9e420ac9b86e4e8d), [issue #195899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/195899). Thanks [@bach205](https://github.com/bach205) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Telegram replies getting stuck after a missing topic is rejected, and fixes custom emoji lookups being rejected as inactive during a reply in the same chat.
  OpenClaw stops the remaining reply and can retry on the original topic; a missing chat is a permanent failure. [Missing topic](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176910) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [Custom emoji](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176985) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops certain failed Telegram button presses from repeating the same error and holding up later messages in the same chat. Temporary failures still retry, and an expired Telegram acknowledgment alone leaves an otherwise authorized button action eligible to finish.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176679">#176679</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ffa14d0e0bf00b9accf1aae7d063b9e9801ee570">ffa14d0e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@hvhoon](https://github.com/hvhoon).
- Fixes `/new` and `/reset` silently failing in idle Telegram group topics, so the reset can finish, acknowledge the command and run its configured hooks.
  [#178649](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178649) · [`8bd1e73`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8bd1e73f90c063f711ece65939310548754d154e) · Thanks [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Fixes Telegram final replies attaching to an earlier message instead of the message you just sent or the quote you selected. This applies in `first` and `all` reply modes when you have not set an explicit reply target.
  [#175561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175561) · [154fdd4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/154fdd4f38d812389dfd4dafdfb556388fc96e2e). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Telegram replies passing a downloaded image to the agent as an unsupported document when the image was originally sent as a file. Downloaded photos and documents also keep their file types in replies. See [Telegram messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/telegram/messaging.md).
  [PR #174884](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174884) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbe01bba4ae88d8858097267e583847cb665ba7e). Thanks [@amittell](https://github.com/amittell) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores missing tagged voice notes during Telegram block streaming in both `final` and `all` speech modes, including when a separate final reply follows. The streamed text still arrives as usual, and audio already sent isn’t replayed.
  <span>[#179072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179072) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@mrmillers](https://github.com/mrmillers), [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) · [Tagged speech output](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tts/output)</span>
- Stops Telegram from showing automatic commentary or a “Working” card when the send policy blocks automatic replies. It also suppresses typing indicators when the policy rules out a reply. Explicit sends through the message tool remain available.
  [Automatic commentary #178518](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178518) · [Typing indicators #178524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178524) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Telegram custom emoji reactions failing to reach the agent when reaction notifications are enabled. Paid reactions are excluded.
  [Telegram reaction events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/telegram/events) [#83611](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83611) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes private Telegram topic titles becoming stale in connected chat after a rename or reply. Your manual session label still takes precedence.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166011">PR #166011</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df3c47e1931227124fac95b75f69113ffa5e69cb">`df3c47e`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/dankarization">@dankarization</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes Telegram’s partial-album warning telling the agent that missing items were images even when they were videos or other media. It names the media type, or says attachments for mixed albums. The download log also names the type of item that failed.
  [PR #187497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187497). Thanks to xialonglee and obviyus.
- Fixes Telegram direct-message replies that left out the footer even with usage reporting on, including queued replies. The usage footer comes through without sending the answer twice.
  [#178437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178437). Thanks to [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) and [@Michel-Settembrino](https://github.com/Michel-Settembrino).
- Fixes OpenClaw reporting a failed Telegram deletion when Telegram confirms the message is already gone. Permission errors and other refusals still report failure.
  [Telegram deletion fix #187327](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187327) · [Issue #127534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127534) · Thanks [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

###### Feishu

- Fixed Feishu table cell contents being erased when replacement Markdown fails to convert.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173047)
- Fixes Feishu tool calls for account names containing punctuation so they use the selected account’s credentials and permissions and respect disabled accounts and tools.
  [#174809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174809) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c08b11bb6e373f7c43ab93ea83e1d2a99a016cb1) · Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Fixes [Feishu](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/feishu) controls such as `/status`, `/new`, and `/stop` waiting behind an active reply or queued chat messages. `/stop` also gets through while a slower command is running, without sending your queued messages early or changing their order.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182423">PR #182423</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e68b0bde68a866cac16dc32b10611f8c205e9600">e68b0bde</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@Chowei11](https://github.com/Chowei11) for the report.</span>
- Fixes Feishu messages losing the mention that tells the receiving bot you addressed it, including in chats with several bots. The bot still recognizes commands prefixed by its mention, and an addressed `/stop` or `/btw` can get through while it is answering. For app-scoped messages from other bots, OpenClaw passes along only the receiving bot’s verified mention.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182441">PR #182441</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/045b6475c25fbb04f2d88f7ef83fc1f4d6b173a5">045b6475</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@AxelHu](https://github.com/AxelHu) for the report.</span>
- Fixes Feishu quick-action, approval and confirmation cards failing to show their buttons.
  [#79832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/79832) · Thanks to [@xiabee](https://github.com/xiabee), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unlimited Feishu directory lookups stopping after the first result and Bitable metadata missing tables or fields beyond the first page. Discovery failures are reported, including failures on later pages.
  Live directory lookups retain their 100-page bound. [Directory lookups](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117427) · [Bitable discovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117455). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Replaces silent denials of Feishu group commands such as `/new` and `/status` with a reply that tells you to ask an admin for [command access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/feishu/access-control).
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182439">PR #182439</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/509ab0779d64976982cbc4df721e7d11be84f641">509ab077</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hjuyam](https://github.com/hjuyam) for the report.</span>
- Fixes misleading Feishu button advice that could point you to an ineffective setting or suggest buttons that only appear as labels. OpenClaw guides agents to use command and link buttons and ask questions in plain text.
  [#179467](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179467) · [5bc8807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5bc88077ef115f28cf4ef2242403d30737e67307) · [related issue #111470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/111470) · Thanks [@shoaibulhaque](https://github.com/shoaibulhaque), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman) for co-authoring, [@njuboy11](https://github.com/njuboy11) for the report.

###### Discord

- Restores per-account thread binding settings for accounts with mixed-case names, including whether to enable bindings, when to start runs in a thread and how long bindings last. For those Discord accounts, OpenClaw also applies the configured server mention rules and tool restrictions. [Discord channel settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord)
  Thanks to anmol0b. [#180715](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180715) · [c2ee4ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2ee4ec64560aa918503d341e090a675e4681926)
- Preserves [Discord tool restrictions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/access-control) and sender overrides in threads and forum posts admitted through a parent channel. Tool policies configured by guild name also apply after the guild is resolved.
  [#172865](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172865). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord sends and retries continuing after you cancel a turn, including polls and webhook messages. Cancellation applies to pending sends. Discord keeps messages it already accepted, and voice attachment uploads keep their own timeouts.
  [#184915](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184915) · [0b4ce059](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0b4ce059cfb86ca10f2fb414b2b6f2c1a07b06af) · [Original PR #184130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184130) · [Issue #184060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184060). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@licheer-zte](https://github.com/licheer-zte), [@novachem-ah](https://github.com/novachem-ah).
- Keeps archived Discord sessions closed if slash-command access is revoked before they can be restored. If a session must stay archived, OpenClaw stops the command before it makes changes and shows recovery guidance when replies are allowed.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/526b2d651b81ddd303af66117f2dea1e0fc653e1). Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes initial replies to Discord auto-threads going to the parent channel, and keeps an explicit parent send from suppressing the thread’s final reply.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167974">PR #167974</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dca551a14bde6526d11ac6cc16e7a63cda8d657c">`dca551a`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/montrellcruse">@montrellcruse</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes replies in bound Discord threads losing their link to the original message when a webhook persona is configured. Native replies are sent as the bot, which needs permission to send in the thread. Messages without a native reply still use the configured persona.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/305b0d7f7bce84995a815b7f02e050ee2ce2354c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Unblocks Discord message retries when an earlier attempt times out but stays stuck. If retries run out, OpenClaw logs why and tries to reply asking you to send the message again, when current permissions and reply settings allow it.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186289">#186289</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2734af0424630e66432421d4f7df3ac3d5b8a122">commit 2734af0</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/troubleshooting">Discord troubleshooting</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes background Discord reads being dropped solely because they waited more than 20 seconds in the queue.
  [#178427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178427). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord voice joins and reconnects being disrupted by other members changing voice state.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172660">#172660</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and reporter <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172648">@yousan (#172648)</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/discord/voice-channels.md#L167-L169">Discord voice documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes Discord’s `/model` command sending a valid quoted model ID to the agent as a chat message. The command switches the session’s model.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179280">#179280</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179242">Reported in #179242</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/sunlit-deng">@sunlit-deng</a>, <a href="https://github.com/NeoGeoSNK">@NeoGeoSNK</a>.
- Removes tool activity and delegated-task status from default [Discord progress drafts](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/messaging) while keeping work updates, plans, and approval requests. Enable `channels.discord.streaming.progress.toolProgress` if you want the detailed activity log.
  [PR #176470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176470). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord pin lists silently stopping after the first 50 messages.
  [#117464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117464) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Retries transient Discord cleanup failures that could leave a Working preview beside a completed reply.
  Previews are kept when the final reply fails. [Streaming guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/streaming) [#138692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138692) · Thanks to [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@WG-Mojo](https://github.com/WG-Mojo).
- Fixes known Discord mentions being sent as plain text when followed by sentence-ending periods or placed after a Markdown link. [Discord messaging](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/discord/messaging)
  [#172191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172191) · Thanks to [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes blank Discord modal role selections when role details are missing, showing the selected IDs instead.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173128">#173128</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Preserves authored emphasis when converting it to Discord formatting would cut into a bare URL.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173420">#173420</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7fe1c8aa5370bc6ac8a38d576effb8de4a8d5047">Commit 7fe1c8aa5</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops reporting a two-minute timeout for Discord event handlers that are still running. Slow completions and failures still appear in the logs.
  [#177294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177294). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Discord voice holding on to outdated speaker details or roles after OpenClaw refreshes the member’s information.
  [#178018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178018) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Discord slash-command deployment error details tied to the deployment, even while other Discord requests are running.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182302">#182302</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Preserves the warning and attachment record when Discord cannot download a sticker, even when the failure has no error details.
  [PR #174476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174476). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps old heartbeat records from piling up in memory on idle Discord connections, without delaying heartbeat sends.
  [#178427](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178427). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Matrix

- Fixes Matrix messages going missing when the Gateway restarts before an agent starts handling them. Pending messages can resume in the order they arrived in each room, without bringing in excluded first-login history or repeating messages OpenClaw recently handled. Encrypted messages can retry when their keys become available, and delivery can retry when a configured ACP route is temporarily unavailable. Existing accounts carry over their record of recently handled messages without changing any settings. Retries are bounded and persistent failures can eventually stop retrying.
  [PR #176491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176491) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f72072bf3fe488e1a07a20edda69e7a01753b6d8) · [Matrix messaging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/matrix/messaging.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes encrypted Matrix setup and repair mistaking an unreadable recovery key for a missing one. OpenClaw stops before replacing secret storage and shows the storage error. Resolve that error before retrying. [Matrix encryption](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/encryption)
  [#174892](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174892) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw confusing Matrix direct-message threads whose IDs differ only in letter case when looking up saved sessions. Older sessions saved with lowercase IDs are reused only when OpenClaw can confirm they belong to the same thread.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ecdad29ca7d6a3e3aa3959bef4018d64f5204a1). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes replies being wrongly rejected in some Matrix direct-message threads.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d241291dbd7f52ca444ffa1a995e999c4e07f43e). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Matrix subagents started through the Gateway’s `chat.send` API losing their thread. Replies go to the intended thread, follow-ups reach the same subagent after a Gateway restart, and a failed attempt to link a thread no longer blocks later attempts.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/MarMarLabs">@MarMarLabs</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177372">#177372</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a1c3e81a2a37684a5ed32231a4ecd49f0b0de66f">Commit a1c3e81</a>
- Keeps new Matrix thread sessions from inheriting the room transcript while preserving allowed root context and room model inheritance.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes `openclaw matrix profile set` updating the wrong bot when you omit `--account` in a multi-account setup. It uses your configured default and checks agent-requested changes against that bot’s permissions.
  [Matrix profile fix #184687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184687) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a48aabc669b65212a088714985995d70b3363095) · Thanks [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184654).
- Fixes stalled background work delaying Matrix account shutdown or reload. Work from the stopped account can no longer start new sends or room joins.
  [Matrix setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/setup) [#133862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133862) · Thanks to [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Waits for Matrix startup maintenance before reporting readiness, lets stopped Matrix CLI clients exit, and reports late in-room verification failures.
  [Commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Fixed Matrix startup verification failing when given an invalid clock value.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172900](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172900)
- Fixes Matrix setup showing an empty lookup when the user resolver fails unexpectedly. Ordinary unresolved inputs are still reported individually.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173420">#173420</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7fe1c8aa5370bc6ac8a38d576effb8de4a8d5047">Commit 7fe1c8aa5</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes misleading Matrix [message-read pagination](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/message) guidance and rejects requests that set both `before` and `after`. Use a `nextBatch` or `prevBatch` token from a previous read to page through history, or `messageId` to read one event.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173362">#173362</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173252">Issue #173252</a>. Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@seriouslysean](https://github.com/seriouslysean) (report).
- Fixes Matrix command exceptions using a different `--json` error format from the rest of the CLI. If your script reads the old Matrix error payload, check for `ok` set to `false` and read `error.type` and `error.message` instead.
  [PR #187173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187173), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e63dd274f23a1e7aa50fec03257e071085e46cb). Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Restores Matrix decryption-failure notices when the same event fails again after Matrix has stopped tracking the earlier failure.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173443">#173443</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes agents seeing an old room name after a Matrix room is renamed. The new name reaches the agent after OpenClaw sees the rename, without restarting the Gateway. Clearing the name uses the room ID as the conversation label. [Matrix accounts and homeservers](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/matrix/accounts-and-homeservers)
  [#177783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177783) · [dd9ead87](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dd9ead874655275af52f10b48d53715b4076be45) · [Reported in #177782](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177782). Thanks to [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Lets Doctor move old Matrix duplicate-message records even when it can’t save the migration as complete. Doctor may scan for those records again on a later run.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops idle encrypted Matrix accounts from repeatedly writing unchanged encryption state to disk.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185991">#185991</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lagomCat](https://github.com/lagomCat)
- Fixes an extra deleted-message placeholder that could appear after a Matrix reply finished when streaming previews and block streaming were both enabled.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186275">#186275</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1019fe3d44af2133570465b70ca8f72bcc494b75">commit 1019fe3</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186191">issue #186191</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/brianmcguire">@brianmcguire</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (co-author), <a href="https://github.com/mrmillers">@mrmillers</a> (report).</span>

###### WhatsApp

- Fixes WhatsApp pairing failing to show a refreshed QR code when WhatsApp replaces the old one, and prevents rendering from giving up when the code keeps changing. If the code changes during rendering, the returned image can still show the previous code.
  [QR rendering #174509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174509) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbbc6da33dd8d11618feab9320ebcc822b19ec8a) · [QR refresh #178519](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178519) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes WhatsApp plugin loading from the source workspace when Baileys cannot resolve `long`. [WhatsApp installation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/whatsapp)
  [#177936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177936) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes a WhatsApp failure notice that could appear even after an attachment reached the chat under a known alternate address for the same contact. The same fix recognizes text replies and records the right poll recipient when WhatsApp uses that alternate address.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182517">PR #182517</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/365ba9b78d5a957300be667faed6008607eb7e1b">365ba9b7</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@mulderp82](https://github.com/mulderp82) for the report.</span>
- Fixes queued WhatsApp messages showing an error reaction even when their reply is delivered successfully. With lifecycle reactions enabled, the acknowledgment stays while delivery is pending, and success appears when the reply is delivered.
  If delivery can’t be confirmed and the transport keeps the reply to retry, the reaction clears and stays neutral. Channel plugins can use reply settlement hooks to follow queue disposition and delivery.

  [#172771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172771) and [report #172708](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172708). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@aleps001](https://github.com/aleps001).
- Adds an explanation to normal Gateway logs when WhatsApp access rules block a direct or group message. Repeat notices are rate-limited and omit sender details and message text. [WhatsApp troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/whatsapp)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182408">#182408</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93408">#93408</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@rushindrasinha](https://github.com/rushindrasinha) (reporter).
- Fixes WhatsApp settings showing an old refresh error after a newer refresh succeeds, and keeps status rows in place when settings refresh or the display language changes, including when the phone-number row appears or disappears. Current failures still show, and retrying clears the old error.
  [Refresh errors #180620](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180620) · [commit 97d659e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97d659e29103380439240f7a4bfb42f34311f8ef) · [Status rows #182364](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182364). Thanks to steipete.
- Dismisses the WhatsApp logout prompt in the Control UI when its settings view closes or the Gateway reconnects.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176129">#176129</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b15a4547319d2237498436eb658a0e4bdef2e3dc">Commit b15a454</a>

###### Google Chat

- Fixes Google Chat delivering only the first attachment to your agent and accepting incoming attachments above a configured limit below 1 MiB. Supported files arrive in order, and the message includes a notice for files that could not be delivered.
  [Google Chat media guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) · [Multiple attachments](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129612) · [Attachment size limits](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177572) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9086268006392753d5203ae112844183d3e6b09f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a confirmed missing attachment from holding up later messages in Google Chat. The caption still reaches the agent, along with a note to upload the file directly.
  [#178195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178195) · [commit e449e9a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e449e9ad3fcd44f013a1dc577d871ff0cb6dcee4) · [Google Chat attachments](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes agent replies in [Google Chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) dropping remote attachments. They come through as web links, even without a caption. The links support remote HTTP(S) attachments only.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182416">PR #182416</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d32c8db757d5372272d906fdb900df07bef06a45">d32c8db7</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jailbirt](https://github.com/jailbirt) for the report and [@pbreault](https://github.com/pbreault) for corroborating it.</span>
- Stops OpenClaw from starting new Google Chat destination lookups after permission to send expires. Messages Google Chat already accepted still retain their delivery receipts and any permitted local history.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185972">#185972</a> · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Fixes [Google Chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/googlechat) leaving a typing message behind after a turn ends without a reply. Queued replies keep their typing message while pending, and an unconfirmed edit is left alone when it might already be the reply.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04be301c3b77474a203e56cf1d56bdc93198ba7b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@MumuTW](https://github.com/MumuTW).

###### Microsoft Teams

- Fixes Microsoft Teams agent replies dropping supported interactive cards, including card-only replies. Stopping a streamed reply also prevents its pending cards from being sent.
  Select menus use the existing fallback. [#129720](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129720) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@edenfunf](https://github.com/edenfunf) for the related report.
- Fixes SharePoint-backed Teams file sends failing when a successful upload returns an item ID without a file name or link, or when successful sharing returns no link. [Sending files in Teams](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/msteams/messaging#sending-files-in-group-chats)
  [#177645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177645) · [2f7829d9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f7829d9769f4ae171579495fcd98b5e9864d812). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Microsoft Teams messages losing the names of other people you mention before your agent reads the message.
  [#184361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184361), [#102376](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102376), [commit b3ee406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3ee40673141dafd1d2b3e528fa1e805fc69e6e8). Thanks [@wyf027](https://github.com/wyf027) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the fix, [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) for the report and [@devinkuhn](https://github.com/devinkuhn) for the example.
- Fixes Microsoft Teams emoji showing up as unavailable attachments. OpenClaw keeps the emoji text Teams supplies in HTML-only messages without dropping real image attachments.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/LiuwqGit">@LiuwqGit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/devinkuhn">@devinkuhn</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177373">#177373</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcbc1e4ce9c830be6f59132a7d0435b6ad74b8c4">Commit bcbc1e4</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177341">Issue #177341</a>

###### iMessage

- Keeps the app-managed Bun Gateway at a stable path across updates so Messages Automation approval can persist. Approve Automation the first time it moves; ad-hoc or source-built Bun replacements may also need Full Disk Access reapproval. Send diagnostics distinguish Automation denial from timeout, and recognized send and attachment warnings remain visible after healthy read checks. If a send times out, check delivery before retrying.
  [Automation approval and send diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a20c18dd0f1be13d939ea6ee3f2ff085607d1b17) · [Account status warnings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3288a4e963cfb4ce2849137d15d94eb6e4b9c5db).
- Requires explicit approvers for iMessage execution approvals from chat selectors. Configure approvers if those chats should receive approval prompts. [iMessage access control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/access-control)
  [#173493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173493) · [2a1151a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a1151addfbf7d48508367cc3a6a3271aa131f0d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes iMessage accounts silently skipping messages received during downtime when OpenClaw can’t read their saved recovery progress. The account now reports the error and halts startup. Resolve the reported storage error and restart the account to resume recovery. Compatibility catchup uses its own saved progress and isn’t blocked by that read failure.
  [iMessage messaging and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/messaging) · [#175442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175442). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes one-to-one iMessage replies and sends creating a separate group history when addressed by chat ID, GUID, or identifier. Resolved chats stay in their direct session, and unresolved targets create no guessed history. Older duplicate history stays in place. [iMessage access control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/imessage/access-control)
  [#173493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173493) · [2a1151a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a1151addfbf7d48508367cc3a6a3271aa131f0d) · [Issue #173367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173367) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@lockhartheavyindustries](https://github.com/lockhartheavyindustries).

###### Mattermost

- Fixes a Mattermost bug that sent native slash command replies to the channel instead of the thread and ran the command in the wrong conversation. Model pickers and typing indicators stay in the thread too, and model-picker exchanges are recorded in its history.
  [#173829](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173829), [issue #173828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173828). Thanks to rodricksz4h5 and obviyus. [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ac89df1b61ce2535934a5182598a6835370decf8)
- Fixes Mattermost sends silently dropping unsupported binary attachments by reporting an error before posting. Use a supported media URL or file path for these attachments.
  [Mattermost media guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/mattermost) [#129287](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129287) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes rapid Mattermost posts failing to combine when inbound batching is enabled, and preserves unhandled input for recovery if the monitor stops.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166499">PR #166499</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3053be2bdbfe9ab9fe327c98960fb28b04608113">`3053be2`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/alkor2000">@alkor2000</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jacobtomlinson">@jacobtomlinson</a>, <a href="https://github.com/abacha">@abacha</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Leon-SK668">@Leon-SK668</a>.</span>
- Retries creating a Mattermost DM channel after more kinds of temporary connection failures, including a network-down error.
  [#177891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177891) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Limits rapid back-and-forth replies between Mattermost bot accounts while keeping their messages allowed by default under the usual access and mention rules.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183239">#183239</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/da579df307a59d6106c8e8a53a90dd5d52a50ae1">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/bot-loop-protection">Bot loop protection guide</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99279">Related report by josh-cornelius</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/hannnnn-l">@hannnnn-l</a> and <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.

###### Nextcloud Talk

- Fixes Nextcloud Talk rejecting allowed messages, media and approvals when the allowlist uses a bare user ID. Bare and prefixed user IDs match regardless of case, while guest identities remain separate. [Nextcloud Talk guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk)
  Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for reporting it. [#176297](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176297), [c456e41](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c456e41cea3d97a7e4d2fa65ce9eafa0ab5e7b12), [Issue #176242](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176242).
- Prevents Nextcloud Talk from mistaking direct chats for group chats or vice versa after the server or credentials change. Room lookups also stop reusing refusals from an old network policy or returning old room types after credentials are removed.
  [#178227](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178227) · [commit e8df190](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8df190f4617c9e0e5f6adff4ed2ec8aacc6d710). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Nextcloud Talk ignoring requests to send messages and supported [native attachments](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/nextcloud-talk#silent-sends) quietly. Quiet messages remain visible in the room. Silent attachments need Talk 18 or later and server support; if support cannot be confirmed, the file is not sent.
  [PR #180202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180202) · Thanks [@lordratner](https://github.com/lordratner) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops OpenClaw from sending pairing prompts or creating pending pairing requests for its own file shares in Nextcloud Talk DMs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183261">#183261</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/593a2ca3f89cb4d98e81a5236717f5b3d299ed47">593a2ca</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183260">Issue #183260</a> · Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>

###### Signal

- Fixes Signal container connections that could still look connected after a network drop even though incoming messages had stopped. OpenClaw reconnects automatically for future messages. Messages missed during the outage remain unrecovered.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186340">#186340</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a43a77bf92d184a990ff4320bf893f83fea2d0e9">commit a43a77b</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186339">issue #186339</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/signal">Signal guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/masatohoshino">@masatohoshino</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (co-author).</span>
- Fixes Signal replies losing quoted media context after a restart when media type or kind is missing.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173397">#173397</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes formatted Signal messages ignoring your paragraph-splitting setting. When a send or reply needs splitting, newline mode respects paragraph boundaries without losing blank lines inside code.
  Thanks [@tianhaotian](https://github.com/tianhaotian), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176258">#176258</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cad7a227e5321b216d04f378e3fc82854d70c79">Commit 7cad7a2</a>
- Fixes Signal chats continuing to show OpenClaw as typing after it finishes a turn without sending a reply.
  [PR #187232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187232). Thanks to yousan, obviyus and steipete.

###### X

- Fixes authorized public X requests failing to start a child session with a plugin model provider, and keeps failed automatic replies to mentions out of public posts. An automatic reply may be withheld if the agent has not declared success.
  Explicit message-tool sends reject drafts marked as failed but do not require a success declaration. An optional non-X route can send failure notices. [Plugin model requests](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173667) · [Reply outcomes and failure routing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173701) · [X guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x#reply-outcomes-and-failures). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@Kimiyu-186](https://github.com/Kimiyu-186) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). @Patrick-Erichsen and @joshavant requested the failure route.
- Fixes a temporary spend-tracking error that could leave paid X requests blocked even after the channel restarted. Once storage recovers, an X channel restart can restore paid requests without restarting the Gateway. Unsettled requests can still count against your spend limit at their full reserved cost.
  [PR #187382](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187382). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes follow-up mentions from X maintainers arriving without references to earlier work in the same conversation. The agent can use those references to look up work it already has access to, and X replies still require approval. If your instructions always require a fresh session, change them to allow continuation.
  [PR #174305](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174305) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b8786216794322a2cd7864af9843c8c4da1856d9) · [X guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes X replies that split a gallery into one post per image. Up to four images stay together with the caption, on the first post if the caption runs across several posts. Rejects an invalid attachment set before posting, and records which posts went out if a later post in the reply fails.
  [#185060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185060) · [ddcc10a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ddcc10ac02c686c3eff078b0bf4fcc9e7621e317) · Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents a paid username lookup when an administrator loses access before OpenClaw sends the lookup for an X allowlist addition.
  [#178861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178861). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a backward system clock change from extending the wait for X to process an attachment. If processing times out, OpenClaw reports that you can retry and leaves the post unsent.
  [#183742](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183742). Thanks to [@mikasa0818](https://github.com/mikasa0818) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cac0a08545cd8bd55f24a7fb3dd94a8d2b0e022b).
- Fixes missing eligible Git co-author credit for requests from X after an administrator links the sender’s immutable ID to an existing profile on the configured X account. [Requester identity and credit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/x#requester-identity-and-credit)
  Credit also depends on the profile’s eligible GitHub identity and credit preference. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182213">#182213</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Clears stale X replies account details and shows the administrator requirement if you lose access. Retrying a failed action clears its old alert, and a late failure from an earlier action no longer overrides a newer result.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180656) · [e8a8b19](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8a8b19c58cea2388d046f762b497e0c6ec42aac)

###### Tlon
