- Fixes automatic replies going undelivered in Tlon group threads. Replies go to the existing thread, while replies to top-level group messages stay in the channel instead of starting a new thread.
  [Tlon group replies fix #187820](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187820) · Thanks [@HootRock](https://github.com/HootRock) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@Somlus](https://github.com/Somlus) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187658).
- Restricts [Tlon citation expansion](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/tlon) to the current watch list when auto-discovery is off. Verified one-to-one messages from the owner are exempt from the watch-list limit.
  [#186092](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186092) · [`21c3c485`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/21c3c485300b6ebf2069320c9d068d621e71e0dc). Thanks [@mmaps](https://github.com/mmaps).
- Fixes Tlon image uploads losing filenames and custom-S3 links breaking on special characters.
  [Tlon media guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/tlon) [#141326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/141326) · Thanks to [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the disconnect request Tlon sends so the server can close the channel and its subscriptions.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Nostr

- Protects delivery of approved Nostr DMs by filtering senders outside an explicit, nonempty DM allowlist made up entirely of valid literal public keys.
  Thanks to [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit). [#173321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173321) · [Nostr allowlists](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/channels/nostr.md)
- Removes the cooldown that could stop the next Nostr send from trying a relay that had already recovered.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Nostr settings refreshes from replacing the channel details and profile rows that are still on screen when only their values change.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182289">#182289</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.

###### ClickClack

- Preserves existing channel revocations when moving ClickClack state to PostgreSQL.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes silent network drops leaving [ClickClack](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/clickclack) bots looking connected but unable to receive messages. The bot reconnects automatically and picks up messages still in ClickClack’s backlog.
  [#184853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184853) · [1ec5acb3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1ec5acb34652a0e90129414fdf13fcf4a026a54e) · [Issue #184852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184852). Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino).
- Fixes ClickClack dropping newer progress updates that arrive while it is posting or updating the current activity.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173464">#173464</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Buzz

- Prevents long-running Buzz accounts from accumulating leftover connection resources when they reconnect after a channel connection fails.
  [#178296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178296) · [commit 39fb90f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/39fb90fb35d5ae628a0316fe40cd9b7b9bbbe055). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an unfinished Buzz member profile lookup from holding up a new member selection. A stalled profile lookup no longer reconnects the account, so fallback names may stay visible until the selection changes or Buzz reconnects.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987">#176987</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/buzz">Buzz guide</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>

###### Zalo and Zalo Personal

- Keeps each managed Zalo Personal registration’s sign-in and group information separate when the plugin reloads. A QR sign-in left over from before the reload no longer overwrites your saved sign-in.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#182619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182619) · [b92e565](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b92e5655b9089d44ab1ac4406b6870accef58164)
- Reports Zalo provider rejections as send errors for message-tool callers.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Reef

- Fixes Reef commands returning a plain error string in `--json` mode instead of the standard structured error. If a script reads the old `error` string, switch it to `error.message`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183384">#183384</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e3b97e1895681709329d3d239bd0a86957eb8b27">e3b97e1</a>. Thanks to [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes inconsistent ordering when several Reef messages are overdue. Reef sends the overdue notices in message ID order, even across different peers.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#181654](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181654) · [`7d5149b`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7d5149bca96f723763a5a82815a3dd3164664812)

###### A2A

- Fixes A2A tasks getting stuck in Working after waiting for another turn in the same conversation. The original task receives the final status and any reply, so peers can keep using the same task ID.
  [#183803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183803). Thanks to [@ensignwesley](https://github.com/ensignwesley) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [A2A task polling](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/a2a).

###### IMAP

- Fixes new IMAP watchers failing to pick up new mail when the server doesn’t provide a valid next message ID. The watcher starts from the end of the mailbox without replaying old mail. An invalid position saved by an earlier version isn’t automatically repaired.
  [commit 2f181d5f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f181d5f907f3a2c9e3f11ecf6408f248e430bda), [related open PR #162548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/162548), [issue #162543](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/162543). Thanks [@linancn](https://github.com/linancn) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). Mail arriving during initial baseline discovery may become part of that baseline. Valid saved positions resume without rebaselining.

###### IRC

- Fixes IRC messages triggering the bot in channels with an explicitly empty `allowFrom` list. Those channels accept no senders. Remove the empty override to inherit the wildcard channel’s settings, or list the senders you want to allow.
  [IRC sender access fix #196293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196293) · Thanks [@mmaps](https://github.com/mmaps), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

###### LINE

- Prevents unsupported buttons and links from causing LINE push messages and replies to be rejected. Invalid quick replies no longer use up the buttons LINE can show. Bad optional links are removed without disabling the rest of the card, and unsupported controls that must stay visible are marked unavailable. See the [LINE guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/line).
  [PR #174079](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174079) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50e696686bc60b2ce2eb6b4e37a1da3d59bf072a). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### QA Channel

- Stops the QA channel from starting a send that was cancelled or lost authorization, including during attachment preparation. If the send has already started, delivery can still be uncertain.
  [#175616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175616) · [50a1fe5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50a1fe55bc36ea50ef95d95dc9ff686e96564240). Thanks vincentkoc.

###### Synology Chat

- Fixes Synology Chat attachments losing their captions and rejects invalid recipients before sending.
  Caption text beyond 2,000 characters continues in subsequent messages. [#128555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128555) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Twilio MMS

- Prevents Twilio MMS from saving attachments for hosting when they fail the existing file type, size or caption rules.
  [#173734](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173734) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

###### Twitch

- Fixes Twitch connection checks reporting success before Twitch accepts the bot’s sign-in.
  [#178354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178354). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Mobile and desktop apps

- Fixes Apple Gateway setup and Watch pairing rejecting raw IPv6 host addresses. Use brackets when entering a full IPv6 Gateway URL.
  [iOS setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/ios) [#129416](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/129416) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes successful computer actions on older paired Macs being reported as failures.
  [Computer use on paired nodes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/computer-use) [#137755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/137755) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes macOS approval panels staying open after a request is resolved elsewhere, and skips obsolete queued prompts.
  [#144685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/144685) · Thanks to [@harjothkhara](https://github.com/harjothkhara) for the fix and [@jarok03](https://github.com/jarok03) for the report.
- Fixes iOS and iPadOS chat showing assistant reasoning after you turn it off, including after reloading history or reopening the app.
  Tool activity follows the local Show reasoning & tool activity preference. [iOS chat settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md). [#151966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/151966). Thanks [@chiragborse1](https://github.com/chiragborse1) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Mac app packaging failures caused by missing private runtime declarations and linked dependency bundles.
  <span>Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/158682">#158682</a></span>
- Fixes Android Thinking and Fast Mode controls requiring administrator access when the connection already has write access.
  <span>Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163516">#163516</a></span>
- Keeps the iOS app’s device private key and stored operator grant out of embedded Control UI page storage. If you sign in using only a stored device grant, your Gateway’s Control UI needs native-signing support. The embedded page can still receive a device token in memory. [iOS guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166479">PR #166479</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50154b2efd3a21f10706803292c3a3ed5c3694fa">`50154b2`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/rocuts">@rocuts</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Raises quiet realtime voice replies played through the Gateway relay on iPhone and Mac. You may need to lower your device volume.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166056">PR #166056</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cb4367539056c72d68ce3c5e2962c7853fea110a">`cb43675`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/marvinthebored">@marvinthebored</a>, <a href="https://github.com/peetiegonzalez">@peetiegonzalez</a>.</span>
- Fixes Gateway errors in the native Apple apps losing their underlying cause.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166129">PR #166129</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97733f252eb76fcf10b06d8ca26a1d18d60d815e">`97733f2`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/Marvinthebored">@Marvinthebored</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez">@Peetiegonzalez</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Solvely-Colin">@Solvely-Colin</a>.</span>
- Fixes text follow-ups getting stuck while an iOS reply is running. With the outbox available, hold Send for **Queue next** or **Steer now**. Attachments and local reset or compaction commands wait for the active reply. [iOS guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168604">PR #168604</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bda23f641542b747308ae52ef0a228dc9be5aaf5">`bda23f6`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/cavit99">@cavit99</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Reduces repeated chat updates during streaming and prevents native chat from pulling you back to the latest reply while you scroll away. The first text appears as it arrives, and later text is displayed in short batches.
  [PR #168919](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168919) · [dde2941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dde29415eb5621f2c08e85d162b0913db70e8065). Thanks to [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@Peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez), and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin).
- Keeps Settings, Updates and other account actions from being crowded out by a long list of saved gateways in the Mac app. Wherever gateway switching is available, open the current gateway row to switch gateways or open **Gateway settings**. The Mac app also drops the redundant **Get the apps** link. [Sessions and sidebar](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/sessions-and-sidebar)
  [#174655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174655) · [`b4c0f82`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4c0f8276bb1d8a3e12b7ab6407fb3083f033ffd). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes embedded iOS Settings staying blank behind an HTTPS reverse proxy using Basic authentication. Settings and embedded Dashboard pages on the same origin use the Basic credentials you’ve already saved for that Gateway.
  [#178282](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178282) · [commit 4039ebd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4039ebd5df375f02a4b576dbb70fa3e8d9593cca) · [issue #175522](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175522). Thanks [@brianmcguire](https://github.com/brianmcguire) and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin), and [@msaitd](https://github.com/msaitd) for the report.
- Fixes Linux nodes failing to notice when a program is installed or removed until they restart.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Addresses a cause of typing lag in the Mac app when the chat sidebar contains many sessions.
  <span>[#179053](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179053) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ProActive2023](https://github.com/ProActive2023)</span>
- Fixes iPad onboarding calling your device an iPhone in the welcome text and setup-code instructions. Both use iPad wording in narrow windows too. The new wording can fall back to English.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179335">#179335</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/TheRealUnknownSoldier">@TheRealUnknownSoldier</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes a startup failure in the newer CLI and Gateway when a running older OpenClaw macOS app cannot handle the new credential request.
  [#179671](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179671) · [9a0a5d0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a0a5d05556d50d91c408c7eca13230b2e9fef6b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes macOS notification tests showing the previous result or letting you send another test while one is still in progress.
  [#179510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179510) · [00f306a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/00f306a4147281c8f69b85e842f8591bcb0d01d6) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Appearance showing the Notifications screen while a native notification test is still pending. The test can finish after you leave, and its result is available in Notifications once it’s ready.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179754">#179754</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes misaligned rows in the native Gateway switcher and identity menu. The Gateway settings action uses a gear icon and drops the ellipsis in English.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179922">#179922</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7d18d04df8e3a64e51e3debccca41980838cf86">commit d7d18d04</a>. Thanks to [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the opt-in OpenClaw Tauri app on macOS reporting that it was up to date when a newer numbered correction was available. The installed app needs the updated checker to offer these corrections.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180092">#180092</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/addfd1b63f7a3ac88356f688922be7f7ca8ef117">commit addfd1b6</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161223">issue #161223</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b), [@aniruddhaadak80](https://github.com/aniruddhaadak80).
- Fixes the macOS Dock icon and Open Dashboard switching you away from the Dashboard window you last used when both windows are open.
  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen). [#180273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180273) · [commit 7c1343c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c1343c249011ca470067f5924c9303ce659b278)
- Stops the macOS app from retrying its bundled Gateway after an illegal-instruction crash. The app keeps the crash log and points you to [recovery options](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/mac/bundled-gateway#manual-recovery), including connecting to a separately managed Node Gateway.
  [#181123](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181123) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f492d369d69b3405e82e7be69de0f0a89019e78d)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Reported by [@MacOSX4ever](https://github.com/MacOSX4ever) ([#181032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181032)).
- Removes Shift-Command-N for New Gateway Window on macOS and corrects the shortcut help, including translated guidance. Command-N starts a new thread, and you can open another Gateway window from File → New Gateway Window.
  [#181168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181168) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/93ba611dc599a87d84435d6e4b35ebcf9a77aae3)), [#181209](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181209) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a1d052f2add5f8e548c2ab791f413061e097aaa)). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Keeps the agent’s narration and media in place after a run finishes in native chat on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. **Worked** sections collect tool activity and reasoning between messages and stay open if you load older history.
  [#181339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181339) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdeb8f7efdd7c70e319c9e41db9cffc4577c348e) · [iPhone and iPad](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md) · [Native Mac chat](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/mac/webchat.md) · Thanks [@marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored) for the PR, [@peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez) for the implementation commit, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for preserving inline narration.
- Rejects ports entered after a hostname in the Host field during manual Gateway setup on iOS and points you to the separate Port field. Supported IPv6 addresses still work in Host.
  [#181474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181474) · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes the Mac menu’s **Browser** toggle saving or showing an older choice after quick clicks. If you switch Gateways while a choice is still pending, it won’t be carried over to the new Gateway.
  Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b). [#182775](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182775) · [#127616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127616)
- Fixes the macOS dashboard getting stuck on a blank window after the page crashes. Choose **Reload** on the recovery page to try again. A signed-out window brings back the sign-in screen.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183280">#183280</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f227543e481517ece870771f39ad78dc4e6772b6">f227543</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182527">Issue #182527</a> · Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@goatinahat](https://github.com/GoatInAHat) for the report.</span>
- Prevents a misleading “Keep computer awake” alert when the desktop app cannot read Saved Gateways at startup. The connection screen reports the problem, and the app preserves your saved setting while keep-awake starts off. Failed preference saves are labeled “Saved Gateways.”
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183899) · [74cfca9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74cfca9aeefa5f463db2bc9ea7e3fe2af59e6cb0)
- Fixes the Gateway rejecting plugin activation reports from paired native apps and leaving their confirmations out of plugin status.
  [#184341](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184341), [commit 32679f5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/32679f5ac9f9e429673364a87421b51a232c5d8f). Thanks [@levonti](https://github.com/levonti) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Makes it easier for agents to find existing controls for paired devices such as dials, watches, relays, and sensors when you ask to configure or control them.
  [#184688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184688) ([`d777ae12`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d777ae1239625a8cadb3da17e7a057d0c4de71fa)). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes website icons disappearing from Mac tabs in the Chat Browser when you jump within a page or when a navigation fails or is cancelled.
  [#184839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184839) · [ea128a10](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea128a10caf1ca1a61ccffbf9388179365b4808e) · [Issue #183925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183925). Thanks [@anmol0b](https://github.com/anmol0b).
- Fixes the **Jump to latest reply** button failing to appear on iOS when a long reply ends below the visible chat.
  [#185117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185117) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes the Mac app leaving an empty **Browser** tab in the sidebar after you close its last page.
  [#185210](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185210) · [d3afa75](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d3afa75270697469514dd22604087da3a31bb337) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes the Gateway switcher and Help submenus in the Mac app’s identity menu flickering closed before you can select an item.
  [#185579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185579) · [5962ce7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5962ce779a8a425d1ffc9e1279b6242154c467e9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Linux desktop app showing “Update your browser” instead of opening the Control UI in WebKit views that already support its menus.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185987">#185987</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes native Talk cutting off or failing to listen again after a reply when your iPhone is locked and background Talk is enabled. Fixes a case where Talk would not start again after a realtime session ended.
  [#187864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187864). Thanks to [@brianmcguire](https://github.com/brianmcguire), [@ultrakorne](https://github.com/ultrakorne).
- Fixes iOS chat locking you out of Gateway settings when a saved Gateway stops responding, so you can correct the address while the app keeps trying to reconnect.
  [#191560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191560). Thanks [@TameTheGame](https://github.com/TameTheGame), plus release backport coauthors [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) (f89e8ef955).
- Fixes the Linux app sending you back to Connection Settings during setup when a page load is interrupted even though the Gateway is reachable.
  [commit d6687fdf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d6687fdf5fde222def02b210b1acbf0e38b34944).
- Fixes first-run setup on macOS switching to the manual wizard while OpenClaw is still finishing startup maintenance. Automatic setup waits within its existing timeout before giving up.
  [PR #174148](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174148). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Android chat losing sent photos or voice-note controls after transcription or a history refresh. Messages queued offline show photo previews when available and label recordings Voice note instead of showing the recorder’s filename. Attachment-only messages drop the “See attached.” placeholder. The default transcript appears beneath the voice note, with View all for long transcripts, and is included when you copy, select, share or reply to the message. Spoken links can still show a preview, and uncached photos in your history load when you reconnect to their Gateway.
  [PR #174152](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174152) and [commit b84ec257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b84ec257c78b565a55dc6c8d2bc26203397a4082). Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Thanks [@elwlahs3029-lang](https://github.com/elwlahs3029-lang) for the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166576).
- Fixes Android’s native Talk giving up on slow answers even when the Gateway allows more time. Ending Talk stays responsive while it waits and leaves accepted work running in chat. See the [Talk guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/talk/client-ui.md).
  [PR #174880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174880) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/363f07d8be98dfa743b7b66dd9f01d8ad13008a0). Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the macOS source live updater failing to package the app after the Gateway has already restarted.
  [PR #176448](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176448) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/993ec298df4ee9e5a761553500c623f3c38feab6) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes a macOS app build failure from source when a previous Git update left a broken link in its rollback files.
  [PR #176483](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176483) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d851443cdc69a13e2b20f5834078b1e3b2f1b679). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes unlabeled switches and duplicate controls for screen readers in Android settings and the notification app picker. Each affected row presents one switch with its label and on or off state together.
  [#178429](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178429). Thanks to [@IWhatsskill](https://github.com/IWhatsskill).
- Fixes deeply nested chat lists squeezing text into a sliver on narrow Android screens, and keeps list numbers and checkboxes from wrapping or clipping at larger text sizes.
  [#178433](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178433). Thanks to [@IWhatsskill](https://github.com/IWhatsskill).
- Fixes Android system navigation covering the bottom of workspace file lists, file previews, and provider and model lists. The last items and the Load more button can scroll clear of it.
  [#178440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178440). Thanks to [@IWhatsskill](https://github.com/IWhatsskill).
- Fixes Android setup missing a valid OpenClaw QR code when another code appears first. This applies to the camera scanner and to images picked during onboarding or in [Add Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/android).
  [#178442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178442). Thanks to [@IWhatsskill](https://github.com/IWhatsskill).
- Fixes the Mac app failing to start when an upgrade carries over credentials stored alongside PortGuardian records. Later PortGuardian updates leave refreshed credentials in place.
  [#178497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178497). Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes [Talk](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk) dropping spoken turns on Android, iOS and macOS when the Gateway is still getting an agent ready. Talk keeps the turn pending and tries again instead of losing it. Apple chat keeps a text message refused during startup queued for its original conversation, even if you switch chats or type a newer draft. macOS Quick Chat keeps the send pending during startup and preserves its caption and screenshot if you retry without editing it.
  [PR #186860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186860) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d307b2177a0be1faa523daf93e94e99a8ee257c3). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a tab in the macOS app’s Browser getting stuck loading if you click Stop just as a new page starts to load. The current page stays visible, and Stop also cancels the next page load after you jump to a section of the current page.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/058dadac12813a76e35f8294fe995ce7366aab36). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents a quick double tap on Send from cancelling the reply you just started in native chat. Stop stays dimmed and inactive for 700 ms after it appears, then you can use it to cancel the reply.
  [#176941](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176941) · [Report #176940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176940) · [Co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcfafb5c0016e0652771c239987baff8dbd09be0) · Thanks to [@marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez) and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin).
- Fixes private conversations showing an unavailable page instead of opening in native macOS chat windows.
  [#183770](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183770). Thanks to [@pstarkgit](https://github.com/pstarkgit).
- Fixes Android model choices getting stuck empty during background refreshes and keeps available choices visible. It also avoids unnecessary list reloads after usage-only updates or catalog and authentication changes for another agent.
  The provider refresh warning clears after recovery, and older Gateways receive fewer repeated requests. [Model refresh #183040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183040) · [6988f241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6988f241bebd53d0bbeab04ded3de312501cf027) · [Model list updates #177137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177137) · [Android guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/android). Thanks [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes iOS chat composer controls overflowing at accessibility text sizes and keeps the selected model accessible in the menu. Native chat text is smaller for a denser transcript, while system text-size controls remain available. For larger text, adjust the app’s text size in iOS Settings. Tapping the blank draft area also opens the keyboard. [iOS guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/platforms/ios.md)
  [PR #166090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166090) · [92638b2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/92638b29a6f2115661217498a8d5767e85fd0235) · Thanks to [@Marvinthebored](https://github.com/Marvinthebored), [@Peetiegonzalez](https://github.com/Peetiegonzalez), and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin).
- Fixes overlapping step headings, a broken **Apply** label and connection icons overflowing their tiles in iOS Gateway setup at accessibility text sizes. Labels continue to scale with your text size.
  [Setup headings #170398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170398) · [1c5fcc0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c5fcc06fef2c7a5ac2b9b3f19ac455af1084cda) · [Connection icons #170444](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170444) · [1d675ae](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1d675aeb031bdc13dee93fcb7d84b28a4b11f52f). Thanks to [@brianmcguire](https://github.com/brianmcguire) and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin).
- Fixes paired Mac window inspections returning controls that could not be used for a follow-up action.
  [commit 4d1b585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Removes recognized speech from routine Swabble logs and raw camera request details and exception messages from Android camera logs. Optional transcript storage is unchanged. It also reduces routine iOS and macOS voice traces and macOS Canvas success logs.
  [PR #173888](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173888) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/59c63a9271a43ce3d4544102fcfc2d84201ea191) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Browser, media and voice

- Fixes browser snapshots reporting success and overwriting an existing file with an empty one when a dialog blocks the page. The suggested command to answer a blocking dialog also targets the selected browser profile.
  [Snapshot fix #148532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148532) · Thanks [@lrddrl](https://github.com/lrddrl) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [Dialog profile fix #173463](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173463) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/47ad9fbaa19f809b7f27c6a095a4659657435de1) · Thanks [@ly85206559](https://github.com/ly85206559) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes the first browser action after a restart timing out while managed Chrome is still starting, and reports startup failures sooner when Chromium exits before it is ready. Local, Gateway and node requests wait for Chrome before their action timeout starts. [Browser troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/browser/troubleshooting)
  [Startup failure #164192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164192) · Thanks [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [Startup wait #174755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174755) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b461dc69d67d58b98f0f9fe9fb03cd42a67cda0f) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes image generation and editing with LiteLLM and other OpenAI-compatible providers when they return image links. Result downloads share the request deadline and can be cancelled while downloading. [Image generation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/image-generation)
  Provider credentials stay scoped to provider requests, and a separate private origin requires explicit permission. [Image-link downloads #173508](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173508) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dc43a7e79cc3571b89663970a496c10bd60ef99b) · [Issue #173507](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173507) · Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Download cancellation #178876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178876) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes configured headers and proxies being ignored by Runway, BytePlus and Together video jobs and fal image, music and video requests. Runway, Novita and Z.AI status checks also respect applicable private-network restrictions. [Runway guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/runway) · [Video generation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/video-generation) · [fal](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/fal)
  [Runway polling #178757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178757) · [Runway requests #179245](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179245) · [BytePlus, Together and fal requests #179273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179273) · [Novita and Z.AI status checks #179321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179321) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Web Fetch running neighboring table values together, losing code indentation or joining the following paragraph to a code block. It also extracts readable text from recognizable HTML pages without a usable content type.
  [Formatting #176263](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176263) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e6afd9d7b46d152c8d6c33a42d1b41db51599010) · Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval). [HTML extraction #180064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180064) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bee83199e15395715ad228af4f3f941d8fc59b05) · Thanks [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes transcription warnings hiding a provider’s HTTP status behind a generic error name.
  [#178279](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178279) · [commit bd9e19b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bd9e19b13034dcec8758c1cabd6ef92028b1d5a7) · [issue #175167](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175167). Thanks [@brianmcguire](https://github.com/brianmcguire) and [@Solvely-Colin](https://github.com/Solvely-Colin), and [@Tinchen9b](https://github.com/Tinchen9b) for the report that surfaced the warning.
- Avoids unnecessary memory use when Google returns an inline video larger than the configured media limit.
  [#117413](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117413) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes voice-call text-to-speech keys configured as per-number SecretRefs failing to resolve. If the plugin is enabled, make sure every configured reference resolves before starting or reloading OpenClaw, even for unused numbers. A rejected reload keeps the active configuration.
  [#128319](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128319) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the stuck tab’s target ID to errors when opening a new browser connection, if OpenClaw can identify the tab. Close the target in the browser or provider dashboard and retry, or restart the affected profile.
  Once a blocker is identified, OpenClaw stops retrying that connection. [Browser troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/browser/troubleshooting.md). [#153765](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/153765). Thanks [@ZengWen-DT](https://github.com/ZengWen-DT), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@dlmccoy](https://github.com/dlmccoy).
- Cleans up unreported photos left by failed node camera and photo batches where possible.
  [#148855](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148855). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes approved voice transcripts disappearing from WebChat, Control UI and native app history after reload when transcript echo is enabled. Audio sends can wait for admission without the usual client timeout. [Audio guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/audio.md)
  <span>Thanks [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163557">#163557</a></span>
- Restores Azure Realtime voice connections to GA deployments and lets you select a separate transcription deployment. Remove an explicit `azureApiVersion` to use GA. Set `inputTranscriptionModel` to your Azure transcription deployment name if it differs from the default. [Realtime sessions guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166772">PR #166772</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dd155be2ecb06bbf789c799b2bac8d62364c2dab">`dd155be`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/CameronVetter">@CameronVetter</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Reduces browser tab-list timeouts when many tab addresses have slow DNS lookups, while keeping URL safety checks in place.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168521">PR #168521</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ca6b84a913c3b6d338bbefa2b2ef605a194f3ae2">`ca6b84a`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/keemsisi">@keemsisi</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>, <a href="https://github.com/Oldrich333">@Oldrich333</a>.</span>
- Fixes local videos being omitted or falsely rejected as context overflows when using a compatible video-capable Chat Completions model without a separate video-understanding model. The server must support `video_url` parts. This handoff is for local attachments. [Media understanding](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/media-understanding.md)
  [PR #170920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170920) · [cd486ed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd486ed7ab7c4ea68b31deae1440a94312e22fca). Thanks to [@evomach](https://github.com/evomach) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Fish Audio rejecting the released Drama 3 model when you select it for speech. To opt in, set `tts.providers.fish-audio.model` or the Talk override `talk.providers.fish-audio.modelId` to `drama-3`.
  [#171294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171294) · [TTS configuration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/tts/configuration.md) · Thanks [@100yenadmin](https://github.com/100yenadmin).
- Fixes slow answers disappearing from split browser Talk when the voice session times out or closes. Accepted work can finish in chat. **Stop** still cancels it. [Browser Talk sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions)
  [#172159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172159) · Thanks to [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new speech from the native Talk provider appearing as a second completed answer in the Control UI. Open **Voice transcript** to read the speech separately while the agent’s answer stays visible. See [Talk realtime sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions).
  Thanks to [@brokemac79](https://github.com/brokemac79). [#172598](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172598) · [60ae44b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/60ae44b74559b1af149a7ff37b434f8e994c12d7)
- Restores Microsoft speech generation after requests failed with HTTP 403. If your network uses an outbound allowlist, allow `api.msedgeservices.com` for synthesis and retain `speech.platform.bing.com` for voice discovery. See the [TTS quickstart](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/tts/quickstart).
  The public Microsoft Edge speech service is best effort. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@jestarray](https://github.com/jestarray) for reporting it. [#172381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172381) · [5a70f52](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a70f529fac16ab823454e4523cd90ee5052a357)
- Rejects invalid video durations before generation and shows the accepted range. Omit the duration to use the provider default. See the [video generation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/video-generation).
  Thanks to [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172420) · [02e70ab](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02e70aba4762ef5bbb49727a02e9fe75988fb99e)
- Fixes Browser previews automatically resizing shared or remote browser windows.
  <span>Previews scale inside the panel. Isolated local profiles auto-fit when the server advertises support, and you can still resize explicitly. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172655">#172655</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev">@fuller-stack-dev</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/browser/profiles.md#L48-L51">Browser profile documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes `nodes camera clip` and `nodes screen record` accepting invalid `--duration` values. Both commands now report the error before looking up a node. Use a duration that rounds to at least 1 ms, such as `2s`.
  The duration must round to a safe integer in milliseconds. Each node can enforce its own capture limits. See the [nodes CLI guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f81b99471ec9dbcb92f3a3d7f6d785ac17cc07db/docs/cli/nodes.md). [#172797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172797). Thanks to [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Kept unfinished cleanup visible after a failed meeting join so you can retry it by leaving or replacing the meeting.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173009](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173009)
- Fixes Voice Call delivery stopping when a Talk diagnostic callback fails.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173064">#173064</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Keeps Control UI Talk calls using the Gateway relay open as long as microphone audio acknowledgments are still making progress. If excess audio is dropped, Talk asks you to repeat the last part. Pending audio with no acknowledgment for 30 seconds ends the call. [Talk realtime sessions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/realtime-sessions)
  [#173490](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173490) · [3f880a1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f880a17527866316e20ff85b8c4fe11e040121b) · [Issue #173388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173388) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jonathanlindsay](https://github.com/jonathanlindsay).
- Stops a closed remote browser panel from intercepting scroll input after you reopen it. The reopened panel handles resizing.
  [#173984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173984) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes web search showing a generic connection or configuration error when a provider’s sign-in cannot be refreshed. Your agent gets sign-in instructions, and the Control UI Search page flags an expired or missing sign-in when the selected provider uses a saved account. If a Grok test search fails because of xAI sign-in, use `/login xai` in a private chat or Control UI session, or run `openclaw models auth login --provider xai` on the Gateway. xAI searches that hit their deadline report a timeout. [Web search](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/web)
  [#174651](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174651) · [`44b487a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44b487a6ae6c76c2fe2844c8a7a9e0965cfa2b63). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes agents being unable to check or correct generated images, videos and music, or to retry a recoverable generation failure. OpenClaw sends finished files to the original conversation before the agent follows up. If OpenClaw can’t confirm whether a send arrived, it skips resending to avoid duplicate files. OpenClaw drops pending delivery if the requesting session has been reset or replaced.
  [#174696](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174696) · [`749464c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/749464ce0a56c75d8b2ef9b4fa2caf745a8bc549). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes classic Voice Call starting a fresh Codex thread on each turn when the agent has a configured tool allowlist and the existing thread is still compatible. An empty configured allowlist no longer blocks all tools by itself. [Voice Call configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/voice-call/configuration)
  [#174717](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174717) · [`31f5299`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/31f5299779724375290281a8e0d04da020832ee3). Thanks to [@xydt-juyaohui](https://github.com/xydt-juyaohui) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Talk showing “listening” again after you stop a WebRTC call.
  [#174721](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174721) · [`d1a7edc`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1a7edc3198f329c440404cab33e9f28014a5379). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Talk failing to save voice-session details or entries during an agent’s first-time setup.
  [#174963](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174963) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Google text-to-speech from sending a second request when Google reports success but returns malformed or oversized output. Temporary failures can still be retried.
  [Google provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/google) · [#175411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175411). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw infer tts convert --output` saving audio with the wrong file extension when the audio format is recognized. If a script needs the saved file, use the path reported in the JSON output.
  [#175615](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175615) · [7fcc86e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7fcc86ef786660348c7754fea2a6270f79d95aa0). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Talk Settings clearing a provider’s connection setting when you select one of its models with a name that resembles OpenAI’s GPT-Live models.
  [#175619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175619) · [7f54c3d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f54c3d9b04c30fc58b649dae682802661f559ca). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Stops the old audio or video from continuing to play when a chat attachment is replaced or its access changes.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176588">#176588</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3065f2e01fa05500919948846aaf25bcb9e481aa">3065f2e0</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Browser panel reloading the current page when a page update overwrites the address you typed just before you click **Go**.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176564">#176564</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2d1bf4d80077af16ff38b28287b66a464d0cb40">c2d1bf4d</a>. Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski).
- Prevents the Gateway from freezing while macOS waits for permission to read Chrome-family browser data. Profile discovery and cookie import can still time out while the prompt is unanswered. See the [browser CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/browser).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176654">#176654</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/891298e939b286c845e15aa42cd8f0cf60b480ce">891298e9</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes regular media sends losing the file type specified with `mimeType`. If you provide both fields, `contentType` takes precedence.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176594">#176594</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f738047bced34a7b740eca8b86bf03175ceff33">7f738047</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes auto-detected whisper.cpp falling back to English when you’ve specified another transcription language. Regional choices such as `pt-BR` are passed in a form both auto-detected Whisper tools accept.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176662">#176662</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/304123679dd890c63f6f8612a69967f08b4fa146">30412367</a>. Thanks [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes audio settings rejecting Deepgram keyterm lists. Batch and Flux transcription receive each keyterm separately.
  Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), co-author [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@patrickmorsellipm](https://github.com/patrickmorsellipm) for the report. [#176781](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176781) · [commit 0139852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/013985229339b26bd03fe2e3ae7cf828c062f0da) · [Deepgram keyterm configuration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/deepgram) · [Issue #176740](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176740)
- Reports failed cleanup after CLI media processing, with the folder to remove and the reason it was left behind. OpenClaw still returns the transcript or reports the original processing error.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176874">#176874</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/media-understanding">Media understanding</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Adds warnings when audio cleanup fails after a Chrome meeting fails to start, or when a node audio bridge fails to stop, including after leaving a meeting. If you see one of these warnings, check Chrome and the audio bridge on the Chrome host before retrying. The bridge can still be running. [Meeting plugin troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/meeting-plugins)
  [#177085](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177085). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Applies the request deadline to stalled or slow-streaming OpenRouter music responses while the response body is still downloading.
  [#177189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177189). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops a pending browser extension relay connection from keeping an otherwise idle process open.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177422">#177422</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b10d3f701143ae970dd08e47b23822c4abaf035e">Commit b10d3f7</a>
- Reports previously silent call cleanup failures in the voice-call logs. This covers calls set to hang up on an answering machine, notification calls answered by a fax, and cleanup after failed message playback. Check the call’s status and logs before retrying.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177439">#177439</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8fd38303576def1d60d73c390c0f46fc2ffd09ba">Commit 8fd3830</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/voice-call/realtime-and-streaming">Voice-call cleanup</a>
- Fixes Talk continuing to show old provider availability after a slow refresh succeeds. While a refresh runs, Talk can show the last available list. [Talk and TTS](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-talk-config-and-agents#talk-and-tts)
  [#177670](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177670) · [2cc639d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2cc639d702348bb802671e1d8f2791b65ab4ba0f). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes fal video results reporting no ignored settings when the model dropped some. This covers aspect ratio, resolution, size and audio for MiniMax Live and HeyGen, and unsupported audio settings for models such as Kling and Wan. [fal video settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/fal)
  [#177687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177687) · [ae3e7605](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae3e7605dad3bf186ae980252b016d687addc0b9). Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes repeated background image, music and video requests showing an older success while matching work is still queued or running. Retries also stop reporting stale successes after a newer matching attempt fails.
  [#177906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177906) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps cached search results separate for different credentials in Brave, Perplexity, Kimi, Gemini, Parallel and xAI web search, as well as xAI’s X search.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · [#178018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178018) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Azure Speech using environment settings ahead of the region or endpoint you configured when generating speech or listing voices.
  [#177966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177966) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes spoken questions disappearing from chat history when realtime Talk consults your agent through the Gateway. The question stays visible once, before the answer.
  [#178259](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178259) · [commit 3806038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/38060388d3fd8872631dfd677f3dea15d1cc0130) · [issue #178235](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178235). Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) for the fix and [@jonathanlindsay](https://github.com/jonathanlindsay) for the report.
- Restores missing browser tab cards in the Control UI during live Claude CLI runs, so you can open the exact tab used by the browser tool, including tabs in a non-default profile.
  [#178321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178321) · [commit c09c95c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c09c95cf1509ad50180250a662dae8c20f60cbc6) · [issue #168332](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168332). Thanks [@DasX](https://github.com/DasX) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333) for the report.
- Fixes Google Meet tabs staying open after you leave a meeting that OpenClaw created and joined in the browser. Cleanup is scoped to the tab OpenClaw opened for the meeting.
  [#178324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178324) · [commit f0ad815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f0ad815092d4acd4ea81dd4d6a6a49572b50a4e2). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw joining a Google Meet call in managed Chrome but hearing silence when Meet plays participant audio only through WebAudio. OpenClaw may reload a restored tab once before joining. If managed capture asks you to rejoin an active call, leave the call and join again. [Google Meet transport guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/google-meet/transports.md)
  [#178715](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178715) · [`d249181`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2491817b54ef123dbad3287ad9c10d78fbc264d) · Thanks [@shannon0430](https://github.com/shannon0430) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Google API keys out of media analysis, text-to-speech, and video generation and download error messages while preserving useful failure details.
  [#178757](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178757), [#178852](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178852). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Google Meet talk-back staying muted even when the supported virtual microphone and speaker are already selected and available.
  <span>[#179010](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179010) · Thanks [@shannon0430](https://github.com/shannon0430), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) · [Google Meet troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/google-meet/troubleshooting)</span>
- Prevents a rejected voice transcript from blocking later valid transcripts in the same session. It also stops a transcript from reaching the agent if the session no longer permits it by the time the connection check finishes.
  <span>[#179056](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179056) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@nierob-cmd](https://github.com/nierob-cmd)</span>
- Fixes Search settings showing outdated status, test results or errors after you change settings or switch agents, models or connections. A test that no longer applies stops showing as in progress without waiting for its answer. If a status refresh fails, your settings and draft query stay in place while you retry.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179309">#179309</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes duplicate web search and fetch providers in the plugin inventory when their IDs match after trimming spaces.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179442">#179442</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Runway video-to-video edits rejecting supported ratios such as 1:1.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179245">#179245</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Removes cancelled Chrome MCP operations from the queue before they start. Running work keeps its slot while it cleans up.
  [#177189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177189). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway-relayed realtime Talk on Apple devices canceling an answer the agent was already working on when the microphone or playback fails. With a compatible Gateway, the answer can still arrive in chat on iPhone, iPad, or Mac even if Talk ends. Pressing **Stop** still cancels it. [Gateway Talk compatibility](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-talk-config-and-agents)
  Thanks to kybrcore and steipete. [#180571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180571) · [70e203e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70e203e96d45d1ccba62194aa4b272941e7b1e8c)
- Fixes keyboard focus landing on the gallery’s unusable Open in new tab link while the original video is still loading. Tabbing backward from Close skips the link until it’s ready.
  [#180763](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180763) · [commit 8b63cb2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b63cb2f71d3689c21c4252dfd3f14af1a575d82) · Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes image and PDF tools rejecting local files that `read` already allows, such as screenshots saved outside the workspace, in unsandboxed runs with `tools.fs.workspaceOnly` explicitly set to `false`. The same fix applies to local files used to generate media.
  [#180846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180846) · [commit f113dde](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f113dde017ecb6dcf91af45e0bf3a4057f867d90) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes image, music and video task status crediting the first provider when a fallback actually generated the media. Once there is a result, status names the provider and model that produced it.
  [#180869](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180869) · [commit 543a636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/543a63624ecc63d070efcde2cc08397efcaa2121) · [#158875](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/158875) · Thanks [@yinx65588-boop](https://github.com/yinx65588-boop) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@kybrcore](https://github.com/kybrcore) for the related report.
- Fixes xAI dictation dropping earlier words from the preview after a pause. If xAI reconnects, OpenClaw keeps confirmed words and discards unconfirmed words from the old connection. Pressing **Stop** in Control UI dictation ends recording right away and waits for the final transcript before adding it to your draft. If the final transcript doesn’t arrive, it uses the text already received.
  [#180923](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180923) · [Talk and dictation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk) · [xAI provider](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/xai). Thanks [@mushuiyu886](https://github.com/mushuiyu886), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@digitalfrost84](https://github.com/digitalfrost84).
- Stops malformed Twilio stream messages from interrupting valid call audio. Voice Call ignores invalid audio and playback markers and rejects invalid stream starts.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182300">#182300</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Blocks [generated video downloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/video-generation) from BytePlus, Runway, Together, Novita, Z.AI, and Kie AI when the result URL or a redirect points to a private network. BytePlus and Runway still use the configured proxy for downloads without passing along the generation request’s credentials or private-network access.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182425">PR #182425</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a97d4cc26c2ecc817ddadb1fa352e3eac94cc23">9a97d4cc</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for the report.</span>
- Restores clear browser error messages for actions like clicking a disabled control, filling a read-only field, or passing an invalid value to a field.
  [#183003](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183003) · [8b46672f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b46672f4762d8c76237ad678b88b5f7201e0609) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [web fetch in text mode](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/web-fetch) dropping Markdown link labels after an escaped exclamation mark. Plain-text session previews also keep the exclamation mark.
  Thanks [@zechen5](https://github.com/zechen5) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#183532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183532)
- Fixes [browser tab close](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/browser) reporting success while a tab is still open on HTTP CDP profiles. If the close can’t be confirmed, OpenClaw keeps the selection and tells you whether the tab is still open or its state is unknown. Check the browser before retrying an unknown result, or dismiss a page prompt first if one is holding the tab open.
  Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183605](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183605) · [Landed fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fcd0f59a1648d40f2f26084bcdaa32255cbfa7e)
- Fixes Google Meet talk-back staying blocked when one audio stream fails to switch to the selected speaker output but another can use it. Routing errors still appear in status, and talk-back stays blocked if no stream can use the selected output.
  Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) for the fix and [@sercada](https://github.com/sercada) for the report. [Issue #183894](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183894) · [#183924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183924) · [06f8a78](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/06f8a78fd5deab4d522f82906d5fe57b8a0afc7e)
- Removes Phone from setup and call control for the experimental FaceTime plugin on macOS. Open FaceTime for audio or video calls. If an earlier setup left an OpenClaw helper running in Phone, quit Phone to release it. [FaceTime recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/facetime-recovery)
  Thanks [@omarshahine](https://github.com/omarshahine). [#184151](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184151) · [13842ed9e5e0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/13842ed9e5e0437abdce88f3d19aeb3292e00212)
- Fixes a case where Talk acknowledged a spoken request but left the agent task queued until the voice session ended.
  [#184669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184669) ([`266f6819`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/266f681939e0403fea9210c2dfd979919fa824bf)). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes earlier unsaved Talk captions dropping below a later saved typed message and its reply, and keeps those captions in place as they update.
  [#184743](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184743) ([`a7795625`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7795625c724852811b9ff9eddd69832c98ec35f)), [Issue #152145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/152145). Thanks [@bilalirfancontact](https://github.com/BilalIrfanContact) for the fix, [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it, and [@valentino-90](https://github.com/valentino-90) for reporting it.
- Reduces Gateway memory overhead when checking browser status or running browser doctor without opening a browser session.
  [#184860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184860) · [b33227f3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b33227f35cceff9294df688ef29e35c4c269585c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores Chromium’s cross-origin protections during OpenClaw browser actions and navigation while keeping blocked destinations off-limits. Fixes pages and embedded frames being cut off before they finish loading after a successful action. Improves recovery when navigation times out after a page has opened, so the tab can stay usable.
  [#185028](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185028) · Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Fixes the Chrome extension staying connected to an old standalone relay after an in-place OpenClaw update. If a relay started before this fix is still running, stop it once or let it go idle. Connected browser automation clients need to reconnect when the relay restarts.
  [#185038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185038) · [Chrome extension relay guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/chrome-extension) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents an open [native Talk](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/session-ownership) call from starting new agent consultations in the old session store after you change where sessions are stored. Start a new call to use the new location.
  [#186197](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186197) · [Commit 1a304fe6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a304fe6af6fab8bf8dc4a6f7360debb0843d545) · [Issue #186186](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186186) · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes attached-browser screenshots converted to JPEG being saved with a `.png` extension instead of `.jpg`.
  [#186571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186571). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes [`openclaw voicecall tail`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/voicecall) continuing to print records after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM for saved call history and custom JSONL logs.
  [#186691](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186691). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Stops [Voice Call](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/voicecall) from starting calls with silently altered instructions from an invalid UTF-8 brief file. If you get an encoding error, re-save the named file as UTF-8 and retry.
  [PR #187174](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187174). Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops a generated video from continuing to download after you interrupt `openclaw infer video generate` with Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. The command cleans up the partial download and does not report success.
  [PR #187563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187563). Thanks to SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Fixes the CLI and Google Meet tool writing [exports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/google-meet/oauth-and-artifacts) to the wrong folder when the supplied path starts or ends with a space. The optional ZIP keeps those spaces in its name too.
  [#187619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187619). Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes Talk leaving an agent consultation marked active when preparation fails before the agent starts.
  [#187840](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187840). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes a timing error that could stop media analysis on Node 26 before its time limit expired.
  [#188806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188806). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Lightpanda navigation timing out before your agent can read a page or work with a form.
  [PR #196400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196400), [commit 51f5d124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/51f5d12476234e111bacc9966cba180d9eed1435). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) (release backport).
- Fixes browser tabs being left open when tab activity interrupts idle cleanup just as OpenClaw is closing them for a session.
  [commit 172aae50](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/172aae503c51cd624223a41eaff06b234175afda).
- Fixes [Comfy media workflows](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/comfy) waiting past their timeout by applying one limit from upload through download. A request timeout takes priority over the configured default. Timing out stops OpenClaw from waiting but does not cancel a job already submitted to ComfyUI.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3389923e50cce17721c62db05cef547b3f62d50). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps private browser connection details, including credentials, out of the results your agent sees when it lists or opens tabs.
  [Commit c78d58a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c78d58a3b44ff85e25715b4a03d2545c8beab576), adapted from commit da9bfb. Thanks [@sallyom](https://github.com/sallyom) for the original work and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes large Gemini 4K images being discarded before they can be saved when a custom OpenRouter URL sends image requests through its chat endpoint. Raises the shared download limit for generated images from 32 to 64 MiB without raising the limit for saved images.
  [PR #174839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174839) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1313c3871a2126fa76a683c2c09fe4167550ee79). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Gives the Gateway owner sign-in instructions when web search can't refresh a provider's login. Use `/login <provider>` in private chat or the Control UI, or `openclaw models auth login --provider <provider>` in the CLI. The error leaves the assistant free to try another route instead of telling it to announce an outage.
  [PR #174844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174844) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7509bb8c66f6eab6d352d1f0a2a65cc4914dc12). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Adds a warning when OpenClaw cannot remove a temporary attachment used for [media processing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/media-understanding). The warning names the file so you can remove it manually if it is still there after processing.
  [PR #175388](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175388). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes search setup overlooking a model key you already configured when the search provider supports reusing it.
  [#175729](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175729) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/51aa1b76d5d3dde7b4972e09f28f6495b081a7d6). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw infer web fetch` failing on a default install with no fetch provider configured. The command now tells you whether fetching is disabled or the provider you named is unavailable, and `infer list` and `infer inspect` describe direct fetching.
  [#175720](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175720) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb957f57ca2dbb61a46d622374a923f6ad963b3c). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents text-to-speech settings changes from overwriting an unreadable or malformed preferences file. `/tts` explains what to repair, and playback can still use your configured defaults.
  [#175847](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175847) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcd6ab322aeb6d7a1bd3550477c1875213889e64) · [TTS commands](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/tools/tts/commands.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents OpenAI Realtime Talk from sending a camera image that was still being captured when you ended the call, switched cameras, or the camera became unavailable. Google Live also skips images caught during a temporary mute or disable and resumes sending when the camera is usable again.
  [PR #175948](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175948) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0604b227a2bd0189ce4b5e7e7505923218f71ea3) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Talk](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/talk/session-ownership) connecting to an archived conversation and then rejecting requests to consult the agent. When you start Talk from a browser or through the Gateway relay, eligible conversations reopen with their history. If Talk can’t restore the conversation, it explains the refusal before connecting.
  [PR #176440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176440) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a9b42a5dbc5ce7fe49d8c000caf2bfe8a88191f) · [issue #175027](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175027) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@shawnholt](https://github.com/shawnholt).
- Changes media saves to report a failure instead of retrying if their temporary folder disappears during the save.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reports the first save failure when a browser download encounters both a destination validation error and a separate disk error.
  [#178464](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178464). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes browser downloads and trace exports dropping spaces from the start or end of filenames you specify, which could send the output to a different file.
