Fixes transfers from a browser node failing on those download paths. On filesystems that support these names, quote the path as shown in the [browser CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/browser).
  Remote staging can still normalize filenames for portability. [#178473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178473). Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes browser actions leaving a second download out of the results when the system clock jumps forward during download collection.
  [PR #186850](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186850) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12c6ec4d7d0e2568db391fcaf35a033737ce255f). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops [`openclaw voicecall continue`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/voicecall) from continuing to wait for results or printing a late reply after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. This interrupts the command, not the call or speech already underway.
  [#186905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186905) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6cc904a742132cd529d2e4d4b6ae4b77375a36d9) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents an accidental change to your default chat model when setting up dictation. The microphone menu's Dictation Configure button opens Talk settings instead of chat-model setup.
  [PR #186290](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186290), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/340b8a77ecd102419698313f0347345ba1e5d55b). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and reporter [@tre1d](https://github.com/tre1d).
- Prevents Lightpanda's JavaScript locale setting from changing the process locale, avoiding disruption to native programs and interactive non-ASCII input.
  [Dependency refresh](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171658). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [11.5 sample configuration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/deploy/lightpanda/compose.yaml).
- Adds **Saving** and **Retry** to native Talk voice and microphone settings when an edit fails. A rejected voice or microphone edit returns to the last accepted value, while a failed language edit keeps the requested selection visible for retry. Older save replies no longer overwrite newer choices, and you can leave Talk while a language save is pending.
  [Voice and microphone settings #180494](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180494) · [Commit 67ff158](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/67ff158af4ac21ef1e633c7dbae592073acd6ba6) · [Language settings #180593](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180593) · [Commit e30796d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e30796d42b9da612d11a211f40fb25da87c897bf). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible replies queued during an active turn arriving as text only when automatic speech is on. It also fixes replies that fit your preferred speech length but exceed the synthesis limit arriving without audio. In that case, audio may be summarized or shortened while the full written reply stays intact; a queued reply still arrives as text if speech generation fails.
  [Queued replies #181592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181592) · [Report #181557](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181557) · [Speech length #174123](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174123) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9df8505b2b665a905518043df954936038891c98). Thanks [@indra622](https://github.com/indra622) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for the queued-reply fix, [@sduenasg](https://github.com/sduenasg) for the report, and [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) and [@lester076](https://github.com/lester076) for reproducing it. Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) for the speech-length fix and [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168253) and an [earlier proposal](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168119).
- Fixes browser commands returning no `--json` output when a timeout or screenshot or snapshot option is invalid, or the Gateway rejects a request. Scripts receive a structured JSON error.
  [Navigation, resize and cookie errors #183437](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183437) · [Commit 566de57](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/566de57556e8da04912b8bf7f8db466a1204c7bc) · [Screenshot and snapshot errors #176013](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176013) · [Browser CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/browser). Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes native Talk consultations getting stuck when a voice provider hands work to an agent. Concurrent requests keep their place in line, and Talk rejects stale requests instead of running them again or mixing them between consultations. Talk also checks that a call is still open and owned before dispatching a consultation.
  [Consultation ownership](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd) · [Consultation admission](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50994cac07c5d15a79bdbae129321190d8fac37c). Thanks [@bdjben](https://github.com/bdjben), [@brokemac79](https://github.com/brokemac79), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the consultation admission release backport.
- Restores browser control on the next use after a borrowed extension connection drops, and waits for cleanup when browser-session closes overlap.
  [Commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Keeps DeepSeek web search from using the model key in shared provider settings when those settings route chat through a proxy. In that setup, provide a key in [DeepSeek search settings](https://docs.openclaw.ai/providers/deepseek#web-search) or through `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. Changes to the search key or its secret reference also take effect without waiting for unrelated agent turns or restarting OpenClaw. The [SecretRef credential reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/secretref-credential-surface) now lists the DeepSeek search key field.
  [Proxy key handling #183831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183831) · [Credential refresh #178544](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178544) · [SecretRef reference #175873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175873). Thanks [@nxmxbbd](https://github.com/nxmxbbd), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents browser voice setup that uses an extension callback and a separate session store from being saved if the source session is replaced or access can no longer be verified.
  [#177533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177533) · [Commit 2346b98](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2346b98de9ccd857c11eb052eedffbd1654d2b69) · [Worker database access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Meetings

<a id="meeting-state-rollback"></a>

- Fixes meeting transcripts changing order when the reader’s timezone changes. If the meeting used as a paging cursor has been deleted, restart paging.
  Existing start times without a timezone use the migration timezone; new ones use the writer’s timezone. To roll back across the schema 23 migration to an incompatible version, restore the matching pre-upgrade backup and use the older binary. [#172755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172755). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes live meeting summaries being blocked by a temporary read error. The next scheduled update can retry the read.
  [#177635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177635) · [415e63d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/415e63d4a251fbc0938950ceac48498751189b8e). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes meeting summaries falling back to basic notes when the system clock jumps forward, even when the model is available. A clock change in either direction no longer alters the model’s time to summarize.
  [#185146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185146) · [8cebac4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8cebac4847362f4d5b9f94656551789e9f3756c7) · Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### Workboard

- Fixes [Workboard](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) cards staying out of date after a missed completion when their linked conversation is beyond the session search limit. Recovery checks the linked conversation directly when the card identifies it, stops checking cards with no updates pending, and reduces session scans during card updates. Workboard also avoids marking a launch as failed when session lookup is incomplete or cannot identify which session belongs to the card.
  [Card lookup and launch recovery #173740](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173740) · [Final recovery lookup #173793](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173793) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6b36380b911c44ce4dbdcd4d2cbbf880a7e136ac). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Workboard workers in newly created sessions finishing without updating their cards or notifying eligible linked automations. Restores cleanup of clean managed worktrees while keeping worktrees with local changes. [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard)
  [#179255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179255) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Workboard dispatch using up a card’s retries when its worker session is already archived. The refusal names the session so you can restore it to continue or run `openclaw sessions delete <worker key>` to start fresh on the next dispatch.
  [#176939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176939) · [Report #176889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176889) · [Workboard CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/workboard) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@mightyx](https://github.com/mightyx).
- Keeps a requeued Workboard card ready for another run even if its old worker finishes late. The old worker can no longer move the card to Review or erase the previous failure.
  [#174979](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174979) · [Issue #174899](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174899) · Thanks [@chelsealong](https://github.com/chelsealong), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RyanTJoy](https://github.com/RyanTJoy).
- Fixes ready Workboard cards getting stuck, even on other boards, when a completed card for the same owner still shows an old run as active.
  [#187880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187880). Thanks [@atomicdjt](https://github.com/atomicdjt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@alfredjbclaw](https://github.com/alfredjbclaw).
- Fixes Workboard dispatch and card updates failing because an existing comment exceeds the current limit, while preserving its full text. New and edited comments still have a 2,000-character limit.
  [Workboard comments](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/plugins/workboard.md) · [#154958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/154958). Thanks [@gokay-ai](https://github.com/gokay-ai) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Workboard from silently dropping unsupported card metadata. When an integration creates a card, captures a session as a card or updates a card, Workboard names the unsupported keys and rejects the request without changing any cards. If your integration sends those keys, remove them before retrying. See the [Workboard guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/workboard) for supported metadata.
  [PR #187098](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187098). Thanks [@yy19971996](https://github.com/yy19971996), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@SquareXRay](https://github.com/SquareXRay).
- Fixes Workboard search missing cards even when the accented word you typed matches a word in a card’s title, labels or notes.
  [PR #187322](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187322). Thanks SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Fixes the Workboard session summary showing the old error when you retry loading progress. The summary shows that the retry is underway without hiding recent messages that already loaded.
  [PR #180528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180528) · [commit d7975c1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7975c1cde4550f8cf5091f09ede494a28019b45). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes collapsed Workboard list groups failing to reopen on a second click. Keyboard focus returns to Workboard’s search button or open search field when the board takes focus. Workboard pages and dashboard widgets receive updates as board data loads or changes.
  [#182293](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182293) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores the bottom fade that shows there are more cards below when a live update makes a Workboard column scrollable or a compact board widget loads another page.
  [#184627](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184627) ([d23fb227](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d23fb2278af1b136b6532c9b14818374be2b55a6)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Board reads and writes from blocking the Gateway while looking up a custom session store.
  [#174692](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174692) · [805c6d2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/805c6d2d74d46653129f6a62e1d0b60df1cffd17). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Storage, workspaces and files

- Fixes generated build and test caches causing conflicts that block local sandbox and cloud-worker workspace sync or recovery of saved results, including older pending changes. Real conflicts in your edits still stop the sync.
  [Sandbox workspace access](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access.md) · [Cloud-worker session lifecycle](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle.md) · [Workspace sync and excluded paths](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) · [#175538](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175538) · [Issue #175503](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175503) · [#176802](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176802) · [commit 6e4883f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6e4883fca44ed3e8174b4dfef16ee17e03ba1621) · [Issue #176778](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176778) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes workspace sync removing a folder you meant to keep when you deleted its last file, then reporting a false conflict when you added a file back.
  [#176819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176819) · [commit 918a379](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/918a379c89cb5f3e7de913fce9eade020317d117) · [Issue #176808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176808) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes replies failing in already-provisioned agent workspaces when packaged templates are missing.
  Creating a missing bootstrap file still requires its template. [Agent workspace guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-workspace) [#120943](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/120943) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes profiles selected through `OPENCLAW_PROFILE` using the default profile data and skills. If you use a tilde-relative `OPENCLAW_HOME` with a named profile and rely on an implicit memory-host workspace, set `HOME` to your home directory when neither `HOME` nor `USERPROFILE` is set. Otherwise the workspace path can repeat part of the home path.
  If you relied on the old default-profile paths, you may see different data or skills after updating. [#133252](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/133252) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unfinished workspace onboarding being marked complete after a starter template update, skipping the identity conversation.
  The fix applies to unchanged starter files with matching recorded hashes. [Workspace bootstrapping](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/start/bootstrapping.md). [#149817](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/149817). Thanks [@Dreamer-HIT](https://github.com/Dreamer-HIT) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes new SQLite work being rejected when capacity is occupied by reclaimable idle shared-state handles.
  <span>Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Jeehut](https://github.com/Jeehut). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164477">#164477</a></span>
- Fixes affected unpinned system agents losing access to their persona and memory after an upgrade. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to restore eligible files and pin the workspace, preserving originals and customized destination files. If the agent roster is in an included config file, pin the workspace there manually.
  <span>Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@gucasbrg](https://github.com/gucasbrg), [@botatdovly](https://github.com/botatdovly), [@DasX](https://github.com/DasX). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165112">#165112</a></span>
- Fixes recursive `openclaw path find` searches missing direct matches, returning duplicates, and producing unusable deep paths. Repeated wildcards also avoid redundant traversal.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168375">PR #168375</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b022ac2404d2bb275f042e7cf8cdaa4fe9db990">`5b022ac`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/shoutoutuoadi325">@shoutoutuoadi325</a>, <a href="https://github.com/altaywtf">@altaywtf</a>.</span>
- Fixes admitted files over 50 MiB being unavailable to agent tools when the configured media limit is raised. Transport limits still apply. Remote workspaces use the agent-level media limit.
  [PR #169163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169163) · [b9ea0a5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b9ea0a58716f6f5398273300459bc54f13f6a4da). Thanks to [@fransqaas](https://github.com/fransqaas) and [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization).
- Fixes orphaned worker workspace cleanup being abandoned after a temporary workspace lookup failure. The next idle sweep can retry cleanup.
  [PR #169223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169223) · [4010ad3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4010ad33c658a93bbf88666cafe2169711fe5bf9). Thanks to [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents path edits from adding duplicate YAML timestamp keys or silently rewriting unrelated numbers. Unsupported timestamp edits are refused and the file stays intact. [Path editing](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/path.md)
  [Timestamp keys #169266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169266) · [commit 4fca771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4fca771606ff8f8c81cb094b11755c4110b01820) · Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [Number preservation #173099](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173099) · Thanks [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes path edits changing untouched Markdown frontmatter or body formatting, losing quotes or whitespace in values, or turning text such as `0123` and `true` into numbers or booleans, or leaving frontmatter unreadable. Quoted string escapes also decode correctly. [Path CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path)
  The string-type fix applies to new edits with the optional `oc-path` plugin. [Frontmatter quotes #171291](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171291) · Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [Preserving Markdown #172124](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172124) · Thanks [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [String types #176710](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176710) · [commit 6ddfe89](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ddfe8903af306ea9e5d03151d32485e11eeb5ac) · [Path mutation contract](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path#mutation-contract) · Thanks [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Reduces unnecessary waits for other state writes while account, authorization and approval operations start on a busy Gateway.
  [#171549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171549) · Thanks [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes repeated SQLite maintenance warnings caused by brief, expected database contention while keeping sustained problems visible.
  [#172121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172121) · Thanks to [@mike1122real-hub](https://github.com/mike1122real-hub), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an empty `--job` value in `openclaw worktrees gc` starting a new cleanup pass. The CLI now reports an error before cleanup starts.
  [#172153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172153) · Thanks to [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes a false incomplete-cleanup warning after stopping a command in a [managed local sandbox](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access).
  [#172800](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172800). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes node-host commands using the wrong working directory when its path begins or ends with spaces. Execution approvals also distinguish those paths.
  [#172814](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172814). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes automations running in the wrong directory when a working-directory path has leading or trailing spaces. Edits that change only those spaces are also recognized for on-exit and stream schedules. Correct any previously saved paths that were already trimmed. On Windows, trailing spaces still depend on how the OS handles the path.
  [#172869](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172869). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Fixes database ports and [Git backups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup) failing when unrelated historical backup directories are inaccessible. The fix also applies to eligible updates run from 11.5. The ordinary upgrade from 11.4 uses the installed 11.4 updater for this check.
  [#172857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172857). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixed delays opening a handle to an already-open SQLite database while an unrelated database is opening.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#173040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173040)
- Keeps legacy meeting-transcript staging files when their database cannot close, with a warning for later cleanup. If you remove the files yourself, wait until the OpenClaw process exits.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173200">#173200</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes shared-state locks being left held after interrupted cleanup, a lease is lost before work starts, or Bun maintenance stops during a lease renewal, leaving a lock or expired lease behind.
  [Cleanup retry #173213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173213) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Lease loss #176274](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176274) · [commit db74ea6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db74ea654514ba536f83deb5c060a68023c507be) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Bun maintenance #176296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176296) · [commit c1da606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c1da606e2d03498cb50237caab2c65b1ca1aead6) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes files being read incompletely on WSL and similar filesystems when a read returns short.
  This covers affected direct file reads, including media and skill files on WSL2 or Docker Desktop Windows bind mounts using 9p. Existing size caps apply. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Hawk5150](https://github.com/Hawk5150) for the related report, and [@iiAnthony](https://github.com/iiAnthony) for reproducing it. [#173305](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173305) · [#145589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/145589)
- Fixes directory downloads reporting success with missing files when saved-file metadata cannot be read.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173336](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173336) · [Node file transfers](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/file-transfers.md)
- Reduces premature managed worktree cleanup timeouts on large repositories and avoids repeated pack indexing.
  Large managed partial clones get a longer pack-index maintenance window, which can occupy the repository queue longer. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173311) · [Managed worktrees](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/managed-worktrees.md)
- Fixes `openclaw path resolve` and `openclaw path set` for wrapped Markdown bullet fields, including fields you just inserted. Setting a value replaces its old continuation text and preserves surrounding items and line endings.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173392">#173392</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1b650393cea30261ffd1f2cf3eac82b8e14ded68">Commit 1b650393c</a>. Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Skips background setup for managed worktree dependencies at startup when an agent has sandboxing turned off. Roles that require a sandbox still prepare dependencies on first use.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173451">#173451</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees">Managed worktree guide</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes manual and scheduled offsite backups failing when `TMPDIR` is inside a selected backup source. OpenClaw stages the archive outside the sources, so you can use `backup create --to <location>` without a temporary-directory override for this case. Backup results include warnings from scratch cleanup.
  [#173584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173584) · [0e70c61](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0e70c61aef1d28333c95e5b14a409b29bef51bd4) · [Issue #173583](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173583) · Thanks [@dokdo2013](https://github.com/dokdo2013).
- Fixes Doctor refusing offline data-only maintenance on PostgreSQL. Stop the Gateway before running maintenance. Registered schema migrations require an exact backup of the previous schema’s data.
  [#173683](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173683) · [Schema backup support](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/407c309f27dae6f2dcf4487b0dd88a73f681e6b2) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session worktrees ignoring the configuration supplied for their preparation.
  [#173642](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173642) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unnecessary memory remaining in use after a SQLite worker finishes opening.
  [#173643](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173643) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes ordinary child sessions failing in a non-Git agent workspace with an empty `.git` folder. With no enclosing checkout, requests to create a worktree report that the workspace needs a Git checkout.
  [#173733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173733) · [Agent workspace guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-workspace) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed worktree checkouts timing out after five minutes even while Git is still checking out files. A checkout that goes five minutes without reporting progress still stops.
  [#173751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173751) · [Managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps managed worktrees on Btrfs from switching to full Git checkouts just because one snapshot was slow.
  [#173892](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173892) · [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes non-blocking Crabbox warm-image captures failing too soon when the system clock jumps forward or waiting too long for a checkpoint when it jumps back.
  [#173987](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173987) · [Regression coverage](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3d03a05e7749ce39022ef8af0318d215bf771a63) · Thanks SunnyShu0925 for the original clock fix and steipete for regression integration.
- Fixes long SQLite agent database migrations blocking their own maintenance check-ins and rolling back as a result.
  [#174638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174638) · [`139b998`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/139b998d0b6aeaa3811326b3198fcb117e1c8307). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a canceled chat or one that loses access from making other authorized chats fail while they wait for the same healthy agent database to finish its integrity check. Stops OpenClaw from silently creating a replacement if an existing agent database disappears while being opened for writing.
  [#175008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175008) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Replaces the generic error from `openclaw worktrees retire-snapshot` when `--removed-at` is invalid. The error shows the rejected value and explains that the flag expects a non-negative whole number in epoch milliseconds.
  [#175015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175015), [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/06eb109ab151a722db5f7643bd7ac25a3891d8ae) — Thanks [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes worktree creation being incorrectly rejected at the configured limit when another worktree finishes being created during the capacity check.
  [#175043](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175043) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes interactive setup failing or leaving application data in SQLite when PostgreSQL is configured. This covers `openclaw onboard`, `openclaw setup --wizard` and legacy `crestodian`. Remote interactive setup needs a PostgreSQL credential the local CLI can resolve. [PostgreSQL setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [#175655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175655) · [f15a2b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f15a2b8f9380714c76c3f7fd2d32b1e2a097172d). Thanks steipete.
- Keeps registered managed chat checkouts out of state-only backups, including checkouts under old worktree locations. Configuration and agent data stored inside them stay in the archive. [Backup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup)
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176142">#176142</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/efcd5d5086dff564f91cedc85067564bf7b7235b">Commit efcd5d5</a>
- Preserves the reason a state-only backup refused a managed SQLite database, such as one that is empty or has moved.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176180">#176180</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1fba7c8e7db168293033abbf1b9a4f66eb4c819c">Commit 1fba7c8</a>
- Releases memory held by finished or discarded SQLite queries sooner on Node 26.8 and later.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176411), [73c8498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/73c8498ea5ae5f38b710b8e178df2c993b11d036).
- Fixes a `database is locked` error that could stop synchronous SDK session writes while a Gateway worker was saving to the same SQLite database.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176822) · [commit 9f6d563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9f6d563714a9d644a4f3c99094ed88db4aa63ab2)
- Replaces an unclear Gateway write error with guidance to free space on the Gateway host when its disk is full. If OpenClaw cannot confirm whether the write succeeded, check whether the change was saved before retrying.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176832](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176832) · [commit f0e683c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f0e683ccb1311c8e189e9998767d8ef7cda0cf88) · [Gateway write troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/troubleshooting/agent-replies-and-control-ui)
- Fixes sandbox workspace setup aborting on brief database locks that clear in time for setup to continue.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176904">#176904</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176882">Report #176882</a> · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes cleanup failures when a managed Docker or Podman command stops or times out during a workspace checkpoint. Preserves final workspace writes from processes started by the command and reports the command’s original result.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176989">#176989</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176960">Report #176960</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access">Sandbox workspace access</a> · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Changes Git repair for a missing tip on Linux to leave certain tracking-ref locks from a previous boot in place. If repair reports a stale lock, follow the warning to resolve it before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987">#176987</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents a concurrent setup completion from being mistaken for proof that an agent’s workspace files survived. If OpenClaw cannot verify the files are still there, it preserves the completed setup state and refuses to recreate the files.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987">#176987</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes commands failing to finish in local managed guest workspaces because disposable build caches could not be read. Changes to those caches no longer cause conflicts when recovering pending workspace results, and original project inputs are still preserved. [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
  The exclusions apply to disposable files under `.artifacts/build-all-cache/` and `.artifacts/build-cache-inputs/`. [#177076](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177076). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents new SQLite database opens from waiting indefinitely when all healthy workers are busy. The open reports overload if no worker becomes available in time.
  [#177194](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177194). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps later OpenShell operations from jumping ahead of waiting work that shares their workspace or sandbox.
  [#177606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177606) · [16aee921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/16aee9219d04a2bad2e076a018e2c21f06f802e6). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes temporary media cleanup silently ignoring permission and disk errors. Failures while checking or removing those folders now appear in the Gateway maintenance log.
  [#177615](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177615) · [d9bee706](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9bee70655afc72c6971166ba333eb73d55a5063). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a missing warning when a Git backup restore cannot remove its temporary files. The warning names the folder so you can inspect it and remove it when safe.
  [#177784](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177784) · [713ca224](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/713ca224c42e67ada372cf53e3abd12c3868ee51). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an issue where cancelling a read of shared state could leave later reads unavailable if the first shutdown attempt failed.
  [#177841](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177841) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed-worktree sessions failing to start or retry from a remote base that is missing locally when the repository has many refs. If the repository is still too large to refresh safely, OpenClaw suggests choosing a base already in the checkout or asking your Gateway administrator for help. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#177893](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177893) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes managed worktree creation failing when you leave the base unspecified in a repository with no `origin` remote. The worktree starts from the main checkout’s current commit, even if it isn’t on a branch. [Managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178129">#178129</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9451b40fa984b958e2899017a54502728c9d4de">c9451b40</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes directory transfers rejecting highly compressible folders before checking whether the compressed archive actually fits the transfer limit.
  [#178201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178201) · [commit e1259a3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e1259a37e726c633ce23e4aec5d37103a9c03425). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops SQLite-to-PostgreSQL adoption when legacy Incognito session records need repair. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` on the SQLite installation before retrying. If you already adopted PostgreSQL with those records, re-adopt from the repaired SQLite source. [PostgreSQL adoption guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179377">#179377</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes `openclaw database port` stopping at an empty retired `fleet_cells` table. It records the skip in dry-run output and recovery records. If the table contains rows, the port stops. Keep the SQLite store and archive those rows before retrying. New PostgreSQL ports also use your configured schema prefix. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181882">#181882</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4c7b43d17b080f1f6f307291f33162a6f2d6d446">4c7b43d1</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181857">#181857</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181858">#181858</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and to <a href="https://github.com/etzelm">@etzelm</a> for reporting both issues.</span>
- Fixes database ports to PostgreSQL rejecting valid agent or shared-state SQLite stores because some features hadn’t been used yet. The port fills in what’s missing on a copy and leaves your original database unchanged. It still refuses stores with unknown columns. [Port existing stores](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines#port-existing-stores).
  Thanks to steipete and etzelm. [#181931](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181931) · [2d8d8ad39dc9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d8d8ad39dc92ccf7d59a2cbce6ae234ad6b2f1e)
- Fixes the generic error from `openclaw database port` when a copied state database no longer matches its credential record. The command explains why it refused the copy and points you to `openclaw backup restore` before you retry.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the fix. [#182830](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182830) · [Issue #182773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182773) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)
- Keeps local client credentials with each OpenClaw state directory when moving between SQLite and PostgreSQL, including when resuming or rolling back a move.
  <span>[#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev)</span>
- Fixes PostgreSQL ports and backup restores leaving the database without fresh query statistics. OpenClaw refreshes them after copying the data and again after a port rebuilds agent memory. If the refresh fails, OpenClaw warns and keeps the verified copy.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183447">#183447</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/660b252bb85696d7f6a60cadf214711a490b66ce">660b252</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines">Database engines</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb) and [@goutamadwant](https://github.com/goutamadwant) for the earlier fixes. Reported by @etzelm in <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183307">#183307</a>.</span>
- Fixes offline edits to database settings being refused on installations with plugin state. When the Gateway is running, the error also explains that database settings must be edited offline.
  [Offline edit guidance #179299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179299) · [Report #179153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/179153) · [Offline settings fix #182822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182822) · [Issue #182769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182769) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jlapenna](https://github.com/jlapenna) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes the first chat failing when OpenClaw initializes memory or standing-intent search after a SQLite-to-PostgreSQL port. You can chat without manually rebuilding the memory index. [Database engine guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-engines.md)
  [#178774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178774). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL agent databases reporting a checkpoint failure in the logs after a clean close. If you filter for these closes, use `postgres-closed`.
  [#178781](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178781). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new chat turns and update progress writes continuing to fail after PostgreSQL comes back online, and gives clearer errors when a connection is lost or a query is canceled. Interrupted writes are not replayed. If a chat write might have been saved, wait and check conversation history before retrying; a confirmed rollback can be retried. The agent stops after a canceled or uncertain operation to avoid repeating work automatically. [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql)
  [Connection recovery #179128](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179128) · [Commit 90f0844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/90f084407e6d78fb137512ea0e775370f76c68ce) · [Write errors #181576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181576) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed preference saves reporting an error after the change was already saved. Keeps later, unrelated database writes from overwriting a previous save confirmation or mixing unrelated results into startup of the shared authentication store. [Database engine reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines)
  [#179114](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179114), [`d56cc30`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d56cc300810ef226de39e54027188cfa436ed43b), [#179230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179230), [`47c8a2a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/47c8a2aa587089fb9b6f7fbfddb5a5416a131f39). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors when saving profile roles, linked GitHub or GitHub Enterprise accounts, channel identities and Git coauthor preferences. Restores reads of saved channel permissions and policies.
  [#179239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179239), [`f562929`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f562929983802ae3354c0347c63444310ba883cb). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL reads of backup history, earlier Goal results, scheduled Template job ownership and Doctor’s shared-state and update history.
  [First-use failures in worker journals, approval records, audit logs and skill stores #179239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179239) · [Commit f562929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f562929983802ae3354c0347c63444310ba883cb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session deletion failing on PostgreSQL when transcript archiving is enabled, so you can delete the session and keep its archived transcript.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179274">#179274</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Stops recurring missing-table warnings during Linux Gateway maintenance when you use PostgreSQL. SQLite maintenance still runs for any stores that use SQLite, including on mixed setups.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179327">#179327</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes PostgreSQL cleanup failures for ACP replay history, the incoming channel message queue, and resolved session suggestions. Also fixes errors updating ACP replay storage usage after trimming.
  [#183044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183044) · [f64a730d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f64a730df184f9f7e96435e290de7a36c553c3d5) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes inconsistent ordering on PostgreSQL. Participants who haven’t been prompted appear first, unused runtimes appear last in filtered sandbox lists, and windows without transcripts appear last when history includes all windows, matching SQLite.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183114">#183114</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a05a06d7c3887a5888ee9bc8d28a726bb969e839">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed Gateway startup failing while state tables are being set up or a worker is catching up with a newly created schema.
  [Startup reads #181837](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181837) · [Commit 68c5c3ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68c5c3ead3594bdd6c42ac57c26b028968d49769) · [Schema catch-up #182082](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182082) · [Commit e775e74c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e775e74cf08108ab0ae646731c9872a102e0dcc9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unnecessary full-table sorts on PostgreSQL for some small reads, including recent sessions, transcript pages and event lookups. Trimming a full memory embedding cache also avoids the extra sort. Existing PostgreSQL stores rebuild affected indexes during the normal schema upgrade, which can take longer on large databases.
  [#183015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183015) · [fdad53b1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdad53b1bc1d66d98a11da12fb633a75f8285ecb) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). · [PostgreSQL index ordering migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes#postgresql-index-ordering-migrations) · [Issue #182808](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182808) · [Predecessor fix #182821](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182821)
- Avoids reprocessing an entire PostgreSQL conversation when an agent repeatedly loads only part of its history.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183398">#183398</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/96a2c731d7305dc0e3c94882f4344ff18b87f0d4">96a2c73</a>. Thanks to [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt). Reported by @etzelm in <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183363">#183363</a>.</span>
- Avoids unnecessary PostgreSQL sorts on affected archived-session and approval lists, latest-message reads, and worker-record cleanup. Existing PostgreSQL state, agent, and Logbook stores rebuild the affected indexes during migration, which can take time.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183443">#183443</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/38753ff3b97dcd388165b063f32d4788324e2a08">38753ff</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes#postgresql-index-ordering-migrations">PostgreSQL index ordering migrations</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Reduces unnecessary database scanning for PostgreSQL-backed session, transcript, and Workboard lookups that match a short list of IDs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183480">#183480</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5dcf05df55e7c37535b559d838f3c5ecd9b9151d">5dcf05d</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors in skill usage tracking, proxy captures, MCP sign-in, voice session lookups, and transcript searches and duplicate handling.
  [Legacy audit and debug-proxy imports, ACP replay history and completed worker turns #183296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183296) · [Commit a6e32c0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a6e32c0a0236472ca1f5b3644604170c4eebea55) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops `openclaw doctor --lint` from leaving empty PostgreSQL schemas behind when it inspects Workboard tools. Schemas left by earlier runs remain in the database.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the fix. [#182827](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182827) · [Issue #182771](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182771) · [Doctor lint](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
- Fixes older Gateways being unable to save restart options in an already compatible state database. During Doctor or schema maintenance, background checkpoints defer and new database writers wait for maintenance to finish.
  [#178280](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178280) · [commit 0ff7795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0ff7795dc43d5d3a456bffbb1f74d88909fafd07) · [Gateway state ownership](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes retries that could leave a required state table missing after a failed database write. Skips an unnecessary write transaction when SQLite already has the tables and indexes the feature needs.
  [#181171](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181171) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9c05ca0d6ece62aa9e9a1d4b620d40f53ae6921c)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the first message in a new chat failing before the agent can reply when OpenClaw reaches its state directory through a symlink or a macOS path alias.
  [#181472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181472) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Extends [symlinked state-folder support](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/session) to PostgreSQL-backed sessions. You can delete sessions and archive their transcripts, remove cron sessions, and read retained cron history through a symlinked state folder.
  [#181554](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181554) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes OpenClaw looking in the wrong state folder when both `OPENCLAW_HOME` and `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR` start with `~` and neither `HOME` nor `USERPROFILE` is set. [Environment variables](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/environment#openclaw_home)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179276">#179276</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Rejects malformed numbers in saved or imported sessions with a repair message. If you see that message, stop the Gateway before running `openclaw doctor --fix` to repair supported legacy values. Values Doctor cannot convert need offline repair or restoration. [Storage repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182311">#182311</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Session Storage dropping its last loaded inventory during a temporary Gateway disconnect when you reconnect with the same client.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179419">#179419</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes OpenClaw holding on to cached SQLite conversation history on Bun when it detects critical memory pressure. The cache clears and saved conversations stay intact.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179399">#179399</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/sobolevbel">@sobolevbel</a>.
- Fixes idle session readers staying in memory longer than intended after unrelated database cleanup or a late-finishing usage request.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182316">#182316</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Frees memory that session archiving used to hold onto after it finished. OpenClaw releases it after five idle minutes and picks up the next archive request as usual.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183410">#183410</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fa9ca884c52805bdc1ed9e5d99bbc0787984164f">fa9ca88</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/database-schemas/storage-changes.md">Storage changes</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes OpenClaw keeping completed SQLite session deletion data in memory longer than needed.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183533)
- Fixes temporary SQLite copies being left on disk when you cancel a read-only inspection while the copy is being made.
  [#185443](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185443). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents shared-state saves, session watches and event updates waiting to start from holding up unrelated SQLite writes. It also fixes slow storage holding up Gateway requests while changing MCP settings, updating a personal GitHub connection or exporting a transcript, and during recovery cleanup and database maintenance.
  [Shared-state writes #181604](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181604) · [Session watches and events #184510](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184510) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ae5565cbfc75015a7bf7498dccedf5b09674400) · [Gateway requests #184586](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184586) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e0b550b0ababbf011ec2aaee40c00a228070562a) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes slow SQLite write-ahead log checks and routine database ownership checks holding up unrelated Gateway requests. Idle databases close once any active inspection finishes.
  [Database worker access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access) · [#184275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184275) · [05a0dd8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/05a0dd8ee67f1896886198f81d25188f0304d18b). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes local managed sandbox sessions staying blocked by an eligible file over the 64 MiB sync limit. The error confirms pending workspace changes are saved and shows a recovery command. Have a Gateway administrator run it on the Gateway host, then retry. The file is preserved outside automatic cleanup. [Sandbox recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox#openclaw-sandbox-recover).
  Offline recovery requires exclusive state ownership. [Recovery command #181143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181143) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c1a97b6502805e8780debe539bff32fe89ad7a71) · [Recovery guidance #182039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182039) · [Commit f21ed5e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f21ed5e34951c8d9626df156da2d8f3dd8f4a4ca) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and TheAngryPit.
- Prevents large tool or browser downloads in `.openclaw/tmp/` at the checkout root from blocking sandbox workspace sync or restart recovery, including results already waiting to sync. That folder stays with the runtime that created it, so save files you want to keep somewhere else in the workspace.
  [#182974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182974) · [8b99577d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b99577d469991477dd7e8ce8ae9c4f9a00b048e) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access)
- Fixes edits to previously included build inputs being missed after an older workspace archive is restored. Complete archives and publications keep those inputs, including ones in nested paths that would otherwise be ignored.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#180149](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180149) · [commit 7ef8532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ef85325b7c718f7ec27ecf496fe09a92a080d94)
- Fixes edits from native-node and SSH workers failing to sync back from Git workspaces because a newly generated build-cache file could not be read. The worker skips those disposable files while keeping tracked inputs and ordinary build reports in scope.
  [#185563](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185563) · [0a9c5fa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a9c5fa4cbdceb5ff375973518f536d52f7b2a3b) · [Report #177057](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177057) · [Earlier PR #178917](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178917) · [Original PR #181889](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181889) · [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and co-author [@grootbro](https://github.com/grootbro), with earlier work by [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and reporting by [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes managed sandbox worktrees getting stuck during sync or cleanup when they contain nested Git metadata. Edits blocked for this reason can sync again, and snapshot recovery leaves that metadata local to the sandbox.
  [#185669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185669) · [f5d2908](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f5d2908f26a7c7452eabbdc18d610eae21ac1cf1) · [Report #185616](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185616) · [Workspace access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) · Thanks [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) and co-author [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), with reporting by [@rywhventures](https://github.com/rywhventures).
- Fixes managed sandbox workspace eviction reporting that a checkout was kept after it had already been removed and saved for recovery.
  [#185650](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185650) · [4c3fd8a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4c3fd8a08b56e644d226fea787a31a23c780f131) · [Report #185631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185631) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for the report and fix.
- Stops settled local workspace writes from holding on to write data and earlier workspace state in memory, including after failures. A committed write can still be recovered if its reply was lost.
  [#185354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185354) · [6592064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65920646ed29cc9082c6ef9792024e00b9f73505). [Workspace write recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/worker-access). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing error messages when an agent’s workspace file list fails to refresh while a file is open. The editor stays open, and an initial list failure stays visible until you choose **Refresh**. The agent and file lists show when a refresh is still running without clearing an open draft.
  [#179532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179532) · [b320b79](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b320b79b41856c90281d86327a6227fd78feb1a5) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents replies from attaching workspace files that global or per-agent tool policies forbid reading. If you use a restrictive allowlist and intend to permit workspace attachments, make sure it includes `read`.
  [#184964](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184964) · [3c23d52c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3c23d52c93b2479d8685564b7e5b4e3dcb47cc1e). Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit).
- Reduces Gateway stalls while OpenClaw prepares a fresh baseline for a large local workspace. Saving a checkpoint also does less work that can hold up other Gateway activity.
  [#180862](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180862) · [commit 7462184](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7462184039f5d1c22519b883aea97bfc97f1b7cd) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a managed worktree creation failing because another request fetching the same default branch is canceled or loses access. The remaining request can continue once the interrupted fetch has safely stopped, within the original wait limit. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). [#184121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184121) · [c3662cb06b8a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c3662cb06b8a304451120b3b1a5ffea23defc04e) · [issue #184111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184111)
- Fixes a busy registered project holding up new workspaces for unrelated repositories. The request for the busy project remains subject to its usual wait limit.
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd). [#184138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184138) · [95a3ccde1410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/95a3ccde1410a55db6262778f8795a9b0ba39b27)
- Fixes managed workspace setup failing early when a registered project’s repository is temporarily busy. The request stays pending and cancellable, and it can continue within the remaining wait time without redoing completed checkout or setup. [Managed worktrees guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#184672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184672) ([`808672dd`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/808672dd778badc08cab870bca9f5f23b4253faf)), [Issue #184272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184272). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for reporting and fixing this.
- Fixes child worktree sessions failing to start when a dedicated worker’s default workspace isn’t available to the Gateway, even though the parent already has a managed repository.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179876">#179876</a> · Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).</span>
- Fixes the Worktrees page showing an empty list while it’s still loading. If the first load fails, select **Retry** to load the list again.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180404">PR #180404</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/02a1caa67dd018915ba0066092b9c3f8cb66176a">Commit 02a1caa</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes OpenClaw’s workspace-limited host tools refusing to read or edit files in registered Git worktrees of the same repository. Those tools now block writes to Git metadata. [Agent workspaces](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/agent-workspace).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182120) · [`d9a546d8`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d9a546d88c090d6fab64b51342c83d63d8517bfc)
- Stops managed worktree cleanup from taking the repository’s Git lock for pack maintenance when the pack directory is empty or missing. [Managed worktree guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#179103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179103), [`89b3268`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/89b3268e1632da6f4030d0b5f373f4f85cb5ac9c), [Issue #168452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/168452). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@alfred429](https://github.com/alfred429).
- Prevents routine Git commits and fetches in Gateway-managed clones and their linked worktrees from kicking off unexpected repacks. Existing managed clones pick up the fix when reused or refreshed. OpenClaw also suppresses automatic maintenance per command during affected worktree, GitHub publishing and worker setup operations in registered repositories and temporary checkouts. [Managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182086](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182086) · [#182166](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182166) · [`8720a81f`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8720a81fac398d9e8cd71d49427e1d6a6403d5e4) · [`2f1838d7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f1838d71bff4cbd452f29fff82b6f445a8f5b08)
- Keeps hourly managed-worktree maintenance from rebuilding Git’s object index for the whole repository. Maintenance works in smaller batches, though Git lookups can take longer if many packs remain. [Managed worktrees](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182204) · [`99aed8a2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99aed8a2d9fdeb06024c1a60d4d22569d1cb9626)
- Fixes [managed worktree repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) getting stuck on the same checkouts after a timeout. Retrying with `openclaw worktrees gc --retry-deferred` can reach later checkouts even after a Gateway restart. A checkout that exceeds the repair budget on its own may still need repository repair.
  [#184450](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184450). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git maintenance getting stuck when another operation is updating the repository.
  [#184450](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184450). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unnecessary rebuilds when files copied into a new [managed worktree](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) by `.worktreeinclude` would otherwise make prepared build outputs look older than their inputs.
  [#184469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184469), [commit b34becd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b34becda29260dae5aac4173b21da7e5dcd2f128). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents quick repeat clicks on Rebuild in Cloud environments from starting the same rebuild twice.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179364">#179364</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes a macOS delay that could leave changes in watched skill and state folders unnoticed after OpenClaw stopped watching many other folders.
  <span>[#179032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179032) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)</span>
- Preserves on-disk path spelling when resolving workspace paths on case-insensitive macOS filesystems, including paths used during skill discovery.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181872">#181872</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f74efc3695f88f8ce9f10eacb0783538e59db7e4">f74efc36</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181107">#181107</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and to <a href="https://github.com/0xtc23">@0xtc23</a> for reporting the mixed-case workspace issue.</span>
- Fixes file creation and publishing on NFS reporting failure after the file was already in place. The filesystem update also lets other work continue while asynchronous durable writes finish syncing.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182398">#182398</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/fs-safe/pull/1031">fs-safe #1031</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/fs-safe/pull/1033">fs-safe #1033</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/fs-safe/pull/1034">fs-safe #1034</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes local file tools on native Windows looking on the wrong drive or reporting files missing when given drive paths copied from Git Bash, Cygwin, or WSL. [Windows file paths](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/windows)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182400">#182400</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/99ed38944d73ee6c84a688a9fcc2ac82a939ddb7">99ed38944d73</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111624">earlier work #111624</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/111620">#111620</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) (reporter).
- Prevents affected directory scans from following linked folders and exhausting memory. Scans reject linked roots and report size or depth limits explicitly. QA session discovery skips linked transcripts and folders.
  Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#182185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182185) · [`65c7ed79`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/65c7ed799833c87cc5bb46e60354aef6048cf23f)
- Fixes `path find` returning quoted Markdown addresses that oc-path could not read or edit, including names with special characters and empty slugs. The fix also covers quoted frontmatter keys and containers, including inserting into a quoted section. `find` stops listing the same match under equivalent spellings while still giving duplicate headings separate addresses. [oc-path guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/extensions/oc-path/README.md)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179821">#179821</a> · Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).</span>
- Fixes [`openclaw path find`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path) returning false matches for Markdown wildcard searches that ask for a field that isn’t there.
  [#186203](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186203) · [Commit 2e628e80](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2e628e80c294d67e4fd903cbe2334fcc0aa28758) · Thanks to [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw path set` losing or joining inline YAML comments when filling an empty Markdown frontmatter field, and `openclaw path resolve` including quote marks or comments in a quoted value.
  [Editing comments #180918](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180918) · [Reading quoted values #182792](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182792) · Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents paths, commit messages and archive details from changing terminal formatting or adding misleading lines to [backup creation, verification, restore and Git backup reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup), including warnings when a backup result cannot be recorded.
  [Git backup output #181586](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181586) · [Backup report output #183354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183354) · [Commit b307533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b307533754a13be26e3d1b1cb78ae4956531ded0) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores the error details in terminal warnings when an optional Git backup push fails, while keeping credentials redacted. The local backup remains available if the push fails.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183448">#183448</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/97d591c43ec2819b825e841f4f6f852e634ddba1">97d591c</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup">Backup CLI</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Warns if preparing or rotating a backup fails during a config save, even if the save succeeds. If you see the warning, run `openclaw backup create --verify` before making more changes.
  [#184950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184950) · [a3283f78](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a3283f78e00fc83c6bf44346099f270748e89287) · [Issue #184891](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184891). Thanks [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng), [@syxscott](https://github.com/syxscott), [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Fixes [recovery of retained local sandbox workspace files](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox#openclaw-sandbox-recover) failing when the workspace and recovery folder are on different filesystem mounts. Recovery preserves any file already at the destination. If recovery is interrupted, check the printed destination before reusing the recovery ID. If both copies exist, inspect them before retrying.
  [#186237](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186237) · [Commit 8e1574b4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8e1574b4aedc6e5d86a140eeff7febc17b147277) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes sandbox startup reporting a path conflict when it cannot access the generated skills folder. The error names the folder so you can check ownership and permissions on it and its parent directories before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186247">#186247</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1f75ea77cf16085ca7e517254a24a8f06e33e18b">commit 1f75ea7</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184115">issue #184115</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing">Sandboxing guide</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/LiuwqGit">@LiuwqGit</a> (report).</span>
- Adds a one-time retry when sandbox startup fails because the container host runs out of keyring quota, even with disk space free. OpenClaw may stop one inactive sandbox to make room, ending its processes and clearing its in-memory files. If the error persists, raise the host’s keyring limits or run fewer sandboxes before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186261">#186261</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/222e6a62131698b771d0c96a4c7323c807c249c5">commit 222e6a6</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/podman-backend">Podman keyring limits</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Prevents managed sandbox sessions from getting stuck when workspace preparation expires during cleanup. Retry the session if OpenClaw reports that preparation expired. Both workspaces are kept. OpenClaw repairs a missing workspace baseline while preserving live edits when it can verify the original. If verification fails, keep both directories and ask a Gateway administrator to recover the baseline before retrying.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186278">#186278</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e69b3829f84444c07480a0bbfd160adc628859ca">commit e69b382</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access">Sandbox workspace recovery</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes workspace file search missing names when the same accented letters are encoded differently in the query and the filename. Results still show each file’s original name.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186329">#186329</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d7acde6ae97e3e95c3ce4b07fb86cd6eb92db7fb">commit d7acde6</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666">@wangmiao0668000666</a>, <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a> (co-author).</span>
- Fixes session lists and lookups, chat history and details, boards, and model lists failing or waiting for full [database checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) after an unclean Gateway restart when the existing database is already up to date and needs no repair. Workboard and other eligible plugin reads no longer have to wait behind unrelated agent database checks. Writes still wait for the checks to finish.
  [#186473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186473). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes project registration choosing the wrong Git checkout or rejecting the selected one when its folder name ends in a space or other whitespace. Existing registrations are not changed.
  [#186474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186474). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Removes the automatic instruction to commit edits during workspace setup, which could conflict with a request to leave them uncommitted for review.
