  [#186507](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186507), [issue #186489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186489). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes agents failing at startup while SQLite is recovering a large database journal by giving temporary recovery conflicts time to clear.
  [#186546](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186546). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes [managed worktree creation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) failing in local Git projects that inherit origin settings but have no actual origin. The default worktree starts from the primary checkout’s current commit.
  [#186555](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186555). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Fixes the agent being unable to read files attached to the first message of a new worktree session, even after the upload appeared to succeed.
  [#186572](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186572). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Stops backup create, verify and restore trimming spaces at the start or end of archive paths and restore destinations, keeping files in the chosen location.
  [#186746](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186746). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes worktree remove and restore commands hanging when an exact-state request points to a special file such as a named pipe. The command now reports which file it couldn’t read.
  [#187615](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187615). Thanks to [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Returns an error instead of waiting when an attempt to reopen OpenClaw’s shared database encounters a closing connection that an active operation is still using.
  [#187819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187819). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes New Session incorrectly disabling existing folders on paired devices for supported models using the default OpenClaw runtime. Starting a chat after provider setup or switching back from a hosted environment also no longer overrides the normal runtime choice.
  [#190065](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190065). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes state database cleanup giving up too early after a brief conflict with offline maintenance, including after a lease renewal. Native startup also recognizes renewed leases.
  [Cleanup retry #191838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191838) · [commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770) · [commit 2d03432](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2d0343202a3448a8bcaa2c79ff84c7b5463e14a7). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes a misleading SQLite timeout when a retry runs out of time while checking the shared-state schema in PostgreSQL. OpenClaw reports the original PostgreSQL error instead.
  [#193735](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193735). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), plus release backport coauthors [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) (487f531188).
- Fixes a failure that could stop an [offline move from PostgreSQL back to SQLite](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines) while OpenClaw checks whether the stores are in use.
  [commit 1a10cd3b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a10cd3b8d390d10c1c0116924f36fe23f57c6ce). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL migration preflight blocking fresh Matrix accounts that have no legacy deduplication data to repair. If preflight finds legacy Matrix data, run Doctor while the account still uses SQLite before retrying.
  [commit a1bdebdb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a1bdebdb9f8dec868e069700f39422f36ad81e22). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a canceled request from interrupting other requests opening the same existing agent database.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b499c60e1968e7e0ff636e34b8045f9982f6592f).
- Reports leftover temporary files after creating, verifying, or restoring a Git backup without changing the reported backup result. Inspect the directory named in the warning.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c96ef749f451f534f341a53d5da96d477fb4140).
- Fixes PostgreSQL setup for worker-environment session attachments and SSH fallback ports, and includes the database setup file packaged Logbook needs on PostgreSQL.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/389ff68c3bc1a5751590d3abe0939582afa80c95).
- Fixes Node workers failing to capture a file manifest for plain workspaces during reconciliation.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/41b9f21f382010852c4d564c8b5902e7ff614707). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps `openclaw path` on the exact literal key when differently encoded keys look alike.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Accounts for completed writes when a later worktree capacity check refuses further growth.
  [commit 2b08b6f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Fixes opening one SQLite database getting stuck while another waits to open.
  [commit 0994eea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Fixes [backup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup) compaction running out of space in the system temporary directory when the backup destination has room.
  [Commit fdadb27](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fdadb276ef02acf11135aa78b354f44f38c91098). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Stops agent databases held after deletion or for recovery from opening as live data. Requests for a held database explain how to restore it, while other agents stay available. Restoring an older held database backs it up and migrates it before the agent returns to use. Stop the Gateway first if the selected database needs migration. See [agent restoration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/agents).
  [Commit 5d93d5e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d93d5e29c4a5071b2af5dd8b8ea253cc046f524). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Retries paired-node workspace cleanup if a session moves just before cleanup starts, instead of skipping that pass.
  [#173873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173873). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw worktrees retire-snapshot` reporting a snapshot identity error for an invalid `--removed-at` value. The error now points to the flag and asks for a non-negative integer in epoch milliseconds.
  [PR #174339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174339) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b8bea44d143f2af90ddb6f81cd0af517b4e6e2d8) · Thanks [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes PostgreSQL setups failing to start the Gateway or handle live turns, including withdrawing or recovering queued messages and reading older conversation history and transcript reports. It also fixes private child-run replay on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes local memory, update, setup, agent and model management, credential, configuration and Doctor commands failing or using the wrong local state on [PostgreSQL installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql). Memory and update commands stop instead of creating local state if the configured database cannot be resolved. Cron and Doctor also stop looking in SQLite for PostgreSQL state, and related discovery stays consistent if that state changes during a check.
  [Memory and update commands #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f) · [Commands and discovery #175069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175069). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL errors in plugin registry updates.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes new agent runs still using the old workspace after you change `agents.defaults.workspace` without restarting the Gateway. After a successful [reload](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload), new runs use the new folder and its instructions unless the agent has its own workspace set.
  [PR #174794](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174794) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9ded080ec6da3de35508fb3db09ecd5cf0cb6103). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@xtimor](https://github.com/xtimor) for the report.
- Makes Doctor report database checks as unknown when it can’t read the config or resolve the database, instead of checking a fallback store. With the Gateway stopped, a database-only config edit can repair a missing connection reference without opening the database. Mixed edits still require a connection. Doctor leaves PostgreSQL untouched when a legacy repair requires a SQLite-only backup.
  [PR #175069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175069). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents OpenClaw from writing to a newer, unsupported state database if its schema changes while OpenClaw is preparing the first write.
  [PR #175295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175295) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8779297c8e7322a6e27280134a4eb02d4132562). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a `database is locked` error that could stop an existing PostgreSQL-backed Gateway store from opening for reads while its local database was busy with a write.
  [PR #175389](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175389). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [managed workspace refreshes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) failing when a partial clone is missing files from the base revision or a shared ancestor. If those files can’t be fetched, your saved work stays available for a retry.
  [#175738](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175738) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ac5faa479233a4e771f380551483fbe22fe90e6e). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents PostgreSQL-backed sessions from treating an unverified copy of session state as current.
  [#175857](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175857) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a39c622fc18557603bcdaadb194bec8ae406942). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missed session updates when OpenClaw reaches the same state store through a symlink. Session history and activity summaries also avoid extra database reads in that setup.
  [#175859](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175859) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e39ce04c819707527c313686d3fd99bd1cc297e5). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a duplicate-worktree error when two requests for the same owner create a managed worktree at the same time and let OpenClaw choose its name. Both requests can reuse the same checkout.
  [PR #175935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175935) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbb590b7bf4b6897726aefa173580ce74111fecf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed guest commands failing to return [workspace changes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) after downloading package dependencies or Playwright browsers. It also fixes recovery of saved workspace results failing when temporary Vitest files have already disappeared.
  [PR #175966](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175966), [issue #175956](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175956). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents project cloning, pinned checkouts and repository refreshes from deleting files when OpenClaw cannot confirm Git has stopped. Remote branch checks also report the cleanup error. If Git has stopped but an incomplete clone cannot be removed, OpenClaw stops and asks you to check filesystem access and remove it before retrying.
  [PR #175973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175973) and [PR #175998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175998). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds recovery for managed sandbox sessions blocked because the total size of changed files exceeds the workspace sync limit. The error shows what is over the limit and, when recovery is available, tells a Gateway admin how to preserve an eligible new file outside sync and retry.
  [#186805](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186805) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7c87e3a892dffa9280b9618dc01792c955ad20d1) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sandbox) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents managed sandbox workspaces from becoming unreadable after certain file deletions, so later operations can still read the files you kept.
  [#186815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186815) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f2a80d3a7e49372b58e7633306323e841f53471a) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes [managed sandbox workspaces](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) failing to resume after their records go missing. OpenClaw can restore the records when it can verify the saved workspace state, without discarding later edits.
  [Workspace recovery #186819](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186819) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2838a483a7915061c48c840a59678d7b19b9bedd) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Bun processes staying open after they finish cleaning up a retained SQLite snapshot.
  [PR #174096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174096) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/72629e1fdff973fef9316e33e8fcf8d3cf643e38). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents sandbox files from being recreated when a [managed working folder](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/workspace-access) is removed while an attachment is being read. The original attachment remains available.
  [Attachment handling #174104](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174104) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4008c32e3097def073b46673e2120a0e7a325937) · [Issue #174029](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174029) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes a resumed move of shared data to PostgreSQL reporting success after PostgreSQL rejects the prepared copy. The copy and recovery record are kept for investigation.
  [PR #194595](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/194595) · Thanks [@ylcn91](https://github.com/ylcn91), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), and [@reisball](https://github.com/reisball) for the report.
- Fixes [managed worktree requests](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) timing out early while a registered project is busy. Requests remain pending and cancellable within the existing creation wait limit and continue without repeating checkout or setup that already finished.
  [#184672](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184672). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).

##### Installing, updating and recovery

- Fixes Doctor repeatedly deferring unindexed legacy conversations whose repeated session headers differ only by timestamp. Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to import affected conversations while preserving the original transcript bytes. See the [Doctor session guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions).
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172360](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172360) · [1c656eb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c656ebb79a3a05714c4b2804de4f1fe201c7ccf)
- Fixes Doctor blocking retries of interrupted legacy session imports when the stored history matches. Rerun `openclaw doctor --fix` on the same state directory. Doctor can append a verified missing suffix and archive matching originals. For conflicts or unsafe gaps, it reports the blocking finding and keeps the originals.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173380">#173380</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172875">Earlier PR #172875</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172866">Issue #172866</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@wangxiajun68](https://github.com/wangxiajun68) (earlier implementation).
- Fixes update repair failing immediately when a known short-lived OpenClaw process holds shared state.
  <span>Update-time Doctor shows progress while it waits for an identified non-Gateway process to release shared state. It waits up to 20 minutes by default, with a shorter budget when time has already elapsed or needs to be reserved for rehearsal. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172636">#172636</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/RomneyDa">@RomneyDa</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/recovery.md#L119-L129">Doctor recovery documentation</a>.</span>
- Fixes updates failing when another OpenClaw process briefly holds an agent database open while the Gateway is stopped. Update-time Doctor waits for it to close within the update deadline.
  If the deadline expires, Doctor defers maintenance and reports the process ID holding the database. See [update troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/ec38f535d3d5de9e087d834fe58e6190852fcb2a/docs/install/update-troubleshooting.md).

  [#172772](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172772). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Reports incomplete Linux systemd checks in Doctor and human-readable Gateway status when service files or backups are unreadable. Skips legacy cleanup after incomplete discovery and stops service owner lookup on inspection errors. If Doctor names a path it could not inspect, restore access and rerun Doctor before retrying cleanup. [Doctor service checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  [#175012](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175012) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Linux Gateway service checks hiding cleanup or ownership errors behind an unknown status or a fallback command. Installation also reports these errors during its final check instead of reporting success. If that check fails, inspect the service before retrying because it may already be running.
  [#175709](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175709) · [68555b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68555b8cf3704bccb3b176006d375eec5a1a9384). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes package updates getting blocked by permission changes on Linux when recovery can safely use the updater’s own files or an otherwise verified saved package. The updater makes its own eligible recovery files private and removes extra write access from verified saved packages where possible, preserving read and execute access there. The updater running the update needs these fixes.
  Exactly matching older recovery records still work with their original permissions. [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) · [#175423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175423) · [#175449](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175449) · [Follow-up permission repair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/812e50f37809) · [Issue #170032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170032). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@council10-kera](https://github.com/council10-kera) for the original report and [@ceo633](https://github.com/ceo633) for the ACL follow-up.
- Fixes package updates failing during permission repairs on files shared through hard links.
  [#175626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175626) · [ea19d90](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea19d90e4f7622665ab380a4996604ade38b7ba4). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes managed updates getting stuck while saving progress during the state snapshot. If an optional progress entry still cannot be saved, the update warns and continues. If it cannot save information needed for recovery or record the final result, it reports a failure. The fix takes effect when the installed updater that starts the update includes it.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176968">#176968</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176813">Report #176813</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating">Updating OpenClaw</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@yoyo837](https://github.com/yoyo837).</span>
- Fixes managed update snapshot timeouts that lost the last progress details. When the installed updater has the fix, the saved error and `openclaw update status` show where the snapshot stopped and how far it got. The size estimate covers the whole snapshot, including plugins. [Update status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update)
  [#177300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177300), [issue #177225](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177225). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@unim0trix](https://github.com/unim0trix).
- Fixes migrated updates reporting a result before cleanup and recovery finish. The change applies when the installed updater already contains this fix.
  <span>Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/159644">#159644</a></span>
- Stops extended-stable update checks from continuing after the Gateway shuts down.
  <span>Thanks [@adenzhou1350](https://github.com/adenzhou1350), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161067">#161067</a></span>
- Fixes the Unix installer claiming OpenClaw is on PATH when it may not be. If your shell can’t find OpenClaw, use the command printed by the installer.
  <span>Thanks [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii), [@romneyda](https://github.com/RomneyDa). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164038">#164038</a></span>
- Fixed source installs rejecting valid linked Git worktrees. Bash and PowerShell installers reject incomplete checkouts and nonempty destinations without a valid checkout at that path, and the Bash installers avoid moving a branch already checked out in another worktree.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172934](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172934) · [Installer guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/installer.md)
- Fixed updates run with the 11.5 updater failing after activation when a deleted agent has an intentionally retained database on an older schema.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the report. [#172975](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172975) · [Managed updates](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/updating.md)
- Fixes Docker release-image preparation failing package validation when a sealed worker refers to a native helper missing from the package.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173173">#173173</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes Feishu Doctor recovery backups that could miss committed database changes. Doctor takes a verified snapshot before deleting an affected session.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173200">#173200</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes updates being rejected for insufficient snapshot space when enough space is available for current SQLite snapshots. The running updater and the candidate snapshot worker must both support the revised estimate. An older installed updater can still reject the first hop under its earlier reservation.
  Later migrations can require additional space. Thanks to [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). [#173284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173284)
- Fixes updates launched through a node waiting for the wrong Gateway, and fixes Gateway status identifying the node service as the Gateway. Restart the updated node to apply the fix. A handoff already stalled under an older node process needs separate recovery.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), coauthor [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668), and reporter [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini). [#173304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173304) · [#171542](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171542) · [Node execution guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/node-exec.md)
- Fixes the Updates page showing **Update status unavailable** for an up-to-date package after a cached startup check when automatic updates are off.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), coauthors [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt), and reporter [@stevenjj33](https://github.com/stevenjj33). [#173330](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173330) · [#173199](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173199) · [Update status and history](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/status-and-history.md)
- Fixes Team deployment verification failing on a temporary readiness dip or a successful configured fallback model. Use provider-qualified fallback names, and settle existing transactions with their original controller before adopting the updated controller.
  The controller waits for readiness within the deployment deadline and verifies the fallback against the deployment’s configured models. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#173329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173329) · [Team deployment controller](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md)
- Fixes Codex replies and tool hooks failing on standalone installs without a separate CLI script. The same launch fix covers ACP, the terminal UI, completion refresh after updates, and live Gateway CLI checks. [Standalone install guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone)
  [#173473](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173473) · [bf18487](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf1848705bd90ff1a33d5afe73bc60b0054d3061) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a team-server deployment from being deferred prematurely when its drain deadline expires just before a status check starts. The controller applies the configured deadline policy and checks that it can safely interrupt before doing so.
  [#173525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173525) · [5469755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/54697558b6eb926cbfcf58c5bd1c8143453ab131) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw migrate codex` previews missing installed plugins and rejecting `--plugin` selection in a fresh process.
  [#173665](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173665) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes read-only Doctor plugin checks writing temporary capture files into your OpenClaw state directory.
  [#174639](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174639) · [`7f93a05`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7f93a05f96ab09091a8b97a6ee553fe8dc69c0d6). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Crabbox trying to download a replacement when it can’t inspect its managed executable. `openclaw sandbox list` reports a failed lease check as an inspection error. Resolve the reported error before retrying. [Crabbox sandboxes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/sandboxing/crabbox-backend)
  [#174935](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174935) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` hanging if you press Ctrl+C or send SIGTERM while it is preparing maintenance archives, before it stops the Gateway or starts repairs.
  [#174898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174898) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a false Gateway ownership error that could block startup or Doctor maintenance in PRoot Ubuntu.
  [#174974](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174974), [Issue #171385](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171385) — Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@caozhongbin](https://github.com/caozhongbin).
- Fixes automatic and managed-service update reports that showed only a generic handoff error. When the 11.5 updater runs the update, the report includes the underlying refusal if available.
  [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · [#175423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175423) · [Issue #170032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170032). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates failing when a leftover setting keeps Doctor from saving an otherwise valid configuration repair. Doctor backs up the original, removes settings that no longer belong to OpenClaw or a plugin, and keeps settings that a plugin still needs to migrate.
  [Doctor configuration migrations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/doctor/config-migrations.md) · [#175404](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175404) · [Issue #174618](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174618). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@klausleopold](https://github.com/klausleopold) for the report.
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` skipping a required database migration for a stopped systemd Gateway when its service settings were already current or couldn’t be refreshed. With the Gateway and other state writers stopped, Doctor can continue the migration and warn about service settings it couldn’t refresh. Doctor rechecks which unit owns the Gateway, so a removed system unit can no longer block the repair.
  [Doctor recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/recovery) · [#175492](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175492) · [Issue #175400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175400). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@halachung](https://github.com/halachung) for the report.
- Fixes offline Doctor repairs on Btrfs appearing to hang while copying unrelated agent files. Doctor now repairs only the affected SQLite files, shows its progress and skips files it already repaired if you rerun it after an interruption. If Doctor can’t confirm which files were put in place, inspect the recovery files before retrying.
  [Offline Btrfs repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#btrfs-and-nocow) · [#175474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175474) · [Issue #175373](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175373). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@asidko](https://github.com/asidko) for the report.
- Removes a redundant verification pass when Doctor creates a full or table-scoped SQLite migration backup. Doctor still checks backup integrity.
  [#175548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175548) · [f9d61d3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f9d61d37da210dea4671b5a725021e65259fdcee). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes backup cancellation errors leaving out how far the archive write got. The error includes the last recorded step and byte counts, plus the last file name when available.
  [#175636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175636) · [a53e1e8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a53e1e85a71b67873ab4c87d8f376281c3d09791). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes long SQLite agent database upgrades stopping when Doctor mistakenly reports losing exclusive maintenance access. Doctor warns when that database step runs long. The fix applies when the new version runs Doctor. [Database integrity and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery)
  [#175588](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175588) · [7daf189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7daf1899b9093746f9f6e73fb6c51052e68aa7a4). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes older SQLite migrations and routine Doctor repairs running repeated full-database checks in quick mode. Quick mode checks changed tables in full and can miss an index mismatch in an untouched table. Use `--full-integrity-check` in 11.5 to check every table and index. This starts when the new version runs its checks. Recovery and restore verification still use full checks. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#175662](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175662) · [f58d46d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f58d46d2a4fee066cc00cefb918d1565dcde945f). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes updates running past `--timeout` while saving the files the updater needs to keep working. That step reports progress, stops if dependency checks cannot make headway, and leaves the running installation untouched if the deadline expires. This protection starts once the updater containing the fix is installed. [Update command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update)
  [#175626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175626) · [ea19d90](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ea19d90e4f7622665ab380a4996604ade38b7ba4) · [issue #171446](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171446). Thanks steipete, dibuyo.
- Prevents `openclaw onboard --reset` from changing files when configuration is unreadable or a reset would strand PostgreSQL data. For PostgreSQL, rerun without `--reset` or port supported stores to SQLite first. Use `openclaw reset --scope config` for a file-only reset. Interactive setup can offer to repair malformed configuration before opening a database. [Onboarding guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/onboard)
  [#175655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175655) · [f15a2b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f15a2b8f9380714c76c3f7fd2d32b1e2a097172d). Thanks steipete.
- Makes setup wait for its temporary Gateway before opening the terminal UI, even with `--skip-health`. If the Gateway cannot start, setup stops it before falling back to local mode. Leaving the terminal UI or pressing Ctrl+C also stops the temporary Gateway.
  [#175655](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175655) · [f15a2b8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f15a2b8f9380714c76c3f7fd2d32b1e2a097172d). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Doctor stopping an update because it could not check for pending Codex assignments while maintenance writes continued. The fix applies when the new version runs Doctor against a database it has already accepted. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#175659](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175659) · [ff908fe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff908fed3f958854fba17ace4b6e6f09545ad8f2). Thanks steipete.
- Fixes Linux node service uninstall reporting success when it can’t read an existing service credentials file to clean it up. If you see this error, credential cleanup and the user systemd reload can still be pending after unit removal. [Node service commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)
  [#175669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175669) · [2e14684](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2e1468478d68dd6495185ab92a2befb1d110f062). Thanks steipete.
- Keeps the file path and parse error visible when the CLI stops at startup because its configuration file or an included file is malformed, including during the new database selection step.
  [#175677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175677) · [7035ba9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7035ba96f2b8c24b2f41ca4b25c8832778bb5398). Thanks steipete.
- Prevents interactive configure and onboarding from silently starting and re-enabling a Linux Gateway service you stopped and disabled. Choose **Skip** to leave it stopped and disabled, **Restart** to start it with autostart still disabled, or **Reinstall** to enable and start it. [Configure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/configure) · [Onboarding](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/onboard)
  [#175680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175680) · [5ec6743](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5ec674314e18716bdd025dec73f6499c09f2bf8c) · [Issue #83354](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83354). Thanks yxshee, JamieJ5926, obviyus, cdeyoung67.
- Fixes stale success messages, restart notices and diagnostic writes in the 11.5 updater when it loses control of the installation before finishing. Recovery reports keep the original failure, and a refused update can report why without changing a newer update’s records.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176125">#176125</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/931de9e55a352c15606022c36adef6a32fa468ae">Commit 931de9e</a>
- Prevents managed Git updates from immediately giving up when another process is maintaining the state database. The 11.5 updater waits before stopping the Gateway and leaves it running if maintenance is still busy. If the conflict persists after shutdown, recovery can restore the previous build. The diagnostic names the process to wait for before retrying. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176131">#176131</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c57ba363c29c263a68ed7602b8a7ff963e94e241">Commit c57ba36</a>
- Stops the 11.5 updater from downloading unrelated branches just to find an update on stable Git installs. It fetches release tags during that check and avoids failures caused by conflicting branch mappings. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@masatohoshino](https://github.com/masatohoshino). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176155">#176155</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/41f162400aa3c4fe8307ecf882bcb814f37a64e7">Commit 41f1624</a>
- Fixes bundled plugin discovery holding up other OpenClaw work during some Doctor checks and configuration loads.
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#176291](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176291), [676658e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/676658eded43f29f9609ca146d108f0def5c2fc5).
- Avoids reading the live state database a second time when Doctor runs plugin checks that need a writable copy and already has a usable snapshot. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor)
  Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc). [#176334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176334), [ec50e32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec50e3204982acec67da761bc482697ceedf5aeb).
- Fixes the live updater refusing managed macOS Gateway updates when the service uses supported Node heap options or the current OpenClaw-generated LaunchAgent wrapper. This applies when the updated driver runs the update. It preserves the heap options during service control.
  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). [#176333](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176333), [196a8e6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/196a8e64b9013d06c719e492afed76b156e0ba23), [#176346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176346), [2aca4a0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2aca4a06b2c8df4908b1e0d4582cbaedd4d62f36).
- Fixes live updates failing before the build when catching up an older checkout with a large list of changed files. The updated driver accepts change lists up to 32 MiB.
  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). [#176351](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176351), [0960eff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0960eff1598bb2c90318c36a6b10d0befb87660c).
- Fixes the managed macOS live updater waiting indefinitely for a compatible Gateway to go idle. The updated driver gives work time to finish, then can interrupt work that is still running. It refuses to stop the Gateway while protected writes are pending.
  Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). [#176365](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176365), [14886e4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14886e46e823ba6289fe24b3d88fd3205b409652).
- Fixes OpenClaw’s version checks rejecting well-formed Node 27 HEAD, nightly, and other prerelease builds during installation, updates, and startup. Node 26 remains recommended, and SQLite safety checks and package manager requirements still apply. See the [Node compatibility guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/node-compatibility).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176568">#176568</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a0fb5a7f5791d9a02c3a3c7b322710840af814d">5a0fb5a7</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xiaopinpin-music](https://github.com/xiaopinpin-music).
- Fixes Doctor rejecting a writable state check when a report snapshot from a different state directory is still open. That refusal could roll back an update.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176665">#176665</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/46c2c45c2511104a2dcc1b1076cbdf95641c798f">46c2c45c</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor skipping its optional SQLite NOCOW repair on supported btrfs mounts in official Docker containers. Use a current official image when running the [SQLite repair procedure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#btrfs-and-nocow).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176595">#176595</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a4e7aefd743790bbca49925ae0c7e6c1a85e6d4">3a4e7aef</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kitiyeung](https://github.com/kitiyeung).
- Fixes database status reports listing deleted Doctor inspection copies and their outdated schemas.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176825](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176825) · [commit 9d495c3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9d495c33ff4e479780fe83cd0e8d62b2264fa53d) · [Doctor inspection guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
- Fixes Gateway shutdown hanging after an agent finishes its work but OpenClaw cannot send the final reply because the requester lost access.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176912">#176912</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents an unresponsive node worker from holding up a Gateway restart for the full cancellation timeout. If the worker never confirms that it stopped, OpenClaw keeps the information needed to recover its work.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177009">#177009</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery">Restart recovery</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents one slow database check at startup from holding up healthy agents’ database opens and cron maintenance. Cron skips stores that are still being checked and returns to them when they become available.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176916">#176916</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery">Database integrity and recovery</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Doctor silently skipping the legacy outgoing-image migration when its records directory is invalid or unreadable. Doctor now reports the problem.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176987">#176987</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes misleading advice to stop a healthy Gateway when a Git update fails without changing the running installation. The new guidance reports the failure and offers a retry for the selected profile instead. When recovery is needed, the instructions keep details of failed or unattempted rollbacks visible.
  [#177129](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177129). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Restores workspace memory in npm installs so missing memory support no longer cuts short onboarding or agent turns. It also restores workspace skills operations that couldn’t run without the missing files.
  [#177130](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177130), [35848cd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35848cd8afeae1179d28613a9d88a951ac151727). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown and restart cutting off interrupted turns before they can finish cleaning up pending input.
  [#177223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177223). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents new worker cleanup and discovery from holding up a Gateway restart after shutdown interrupts worker recovery. Work already accepted can finish, and recovery picks up on the next start. Adds periodic shutdown logs that show what the Gateway is still waiting for and for how long. [Gateway restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)
  [#177304](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177304). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops unnecessary file watches from interfering when Doctor resumes database maintenance.
  [#177300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177300). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving stale copies of generated provider catalogs in `models.json` files with line comments or trailing commas. Doctor leaves custom entries alone and backs up the original, including comments, before rewriting the repaired file as plain JSON.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177346">#177346</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1f6e0b48d2e5f14740363c49721d1fcdec718041">Commit 1f6e0b4</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions">Doctor state and sessions</a>
- Fixes update repair timing out before it reaches the plugin step on installations with large session migration histories.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/jonstarry-oc">@jonstarry-oc</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177392">#177392</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1d107a62cfa338321d97819421ac65fe522938c6">Commit 1d107a6</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance">SQLite maintenance</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177352">Issue #177352</a>
- Fixes updater and Doctor cleanup leaving unused runtimes behind when it can verify that a Node process without a package manifest is unrelated to OpenClaw. A process using one runtime no longer blocks cleanup of another runtime that can be confirmed unused.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/DonnieFi">@DonnieFi</a>, <a href="https://github.com/angeliti999">@angeliti999</a>, <a href="https://github.com/woshicby">@woshicby</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177407">#177407</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b78b230a1c109fe6456964e59cb0eeefe63b7e5">Commit 8b78b23</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173082">Issue #173082</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks">Doctor checks</a>
- Fixes Git source installs giving up on certain temporary connection errors while looking up a release tag. When lookup fails, the installer shows Git’s error with sensitive details redacted.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177502">#177502</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/146284a289f98a2cf3babbc55cc3bd16c28e604b">Commit 146284a</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer">Installer guide</a>
- Improves systemd service inspection timeout errors with the phase that timed out. Long Doctor warnings keep complete sentences and paths or indicate that details were omitted. [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery)
  [#177560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177560) · [723bc4a5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/723bc4a577208e514f2b7df6642e65489e6f419f) · [Reported in #177442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177442). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sdamian](https://github.com/sdamian).
- Fixes Gateway startup errors that report a corrupt state database without saying which file is affected. The error now includes the path alongside the original reason.
  [#177590](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177590) · [6fb9c2e3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6fb9c2e3912ec85a7c2e5bdcd031db1cce234c60) · [Reported in #177440](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177440). Thanks to [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@patelmm79](https://github.com/patelmm79).
- Fixes an update recovery capture being left unsealed for a PostgreSQL Workboard store when the updater can obtain exclusive access. The fix applies when the installed updater contains it.
  Before Doctor runs, the updater observes its recorded database writes. Update status reads history and recovery outcomes from the configured database engine. [PostgreSQL update recovery #187217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187217) · [Report #187155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187155) · [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) for the report.
- Stops Gateway restarts waiting on worker pairing and presence checks, applies the shutdown deadline to remote computer sessions, and clears finished agent work even if its final reply cannot be delivered and cleanup reports an error after completing. Background checks pause while the Gateway is suspended and resume at the next scheduled check. [Gateway restart and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)
  [#177756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177756) · [bf105d1b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bf105d1bf296021e38f61357fde7bd119656521c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Doctor’s Gateway health and heartbeat checks from creating a primary device identity on an empty or node-only store. Doctor also reports when the Gateway is reachable but the current connection lacks read access. [Doctor recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/doctor/recovery.md)
  [#177843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177843) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates that need SQLite schema repair stopping because Doctor rejected its own earlier maintenance writes. The repair preserves rollback eligibility for those writes and still checks for unrelated changes.
  [#177844](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177844) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents source-checkout updates from failing a validation check just because pnpm installs dependencies in a different location. Also fixes updates refusing a checkout with a verified nested Git worktree, which is left out of the update without touching its files.
  [#177934](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177934) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps dependency patches in candidate installs and refreshes bundled plugin links after the final install in a source checkout. Preflight warns and continues when a declared optional dependency’s link target is missing. These changes take effect once the installed updater includes them. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#177936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177936) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Reports the affected launcher and any retained backup path when a package update cannot restore a launcher during rollback. The diagnostic is available when 11.5 drives the update. [Rollback and recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/rollback-and-recovery)
  [#177991](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177991) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes updates counting the same SQLite database twice when a state path is reached through a symlink.
  [#178005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178005) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops the macOS directory watcher from lingering after a Gateway running on Node.js exits. [Running a foreground Gateway](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/gateway/running.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178052">#178052</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0dc6b7fcd6fa70cb654f5cbebc070fc1d7a7960e">0dc6b7fc</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the Gateway from taking over a state lock when it can’t verify that the previous owner is gone. On local SQLite, if the lock remains after you’ve confirmed the previous Gateway is stopped, run `openclaw gateway recover-lock` in the same state and profile context and follow the confirmation it prints. [Gateway lock recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/gateway-lock.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178076">#178076</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/edea1190b7760cad5b0c8ee4693000517ffb512c">edea1190</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174895">#174895</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@chenguoshun1979](https://github.com/ChenGuoShun1979) for the related report.
- Fixes the immutable updater holding a valid update for recovery when an automatic settings migration has no audit record. The updater checks for additive changes that preserve protected policy. This check no longer uses audit records to identify who made each addition. [Immutable updates](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/reference/team-immutable-update-design.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178097">#178097</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/01264a1e04a1164529e758d1531b7da4e91df0b2">01264a1e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Gateway reporting a successful shutdown while it and background Claude CLI processes were still running after a Claude session finished. [CLI backends](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/gateway/cli-backends.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178100">#178100</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3fceb15ea5a45ce2d08e148a4289bdf0bd29e6e4">3fceb15e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway startup failing on a read-only SQLite state database when the account running it owns the file and can make it writable. If storage remains unwritable, is full or cannot be accessed, the startup error identifies the path and what to check. [Gateway startup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/gateway/running.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178107">#178107</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2a8b77fa5c4403522233a231ab7c1f5aa0119dfe">2a8b77fa</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving unused updater files or runtimes behind after the systemd user manager restarts or an unrelated helper’s working directory cannot be read. Doctor clears files it can confirm are unused. [Update recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/install/updating.md)
  [Systemd restart cleanup #178117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178117) · [commit 79506514](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79506514289f3d51342af165dc0f6f9c0638a40b) · [issue #177876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177876) · [Runtime cleanup #178278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178278) · [commit 9e9e1bf](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e9e1bf108212249f3d56cce2a2bc371222309de) · [Doctor checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks) · [issue #178189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178189). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@sunlit-deng](https://github.com/sunlit-deng) for the first fix, [@warhangel](https://github.com/Warhangel) for the report and [@holny](https://github.com/holny) for the diagnosis, and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the runtime cleanup fix and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for its report.
- Moves the running updater’s temporary copy to the directory set by `TMPDIR` when that directory is outside the installation being replaced. The updater warns and skips the optional recovery copy before writing it if the known files won’t fit beside the state directory. These changes apply when the installed updater contains the fix.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178135">#178135</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/37b1bc4a99923205ca79959104d5a3a77864671a">37b1bc4a</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177707">#177707</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@donniefi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) for the report.
- Fixes Doctor’s SQLite migration skipping valid legacy conversations whose transcript filenames no longer match their session IDs. Doctor warns about the mismatch and preserves the original files. If different histories claim the same session ID, it leaves them untouched. [Doctor SQLite maintenance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178146">#178146</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fd566f2a968b27d1ba500c4127e3470f5f2aba76">fd566f2a</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177987">#177987</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@zouxiaoyu58-hue](https://github.com/zouxiaoyu58-hue) for the report.
- Makes `openclaw doctor` name the state file or directory it cannot write and explain how to fix it. It repairs eligible read-only state files Doctor owns and can use writable shared storage even when changing its permissions fails.
  [#178178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178178) · [commit 11ad47f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/11ad47f0ea868e86771bce3849ef9a016a9a979d) · [Doctor storage diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw update repair` staying blocked when it can verify that the abandoned update came from before a reboot or that a process holding up repair is unrelated. If an abandoned update is blocking you on Windows, reboot and run `openclaw update repair` from a version with this fix.
  [#178184](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178184) · [commit d266254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2662541b286ba05249add33c6e14f3dfd41d179) · [Windows update recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · [issue #177867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177867) · [issue #173430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173430). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@karljamoralin](https://github.com/karljamoralin) for the reports.
- Fixes OpenClaw failing to confirm a scheduled Gateway restart on Windows when a path used to launch the Gateway contains a curly apostrophe.
  [#178215](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178215) · [commit f7968d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7968d7f0f9a7e36a608bbfc9abf1ea3a105c464). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Windows CLI commands and portable workers being blocked from their own OpenClaw state when Windows cannot report its last boot time.
  [#178229](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178229) · [commit f5275a2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f5275a26109a35a66c5e937389a856d6444cc93e) · [Gateway lock and state access](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Doctor from reporting a migration problem for a valid SQLite state database that still holds retired data and is missing a column created on first use. Moving the database to PostgreSQL checks the full layout and fills in first-use columns on a private copy.
  [#178230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178230) · [commit c29f3bc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c29f3bca4c65c397fccb82e8459cf61c45c98df5). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops updates and Doctor from warning that backup coverage is unknown for Codex and Voice Call migrations. New update recovery backups also include legacy Codex thread bindings when they’re present.
  [#178286](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178286) · [commit 2e41793](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2e41793e3ef693c57486e0cf6b356c7c72c872d5) · [Doctor state migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations) · [issue #178121](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178121) · [issue #178122](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178122). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@mnowrot](https://github.com/mnowrot) for the reports.
- Fixes confirmed abandoned update repairs still showing as active after a retry starts maintenance, even if that maintenance later fails. `openclaw update status` also shows `repairing` while a standalone repair is running maintenance.
  [#178292](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178292) · [commit 68603ba](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/68603baa2c1ef5d4d368199f47072a8a7fb371dc) · [Update repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · [issue #178177](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178177). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@jirboy](https://github.com/JIRBOY) for the report.
- Fixes Gateway startup giving up while another process briefly holds the SQLite write lock during worker recovery. The Gateway retries for a limited time. If the lock persists, run `openclaw doctor` or `openclaw gateway status --deep` to diagnose it.
  [#178326](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178326) · [commit 73dc02d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/73dc02db0a8a2993d916eb4e8de1896c6e337b2b) · [Gateway startup troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/running) · [issue #178255](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178255). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@jasonftl](https://github.com/jasonftl) for the report.
- Fixes historical conversations staying unavailable to search after an unchanged archive registry is copied back to its original location. If the copy is on the same device and retains its original modification time, `openclaw doctor --session-sqlite recover` can recover eligible history while keeping the archive and current session settings. [SQLite maintenance guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance)
  [#178668](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178668) · [`e4babdd`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e4babdd4816dad31b0cf3c30aa353dfaa45d661f) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@Aldubai78](https://github.com/Aldubai78) for the report.
- Fixes an update failure where the 2026.10.4 updater could reject a valid client credential store after activating the new version. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#178686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178686) · [`2f2e606`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f2e6068d5d4024e5f0025010328129fac30fb37) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the report.
- Fixes updates stopping over stale command-approval socket information even though the saved settings were valid. The migration keeps the saved settings and approval rules.
  [#178688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178688) · [`a368032`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a368032f727dbacbb98774aa0bd844ab8bd493e0) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the report.
- Keeps the reason in saved and shared update reports when a migration stops over invalid local client socket credentials, while keeping private paths and credential values out of the report. [Update status and history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history)
  [#178689](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178689) · [`097a2f7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/097a2f70d0c4ea0751346d5b50dd7d677744fa74) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the diagnosis fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the related migration report.
- Fixes Gateway or node-host startup getting blocked when Doctor missed a saved node or share-extension identity. Doctor repair imports those identities and preserves valid keys. [Doctor state and sessions guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  [#178687](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178687) · [`05ade6d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/05ade6d2df13f660e9df17cbedaeba5eb9f93dfc) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph) for the node identity report.
- Stops Doctor from making another archive each time the same already-migrated sign-in file reappears. Doctor reuses a verified copy when one exists and still saves a fresh archive if it cannot verify an existing one. [Doctor state migrations](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/doctor/state-migrations.md)
  [#178736](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178736) · [`8496db7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8496db795978e95001800d7971778357ed990054) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt) and [@patelmm79](https://github.com/patelmm79).
- Replaces the generic Windows Gateway launcher error in JSON status and update warnings with the rejected line number and the rule it broke. The launcher contents stay private. If you need OpenClaw to inspect the launcher, check the indicated line and use literal values and a single Gateway command. [Windows launcher guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/windows)
  [#178696](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178696) · [`ee85bcb`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee85bcb3feae995717458e94e379ab33ec5a31f4) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@homeworld520](https://github.com/homeworld520) for the report.
- Adds a warning to update reports and history when your `--timeout` gives the new version less time to pass its checks than OpenClaw would normally allow. The warning shows both limits and keeps your deadline in force. It applies to subsequent updates once this version is installed. [Update command guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update.md)
  [#178702](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178702) · [`e99ca01`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e99ca016a45fcd503de91eea9e992374fa3a1039) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@yxshee](https://github.com/yxshee) for the change, [@hawkit](https://github.com/hawkit) for the report and [@ArthurNie](https://github.com/ArthurNie) for the large-state example.
- Fixes a Windows case where an old agent database lock could keep Doctor from running after a reboot. Doctor can clear and report a legacy lock recorded more than five minutes before the current boot. If the database still appears busy, stop the Gateway and other OpenClaw processes or reboot, then retry `openclaw doctor --fix`. [Doctor recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/recovery.md)
  [#178703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178703) · [`f1a05b0`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f1a05b0de1508912499beaedcbfcc28e5f541918) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) for the report and [@User59861](https://github.com/User59861) for the additional reproduction.
- Fixes Doctor and update cleanup on macOS stopping all process checks when one process’s environment can’t be read. OpenClaw checks the rest and still keeps any older runtimes that process might be using.
  [#178705](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178705) · [`4797b07`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4797b0792f7887c6cbfb41d3ddb505a85d01f32d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Mac app repeating an already completed update repair on launch and stopping the Gateway again just because the repair reported a warning. The repair command’s JSON output also distinguishes completed core work from work that still needs a retry. [Update repair guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/repair-and-recovery.md)
  [#178707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178707) · [`35008f6`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/35008f6988895d9901e0a0166633236b7ba514b5) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z) for the fix, [@dselz](https://github.com/dselz) for the report, [@printbyme](https://github.com/printbyme) for the investigation and [@bbn-pixel](https://github.com/bbn-pixel) for the completion result proposal.
- Fixes Doctor, Gateway status and update status flagging recognized systemd settings or valid application metadata as unknown. Warnings still identify misspelled settings and settings in the wrong section. When the service manager is unavailable, the fallback health check reads settings from the relevant unit sections. [Gateway service checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  [Systemd settings #178759](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178759) · [issue and corroborating report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161977) · [commit e213fdbe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e213fdbeef1c81e5c44b0ed6bf6d9f94346188db) · [Service metadata #180143](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180143) · [commit c234ee3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c234ee3561a2ca46b6b847efbb129ffb1e8d46a9). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kohjunhao](https://github.com/kohjunhao), [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault) and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini).
- Fixes Linux Gateways getting stuck on shutdown during a restart under nested process supervision.
  [#178786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178786). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Linux worker cleanup failure that could happen when an unrelated process exited at the same time. That failure could also get in the way of resuming the service or running Doctor after an update.
  [#178883](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178883). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the package updater from using a saved runtime for rollback if a replaced file fails verification. The updater warns and continues, with the separate verified package backup available for recovery.
  <span>[#179051](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179051) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal) · [How updates run](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run)</span>
- Fixes **Update now**, update retries and the sidebar’s **Review update** button acting on out-of-date state after the page or view changes.
  [Update actions #179078](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179078) · [Review update #179084](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179084) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Updates page losing progress or getting stuck while loading a confirmation, checking update status, previewing or submitting a failure report, holding an update, or changing automatic updates. **Hold 1 h** is disabled while the request is pending, and you can retry a declined hold, failed confirmation or failed device setting save. The Mac app keeps the automatic-update choice visible while it saves.
  [Hold feedback #179422](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179422) · [Update settings feedback #179595](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179595) · [commit eb07b2a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eb07b2a38e26052cad79aac3cbe8058399310871) · [Settings progress #179911](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179911) · [commit ce8a2eb9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ce8a2eb9bf4a807d0aa8a59da49c5ac391c62d2c) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git-based updates hiding the original failure when cleanup also goes wrong. The update report keeps the original error and the recovery result, with ordinary cleanup problems shown separately as warnings. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#179095](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179095), [`bc62613`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bc6261307f43903e0d92ebb9e9bc83850a2cf385), [Issue #178656](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178656). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes foreground Gateway updates being marked failed or abandoned after activating the new build, before the replacement Gateway can verify startup. If the replacement never starts, use `openclaw update repair` to recover the abandoned handoff. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#179209](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179209), [`6f60774`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f60774dcb9d3bad23c12c1250c34f61244da6d4). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces the risk of running out of memory when building or updating OpenClaw from source on a machine with limited RAM. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#179140](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179140), [`8816945`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8816945e4a1cc73d90c4f2d7e5486b0cce99ecc8). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git-based updates and dry runs giving up after a temporary download failure. They retry eligible failures once, and cancelling a dry run while it waits stops the retry. An older updater may still need a manual retry before this fix is installed. [How updates run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/how-updates-run.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179440">#179440</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec437b3c9580ce53fa86523d7ee731b488458e88">Released commit</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/duyufansh2008">@duyufansh2008</a>.
- Adds a migration check to the source-server updater before it stops the Gateway or replaces the running installation. If the check refuses the update or cannot run, the Gateway stays up. The check applies when the installed updater includes it. Address the reported problem before retrying. [Source update methods](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/updating/update-methods.md)
  [#179673](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179673) · [cffdc96](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cffdc96369474e6f2c28f0a3273abba2e16bc50b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents unrelated plugin databases from blocking Gateway recovery after a failed update that migrated core state. This applies when recovery runs through the updated updater.
  [#179552](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179552) · [c6ebd32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c6ebd32d684340308b2258529a17b67254a3be30) · Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes Doctor running a quick check instead of the requested full integrity check during legacy-state migration. The full check can catch and repair database index damage that the quick check could miss.
  [#179483](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179483) · [fa2fd0c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fa2fd0ca7702e0b349decb8ab36cc69a4123f60b) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xydigitLybnnnn](https://github.com/xydigitLybnnnn) for co-authoring.
- Fixes [Claude migration](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/migrating-claude) reporting success after skipping unreadable skills, and prevents Claude Code and Desktop imports from changing settings when source JSON contains invalid UTF-8. Migration stops before importing when skills are unreadable, and leaves OpenClaw settings unchanged when a source file has invalid UTF-8. It names the affected folder or file so you can restore access or re-save it before retrying.
  [Unreadable skills #179468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179468) · [commit 1e48ec3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1e48ec3a9e3fb2cb9dc5e714582af998a93cc1f4) · [UTF-8 settings #180268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180268) · [commit 9905a69](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9905a699e2d63732a49fdcf3ccb45bcf5f1c7971).
