Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).
- Adds a warning in Doctor and Gateway status when a short Linux systemd timeout can stop the Gateway before it finishes shutting down. If it warns about the user manager, follow the [Linux systemd guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/linux#gateway-service-systemd) to adjust the host timeout.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179749">#179749</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d0fc03b08d273afc8c6a2c4bd661f484d4915e70">d0fc03b0</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177777">#177777</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).</span>
- Fixes `openclaw update cleanup` treating sealed recovery copies with no matching update run as unrecognized. It lists them as protected orphan captures with their creation times. Ordinary cleanup leaves them alone, and retiring one requires opting in by its exact path. [Update cleanup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179789">#179789</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174202">#174202</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74c642792f4f0b0d36f2ab23daed762b9b889080">74c64279</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b7940222e3b0827580de712372ac87fd3f87d871">#181195 follow-up</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Navras98](https://github.com/Navras98) and Andrea Sforna.</span>
- Prevents `openclaw doctor --fix` from rewriting legacy plugin manifests it can’t read as UTF-8. Doctor leaves those files unchanged, reports their paths, and continues repairing valid manifests. If Doctor skips a file, [preserve the original and convert a copy to UTF-8 before retrying](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks).
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179798">#179798</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174267">#174267</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).</span>
- Fixes a recovery error when an update completion message already in chat no longer matches the recorded result. The original message stays in chat, and Settings → Updates shows the current result. Stops retrying update milestones that have no eligible destination. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179806">#179806</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161863">#161863</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178461">#178461</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/170600">#170600</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z), [@duyufansh2008](https://github.com/duyufansh2008) and [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault) for reporting it.</span>
- Corrects `openclaw update status --help` and the [status reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) to show the existing 30-second limit for update checks.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179807">#179807</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175694">#175694</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@yxshee](https://github.com/yxshee).</span>
- Fixes update inspection progress going quiet after its output is temporarily blocked. Once it can print again, later progress and the notice that some output was omitted can still appear. The change takes effect with the updated inspection worker.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179874">#179874</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/161043">#161043</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161042">#161042</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@creanet-64](https://github.com/creanet-64).</span>
- Stops managed macOS Gateway and node services from trusting an outdated certificate bundle alongside macOS system trust. Updates try to carry over eligible private certificates and keep separately configured bundles. If a private HTTPS or WSS connection stops working after updating, [configure a maintained certificate bundle and reinstall the affected service](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).
  [Certificate trust #179898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179898) · [commit 502c6f51](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/502c6f514fb783d1b8d70a4736c2c5a9e9563e92) · Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes managed macOS service updates missing a changed Node path when the selected runtime is recognized. If the updater rejects the runtime, select a supported Node version before retrying.
  [Node path #179898](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179898) · [commit 502c6f51](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/502c6f514fb783d1b8d70a4736c2c5a9e9563e92) · Thanks [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) and [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes Doctor flagging configured models as missing when the selected Gateway already lists them. Offline checks and genuine Gateway warnings still apply. [Running Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179907">#179907</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a5d689c1a7451adad2f4d91512cbef4ddbd8dcf">commit 4a5d689c</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/157010">issue #157010</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xilopaint](https://github.com/xilopaint), [@Olli0103](https://github.com/Olli0103).
- Stops Doctor from passing malformed direct-message policies or allowlists to channel plugins when checking your configuration.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180072">#180072</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bc9e050a2864c89bc47b4fc0a303f3ce3cc1e806">commit bc9e050a</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a credential migration that could stop Doctor during repairs or updates when an older SQLite database contains statistics the current SQLite version can’t recreate. On retry, Doctor keeps the original rollback backup and refuses to use it if the saved credentials no longer match. [Database migrations and backups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179969">#179969</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7be1bee9e35651e471d94ee238461ba424a590dd">commit 7be1bee9</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178584">issue #178584</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@HeZ2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z), [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Fixes a case where `openclaw doctor --fix` kept warning about older session media after a database version upgrade without completing the repair. Doctor can also finish repairs on readable databases when another database still cannot be read.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180005">#180005</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/697ed2c341bf3181f6495dfb082f52ee4635b7db">commit 697ed2c3</a>. Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes successful package updates deleting database recovery copies after Doctor has said they need to be kept for manual recovery. The updater that starts the update must already include the fix.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180010">#180010</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1d59169ef8b2e68ea86b7f291824c16502e419a8">commit 1d59169e</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170335">issue #170335</a>. Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes updates and repairs that could fail at the end or stay marked as running when another process temporarily held the state database. OpenClaw honors the full wait it allowed for finishing them.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180047">#180047</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/81c7f82f4ef5f5a4ad2b2193adafb517bb23303c">commit 81c7f82f</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization).
- Fixes the Android and Termux updater mistaking unchanged plugin files for modified ones and refusing the update. If an older updater reports “Plugin entry changed after snapshot inventory” for unchanged files, use the [manual update method](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods) for your installation, with a verified backup and the Gateway stopped during replacement.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179983">#179983</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f244099124e1e70b78a3150d049618b3098343b5">commit f2440991</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@yxshee](https://github.com/yxshee).
- Fixes Gateway restart diagnostics incorrectly ruling out the Gateway as the owner of a port just because SSH appears in a folder name or command argument.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180033">#180033</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3282fda7943c9fdd7a6778289521cbfc1bd048db">commit 3282fda7</a>. Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes Doctor checking the wrong model and tool rules when your primary model is set with an alias. Doctor also stops flagging a scheduled job as using a different model when its setting and the default resolve to the same model through global aliases. [Doctor model checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@KrasimirKralev](https://github.com/KrasimirKralev). [#180234](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180234) · [commit 8f6e418](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f6e418cc4ea1f466f895d97806639adc9d6f7c3)
- Stops Doctor’s workspace check from throwing “No agents configured” when the agent list is explicitly empty. Configuration validation still requires at least one agent. [Doctor workspace checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/checks)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee). [#180284](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180284) · [commit 71a8363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/71a8363f9606889228d7562fe9ac74c7a2f13d29)
- Prevents Doctor from importing garbled legacy auth profiles, configuration health records, retired runtime data or cron job stores containing invalid UTF-8. It warns about unreadable data and keeps the original or a recovery copy. If Doctor names a damaged JSON file, restore it from a verified backup before retrying `openclaw doctor --fix`. [Doctor state recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions)
  [Legacy JSON #180281](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180281) · [commit 534b91e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/534b91ef33d1e6c1c36e9ba7b64fcebb0aa3d85a) · [Legacy imports #180861](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180861) · [commit bb41c47](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb41c47d7736fa04592a80c5e59826623ede2046) · [Doctor state migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666) and [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen).
- Fixes named-profile node installs targeting the default service and commands started by a node service falling back to the default profile. Use the same `--profile` for node status and service commands. Nodes already installed under the default service name stay under default-profile management. [Node host service commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/node-host)
  [Node installs #180288](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180288) · [commit 082eef8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/082eef88b6dba679abe3492a6159f27195185502) · [Node service commands #180951](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180951). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@MertBasar0](https://github.com/MertBasar0) for node installs, and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) for the command fix.
- Fixes memory migrations that could make little progress during an update or a Doctor run when maintenance checks took too long. The fix applies when the update candidate or installed Doctor contains it. [Updating guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180469">PR #180469</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/57551af25bbf0501a352d25c28a5cda5ade7beba">Commit 57551af</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/166066">Earlier contribution #166066</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@keenranger](https://github.com/keenranger).</span>
- Separates the Mac app’s **Check for Updates…** button from **Update Gateway…**. When no Gateway update is known, Settings warns that continuing can reinstall the current version and restart the Gateway, which can interrupt sessions and disconnect the Control UI. [Settings → Updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/settings#updates)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180479">PR #180479</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e39433dfdab333223c9b2cf4c0d6f402a5c33808">Commit e39433d</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169383">Issue #169383</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171129">Earlier contribution #171129</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@chelsealong](https://github.com/chelsealong) and [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen) for the report.</span>
- Prevents Doctor repair runs from repeating a finished legacy-state scan when the configuration and plugin inventory haven’t changed. If Doctor needs to scan again, it avoids repeating the notices and warnings it already printed. [Doctor state migrations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations)
  Thanks to steipete and MertBasar0. [#180576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180576) · [48fcb8b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/48fcb8be111ca6282fbfff373a3dffc2d0bb1a60)
- Changes how the 11.5 updater handles a registry package whose Node requirement the Gateway service’s selected Node cannot meet. It refuses before installation, even if a compatible Node is installed elsewhere. If you see this refusal, update the Node selected by the service before retrying. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#180769](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180769) · [commit 3755040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/37550409085cf78e3bf059f4de5e1cb5b05d943d) · [#180636](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180636) · [#180701](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180701) · [#180707](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180707) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and reporters [@sglion777](https://github.com/sglion777), [@Almost-Certified-ops](https://github.com/Almost-Certified-ops) and [@billpang1-sketch](https://github.com/billpang1-sketch).
- Fixes managed-update reports saying recovery was unknown after a refused update even when the result was recorded. The report keeps the result, whether the existing Gateway was healthy or recovery failed.
  [#180777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180777) · [commit df387ce](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df387ceebf6920d0abc59db33bc0a2c10d2f2c21) · [#180739](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180739) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).
- Stops repeated standalone `openclaw doctor --fix` runs from leaving duplicate recovery copies when Doctor can verify that your state hasn’t changed. It still takes a fresh copy if it can’t verify a match or you request a full integrity check.
  [#181025](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181025) · [Doctor recovery copies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev), [@jsy](https://github.com/jsy), [@8bitsforge](https://github.com/8bitsforge), [@BjoernSchotte](https://github.com/BjoernSchotte).
- Adds a warning when the updater proceeds without an original-state snapshot because there wasn’t enough disk space. The warning shows how much space was needed and how much was available. The warning appears when the update is run from an updater that already includes this change.
  [#181195](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181195) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b7940222e3b0827580de712372ac87fd3f87d871)). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes [managed update reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) that said the update couldn’t start without telling you why. When startup error details are available, the report shows them with sensitive values removed. This depends on the updater you’re already running.
  [#181402](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181402) · [Report #181337](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181337) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@Chengmun58](https://github.com/Chengmun58) for the report.
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --fix` leaving obsolete usage-cost cache entries behind and showing database ownership warnings even for clean stores. Current usage data and session history are preserved.
  [#181415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181415) · [Report #181361](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/181361) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@beru-ant-king](https://github.com/beru-ant-king) for the report.
- Prevents Claude migrations from hanging on named pipes. Migration skips unreadable optional settings and rejects special-file instruction or command inputs before writing or backing up the affected item’s destination. Restore a regular source file and retry the migration. [Claude migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/migrating-claude)
  Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#181752](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181752) · [`372c6fa`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/372c6fa46bf2c6c828a0bdfaf414c238cd00c04d)
- Fixes the `openclaw` command not being found in a fresh zsh after a [Unix install](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer) when you’ve exported a custom `ZDOTDIR` inside your home directory. The standalone CLI installer also fixes npm’s install path in the right zsh profile when that profile already exists.
  [#186157](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186157) · [Commit 31fbc109](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/31fbc1099605ff53ee82d57599216e6a6855acf1) · [Issue #163569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/163569) · [Original proposal #163570](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/163570) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii) for the report and original fix proposal.
- Fixes npm installations that appeared to succeed but left the Gateway unable to start because a required Anthropic SDK dependency was missing.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182168) · [`e3d39628`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e3d396280fc8bb99646edd83b7aa09c48988b18b)
- Fixes selected external plugins such as `memory-lancedb` failing to load their dependencies in [source-built Docker images](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/docker). The build now stops and reports conflicting dependency versions.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183080">#183080</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80ee015d2a4c4748b4f4ecb14d7063617390c459">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/shakkernerd">@shakkernerd</a>.
- Corrects the Nix installation guide for macOS. The Gateway service doesn’t search your Nix profiles automatically, and the guide explains how to make Nix-installed tools available through a service wrapper, absolute executable paths where supported, or Home Manager’s `runtimePackages`.
  [#185048](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185048) · [Nix installation guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/nix) · [63f9c11](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/63f9c1166ebddf9f9e90295e7189aeae6d98b280) · Thanks [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).
- Fixes a build error that could stop OpenClaw builds or updates from source. CI now checks the affected build step before building the runtime so it can catch similar errors earlier.
  [#185050](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185050) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes onboarding giving up on opening the dashboard after one temporary timeout. Onboarding and `openclaw dashboard` show a waiting message while retrying within the usual time limit.
  [#183713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183713). Thanks to [@LiuwqGit](https://github.com/LiuwqGit) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183682). Thanks to [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes updates stopping during SQLite migration when a read-only check is mistaken for a database write. The repair is in the version being installed, and migration can still stop if SQLite records a write. [How updates preserve SQLite state](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).
  Thanks to steipete. [#182032](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182032) · [237fdc662d90](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/237fdc662d90d216a8693fa6b9178afc0cbc54d6)
- Fixes Git and package updates getting partway through before reporting too little room for database backups or rollback. Once the fixed updater is installed, it stops before staging when it detects a shortfall and tells you how much space is needed and available.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183177">#183177</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8738c093be6ef3ae0dab93fb3dbe804764e84c60">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/update-methods">Update methods</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183091">Issue #183091</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and <a href="https://github.com/etzelm">@etzelm</a>.
- Fixes native updates where Doctor could stop after the plugin stage and leave deferred plugin migrations or model retirement unfinished. Both the installed updater and the version being installed need the fix. Avoid direct writes outside OpenClaw to databases the update touches. Automatic rollback can discard those writes. [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  [#185789](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185789) · [`db37496`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db37496952a4a42e84853ac1111c97458d25a267) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes updates aborting on some failures to save a copy of the running updater. When the native recovery helper is safely in place and the update can continue, the updater warns that it could not keep a verified copy for rollback. If your installed updater still stops at this step, the failure occurs before 11.5 can take over. Follow [update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update#runtime-retention-failures) before retrying.
  [#185178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185178) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes a verification error that could block [updates from the Control UI or chat](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run) for a foreground Gateway in Termux. Android still needs to let OpenClaw verify the running process, and unattended updates still require a managed service.
  [#186223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186223) · [Commit 0a6415be](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a6415bed1d795f68903758c03e6f18c6a9e491c) · [Issue #165296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/165296) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@tei8206](https://github.com/tei8206) for the report.
- Fixes [native updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) timing out on a healthy check when a slow snapshot or Doctor check left too little time to finish. The fix has to be in the OpenClaw installation running the update, and an explicit `--timeout` still limits the whole update.
  [#186139](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186139) · [Commit 8f2190bb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8f2190bb63cc8ff1cafceffbf1bb429232c1ad5d) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Keeps a short-lived file lock from immediately rolling back a Windows npm-global update. If the lock persists, the update still stops and tells you to close processes using the installation. This applies once the installed updater includes the fix.
  [#186221](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186221) · [Commit 81d49158](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/81d4915836b36c11452999e52b5d628a0123f0c0) · [Issue #178004](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178004) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Sigma711](https://github.com/Sigma711) for the report.
- Fixes Git updates aborting during the recovery database backup when `.artifacts` is symlinked, including to another volume. This backup runs before the new version is installed, so the updater already on your machine needs the fix.
  [#185680](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185680) · [aaa0f43](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aaa0f434e956cb25684d107a1815535fd6d683f0) · [Updating Git installs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents a hidden Corepack prompt during pnpm detection from stalling `openclaw update` on npm-global installations when using the 11.5 updater.
  [#185828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185828) · [`fa8b379`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fa8b3796fa4c01c4fee270e62f85a7d10e689a97) · [Issue #185807](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185807) · Thanks [@Yuaneen](https://github.com/Yuaneen) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) for reporting the issue
- Fixes `openclaw update` failing on npm-global installs when your shell uses an older Node version even though the managed Gateway service has a compatible one. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185966">#185966</a> · Thanks to [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar), [@donniefi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes a native update failure that could stop the final Doctor check and leave model retirement unfinished. This applies when the updater running the update includes the fix.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185977">#185977</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes an update failure while preserving very large dependency trees, such as those in some pnpm global virtual store installations. This applies to updates run with the 11.5 updater.
  [#184958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184958) · [5fa9dba0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fa9dba026063bf4e4301ba052300b4ba303bec8). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents system clock changes from cutting short a healthy state snapshot or inspection, or making a stalled one wait longer than intended, when updating with the 11.5 updater.
  [Update guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update) · [#184288](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184288) · [e8c9e71](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8c9e71fc9db7c3aed9d28e7ab000a7f384e12f6). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes update rehearsals checking the wrong set of scheduled jobs when an installation uses a custom config path and its database still holds both sets. The rehearsal uses the installation’s own jobs in the rehearsal copy.
  [#184905](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184905) · [25981341](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/259813419cabb33e651fff2c75678d10c3fe96cb). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes a misleading service-inspection warning on Linux with systemd 245 when an update dry run finds no Gateway service installed.
  [#184505](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184505) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a920c0eaad35eead836134f18c6e77a42879c9a) · Thanks to [@guhyun9454](https://github.com/guhyun9454) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Moves optional database checks out of the Gateway restart window on updates that can run them after the Gateway is ready. Their findings still appear in the update report.
  [#184527](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184527) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2c9649d16e998c3d59c4029b495859f69e4c41c0) · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Stops superseded update checks from sending further Gateway credentials or readiness requests.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182343">#182343</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes native updates reporting failure after a healthy Gateway restart when the old and new versions use different protocols. The installed updater must already contain this fix, and a successful update can still show a protocol warning. [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182399">#182399</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops malformed update handoffs before Doctor or post-update maintenance runs. The updater gives a clearer recovery error when it receives invalid update ownership information.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182296">#182296</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes update history and failure reports hiding why OpenClaw refused an update repair. If the repair was refused because it started inside the Gateway, run `openclaw update repair` from a terminal outside it. [Repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@coygeek](https://github.com/coygeek). [#182103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182103) · [`1fead915`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1fead915921e307018bdb7b8d2a2e7d80c9d8d4a)
- Fixes Doctor and update repair on Windows warning that the Gateway was not ready while it was still starting. Restoring the Gateway now allows the same default startup time as starting or restarting it normally.
  [How updates run](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/how-updates-run). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@Rene-F](https://github.com/Rene-F). [#182146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182146) · [`071f27c2`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/071f27c2b58ce383e1a70f71b6fec66461261cb8)
- Fixes cancelled macOS updates that could leave later updates blocked even after repair reported success. On versions with the fix, `openclaw update repair` can clear abandoned updates while newer, unrelated OpenClaw processes stay running. Repair refuses to clear an update if its work might still be active.
  [#185002](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185002) · [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes failed updates leaving recovery copies protected indefinitely when OpenClaw can verify the update never reached repair or activation. OpenClaw tries to remove those copies automatically. If an eligible copy remains, `openclaw update status` flags it as stale and points you to `openclaw update cleanup`.
  [#185223](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185223) · [a9c4f63](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a9c4f63472f6b0ae132ef836aa4eb29d73e49a76). [Update repair and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Stops old migration backups from piling up after failed or recovered Team deployments. Adopt both components of the updated controller to get cleanup of eligible earlier backups during release pruning. Backup cleanup runs only when there is no activation journal and keeps backups that may still be needed for recovery. The next eligible prune ends the saved retry window for a failed `update finish`.
  [#185600](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185600) · [9242bf5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9242bf5778642e156505d5589e862c5c464064b1) · [Team deployment controller guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes ordinary system processes on macOS 27 being mistaken for blockers during Doctor cleanup, update repair and update finalization.
  [#185342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185342) · [a9e413e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a9e413e9ed652b1259d77bc9de19880df711be47). [Report #183957](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183957). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the repair and [@cmanrav](https://github.com/cmanrav) for the report.
- Fixes macOS update recovery blaming a remote Gateway when it cannot inspect the Mac node’s launcher. Recovery points to the node’s LaunchAgent, leaves custom launchers intact, and checks the node when you retry after repairing its launcher.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183215">#183215</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d730d23ca94c494cdabdab9e92c6d4cd55737b29">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/updating.md">Update recovery guide</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183138">Issue #183138 reported by kqtxmaster-boop</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Doctor and updates on Windows being blocked by an expired legacy Gateway lock when OpenClaw can confirm its former owner has stopped.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182324">#182324</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Windows Doctor stopping original-state capture at a permissions check for an eligible, verified local drive-root ancestor. Capture still requires the existing safety checks to pass.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181872">#181872</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f74efc3695f88f8ce9f10eacb0783538e59db7e4">f74efc36</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180892">#180892</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and to <a href="https://github.com/WG-Mojo">@WG-Mojo</a> for reporting the Windows capture failure.</span>
- Fixes saved failure reports and diagnostic JSON omitting the intended update target when the run recorded it. Keeps shortened error excerpts from cutting words in half.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181906">#181906</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3483558acbfd50d5bfe9723e52b50b4480115230">3483558a</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/156112">#156112</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180310">#180310</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/155856">#155856</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> and to <a href="https://github.com/node-sketch">@node-sketch</a> for the Linux reproduction and diagnostics.</span>
- Fixes `openclaw update` timeouts that hid the last health-check error while waiting for the Gateway. When an error is available, the timeout message includes it alongside the operation that was interrupted.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182858](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182858) · [Updating OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating)
- Corrects `openclaw update --help` to explain that `--timeout` sets one time limit for the whole update.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182601](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182601) · [Update command reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update)
- Fixes overlapping recovery buttons after a failed update in Control UI Settings. On narrow screens, the labels stay readable and Retry update gets its own row.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185980">#185980</a> · Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman)
- Fixes valid Kubernetes reseeds and hand-edited `openclaw.json` files being replaced with older settings just because OpenClaw metadata was missing. When backup recovery does replace a config, the warning tells you where the original was saved and how to restore it.
  [#183703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183703). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Kubernetes reseed guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/kubernetes). [Kubernetes report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183641). Thanks to [@csabatatrai](https://github.com/csabatatrai). [hand-edited config report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/126806). Thanks to [@yetval](https://github.com/yetval).
- Fixes an agent database warning that called even an index rebuild an identity migration. The [PostgreSQL upgrade guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) explains the normal updater and the `openclaw doctor --fix` path with writers stopped.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183155">#183155</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b3a3924256efaecaae16f6baea661121c4837e6">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Replaces Doctor’s generic plugin migration conflict error with the step that failed, the plugins involved, and the names of the fields that changed. Doctor keeps the migration inputs available for retry. If another repair is still running, let it finish before retrying.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183222">#183222</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22cd584794efafce3b2df2f1f41ad7a8276fd847">Landed commit</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/doctor/config-migrations.md">Migration guidance</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180350">Issue #180350 reported by RomneyDa</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180350#issuecomment-6343165911">Linux fleet evidence from 609NFT</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt">@xiaopan-xydt</a> and <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes Doctor warnings that hid why a shared-state or agent database migration was refused. The warning shows the cause and any SQLite error code, with steps for recovering and retrying.
  [#183762](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183762). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [migration recovery steps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183731). Thanks to [@ausvald](https://github.com/ausvald).
- Fixes `openclaw doctor --non-interactive` refusing to check healthy transcript history while another agent is active. Transcript repairs still require stopping active writers.
  [#185838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185838) · [`d43865a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d43865a98aa7e7d066fb4885d8440bdb7641f549) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Clarifies update errors when a SQLite migration cannot be verified. The error names the database if it changed, and the restore warning explains what went wrong.
  [#184399](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184399). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor failing to clean up its temporary copy of session data during an update.
  [#184405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184405). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor stopping before it can upgrade an outdated PostgreSQL agent database and asking you to run the same repair again.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182456">PR #182456</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dfdb2c4bcbaf2b8fbf1be93c30dd0e1f28131006">dfdb2c4b</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes package update checks returning a missing-table error when inspecting legacy heartbeat tasks on a PostgreSQL-backed installation. Incomplete legacy tasks still block activation.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183645](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183645)
- Fixes Windows Scheduled Task stops that could force-close a PostgreSQL-backed Gateway without asking it to shut down cleanly first. The service can request a clean stop even if PostgreSQL is unreachable. The [PostgreSQL guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql#native-windows-qualification) records the tested service lifecycle, from installation through restart and data-preserving uninstall.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183632) · [#183634](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183634)
- Fixes a misleading database connection error at startup on PostgreSQL-backed Gateways with existing state. The error now identifies the invalid settings. If the message points to retired heartbeat settings, run `openclaw doctor --fix` before restarting.
  [#183000](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183000) · [0fc426ff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fc426ff388db0b99af08ce34a6916545810be28) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert). · [PostgreSQL startup guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) · [Issue #180686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180686)
- Fixes startup errors that misleadingly said an older agent database needed a session-identity migration. The error now shows the database version and the version OpenClaw needs. Warnings about skipped agent databases identify the path and the agent when known.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182288">#182288</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/jalehman">@jalehman</a>.
- Fixes agents staying unavailable when a brief SQLite database lock during startup clears in time for a retry. If the retries run out, OpenClaw tells you to close competing processes and [restart the Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/running).
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182446">PR #182446</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/84806d0adae0276f388de79e9726d21a7e5508a8">84806d0a</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).</span>
- Fixes multi-agent Gateways preparing a second copy of unchanged global plugins for agent workspaces at startup, reducing peak memory in setups that hit this duplication.
  [#184246](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184246) · [2dc1c65](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2dc1c658744e463e187da8d45451e91ed4b063ba). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes failures when verifying or restoring gzip backups or creating Claw, feature-plugin, and worker archives on runtimes with read-only built-ins. Existing archives remain compatible.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182432">PR #182432</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0c2b6e2b11c24b93fe2b7b15f0df9f0b412f2b7e">0c2b6e2b</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes ahead-of-time standalone builds failing to validate structured results from MCP tools. The repair also covers checks on plugin settings and the arguments models send to tools.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182856](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182856) · [MCP tools](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp)
- Fixes failures when publishing or restoring repositories, listing workspace files, reading workspace Git history, or capturing the shell environment in [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) and relocated installs. Fixes failures in runtime checks and package recovery in packaged installs.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183120">#183120</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fe0be1ae7477634479885e788d1e0b058f84905f">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes standalone startup incorrectly rejecting a supported SQLite runtime.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183120">#183120</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fe0be1ae7477634479885e788d1e0b058f84905f">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes standalone build IDs changing between builds with identical prepared inputs, even across different build directories. To verify byte-for-byte reproducibility, [compare executable hashes before timestamped signing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183179">#183179</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cacc2717861eb1ee81072e0f59d8e03f6f893a75">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Prevents experimental standalone builds compiled from TypeScript from reusing stale bundled-plugin caches when tracked source inputs change, even when the generated JavaScript stays the same.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183290">#183290</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a171cfb74891e3abce0fb8312e976323998b3654">a171cfb</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) failing when a bundled plugin uses a supported default index file without a package manifest or an explicit entry.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183326">#183326</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4dfd92bbda37dd05db97d93d773b342245c632be">4dfd92b</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Stops standalone builds from producing an incomplete executable when a required worker or helper module is missing. The build error names the missing entries.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183337">#183337</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f5727b9c61c2ba9dccc3c880d9115f02cb8652f">2f5727b</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes a pre-compilation failure in experimental standalone AOT builds caused by an obsolete capture requirement.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183377">#183377</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f3ab195038294f9b3ffb96f4f381752e580cdb4">2f3ab19</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes the standalone post-upgrade check incorrectly reporting healthy bundled plugins as missing.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183468">#183468</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/52faebcb6a97f73f477de65270cc541ed76080b2">52faebc</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint">Doctor lint</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes worker bundle delivery from standalone Gateways to paired nodes and a separate startup failure for downloaded workers on standalone installations.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183473">#183473</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44dd89b76ce56ef532bb6868b5d39c0dbbed7714">44dd89b</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone">Standalone installations</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes SQLite startup failures for portable workers in hardened macOS standalone builds. The startup check looks for bundled SQLite first and runs without loading project preloads or `.env` files.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183486">#183486</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7397050bdf9959d834e92eb3a8f6c243f9b61f9">f739705</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/bun-compatibility.md">Bun compatibility</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes command execution failing with a JIT error in portable standalone AOT workers. On macOS, the fix requires a [compatible worker bundle](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183626)
- Fixes startup failures in experimental Bun standalone builds that couldn’t load bundled functions. Fixes external CommonJS plugins in those builds seeing only the SDK’s default export and missing its named exports.
  [#184314](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184314) · [622215d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/622215d053bbe4c1ec3c6cdc4a386ccd27d5a844). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes experimental standalone builds from source stopping with a duplicate-entry error for the Codex catalog and session history workers.
  [#184381](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184381). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes standalone update checks, Doctor, recovery and database backups failing to start. It also restores managed MCP bridge launches, paired-node folder listings and archive downloads, and retired worktree cleanup. Standalone builds include browser MCP and remote repository setup scripts and background helpers for selected bundled plugins.
  [Standalone maintenance, certificates and helper programs #182405](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182405) · [MCP, paired-node files and worktree cleanup #182982](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182982) · [57f6d207](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/57f6d2076b092a1f4e057cbebf1d43577282b3bc) · [Standalone installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes downloaded plugins installing but failing to load in experimental standalone AOT builds, including after moving the installation. For builds compiled directly from TypeScript, the fixes cover on-demand dependencies and the bundled SDK. Strict code-generation policies can still block interpreted plugins. Build checks also find required parser dependencies, and Playwright workers compile in this mode.
  [Plugin loading #183472](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183472) · [25a70e7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25a70e7d1f0cdf4af26ea3fd54d4ba82801957f9) · [On-demand dependencies #183756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183756) · [Bundled SDK #183822](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183822) · [SDK and build checks #184155](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184155) · [b2e42c13232b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b2e42c13232b1a0949a01924da5965eba0c10f9e) · [Standalone installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes command-palette keyboard shortcuts failing inside embedded widgets in standalone builds compiled ahead of time.
  [#184134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184134) · [b0f321730dc1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b0f321730dc11f598d500323e22c64c45adbd1db) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a macOS hostname change blocking Gateway restarts, update preparation and read-only database checks on the same boot. It also fixes startup after a reboot with a different hostname when an earlier successful start recorded the Mac’s identity. If an older lock still blocks startup, use `openclaw gateway recover-lock` to inspect it and confirm recovery if appropriate. Gateway status and macOS readiness checks give clearer recovery guidance, and update messages distinguish ownership problems from configuration errors.
  [Same-boot maintenance #182271](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182271) · [Lock recovery and diagnostics #184277](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184277) · [798570b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/798570bc460f96d8321744be7bb99637d44a5b7d) · [Gateway lock recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/gateway-lock.md) · [Update troubleshooting](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for both fixes and [@coygeek](https://github.com/coygeek) for #182271.
- Fixes later updates getting blocked by a leftover record from an interrupted package update after the previous package and its launchers have been replaced. A dry run can check whether that record still blocks the update without changing the installation. If an older updater is already stuck on “Package publication journal does not match its installation,” manually install a package that includes the fix.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186355">#186355</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5c981ecd200ca6bc68bf58d6a11290f09efdb5fe">commit 5c981ec</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186314">issue #186314</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating">Manual package updating</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>, <a href="https://github.com/ichbinnishan">@ichbinnishan</a> (report).</span>
- Warns when your shell is using a different or older CLI than the Gateway installation, and extends Doctor’s protection against a newer CLI upgrading an older Gateway’s agent databases. Database-too-new errors also identify the version that wrote the data as newer than your Gateway when known. If the warning appears, use `openclaw update` or the CLI named for the Gateway installation.
  [Doctor protection #186971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186971) · [Split installation warning #196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@tomdailey55](https://github.com/tomdailey55), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes managed Node Gateway updates leaving the command-line installation behind when service overrides contain only named environment variables, and keeps [managed Gateway updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) pointed at the new installation after Doctor migrates runtime settings. Settings are preserved when the service moves or is restored after a failed update, and timed updates distinguish the service installation from the update target. The updater running the update must already include these fixes.
  [Service environment #196371](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196371) · [commit 7ac7a5ea](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7ac7a5ea14ab59ea9b534ac9d3a62fd1fd671f33) · [Doctor migration #196474](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196474) · [commit d8fe3b88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8fe3b88a1a95682a011f00452be47da28929ae0). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), and thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the service environment release backport, and [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi) for related split-installation and systemd override reports.
- Stops the [CLI status commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) from recommending another update for an old failure once the Gateway is serving a different build than the one recorded with that failure. The Control UI keeps the attempt in history and clears its current failure alert and retry action.
  [#186150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186150) · [Commit ae13ca4d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae13ca4dc3e8983fe3affbcc27e9791bc37a6d58) · [Issue #169950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/169950) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@amittell](https://github.com/amittell) for the report.
- Catches Git updates that would fail under the managed Gateway’s Node or Bun runtime before stopping the service, when OpenClaw can verify that runtime. The check runs in the installed updater.
  [#186539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186539). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Adds the wait time, stalled step and any recorded lock holder to managed update timeout messages. [Update history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) retains the failed step and reason for recorded runs. The updater also clears certain stale locks and avoids self-blocking across path aliases.
  [#186551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186551). Thanks to steipete and n572770.
- Keeps the original error when a Git or package update fails before it makes changes, instead of replacing it with a misleading rollback error after the previous Gateway restarts. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  [PR #186977](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186977). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes unnecessary low-disk-space refusals when a SQLite-only installation has an agent database larger than its shared database. The updater running the check must include this fix.
  [PR #186980](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186980). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Avoids delays during Windows updates caused by repeated checks on a Gateway that has already stopped. The updater running the update must include this fix.
  [PR #187005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187005). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Fixes `openclaw update` asking you to stop the Gateway or rejecting its database when the registry package is already current. If the updater cannot verify that the Gateway is stopped before a replacement, the [stop instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update) name the right service manager for your OS and show how to check what went wrong. The updater running the check must include this fix.
  [PR #187020](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187020). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@BFG508](https://github.com/BFG508).
- Fixes systemd-managed updates staying marked as running after the updater and its helper have disappeared. OpenClaw records the failure and the last phase it reached, even if the Gateway is still running. It also removes unused npm staging files when it can verify that the update never reached activation and no work is still using them. These changes require the installed updater, not just the version it downloads.
  [PR #187215](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187215). Thanks to steipete, masterdevill and joy-digital-healer.
- Fixes updates going quiet while Doctor runs during activation and before or after plugin updates. Doctor’s progress appears on standard error as it happens, even with `openclaw update --json`, so standard output still contains only the final JSON result.
  [PR #187372](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187372). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes `openclaw update --dry-run` creating reports, support bundles or package cache files when configuration cannot be read. The preview still explains why an update would be refused, though the package target may remain unknown until the configuration is readable.
  [PR #187498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187498), [PR #187515](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187515). Thanks to steipete and shakkernerd.
- Fixes a missing warning when the update succeeds but Doctor can’t finish post-update plugin repair. The summary shows `openclaw update repair` so you can retry.
  [#192942](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192942). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and, for the release backport 7a5ec45163, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes update rehearsals failing when an installed plugin reads a supported data file linked from outside its package. Repair can replace missing files without overwriting a plugin’s existing private changes. The fix needs to be in the updater you run, not just in the version it installs.
  [#196301](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196301). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes a pnpm version check that could rewrite your lockfile and derail [updates from a Git checkout](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). The updater you are running must already include this fix.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ecb4591e6e271e8f33f7687c525153e67daedd18). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible recovery copies piling up after interruptions or being left behind after OpenClaw saves session data. [Cleanup sweeps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) reclaim eligible copies while keeping protected ones.
  [Interrupted snapshot cleanup #186201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186201) · [Commit 22561309](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2256130976988c563f4df98cace977cf45337c4a) · [Issue #186144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186144) · [Recovery copy cleanup #189628](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189628) · [Cleanup follow-up #191275](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191275). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for the report, [@ericcaiwx-star](https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star) for a parallel draft, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa). Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the #191275 release backport.
- Fixes [update cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup) refusing to remove eligible recovery copies after harmless timestamp changes, and update or recovery checks rejecting an unchanged SQLite database when connections open or close.
  [Cleanup checks #186411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186411) · [Issue #185145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185145) · [Connection changes #193134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193134). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@kaguranananana](https://github.com/kaguranananana), [@thatsrue](https://github.com/thatsrue), [@TameTheGame](https://github.com/TameTheGame), [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport of #193134).
- Fixes `openclaw update repair` rejecting an intact installation after a filesystem remount when the package has a copied launcher. Repair can finish an already installed update without reinstalling it or restarting the service.
  [#186557](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186557). Thanks to ericcaiwx-star and sennyhoney.
- Fixes [`openclaw update repair`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) getting stuck on abandoned updates recorded under an old hostname when using SQLite. Repair warns about the abandoned runs it clears and continues, but still stops if another updater may be active.
  [#187638](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187638). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@bondskin](https://github.com/bondskin).
- Fixes the update progress display blocking Doctor’s database maintenance and leaving automatic database restoration unavailable after an otherwise successful update.
  [#192083](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/192083). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport c6e3f0e79e).
- Prevents rollback of a root-owned global npm install from removing the access a non-root service needs to start. It preserves existing access rather than restoring permissions an earlier rollback already removed.
  [#193272](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193272). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents a briefly busy Windows file from immediately stopping a backup, including a backup taken during an update. If a source file still can’t be read, the error names it and no partial backup is published. The backup or updater performing the capture must contain the fix.
  [#193685](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193685). Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (bf0dd347).
- Fixes update checks stopping after a successful database read because a temporary copy could not be removed. A failed read keeps its original error. It also prevents busy temporary files on NFS from making Doctor or Gateway startup fail after successful snapshot work, while warning if cleanup still needs to finish.
  [Update candidate cleanup #193702](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193702) · [NFS snapshot cleanup #195409](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195409). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backports.
- Restores owner-only access to package update recovery files and folders when the running updater can safely repair them, so overly broad permissions alone do not stop recovery.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3f50415ef21515fba2bb23114ab573abd5068b92).
- Finds saved database recovery copies through state-folder aliases and preserves the first refusal reason when restoration is refused more than once.
  [Recovery copy lookup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc983d036c6312dc9de2e7cf51b7a849661c3bd9).
- Fixes Update Doctor refusing a database migration because an earlier step in the same run already changed a database it needs.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186251">#186251</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ba2c43235473f7977060b00cce5ad729c951ad83">commit ba2c432</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes Doctor and upgrade preparation stopping when a shared database reports the expected version but is missing columns OpenClaw knows how to restore. Repairs finish before agent databases change.
  [#186567](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186567). Thanks to galiniliev.
- Adds warnings and recovery guidance for held agent databases that `openclaw doctor --json` and lint used to leave out. Update lint includes the warnings without blocking the update. Doctor also flags missing or unreadable deletion history even if it cannot name a held database.
  [#186535](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186535), [issue #185843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/185843). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@4140leal-cw](https://github.com/4140leal-cw).
- Gives scripts a distinct exit code when [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) cannot parse your configuration or determine which database to inspect. It exits with code `2` and tells you why no migrations ran. `openclaw doctor --json` also marks the inspection as blocked.
  [PR #187192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187192). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@JordanNewell](https://github.com/JordanNewell).
- Fixes update results and Doctor history still saying model retirement is pending after the same update has finished that repair.
  [PR #187208](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187208). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes Doctor reporting a pending schema upgrade when database porting only needs to prepare its own copy. Doctor no longer recommends ownership or backup maintenance based on facts it has not checked, and status no longer promises backup checks that Doctor does not provide.
  [PR #187213](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187213). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes Doctor reporting a lost lock on local state during an update without keeping the reason. Doctor errors and refused media migrations retain the first known reason, such as an expired lock or a storage failure. This improves diagnosis without preventing the failure.
  [PR #187477](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187477). Thanks to steipete and vincentkoc.
- Stops Doctor from repeatedly treating an update as unfinished because of an inactive, unavailable plugin with no settings that need to migrate. Existing plugin data stays in place, and migrations that are still needed can wait until the plugin is enabled.
  [PR #187592](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187592), [PR #187641](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187641). Thanks to steipete, jenswollenweber, mlobo2012 and coccoinomane.
- Makes [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) report which installation, configuration or Tailscale startup check timed out instead of waiting silently. Fixes Doctor staying open when you stop it during one of those waits.
  [#187936](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187936). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), to [@JordanNewell](https://github.com/JordanNewell) for the report, and to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport 258063a302.
- Fixes Doctor checks from the setup assistant copying large live databases and competing with active sessions. The live check covers configuration, runtime and installation, and reports that database, plugin, credential and workspace inspections were deferred. It stops and reports interrupted checks and applies a two-minute deadline. For a full report, stop the Gateway and run `openclaw doctor --lint` on the same host. Use `openclaw doctor --fix` for repairs. [Doctor guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint)
  [#191125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/191125). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport (f6b66118).
- Fixes Status and Doctor guidance for custom Gateway launchers that need manual correction instead of recommending a reinstall that leaves them in place.
  [#196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Makes systemd permission errors name the blocked path, and makes Doctor report a healthy restart separately from repairs it couldn’t finish.
  [#196342](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196342). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes updates running out of disk space during Doctor’s inspection of fully settled SQLite session databases. [Doctor reads those databases in place](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) instead of making a second copy.
  [PR #196346](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196346), [commit 0fed0517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0fed0517474ab015b1b140698a4890eb5a2ce749). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes a Doctor repair failure that could leave settings unchanged and omit the repair from the results.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d80482379b376f9ad921b6acff0df9bc2ce8c80).
- Fixes the opt-in [Doctor disk-space check](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) looking at the wrong volume when run alongside plugin checks.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cf4e6531e751cdd42d331844ad3d26c478b709d1). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor imports of recognized older SQLite stores with unfinished worker setup or legacy image snapshots while preserving their records. Older queued inputs are marked interrupted without replay. Keep [stores with retained historical fields](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#historical-import-evidence) on SQLite.
  [Historical import fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/85e0295f35e67b0f65db84aafe5e64000bb1bbf9).
- Clears an obsolete SQLite preparation warning with `openclaw doctor --fix` after affected upgrades from 2026.10.10.
  [SQLite preparation warning](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/74f838a0fd8360617c9be953ada5513ec6c44fea).
- Fixes Bash and PowerShell installers accepting an unsupported Node version for a hosted npm package or upgrading Node unnecessarily for a [Git installation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/installer). They keep a compatible version and install a suitable one when needed.
  [Hosted npm installs #187564](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187564) · [Git installs #187635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187635). Thanks to steipete, RomneyDa and [@McgAtom](https://github.com/McgAtom).
- Keeps `openclaw update` from rejecting an otherwise compatible Node runtime found during recovery just because it cannot check the security patch level again. Node 24.22.1 or newer on 24.x, or Node 26.12.1 or newer, is still strongly recommended.
  [#186589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186589). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes standalone setup and conversational onboarding failing before reaching a configured model. [`openclaw setup --message`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/setup) can run with the Gateway stopped when the model allows local execution. Required worker profiles still need a Gateway.
  [#186608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186608). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes fresh macOS setup failures after onboarding where OpenClaw could leave database work unfinished or fail to record where a plugin came from.
  [#189533](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189533). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Codex plugin installation failing during first-run setup when you run the macOS shell installer through a pipe and a controlling terminal is available.
  [PR #200247](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200247), [commit 98f3d07c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98f3d07ccad7c15d1000d9f8a8d3b38914b7ee77), [issue #200244](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/200244). Thanks [@miguelbranco80](https://github.com/miguelbranco80) for the report and fix, and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes installed plugins failing to start their workers or load their own modules in [experimental standalone AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) made with a compatible compiler.
  [#186463](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186463). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Docker builds with bundled diagnostics failing package checks because required tracing dependencies were missing.
  [PR #187363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187363). Thanks to vincentkoc.
- Fixes Docker and release packaging rejecting bundles that contain hard-linked dependency assets.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/368b5ec115535a1b3ac966b2f521df33639a69bd).
- Fixes eligible sessions being left idle when an older Gateway interrupts them during the upgrade to the new [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). OpenClaw makes one attempt to continue them. If the Gateway was stopped for more than six hours before upgrading, send a new message to continue.
  [#187867](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187867). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps standalone Gateway shutdowns from waiting past their cleanup deadline for background services and names what is still holding up shutdown when cleanup times out.
  [PR #187090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187090). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the Team Gateway from accepting new work again between the maintenance handoff and service stop.
  [PR #187090](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187090). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway stops and restarts reporting a cleanup failure after a command was refused before it ever started. You still see why the command was refused.
  [PR #187137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187137). Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes `openclaw dashboard` continuing to wait for the Control UI or printing browser instructions after you press Ctrl-C. Cancelling the browser step in guided onboarding no longer triggers fallback instructions. Setup also stops the browser handoff when you cancel.
  [PR #187220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187220). Thanks to yy19971996, obviyus and Alix-007.
- Fixes the CLI continuing to wait for the Gateway to become healthy after you press Ctrl-C or send SIGTERM during a start or restart. Interrupting the wait doesn’t stop a restart that’s already underway.
  [PR #187335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187335). Thanks to SunnyShu0925 and obviyus.
- Keeps late chat saves within the [original restart wait](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/external-apps) instead of starting a separate wait. If saves are still pending when time runs out, the restart is refused and the deployment log keeps the reason.
  [PR #196493](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196493), [commit b4d4ed88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b4d4ed88d11cd48a7747a92b8a5a6e9d9fbfbac0). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and, for the release backport, [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes the Control UI staying unavailable after a restart interrupts its first build on a Gateway running from source on POSIX. The next build can start once OpenClaw confirms the interrupted build has stopped.
