  [PR #200338](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200338), [commit eea92fb2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eea92fb271dc579e3d76e0eb8df4208e85bbe6f1). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Lets Gateway startup wait within the SQLite busy timeout for a transient schema lock held by another OpenClaw command. Offline maintenance still blocks startup.
  [SQLite startup wait](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc73f133baaa806b82aa0b1c10c41d54cf026dd1).
- Fixes first launch after a Mac app upgrade choosing an older Gateway runtime after state migration. Explicit runtime choices remain respected.
  [Mac runtime selection](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b08b6f7880ded69c626f5c63f087517c0802bcd).
- Reports the observed Gateway startup failure instead of a generic timeout and gives a partially started service a bounded opportunity to shut down.
  [Startup failure and cleanup](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0994eea54a174df5c0f967ab353524d541058770).
- Stops an eligible older app-managed Gateway before preparing the updated service and attempts to restore it if preparation fails. Service ownership and update-policy checks still apply.
  [Mac service update](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Prevents `openclaw doctor --fix` from putting a systemd system Gateway into maintenance when it cannot stop the service. [Doctor shows the stop command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) for the service owner before repair is retried as the state-owning account.
  [#186648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186648). Thanks to steipete and cryptoninja1stat.
- Reports the last database snapshot check that failed and how many tries were made when an update candidate cannot get a consistent copy.
  [#186386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186386), [issue #177482](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/177482). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jfrancis21](https://github.com/jfrancis21).
- Requires a verified pre-upgrade backup and its matching OpenClaw build to [roll back](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/state-schema-history) after the shared-state database has been upgraded. Reinstalling the older build alone will not work.
  [#173873](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173873). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Unblocks upgrades that got stuck on retired JSON files from before July 2026. If these files are blocking your update, run `openclaw doctor --fix` with v2026.11.5’s Doctor, then retry. For these files, Doctor replaces the broken detour through 2026.9.7. It recovers supported cron jobs, referenced OAuth sign-ins, Voice Wake settings, conversation bindings and default-home plugin approvals without overwriting existing data. It archives retired files without replaying old queued deliveries. You may still need to sign in again if an old OAuth key is unavailable; missing referenced OAuth files need repair, and some other retired formats still need a bridge release. See the [state migration guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/state-migrations).
  [PR #174489](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174489) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/956dd5d98995089f2956781fa0d6b99689e5f663) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@StarGazer1995](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174343) for the report.
- Stops Doctor from importing or archiving old sessions when the shared-state database is missing but its SQLite recovery files remain. If Doctor reports this, [restore the matching database](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery) and keep those files intact before retrying.
  [PR #175300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175300) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e72e9a566d35047c08ef7ee6a85966491be81707). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Git updates losing SQLite diagnostic catalogs after activation. If an older updater reports a catalog `tables` error, keep its recovery files and follow the [manual source update procedure](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) before retrying. The fix must already be in the updater running the update.
  [Commit 8bedc56](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8bedc5686c42e892a985f93627066f0e022a7ad4).
- Restores [automatic updates](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating/automatic-updates) for installed headless node services. If an older service warns that it can’t start automatic updates, run `openclaw doctor --fix` on that node. The repair restarts running services, leaves stopped services stopped, and skips custom or externally managed definitions. On Windows, the fix also prevents startup failures with `openclaw.cmd` and restores the previous Scheduled Task if registration fails after changing it.
  [#175860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175860) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0a0d88df543a9d36c4708f93c56d995da769050c) · [Issue #175831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175831). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) for the report.
- Prevents unfinished Gateway update drains from blocking new work for minutes. A drain that hasn’t handed off to shutdown expires after 45 seconds, and the Gateway accepts new work again without interrupting work already underway. The update CLI and bundled deployment controller limit how long they wait for work to finish, and Gateway logs show who started the drain and why it ended. If you run an [external drain controller](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/external-apps), complete the shutdown handoff within 45 seconds or defer the update.
  Deploying the bundled controller revision is separate from updating the Gateway. [#173788](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173788) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7042b9a4f572d92304c369f47cb30a55f5210e98). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Changes the Team server release controller to wait up to three minutes for maintenance or another deployment to finish instead of reporting a skipped deployment as a success. If the wait expires, it reports a deferral. Existing installations need to adopt the matching [controller pair](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/.agents/skills/update-team-server/controller/README.md) separately.
  [#173869](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173869). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Windows update repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery) mistaking unrelated processes for unfinished update work. Run `openclaw update repair` from the Windows account that started the update. Repair can still refuse to proceed on older update attempts or when it can’t rule out unfinished work.
  [#173783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173783) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc319b51e48299d10195139bee3a149674807f6d) · [issue #173430](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173430). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@karljamoralin](https://github.com/karljamoralin).
- Fixes `openclaw update migrate` accepting the new version before all live agent databases pass validation, and keeps the recovery backup if validation fails.
  [Commit 5d93d5e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d93d5e29c4a5071b2af5dd8b8ea253cc046f524). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes update migration failing to recognize a supervised Gateway between service restarts and attribute its own stop record. Unrelated database writes still block migration.
  [Commit 4d1b585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Fixes managed updates for a foreground PostgreSQL Gateway failing to verify the owner and adopt the configured update ledger. It also restores missing restart and failure notices, and prevents update processes from staying open unnecessarily after handoff or cancellation. If a notice cannot be recorded, OpenClaw logs the failure without stopping service recovery.
  [Foreground handoff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70914560023817b44cc9c98417c33f5a3aa76521) · [PR #174505](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174505) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d5f787453cb4b65907a3f6554f131d50e50e0e53) · [Database engines](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps restart tied to the installed service and reports when the new database settings can’t be resolved.
  [PR #175069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175069). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes adopted immutable Linux updates failing during preparation on slow or interrupted connections and builds being rejected because Plugin SDK files were missing. The updater downloads missing source history and retries a failed download once; default builds include the required SDK files, which can add build time. The download fix applies when the running updater already includes it.
  [Download preparation #175071](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175071) · [Plugin SDK files #175087](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175087). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fixes and [@potterdigital](https://github.com/potterdigital) for reporting.
- Fixes [update preparation on adopted immutable Linux installs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update#immutable-release-installations) failing when no separate build account is configured. The updater warns before building as a non-root operator, and update status and Doctor show that the build ran without a separate account. This fallback uses the operator’s account without separate build-account isolation. If the updater can’t identify an eligible non-root account, it stops before changing the installation.
  [#176532](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176532) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed Linux updates waiting indefinitely for a systemd Gateway service to stop. If the stop times out, the update moves on to recovery. Failure notices explain what failed and any recorded next step, and name the version still running when verified. If maintenance is already in progress, the error keeps any known details about what is holding it. The stop fix applies only when your installed updater includes it.
  [#186792](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186792) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/473d221d0c9a38bd78a187147659a62ebdef3b89) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ndirazar](https://github.com/ndirazar).
- Fixes Linux updates rolling back during a state migration when the native process check is unavailable but Linux can still verify the updater. If neither check works, Doctor explains why the update stopped and [how to retry](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating). When available, it also shows the system’s glibc version to help diagnose why the native check could not load.
  [PR #186871](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186871) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82c1391e9f94dc9192e3a3f5a2a12723f821a754) · [issue #186817](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186817). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Prevents package updates from replacing files when service checks are unavailable and the updater cannot rule out a running Gateway using that installation. This guard applies once the installed updater includes the fix, so it may not protect the first update from an older version.
  [#176038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176038) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes confirmed abandoned updates staying active until a timeout. `openclaw update status` points you to [repair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery), and repair or the next actual update can mark the abandoned run as failed without waiting. Check that generated guidance matches your platform and profile.
  [#176038](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176038) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes idle CLI and plugin commands holding up updates or update repair long after they finish using an agent database. If [update maintenance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting) reports that a command started on an older release is still holding the database, stop that command so maintenance can continue. Plugin authors holding a deprecated unborrowed database handle across work should use the supported borrowing API, because an idle handle may close.
  [PR #175986](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175986). Thanks [@romneyda](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes the updater relying on an outdated database compatibility check after Doctor runs, so OpenClaw checks the database again before using it even if Doctor exits with an error.
  [PR #175300](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175300) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e72e9a566d35047c08ef7ee6a85966491be81707). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents oversized recovery file lists from causing updates to fail on large installations. The fix applies to updates run by the new updater.
  [PR #175824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175824) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/731d1c17820982a8581447e1d7dcb20ceff9b489) · [Follow-up #184958](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184958). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes scheduled update checks getting stuck on a previous installation-detection error. The next check tries again.
  [Commit 525d41b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/525d41b11a8aa3ede5aecdf529044859c4a5f619). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents Windows update checks from listing the same database twice under different paths when OpenClaw uses an extended-length state path. Rollback checks keep the original path, and newly discovered plugin databases still count.
  [PR #174471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174471). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw config validate` and plugin update checks failing because a running OpenClaw instance was still writing to its SQLite database.
  [PR #175774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175774) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f15018960a17d526f9b17c9fcfc803101942870d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@dankarization](https://github.com/dankarization) for the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/160483).
- Fixes migrated updates looking stuck near the end when run by the 11.5 updater. Finalization messages appear as they arrive.
  [PR #175777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175777) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/972e639b799b43c948756cf2b747e5ed3f32aa00) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `openclaw update status` hanging when a check stalls, and update inspection errors pointing to process or storage trouble when a worker reached its output limit. Status returns the results it has and names incomplete checks, including in JSON. Redacted update snapshots keep the output-limit reason. Doctor warns if it cannot read Gateway replacement history.
  [Status and history](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/status-and-history) · [Status checks #174060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174060) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/910b54b1ffa9c3a9e60e3a1722b84d82457bc537) · [Output limits #175997](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175997). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the status fix, [@jsf9789](https://github.com/jsf9789) for the report and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc) for the output-limit fix.
- Makes [OpenClaw update](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) warnings explain why an old package backup was left in place, such as a locked file or a denied rename.
  [#175890](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175890) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the failed systemd check and any available error details to `openclaw update` diagnostics when OpenClaw cannot inspect the managed Gateway service on Linux.
  [#175928](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175928) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops `openclaw update` warning about missing optional package managers, such as `pacman` on Debian. Other failed package-manager checks warn only once per update for the same search path. The fix takes effect on [updates run by the new updater](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating).
  [PR #186839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186839) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/26cc81a8b17377982faf17e6dd959eef85e0d13f) · [issue #186814](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186814) · [issue #173084](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173084). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@jb168](https://github.com/jb168), [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi).
- Corrects inflated reclaimable space in `openclaw update cleanup` reports. Qualifying recovery originals that are already gone are counted separately in text and JSON instead of being listed as files you can remove.
  [PR #174241](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174241) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fd2d5d0ae8ca4fa7eb8f4ce4fddb03508713160e) · [issue #174153](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174153) · [repair and recovery guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/update/repair-and-recovery.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Navras98](https://github.com/Navras98).
- Limits the buildup of standalone Doctor recovery copies after repeated Docker rollouts. Doctor always keeps the newest completed copy and retires other eligible copies outside the newest three or older than 30 days. Copies needed for recovery stay protected and can bring the total above three. [`openclaw update cleanup`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery#update-cleanup) shows copy sizes and lets you review and remove eligible copies.
  [#174415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174415) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@BjoernSchotte](https://github.com/BjoernSchotte).
- Warns when Git backup creation, verification or restore may have left private files behind and names the temporary location to check. Fixes cleanup errors masking the real result, including when the backup succeeded. If you see the warning, check the named location for private files; cleanup is not retried. See the [backup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/backup).
  [PR #175339](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175339) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c5791c36dc0e1b7d09bd43118e9ed71a5f4dba35). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Rejects a mismatched database in a recovery copy even when SQLite’s companion files match.
  [PR #175776](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175776) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3ce9e7c2961cce1202215601799d52dd76e75dcf) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the original copy of ordinary files for manual update recovery if they change after copying, while rejecting changes during the copy. Each capture keeps the plugin file list it started with.
  [PR #178511](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178511). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [session cleanup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/sessions) from deleting files still needed by pending plugin migrations. Fixes [Doctor import and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/sqlite-maintenance) getting stuck on a missing transcript when its original contents can be verified in session history. Doctor clears that conflict without losing newer messages. If Doctor cannot verify the contents, restore the named transcript from a verified backup before retrying recovery.
  [#175274](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175274) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d03dde9604a20c60567c3763fe37cff5cd78ac65). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@cbremer](https://github.com/cbremer) for [reporting the issue](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175245).
- Fixes Doctor undoing a completed import of outgoing image records when it cannot clean up the old files. Fixes Doctor undoing an import of meeting transcripts when it cannot archive the originals. In both cases, a later Doctor run can retry the unfinished step without starting the import over.
  Changed source files are preserved with a warning, and conflicting image records still need explicit recovery. [#178452](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178452). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor stopping during session repair when differently capitalized agent IDs refer to the same database. The repair preserves conversation history and lets later migrations run, including the one that updates where Telegram picks up incoming messages.
  [PR #174243](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174243) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/98bf0b139b630cb319d6f900d54d9b79691a81d5) · [issue #174089](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174089) · [state migrations guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/state-migrations.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@keirmodon](https://github.com/keirmodon) and [@sukhdeepjohar](https://github.com/sukhdeepjohar).
- Recognizes completed runtime-pin migrations for the same profile when [Doctor](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running) checks a running Gateway, and fixes Doctor asking you to stop the Gateway on a fresh SQLite profile with no old pins to move. For pending legacy pins, stop the Gateway and other owners of the profile, run `openclaw doctor --fix` against the same state and config, and restart the Gateway.
  [Completed migrations #174147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174147) · [Fresh profiles #174228](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174228) · [Doctor guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/running). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor omitting the SQLite library it uses when it skips the Gateway service check.
  [PR #174147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174147). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor silently skipping legacy skill-upload files it cannot inspect, in both preview and repair. During repair, Doctor also warns if it cannot inspect an agent database for legacy usage-cache cleanup and continues checking the other agents.
  [PR #174218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174218). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents `openclaw doctor --lint` from treating missing optional databases as errors on healthy installations. Doctor still checks the databases that are present.
  [#175169](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175169) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [read-only Doctor database checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) from leaving plugin build files in your profile’s state directory.
  [PR #175173](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175173) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8c7c9f6947ebb457a4ea3fec97a7fcc010cd1c05) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents [selected Doctor lint reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/lint) from repeatedly copying the SQLite state database for ordinary reads. Each report uses one private copy if it needs to read state, and checks that don’t need state skip the copy.
  [#176014](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176014) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Doctor stopping early when its output is temporarily slow to print.
  [PR #175777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175777) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/972e639b799b43c948756cf2b747e5ed3f32aa00) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `/openclaw rescue` dropping a completed command’s findings when it exits with an error status. The reply includes the findings and exit status instead of treating the completed command as a failed message that may be retried.
  [Commit f6c8beb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6c8bebd933e66d2934633a8a847e116c5443a81). Thanks [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents Gateway startup from staying blocked by offline maintenance after the launcher for `openclaw doctor --fix` is killed. The Gateway can start again once the interrupted repair has shut down, without deleting locks or the database.
  [#174268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174268), [#174219](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/174219). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@chrislro](https://github.com/chrislro).
- Fixes Gateway startup failing immediately while offline maintenance is still running on the same database. The Gateway waits up to five minutes and logs which process is holding it. If the wait expires, let that process finish before retrying startup. See the [Gateway lock guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/gateway-lock).
  [PR #176548](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176548), [commit 943e9af](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/943e9af522a8e0070fc051a7052edd5c267dfeaf) and related [issue #175730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/175730). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, [@waynegault](https://github.com/waynegault) for the related report and [@kesslerio](https://github.com/kesslerio) for reporting related Docker behavior.
- Fixes startup checks for older webhook installations failing immediately during a transient SQLite schema lease. The check can wait within the busy timeout; offline maintenance still refuses immediately.
  [Commit 4e89349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4e89349b53b051778ce65fcf910fb742d2b64cc4).
- Fixes agent database cleanup warnings during long-running native updates or Doctor maintenance, so the databases can close cleanly when maintenance finishes.
  [#186783](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186783) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5ec695485f7522ccdc70395b30830bfb7091294d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes session restart markers running out of time during shutdown cleanup. Marker persistence can use the remaining cleanup budget, and idle agent stores stay open until it settles or times out. The one-second limit remains when there is no cleanup budget.
  [Shutdown budget](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcd0ec9940b991f92d298da4a3d7b1bd4efd113a) · [Agent stores](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/86597179b87acbba6b0b96edc7a1079dc5de9df0).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown getting stuck behind a command still running on a worker. A remote worker that doesn’t confirm it stopped remains eligible for cleanup when it reconnects. Shutdown diagnostics also show which cleanup steps took time.
  [PR #174312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174312) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ffbb394f438b404ce709731d5ff4001965da315f) · [Restart and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown hanging after an agent database lock is removed or replaced. The Gateway warns about the lost lock, stops accepting new writes when it detects the loss, and leaves any replacement lock alone. If cleanup fails, the Gateway keeps its exit deadline so a managed update can move on to recovery. The running Gateway must already have the fix.
  [#186811](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186811) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c57ad9ae56e01f479ff454b3743e2432b4b53046) · [Documentation](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@Rene-F](https://github.com/Rene-F).
- Fixes the Gateway appearing ready when a Node.js upgrade or removal leaves it unable to start new workers. The Gateway reports the runtime failure, and eligible managed services try one graceful restart after active work has drained. If the Gateway only reports the problem, follow the [recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health) to repair Node.js and restart through your service or process manager.
  [#175206](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175206). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents an unnecessary [agent database integrity scan](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#integrity-checks) on restart when a late request is turned away before opening the database during an otherwise clean shutdown.
  [#175232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175232) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes the Gateway skipping startup checks or session preparation for existing `openclaw` and `crestodian` databases when those built-in agents aren’t listed in your configuration. You no longer need to add roster entries for them as a workaround.
  [PR #176508](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176508) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/96e6d2d00cb442a8c1d8a884dffd3f4037845cfc) · [Issue #176355](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176355). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@yozakura-ava](https://github.com/yozakura-ava) and [@oldrich333](https://github.com/Oldrich333).
- Fixes agents staying unavailable after Gateway startup when a last-minute change invalidates their database readiness check. The Gateway retries that step automatically.
  [PR #178577](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178577) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7bad8ec61de9ee59758f3ee876e8b49778d41436). Thanks [@hez2z](https://github.com/HeZ2z) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@609nft](https://github.com/609NFT) for the report.
- Fixes Windows agents staying unavailable after `openclaw doctor --fix` successfully migrates their database, blocking access to sessions, chat history and model listings. If OpenClaw still reports a serialization error, the [recovery guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/integrity-and-recovery#a-migrated-agent-remains-unavailable-with-a-serialization-error) points you to updating OpenClaw and restarting the Gateway instead of repeating the migration.
  [#175929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175929) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). Thanks [@rspires1952](https://github.com/rspires1952) for the report.
- Fixes Linux Gateway discovery failing when any loaded systemd service has a multiline startup argument, even if the service is unrelated to OpenClaw. Discovery through a private systemd manager, including the default root system route, requires native inspection support.
  [PR #176469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176469). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes service setup and recovery when ownership changes and keeps older builds while a running Gateway still uses them.
  [Commit a20c18d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a20c18dd0f1be13d939ea6ee3f2ff085607d1b17).
- Fixes uninstall and Doctor leaving an unloaded LaunchAgent file behind when Trash access is denied. In that case the file is deleted without a Trash copy. The cleanup candidate must already include the fix.
  [Commit 1833a1d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1833a1d1442482eb947dbf4348761d4110b3d9ca).
- Prevents system clock changes from cutting macOS Gateway startup retries short or stretching them out while the previous service is still stopping.
  [#175204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175204). Thanks [@sunnyshu0925](https://github.com/sunnyshu0925).
- Fixes macOS Gateway service checks reporting the service as missing when an inspection command couldn’t be cleaned up. A restart that hits a cleanup failure during inspection stops before changing the service and reports what went wrong.
  [#175716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175716) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/879e99cb19617232e384d4ec4f48a65ebc9c2ec5). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a startup error in affected [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) that could stop agent turns, Doctor commands such as `openclaw doctor --fix`, and plugin installs before they began.
  [PR #174545](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174545) · [commit 71fac53](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/71fac535968655bd6ae9a60449e27111d5e7286f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes source native resources, including SQLite, failing to load through a compiled process broker.
  [Commit 26048d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/26048d73fc952ebd44a84ac14cfdc3564c00fc70).
- Fixes missing-export errors in npm and Docker installations, including Doctor and PostgreSQL Gateway recovery.
  [Commit a8a974d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a8a974d3f9991bc5e4abd2ac5bacc6cb7a9fcd36).
- Fixes npm installs losing the patched Bonjour dependency that OpenClaw needs for local network discovery.
  [Commit 8878714](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/887871495550a9f1a869bd5dbca41d2e4591830a). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman), [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), [@ava-perry](https://github.com/ava-perry).
- Reduces the number of files in npm installs so the package fits within existing updater limits, without changing how you set up or use Mistral chat.
  [PR #175296](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175296) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae160c8261f4661b53121000ab5c6130a82924eb). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps the previous Crabbox installation in a reported recovery directory if replacement fails after it has been moved. A later ensure starts a fresh managed install if neither the preferred nor managed binary is supported.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an oversized launcher that could make managed Node worker bundle checks run out of memory.
  [PR #176502](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176502) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8e507974830bbbf4ad5773712417a84fd4c5a5a6). Thanks [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev).
- Fixes onboarding recommending LINE for Linear while keeping each integration eligible for the app it matches.
  [Commit bb674d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bb674d1d10dcba2cde7936ed46c2888c523ca822).
- Fixes long waits in `openclaw doctor --fix` when it recovers many older plugin sessions on large installations. Doctor still keeps the recovery records from interrupted runs, so you don’t need to delete them before retrying.
  [PR #186880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186880) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a1859e5195f6e74f1980192bdf291c0193e940a1) · [issue #186824](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186824) · [issue #172809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/172809). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@oiGaDio](https://github.com/oiGaDio).
- Fixes Gateway startup failing when a brief database lock interrupts cleanup of leftover worker workspace records. The Gateway retries the cleanup before giving up.
  [#186920](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186920) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d1416cf48dc2d582a3bc1e0139783d592b599b82) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@bianyuxia-commits](https://github.com/bianyuxia-commits) for [the report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186875), and [@yousan](https://github.com/yousan).
- Fixes PostgreSQL-backed updates failing their initial checks. On managed updates driven by a supporting updater, automatic rollback remains available if the update fails after migrating state or agent data, including restoring the previous schema and data. If other database writes or uncertain ownership make rollback unsafe, OpenClaw keeps the [recovery copies](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines) rather than restoring automatically.
  [#174360](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174360) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw update repair` reporting success without warning when it finds your managed Gateway still stopped. The warning points you to `openclaw gateway start` and `openclaw gateway status --deep`.
  [PR #186312](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186312), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff2d58950bf7fd07c7c0daa267f9ec93325a9547). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@chamber32](https://github.com/chamber32) and [@mmhzlrj](https://github.com/mmhzlrj). [Repair guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/update/repair-and-recovery).
- Adds a backed-up migration path in Doctor for supported PostgreSQL shared-state schemas while the Gateway is offline. Doctor reports eligible older schemas as pending and leaves them untouched during inspection. It backs up the existing data before migrating and keeps the backup available for recovery if the migration rolls back.
  [PR #173981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173981). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes Windows Gateway startup and updates getting blocked by a stale lock left by an older OpenClaw process. Automatic and confirmed recovery clear these legacy locks only when Windows can verify the old process has stopped.
  [#182031](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182031). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and to [@asswwwsa](https://github.com/asswwwsa) for the report.
- Fixes managed updates aborting and leaving the Gateway stopped when retained plugin data, such as Voice Call’s, is mistaken for agent data. [Update backups](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) still cover those plugin stores.
  [PR #174973](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174973) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/76752e06f636731b7913774df4eb8a5abc4623e9) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vishnusenthil-16](https://github.com/vishnusenthil-16).
- Fixes global npm updates rolling back because of a recovery record left by an earlier successful update. The repaired updater prevents new occurrences and can clear the blockage while keeping the existing record. If an older updater reports `nlink=2` or higher, follow the [Doctor recovery steps](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting#node-and-global-install-permissions) before retrying.
  [PR #187549](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187549) and [report #187468](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/187468). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@zigit](https://github.com/zigit).
- Fixes Doctor refusing to migrate a database because the Gateway wrote to it during a startup check on an update that skips the service restart. Those startup changes also no longer cause the updater to refuse an otherwise eligible database restore if the update fails.
  [Released backport](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ee283073849efe6bd080fef53328a3a3ec72a6bf), [canonical fix #200260](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200260), and [helper #198268](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198268). Thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the backport and Ayaan Zaidi for the helper.
- Fixes an update check that could reject a supported older PostgreSQL agent database even with the Gateway stopped. This clears the early check, not later migration or restart failures.
  [#186972](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186972) · [commit 12cf994](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/12cf99436f7804ae867b0d01f76faa0027b42a29). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes update checks and repair failing on installations that use PostgreSQL for state, agents and the workboard. It also fixes a related failure that could keep the Gateway from starting after an update.
  [#187064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187064) · [commit 537c3f3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/537c3f3e0a855dee5d17b55f34c99cc91ad635f3). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes updates on [PostgreSQL-backed installations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/postgresql) rolling back when Doctor is denied database access while activating the new version.
  [#187160](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187160) · [commit 7e75d49](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e75d4900ebea39e593b12680875b38fdc6e84de). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes `openclaw update` reporting a missing backup provider instead of the real error when it cannot check a PostgreSQL store. If the error says `unaccent` is missing, have a database administrator run the SQL shown before retrying. See the [PostgreSQL database guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-engines).
  [#187178](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187178) · [commit 960debc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/960debc51780c899df913ea2ddf3cf971a80ea02). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown getting held up by a stalled check for an idle worker.
  [#177081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177081). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway shutdown failure where stalled restart details could force an exit before OpenClaw saved the information needed to resume running sessions. Keeps locally authorized Gateway restarts from getting stuck waiting for saved restart details, which may be lost if they time out.
  [#188047](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188047). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport ad1886f5dd).
- Restores [direct upgrades](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/updating) from extended-stable 2026.9.33 and 2026.9.34 without first replacing the installed updater. Read-only Doctor checks no longer change database files and cause an update to reject an unchanged database. It also fixes a rollback when the 2026.10.5 updater lost track of the original task schedule during rehearsal.
  [Update compatibility #184547](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184547) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ad1b598587318803d816fbb254cef92f8a9aa1e4) · [Doctor checks #185561](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185561) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/851c6a6978864a1bf3df9712052f97e4e6bdbeb8) · [Update troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/update-troubleshooting). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes eligible active built-in Goals stopping after the first successful recovered reply following a graceful Gateway restart. It also keeps an interrupted turn eligible to resume while its managed workspace is still being prepared, even if another graceful restart interrupts the wait. See [restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery).
  [Goal continuation #186599](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186599) · [Restart recovery #185730](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185730) · [Workspace wait #196423](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196423). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc), and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the #196423 release backport (ab01422).
- Fixes standalone profile commands failing after a restart during startup. It also fixes Doctor hiding native snapshot failures or remaining open after one. Sandboxed Doctor requires local broker IPC.
  [#173154](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173154) · [Doctor guidance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/doctor/running.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Gateway connections and remote access

- Fixes remote setup losing saved connection settings when you change only the spelling of an equivalent Gateway URL.
  [Onboarding command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/onboard) [#127072](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/127072) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway probes taking much longer than their timeout when discovery is slow, while checking known targets without waiting for discovery.
  Connection cleanup can take a little longer. [Gateway probe command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway) [#127197](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/127197) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw nodes status` and `openclaw nodes describe` failing to use configured credentials on affected trusted-proxy Gateways.
  <span>Thanks [@DonnieFi](https://github.com/DonnieFi), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164480">#164480</a></span>
- Fixes valid node join codes being reported as expired when a proxy changes the case of the JSON media type in its response.
  [#171759](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171759) · Thanks [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes cloud workers failing to start from composed distributions that exclude bundled plugins.
  [#172818](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172818). Thanks [@freeqaz-openai](https://github.com/freeqaz-openai).
- Fixes first [AWS warm-image captures](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/warm-images) stopping at a valid pending checkpoint. If Crabbox hasn’t confirmed capture, OpenClaw waits for that checkpoint to become available before enrolling the worker.
  [#172846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172846). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces macOS Gateway stalls from filesystem activity that could time out chat history and connections.
  [#172838](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172838). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Connection diagnostics failing to start when the page loads after connecting.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173195">#173195</a> · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes remote workspace setup reporting a generic error when pairing changes during setup, so workspace discovery can recognize the pairing change and use its existing recovery.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173393">#173393</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces Gateway stalls after signing in, signing out, removing a key or changing plugin settings by avoiding redundant plugin scans. Scheduled jobs also pick up current provider sign-in aliases without another scan.
  [Packaged installations #173626](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173626) · [Plugin scans #174860](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174860) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a5dee9eec0b11e9bdc55361dd0327f223e4f20a9). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Shows the redacted reason when `openclaw node run` fails to start, in normal output and installed node service logs without turning on debug mode.
  [#173894](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173894) · [Original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173893) · [Review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173894#issuecomment-6271713589) · [Test integration](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0386bbc1f3b2c9a9370ab22c922b45a117e314e8) · [Node CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node) · Thanks masatohoshino for the original report and fix and steipete for review and test integration.
- Fixes worker connection retries ending too early or running too long when the system clock changes while the worker is connecting to the Gateway.
  [#175040](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175040) — Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for integration and regression coverage.
- Stops late connection and error updates from a remote desktop that has permanently disconnected.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176377](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176377), [26e2445](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/26e244507d0fd528e696f5f6b6a0b354f3f3fcde).
- Cancels outdated Cloud Workers profile lookups when the connection, configuration, or access changes, so late results don’t replace the current catalog.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176634">#176634</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04ec2430fe1ec97483a6fa87f6f68c3f056342d2">04ec2430</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes follow-up updates that could leave a client’s presence or session list out of date after the Gateway detects a missed delivery.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176583">#176583</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/841ac58e111e13a108f4fc96a24dba5b82bb9f93">841ac58e</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateways getting stuck and using CPU during shutdown after their output stream closes.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176578">#176578</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0319200bb1b72e8ec2f0601cbb53d61f865313bd">0319200b</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway shutdown delays during cloud-worker setup or optional worker checks, and preserves a recoverable allocation if shutdown interrupts setup. The wait for worker stop or workspace cleanup confirmation is capped at five seconds, and the attachment is kept for recovery if cleanup is not confirmed. Accepted provider changes may still take longer, and checks for a worker environment can resume after its inventory reopens. [Gateway restart recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/restart-recovery)
  [Setup recovery #176777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176777) · [commit d01eb83](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d01eb83804aeb76bcc2ddcc44ee7b0706e6a0637) · [Worker acknowledgments #176803](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176803) · [commit fcbcaad](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fcbcaad75f0db848b54df62275ff4beaacbd50d0) · [Optional worker checks #180841](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180841) · [commit 51ee257](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/51ee2570bf3628fe93680c77dc67efee6065c34c) · [Worker provider guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/sdk-overview/capabilities). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway stall that could happen while rejecting an invalid configuration edit when the running Gateway already has the plugin information it needs to explain the error. The Gateway reports why it rejected the edit and keeps using the last valid settings.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176831](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176831) · [commit 649eb17](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/649eb175135e8d35f494cd97877714bd1f410e3d) · [Configuration hot reload](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload)
- Fixes a process identity error that could refuse an authorized stop from inside a hosted Gateway.
  [#177635](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177635) · [415e63d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/415e63d4a251fbc0938950ceac48498751189b8e). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes unclear Gateway reconnect feedback in the Control UI. A progress indicator shows while it reconnects, and repeated Retry clicks can’t replace a connection attempt that’s already underway.
  [#177690](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177690) · [08d04a9d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08d04a9d7b97e50849ba089c3837d2e1c3c4f7fd). Thanks to [@jacobtomlinson](https://github.com/jacobtomlinson).
- Fixes node hosts reporting no free worker slots without explaining that the capacity check failed. If capacity does not recover, the warning points you to restarting the node host. [Session hosting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting)
  [#177797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177797) · [d4daa41b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4daa41b9efd4888195f4710f85f4f7da6ec9469). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes already paired ephemeral nodes failing to reconnect after their direct setup code expires, and approved commands remaining unavailable when a node connects during its first capability approval. The node needs a valid saved pairing for the same Gateway. [Connect guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/connect)
  [Expired setup codes #177880](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177880) · [Capability approval #177944](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177944) · Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman) for the fix and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for regression-test integration and the capability fix.
- Fixes Gateway shutdowns that could be cut short after a burst of reconnects on installations with many paired devices. It also fixes devices failing to save connection details or record token use because another paired device’s record could not be read.
  [#177981](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177981) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes sessions getting stuck after a Windows node host crashes during a tool call. Update and restart the node host so launches with recorded Windows Job custody can release the occupied slot after a crash and let the session continue. A tool process that is slow to exit can briefly overlap the next turn. [Session hosting guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-hosting)
  [#179188](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179188), [`4de3285`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4de32850e366868f97a5cd465b5eccdda1b30bb3). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes one source of memory growth on long-running Gateways on Node 24.16–24.19, where memory from completed model requests could build up over time. The fix also covers Microsoft Teams file-consent uploads on those Node versions.
  [#179232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179232), [`9edb131`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9edb131db8deb28ca53a8e51f8886bdf6645f6c4). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw gateway status` reporting misleading permissions for a local Gateway bound to a custom address or Tailnet. Use `--url` if you want to check a different address. [Gateway status guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/query)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179299">#179299</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Prevents temporary rows from being clickable while the Devices list is still loading. Refreshing an empty list shows a loading placeholder, while a quiet refresh keeps existing rows visible. Failed reads offer a retry, and switching Gateways clears the wait for the previous connection.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180016">#180016</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/433146c1bdf4dc16208a52328e57a050452455fd">commit 433146c1</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds **Retry** when Portals cannot load its list on first open. Keeps the preview open during a list refresh on the same Gateway and closes the old preview when you switch Gateways. [Portals guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/portals)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180431">PR #180431</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5198c7030ef4547c2b88bb70802f3e6e5f158ea0">Commit 5198c70</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Prevents profile-specific node commands from stopping, removing or replacing another profile’s Gateway service when their service names collide. If OpenClaw reports this conflict on Linux, move the Gateway service to its current name before managing the node. Newly installed named-profile node services on macOS also use separate supervisor logs. To switch an existing service to its own log, reinstall it with `openclaw --profile <profile> node install --force`. [Node service guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)
  [Service-name conflicts #180541](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180541) · [commit 419d3c5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/419d3c5af2017a782f86621bd1e6c5b99d8fc554) · [Profile logs #180503](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180503) · [commit 07bd3ef](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/07bd3eff3be9bf5a25e0615456ecfa6b38b8e45a). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@MertBasar0](https://github.com/MertBasar0), and [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13) for macOS validation.
- Prevents a late cloud-worker rebuild error from replacing feedback from a newer inventory refresh. A rebuild from the previous connection no longer leaves controls disabled or shows a stale error after you reconnect.
  [#180801](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180801) · [commit 4bd1d4a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4bd1d4a835e4193970e8892766536b8f3c1c599d) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Gateway readiness check reporting ready after a restart while the Gateway could still reject a new chat message. The updated macOS app also waits for the Gateway to accept new chat messages before showing it as ready.
  [#180924](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180924) · [Gateway health](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes invalid Gateway configuration being reported as a database connection error on PostgreSQL. `openclaw gateway run` shows the actual configuration problem and exits with code `78`, as it does on SQLite.
  [#181224](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181224) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d0c23802ffb9f590ca4897bfaa9bf9c4d8ed8203)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert). Reported by [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) ([#180686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180686)).
- Fixes saved changes to settings that support hot reload failing to take effect on a running Gateway that uses PostgreSQL for state.
  [#181371](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181371) · [Shipped change](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2172eea64c60bcd614da44d2ee2f3e9a2aeb3680) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat with ready agents being held up after a Gateway restart while an optional agent’s database is still preparing. The agent that’s still preparing remains unavailable, and failures are still reported in [Gateway health checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health).
  [#181428](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181428) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert).
- Corrects the same-host Gateway setup example to use ports `19001` and `19121` so the two Gateways’ default sandbox and browser ports don’t overlap. [Gateway setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway)
  [#184694](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184694) ([`6179ba4d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6179ba4da93ec441453fa4e384417c15acec8fde)). Thanks [@Satoshi-Kusumoto](https://github.com/Satoshi-Kusumoto) for the fix and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) for co-authoring it.
- Stops eligible task workers from recompiling code already cached by Node when you run the Gateway in the foreground.
  [#185575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185575) · [bcbda18](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcbda18321ec11435693223f3c688630df52dc91) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces the memory the Gateway holds on to after process cleanup fails or a scheduled job creator’s permissions are revoked, while preserving the original error.
  [#185584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185584) · [c579c55](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c579c55a1242a24ddf1696a1d89ef97f03a11983) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops the Gateway from unnecessarily keeping old configuration schemas in memory after settings or plugin metadata change.
  [#185617](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185617) · [320841f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/320841f02d002e0f6b3bb2064fe9369ae4ac996a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [foreground nodes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/node.md) that could keep running when stopped during startup before connecting to the Gateway. Stopping at that point shuts the node down and releases the resources it already prepared.
  [#186106](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186106) · [`f39b480c`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f39b480c874d8acdae73f3b1c060dbd6cfc7a052). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes an unnecessary login prompt on private conversation links for authorized [Tailscale Serve](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/urls) viewers without a saved Gateway credential when Serve identity authentication is enabled.
  [#186164](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186164) · [Commit 25c300f7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/25c300f73654074c03edbb2cc8bb97d19bbf2678) · [Issue #186162](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186162) · Thanks to [@pavonis-martian](https://github.com/pavonis-martian).
- Fixes `openclaw gateway probe` reporting a reachable Gateway as unreachable almost immediately when given a timeout longer than about 25 days.
  [#186528](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186528). Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes [`openclaw connect`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/connect) continuing to wait on a join link after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. An interrupted lookup no longer reports a late join error or starts the node. If the Gateway already redeemed the code, use a new one to retry.
  [PR #187315](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187315). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes Host Desktop checks locking the viewer out of a password-protected TigerVNC desktop. Managed Linux desktops verify their password before reporting readiness, and rejected passwords get specific guidance. An unreadable attach password file no longer blocks managed startup when there’s no existing desktop to attach to.
  [#193487](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193487). Thanks [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the [release backport](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/768ce7b90ddb18be63413a1100827668adee8645).
- Opens eligible tunnel or host-and-port dashboards under the authenticated Gateway’s advertised Control UI path.
  [Dashboard path commit 4d1b585](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Fixes [Crabbox cloud-worker setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/troubleshooting) downloads giving up too soon during a brief Gateway outage. Setup retries temporary Cloudflare errors for longer.
  [#173810](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173810). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [session catalog discovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/session-catalogs) waiting on queued pairing updates even when the paired-node list is already available.
  [#173817](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173817). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes certain node-worker bundle storage errors going unreported, as if the bundle were missing. If installing a replacement and restoring the old bundle both fail, the error tells you where the backup was left.
  [PR #174142](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174142). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [`openclaw attach`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/attach) crashing when the Gateway sends a connection grant with an expiry outside the supported date range. The command reports the invalid response and tries to revoke any grant token it received.
  [PR #174534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174534) · [commit 944eba4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/944eba49f398480d2776f3698a7605f719dcc6bf). Thanks [@YangManBOBO](https://github.com/YangManBOBO) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops shared-token Gateway calls from requiring unrelated local database credentials. Paired-device authentication still uses the configured device identity.
  [PR #175069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175069). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds log redaction for sensitive answers you enter in the terminal during remote Gateway setup.
  [PR #175096](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175096) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2546201ca6b4cf2a180aec143058460816321ce1). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents stalled desktop cleanup from blocking [dedicated cloud-worker teardown](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle) indefinitely during Stop, forced destruction, or idle reclaim. Shared or unknown hosts still need confirmation that their worker stopped. If you see a cleanup warning, check the provider’s lease status and retry Stop if the machine is still running.
  [PR #175189](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175189) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8457e29a4d0140c7185e74bab673f5f72db94844) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@saftall](https://github.com/saftall) for the [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/166196).
- Fixes stale entries piling up in [Gateway presence](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/presence) when the same Control UI device reconnects. Open tabs still show up separately, and only the most recent offline entry is kept briefly after the last tab disconnects.
  [PR #175352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175352). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway error that could occur just after a session history stream disconnected.
  [#175846](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175846) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/964d3238270df34715cd3064ca1d3625facbc8db). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes a fallback in webchat device pairing that could be triggered before the Gateway showed its QR code.
  [#178419](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178419). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway startup making authenticated clients wait for one agent’s database before they can connect and read sessions that are already available. The model list arrives when it’s ready instead of holding up the connection. Healthy channel accounts can also start while another agent’s store is still becoming ready, after startup prerequisites are met.
  [#185732](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185732). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Bonjour’s bundled discovery code being unable to load its dependencies after installation from affected pnpm-built packages.
  [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44d96512e0ea13f6343bbe72515e95916253cf71). The commit names Alfred J Berchtold and credits @alfredjbclaw, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc as co-authors.

##### Gateway operations

- Restores Gateway memory-pressure protection for idle workers when diagnostics are disabled.
  [#160765](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/160765) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Reduces optional worker-placement maintenance during Gateway shutdown and adds the pending placement phase to shutdown diagnostics. Accepted work can still take time to finish.
  [#172971](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172971) · [Gateway restart and recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/restart-recovery.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes normal Gateway HTTP shutdown being logged as an unexpected request failure when an in-flight request was closing.
  [#172996](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172996) · [Gateway logging](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/logging.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a Gateway shutdown and restart stall on macOS under Node when the system directory monitoring service is busy.
  [#173016](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173016) · [commit 0dc6b7fc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0dc6b7fcd6fa70cb654f5cbebc070fc1d7a7960e) · [commit 133b8ec1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/133b8ec1d5b28791dbf38f4158b785ba271f2552) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes memory accumulating from retired model catalogs and stopped Control UI services after repeated configuration or plugin reloads.
  [#173271](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173271) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces memory that can linger in a long-running Gateway after it processes large state snapshots. Repeatedly processing exceptionally large snapshots can take more work.
  [#174677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174677) · [commit f82e6b2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f82e6b21284a0adbf652862cea705efcb302dde1) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes node-backed worker portal shutdown reporting completion while a request is still finishing on the OpenClaw side. An overlapping shutdown still waits if the portal connection has already closed.
  [#177798](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177798) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Warns when automatic idle-worker cleanup fails and leaves a slot reserved. Check the node host and, for container-isolated workers, the container engine. [Node troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/troubleshooting)
  [#177806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177806) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes idle workers remaining active under critical memory pressure on Bun. It also protects Code Mode worker cleanup, SQLite close-probe progress reporting and HTTP rejections waiting for an earlier response.
  [#178150](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178150) · [commit 4a2fb285](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4a2fb285671d8bf5c5c12c657c2910f410d54112) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps Bonjour, browser automation and the QA Lab Crabline recorder from changing host-wide process behavior when they load. Bonjour filters only its own responder messages, and Crabline preserves the application's existing signal handlers.
  [#182826](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182826) · [Bonjour discovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/bonjour) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents stop and restart retries for the Windows Scheduled Task Gateway from ending early or waiting too long if the system clock changes while SQLite is busy.
  [#183002](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183002) · [commit db6fc299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db6fc2996635567379071597aedc033eb2341baf) · [Gateway service](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/service) · Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes duplicate config reload notifications when automatic config watching recovers from a failure. Edits made during the interruption are still picked up.
  [#183230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183230) · [commit c409abe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c409abe1885583a49a2938f689f2f5e18ef8e3da) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes pending Gateway hook requests receiving a service-unavailable error when credentials are refreshed without changing the configuration.
  [#172266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172266) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents idle Skills watches on node-backed workspaces from delaying Gateway restarts after a settings change or blocking Gateway suspension.
  [#186415](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186415) · Thanks [@freeqaz](https://github.com/freeqaz).
- Fixes waits that could end early or run long after the system clock changed, including browser startup and actions, Gateway suspension and plugin lifecycle operations. The correction also covers selected Discord and Slack startup, setup, meeting, media, MCP and agent waits, and keeps node statistics saving on schedule.
  [Timing sweep #186484](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186484) · [#186039](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186039) · [#186134](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186134) · [#186412](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186412) · [#184716](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184716) · [#184613](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184613) · [#184576](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184576) · [#184525](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184525) · [#182064](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182064) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@mikasa0818](https://github.com/mikasa0818).
- Stops routine Gateway replacements in Kubernetes or under declared external supervision from warning about a competing supervisor. A late shutdown request during an in-process restart is also reported as a normal stop.
  [#186491](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186491) · Thanks [@freeqaz](https://github.com/freeqaz).
- Prevents the Gateway from stopping after it rejects input that is no longer valid in a shared session. The rejected input still does not run.
  [#186580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186580) · Thanks to steipete.
- Stops pending usage scans from holding up Gateway shutdown and limits how long the Gateway CLI waits for cleanup after a failed start.
  [#187877](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187877) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Reduces unnecessary Gateway load on Windows when files unrelated to settings or personal skills change elsewhere in your home folder.
  [#188324](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188324) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and thanks to [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) for the release backport.
- Fixes a Gateway startup failure that could happen even after a successful configuration health check.
  [#189722](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/189722) · [follow-up commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d173339f9c7ae9bf34f33d624a2d8bd3a5eccbe6) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes early Gateway requests racing the initial configuration check and reload during startup.
  [#172266](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172266) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a startup slowdown in commands that talk to an already-running Gateway, where unnecessary disk work on large SQLite state databases could hold up the command and other database writes. The fix applies when OpenClaw can verify that the Gateway owns the live database.
  [#190761](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190761) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) (release backport b1e4976a32).
- Prevents Gateway startup and affected background reads from failing immediately when another process temporarily locks the shared state database. OpenClaw waits a short time for the lock to clear.
  [#195398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/195398) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes Gateway startup giving up when the previous Gateway process exits during startup checks. Startup continues once the old process is confirmed stopped.
  [#200334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200334) · [commit d0790897](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d079089798a7b07e0962868d263b144756ff75ee) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa).
- Fixes slow worker environment checks holding up Gateway suspension or shutdown. Cancelling a check leaves the environment in place so the Gateway can check it again after resuming.
  [#178538](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178538) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops `openclaw gateway suspend --wait` from retrying after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. If a request was already sent and does suspend the Gateway, the command still prints the ID you can use with [`openclaw gateway resume`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/query).
  [#186886](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186886) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/90d6cf560292d4906fff5b48edaba774ea250629) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).

##### Accounts, credentials and approvals

- Fixes new approval cards using old links or forwarding accounts after configuration reload. Approvals already in progress keep their original delivery settings.
  [#138553](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/138553) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents malformed UTF-8 approval imports from corrupting and replacing the saved allowlist. [Approvals CLI reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/cli/approvals.md)
