  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167273">PR #167273</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a984f7723914e75c5a5a9a23c802aa356faedb95">`a984f77`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/Alix-007">@Alix-007</a>, <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes local Pi, Codex and opted-in container commands using the wrong GitHub account or host. With a managed GitHub identity selected, Codex uses OpenClaw’s execution tools and disables native shell and Code Mode. If the selected profile is unavailable, reconnect or select another identity before retrying. Agents that borrow tool policy use their own selected identity. Paired nodes use their own GitHub sign-in.
  [PR #171168](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171168) · [8cfc3d4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8cfc3d4879ee8d3dc4535124af7f3e2de2bf4d00) · [PR #171218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171218) · [14eee34](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14eee3444e39e83a6a95591a128200571b5b1304). Thanks to [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes GitHub commands losing authentication during long repository-bound cloud-worker turns. Later commands can use the renewed credential while the turn remains authorized. Commands already running keep the credential they started with. Older workers may need a rebuild and retry.
  [PR #171212](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171212) · [824fde2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/824fde2bfab6f335ba493819c804339c538abcca). Thanks to [@galiniliev](https://github.com/galiniliev) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes pairing QR images disappearing from Control UI chat when history refreshes. Run [`/pair qr`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/pairing) again after a reload, reconnect or authentication change.
  [#172806](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172806). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ixxyjixxy](https://github.com/Ixxyjixxy).
- Requests native permissions when enabling an [installed ACP agent](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/acp-agents-setup) in Models. Consented chats start with **Full access** and optional sandboxing off. The native app controls its own permissions.
  [#172815](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172815). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes cooldown replies revealing the operator’s saved-login label to conversation participants. Affected replies give generic retry guidance.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173255">#173255</a> · Thanks [@pgondhi987](https://github.com/pgondhi987).</span>
- Fixes quoted OAuth callback URLs and URLs with escaped ampersands being rejected before node execution approval on `sh`. Quote the full callback URL so it reaches the usual approval checks.
  Thanks to [@fionn77](https://github.com/fionn77), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), and [@xiaopan-xydt](https://github.com/xiaopan-xydt). [#173273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173273) · [#173240](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173240) · [Node execution guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/node-exec.md)
- Fixes pairing allowlist checks hanging when the state database is replaced while the check is waiting. The check reports that the database changed.
  [#175628](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175628) · [9cea70f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9cea70faa44f3cc43d506032bec1cf31787ec775). Thanks steipete.
- Prevents new native Codex work from using a session’s old permissions after access is revoked or its parent session changes. This includes starting or resuming threads, sending turns and opening `/btw` side questions. [Codex runtime guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/codex-harness/runtime-behavior)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176352), [1398ba9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1398ba9837e19da853bb6b1d6623cb6fee5421f6).
- Fixes chat showing an old approval again when it is no longer pending for that conversation.
  Thanks [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski). [#176367](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176367), [58dcfc0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/58dcfc01287d12997106ceff40cd5cca286717e7).
- Helps prevent an unrecognized session owner from cutting short work the agent already has permission to do in a prepared workspace. Owner-authorized agents can look up registered profiles. If an assignment fails because the owner is unknown, select a registered person or use **Assign to me**.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176401](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176401), [cd7ebe9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cd7ebe9be15f7e14dbf472a8a6d0191aac7cf864).
- Prevents an approval button left on screen from acting on the previous item after you switch approvals. Avoids loading intermediate items when the approval or question changes in quick succession.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176634">#176634</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/04ec2430fe1ec97483a6fa87f6f68c3f056342d2">04ec2430</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Blocks new input from OpenClaw’s built-in Mac automation while an OpenClaw approval is waiting for you. Its screen snapshots leave out OpenClaw during the prompt or are skipped if the app can’t be hidden. Adds Escape to cancel the fallback command approval prompt. The safeguards cover OpenClaw’s own prompts, and some input already in progress can continue. Keep unrestricted computer use off for untrusted models when command approvals are set to ask.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and contributor [@mtbba8-afk](https://github.com/mtbba8-afk). [#176751](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176751) · [commit 60cfa37](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/60cfa37acc6eb1fd9a7daccc3ecb00f035094fbd) · [Mac computer use](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/nodes/computer-use.md) · [Command approvals](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/exec-approvals.md)
- Prevents an installed Gateway or node service from inheriting temporary secret-egress proxy trust. On an affected managed Gateway, run `openclaw doctor --fix` to repair the service and preserve your own certificate settings. Doctor can bring the service back up if it was running before the repair.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177007">#177007</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/176479">Report #176479</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/secrets/secret-store-and-egress">Secret store and egress</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) and [@hehuang139](https://github.com/hehuang139).</span>
- Prevents Gateway disconnects and interruptions to accepted work when an identity permission edit leaves effective access unchanged. Role changes also leave unaffected work running. Revocations stop affected work, while widening or restoring a role does not give existing work more access or restart revoked work. [Gateway configuration reloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload)
  [Identity permission reloads #177254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177254) · [Role reload commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b0777e11ffb6e2bcaa468654a4518e8cb6abff57) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for #177254.
- Fixes trusted-proxy read-only limits that could deny read access to operators whose write permission already included it, including on automatically approved devices. Read-only limits admit only read access, and Gateway audit logs reflect the identity permissions actually granted. [Trusted-proxy authentication](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/trusted-proxy-auth)
  [#177254](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177254). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Doctor asking you to sign in to Claude CLI again when it couldn’t tell whether you were signed in. It reports that it couldn’t check and suggests `claude auth status --json` instead.
  [#177283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177283). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents repeated or conflicting clicks from sending another device or node pairing decision while the first is pending. Screen readers now hear the device name on each pending device’s Approve and Reject buttons.
  [#177571](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177571) · [f172da3c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f172da3c5130b2d017329fc5795dbae2569a8139) · [Issue #127580](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127580). Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@vyctorbrzezowski](https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes silent cancellations when a pending secret-input prompt can’t be delivered. The warning identifies failed delivery and keeps the prompt and private error details out of the log.
  [#177688](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177688) · [3e151582](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3e151582c15b909a319330dde1b638ec5090c9e5). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Mac app failing to read or save command approval rules when OpenClaw uses PostgreSQL, so native commands use the policy you configured. On PostgreSQL and SQLite, the app rejects saves based on outdated rules and checks current permissions when authorizing a command. The final check blocks commands whose permission was revoked and allows commands that current rules still permit. Use a compatible Mac app and CLI with access to the configured database. [Native command approvals](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec-approvals)
  [#177795](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177795) · [dcaf3d92](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dcaf3d92fcd208737f447fbc1eb3093182cc2c9b). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes client credential migration failing after restoring a newly created backup of older execution-approval settings. The backup preserves the approval policy and leaves out the socket token.
  [#177848](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177848) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes migrations and rebuilds of large client credential stores failing with a SQLite size error. Fixes the Gateway rejecting intact client credentials at startup after a verified Btrfs database repair, so existing clients can reconnect without pairing again. If an older build stopped with `too many SQL variables`, install the fixed build and rerun `openclaw doctor --fix`. [Database versioning guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/database-schemas/versioning)
  [#177925](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177925) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Checks current session access before committing fresh input and keeps tool effects, child tasks and replies tied to the session that authorized them.
  [#177939](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177939) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant).
- Fixes recorded approvals being reported as expired when later delivery fails. When a command cannot run, the result distinguishes a decline, timeout, missing approval or other failure where the reason is known. [Exec guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec)
  [#177940](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177940) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant), [@eleqtrizit](https://github.com/eleqtrizit) (co-author).
- Fixes 502 errors in protected commands when the destination is only reachable through the Gateway’s proxy. Protected requests follow the Gateway’s proxy settings and exclusions. Restart the Gateway if you change those settings. [Secret egress proxy settings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/secrets/secret-store-and-egress.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178080">#178080</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e6a1ed1b9058ffc01585ce1cbd8d9a2a08dba032">e6a1ed1b</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/170145">#170145</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@mogol](https://github.com/mogol) for the report.
- Stops the standalone approval page from piling up duplicate checks when you switch back to its tab while it’s still waiting. Retry can use the check already in progress and still shows that it’s working.
  [#178217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178217) · [commit b814a1e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b814a1efcde739ad4494f6f10821047b439e900c) · [issue #127579](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/127579). Thanks [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm) and [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd), and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the report.
- Prevents safely retryable OAuth refresh failures from forcing another sign-in. This includes temporary failures for managed Google Meet, Vertex authorized-user ADC and delegated Microsoft Teams accounts, and readable rate-limit or server-error responses from xAI unless the provider explicitly rejects the sign-in. Calls already waiting for the same refresh share its failure. If OpenClaw can’t confirm whether a one-time refresh credential was used, reconnect the affected account when prompted. [OAuth recovery guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/auth-credential-semantics#recovering-an-interrupted-rotating-refresh)
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646) · [`6a4ac84`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a4ac8401a591d3cb5b6c2a20d311a3b961f9f2e) · Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Fixes MCP sign-in appearing to succeed with credentials it can no longer use. It opens a fresh sign-in when an earlier refresh left the credential unusable and reports failures from the current sign-in.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646) · [`6a4ac84`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a4ac8401a591d3cb5b6c2a20d311a3b961f9f2e) · Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps completed refreshes for GitHub, X and Twitch from leaving OpenClaw without the updated sign-in. Vertex leaves externally managed ADC credentials under their existing owner.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646) · [`6a4ac84`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a4ac8401a591d3cb5b6c2a20d311a3b961f9f2e) · Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Keeps provider response bodies out of Anthropic OAuth refresh errors.
  [#178646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178646) · [`6a4ac84`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a4ac8401a591d3cb5b6c2a20d311a3b961f9f2e) · Thanks [@stronggenetics](https://github.com/Stronggenetics) and [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Prevents Claude CLI from automatically replaying saved conversations under the wrong sign-in when OpenClaw detects that readable local administrator settings switch Claude Code away from your native login. The check covers local policy files when you opt in to native-login history recovery. [History account boundaries](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends#history-account-boundaries)
  [#178929](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178929). Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Mac app, Gateway and nodes getting stuck after an update because client credentials or approvals still needed migration. Supported upgrades prepare them automatically and keep existing device identities, pairing tokens and approvals, including credentials for profiles that were offline during the update.
  <span>[#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) · [Mac app and bundled Gateway](https://docs.openclaw.ai/platforms/mac/bundled-gateway) · [Node startup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/node)</span>
- Fixes startup refusing a database after a remount when OpenClaw can verify it is still the same database. Missing or conflicting credentials and a different database generation require explicit recovery.
  <span>[#178998](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178998) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev) · [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running)</span>
- Fixes two controls that could respond to an earlier screen state after an update. **Refresh** during login recovery and **Open session** on approval cards use the current action. **Close** and cancel also act on the current loading dialog.
  <span>[#179069](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179069) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)</span>
- Fixes a paired Mac also appearing under **Connected without pairing** in **Settings → Devices**. An old duplicate can remain until it expires, normally after five minutes.
  <span>[#179067](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179067) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@edosulai](https://github.com/edosulai) · [Device presence guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/presence)</span>
- Fixes unnecessary pairing prompts when the CLI or a connection check uses the Mac app’s already-approved identity and the device family still matches.
  <span>[#179081](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179081) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@josephbergvinson](https://github.com/josephbergvinson), [@ProActive2023](https://github.com/ProActive2023), [@dprev](https://github.com/dprev) · [Pairing guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/pairing#metadata-upgrade-auto-approval)</span>
- Fixes Doctor mislabeling unchanged environment-backed credentials as plaintext when previewing or repairing configuration. Doctor also warns about literal credentials that were being missed, including escaped environment placeholders. [Doctor guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/gateway-and-services)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179896">#179896</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171039">#171039</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/171022">#171022</a> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@ooiuuii](https://github.com/ooiuuii), and [@exgeni](https://github.com/exGeni) for the related report.</span>
- Fixes read-only and session-only members being blocked from changing their own display name, avatar or Git co-author credit preference in Settings → Profile. Session-only members can see their own avatar, with access tied to the currently signed-in identity.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179924">#179924</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/df72d285c4e73b11d10f372e816c08718b5c7aa5">commit df72d285</a>. Thanks to [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes MCP sign-in messages that pointed you to a terminal command that couldn’t work. Use Settings for servers you configured, **Connect** on the plugin’s Settings page for servers it supplies, or the channel’s connect flow for an account connected there. If you use terminal sign-in for a server you configured, stop the Gateway first and restart it when you’re done. [MCP sign-in and recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/control-ui)
  Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen). [#180222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180222) · [commit ec39df0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ec39df06ca9682962e98540ed98e139596643789)
- Disables the relevant pairing, cleanup, removal and token controls while a Devices action is running, and keeps expanded details open during the refresh. Leaving the page or reconnecting clears the old progress display without canceling the action or hiding a one-time replacement token that OpenClaw receives.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180346">PR #180346</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/702a59916f67f95411c83f1c3d443c71c40972e3">Commit 702a599</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Clears the old save indicator for device bindings and execution approvals when the page, target or Gateway changes. A rejected execution approval save shows the error and keeps your edits available.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180375">PR #180375</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5d0eef65978f3bf9397e155bc7a07b71c1d1487a">Commit 5d0eef6</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes Reload leaving the old device pairing error on screen without showing that a new check is running. The dialog shows progress and blocks repeat pairing actions while it checks. Closing and reopening it does not leave the new dialog waiting on the old check.
  Thanks to steipete. [#180560](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180560) · [49c1ab9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/49c1ab9aca872d4516972910565f6224d6b4c064)
- Fixes Doctor sending local-only installations to channel setup for administrator access. If you need local admin access, run `openclaw dashboard` on the Gateway host, or choose **Inbox → System → Limited access → Request admin** in a limited-access browser and approve the request on the host. [Control UI connection and pairing](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/connect-and-pair)
  Thanks to steipete and issue reporter pawelbbdrozd. [#180598](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180598) · [5688232](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5688232f8a3d776e3bc850adf697786c30c7fb0f) · [Issue #180530](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180530)
- Fixes agents getting a generic error when a secure credential request can’t open from chat because the Control UI is disabled or its public address isn’t configured. Your agent gets the same guidance you do on retrying in a trusted Control UI or native app, or asking an operator to configure the address. [Secure credential requests](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/secrets)
  Thanks to vincentkoc. [#180663](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180663) · [9d48273](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9d4827306a89deb997628dae3d573ee634240d33)
- Fixes the plugin credential editor showing the old discard error while you retry Cancel. If a credential check fails after saving, a successful Retry clears the error without saving the credential again.
  [#180804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180804) · [commit 00ccde5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/00ccde559bc752a82c53a0c143ccecf485bfae98) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes PostgreSQL Gateways exiting during startup when the agent that supplies shared credentials is still preparing. Agents that have finished preparing can start with their own credentials, and inherited credentials become available automatically once their owner is ready.
  [#181198](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181198) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e477d35bf13e384c417b977877d1e9811f7d0c5)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert). Reported by [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert) ([#180631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180631)).
- Restores a recovery path when a Gateway host loses its local credentials but still has its PostgreSQL state. If a matching backup is unavailable, run [`openclaw doctor --fix`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/doctor/running) and confirm the repair. Clients on that host must pair again, while already-paired remote devices that kept their credentials can reconnect.
  [#181201](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181201) ([commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aa5de0fd379cfb1eb54ead833e57e5272e3f64b2)). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@ceckert](https://github.com/ceckert).
- Fixes cloud-worker shell commands failing to get automatic review or a one-time human approval from the Gateway under the configured exec policy. Update the Gateway and installed worker bundles together. [Cloud-worker security model](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/security-model)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182356">#182356</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/db38f86b6d086631347af055d2bc87a653b7e8c8">db38f86b6d08</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167183">earlier transport draft #167183</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178560">#178560</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author), [@ferrine](https://github.com/ferrine) (earlier transport work), and [@davidcittadini](https://github.com/davidcittadini) (reporter).
- Stores environment-backed provider credentials from Linux Gateway auth profiles in an owner-only systemd environment file. Reinstall an affected Gateway service to move its credentials out of the unit and scrub the unit backup. Reinstall can preserve credentials already installed even if your shell no longer exports them.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182413">#182413</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95895">#95895</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author), [@615Works](https://github.com/615Works) (reporter), and [@mattgodbolt-molty](https://github.com/mattgodbolt-molty) (corroborating reporter).
- Removes misleading limited-access Inbox warnings for intentionally restricted guests and keeps access guidance in **Settings → Profile → Your access**, even after dismissal. Hides **Request admin** when your role cannot grant it. If you need more access, ask a Gateway administrator to change your role, then reconnect and request separate approval for this browser.
  [#183018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183018) · [b3aa84d0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b3aa84d0d79e3bfe7f2ef697fec3f5bf15b634fd) · Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13). · [Connect and pair](https://docs.openclaw.ai/web/control-ui/connect-and-pair) · [Related guest access work #185005](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185005)
- Fixes [`openclaw security audit`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/security/audit-checks) overlooking effective host command access. The audit flags full access with approvals turned off and reports a critical finding when an open channel can reach an agent with full host command access.
  Thanks [@lonexreb](https://github.com/lonexreb) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), with [@nik-greek](https://github.com/nik-greek) reporting the issue. [#183559](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183559) · [#183541](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183541)
- Fixes model setup, provider sign-in, runtime setup, and hosted onboarding hitting a permission error after they start. Model setup and hosted onboarding can finish after reconnecting where the flow supports it. Removing or reducing the starting device’s access stops an activation that hasn’t been saved. Browser-based provider and MCP sign-in still stop on disconnect.
  [#183777](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183777). Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [commit crediting the original report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/921f25822b7670a3fd1566909d158350dbcdbc3b). Thanks to [@Sedrak-Hovhannisyan](https://github.com/Sedrak-Hovhannisyan).
- Fixes native Claude Code tools being denied without an approval prompt under `on-miss` or `always` when an approval route is available. A failed approval request leaves the tool blocked, and the Gateway logs errors other than aborts.
  <span><a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cli-backends">Native tool approvals</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183984">#183984</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/holgergruenhagen">@holgergruenhagen</a>.</span>
- Fixes approval-gated agent runs timing out early or running past their limit when the system clock changes. Prevents clock changes from cutting off a pending plugin approval early or delaying recovery after its wait expires.
  Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#184116](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184116) · [b39ec5bd63ec](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b39ec5bd63ecc5eef862797518e5a331f1b459c3)
- Stops repeated connection attempts and warnings across sessions and workspaces when the same MCP server is waiting for you to sign in. Its tools stay hidden while the catalog shows [how to sign in](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp), and OpenClaw can try again after you do.
  [#184344](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184344). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a permissions issue that prevented signed-in, session-only users on multi-user Gateways from reading or saving their own instructions in [Settings → Profile → Personal instructions](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/user-model) or through the personal-instructions chat tool.
  [#184980](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184980) · [84faa380](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/84faa3803475e1be410816240ae37040b5a80f70). Thanks [@PollyBot13](https://github.com/PollyBot13).
- Fixes MCP sign-in failing after browser approval for providers such as Linear that require issuer verification. If you complete sign-in manually in the CLI and the callback includes an issuer, pass that same value with `--issuer` alongside `--code`. The Control UI gives specific recovery guidance and tells you if credentials were already saved.
  [#185334](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185334) · [6f483d3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6f483d3932b2db88dc58975d8c0fbac1173de879). [Manual MCP sign-in](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/transports) · [Control UI sign-in](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/control-ui). Thanks [@Patrick-Erichsen](https://github.com/Patrick-Erichsen).
- Fixes host-only native runtimes such as Muse Code refusing an owner’s own messages, including in Telegram chats, after the owner chose to remember that runtime’s permissions for the agent. The fix applies to the live owner’s own turns, subject to explicit chat restrictions and configured sandboxes.
  [#185597](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185597) · [64f2ce2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/64f2ce2ac296024e5f3c9d16829164dbaaec6682) · [Muse Code guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/muse) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Stops a running subagent before its next native-runtime step once the channel owner who spawned it loses owner access.
  [#185796](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185796) · [`3748a9d`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3748a9d0c31194c19e5190d2acbfd73e555d71a0) · Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus)
- Fixes overlapping agent turns failing to use the same OAuth account even after a successful refresh. Signing out or switching accounts still prevents a turn from using the old sign-in.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185880">#185880</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes native harness runs failing to receive the Allow or Deny decision for their own requests when the operator has write access but no reviewer permissions. The run still can’t approve requests itself.
  [#186461](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186461). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents [secret-store imports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/secrets) from replacing stored values when a file or standard input contains invalid UTF-8. Secrets migration refuses to rewrite affected settings or environment files with invalid UTF-8 instead of saving damaged text. Shell completion installation also leaves invalid UTF-8 profiles untouched, and Doctor and setup show how to load completion for the current shell session.
  [#186476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186476), [#167250](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167250), [#168460](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/168460), [#175125](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175125). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@hugenshen](https://github.com/hugenshen), [@wangmiao0668000666](https://github.com/wangmiao0668000666).
- Fixes `openclaw policy compare` reading the wrong file when the filename passed to `--policy` starts or ends with a space. If the file you specified is missing, the command reports it missing instead of comparing a different file.
  [PR #187218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187218). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Makes Allow once readable on the standalone approval page in light mode, where the label was nearly invisible against the button.
  [PR #187550](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187550). Thanks to Alix-007, obviyus and dh-js.
- Fixes the local Mac Gateway missing supported environment-based credentials or letting a remote-client token suppress its local password. Provider and allowlist checks still apply.
  [Credential resolution commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d1b585d1f4662c24f52e591b86133a0f0ce0546).
- Stops managed attachment downloads, including thumbnails, when the reader loses access to the conversation. Transfers in progress stop too, and browsers are told not to cache the files from those links. A normal disconnect does not revoke access, and files already downloaded cannot be recalled.
  [PR #174137](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174137). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents xAI device-code sign-in from timing out early or checking for approval for too long when your system clock changes.
  [PR #174227](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174227). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes [setup](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/wizard-cli-reference) leaving a verified replacement sign-in pending after an upgrade. Setup keeps your existing provider settings and workspace, and leaves newer edits alone if activation fails.
  [#175138](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175138) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents pending Web Push subscription and approval changes from taking effect after the Gateway revokes the permission they were submitted under.
  [#175230](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175230) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes [Gateway role reloads](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload) disconnecting operators or stopping accepted work when their existing permissions still allow it. Widening a role does not grant an existing connection more access. Removing required permissions still disconnects affected operators and stops their work, and restoring access does not restart it.
  [#175251](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175251) · Thanks steipete.
- Fixes personal GitHub connection status showing as unavailable when unrelated changes are waiting to be saved. Connection lookups during OAuth maintenance can also read the saved connection without waiting for those writes.
  [PR #175319](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175319) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cf8b64523296d5ef198e780521ff205bfa792763) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Codex command approvals looking like someone rejected them when OpenClaw could not offer the command for approval. The notice explains why no one was asked and suggests what to try next.
  [PR #186876](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186876) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/afc8bcdbc8f9843f9aa6041a1f0e90dc3590dbae) · Thanks [@freeqaz](https://github.com/freeqaz).
- Fixes invalid, unreadable or conflicting legacy approvals files blocking Gateway and node startup. OpenClaw starts with a warning and keeps current approvals usable and editable. If there are no current rules, execution approvals stay unavailable until migration succeeds. Before running `openclaw doctor --fix` in the same state directory, stop older nodes or other writers and [reconcile the old file](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/exec-approvals), preserving the intended SQLite policy.
  [#196401](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/196401) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Redacts recognized credentials from [MCP CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/registry) `list --json` and `show` output without changing saved credentials. Scripts that used these commands to export credentials need another source; previously captured output is unchanged.
  [#180321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180321) · Thanks [@brandon-julio-t](https://github.com/brandon-julio-t) and [@wr-web](https://github.com/wr-web).
- Prevents malformed legacy device-auth files from being imported as corrupted credentials. Doctor identifies the file and leaves it untouched so you can [restore a valid copy from backup and retry](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/doctor/state-and-sessions).
  [#180544](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180544) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@KrasimirKralev](https://github.com/KrasimirKralev).

##### Configuration and settings

- Fixes configuration saves reporting success when an external edit has already overwritten them. Reread the configuration and reapply the intended change. See the [configuration reload guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/configuration/hot-reload).
  [Configuration save conflicts #172426](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172426) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5475f92deefc9e9f791130567a9f33c9537a727a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Monitoring and reports

- Fixes deep status hiding warnings for quarantined context engines and disabled configuration reload. The warnings explain the context-engine fallback or when to restart the Gateway.
  [Status command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) [#117220](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/117220) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes security audits missing some allowed plugin tools and reporting open channel exposure inconsistently.
  [Security audit command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/security) [#118512](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/118512) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes readable status reports missing degraded-secret warnings and improves credential masking in diagnostic details, health-check failures, Doctor connection notes and Gateway client diagnostics.
  [Status command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) · [Status and diagnostic details #126786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/126786) · [Health, Doctor and Gateway diagnostics #127073](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/127073) · [Gateway logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the Logs page losing its incomplete-history warning while older entries are still missing, including when the display buffer drops them.

- Keeps recognized Incognito session details and errors out of the affected formatted diagnostic logs. Diagnostic events still reach listeners.
  [#156429](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156429). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes Windows Gateway scheduled-task inspection rejecting quoted environment-variable log paths, and health checks timing out against a healthy scheduled Gateway when its listener cannot be attributed.

- Fixes missing usage diagnostics for memory flushes and Skill Workshop reviews. With diagnostics enabled, completed runs that report billable usage have their own token counts and any available cost estimate.
  [PR #169179](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/169179) · [f92d068](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f92d06804624962fe4a8a778b8f3ef1762171e24). Thanks to [@pratikrai0101](https://github.com/pratikrai0101), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@th-m-vogel](https://github.com/th-m-vogel).
- Fixes trajectory exports using the wrong directory when an output name has leading or trailing spaces.
  [#171608](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171608) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes model-call traces losing reported five-minute and one-hour cache-write counts for Anthropic models, including on Amazon Bedrock.
  [#171663](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171663) · [OpenTelemetry spans and events](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/opentelemetry/spans-and-events.md) · Thanks [@ryan-dyer-sp](https://github.com/ryan-dyer-sp) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the system agent rejecting health requests as an unknown action, so it can answer with the existing Gateway health snapshot.
  [#172001](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172001) · Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925).
- Fixes keyboard focus being lost from Logbook actions such as **Analyze now** when the page refreshes.
  [#172060](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172060) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Warns in `openclaw config validate` when custom `logging.redactPatterns` entries are invalid or unsafe and restores configuration warnings in Doctor and directory inspection when malformed rules would have hidden them. Correct the flagged patterns because values they were meant to hide can appear in logs.
  [Configuration validation #172551](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172551) · [commit cc4315e](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc4315e0deff7b3a608bc619b03d8ca824ff1f7e) · [Doctor and directory inspection #173471](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173471) · [commit 072e842](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/072e8420ddc19a26e33467a791d2832e67d0c28b) · [Issue #173461](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173461) · [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging). Thanks [@maliv2](https://github.com/maliv2) and co-author Tak Hoffman for #172551, [@IntegraCalatrava](https://github.com/IntegraCalatrava) for reporting it, and [@skyzhao1223](https://github.com/skyzhao1223), [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) and [@moerai](https://github.com/MoerAI) for #173471.
- Removes suppressed reply previews, background command text, tool argument previews and malformed file-read input previews from the affected diagnostic logs.
  [Suppressed replies and background commands #172669](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172669) · [Tool diagnostics #172992](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172992) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Bun version, uncaught-error, CLI and Gateway diagnostics hiding the reason for affected failures.
  [Version and uncaught errors #172774](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172774) · [CLI and Gateway errors #173159](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173159) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa), [@xialonglee](https://github.com/xialonglee) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes message, command, attachment and malformed-input content from selected channel diagnostics, including Discord voice excerpts. Telegram raw-update logs also redact strings in unfamiliar fields.

- Fixes overlapping Logbook standup saves returning another caller’s receipt.

- Fixes session delivery recovery warnings missing the failure reason or queue ID, including when final cleanup fails.

Retirement labels distinguish `eviction`, `idle-expiry`, `dispose`, `shutdown`, `crash` and `gc-thrash`. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Logbook silently treating malformed stored distraction JSON as an empty list. The timeline reports the read error and preserves the stored card.

  [#173523](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173523) · [a05b8f6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a05b8f6e552c11340df8ab706e7a8ab180701dec) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Avoids a JavaScript wakeup after every garbage collection in instrumented Node workers and the main process. Native GC metrics now use `reason="other"`, so update dashboards or alerts that filter on the old reasons. [Prometheus metrics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus)
  [#173574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173574) · [9a8ef35](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9a8ef35a96ed78d88310c0247b1749aca9fada92) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway health checks falsely timing out healthy channels or waiting much too long for stalled ones when the system clock changes. Reported check durations reflect elapsed time.
  [#173904](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173904) · [Landed commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3020cb46d4737c0a1b1085e9d5eb6985bf33821b) · Thanks sunnyshu0925 and obviyus.
- Fixes unused worker pools and the data they hold lingering in memory after OpenClaw has finished with them.
  [#175496](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175496). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway CPU profile summaries hiding the OpenClaw callers of dependency work, and CPU and heap profiles hiding identifiable OpenClaw function names and source locations. Private paths stay hidden.
  [Gateway diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/diagnostics.md) · [CPU callers #175391](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175391) · [Profile attribution #184878](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184878) · [commit a83eebda](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a83eebda23b8ecf0ccf017fb2d82bfac66bdc1fd) · [Gateway CPU and heap profiles](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway stability bundles leaving out which OpenClaw build was running when a failure occurred. Offline inspection shows the saved version, build ID and commit when available, even if the installation has since been updated.
  [#175631](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175631) · [1a498e4](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1a498e41fb0c09910243f3d616209f592988c977). Thanks vincentkoc.
- Fixes Activity’s Run Inspector suggesting a Gateway upgrade for certain inspection errors even when the UI and Gateway are on the same version. For those errors, it offers a retry if the first load fails and keeps the results you already have if loading more fails.
  [#175713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175713) · [51e003d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/51e003d37df231b61a8cdec0370444dfdd46ebe7). Thanks steipete.
- Keeps Gateway health and memory-pressure checks on schedule while memory is sampled.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176411](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176411), [73c8498](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/73c8498ea5ae5f38b710b8e178df2c993b11d036).
- Fixes Gateway audit logging stopping after one malformed record. The bad record is still dropped, and valid records can continue to be logged. Also fixes repeated attempts to trim audit history when the log is already within its record limit.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176608">#176608</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/3a2d76f8ddd9eda3397a798affde0b8a510a1e5f">3a2d76f8</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@aniruddhaadak80](https://github.com/aniruddhaadak80).
- Fixes session diagnostics continuing to show processing after a reply fails to start, and labeling a stalled model attempt as an ordinary reply after it is accepted for recovery.
  [Reply startup #176682](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176682) · [commit d6ec4c7d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d6ec4c7de8919a1711d0a87798776e1fd5264d97) · [Stuck-session recovery #177406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177406) · [commit 0da2fc1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/0da2fc11fb80f270164b313a095aad8162a5e8eb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@enki](https://github.com/enki) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Stops routine channel activity from triggering redundant Gateway health updates. Event-loop slowdowns only trigger an update on their own once they’ve lasted at least a minute. Channel status changes and recovery appear on the next refresh.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176726](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176726) · [commit 1c50d30](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/1c50d30b28712cceaf1f35029316909987ce8613) · [Gateway health guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/health)
- Fixes Gateway admin snapshots reporting a configuration path different from the one the running Gateway uses.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176809](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176809) · [commit c928f1a](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c928f1a3a05daa017eb939fc33a1a7d49af4ea70)
- Fixes false prompt-cache warnings that said conversation history had been rewritten when only a Code Mode checkpoint changed.
  Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#176853](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176853) · [commit a770f7b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a770f7b309293288025539fc3b5da9a8cb2be726) · [Prompt-caching reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching)
- Fixes completed Claude CLI turns, including subagent turns, being left marked as active in diagnostics. That could trigger false stuck-session warnings and keep idle sessions from being cleaned up.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176875">#176875</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes missing cancellation reasons in OpenAI Responses diagnostics when a WebSocket request times out. Transport logs use fixed reason labels and omit raw provider error messages.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176915">#176915</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging">Transport logging</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Restores missing database wait times in native transaction reports. Fixes Linux worker-memory samples looking newer than they are when publishing the report is delayed.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176926">#176926</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics">Gateway diagnostics</a> · Thanks to [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).</span>
- Fixes Code Mode evaluation reports counting internal tool activity as calls visible to the model. The reports separate the two counts and distinguish zero from a missing measurement. Check the per-test results when comparing with older reports. [Code Mode troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/code-mode/troubleshooting)
  [#177083](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177083). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes `openclaw status --all` silently omitting unreadable Gateway or restart logs, and `openclaw status` failing to warn about unreadable plugin quarantine records. Check the reported log path and permissions, or run `openclaw doctor` when quarantine records cannot be read.
  [Unavailable logs #177316](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177316) · [commit 49c8d04](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/49c8d04bd68a6a49777b49ac615de91f3f1b3ea0) · [Quarantine records #177408](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177408) · [commit 808cb5d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/808cb5d124ccf003ec346809f64b3170b38dcd63) · [Status command](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing trajectory records for conversations that run entirely on the Claude CLI backend. New runs record prompts, answers, usage and outcomes by default unless you’ve turned trajectory capture off. [Trajectory guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/trajectory)
  [#178007](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178007) · Thanks [@hez2z](https://github.com/hez2z), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) (co-author), [@wherewolf87](https://github.com/wherewolf87) (report).
- Prevents false failure logs when shutdown cancels model discovery, prevents scheduled jobs from starting or blocks pending delivery recovery, and when expected session database cleanup runs during shutdown. It also avoids a false provider failure when a session reset or shutdown cancels an Activity recap. Genuine database maintenance errors include details.
  [Shutdown cancellation #178864](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178864) · [Database cleanup #178956](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178956) · [Activity recap cancellation #181382](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181382) · [commit 2fe4b72](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2fe4b7241b40fee1ae7f3aad29112299e88acc4c) · [Gateway logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging#expected-shutdown-cancellation) · Thanks [@joshavant](https://github.com/joshavant) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops Gateway logs from warning about an agent turn just because it takes a while. Warnings still flag slow waits and turns that leave other work waiting too long, and slow session changes and compactions are still reported. [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging)
  [#179234](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179234), [`7a0342f`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7a0342f55f962ae8bae982172bf6aac9e86e2ca8). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes busy Prometheus scrapes crowding out important run, model, tool, garbage collection and memory metrics. The exporter has more capacity and reserves room for these metrics and worker request and WebSocket breakdowns; it also counts and warns about drops by metric family.
  [Main-thread GC timings at startup #180103](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180103) · [commit cc4ca8d1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cc4ca8d1eaaa243afce5a70e54279b07665af7bb) · [Metric family retention #180117](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180117) · [commit b98018c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b98018c4433de6a471c7b9376156193debd91af9) · [Worker and WebSocket breakdowns #180146](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180146) · [commit fc525df](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fc525dfddb8ddc4d67bccf476a3e26cedcb6078c) · [Exporter capacity #180261](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180261) · [commit e8b4ced](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e8b4cedb7d16787e1a176b8ebb43519db7878f35) · [Heap and GC reservations #181169](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181169) · [commit 20e3d756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/20e3d75601d5f1282570362634ecb5372c71224c) · [Prometheus metrics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/prometheus.md) · [Exporter limits](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps repeated session phase messages in the file log without crowding the Gateway console, and identifies the request or scheduled task involved in session-row stalls when available. Slow-operation warnings remain visible.
  Subsystem loggers can use `consoleMessage: false` to keep individual records in the file log. [Console logging #180185](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180185) · [commit c02e09d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c02e09dd5cf0e1c2d3462390f84f8a445c0910c8) · [Session-row stall warnings #180239](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180239) · [commit da0de99](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/da0de99ddd8731f7380de148da2199555e51d315) · [Logging guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging) · [Gateway diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents Logbook from repeatedly requesting status and timeline updates when its view never finishes opening.
  [#181462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181462) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway memory diagnostics missing PostgreSQL bridge workers that run inside other workers. The bridge count includes nested bridges, and heap totals cover direct workers only. The two worker counts overlap, so use them separately. [Gateway memory diagnostics](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/diagnostics).
  Thanks to steipete. [#182036](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182036) · [b052b9736bca](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b052b9736bca156bda1e69b9391ffc6e06013d7f)
- Fixes diagnostics dropping reported usage from auxiliary model calls when their results are rejected or the caller cancels. Diagnostics tie usage for activity summaries to their sessions, and OpenTelemetry leaves unavailable token and cost figures out.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182298">#182298</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/vincentkoc">@vincentkoc</a>.
- Fixes native heap snapshots failing on runtimes that can take a snapshot but lack heap allocation sampling.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182379">#182379</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes security audit warnings that incorrectly say an externally supplied Gateway password or webhook token is stored in the config. Keep those values outside the configuration file and verify their storage directly, since a clean audit is insufficient evidence of where they’re stored. [Security audit](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/security)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182407">#182407</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62438">#62438</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) (author) and [@ahuray](https://github.com/ahuray) (reporter).
- Fixes queued diagnostic events changing after they were sent when the sender edits the original data. Reduces the work of delivering the same event to multiple consumers and skips queuing skill-use events when diagnostics are off and no trusted listener wants them.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182677](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182677) · [OpenTelemetry spans and events](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/opentelemetry/spans-and-events)
- Prevents the updated Prometheus exporter from retaining unrelated memory with metric labels or holding on to removed series after a scrape.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182804)
- Fixes activity recaps incorrectly reporting a missing model credential when your catalog includes multiple providers and the model selected for recaps already has usable credentials.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183197">#183197</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5181de212c10b558a87b5cb6e1f3aee30b459f47">Landed commit</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes PostgreSQL proxy diagnostics putting entries with no host last when counts tie. Fixes limited lists of failed incoming messages putting dated failures ahead of undated ones on PostgreSQL, which could leave the undated failures off the list.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183469">#183469</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/44347a81cfa15ddddd3b73151c570ecb75250fbd">44347a8</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes [Gateway stall profiles](https://docs.openclaw.ai/logging) including unrelated work that ran after the stall. Warnings and profiles show when the stall was observed and when it was reported.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183539](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183539)
- Records the available stack trace in the node’s local log when the node can’t prepare a command.
  [#183755](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183755). Thanks to [@etzelm](https://github.com/etzelm). [co-authored commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/026efa81b115155a2d2312451c6cb1e9e8251c39). [node troubleshooting](https://docs.openclaw.ai/nodes/troubleshooting).
- Shows which work is holding up a plugin reload in structured Gateway logs when those details are available. If the reload times out waiting, the logs now flag it as a warning.
  <span><a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging">Gateway logging</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183995">#183995</a>. Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Enforces the responsible operator’s model access for Activity recaps from sessions with a human owner or creator, including manual refreshes. When access is denied or revoked, OpenClaw skips new recap requests and keeps any existing recap visible.
  [Operator scopes](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/operator-scopes.md) · [#184279](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184279) · [dd704fe](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dd704fed5cc58d37ca693942c4fd889cdd429813). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Gateway diagnostics labeling unscoped session repairs as metadata writes.
  [#185379](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185379). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Corrects the [audit CLI guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/audit) so you can enable execution identity or message audit records while the Gateway is running. Audit settings already apply live and affect future events.
  [#185756](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185756) · [`70e36ce`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/70e36ceeb2ebd866d5ba82e70dfec2f6a937fead) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc)
- Prevents paths, names, and other values from changing terminal formatting in affected CLI text reports such as hook lists, plugin reports and Gateway status. Line breaks and tabs in those values appear as text. JSON still returns the original values.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185927">#185927</a> · Thanks to [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007), [@qingminglong](https://github.com/qingminglong)
- Fixes Gateway stall reports mislabeling a session-list or session-event operation as a roster update. [Gateway diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/diagnostics.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185954">#185954</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete)
- Fixes unnecessary memory retention after failures in paths such as opening the state database, looking up Codex sessions, and shutting down plugins or workers.
  [#186147](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186147) · [Commit eea1d352](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eea1d35267cbf60eb9b91099ba771514fab0b41c) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fills a gap in Prometheus memory reporting by including external and ArrayBuffer memory for session archive, reclamation and reusable cold-restore workers. External memory already includes the ArrayBuffer count.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186292">#186292</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/caf42beb2e70c64ba4b58fe4fb0479064d29f3ad">commit caf42be</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/prometheus">Prometheus worker memory</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Fixes Team Reports timing out too early when the system clock jumps forward during report generation. It also keeps scheduled reports from waiting longer than their usual one-minute retry when another report is running and the clock moves backward.
  [#186531](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186531), [#186534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186534). Thanks [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes [Team Reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/team-reports) silently garbling names from a roster file with invalid UTF-8. It now rejects the file and tells you to re-save it as UTF-8 before reloading the plugin.
  [#186902](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186902) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4983e46f3dc6d6a01623580ceb0ba01e16bbd60d) · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes PostgreSQL storage errors for session usage and cost records and for GitHub records in Team Reports.
  [PR #174786](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174786) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a11893ec5fdc9731e0c5c81adb3bec8156d96e9f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [Gateway status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/gateway/query) reporting the wrong configuration, expected service state or log location when you check an installed Gateway from a separate OpenClaw profile. Fixes Doctor on macOS looking for a stale updater in the wrong place in the same situation.
  [#187901](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187901). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Prevents one agent deletion from interrupting fresh Gateway health and status reports for other agents. [Health](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/health) and local [status](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/status) reports leave out deleted agents without losing the remaining agents’ session counts or recent sessions, even when they share a store. If the configured default agent is deleted, health shows a remaining agent’s heartbeat and session store without changing the configured default. Fixes health losing the remote Gateway’s session summary when the Gateway sends no per-agent summaries and no agents are configured locally.
  [PR #175119](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175119) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f5e84318bd2c1430670dcfc314a26fa13d12737f). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes diagnostic traces attributing a helper model request’s provider activity and rate-limit waits to the main request.
  [PR #187202](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187202). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes GitHub Copilot’s name and other non-secret identifiers appearing as asterisks in logs, diagnostics, and OpenTelemetry exports after a Copilot run. Credentials are still masked.
  [#173791](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173791) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/14c91595bef21de60a55db45d503dbb38d730ac0) · [issue #145627](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/145627) · [related issue #147118](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/147118). Thanks [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), [@pablonajera](https://github.com/pablonajera), and [@jason-allen-oneal](https://github.com/jason-allen-oneal).
- Fixes ambiguous entries in `/context detail` by showing the source path for workspace files that share a name, such as two `AGENTS.md` files.
  [PR #175386](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175386) and [issue #173950](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173950). Thanks [@ericcurtin](https://github.com/ericcurtin) and [@yigtwxx](https://github.com/Yigtwxx).
- Fixes images disappearing and going back to loading in expanded Logbook cards while you’re still viewing them.
  [PR #176460](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176460) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f2d438b35684cbb6912ce85b313267ea59c92bb) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Prevents the Gateway from starting too many Activity recaps at once while earlier recaps are still cleaning up. Fixes Gateway shutdown finishing before that cleanup is done.
  [PR #174295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174295) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7e8deb02b6b8934123346937e845e7a31fa54b29) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes CI sending requests to the production telemetry service when its URL is set explicitly. Custom test receivers still work.
  [#186569](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186569). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes [trajectory records](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/trajectory) that left out successful Codex tool outcomes or made an unknown outcome look complete. The records also keep more structured output and usage data within the existing limit, and retain the tool name and outcome when the result itself is too large to record.
  [PR #174398](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174398) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aded33b0cef1a063fa68e6fb4e1fc4b099d04241) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Makes short-lived CLI and backend connections easier to identify in [normal Gateway logs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/logging). Admitted operator and node connections use a single `client connected` entry. If your filters match `authenticated user connected` or `webchat connected`, update them to use the new message.
  [PR #174406](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174406) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5b4824b8c80bd250cc031a545799f93cad97b3bc) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes provider error text and response bodies from AI transport warnings and content previews from failed-response diagnostics. The `full-redacted` debug mode keeps request shape and tool names but no longer logs a copy of the request. The [debugging docs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/environment) also clarify that both streaming debug modes report timing, not event contents.
  [PR #174217](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174217). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Removes a duplicate log entry when Tlon fails to accept a direct-message invite automatically.
  [PR #174509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174509) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dbbc6da33dd8d11618feab9320ebcc822b19ec8a) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps malformed Codex response snippets, routine Codex error output and MCP server error output out of ordinary logs. Detailed Codex startup and connection diagnostics can still include a short error excerpt; MCP startup and connection failures keep their usual diagnostics.
  [Codex logs #174469](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174469) · [MCP logs #174497](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174497) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c20c28929a479fbd2b27f12c69abf08ba1d74646) · [MCP client](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/mcp) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Keeps error text and previews out of affected operational logs, including compaction, tool and plugin failures, web and media diagnostics, and voice calls. Tool results retain their original failure messages. Routine plugin command and hook startup messages are also removed.
  [Compaction, Gateway messages, Code Mode, web, media and voice logs #174476](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174476) · [Tool failure logs #174517](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174517) · [commit 18d6311](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/18d6311722985dc2006b7ee22e715284106437f9) · [Plugin command logs #175084](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175084) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Returns a redacted summary of where startup spent the most CPU time instead of an error when the full diagnostic profile is too large to send. If you call `diagnostics.cpuProfile` directly, handle the summary separately, since the CPU profile analyzer still needs a full capture. Review captures before sharing because recognized code symbols can remain visible.
  [PR #175313](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175313) · [Released commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/08b1e57318458bdeff07a5b44028e97832e01551) · [Diagnostics guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/diagnostics.md). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Developer tools and APIs

- Fixes ACP turns that could look like empty successes when the Gateway sent a failure explanation. ACP clients receive that explanation during the turn and when replaying the session. Partial replies that hit the output limit keep their text and are reported as cut short. [ACP CLI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/acp.md)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178057">#178057</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/82919eb7cc133d487518bcf83028376cafcf9e9b">82919eb7</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178032">#178032</a>. Thanks [@huyengiang101086-spec](https://github.com/huyengiang101086-spec) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix, and [@YiWang24](https://github.com/YiWang24) for the report.
- Returns a retryable 503 instead of a generic 500 when a Gateway HTTP request reaches an agent whose database is still starting. Clients should retry after the indicated delay.
  [#175133](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175133) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds an `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_READONLY` error detail so Gateway clients can distinguish a blocked write to externally managed settings directly. Nix mode keeps its own guidance.
  [#185299](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185299) · [2bf2340](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2bf234076397255f851422e1ea45b3b359eeee82). [Gateway configuration RPCs](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/protocol/rpc-talk-config-and-agents#secrets-config-update-and-wizard). Thanks [@stevenlee-oai](https://github.com/stevenlee-oai).
- Stops `openclaw infer model run --file` from silently discarding images when you run it locally with a text-only model. Use an image-capable model, run `openclaw infer image describe`, or add `--gateway` to have the image described for the text-only model.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176921">#176921</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/infer">Inference CLI</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes `openclaw infer embedding create` silently requesting the wrong model when `--provider` and the provider in `--model` disagree. The command now tells you which providers conflict. If the model ID itself contains a slash, include its provider prefix.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176959">#176959</a> · <a href="https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/infer">Inference CLI</a> · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes [MCP connection checks](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/json-output) reporting success when OpenClaw cannot confirm that the local connection closed. `mcp probe` exits with an error, `mcp doctor --probe` flags the failure, and `mcp add` and `mcp configure --probe` do not save settings after failed local cleanup. A Streamable HTTP server that does not confirm its session ended only triggers a warning if the local connection closed. If local cleanup fails, rerun the command and restart the process owning the connection if it still fails.
  [#173830](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173830), [cleanup policy](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/791621be9e050bb12ad221d74905cee7e11bfd71), [CLI alignment](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5f771be300fdcaf18c79ea08a4a4b6b2351c1424). Thanks to montrellcruse. · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182584) · [MCP CLI cleanup guidance](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/mcp/json-output)
- Enforces the existing limit of four simultaneous resource requests on the same MCP form. New requests can proceed once a slot frees up.
  [#178017](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178017) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a repeated SDK connection close reporting success after the original close failed.
  [#177606](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177606) · [16aee921](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/16aee9219d04a2bad2e076a018e2c21f06f802e6). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes late resource errors being reported as cleanup failures before OpenClaw knows whether cleanup succeeded. OpenClaw still reports the original error separately.
  Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177526">#177526</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/dfff19c4f331c57727331f5f0f3cd9dd02d0efa8">Commit dfff19c</a>
- Prevents untrusted names, paths and other text from changing terminal formatting in session and node reports, `status --all`, marketplace plugin listings, [Policy CLI reports](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/policy/running-checks), and affected plugin, secrets, memory, wiki, Workboard, backup, pairing, path, configuration and setup reports. JSON output in session and node reports and JSON and raw exports in the affected CLI reports retain their original values. If a session ID looks different in a terminal report, its suggested memory cleanup command may require the original ID.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176638">#176638</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/91e371698fe01519a2c225dc3e9877f14692742b">91e37169</a>. - Keeps the steps for fixing human-readable hooks errors on separate lines when OpenClaw strips unsafe terminal formatting.
  [Source commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/fbd7cbc464b19eb5e8fd4069e04b80079a8240f9). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
