  Thanks to loading2332 and steipete. [#180678](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180678) · [89bc6de](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/89bc6de4583cb2b3fd70a6bb52dd1a5e1db202c9) · [#186574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186574). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus. · [PR #174529](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174529) · [commit 157e5b0](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/157e5b0b51a1bfe02e3d507e7a3b38b0e831e8a9). Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@Takhoffman](https://github.com/Takhoffman).
- Fixes PowerShell suggesting filenames or top-level options after a quoted OpenClaw subcommand. Regenerate your PowerShell completion script to get suggestions for the correct subcommand.
  [#177584](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177584) · [e986481f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e986481fc31e36c350e85ae60de1d350dfdc3876). Thanks to [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Restores missing `--help` and `-h` suggestions in shell completion for `openclaw` and its subcommands where those flags are available. If you use a cached completion script, refresh it with `openclaw completion --write-state` to pick up the change.
  [#187799](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187799). Thanks to [@bajiaoshan](https://github.com/bajiaoshan), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw completion --install` giving a generic error when the completion cache is missing. It now shows the missing path and tells you to run `openclaw completion --write-state` before retrying.
  Thanks [@SebTardif](https://github.com/SebTardif), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus) and [@zyw02](https://github.com/zyw02). [#184191](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184191) · [9e173826901b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e173826901b42b487f7aa2cb9a053169c308e16) · [issue #184135](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/184135)
- Fixes CLI help showing the parent command when the requested subcommand name follows `--`. For example, `openclaw help plugins -- list` opens help for `plugins list`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177013">#177013</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/50ff12b5a6801f5a344778691137a6f2c5ea880e">Co-authored commit</a> · Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise).</span>
- Fixes invalid or empty `openclaw proxy query --preset` values appearing to succeed with empty results. The command lists the accepted choices, including in JSON mode.
  [Proxy CLI reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/proxy) [#136158](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/136158) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw dashboard` reporting success to scripts when it fails to prepare a URL. Failed preparation exits with status `1`, and an explicit decline at the recovery prompt exits successfully.
  [#171753](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/171753) · Thanks [@zhangguiping-xydt](https://github.com/zhangguiping-xydt) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes mistyped or unknown top-level `openclaw` commands loading unrelated plugins before reporting the error. OpenClaw may still load older plugins that do not declare their commands to check whether one provides the command.
  [PR #175363](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175363) and [issue #173478](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173478). Thanks [@alkor2000](https://github.com/alkor2000), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus), and [@Tosko4](https://github.com/Tosko4).
- Fixes quoted special keys in path commands returning the wrong value, changing the wrong JSONC, JSONL or YAML data, or writing the wrong value type. See the [path command reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path).
  Quote literal keys such as `$first` and `$last`. Thanks to [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172382](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172382) · [ae55909](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ae55909c90267aaaf48f03a25883a1f6faa061e9)
- Fixes JSONL path edits and appends changing unrelated numbers or discarding untouched text.
  Thanks to [@fhgffy](https://github.com/fhgffy) and [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#172410](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172410) · [a0c056b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a0c056b30543cce1279855b93efb73bc8ca042ab)
- Fixes YAML path edits rejecting scientific notation returned by `path resolve` for existing numeric fields.
  Thanks to [@linzeshi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#172567](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172567) · [b121952](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b121952b58f029638572ccb123bbaceffddf10c2)
- Fixes `path find` union searches that skipped quoted keys containing commas or rejected valid quoted keys as malformed, including in nested unions.
  Thanks [@linzeshi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [#176332](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176332), [5c63a88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5c63a88ad20d9696b211546289b9765a4c64cbc4).
- Fixes `oc-path` wildcard searches missing children beneath quoted array indexes in JSON, JSONC, JSONL, and YAML. Matching paths keep the quotes and can be used with `path resolve`.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181861">#181861</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/22a311919bab0057bde6ee941466af743c21efab">22a31191</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/LinzeShi">@LinzeShi</a> and <a href="https://github.com/obviyus">@obviyus</a>.</span>
- Fixes [`openclaw path`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path) skipping empty-string object keys in searches and rejecting quoted paths to those keys when reading or editing JSONC, JSONL, or YAML.
  [#175754](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175754) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9fd61f332844d94c0444768c6ea158cc6a9a34b8). Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Prevents `path set` from reporting success and adding a duplicate when inserting at an existing `true`, `false`, or `null` key in YAML. The edit reports an error and leaves the file unchanged.
  [PR #186983](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186983). Thanks [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw path resolve` and `openclaw path set` rejecting dotted insertion paths in JSON, JSONC, and YAML. You can add a key or insert or append an array item where the parent already exists.
  [#187828](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187828). Thanks to [@LinzeShi](https://github.com/LinzeShi), [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes `openclaw config validate` and `openclaw config get` delaying errors for known retired settings until after plugin migration checks. Their JSON errors also include a `repairHint` alongside `error.message`.
  [#178289](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178289) · [commit eeb9d14](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eeb9d148cc8660ced873454237237f043a199f21) · [Configuration CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/config) · [issue #178177](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/178177). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@jirboy](https://github.com/JIRBOY) for the report.
- Fixes [`openclaw config patch --stdin`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/config) hanging after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM while waiting for input. Interrupting that wait exits without applying the pending patch.
  [PR #187336](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187336). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Adds the rejection reason to the configuration warning shown during directory inspection.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/167326">PR #167326</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/634ca9ee00f8f8ae2f71ed9a3cc4f6c297da3589">`634ca9e`</a> · Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/ruel225">@ruel225</a>, <a href="https://github.com/NovaUnboundAi">@NovaUnboundAi</a>, <a href="https://github.com/JIRBOY">@JIRBOY</a>.</span>
- Restores the reason and advice to retry when a command reports an internal state ownership error. If the error persists, the CLI tells you to report it.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176191">#176191</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/104730ba84765f16915cfe2150b368e6344a019d">Commit 104730b</a>
- Fixes [browser CLI commands](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/browser) returning nothing to scripts that requested `--json` when a viewport or browser state setting was rejected. Scripts now get a JSON error for failures such as invalid viewport dimensions, invalid geolocation settings, or a missing cookie URL.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183366">#183366</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d2e26080fad33d5c9b03c8114eee3770c82bf90e">d2e2608</a> · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).</span>
- Fixes [`openclaw memory status`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/memory) returning nothing to scripts that request `--json` with `--deep`, `--index`, or `--fix` when another plugin provides memory. The refusal now comes with a JSON error naming the plugin.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183373">#183373</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d4a17a6bfaf7977afce3c703b731ff5e0547baf0">d4a17a6</a> · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).</span>
- Corrects the [system CLI reference](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/system) to explain valid session targets and how to address a configured agent’s session. It also clarifies that `system event` returns when the Gateway accepts the event, heartbeat completion happens separately, and `--expect-final` has no effect on system commands.
  Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise) for the correction, and to [@khancold](https://github.com/KhanCold) for reporting it. [#172353](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172353) · [bbb775b](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bbb775bd011b435f51a0d0ee2df2b51285f16761) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176120">#176120</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcfc4cced99385b18b215b43f168f71a949d5196">Commit bcfc4cc</a>
- Corrects the `openclaw docs` reference to show that you can run the command without a search query. [Docs CLI reference](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/v2026.11.5/docs/cli/docs.md)
  Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd) and [@gideonpraise](https://github.com/gideonpraise). <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176205">#176205</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/28f97f236f882af739aac9f0e6e77d83b2da2a7c">Commit 28f97f2</a>
- Fixes `openclaw agent exec` leaving temporary state behind when interrupted with Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. The command waits for cleanup before exiting and keeps any state directory you supplied. This cleanup requires a cooperative interruption.
  [#173761](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173761) · [Agent CLI](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/agent) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes `openclaw policy watch` waiting for the next check after Ctrl-C or a service stop. An already running check finishes before exit without printing another report.
  [#186562](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186562). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Fixes [`system presence` and `system heartbeat last`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/system) continuing to wait and print results after Ctrl-C or SIGTERM. Fixes the same interruption problem in [ClawHub skill search and Trending](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/skills). System events and heartbeat changes already accepted by the Gateway still wait for their receipts.
  [PR #187504](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187504). Thanks to alix-007 and obviyus.
- Keeps compile-cache cleanup running after short CLI commands exit, reducing disk buildup without making commands wait. Large backlogs may take several passes, and cache size and retention targets are best effort.
  [#173603](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173603) · [c335f9c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c335f9ca886e6a63619c2854851079777cb2aa4a) · [Issue #173568](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/173568) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete), [@personaltrainerkoichan](https://github.com/personaltrainerkoichan).
- Fixes completed tools still appearing to run in ClickClack when an earlier progress update is slow to arrive.
  [#178895](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178895). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Surfaces unexpected errors from the ClickClack progress logger callback to its caller.
  [#178843](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178843). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes Settings preparation errors when building the Control UI from source on Windows, from a checkout path containing `#`, or in parallel from the same checkout.
  [#174686](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174686) · [`648150a`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/648150a68b4a0c0ee615a2f3ed04024d8ff92a47). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). · [#175839](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175839) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ab421e3c8043dfac4c10c4d0ffa170e7e926bb80). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes repeat Control UI builds from source rebundling unchanged files when you use the default build cache. This applies to `pnpm ui:build` and the UI step of `pnpm build`.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176620">#176620</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c2d09f31dab7ab2fd5a453fdcafd3e4e6e00816e">c2d09f31</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Restores hot reload on affected macOS development hosts when you start the Control UI with `CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=1 pnpm ui:dev`. Polling uses more CPU.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179260">#179260</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes the UI development launcher cutting Vite off during a normal shutdown. It gives Vite up to five seconds to finish before forcing it to stop.
  [#187713](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187713). Thanks to [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes active replies being cut off early when you stop a development Gateway running from source or its watcher replaces it. Replies get the normal Gateway shutdown window to finish and save.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182281">#182281</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes a running source Gateway shutting down when you run another `pnpm openclaw` or `pnpm dev` command from the same checkout with uncommitted build inputs that haven’t changed since the last build. Changes to build inputs still trigger a rebuild and can stop the running Gateway.
  [#186246](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186246) · [Commit 80ee5917](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/80ee5917c7be28eb28506d383167baa8235a16ec) · [Source setup guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/start/setup) · Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Lets you retry extension-boundary preparation after a cancelled source build once the build has verified that it can release its artifact claims.
  [#173536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173536) · [c87f400](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c87f400b27f3ee20f57ae728f50be548802b90fa) · Thanks [@fuller-stack-dev](https://github.com/fuller-stack-dev).
- Includes the file watcher required by the updated dependency in portable worker archives, fixing the missing-file validation error during packaging.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176640">#176640</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b5d3c98ba9dfd7f99e9d00ec2e2c083eef99f81">8b5d3c98</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes the experimental standalone builder rejecting compatible Bun compilers that use the current AOT option.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182309">#182309</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Fixes [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) failing at the operating system’s argument limit when you select many plugins or modules. This covers JIT and bytecode builds, including the JIT companion in an AOT build.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183582](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183582)
- Fixes experimental [standalone AOT builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) from TypeScript source failing validation on code the app won’t use, including unused files and unused exports in shared files.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183575](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183575) · [#183654](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183654)
- Fixes type-checking errors in experimental standalone builds from source with `--aot-source`.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183689](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183689)
- Prevents a string-length error before native compilation when building standalone OpenClaw from generated JavaScript in JIT or experimental AOT mode.
  [#183724](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183724). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [compilation modes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone#choose-a-compilation-mode).
- Fixes [standalone builds](https://docs.openclaw.ai/install/standalone) producing different plugin loaders, split-module names or contents across directories with the same inputs. Runtime scripts in source checkouts also avoid treating matching builds as out of date just because the pnpm virtual store is outside the checkout.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183489">#183489</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c887adba97b6ee6a9c7817564c69cad31f976ca1">c887adb</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/install/standalone.md">Standalone builds</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span> · <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183493">#183493</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/60c3a7c35283dd6377baff1e6ab137d1e0e96c0d">60c3a7c</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span> · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183536](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183536) · [#183570](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183570)
- Fixes LanceDB memory writes, OpenAI Realtime codec loading, and QA Lab Feishu frame handling failing on hosts that disallow JavaScript string compilation.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182335">#182335</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes failures when evaluating a browser page or element or waiting for a page condition on hosts that disallow JavaScript string compilation. On those hosts, Code Mode also stops mistaking valid JavaScript for shell input, and Codex keeps supported command and patch actions visible in the transcript. [Browser control](https://docs.openclaw.ai/tools/browser-control)
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182341">#182341</a>. Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes logger imports failing in browser-like runtimes that provide a partial Node `process` API.
  [#186591](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186591). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes Buzz QA reading the wrong credential file or failing when its path has leading or trailing spaces.
  Thanks to [@SunnyShu0925](https://github.com/SunnyShu0925). [#172283](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172283) · [d8d8e12](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d8d8e12784bbc947279d4a839f1e3684f896c5f8)
- Shows an error in QA Lab when copying capture data, deleting selected captures, or purging all captures fails. Failed deletions keep your selection. QA Lab skips overlapping actions and keeps the current action marked as busy until it finishes.
  [#177578](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177578) · [9e714bdb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9e714bdb8bbe29e48fdd13ce392578d84047a44a). Thanks to [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops QA Lab runs from buffering Gateway logs indefinitely when a debug log file cannot keep up. The suite reports a log backlog error and stops the Gateway it started. Check the output disk before retrying. [QA Lab runners](https://docs.openclaw.ai/help/testing/qa-runners).
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#182132](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182132) · [`232ca2aa`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/232ca2aaf055addb16c8d1231c922e40a8b8347e)
- Fixes live QA runs rejecting or ignoring provider overrides written in OpenClaw’s usual JSON5 format. Live Multipass runs also keep supported custom-provider keys and Anthropic setup tokens that could previously be left behind.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182280">#182280</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Stops the QA Lab coverage command overwriting a completed suite summary when report output points to the same file, even through a link.
  [#186743](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186743). Thanks to Alix-007 and obviyus.
- Prevents GitHub stale cleanup from acting on an old warning after someone resumes work on an issue or pull request. The [scheduled workflows guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/ci/scheduled-workflows.md) explains the notice and response periods.
  [#177120](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177120). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Prevents normal ACP shutdown from dropping session updates already accepted for replay. If a write fails and replay is incomplete, reopening the session can use the transcript instead.
  [ACP replay #176015](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176015) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes `openclaw path --json` leaving stdout empty when it refuses a path or file operation. Refusals still exit with an error; scripts that parsed the JSON on stderr should read stdout and use the [updated error format](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/path).
  [Path JSON errors #176018](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176018) · Thanks [@Leon-SK668](https://github.com/Leon-SK668) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes interrupted CLI commands, including Doctor maintenance, reporting only a generic cancellation when OpenClaw knows why they stopped. Update failure records keep the known reason too.
  [Interruption reasons #186903](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186903) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6a2b56560cac16e0d29245234b7e23c56ba4f695) · Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes [`openclaw docs`](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/docs) continuing a search and printing results after you interrupt it with Ctrl-C or SIGTERM.
  [Documentation search #186906](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186906) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/cfa38e1a98ff96464bc8c8e6b4982dc47172f437) · Thanks [@Alix-007](https://github.com/Alix-007) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus).
- Fixes [ACP conversations](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/acp) getting stuck on a question the client cannot show. The assistant can ask in ordinary text instead, and a later turn from a client that supports structured questions restores that option in the same session.
  [ACP questions #186653](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186653) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete) for the fix and [@YiWang24](https://github.com/YiWang24) for the report.
- Fixes Code Mode reporting rejected storage keys or writes over the storage limit as internal errors. An oversized write explains how to make room or save less, and worker diagnostics distinguish more failure types. See the [guest API guide](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/tools/code-mode/guest-api.md).
  [Storage errors #185959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185959) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes missing text at the end of streamed ACP replies.
  [Streaming fix](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/e0430c8f30dfc98df47b6a84996d8ee3fe4da858) · Thanks [@RomneyDa](https://github.com/RomneyDa) and [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).

##### Cloud workers

- Fixes [node worker dispatch](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/dispatching-a-session) failing or starting from the wrong Git state when the selected commit isn’t available from the remote. The worker gets the Gateway’s workspace snapshot, including the local commit it was based on. It also fixes [cloud worker turns](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/session-lifecycle) missing new files staged with `git add` on the Gateway after dispatch. The next turn sees those files in local workspaces dispatched from the Gateway and preserves independent worker edits. New unstaged files need a fresh dispatch.
  [Dispatch from local Git state #185420](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185420) · [Staged files on later turns #185424](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185424) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes retired Crabbox warm images staying billable after Crabbox confirms their worker lease has ended. Cleanup retries pending deletions while protecting active work and leases Crabbox cannot confirm are gone.
  [Warm-image cleanup #185485](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185485) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [Warm-image recovery](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/cloud-workers/warm-images) also clears the hold left by an interrupted capture’s source lease when recovery is acknowledged or Crabbox confirms it has ended. Periodic cleanup recognizes the same compatible bundled Crabbox installations as Gateway startup.

##### Reef

- Fixes duplicate audit entries when Reef retries an unmatched delivery receipt after an audit write fails. Replaying receipts it cannot match to an outgoing delivery also takes less database work.
  [Receipt replay #183329](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183329) · [Commit eda5705](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/eda570538115236da724db5943f498a853f6ab79) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).

##### Help and documentation

- Fixes `openclaw docs` showing a JavaScript error when the search service returns `null`. It now tells you the response is missing the expected results list.
  [#181055](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181055) · [Documentation search](https://docs.openclaw.ai/cli/docs) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes repeated “More details” headings breaking up fix lists in generated Markdown release notes, keeping source links and contributor thanks with each fix.
  [#178733](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178733) · [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f0631ecd936cd306552936081748e80f1b6250c7) · Thanks [@hannesrudolph](https://github.com/hannesrudolph).

##### GitHub publishing and pull requests

- Reduces timeouts and slow loading when opening GitHub publishing options, including when many clients reconnect at once.
  Concurrent publication status reads. [#173534](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173534) · [6574349](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6574349e132d11db684392cfd1ef8cb9f32598e6) · [#173589](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/173589) · [4cf3df6](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4cf3df6352cea03d80bf0ff35758503089ba30db) · First-load performance. [#182000](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182000) · [c0adfa67d6a8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c0adfa67d6a8a914f4ee4369a56c3031d797303d) · Shared options for a connected session. <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179308">#179308</a> · <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a> · Publishing option reads. [#186163](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186163) · [Commit 66836335](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6683633577343728c7c859227e72944c55decc99). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat continuing to load checks for the previous pull request when you switch sessions, change PR revisions, or change Gateway connections. It also prevents a CI automation toggle for the previous session from acting on the new one.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176554">#176554</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f6d27e29547d63387bc5f14f96cf2b144bb2d9bd">f6d27e29</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes managed GitHub commands failing in PowerShell when profile paths or launch arguments contain curly apostrophes.
  [#178215](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178215) · [commit f7968d7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f7968d7f0f9a7e36a608bbfc9abf1ea3a105c464). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Corrects the managed worktree error when you supply a directory outside a Git checkout without a project Git URL. The message names the directory you specified.
  [#178664](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178664) · [`19753a7`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/19753a7f33bcfafe252ca5bb89db9ec5d972ee25) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops offering sandbox-only base refresh and evidence upload in direct GitHub publishing sessions. If you need to bring in changes from the base branch in a direct session, merge it with Git before publishing. [Managed worktree guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees)
  [#178671](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/178671) · [`503ae08`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/503ae08b7b16f62492914c8107dcf350b962b724) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes a stale **Try again** button in chat’s pull request automation. If the retry action changes while the error stays on screen, the button uses the current action.
  <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179397">#179397</a> · Thanks <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.
- Keeps GitHub pull request preparation out of sessions that can’t use it, including sessions running directly on the host. If you pass a pull request link to the wrong action in one of those sessions, the tool points you to inspection. [GitHub identity guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity)
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/179725">#179725</a> · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes Chat showing **Interrupted** when GitHub pull request preparation starts successfully and the conversation continues. Permission prompts still appear when tool details are hidden.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180538">PR #180538</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/936599f036fb3cd085584671e88f9d41b6f22243">Commit 936599f</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180524">Issue #180524</a>. Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes broken links in Control UI notices about prepared pull requests. The link opens the original pull request and leaves the details that follow readable.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180507">PR #180507</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4d270d3bfd708be964b39558cb02b038380cc4f0">Commit 4d270d3</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/180496">Issue #180496</a>. Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).</span>
- Fixes split Chat panes showing an account picker or an active **Publish** button after you start publishing a GitHub pull request. Other panes showing the same session lock the chosen account and show that publishing is in progress.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180438">PR #180438</a> · <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/83d9dc1ca09eb3c4e7a574f169905ccb628d5a5f">Commit 83d9dc1</a>. Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).</span>
- Fixes later errors replacing the first one when several pull request CI automation changes fail in chat. If OpenClaw can’t confirm a change, the controls pause and Retry refreshes the current settings so you can see whether the change went through.
  [#180747](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180747) · [commit a7958bd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7958bd9d54350bd2ba5c7f5c8686614f8e87ffe) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Clears pending GitHub publication feedback when you leave a chat while letting publication continue. If it finishes while you’re away, you can see the result when you return.
  [#180812](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180812) · [commit 5ce3f4f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5ce3f4f395712a1a3e2120044c4195e3a704d8ab) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes chat showing **Retry** while your pull request is still being created. The status reads **Creating**, and the published link, action menu and keyboard focus stay in place as the title and checks load. Hiding a different pull request leaves the one you just published in Details.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181855">#181855</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2b663a4a6758817bc8d0fdc5fa0fd13b982faa55">2b663a4a</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/vyctorbrzezowski">@vyctorbrzezowski</a>.</span>
- Keeps the failure details and recovery information available when sharing to GitHub fails before saving a workspace snapshot, even if OpenClaw can’t look up pull requests.
  <span><a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181894">#181894</a>, <a href="https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6233762a3defec0a5ee86bb26d85ae03b502cb94">6233762a</a>. Thanks to <a href="https://github.com/steipete">@steipete</a>.</span>
- Spaces out automatic retries when OpenClaw can’t confirm a GitHub pull request or repository checkpoint publication. While a retry is pending, publication status shows the latest error and when OpenClaw will try again. Check the original branch or pull request before submitting a replacement.
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#183646](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183646)
- Fixes pull requests missing from Control UI sessions when the branch tracks a fork on another remote on the same GitHub host. Sessions board rules can use the pull request’s status for those sessions too.
  [#183804](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183804). Thanks to [@PratikRai0101](https://github.com/PratikRai0101) and [@obviyus](https://github.com/obviyus). [report](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/183747). Thanks to [@holgergruenhagen](https://github.com/holgergruenhagen).
- Keeps GitHub publishing tools and their instructions stable when the same session switches between interactive and background turns, as long as its publishing and workspace capabilities stay the same. This avoids one cause of prompt-cache misses. [Prompt caching guide](https://docs.openclaw.ai/reference/prompt-caching)
  Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete). [#184144](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184144) · [77d0f72273cb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/77d0f72273cb1aaeb21e8e84e6e0742d14de2c03)
- Enforces the initiating caller’s current [operator write permission](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) for privileged GitHub pull-request actions, including inspection, merge, close and marking a delegated draft ready.
  [#184366](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/184366), [commit 116452f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/116452f6ea7098e55bb46c6a26fc111d3fa834ac). Thanks [@vincentkoc](https://github.com/vincentkoc).
- Fixes GitHub publishing rejecting a conversation’s own managed worktree as the wrong checkout. In a conversation that already has a checkout, omit `workspacePath` or use the managed worktree’s path. Use a separate conversation for a different checkout. [Publish with your account](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/concepts/user-model.md#publish-with-your-account).
  [#185203](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185203) · [90e2278](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/90e227861c32575c053bb05692886f41f9594703) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Stops unconfirmed GitHub publications and repository pushes from retrying indefinitely and blocking another publication. If OpenClaw still cannot confirm what happened, it says so and keeps your saved work. Check the original branch or pull request before trying again, because GitHub may already have accepted the change.
  [#185566](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/185566) · [4633c4d](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/4633c4d17fa4bfd1e502c606f47ede385e54223f) · [Publication recovery](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/e13cf15ece9bbd969b7362927c315362c90c97ff/docs/gateway/protocol/rpc-session-control.md) · Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Fixes guests being unable to continue an imported GitHub pull request after its author changes the destination branch. Preparing the pull request again updates the review comparison without losing your edits, staged changes or commits, as long as the source branch hasn’t changed.
  [#186451](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186451), [issue #186442](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/186442). Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes [base refresh](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/managed-worktrees) using an old branch after you retarget an open pull request originally published from the conversation. Refresh follows the new destination, keeps saved work and continues updating the same PR.
  [#186632](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186632). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Reports a confirmed GitHub push rejection as a failure instead of leaving publication unconfirmed. The message names the account and repository and suggests checking branch rules, granting write access or using an owned fork before retrying.
  [#186657](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186657). Thanks to steipete.
- Fixes retries of interrupted GitHub PR updates that could open a replacement PR or fail after the original closed. Recovery keeps an accepted update with the original PR without disturbing later local work.
  [#186717](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186717). Thanks to shakkernerd.
- Replaces generic GitHub publishing errors with the specific reason and next step when the reason is known, without repeating the failure heading. If the worktree is on a different branch, the notice names both branches and tells you how to get back to the session’s branch before retrying.
  [PR #186984](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186984). Thanks [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).
- Removes a mistaken admin requirement when authorized session writers publish a checkout their session already owns outside the agent’s default workspace.
  [#187660](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/187660). Thanks to [@VACInc](https://github.com/VACInc).
- Shows the available error details, with sensitive information removed, when OpenClaw can’t confirm a GitHub PR edit, a request to mark it ready for review, a close, or a merge. An unconfirmed action may already have completed, so inspect the PR before retrying.
  [#175222](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175222) · Thanks shakkernerd.
- Fixes [GitHub publication requests](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) being unavailable on the first turn of an eligible managed Gateway conversation, even when that turn can already edit the repository. The usual access checks still apply.
  [#175932](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175932) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes [managed GitHub squash merges](https://docs.openclaw.ai/gateway/config-tools/github-identity) using the original commit subject instead of the pull request title edited during review.
  [PR #176071](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176071) · [Commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/559161db9c03d96f97a58fdb6bfb9b53de27bd4c) · Thanks [@shakkernerd](https://github.com/shakkernerd).
- Fixes GitHub publishing incorrectly refusing to proceed because it thinks a long-running local session has changed.
  [PR #186321](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186321), [commit](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5fddba9d091277d19e3a38a5e2e51918717f0b0b). Thanks to [@jalehman](https://github.com/jalehman).

##### GitHub lookups

- Fixes pull request previews staying open after the reader shows a PR as merged, and hovercards showing older status or change counts after the reader has fetched newer details. A failed or stale refresh keeps the cached label.
  [Merged status #172910](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/172910) · [Hovercard updates #180023](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/180023) · [commit 5a9fa922](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/5a9fa922f96f23c99627553cc22a122c1c643f12). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
- Adds the missing preview when you hover over or focus a supported GitHub commit link in Control UI chat, so you can see the commit title, author and change counts without opening it. This includes GitHub Enterprise links the session already has access to.
  [Commit previews #182224](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182224). Thanks [@steipete](https://github.com/steipete).
